resource consumption. **Quality, Security, and Collaboration** * Create meaningful tests and evaluation datasets for AI features. * Assess response accuracy, tool\-use correctness, reliability, Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and MLOps practices * Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, and statistical modeling * Experience with SQL/NoSQL databases  Experience building or consuming REST APIs and working with JSON. * Familiarity with AI agent tool calling and workflow orchestration. * Understanding of MCP concepts and how MCP servers connect AI applications to tools and resources. * Working knowledge of SQL, data processing, and application integration. * Experience with at least one major cloud platform: Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud. * jobs.title: Agentic AI/LLM Engineer, Coverage Intelligence
jobs.description: **YOUR ROLE** As an Agentic AI / LLM Engineer on the Coverage Intelligence team, you design and build the AI systems that turn complex insurance documents into reliable, explainable coverage intelligence inside the Digital Exchange, powered by DeX ai. You own problems end to end, from understanding unstructured documents to building agents that reason about coverage, and you hold that work to a measurable standard of accuracy. You work alongside our coverage and ontology specialists and help shape how the team builds with AI as the technology evolves. **WHAT YOU'LL DO** * Design, build and own production AI systems for document understanding and coverage analysis. * Build agentic workflows that combine models, tools and human review, and recognize when a decision needs an expert. * Ground outputs in source documents and domain knowledge so every result is traceable and explainable. * Drive accuracy through evaluation, experimentation and error analysis against expert\-labeled data. * Make sound trade\-offs across models and providers on accuracy, cost and latency. * Partner with domain experts and engineers to turn expert judgment into durable system behavior. * Help set the team’s technical direction as LLM and agent capabilities evolve. * Other duties and responsibilities as assigned. **YOUR LOCATION** This is a fully remote role, with the exception of onboarding and optional in\-office events. **SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS** * 5\+ years’ experience in software engineering or applied machine learning, including 2\+ years building LLM applications in production. * Strong Python skills, including typed schemas for structured output (e.g., Pydantic). * Hands\-on experience extracting structured data from complex documents using PDF parsing, OCR and vision\-language models. * Experience with agentic patterns such as tool use, multi\-step workflows, self\-verification and human\-in\-the\-loop review. * Experience with retrieval\-augmented generation, embeddings and source\-grounded output. * A rigorous approach to evaluation: defining metrics, building test sets and doing systematic error analysis. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including working directly with domain experts. * Works autonomously with minimal direction, sets a clear path through ambiguity, and holds a high bar for quality. * Thrives on the energy of a start up: comfortable with pace, changing priorities, and building the function while running it. * Experience with insurance, legal, financial or other contract\-heavy documents (strongly preferred). * Experience with LangGraph or similar agent frameworks (preferred). * Experience with LLM observability and evaluation tooling (preferred). **Physical Requirements** * Must be able to sit/stand/walk for prolonged periods of time (up to 8 hours per day), at a desk working on a computer. * Must be able to use standard office equipment for extended periods of time, including but not limited to, a mouse, keyboard, phone and video conferencing. * Must be able to travel to the Bold Penguin office in Dublin, Ohio for New Hire Onboarding \& Orientation (2 days, 2 nights); travel costs are covered by Bold Penguin. * Must be able to travel occasionally (up to 10%) for corporate events and team planning sessions. Bold Penguin is the premier digital broker for commercial insurance. Their technology expands top\-of\-funnel demand and increases yield for enterprise partners. Through digital distribution, wholesale capabilities, and AI\-driven insights, they transform the lifecycle of both simple and complex risks, from prospecting to placement. **Benefits** We offer competitive compensation and progressive benefits that include: * Medical, Dental, and Vision * Flexible PTO Policy * 401(k) with a company match * Employee Assistance Program * Parental Leave * Disability and Life Benefits **Stay connected to the Glacier.** We have great SLACK channels for work and play. To learn more about our results\-focused culture and employee\-focused perks, read more on our **careers page**.

jobs.title: Applied Science DevOps Lead
jobs.description: **Why Join Stand****:** At Stand, you’ll help build a new class of global property protection. We use advanced physics and AI to model catastrophic risk at the asset level, then automate underwriting and mitigation before loss occurs. Insurance is simply the current delivery mechanism. The real product is a scalable risk engine, our **Stand World Model**. We stay when traditional insurers exit. We model what others approximate. And we build systems that change outcomes, not just prices. Our **leadership team** includes former successful founders and CEOs from Metromile, PolicyGenius, WePay, and HotelTonight, bringing deep experience in building and scaling high\-growth companies. **Background:** The property insurance industry is built to price loss after it happens. It relies on coarse proxies, backward\-looking data, and manual processes, then accepts damage as unavoidable. Stand takes a different approach. We simulate how real\-world catastrophes affect individual properties, translate that into actionable decisions, and automate the business around it. The result is a platform that can underwrite what others can’t and operate with far less friction. **Role Summary:** As the **Applied Science DevOps Lead**, you’ll lead the platform sub\-team within Applied Science that helps build, deploys, and supports Stand’s flagship physics simulations, digital twins, AI/ML models, and spatial intelligence. You’ll own the technical direction, planning, and execution of critical platform initiatives — ensuring they align with Applied Science and companywide stakeholders, ship on schedule, and deliver measurable outcomes. The role spans production AI training and inference, simulation pipelines, infrastructure and CI/CD reliability, geospatial data processing, annotation and QC systems, and new digital\-twin capabilities that support Stand’s expansion into new geographies and perils (e.g., hurricane). This is a player\-coach role, combining direct technical work with the leadership around it: people management, project planning, cross\-team coordination, and process. Reporting to the Chief Science Officer, you’ll own key projects yourself while ensuring the broader sub\-team operates effectively, grows, and delivers real impact. You’re the person who looks around corners, sees what the business needs, and turns “the business needs X” into “the team builds Y.” You’ll partner closely with Physics Simulation Engineers, Machine Learning Engineers, and peril\-specific SMEs to keep our simulation, AI, and geospatial pipelines reliable, observable, and scalable. **What You'll Do:** * **Lead the platform sub\-team**: set priorities, coordinate execution, and unblock the team to deliver on critical software and infrastructure initiatives. * **Manage and grow the team**: run 1:1s and growth conversations, give direct and timely feedback, manage performance, and mentor engineers as the team scales. * **Design, build, and scale core systems** spanning physics simulation, AI, digital twins, computer vision, and spatial intelligence, contributing directly to core components. * **Own production pipelines**: debug, monitor, and resolve issues to improve uptime and reliability. * **Build and support scalable ML infrastructure**: data pipelines, training systems, evaluation frameworks, and production monitoring. * **Design and operate geospatial pipelines** that merge heterogeneous spatial datasets into reproducible, production\-grade workflows. * **Strengthen CI/CD and infrastructure reliability** across simulation, digital\-twin, and ML pipelines. * **Drive cross\-functional alignment and set direction**: coordinate across Applied Science and the business, communicate modeling decisions and tradeoffs, and articulate a multi\-year vision for how the team’s work moves the business forward. **Core Skills (Must\-Haves):** * **Technical leadership and ownership**: managing and leading engineers and complex initiatives, delivering through others as well as hands\-on, with strong planning, prioritization, and stakeholder coordination from concept through production. * **5\+ years building production\-grade** data, simulation, or modeling pipelines with end\-to\-end automation, monitoring, and alerting. * **Strong DevOps ownership**: cloud infrastructure, infrastructure\-as\-code, containerization, CI/CD, automated testing, observability, and incident response for systems your team runs. * **Depth in distributed, data\-heavy systems**: debugging across APIs, preprocessing, modeling, and downstream consumers; cluster compute (SLURM, Kubernetes) and orchestration (Prefect, Airflow). * **Business judgment and succinct communication**: translate SME needs into platform capabilities and balance research depth, timelines, and impact. **Nice to Haves:** * Startup or zero\-to\-one technology development experience. * Hands\-on data and ML infrastructure: ETL over large heterogeneous datasets, dataset construction, GPU training and inference, evaluation frameworks, and production model monitoring. * Breadth across backend, AI pipelines, simulations, and digital twins, even if your background leans toward one area. * Experience supporting physics\-based or simulation\-heavy workflows (e.g., CFD, multiphysics, digital twins) in production, with strong physical\-simulation intuition. * Knowledge of geospatial, remote\-sensing, or Earth\-observation datasets and systems. * Experience working directly with business or product teams on customer\-facing technology. * Experience collaborating with MLEs on training pipelines and dataset construction for large\-scale models. **Compensation:** The annual base salary range for full\-time employees in this position is $240,000 to $295,000 \+ meaningful Equity Grant. Compensation decisions are dependent on several factors including, but not limited to, an individual’s qualifications, location where the role is to be performed, internal equity, and alignment with market data. **Benefits:** * Above\-market Health, Dental, and Vision coverage * Weekly lunch stipend * Flexible time off \+ holidays * 401(k) plan * Commuter benefits * PAT \& MAT Leave * Short\-Term and Long\-Term Disability * Monthly team gatherings * In\-office perks **AI in the Interview Process** Thoughtful use of AI tools is expected and valued at Stand. Candidates should be prepared to discuss how they use AI, how they evaluate its output, and how it informs their work. Strong communication, sound judgment, and the ability to clearly articulate experience and decision\-making remain core requirements. Some parts of the interview process are designed to assess independent thinking, communication, and problem\-solving. If you plan to use an AI assistant or LLM during any portion of an interview, please discuss it with your interviewer in advance. **Work Authorization** Candidates must be authorized to work in the U.S. Stand does not sponsor new work visas. We can consider candidates on TN visas, O\-1A visas, or H\-1B transfers with three years or more remaining. **Equal Opportunity Employment** *Stand is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. We believe that diversity enriches the workplace, and we are committed to growing our team with the most talented and passionate people from every community.* *We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals. If you require assistance, please contact us at* *hr@standinsurance.com**.* *Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.* **AI Use in Hiring** *We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us at* *hr@standinsurance.com**.* Compensation Range: $240K \- $295K

tasty*live \&* tastyfx—a family of brands built to democratize trading and empower individual investors. Founded in Chicago by the creators of thinkorswim, acquired by London\-based IG Group in 2021, we combine startup innovation with the backing of a FTSE 100 fintech operating across five continents serving over 1\.3m customers and handling billions of dollars in transactions – built on scale, trust, and proof. From our headquarters in Chicago's Fulton Market, our team builds award\-winning trading platforms, produces live financial education content daily, and creates technology that makes complex markets accessible. tastytrade is our retail brokerage for self\-directed investing and trading, with tasty*live* providing content to educate our customers. tastyfx is the fastest\-growing forex broker in the US. tastycrypto provides self\-custody digital wallets for decentralized finance. jobs.title: Embedded Firmware Engineer
jobs.description: **Embedded Firmware Engineer** ============================== **Efference** \- Robust Robotic Perception **Location**: North Beach, San Francisco, CA **Employment** **Type**: Full Time **Location** **Type**: On\-site **Department**: Engineering **Company Overview** -------------------- Efference builds robust, high\-performance robotic perceptual systems that make robots easier to develop and faster to deploy. Our technology integrates proprietary optical designs, advanced sensor fusion, depth estimation, image sensor processing, and tightly optimized hardware\-software stacks to enable reliable perception across general and specialized robotic systems. We are currently deploying the first generation of vision systems with state\-of\-the\-art hardware and software while actively prototyping generations two and three of our core perceptual system. Efference was founded by Gianluca Bencomo, a PhD student at Princeton University whose research spans visual neuroscience, Bayesian filtering for fast and robust sensor fusion, neural network inductive biases, and robotics perception. The company is backed by Y Combinator and Anti Fund. **Position Overview** --------------------- As a Embedded Firmware Engineer at Efference, you will lead the design, implementation, and integration of low\-level software that powers our next\-generation robotic perception systems. You will work at the boundary between custom hardware and advanced perception software, enabling reliable, high\-performance sensing across cameras, IMUs, and other robotic sensors. This role requires deep expertise in embedded Linux, real\-time systems, and hardware bring\-up, as well as the ability to collaborate closely with PCB designers, perception researchers, and full\-stack engineers. Your work will directly influence the performance, reliability, and deployability of Efference’s custom camera and sensing platforms across multiple product generations. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * Lead firmware architecture and development for ARM\-based SoCs and MCUs * Read, modify, and maintain device trees, BSPs, and board support packages * Review and approve schematics and PCB layouts, with a focus on signal integrity, power distribution, and manufacturability * Develop and maintain embedded Linux systems using Buildroot and Yocto * Implement and optimize RTOS\-based firmware for real\-time sensing and control * Write and maintain kernel drivers and low\-level device drivers for sensors and peripherals * Integrate and optimize MIPI\-CSI camera pipelines, including basic camera bring\-up and tuning * Implement and debug WiFi and Bluetooth connectivity on embedded platforms * Work with a wide range of communication interfaces, including CAN, USB, RS\-485, UART, I²C, SPI, GMSL, etc. * Integrate and calibrate sensors such as IMUs, cameras, LiDAR, and other robotic sensing modalities * Perform hands\-on hardware debugging using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and other lab tools * Collaborate with perception, robotics, and full\-stack teams to support teleoperation, data collection, and on\-device inference * Contribute to product roadmaps, technical documentation, and platform evolution across multiple hardware generations **Qualifications** ------------------ * Bachelor’s degree or higher in Electrical Engineering or a related field * 3\+ years of professional experience in embedded systems or firmware engineering * Strong proficiency in C/C\+\+ for embedded and systems programming * Experience working with embedded Linux on ARM\-based SoCs * Deep understanding of hardware–software co\-design, including power, clock, and memory subsystems * Proven experience bringing up custom hardware from early prototypes through production * Familiarity with common MCUs and peripheral architectures * Strong debugging and root\-cause analysis skills across hardware and software layers **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Experience with Rust for embedded or systems programming * Background in robotics, perception, or sensor fusion * Familiarity with robotic control systems and real\-time constraints * Personal interest or hands\-on experience in robot learning or autonomous systems * Experience supporting high\-throughput image or sensor data pipelines **Benefits** ------------ * Competitive salary and meaningful equity in a seed\-stage, venture\-backed startup * Opportunity to work at the cutting edge of robotic perception and applied research * Close collaboration with world\-class researchers and engineers * High\-impact role with significant technical ownership and growth opportunities

Maintain and extend SQ4D's operator interface, a Vue.js/TypeScript fork of Duet Web Control, and its automated build and deployment * *Testing \& Continuous Improvement* Reproduce and diagnose firmware issues through code analysis, logs, controlled experiments, and hardware testing. * Collaborate with electrical, mechanical, automation, and manufacturing engineers to resolve system\-level problems. * Validate firmware changes on physical ARCS machines before deployment. * Identify opportunities to improve system stability, responsiveness, fault handling, and recovery from errors. * Contribute to the long\-term development of a more autonomous, intelligent, and reliable robotic construction platform. * **Required Qualifications** Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Science, Robotics, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * Demonstrated experience developing or modifying embedded software and firmware * Proficiency in C and C\+\+, and working knowledge of JavaScript/Typescript and Python. * Experience navigating, debugging, and contributing to an existing software codebase. * Familiarity with Git and structured software development workflows. * Strong debugging and analytical skills, including the ability to isolate complex software issues. * Ability to work across software and hardware boundaries and systematically troubleshoot physical systems. * Strong written and verbal communication skills. * **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with RepRapFirmware and Duet controllers Experience with Vue.js or another front\-end framework, and with HTTP/REST APIs * Experience with 3D printer control systems, CNC machines, robotics, or industrial automation. * * Familiarity with G\-code interpretation, motion planning, kinematics, and stepper motor control. jobs.title: Lead Data Scientist
jobs.description: Technology is at the heart of Disney’s past, present, and future. Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product \& Technology is a global organization of engineers, product developers, designers, technologists, data scientists, and more – all working to build and advance the technological backbone for Disney’s media business globally. The team marries technology with creativity to build world\-class products, enhance storytelling, and drive velocity, innovation, and scalability for our businesses. We are Storytellers and Innovators. Creators and Builders. Entertainers and Engineers. We work with every part of The Walt Disney Company’s media portfolio to advance the technological foundation and consumer media touch points serving millions of people around the world. Here are a few reasons why we think you’d love working here: * Building the future of Disney’s media: Our Technologists are designing and building the products and platforms that will power our media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come. * Reach, Scale \& Impact: More than ever, Disney’s technology and products serve as a signature doorway for fans' connections with the company’s brands and stories. Disney\+. Hulu. ESPN. ABC. ABC News…and many more. These products and brands –and the unmatched stories, storytellers, and events they carry – matter to millions of people globally. * Innovation: We develop and implement groundbreaking products and techniques that shape industry norms, and solve complex and distinctive technical problems. Product Engineering is a unified team responsible for the engineering of Disney Entertainment \& ESPN digital and streaming products and platforms. This includes product engineering, media engineering, quality assurance, engineering behind personalization, commerce, lifecycle, and identity. News \& Entertainment Machine Learning (N\&E ML) team is responsible for building robust data pipelines and advanced machine learning platforms that deliver personalized experiences to users across Disney's News \& Entertainment portfolio including ABC News, ABC Entertainment, National Geographic, Marvel, and Disney Studios. Our services leverage machine learning models to enable real\-time content personalization and targeted distribution across web, mobile, and connected TV platforms, ensuring that users receive the most relevant and engaging content tailored to their interests. Our mission is to drive seamless, resilient, and low\-latency personalized content delivery at scale, while continuously advancing our ML infrastructure and recommendation algorithms across one of the world's most iconic collections of entertainment brands. As a Lead Data Scientist, you will act as the bridge between data and product decisions for the N\&E ML Platform, ensuring that machine learning and personalization investments translate into measurable business impact across Disney's News \& Entertainment portfolio. You will conduct exploratory data analysis, design and evaluate experiments, and define the success metrics used to judge model and product performance. You will partner closely with Machine Learning Engineers on feature design, drift detection, and model evaluation, translating data insights into concrete, actionable recommendations for product and engineering stakeholders. Your impact will be measured by how effectively you turn data into decisions that improve the guest experience across ABC News, ABC Entertainment, National Geographic, Marvel, and Disney Studios. **Responsibilities**: * Exploratory Data Analysis \& Insights: Conduct exploratory data analysis (EDA) across user, content, and engagement data to identify patterns, trends, and behavioral insights across the N\&E portfolio (ABC News, ABC Entertainment, National Geographic, Marvel, and Disney Studios). * Experimentation \& A/B Testing: Design, implement, and evaluate A/B tests and other controlled experiments to validate product and personalization changes, applying sound statistical methodology to ensure results are reliable and actionable. * Success Metrics \& Model Evaluation: Define success metrics for ML\-driven features and measure model performance against them, ensuring that model improvements are grounded in measurable, statistically valid outcomes. * Partnership with ML Engineering: Partner closely with Machine Learning Engineers on feature design, drift detection, and model evaluation, acting as the analytical counterpart that ensures models remain accurate and relevant as data and user behavior evolve. * Translating Insights into Action: Translate data insights into clear, actionable product recommendations, working with product managers, designers, and engineering stakeholders to prioritize changes with the greatest expected business impact. * Statistical Analysis \& Reporting: Apply statistical analysis using Python, SQL, and PySpark to large\-scale datasets, and leverage tools such as Adobe Analytics to understand user behavior and content perfo d, including experience partnering directly with engineering and product teams * Strong proficiency in Python, SQL, and PySpark for large\-scale data analysis and manipulation * Deep experience with cloud data platforms such as AWS, Databricks, or Snowflake * Deep experience with statistical analysis and experimentation, including designing, running, and interpreting A/B tests * Demonstrated ability to conduct exploratory data analysis (EDA) and translate patterns in user behavior into clear, actionable insights * Experience defining success metrics and measuring model performance in partnership with Machine Learning Engineers, including feature design, drift detection, and model evaluation * Proven ability to translate data insights into product recommendations that influence roadmap and prioritization decisions * Experience with Adobe Analytics or comparable web/product analytics platforms * Experience working with large\-scale content or media platforms serving millions of consumers * Experience with cloud infrastructure, preferably AWS (Step Functions, Lambda, Glue, SQS, SNS, Personalize) * Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker) for communicating insights to stakeholders * Strong communication skills, with the ability to present findings clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders * Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments and collaborating across product, engineering, and design teams **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with agentic AI workflows and frameworks (e.g. LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI) and applying them to automate complex ML and data engineering tasks * Familiarity with AI\-assisted development tools such as Claude, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot to accelerate software development lifecycle and engineering productivity * Familiarity with prompt engineering, jobs.title: Lead Electrical Engineer
jobs.description: **About SleepRes** SleepRes is developing next\-generation sleep apnea therapy technologies that improve patient outcomes. We are a small, fast\-moving R\&D team focused on building high\-quality medical devices that make a real\-world impact. **Position Overview** We are seeking a Lead Electrical Engineer to lead the electrical and electronic architecture of current and next\-generation positive airway pressure (PAP) therapy systems. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role where you will own the design, integration, verification, and production implementation of device electronics, including power architecture, PCBAs, sensors, blower and heater interfaces, display and user\-interface hardware, communications hardware, electrical safety, EMC, and production\-test interfaces. You will work closely with systems, firmware, mechanical, software, V\&V, NPI, quality, regulatory, overseas suppliers, and contract manufacturers to deliver reliable, compliant, and manufacturable electronics from concept through commercialization. **Level** This role may be filled at the Staff or Principal level based on experience, technical scope, and demonstrated leadership. * Staff: Typically 8\+ years of relevant product\-development experience. Serves as the primary technical owner for the electrical discipline, leads architecture and cross\-functional technical decisions, mentors engineers, and remains deeply hands\-on in design, testing, and commercialization. * Principal: Typically 10–12\+ years of relevant experience with demonstrated platform\-level technical leadership. Acts as a company\-level authority for electrical architecture, establishes engineering standards, resolves the most complex multidisciplinary problems, mentors senior engineers, and influences multiple product generations. **What You'll Do** * Lead electrical architecture, design, development, and verification for SleepRes PAP products * Own main control PCBAs, power distribution and conversion, sensor interfaces, blower and heater electronics, display/UI hardware, communications hardware, and electrical protection circuitry * Translate system requirements into electrical specifications, interfaces, component selections, design margins, and production\-ready solutions * Lead schematic, PCB layout, component\-selection, tolerance, derating, grounding, shielding, and signal\-integrity reviews * Own electrical\-safety and EMC engineering, including early pre\-compliance testing, troubleshooting, and support of formal certification testing * Lead the hardware side of cellular, BLE, Wi\-Fi, antenna, SIM/eSIM, and RF integration and support FCC, PTCRB, carrier, and related certification activities * Support verification, reliability testing, and hands\-on root\-cause investigation using appropriate electrical laboratory equipment * Work with NPI, PCBA suppliers, and contract manufacturers on DFM, testability, ICT/functional test, calibration, programming, end\-of\-line test, yield, and design transfer * Partner with Operations and Strategic Sourcing on component lifecycle, alternate\-source qualification, supplier changes, value engineering, and cost reduction * Support design controls and risk management, including requirements, specifications, DFMEA, verification documentation, engineering reports, and design changes **What We're Looking For** * BS in Electrical Engineering or related engineering discipline (MS preferred) * 8\+ years of relevant electrical product\-development experience; Principal\-level candidates will typically bring 10–12\+ years and demonstrated platform\-level technical leadership * Strong experience with analog and digital circuit design, embedded microcontroller systems, power electronics, sensor interfaces, PCB design, signal integrity, grounding, shielding, and EMC * Strong hands\-on laboratory and troubleshooting skills using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, spectrum analyzers, power analyzers, electronic loads, and related equipment * Experience with component selection, tolerance analysis, derating, lifecycle management, and alternate\-component qualification * Demonstrated experience taking complex electromechanical products from concept through commercial production * Experience working directly with PCB assemblers, contract manufacturers, and component suppliers * Strong systems thinking, communication, and ability to lead technical decisions in a fast\-paced cross\-functional environment **Nice to Have** * Experience developing CPAP, ventilator, respiratory, anesthesia, patient\-monitoring, or other medical devices * Medical\-device development experience under ISO 13485 and FDA design controls/QMSR * Familiarity with IEC 60601\-1, IEC 60601\-1\-2, IEC 60601\-1\-11, and applicable IEC/ISO 80601 requirements * Experience with pressure/flow sensors, blowers or motors, resistive heaters, thermistors, TFT/LCD displays, cellular modems, BLE, or Wi\-Fi * Experience with FCC, PTCRB, cellular\-carrier, or other wireless\-device certification * Experience with production\-test systems, high\-volume Asian manufacturing partners, and electrical failure analysis * Experience leading electrical engineers or serving as the electrical technical lead for a multidisciplinary product program

Whether that’s evolving our streaming and digital products in new and immersive ways, powering worldwide advertising and distribution to maximize flexibility and efficiency, or delivering Disney’s unmatched entertainment and sports content, every day is a moment to make a difference to partners and to hundreds of millions of people around the world. *A few reasons why we think you’d love working for Disney Entertainment \& ESPN Technology* * **Building the future of Disney’s media business:** DE\&E Technologists are designing and building the infrastructure that will power Disney’s media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come. * **Reach \& Scale:** The products and platforms this group builds and operates delight millions of consumers every minute of every day – from Disney\+ and Hulu, to ABC News and Entertainment, to ESPN and ESPN\+, and much more. * **Innovation:** We develop and execute groundbreaking products and techniques that shape industry norms and enhance how audiences experience sports, entertainment \& news. Product Engineering is a unified team responsible for the engineering of Disney Entertainment \& ESPN digital and streaming products and platforms. This includes product engineering, media engineering, quality assurance, engineering behind personalization, commerce, lifecycle, and identity. **Job Summary:** The News ML team is responsible for building robust data pipelines and advanced machine learning platforms that deliver personalized experiences to users across ABC News, Good Morning America, and local news stations. Our services leverage machine learning models to enable real\-time content personalization and targeted distribution across web, mobile, and connected TV platforms, ensuring that users receive the most relevant and engaging news content tailored to their interests. Our mission is to drive seamless, resilient, and low\-latency personalized content delivery at scale, while continuously advancing our ML infrastructure and recommendation algorithms. As a Lead Machine Learning Engineer, you will play a leading role in shaping the technical direction of the News ML Platform. You will drive infrastructure for scalable learning, inference, and monitoring, conduct in\-depth data exploration and analysis, and collaborate across product, data, and engineering teams to power exceptional, personalized guest experiences. advanced automation solutions. **Testing \& Validation** * Develop and implement robust in\-process and end\-of\-line testing strategies. * Analyze testing data and identify opportunities for product and process improvements. * Establish testing standards that ensure product quality and customer satisfaction. * Support development of validation methodologies for new products and processes. **Data ems and MES platforms. **Core Competencies** Successful candidates will demonstrate: * Manufacturing Process Optimization * Automation \& Controls Knowledge * Statistical Analysis * Continuous jobs.title: Senior Researcher
jobs.description: **Senior Researcher** ===================== **About the Company** Troveo builds the data platform that AI labs and model builders need to train the next generation of models. We have created the world's largest licensed platform of scarce, proprietary data for AI, spanning video, audio, text, and business workflows. Troveo indexes, enriches, and packages this high\-quality data into formats ready for training, fine\-tuning, evaluation, and agentic use cases. Backed by top investors, we’re a small, high\-impact team solving one of the biggest bottlenecks in AI development. **Role Overview** We’re looking for a Senior Researcher who thrives on exploration, discovery, and experimentation. You’re naturally curious and a tinkerer at heart, someone who wants to get hands\-on with new models, techniques, and ideas to understand what they can actually do. You’ll stay ahead of industry trends and advances in AI and machine learning that open new ways to leverage our data, continuously surface opportunities to enrich our existing data assets, and keep us sharp on relevant AI and machine learning progress.Your focus is clarity on the what and why: well\-researched opportunities, idea validation, and clear problem definitions that help guide the business toward its next potential opportunities in multimodal content, audiovisual assets, and training data generation. **What You’ll Do** * Monitor and synthesize trends across our industry, AI and machine learning research, foundation models, agents, evaluation techniques, and data enrichment methods. * Tinker with emerging models, tools, datasets, and techniques to understand their practical potential. Build lightweight prototypes, run experiments, and explore unconventional combinations to turn interesting ideas into evidence. * Identify high\-leverage opportunities to enrich or restructure our existing assets (internal and external), including multimodal and audiovisual sources as well as approaches for generating high\-quality training corpora that could improve model performance, product features, or decision\-making. * Translate research into actionable outputs: opportunity briefs, experiment proposals, success criteria, and recommendations on what to explore next. * Own and advance a research program around priority data opportunity areas, including designing and running experiments and proof\-of\-concepts to validate hypotheses and de\-risk ideas. * Partner with product, prototypers, engineers by providing well\-scoped ideas and serving as a research advisor. * Maintain living knowledge bases and briefings that keep the broader team informed. * Evaluate emerging techniques and papers for relevance in our context. * Contribute the research perspective to prioritization and longer\-term opportunity discussions. * Support business operations in ad hoc requests. **Ideal Background** * 5\+ years of relevant experience in applied research or machine learning research. * Strong tinkerer’s mindset: enjoys getting hands\-on with new models, APIs, datasets, tools, and techniques, and is comfortable learning by building and experimenting. * Deep familiarity with modern paradigms including large language models, multimodal models, retrieval\-augmented generation, agent architectures, fine\-tuning, model distillation, and evaluation frameworks. * Clear communication of research findings to both technical and non\-technical audiences. Preferred Experience * Master’s degree in Applied Sciences, Statistics, or a related field required. * Track record centered on opportunity discovery and problem definition. * Experience with data enrichment approaches such as synthetic data generation, active learning, weak supervision, and knowledge graph construction. * Ability to stay current across research and industry sources while separating signal from noise. * Experience collaborating with prototyping or applied teams is a plus. * Domain familiarity with our business area (or ability to ramp quickly) is valuable. **What We Offer** * **Comprehensive Health Benefits**: Medical, dental, and vision coverage (100% employer\-paid for employees) * **Flexible PTO \& Paid Holidays**: Unlimited PTO with encouragement to actually use it * **Remote\-First Policy**: Work from anywhere in the US (with occasional team offsites) * **Learning \& Growth**: Annual learning stipend, access to top conferences, and direct mentorship from experienced founders * **Equity Ownership**: Competitive equity package with clear growth potential as we scale * **Modern Tech Stack \& Tools**: Budget for the best equipment and software * **Strong Culture**: High\-trust, low\-ego environment focused on impact, transparency, and work\-life balance. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

The role writes production software with fully agentic AI development workflows. AI agents (Claude Code or equivalent) are the main environment for writing, testing, and running code. The work is backend focused and centered on .NET, within a full\-stack ownership model. The engineer owns features end to end: the API contract, the service logic, the data layer, any external integrations, the supporting UI where needed, deployment, and production support. They work in a cross\-functional pod with other senior engineers and QA. ### **Essential duties and responsibilities** * Design, develop, and maintain backend services and RESTful APIs in C\# / .NET (ASP.NET Core) on the company’s current and next\-generation platforms. * Build and maintain integrations with third\-party systems, such as accounting platforms, ERP, EDI, and vendor APIs. This covers authentication (OAuth 2\.0\), data mapping and sync, webhooks, rate limiting, retries, idempotency, and error reconciliation. * Design data models and write efficient, well\-tested data access against relational databases (SQL Server and/or PostgreSQL), including schema migrations and query performance tuning. * Direct agentic AI development workflows to write, test, refactor, and document code. Review agent output and confirm it passes the company’s blocking quality gates before release. * Own delivered work end\-to\-end: design, implementation, automated tests, deployment, monitoring, and fixing production issues that arise from that work. * Build and maintain automated test coverage (unit, integration, and contract tests), including AI\-authored test suites, as a condition of feature completion. * Work with the pod on API contracts. Build or modify React / TypeScript front\-end code when needed to finish a feature without handoffs at team boundaries. * Take part in sprint planning, estimation, code review, and the pod’s operational cadence. Report status and blockers clearly and early. * Contribute to shared libraries, integration patterns, and platform foundations. ### **Required qualifications** * 8\+ years of professional software engineering experience, with substantial production backend work in C\# / .NET. * Hands\-on experience building and supporting production integrations with third\-party platforms. * Demonstrated experience shipping production code through fully agentic AI development tools (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor agent mode, or equivalent). This means using agents to write, test, and operate substantial production code, not only code completion. * Strong proficiency in ASP.NET Core, RESTful API design, asynchronous programming, and dependency injection, plus an ORM such as Entity Framework Core and/or Dapper. * Solid relational database skills (SQL Server and/or PostgreSQL): schema design, query optimization, and migrations. * Working proficiency in React and TypeScript, enough to build and modify front\-end features as part of full\-stack delivery. * Strong problem\-solving skills: able to read unfamiliar codebases quickly, debug across layers (API, data, external systems, UI), and make sound technical decisions under time pressure. * Working fluency in at least one major cloud platform (AWS preferred; GCP or Azure acceptable), including messaging and queuing (e.g., SQS/SNS), and the ability to learn new stacks quickly. * Demonstrated end\-to\-end ownership of production software, including post\-release support. ### **Preferred qualifications** * Experience with additional accounting, ERP, or financial integrations (e.g., Xero, NetSuite, Sage) or EDI (X12 850/855/810\). * Event\-driven and asynchronous architectures: background workers, message queues, and reliable sync / reconciliation patterns. * Containerized deployment (Docker, ECS, or Kubernetes) and infrastructure as code (Terraform). * Observability tooling (e.g., Datadog) for tracing, logging, and alerting on integration health. * React PWA, React Native / React Native Web, or design\-system experience. * Data\-dense B2B application experience (purchasing, invoicing, ERP\-style workflows). ### **Success measures (first 6 months)** * Independently delivers the pod’s committed backend and integration work through the release gate, sprint over sprint. * Uses the team’s agentic development pipelines fluently, and agent\-authored test coverage ships with every feature. * Owns at least one production service or integration surface with no unresolved escaped defects attributable to delivered work. ### **Working relationships** Reports to the Director of Engineering (career line) and takes technical direction from the pod lead. jobs.description: **Job Overview** Meadow Health is a 50 state telehealth practice providing precision care for neurodevelopmental conditions. We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to build these capabilities hands on, end to end, in Python, Django, Angular, PostgreSQL and AWS CDK. This role sits at the intersection of engineering and clinical research: you will build, validate and document software that will be inspected under FDA 21 CFR Part 11, ICH E6(R3\) Good Clinical Practice, IRB and HIPAA expectations. The screening tools you build flag, explain and document, while investigators and clinicians make the decisions. You will report to the CEO and have early ownership of the clinical research architecture of a platform used in real patient care. **Duties** * Design and ship features across the stack in Python, Django and Django REST Framework, Angular and TypeScript, and PostgreSQL, running on AWS with infrastructure defined in AWS CDK. * Build online prescreen questionnaires, consent to contact registries and a versioned, protocol driven inclusion and exclusion rules engine whose results ("likely met," "likely not met," "needs review") are explainable and linked to evidence. * Build eConsent and assent workflows with version control of IRB approved materials, identity verification, comprehension checks and Part 11 compliant electronic signatures. * Support remote and telehealth study visits, scheduling and reminders, and ePRO and eCOA questionnaires for participants and caregivers. * Build electronic case report forms with edit checks, query management, data review and locking, and complete audit trails. * Implement Part 11 controls, including time stamped audit trails, electronic signatures, role based access, record retention and human readable exports. * Produce risk based validation evidence (CSV and CSA, IQ/OQ/PQ, traceability, test scripts and release records) in line with GAMP 5, backed by automated tests across the stack (Django unit and API tests, Angular unit tests, Playwright end to end tests). * Build secure, reliable integrations with sponsor, CRO and site systems (EDC, CTMS, lab and rater data) and sponsor reporting such as enrollment funnels, screen fail reasons and data completeness. * Keep each study and the clinical care program strictly separate in the data model, authorization and queries. * Protect PHI under HIPAA with encryption in transit and at rest, managed secrets, least privilege access and access logging, and contribute to controls aligned with NIST CSF and SOC 2\. * Write and maintain data models, API and data flow documentation, and system descriptions for IRB submissions, sponsor audits and regulatory inspections. * Work closely with clinicians, research and operations staff to translate protocol requirements into clear specifications and working software. **Skills** * 5\+ years of professional software engineering with production ownership of a web application. * Strong Python, Django and Django REST Framework, including the Django ORM and versioned migrations. * PostgreSQL schema design, migrations, constraints and query performance. * Angular with TypeScript (components, services, routing, HTTP interceptors) and RxJS. * AWS (ECS Fargate, RDS, IAM, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch), Docker, and infrastructure as code with AWS CDK in TypeScript. * REST API design, OAuth 2\.0 and JWT authentication, role based access control and multitenant SaaS patterns. * Automated testing across the stack, CI/CD, and Git with pull request based code review. * Experience building and running software that stores PHI under HIPAA. * Working knowledge of 21 CFR Part 11 and GCP, or equivalent experience building GxP or other FDA regulated software. * Experience building rules or decision logic whose outputs are explainable, versioned and auditable. * Clear technical writing for regulated documentation. **Preferred** * Software for clinical trials or DCTs (EDC, eConsent, eCOA/ePRO, CTMS, IRT or recruitment platforms). * Hands on validation work (IQ/OQ/PQ, CSV and CSA) and audit or inspection support. * CDISC standards (CDASH and SDTM; ODM and ADaM awareness). * HL7 FHIR R4 and US Core data mapping. * Telehealth or video visit experiences and WCAG 2\.1 AA accessibility. * LLM assisted extraction of criteria from protocols and records, with human review. * Familiarity with autism assessment instruments such as ADOS 2, ADI R and Vineland 3\. * SOC 2 Type II audit support, AWS Associate level certification, or GAMP/CSV training. Required within 30 days of start: ICH E6(R3\) GCP training (for example CITI GCP), Human Subjects Research training and Meadow HIPAA training. We offer a competitive salary and equity, and meaningful work that improves care and research access for autistic children and their families. Meadow Health is an equal opportunity employer. Pay: $125,000\.00 \- $160,000\.00 per year Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Software Developer
jobs.description: About Peregrine Peregrine Advisors is a rapidly growing AI and data innovation hub helping government solve hard problems and deliver better outcomes. We work across the full lifecycle—from strategy and governance through architecture, engineering, analytics, AI, visualization, and training—for clients including the SEC, PCAOB, DDOT, and DCAA. Our clients describe our support as “absolutely excellent” and our people as “instrumental to organization’s success.” Winner of the United Nations COP27 Datathon, our work has earned all Exceptional CPARS ratings, SEC Chair’s Awards, the SEC Vision Award, and recognition from FDA leadership. We are also built differently. Peregrine is the first and only social enterprise organized as a Benefit Corporation and SBA 8(a) company focused on AI and data for government. We believe business success should create client value, social value, and opportunity for our people. As we enter our next stage of growth, we need dependable, motivated, and skilled people who have a combination of intellectual curiosity and intellectual courage. With new clients, larger programs, and expanding responsibilities, the people joining Peregrine now will have the opportunity to help shape the company we become. People first. Ownership always. We solve problems through people, process, and technology—in that order. Technology matters, but people make transformation happen. That principle defines our culture. Trust and motivation are the foundational pillars of delivery on which our skills stand. We hire people we can trust, who care deeply about what they do, take ownership, learn quickly, help one another, and refuse to walk past a problem because it belongs to someone else. At Peregrine, you are not joining simply to fill a position. You are joining a team, taking ownership of a mission, and helping build a company. If that excites you, we should talk. At Peregrine Advisors, you will build cloud services in Python that automate a federal agency's high\-volume filing intake. But we hire people, not seats. As the work evolves, you will move to where the hardest problems are. This is a hybrid work arrangement based in the Washington, DC metropolitan area, and the commuting cadence varies by assignment. The initial engagement requires United States citizenship and the ability to obtain a Public Trust determination. Your first project Your first project will likely have you automating how a federal agency handles a high\-volume stream of filer applications. Depending on the assignment, you may: * Turn a manual, document\-heavy intake process into a pipeline that reads, understands, and routes each submission. * Build document\-intelligence services that use optical character recognition (OCR) and AI in the cloud to pull structure and meaning out of filings at scale. * Add confidence scoring and the decision logic that determines what happens to each document next. * Build the validation around it: exact and fuzzy matching and the business rules that apply to each filing. * Design the human\-review workflows that catch what the machine should not decide alone. You help deliver a working document pipeline that moves filings from submission to decision, built for an environment where accuracy and auditability are not optional. This is where you start, not the shape of your career here. **Requirements** * 4\+ years of software development experience in Python * Bachelor's degree * Hands\-on experience building document\-processing systems in the cloud, from OCR through extraction, using Amazon Textract or an equivalent service * Experience with data validation, including exact and fuzzy matching * Experience building the application programming interfaces (APIs) and SQL that move documents through to a decision * Proficiency in writing, PowerPoint, and Excel Preferred* Experience applying large language models (LLMs), machine learning, or natural language processing (NLP) to documents * Experience with Amazon Bedrock * Experience processing PDF documents Who you are You have a hacker's mindset: you would rather ship a working prototype tonight than a perfect plan next week. You have built real document\-processing systems in Python, and you move at the speed of the tools, not the clock. You experiment, fail, learn, and repeat quickly. You would rather own an outcome than be handed a task. What you bring* Deep, hands\-on Python, with real experience building cloud document\-processing systems on Amazon Textract or its equivalents, from OCR through extraction. * The engineering that surrounds it: data validation, matching, and the APIs and SQL that carry a document through to a decision. * The judgment to build in a regulated environment where accuracy and auditability are not optional. You adapt your development workflow as AI tools evolve, using them to help implement, test, and improve the components you own. You give the tools clear context, review and test their output, and remain accountable for the code you deliver. When we talk Be prepared to discuss a difficult problem you worked through, the decisions you made, what happened, and what you learned. jobs.title: Software Engineer - Realtime Pipeline
jobs.description: **About Bridge Neurotech** -------------------------- Bridge Neurotech is building a non\-invasive functional ultrasound imaging (fUSI) platform with AI\-based neural decoding for brain\-computer interface applications. We are a seed\-stage neurotechnology company developing technology that has the potential to transform how we interact with the human brain. **About the Role** ------------------ We are looking for a Software Engineer \- Realtime Pipeline to own the realtime system that runs from raw RF data off the probe all the way to decoded outputs from our neural decoding model — beamforming, imaging preprocessing, and ML inference, all in one tightly coupled latency budget. The inference latency budget is tightly coupled to the imaging pipeline latency budget: they share GPU, share memory, share the data stream. This role owns the entire realtime path and is accountable for it as one system. Given the neural decoding model, you turn it into a production realtime decoder, sitting on top of the imaging pipeline you have also built. We build from open primitives like the Mach beamformer (https://github.com/Forest\-Neurotech/mach), and you provide the technical leadership and strategy to mature the system — designing, developing, testing, deploying, and enhancing it into a scalable software solution — including what to extend, what to replace, and what to push upstream. You will work closely with our ML/AI Lead on the model serving boundary, our Embedded Systems Engineer on the data handoff from the probe, our Imaging Scientist on the imaging pipeline itself, and our Applications Engineer on the decoded output handoff downstream. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * Own the end\-to\-end realtime path: raw RF data ingestion, beamforming, processing (e.g., clutter filtering), ML preprocessing, model inference, and decoded output. * Build the ML inference engine: model loading from artifacts, GPU memory residency, batching, TensorRT/ONNX or hand\-built CUDA inference, and kernel\-level integration with the upstream imaging compute. * Integrate, extend, and, where appropriate, contribute to GPU beamforming. * Hit and hold realtime throughput and latency targets at multi\-Gbit/s ingest with deterministic tail latency suitable for closed\-loop decoding. * Define and own the model serving contract with the ML/AI Lead and the path for model updates without service interruption. * Build the streaming and storage layer that serves raw and processed data to both offline training and realtime inference. * Collaborate with other team members to define the upstream interface to the device acquisition layer and the downstream interface to the BCI applications layer. * Build observability into every stage and develop benchmarks and regression tests that lock in both pipeline performance and inference correctness as the system evolves. **Who You Are** --------------- **Required** * BS/MS/PhD in computer science, electrical engineering, or a related field, with 8\+ years building production realtime or HPC systems. * Expert\-level CUDA and modern C\+\+; experience writing or extensively modifying GPU kernels for signal processing or imaging workloads. * Demonstrated experience building production ML inference systems: taking trained PyTorch (or equivalent) models to deployment on GPUs under hard latency budgets. Hands\-on with TensorRT, ONNX Runtime, Triton, or hand\-built CUDA inference engines. * Demonstrated experience building realtime data pipelines at multi\-Gbit/s rates with tight latency budgets. * Strong grasp of data structures, algorithms, and the signal processing stack relevant to imaging or RF: beamforming concepts, FFTs, IQ demodulation, SVD\-based filtering, autocorrelation. * Proficiency in Python and the PyTorch ecosystem sufficient to collaborate with the ML team, identify what needs to change for production, and have informed conversations about model architecture trade\-offs that affect latency. **Nice to Have** * Experience with functional imaging or other high\-data\-rate imaging modalities. * Experience integrating ML inference with upstream realtime compute, including shared GPU memory layouts and minimizing host–device round\-trips. * Experience with high\-bandwidth I/O: GPUDirect Storage, RDMA, kernel\-bypass networking, NVMe arrays. **What We Offer** ----------------- * The opportunity to shape a role and a team from the earliest stages. * Direct collaboration with leading clinicians and neuroscientists at top\-tier academic institutions. * Excellent medical benefits and a 401(k) with 6% match. Bridge Neurotech is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply.

jobs.title: Staff AI Research Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us:** Lovelace is the only provider of enterprise\-scale context engines capable of analyzing trillions of real\-time data points to create knowledge graphs that are usable by autonomous agents at the speed, scale, and accuracy required for mission\-critical analysis. Lovelace’s context engine platform, Elemental, uniquely integrates data ingestion, entity resolution, and graph building into a single pipeline that empower agentic deployments, delivering 1000X the investigative power for complex queries. With its proprietary ground\-breaking YottaGraph, Lovelace provides enterprises with real\-time, real\-world context, enabling agents to understand the impact of global intelligence on enterprise data for unmatched insights with millisecond precision. Founded in 2023 by Andrew Moore, former head of Google Cloud AI, dean of Carnegie Mellon’s School of Computer Science, and first AI advisor for U.S. CENTCOM, Lovelace currently works with some of the largest public and private enterprises in the world. **Job Summary:** * The Staff AI Research Engineer will lead the design, development, and deployment of advanced AI models and systems that power Lovelace’s context engine and agentic platforms. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include researching and productionalizing ML models, pipelines, and services and working closely with product management and infrastructure engineers. In this role you will develop key components of the Elemental platform including multimodal data ingestion, entity resolution and knowledge graph construction, and agentic search. The Staff AI Research Engineer will mentor team members, collaborate cross\-functionally with product and infrastructure groups, and contribute to externally facing research, technical documentation, and internal best practices. This is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Pittsburgh, PA. **Qualifications:** * Strong foundation in Machine Learning and AI Engineering, with experience building and scaling production\-grade AI systems. * Graduate degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * Proficiency in ML frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow, training pipelines, and deploying and scaling models on Kubernetes\-based infrastructure (e.g., GPU scheduling, model serving, and MLOps tooling). * Ability to design rigorous experiments, interpret results, and communicate technical findings clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. **Preferred Skills:** * Advanced expertise in one or more of the following: Multimodal ML, NLP, Entity Resolution, Knowledge Graphs, Agentic Search. * PhD with published research works in major ML or NLP conferences (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, AAAI, EMNLP, etc.). * Experience in a technical leadership role that required mentoring, communicating technical findings to external stakeholders, and cross\-functional project management. * Experience getting a product to market and working backwards from the customer to get to the right solution, balancing technical rigor with practical delivery. **Benefits:** LovelaceAI offers competitive compensation packages, comprehensive benefits. We provide a supportive and inclusive work environment where your skills and expertise can make a significant impact on the safety and security of our communities. **Lovelace’s founding team includes:** **Andrew Moore**, who has a track record of building impactful AI systems, designing them with human rights impact assessments as a top priority, leading the AI division of one of the world’s foremost cloud companies, and actively participating in machine learning and AI research over the past two decades. **Toby Smith**, well known in the Pittsburgh Tech community for his engineering leadership and design skills, and who has led many of the most ambitious and complex system infrastructure projects in Google Pittsburgh and NetApp. Here is a note from Andrew Moore to people who are reading these Job Postings: “Hi folks, I’m so glad you are potentially interested in Lovelace AI. This area means a lot to me because while I am an AI optimist, I also think that we technologists owe it to a rightly skeptical world to show that modern intelligent systems can actually be useful. Usefulness comes in many guises: from life sciences to education and from transportation to entertainment and many others. For many of us, security and public safety is also very high on that list. That reasoning leads to this conclusion: I’m determined to make sure that the people building Lovelace AI gain a lot from the experience, including the chance to solve fascinating problems in computer science, AI, business development, customer success and product management. I also hope that we all learn from each other in a highly enriching work environment. But my main hope is that we have a shared sense of accomplishment as we see an increasing number of national security and public safety domains made safer through sensible and robust use of advanced computer science."

jobs.title: Data Scientist

Model the financial impact of proposed pricing changes before they go live. * Build and maintain rules\-based pricing and case\-difficulty logic by court and county, alongside statistical and ML approaches. * Build and tune large scoring and prioritization frameworks in Metabase, such as weighting, percentile scenarios, and drop\-rate analysis, that drive daily operational decisions such as Hearing priority and assignment. * Turn ambiguous business questions into clear, well\-scoped analyses. **Cross\-functional partnership and documentation** * Partner with engineering on data pipelines (AWS Glue, Lambda, EventBridge). for anomaly detection, zero\- and few\-shot recognition, semantic segmentation, and related tasks on real industrial image data. * Run experiments under the guidance of senior scientists, including ablations and failure\-case analysis, and summarize findings in clear write\-ups and team presentations. * Prepare periodic test datasets and help maintain data annotation and evaluation pipelines, including label review, sampling and dataset splits, and data\-quality analysis. * Review relevant research literature, share takeaways with the team, and translate useful ideas into small, focused experiments and prototype improvements. * Contribute clear, tested, reproducible Python and PyTorch code, and work with engineers to transition models to production. **Skills \& Requirements:** * Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, Machine Learning, Mathematics, or a related field. * Hands\-on experience training and evaluating deep learning fundamentals: model training, optimization, loss design, evaluation, and generalization. * Familiarity with modern vision foundation models and VLMs. * Proficiency in Python and PyTorch, comfort jobs.title: Sr. Computer Vision/ML Scientist
jobs.description: Aicadium's Applied Research team is looking for a senior computer vision / ML scientist to tackle open\-world visual understanding with limited labels across 2D recognition, multimodal inspection, and 3D/4D perception. You will bring anomaly detection, zero\- and few\-shot recognition, and semantic segmentation to applied systems used across multiple industries, building on 2D and 3D vision foundation models and vision\-language models (VLMs). Collaborate with engineering and product teams to bring new models to production, and maintain and improve model quality after launch. * Provide technical guidance to junior scientists and communicate methods, results, and trade\-offs to technical and non\-technical stakeholders. **Skills \& Requirements:** * PhD or Master's in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, Machine Learning, or a related field with 4\+ years of hands\-on computer vision / ML experience; doctoral research counts toward this requirement. * Expertise in at least two of the following: anomaly detection, zero\- and few\-shot (open\-vocabulary) recognition, semantic segmentation, or multimodal (vision\-language) learning. * Experience adapting vision foundation models (e.g., DINOv3, JEPA\-family models , SAM series) and VLMs (e.g., the Qwen\-VL series) to new domains. * Hands\-on experience in 3D/4D reconstruction and spatial perception, including modern 3D foundation models (e.g., VGGT, MASt3R, Depth Anything 3\), grounded in multi\-view geometry and camera models. * Ability to independently define research problems and turn recent research into working prototypes, with rigorous experimental practice: strong baselines, ablations, and sound evaluation on real\-world data, including rare\-event and heavily imbalanced problems. * Strong proficiency in Python and PyTorch, with a solid foundation in applied mathematics (linear algebra, geometry, probability, statistics, optimization). * Clear written and verbal communication skills, including presenting research to technical and non\-technical audiences and stakeholders. **Nice to Have:** * Publications at top\-tier venues (CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS, ICLR) or notable open\-source contributions in related areas. * Experience bringing computer vision models from prototype to production or customer\-facing deployment. * Experience generating synthetic training data with generative models or simulation, particularly for defects, anomalies, and rare or data\-deficient scenarios and classes. * Domain experience in industrial inspection, manufacturing, aerospace, food processing, medical imaging, or other fields with similar rare\-defect or visual verification problems. * Experience with world models, such as V\-JEPA 2, NVIDIA Cosmos, or spatially grounded VLMs. Experience with VLAs and transformer\-based action planners. **About Us:** Aicadium is a global technology company delivering AI\-powered industrial computer vision products into the hands of enterprises. With offices in Singapore and San Diego, California, and an international team of data scientists, engineers, and business strategists, Aicadium is operationalizing AI within organizations where advanced machine learning innovations were previously out of reach. **Team** Join a growing team of data scientists, machine learning, and software engineers in an agile development environment. Work together with some of the best in the field to tackle challenging projects and operationalize the solutions you develop across a variety of industries and use cases. **Culture** We work in a casual and collaborative startup environment. Every member of the team plays a key role in shaping the solutions we develop and creating positive business value for the companies we work with. We are building a hub of the best talent in San Diego, CA, but we are open to working with people all over the U.S. **Benefits** Aicadium has a great benefits package to come with your salary. Benefits include PTO, health, vision, and dental insurance, life and AD\&D, 401k with matching, and more!
