Working alongside senior engineers, you will turn business logic into intelligent, automated workflows that reason, call tools, and execute multi\-step tasks.**This is an in\-person role in Glenview, IL. This requires regular on\-site work, and relocation assistance is not provided.** **Core Responsibilities** * Agent Implementation: Build and refine AI agents and multi\-step workflows using our in\-house agent framework. * API Integration: Write clean PHP code to connect commercial LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google) to internal REST APIs and enterprise databases, including tool calling and structured outputs. * RAG \& Vector Management: Assist in building and maintaining Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines using embeddings and vector search. * Testing \& Evaluation: Write test scripts to evaluate agent outputs, benchmark token costs, and track down hallucinations and runaway loops. * Prompt Engineering: Design, test, and version\-control system prompts, function schemas, and tool definitions for chat and batch processing. **Required Technical Skills** * Programming: 1–3 years of professional experience writing clean, readable, object\-oriented PHP. * API Fundamentals: Strong understanding of RESTful APIs, JSON parsing, and serialization in backend environments. * Databases: Solid SQL experience (we use Oracle, MySQL/MariaDB, and Postgres). * Version Control: Proficiency with Git and collaborative code\-review workflows. **Preferred Qualifications** * Hands\-on experience with LLM APIs * Experience working with legacy code in a large, established codebase. **We offer our team members:** * Full Time starting pay: $50\-54 based on experience * Yearly performance review * Potential for advancement * Performance\-based bonuses throughout the year * Medical/Dental (Blue Cross and Blue Shield PPO Network) \& Vision (VSP) * 401(k) (Charles Schwab) which includes a matching program * Life \& Disability insurance (Lincoln Financial) * Generous Paid Time Off/Sick Pay Program * Continued training \& career development * Employee discounts on all the products we sell

jobs.title: Senior Engineer - AI Test Automation
jobs.description: For more than 40 years, Accelya has been the industry’s partner for change, simplifying airline financial and commercial processes and empowering the air transport community to take better control of the future. Whether partnering with IATA on industry\-wide initiatives or enabling digital transformation to simplify airline processes, Accelya drives the airline industry forward and proudly puts control back in the hands of airlines so they can move further, faster. We are looking for a Software Engineer – AI Test Automation to join the team developing AiroQ, an AI\-powered platform designed to automatically generate executable test cases for airline distribution APIs. AiroQ generates test scenarios for IATA NDC APIs, producing tests that can be executed through SoapUI and integrated into modern engineering and QA workflows. The platform can be accessed through AI development assistants such as Claude Code, Kiro, and Windsurf using the Model Context Protocol (MCP), as well as through REST APIs. The ideal candidate is a strong TypeScript/Node.js engineer with experience building APIs and cloud\-native applications on AWS. Experience with API testing, XML/SOAP, AI\-assisted development, or airline/NDC technology is highly desirable. **Key Responsibilities** * Design, develop, and maintain backend services for the AiroQ platform using TypeScript and Node.js. * Build and maintain MCP servers and REST APIs used by AI assistants and external applications. * Develop capabilities that automatically generate executable API test cases and test data. * Implement API contracts, schemas, and runtime validation using OpenAPI and Zod. * Build integrations with AI development tools and assistants through the Model Context Protocol (MCP). * Develop and maintain support for IATA NDC 17\.2 and 24\.1 API workflows. * Generate and validate XML/SOAP requests and responses for NDC testing. * Develop automated validations using XPath, Groovy, and SoapUI. * Design and maintain AWS\-based services using Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, ECS Fargate, Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, S3, Cognito, and CloudWatch. * Implement secure authentication and authorization using OAuth 2\.0, JWT, and Amazon Cognito. * Develop and maintain infrastructure as code using AWS CloudFormation. * Implement logging, monitoring, error handling, and observability for production services. * Collaborate with QA engineers, developers, architects, and product teams to translate business and API requirements into automated testing capabilities. * Contribute to engineering standards, code reviews, automated testing, CI/CD, documentation, and platform reliability. **Required Qualifications** * Strong software development experience with TypeScript and Node.js. * Experience designing and implementing REST APIs. * Strong understanding of API contracts, schemas, validation, and error handling. * Experience developing cloud\-native applications on AWS. * Experience with services such as Lambda, API Gateway, ECS/Fargate, DynamoDB, S3, Cognito, and CloudWatch. * Understanding of OAuth 2\.0, JWT, and API authentication/authorization. * Experience working with structured data formats including XML and JSON. * Strong understanding of automated testing and software quality practices. * Experience with Git\-based development workflows, code reviews, and CI/CD. * Ability to troubleshoot distributed applications and independently analyze complex technical problems. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP) and AI\-assisted development tools. * Experience building applications or tools using LLMs or generative AI. * Experience with Amazon Bedrock or Bedrock AgentCore. * Knowledge of IATA NDC, particularly versions 17\.2 and 24\.1\. * Experience with airline shopping, pricing, booking, servicing, or order\-management APIs. * Experience with SOAP, XML Schema/XSD, XPath, and SoapUI. * Experience writing Groovy scripts for SoapUI automation and validation. * Experience building test\-generation frameworks or API testing platforms. * Experience with Zod and OpenAPI. * Experience with Infrastructure as Code, particularly AWS CloudFormation. Technical Stack Backend: TypeScript, Node.js, MCP, REST, OpenAPI, Zod AI / Agent Integration: Model Context Protocol (MCP), Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, AI coding assistants NDC \& Testing: IATA NDC 17\.2 / 24\.1, XML, SOAP, SoapUI, XPath, Groovy AWS: ECS Fargate, Lambda, API Gateway, Cognito, DynamoDB, S3, CloudWatch, Bedrock AgentCore Infrastructure: AWS CloudFormation **What Success Looks Like** The engineer in this role will help evolve AiroQ into a scalable AI\-powered testing platform that enables engineering and QA teams to generate reliable NDC API test cases quickly, execute them through existing testing workflows, and increasingly incorporate automated testing into the software development lifecycle. Success will be measured by the quality and reliability of generated tests, expansion of NDC workflow coverage, platform stability and scalability, and adoption of AiroQ across engineering and QA teams. **What do we offer?** · Open culture and challenging opportunity to satisfy intellectual needs · Flexible working hours · Smart working: hybrid remote/office working environment · Work\-life balance · Excellent, dynamic and multicultural environment **About Accelya** Accelya is a leading global software provider to the airline industry, powering 200\+ airlines with an open, modular software platform that enables innovative airlines to drive growth, delight their customers and take control of their retailing. Owned by Vista Equity Partners long\-term perennial fund and with 2K\+ employees based around 10 global offices, Accelya are trusted by industry leaders to deliver now and deliver for the future. The company´s passenger, cargo, and industry platforms support airline retailing from offer to settlement, both above and below the wing. Accelya are proud to deliver leading\-edge technologies to our customers including through our partnership with AWS and through the pioneering NDC expertise of our Global Product teams. We are proud to enable innovation\-led growth for the airline industry and put control back in the hands of airlines. For more information, please visit www.accelya.com What does the future of the air transport industry look like to you? Whether you’re an industry veteran or someone with experience from other industries, we want to make your ambitions a reality!

jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.description: We are looking for a hands\-on Director of Engineering to lead our engineering function and scale AVA, Acclinate's community intelligence platform, into an enterprise\-grade product. You will report to our Head of Product \& Marketing and lead and grow a small engineering team while shipping code yourself. You will work inside a unit that owns the path from customer and community need to product, launch, and growth. Product decides what we build and why. You own how it gets built, whether it is ready for production, and whether the data behind it can be trusted. You prioritize impact over flawless code. You join customer calls, turn thin specs into working software, and keep a clear boundary between fast iteration and rigorous, compliant production releases. ### **About Acclinate Inc.** Acclinate is the catalyst for health equity. We use trust, technology, and community engagement to help the healthcare ecosystem connect with those they aim to serve. Our approach ensures innovation is inclusive, empowering communities to take actions for better health. ### **Description** **What you will own** --------------------- ### **Architecture and systems** * Own the architecture and full\-stack systems behind complex proprietary data, analytics pipelines, and LLM\-powered features. * Maintain and modernize our core stack: GCP\-native infrastructure (Cloud Run, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Vertex AI), containers, CI/CD, and Ruby on Rails. * Evaluate a new stack to modernize the frontend and backend, and bring a migration recommendation to the Head of Product \& Marketing. * Own integrations across our data and business systems, including Metabase, HubSpot, and the tools connecting product, analytics, customer, and operational data. * Think in systems. Every feature touches an external platform, a background job, a database, an API contract, a client, and a customer report. Design so a break is visible before a customer sees it. ### **Data confidence and traceability** * Know where every number comes from. The platform pulls from several external sources, runs predictive scoring models, and reports back to customers. * Trace a wrong metric to its source and fix the pipeline when an upstream platform changes. * Write the SQL that answers a customer's question, and stand behind the number. ### **Quality, security, and compliance** * Set delivery standards: small PRs, tests that prove behavior, migrations that don't break a deploy, and structured logs and traces. * Build and maintain the technical controls for data security, audit trails, HIPAA, and SOC 2, working with our Director of Quality Assurance and Compliance, who owns the compliance program. * Modernize engineering processes through streamlined code review, automated testing, and production monitoring. ### **Partnership with Product and the business** * Turn product priorities into a delivery plan, and be clear about what it will take. * Join customer and partner calls when the work calls for it. Turn a thin spec into working software without waiting for exhaustive documentation. * Push back when an ask won't hold up in production, and propose a better path. Your manager expects this. * Work with Community, Customer Success, and Commercial teams so engineering output supports how we sell, deliver, and support the product. ### **Team building and mentorship** * Manage, mentor, and work alongside the engineering team, including engineers supporting AVA and NOWINCLUDED. * Build the team intentionally, hiring engineers who are strong at rapid prototyping, system design, and disciplined delivery. * Onboard new engineers into the codebase and the customer context. ### **AI\-native development** * Use Claude Code, Cursor, or an equivalent for most of your output. Know when to prompt, when to code by hand, and how to evaluate AI\-generated work critically. * Write the repo instructions, decision records, and plans that help AI agents produce correct code the first time. * Review agent output with the rigor you'd give a junior engineer's PR. * Help the team improve how it uses AI through better workflows, shared practices, and internal tooling. **What you bring** ------------------ ### **Leadership and engineering experience** We're open to several profiles: * 8\+ years of engineering leadership, with a recent and proven shift to AI\-native ways of working. * 5\+ years in AI\-native engineering teams, with deep fluency in how they operate. * 3–5 years, if you have clearly outpaced peers with more experience through speed and shipping. In every case, you have led engineers directly and are comfortable reporting to a product and commercial leader rather than a technical one. ### **Technical depth** * 5\+ years building production systems, including at least one you took from early design to customers using it. * **Data engineering and AI:** data pipelines, data security, and LLM APIs or modern AI tooling in production. * **Cloud infrastructure:** strong cloud experience, GCP preferred, including Cloud Run, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Vertex AI, and CI/CD practices. * **Full stack:** backend architecture, data infrastructure, APIs, integrations, and front\-end work. Ruby on Rails and a typed client framework preferred; strong Rails plus React and a willingness to learn Flutter also works. * **Data\-model\-first thinking:** you design tables and APIs before screens, and can explain the tradeoffs. * Healthcare or regulated\-data experience (HIPAA, SOC 2, audit trails) is a strong plus. ### **AI tooling fluency** * Daily use of AI coding agents on real codebases, with a clear view of where they fail. * A concrete approach to structuring a repo so an agent produces correct code, and to checking its work before merging. ### **Communication** * Plain, direct writing. Most coordination is asynchronous: PR descriptions, decision records, Slack updates, and memos a non\-engineer can follow. * You can explain technical risk and tradeoffs in business terms to a non\-technical manager and to customers. * Comfort with a small team, a real customer base, and ambiguity. Shipping is expected. **Salary and Benefits** Compensation depends on experience and includes base salary, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package. At Acclinate, we offer a competitive benefits package, including health, dental, and vision insurance with 50% of premiums covered by the company. jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer
jobs.description: **Role** ======== The Senior Full\-Stack Engineer exists to solve problems that make Acquisition.com's advisory and client application efforts more successful. The goal is a better net client experience, built by designing systems and processes around client data inside our platforms and integrations. Some of those problems are integrations. Some are net\-new applications. Some are automations that replace manual work nobody should be doing. The common thread is that you see a problem, figure out the right solution, and build it end\-to\-end. Acquisition.com operates across advisory, media, and technology functions, each generating its own set of systems, data flows, and process challenges. You will work across these functions, building the internal tools, automations, and application layers that let the business move faster and serve clients better. The work is varied by design. One week you might be standing up a new client\-facing workflow; the next, you might be wiring two systems together or rebuilding a pipeline that has outgrown its original architecture. This is a hands\-on, individual\-contributor role. You will own projects from idea through production, working directly with engineering, leadership, and business teams to understand what needs to exist and then making it real. **Responsibilities** ==================== * Build and ship full\-stack applications, services, and internal tools that improve the client experience and support advisory operations * Design and implement automations that replace manual processes and reduce operational overhead across business functions * Architect and maintain integrations between internal systems and external platforms to keep client data accurate and accessible * Own projects end\-to\-end, from scoping the problem with stakeholders through deployment, monitoring, and iteration * Collaborate with engineering, leadership, and business teams to translate raw needs into working software that delivers measurable results * Continuously evaluate and improve system architecture for performance, scalability, and reliability as the business grows **Requirements** ================ * Proven ability to build production applications across the stack, not just one layer, with 5\+ years of experience delivering complex or high\-impact systems * Strong experience designing and shipping automations and process\-driven tooling that reduced real operational burden * Demonstrated skill building integration frameworks and data pipelines that connect multiple systems reliably at scale * Proficiency in both Python and TypeScript for building scalable services, automation workflows, and application layers * Track record of working directly with non\-technical stakeholders to understand the real problem before writing code * Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred), CI/CD, observability tooling, and agent\-driven development tools such as Cursor and Claude Code **Results** =========== * The net client experience improves because the systems and processes around client data are reliable, well\-designed, and built for how the business actually operates * Advisory and client application teams operate faster because the tools they depend on work and are built for their actual workflows * Manual processes are replaced by automations that save measurable time and reduce errors across business functions * Integrations between systems are seamless, accurate, and maintainable, reducing the overhead of keeping data in sync * New capabilities move from idea to production quickly because you own the full path and do not wait for handoffs * Engineering patterns and reusable components emerge from your work, raising the baseline for the entire platform **Schedule** ============ * Work hours aligned with local timezone or Pacific timezone (8a\-5p M\-F) * Availability to support critical launches or events when needed **Location** ============ * Full\-time, remote (US\-based) * Quarterly on\-sites in Las Vegas **Compensation:** ================= * $170,000 \- $200,000 base salary * The salary range may be inclusive of several levels that would be applicable to the position. Final salary will be based on a number of factors including, level, relevant prior experience, skills, and expertise. This range is only inclusive of base salary, not benefits (more details below). **Benefits:** ============= We offer a comprehensive, evolving benefits package designed to support your health, family, and wellbeing. Some key offerings: * Flexible Unlimited Paid Time Off and Company\-wide Holidays * Employer sponsored Medical, Dental, \& Vision plans + $1,950 annual Employer HSA contribution + FSA options including dependent care + Employee assistance program and mental health resources * Employer match program for 401(k), eligible for both Traditional and Roth accounts * $1,200 annual wellness reimbursement through JOON that supports health, family care, pet care, fitness, and more! * For local or visiting team members, enjoy access to a state of the art gym at our HQ in Las Vegas * *Benefits eligibility applies only to full\-time exempt roles.* **ACQ Core Values:** ==================== Our core values are the heart and soul of this incredible company. The right person for this role will appreciate each of these values, personally subscribe to them, and understand why each is critical to having a great business. **Competitive Greatness** ------------------------- Be at your best when your best is needed. Enjoyment of a hard challenge. Those who have the drive to constantly improve, the superior intellect and long term commitment to see incremental improvements become compounding returns. **Sincere Candor** ------------------ Have the self awareness to accurately perceive and communicate hard truths that improve others and self, the courage to do so, and the humility to accept them, even when it hurts. Nothing great can be built without feedback: internally or externally. **Unimpeachable Character** --------------------------- Be the type of person with whom people are always proud to associate, personally and professionally. We look for true alignment of thoughts, words, and actions towards a goal worth pursuing. Compensation Range: $170K \- $200K

jobs.title: Senior Java Systems Engineer - Platform Exchange / Matching Engine - NYC - Fintech
jobs.description: **WE ARE:** At Adaptive, we are a technology provider firm that partners with capital, commodity, and digital market participants to build custom front\-office technology, messaging systems, and trading infrastructure. Our experienced teams design and deliver complex front\-office technology solutions using our proven accelerators to create long\-term competitive advantage. Our clients include the world's leading investment banks, investment managers, fintechs and capital market service providers. With a global reach, with offices in London, New York, Barcelona, Montreal, and Manila, we have a proven track record of delivering powerful, elegant and intuitive trading technology solutions, and we value technical pragmatism, collaboration, and clear communication. We're looking for a Senior Java / Systems Engineer with significant experience in Platform Exchange Systems to design, deliver, and optimize production\-ready, high\-performance, low\-latency technology using Aeron. **YOU ARE:** * A hands\-on engineer who enjoys designing and optimising low\-latency Java services and protocols across the full delivery lifecycle. * Someone with genuine experience building Matching Engines and Platform Exchange Systems. * Driven by evidence\-based engineering, automated testing, benchmarking, and profiling rather than guesswork. * A clear, confident communicator who can work across domain boundaries in a collaborative Agile environment, rather than being siloed into a single technology stack. **YOU HAVE:** * Strong server\-side, low\-latency Java expertise (concurrency, memory management, I/O, and performance profiling). * Solid exchange, risk, or matching\-engine experience. * Hands\-on experience building automated testing strategies, running performance benchmarks, and diagnosing production issues. * Excellent technical communication and collaborative problem\-solving skills. * Experience with order entry and market data protocols (e.g. FIX, ITCH). * Familiarity with low\-latency frameworks such as Aeron, Chronicle, or LBM. * An understanding of replicated state machines, event sourcing, or deterministic systems. * Exposure to cloud environments (AWS/GCP), containers, Kubernetes, or observability tooling. **YOU WILL:** * Design, build, and optimise low\-latency Java services and protocols for an Exchange Accelerator product across the delivery lifecycle. * Define order, session, instrument, and account models alongside exchange integration boundaries. * Develop automated testing strategies and perform evidence\-based performance benchmarking and profiling. * Collaborate directly with client teams, SREs, QA, and leadership to ensure exchange readiness and durable production fixes. * Engage with client engineering and business stakeholders, communicating technical trade\-offs clearly. * Support the product in production across multiple client deployments. (And after six months) * Independently own key technical workstreams from concept to production readiness. * Deliver maintainable, observable, and well\-tested systems aligned with core architecture. * Establish trusted relationships with clients through clear communication and steady delivery. **WHY US:** * To be immersed in high\-standard engineering culture. Our fantastic team takes pride in crafting complex technical solutions but also loves sharing their knowledge and helping you grow professionally (we have extraordinary minds at Adaptive, you can learn from anyone here, which is the beauty of it). * To take part in the growth and development of a great company. * Our teams feel free to speak up, make suggestions and raise concerns. * Collaborative team environment: we all work together, respect each other, and pitch in * Great consideration for work/life balance (highly\-flexible, hybrid working model, well\-being benefits…). The balance between professional and personal life is massively important to us. * We work hard to provide a positive, collaborative and inclusive culture and to positively impact our staff and local communities through different well\-being, diversity and inclusion programmes. **WHAT PEOPLE THINK OF US** You can check our Glassdoor page **BENEFITS (What we offer in return // what you'll get ):** For permanents: We create benefits with YOU in mind. We create benefits with YOU in mind: * Flexible hybrid working model * Medical from the 1st of the following month of your start date (i.e. if you join on the 24th of July, it starts on the 1st of August). We have 6 Aetna plans to choose from as provided by our PEO, Justworks. We make a flat monthly contribution to your healthcare costs * Dental and vision from the 1st of the month following your start date \- we have 3 dental and 2 vision plans to choose from. We make fixed contributions to each * 23 days of vacation per calendar year plus 11 public holidays * Group disability insurance: short\-term and long\-term (60% and taxable) * 401K safe harbor plan where we match contributions up to 5% of base pay on a paycheck\-to\-paycheck basis (you can opt\-in after 90 days of service) * Gym subsidy of up to $50 per month (and we pay the taxes on that so it's a real $50\) post probation * Life insurance at 2 x salary * Commuter benefits * Health Savings Account and Flexible Spending Account * Mental Health First Aiders **THE PROCESS** Long interview processes are stressful and boring and that is not us! We want to make sure that everything runs smoothly. So here you will have three\-stage interviews: 1\- A chat with one of our great recruiters. 2\- A Zoom chat with one of our Java colleagues where they will ask you detailed questions about your experience. 3\- A Face to Face interview (either in our office or via Zoom). During this interview, we will dig even deeper and you will have a pair programming task to do. But don't worry; everything will be explained to you step by step by your recruiter. **A little tip for you during those stages:** Collaboration is massively important to us, so don't hesitate to share your thoughts, ask questions, ask for help if needed, etc **DIVERSITY \& INCLUSION:** Diversity and inclusion are key to a great workplace, and Adaptive is better when it's more representative of the world around us. We want everyone to feel comfortable bringing their whole selves to work without any fear of judgment or negativity. All we ask is that our colleagues are respectful, collaborative, passionate about what they do, and have the skills needed to be successful in their roles. **Background check:** the employment/engagement is subject to an acceptable background check that will be run by Adaptive. ***E\-verify:*** *Adaptive Financial Consulting Inc. makes use of E\-Verify to validate someone's right to work in the US. We will provide the Social Security Administration, and, if necessary, the Department of Homeland Security, with information from each new employee's Form I\-9 to confirm work authorization. Please note that we do not use this information to pre\-screen job applicants.*

jobs.description: At Alcon, we're passionate about enhancing sight and helping people see brilliantly. You will be a quantitative scientist who combines rigorous statistical thinking with modern computational methods to solve complex scientific problems and translate innovation into reproducible, validated, and scalable capabilities for a regulated environment. jobs.title: Desktop Support Engineer - SCCM Knowledge
jobs.description: \*Position Title: Deskside Technician – End User Computing \*JOB DESCRIPTION **(CONTRACT JOB: Renewable once in every 3 months)** The position of Deskside Technician – End User Computing performs troubleshooting, repair, and preventative maintenance of end user computing equipment and peripheral equipment at corporate locations. The candidate works on assignments of a diverse scope where analysis of data and hardware requires evaluation of identifiable factors. The candidate exercises judgment with supervision within the generally defined practices and policies in selecting methods and techniques for obtaining solutions and acts as a liaison between customers, departments, and within the organization to lead problem resolution. Any incumbent in this position is expected to perform all the duties of this job description at a minimum level of satisfaction as determined by this position's ADSL managers and/or the ADSL client(s) this position may be assigned to support. If the incumbent is given a separate job description or a different protocol/guideline or expectation by an ADSL client, the incumbent will immediately notify this position’s immediate manager at ADSL so that the ADSL manager can ensure the ADSL and client job descriptions are compatible and aligned. The incumbent in this position understands that the "at will" employment relationship which ADSL has with all of its employees also applies to the assignment of the incumbent to an ADSL client. Therefore, the incumbent understands that an ADSL client may end the incumbent's assignment with the client at any time and at the ADSL client's sole discretion. In such cases, ADSL's continued employment of the incumbent in this position will be evaluated on a case\-by\-case basis and be further subject to ADSL's business needs and the terms of the "at\-will" relationship which ADSL has with all of its employees. Required Skills and abilities (For any questions, please contact INF\_Leadership.) · Managing work queues in Service Now. · Attend daily Team meetings. · Assist in coverage support for PTO and sick days. · Prioritize tickets accordingly (P1’s, P2s, Break/Fix, VIP, escalated and expedited incidents and tasks). · Good working knowledge of MS Windows versions 10 and 11 and experience troubleshooting the same. · Experience troubleshooting network printers. · Resolving hardware issues for desktops and laptops including Break / Fix. · Support of Desktops, Laptops and mobile devices including Windows, Apple, and Android. · Troubleshooting and diagnosing various technical issues. · Installing and maintaining the company’s software and equipment using tools such as SCCM. · Re\-imaging devices when necessary. · Troubleshooting various technology issues. · Helping new employees to set up their workstation. · Preventative maintenance tasks on machines with low health scores in Systrack. · Assisting other teams with gathering information such as rack space, cabling, or pictures as needed. · Creating and updating Knowledge base articles (KB’s) and Standard operation processes (SOP’s). · Excellent English and communication skills · Assessing and understanding user needs and issues. · Answering general questions presented by our customers. · All other tasks as assigned. · Daily duty details CUSTOMER SERVICE · One of the most important responsibilities that deskside support technicians have is providing personal support services. They must build rapport and obtain problem details from help desk customers. They politely take incoming requests for help from end users through the Service Now ticketing system. PROBLEM\-SOLVING · Deskside support technicians take initiative and ownership of reported end\-user problems. They use diagnostic tools to identify root problems. Once the issue is identified, deskside support technicians process these incidents through an incident management process. DELIVER HARDWARE AND APPLICATION SUPPORT · When end users need technical support with desktops, laptops, tablets, workstation devices, mobile devices, printers, and software, they turn to deskside support. These technicians then diagnose and solve unique one\-time problems. To complete this, they reimage systems and engage in computer networking. Deskside support technicians also work with purchasing staff to buy replacement hardware and software as needed. ASSIST OTHER TEAMS · Deskside technicians are occasionally called up to lend support to other technical towers. This may require going into server rooms, network closets or other locations to assist. INSTALL SOFTWARE UPGRADES · Deskside support workers complete hands\-on fixes for desktops and laptops that include software installations and upgrades. They perform file backups and configure new systems and applications. After completing installations, deskside support workers test new computers according to established guidelines. CREATE AND MAINTAIN DOCUMENTATION · Documentation is a major requirement for deskside support. They re e notes for the help desk problem\-solving process, including decision outcomes, actions taken, and final resolutions. Deskside support technicians are often required to submit accurate call logs itemizing customer interactions. APPLICATION MIGRATION \& REPACKAGING · Inventory SCCM\-deployed applications by exporting the list of applications, versions, and deployment types · Identify Intune\-compatible formats, flagging MSI, EXE, and script\-based installers that need conversion to Intune · Repackage applications using the Microsoft Win32 Content Prep Tool to create Intune files, and validate silent install/uninstall commands · Test application deployments in pilot groups, validating install success, detection rules, and rollback · Document application metadata, including publisher, version, install command, detection method, and related details ENROLLMENT \& POLICY TESTING · Enroll test devices via Autopilot or manual enrollment, validating device join type (Azure AD joined vs. hybrid) · Apply pilot configuration profiles and test compliance policies, device restrictions, and security settings · Verify Conditional Access behavior to ensure policies trigger correctly based on device state · Log and report enrollment errors, capturing screenshots and logs for troubleshooting · Perform device imaging and OS updates for desktops and laptops following customer standard procedures END USER COORDINATION · Schedule pilot user testing sessions, coordinating with selected users to validate app access, device behavior, and policy enforcement · Create user\-friendly, step\-by\-step guides for enrollment, app access, and common issues · Collect feedback from pilot users using forms or Teams surveys to gather usability and performance insights · Provide Tier 1 onsite support to Authorized Users during migration, assisting with enrollment issues, app failures, and basic troubleshooting, and to meet specified SLAs · Utilize existing customer Knowledge Base to resolve incidents and tasks associated with EUC equipment · Remote support tooling including BeyondTrust; Bomgar; TeamViewer, etc SECURITY \& COMPLIANCE CHECKS · Verify BitLocker and Defender status post\-enrollment · Ensure FIPS and TPM settings align with compliance policies · Confirm device tagging and group membership in Intune · Security responsibilities including Defender; MDM enrollment; BitLocker handling; Phishing response REPORTING \& DOCUMENTATION · Update the migration tracker, logging completed repackaging, test results, and deployment status · Maintain an issue/resolution log, tracking recurring problems and fixes for future reference · Assist with the Power BI dashboard · Utilize customer provided ITSM ticketing systems with regular updates and proper hygiene applied to all tickets · Update CMDB with asset allocation and de\-allocation details following customer standard procedures · Provide regular, accurate, and timely feedback regarding customer requirements and maintain timely communication with operations and project personnel · Excellent written communication and customer service skills with ability to communicate technical information to both technical and non\-technical team and customers · Intune migration support and other duties as required \*JOB REQUIREMENTS/QUALIFICATIONS Experience: · Requires 3\+ years of related work experience · Knowledge of imaging tools (SCCM, MDT) · Knowledge of data backup and recovery tools · Installing, upgrading, and migrating to Windows 10/11 · Deploying Windows 10/11 in large enterprises · Configuring hardware and applications · Configuring network connectivity · Configuring access to resources · Configuring mobile computing · Monitoring and maintaining systems that run Windows 10/11 · Configuring backup and recovery options Certifications: · A\+ Certification a plus Pay: $26\.00 \- $27\.00 per hour Expected hours: 40\.0 per week Experience: * Desktop support: 4 years (Required) * SCCM: 4 years (Required) Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Data Engineer, Amazon Live Data Engineering, Sciences and Analytics (DESA)
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Description Amazon Live is building the future of shoppable video — connecting brands with customers through livestreams, short\-form video, and creator\-driven content across Amazon Shopping, Fire TV, Prime Video, and social platforms. The product serves millions of monthly viewers, processes billions of events daily across 9 marketplaces, and generates tens of millions of dollars in advertiser revenue, with a goal to reach 100MM\+ MAUs and 20K\+ brands in the next couple of years. Amazon Live has a mature, high\-performing data platform powering reporting across 9 marketplaces, 14\+ dashboards, real\-time creator analytics, and a growing suite of AI\-native tooling (self\-serve analytics agents, agentic operational assistants). The opportunity ahead is to build the next layer on that strong foundation: the team is standing up an intelligence layer — causal measurement, content intelligence, and ranking signals — and that requires a new class of foundational, reusable data assets purpose\-built for both analytics and ML consumption. This role builds them. We are looking for a Data Engineer to join the DESA team as a dedicated owner of forward\-looking data architecture. You will design and build durable, well\-modeled datasets that serve three consumers at once: the BIE for executive reporting, the Applied Scientists for model training, and downstream ML systems (ranking, personalization, recommendations) for feature consumption. The goal is leverage — build an asset once, serve many use cases, and let the whole team move faster on top of it. Your work becomes the foundation the science function builds on: when the data assets are ready ahead of need, scientists model from day one instead of waiting on bespoke pipelines. This is a high\-ownership role on a team that moves fast. You will go from problem to production quickly, in a challenging and fast\-paced environment, and you will work across the full breadth of the data domain — platform engineering, data modeling, ML\-ready feature production, data quality, and AI\-assisted development. You will partner closely with Applied Scientists, MLEs, fellow Data Engineers, and the BIE, giving you the opportunity to learn and execute across every aspect of a modern data organization — from raw event ingestion through the models and reporting that move multi\-million\-dollar business decisions. Key job responsibilities * Design and build a content metadata layer that unifies broadcast events, product catalog data, creator profiles, and show metadata into reusable assets consumed by both dashboards and models. * Build cross\-session shopper profile datasets that sessionize event data across visits and compute rolling engagement metrics (frequency, recency, depth, conversion lag). * Build integration pipelines connecting retail catalog and advertising performance data into the Amazon Live platform, unlocking new dimensions for analytics and ML. * Produce structured, ML\-ready datasets that feed Applied Scientists' models and serve features to downstream ranking and personalization systems. * Own and advance data quality: proactive monitoring and anomaly detection so the team stays ahead of issues. * Advance platform engineering maturity — CI/CD for ETL (BDT/Maestro), standardized deployment, and AI\-assisted code generation and review. * Partner with Applied Scientists, MLEs, DEs, and the BIE to align data assets to model, serving, and reporting needs. A day in the life You will move fast across a broad surface. Some weeks you will be designing a denormalized content metadata asset with an Applied Scientist to unblock a new model; other weeks you will be integrating a retail or advertising data source, hardening a pipeline's CI/CD, building data\-quality alarms, or packaging features for the distribution team's ranking systems. You will partner daily with scientists, MLEs, DEs, and the BIE — scoping what to build and how it will be consumed — and you will have self\-serve analytics agents and agentic operational tooling to accelerate your work (and a hand in extending that tooling as the platform grows). The pace is quick, the problems span the full data lifecycle, and the ownership is real. About the team The DESA team owns the data platform, analytics, and sciences for Amazon Live and Shop the Show. jobs.description: Amphenol Communications Solutions (ACS), a division of Amphenol Corporation, is a world leader in interconnect solutions for Communications, Mobile, RF, Optics, and Commercial electronics markets. Amphenol Corporation is one of the world’s largest designers and manufacturers of electrical, electronic and fiber optic connectors and interconnect systems, antennas, sensors and sensor\-based products and coaxial and high\-speed specialty cable. ACS has an expansive global presence in research and development, manufacturing, and sales. We design and manufacture a wide range of innovative connectors as well as cable assemblies for diverse applications including server, storage, data center, mobile, RF, networking, industrial, business equipment, and automotive. The **Reliability Engineer (Data Analytics)** will apply reliability testing, statistical modeling, design of experiments (DOE), and data analytics to improve cable backplane assemblies for AI and hyperscale data centers. Working across design, manufacturing, and quality teams, this role will translate test, process, and field data into actionable insights that reduce risk, strengthen product robustness, and improve launch readiness. This position is based in Etters, PA; Raleigh, NC; or Nashua, NH. Some remote work may be considered based on the candidate’s qualifications. Approximately 30% travel is expected. **RESPONSIBILITIES:** * Develop data\-driven reliability and robustness strategies across the product life cycle. * Analyze reliability, manufacturing, FRACAS, RMA, and field data to identify trends, failure patterns, and systemic risks. * Apply regression, ANOVA, hypothesis testing, distribution analysis, and multivariate methods to support risk\-based decisions. * Design and analyze experiments to identify critical factors and optimize product and process performance. * Lead Six Sigma and structured problem\-solving efforts using DMAIC, DOE, MSA, SPC, 8D, and root\-cause analysis. * Build reliability and life models using Weibull, Arrhenius, and physics\-of\-failure methods; correlate accelerated test results with field performance. * Automate analyses and dashboards that communicate reliability metrics, variation, leading indicators, and emerging risks. * Lead failure analysis and present clear technical conclusions and recommendations to cross\-functional, executive, and customer stakeholders. **QUALIFICATIONS:** * Bachelor’s degree in engineering, reliability, statistics, data science, or a related quantitative field; advanced degree preferred. * 5\+ years of experience in reliability, validation, quality, data analytics, or failure analysis; cable, connector, or high\-speed interconnect experience preferred. * Proficiency in reliability statistics, life\-data and accelerated\-test modeling, sampling methods, confidence bounds, and regression. * Experience with Six Sigma methods and tools; Green Belt or equivalent practical experience preferred. * Proficiency with JMP, Minitab, Python, R, SQL, MATLAB, or comparable analytics and visualization tools. * Hands\-on experience with electrical, mechanical, and environmental testing and with diagnosing mixed failure modes. * Strong analytical, technical leadership, and communication skills. * Ability to travel up to 30% **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience with HALT, HASS, ALT, ORT, and ESS methodologies. * Experience with AI data centers, hyperscale infrastructure, or high\-speed copper and hybrid cable technologies. * Experience with predictive analytics, machine learning, anomaly detection, or reliability data pipelines. * Familiarity with Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) and manufacturing data integration, traceability, and analytics. * Six Sigma Black Belt, Certified Reliability Engineer, or comparable certification. * Familiarity with IPC, IEC, Telcordia, or MIL\-STD standards and FIT, MTBF, warranty, or return\-rate analytics. jobs.title: Applied AI Demo Engineer
jobs.description: **About Anthropic** ------------------- Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. **About the role** ------------------ Anthropic's customer\-facing teams are often the first place a customer sees what Claude can do. As a Demo Engineer, you'll build the demos, reference implementations, and reusable tooling that help those teams make new capabilities tangible, relevant, and trustworthy, ideally within days of a product launch rather than weeks after. This role sits between product engineering, technical storytelling, and GTM execution. You'll own ambiguous, high\-leverage problems end to end: prototyping an agentic experience for a new capability, then hardening it into something reliable that other teams can run on their own. You'll work closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Operations, and our sales and solutions teams, and you'll bring what you learn from customer\-facing work back to the people building the products. Because a demo is frequently someone's first impression of what our models can and can't do, accuracy and honesty matter as much as polish. Success in this role looks like customer\-facing teams demonstrating new capabilities sooner and with more confidence, recurring requests becoming reusable assets rather than one\-off projects, and field insights shaping product and launch\-readiness decisions. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Own demo readiness for new and priority Claude capabilities, including environments, integrations, synthetic data, evaluations, reliability checks, and fallback paths * Build prototypes, agents, and reference flows that make complex capabilities concrete and tie them to clear customer outcomes * Turn recurring requests into reusable accelerators such as companion apps, templates, Skills, plugins, and self\-service demo packages that scale across customer\-facing teams * Partner with GTM colleagues on high\-impact customer moments, unblock critical technical gaps, and spot the patterns worth turning into shared assets * Build internal agentic systems that automate demo preparation, validation, and asset maintenance, so demos stay current as products change * Translate patterns from customer\-facing work into product feedback, launch\-readiness priorities, and systemic improvements with Product and Engineering * Define and raise the bar for demo quality across accuracy, safety, reliability, usability, and adoption * Decide when a customer need calls for a bespoke build and when it should become a shared capability **You may be a good fit if you have** ------------------------------------- * Proficiency in Python or TypeScript, with experience shipping working software end to end * Hands\-on experience building applications or agents on top of LLM APIs, including prompting, tool use, and retrieval * Experience designing integrations with third\-party APIs, data sources, and services * The ability to take an ambiguous capability or customer need to a working prototype quickly, and then make it reliable * Clear communication of technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences, including sales and solutions teams * Comfort collaborating across Product, Engineering, Marketing, Operations, and GTM teams * Experience in a demo engineering, solutions engineering, sales engineering, forward deployed engineering, developer relations, or product engineering role * A track record of building reusable internal tools, templates, or self\-service assets that other teams adopted * Hands\-on experience with Claude Code, the Claude Agent SDK, the Model Context Protocol (MCP), Skills, or plugins * Experience building evaluation or validation harnesses for AI systems, including reliability checks and graceful fallbacks * Experience building always\-on or scheduled agentic systems that automate internal workflows * Experience building synthetic or sanitized datasets that make demos realistic without exposing sensitive information * Front\-end or product design skills that help demos feel polished and intuitive * Experience supporting product launches or running launch\-readiness programs * A history of turning field feedback into concrete product input that influenced a roadmap * A passion for making powerful technology safe and beneficial, and a commitment to representing model capabilities accurately and honestly The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $240,000 \- $315,000 USD **Logistics** ------------- **Minimum education:** Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience **Required field of study:** A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience **Minimum years of experience:** Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position **Location\-based hybrid policy:** Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. **Visa sponsorship:** We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. **We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. **Your safety matters to us.** To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. **How we're different** ----------------------- We believe that the highest\-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large\-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long\-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest\-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT\-3, Circuit\-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI \& Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. **Come work with us!** ---------------------- Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. **Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:** Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

jobs.title: Sr. Robotics Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: * ### **About Anyware Robotics** Anyware Robotics builds general\-purpose mobile manipulator robots for industrial applications. Our robots are trusted by customers across logistics, retail, and manufacturing, supporting applications such as truck unloading, mobile palletizing, and machine tending. ### **Description** **About Anyware** Anyware Robotics builds general\-purpose mobile manipulator robots for industrial applications. Our robots are trusted by customers across logistics, retail, and manufacturing, supporting applications such as truck unloading, mobile palletizing, and machine tending. **The Role** The robots run on **AnywareOS**, our industrial physical intelligence system. Its architecture is modular and designed to generalize across applications without reprogramming. We are looking for a **Sr. Robotics Infrastructure Engineer** to improve the platform our infrastructure team runs AnywareOS on: the release and deployment pipeline, the runtime on each robot, the fleet management system, web applications, and AI tooling. You measure success by how fast a change reaches a customer robot safely, and how quickly a field failure is understood. This is a hands\-on senior individual\-contributor role. You will write production code every day. **What you'll do** * **Ship software to the fleet** — CI/CD, Docker images, releases, and deployments across customer robots. * **Make the on\-robot runtime fast and predictable** — profile and optimize robot services, middleware communication, and compute usage to meet cycle\-time budgets. * **Build the fleet management system (FMS)** — the cloud services that connect the fleet to customers' warehouse systems, on secure AWS infrastructure defined as code. * **Build the robot data platform** — the pipelines that bring robot data to the cloud and turn it into ML training data and fleet health monitoring. * **Build web applications** — the operator HMI on every robot and the internal tools engineers, operators, and field teams use daily. * **Build AI tools and agentic workflows** — agents that automate engineering and operations work across development, deployment, and the field. **Required Skills** * **3\+ years building and operating production software infrastructure** — CI/CD, Docker, and AWS (or GCP) — ideally for physical, edge, or real\-time systems. * **Strong modern C\+\+ and Python**, with Linux system\-level debugging and performance profiling. * **Low\-level systems depth** — IPC, networking, shared memory, concurrency — and the judgment to find where latency and throughput actually go. * **Fluent in AI\-assisted development** — you work with coding agents daily and review their output critically. **Nice to have** * ROS 2 and DDS in production. * Behavior trees (BT) and finite state machines (FSM) for robot task execution. * Web and backend service development. * Building products or workflows on LLM agents. * Infrastructure as code, secrets management, and SSO. * Fleet software delivery and device provisioning. * Robot data pipelines, ML pipelines, and observability stacks. * GPU software deployment on edge compute. * Robotics startup or warehouse automation experience. **Why Anyware** * **Real Impact, From Day One:** Your work will directly shape the robots and system that power every deployment. This isn't a research demo. Your work ships directly into customer sites across logistics, retail, and 3PL, solving real problems at scale, and you'll see the results of your work in production, not just in a paper. * **Ground Floor, Real Ownership:** Our team is doubling in size every year. That means real responsibility early, room to shape how things get built, and meaningful equity in a company at its inflection point. You won't be one voice among hundreds; your decisions will directly shape the product and the company. * **A Team Built to Win:** You'll work alongside a top\-tier team with a track record to match, including six Best Paper Awards and Finalists (ICRA 2025 and ICRA 2024 among them) and back\-to\-back Best Innovation Awards for Pixmo at ProMat 2025 and MODEX 2026, the largest logistics automation exhibitions in North America. It's a rare group, and you'd be joining at the moment physical AI is becoming real into real\-world industrial deployment. **Compensation** The expected salary range for this role is *150K\-220K* /year, depending on experience and qualifications. Additional compensation may include equity, benefits, or other incentives, where applicable. **Benefits \& Perks** * Comprehensive health insurance for you and your family * Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO) * Paid sick leave * 401(k) plan support * Daily meal credit **Equal Opportunity Statement** Anyware is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. #### **Salary** $150,000 \- $220,000 per year

jobs.title: Machine Learning Algorithm Engineer
jobs.description: Join Apple's HID sensing and interaction algorithms team, which develops advanced sensing algorithms that enable best\-in\-class user experiences across Mac, iPhone, iPad, Apple Pencil, Apple Watch, and exciting new products. We are looking for a machine learning engineer with hands\-on generative AI experience and a strong foundation in signal processing, who is excited to apply both to how people interact with Apple products. Our team draws from diverse backgrounds: signal processing, machine learning, firmware, software engineering, physics, human factors, and more; all dedicated to inventing new ways users interact with Apple products. You will work at the intersection of hardware, software, and design, collaborating with specialists across Apple to ship extraordinary products to millions of users every year. **Description** In this role, you will help explore how generative AI can advance sensing and interaction. You will research, develop, and evaluate generative models and AI systems for physical signals such as time series and images. Success here is measured by real\-world impact on products and users, not by leaderboard numbers. That takes a deep understanding of the signals you model and statistical rigor in how you judge results. These are challenging, open\-ended problems, and we are looking for someone with the persistence to carry an idea all the way into production. You will also bring a solid understanding of physical signals and signal processing, and use it to develop sensing algorithms for products. You will collaborate with algorithm, firmware, and software engineers to deliver features from prototyping through production. We value engineers who check their claims against real data, report negative results honestly, and explain technical findings clearly to people outside their field.","responsibilities":"Researching, developing, and evaluating generative models and AI systems for physical signals such as time series and images, and driving them from idea to production Prototyping and developing sensing algorithms using signal processing and machine learning techniques for current and future products Designing statistically sound evaluations that measure real\-world impact rather than benchmark scores Building data pipelines for large sensor datasets, including collection, labeling, and quality control Turning research ideas into working prototypes quickly, with controlled and reproducible experiments Working with firmware and software engineers throughout the product lifecycle, from early prototyping through production support Communicating results, trade\-offs, and recommendations clearly to team members, partner teams, and leadership **Preferred Qualifications** MS or PhD in machine learning, signal processing, electrical engineering, physics, or a related field, with publications, open\-source contributions, or shipped products in generative AI Experience training generative or other ML models on time\-series, sensor, audio, or image data, including at scale on GPU clusters Statistical rigor in designing experiments and evaluations and in interpreting their results, backed by reproducible research practices Experience using LLM\-based AI assistants and agents to accelerate research and development work, such as coding, data analysis, and experiment automation Proficiency in C/C\+\+, and familiarity with embedded or resource\-constrained systems Demonstrated persistence in driving a challenging project from idea to production or real\-world deployment Excellent communication and cross\-functional collaboration skills across algorithms, firmware, and software disciplines **Minimum Qualifications** BS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related STEM field with a minimum of 3 years of relevant industry or research experience Hands\-on experience developing generative AI models or systems that go beyond tutorials, such as through shipped products, publications, or substantial projects Experience working with real\-world sensor or physical measurement data. Strong understanding of physical signals such as time series and images, and how their structure and noise shape what a model learns Solid foundation in digital signal processing and time\-series analysis, such as filtering, spectral analysis, and feature extraction Strong Python programming skills and proficiency with a modern deep learning framework such as PyTorch **Pay \& Benefits** At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $150,400 and $277,600, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple's discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple's Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You'll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses \- including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. Learn more about Apple Benefits Note: Apple benefit, compensation and employee stock programs are subject to eligibility requirements and other terms of the applicable plan or program.

jobs.title: Engineering Project Manager

We welcome candidates from the Twin Cities metro and beyond to apply. within budget * Manage full project lifecycles including planning, execution, tracking, close‑out, and lessons learned * Build and maintain detailed project schedules, charters, financial summaries, RAID logs, and stakeholder communication plans * Drive consistent project execution, governance, and reporting practices across RDE * Lead onboarding, coaching, and mentoring of project team members change control, and market launch readiness * Identify project risks and implement mitigation plans balancing technical, financial, and business impacts * Report project progress, risks, and performance to leadership on established cadences * Navigate difficult conversations, align cross‑functional priorities, and calm stakeholders during high‑pressure situations * Contribute to project governance standards, tools, templates, and continuous improvement initiatives * Support portfolio reviews, resource balancing, and scenario analysis * Collaborate cross‑functionally to remove barriers, align priorities, and improve execution effectiveness * Lead projects through ambiguity, shifting priorities, and evolving business needs in a still‑developing PMO environment This role is ideal for a seasoned Engineering Project Manager who brings technical literacy and strong project leadership experience, capable of owning complex, high‑visibility projects with significant customer and business impact. #### **QUALIFICATIONS** * Bachelor of Science degree or higher in engineering or a business‑related field * PMP (Issued by PMI) or a Master's Degree in Project Management * 7\+ logs, and stakeholder communication plans * Demonstrated ability to lead projects in environments with immature or evolving PMO processes * Strong business acumen with experience navigating difficult as a team member * Strong work ethic and unwavering integrity * Excellent interpersonal skills and a learning mindset * Curiosity, problem solving, and analytical thinking * Effective verbal and written communication * Desire to work on a variety of projects #### **ESTIMATED PAY RANGE** Project Manager: $48\.95 – $59\.82/hour Program Manager: $59\.09 – $72\.22/hour Final compensation is based jobs.title: Principal Hardware Engineer
jobs.location: San Francisco Bay Area, CA, US
jobs.description: **About Arable** ---------------- At Arable, our goal is to connect the world’s farms to help optimize the global food system. As we work to feed a growing population while reducing our impact on natural resources, we believe a critical part of the solution is digitizing the analog world with high\-fidelity data that helps food producers optimize their operations. Our work helps improve the lives of farmers and contributes to securing the global food supply for decades to come. **Examples of Our Work:** * Helping farmers maximize ROI through precision irrigation and data\-driven water management. * Supporting leading agricultural and technology partners in meeting sustainability and climate resilience goals. * Equipping growers with insights to improve decision\-making, reduce waste, and enhance yields across diverse cropping systems. **The Role** ------------ We are seeking an experienced, hands\-on hardware engineer to drive the development of our hardware ecosystem, including the Arable Mark 3 and future sensing platforms. This role centers on individual technical contribution and ownership across the hardware product lifecycle—from design and prototyping through production and field performance. You will work directly on engineering challenges while providing technical leadership, mentoring colleagues, and collaborating closely with internal teams and external partners. This is an opportunity for an engineer who enjoys staying close to the work while helping shape the technical direction of sensing products used by growers around the world. ### **What You Will Do** * Drive hardware development across the full product lifecycle, from concept to production. * Coordinate domestic and offshore manufacturing operations. * Review and validate ODM designs to meet Arable’s quality standards. * Develop technical documentation for designs, testing, and support. * Lead hands\-on prototyping of new hardware products and features. * Work with QA teams on product validation and testing. * Collaborate with product management, software, operations, and customer success. * Manage key vendor relationships and guide component selection. * Troubleshoot hardware issues and coordinate bug tracking and resolution. * Support manufacturing test fixtures and processes. * Provide technical leadership and mentorship, influence technology direction, and strengthen the team’s engineering capabilities. ### **Experience and Skills** **Required** * Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Physics, or a related field. * 6\+ years of hardware engineering experience spanning the full PCB design lifecycle. * Proficiency with schematic capture, PCB layout, board bring\-up, and lab equipment. * Knowledge of regulatory testing, including FCC and CE, and new product introduction (NPI) processes. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities. * A self\-directed approach and the ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced environment. * Excellent communication and organizational skills. **Preferred** * Advanced technical degree. * 8\+ years of experience bringing multiple hardware products to mass production. * Experience managing or collaborating with offshore teams. * Knowledge of C programming for embedded systems. * Experience with wireless product design (WiFi, BLE, cellular) and/or RTOS. * Background in agricultural or environmental sensor technology. * Experience leading engineering initiatives, developing processes, or mentoring engineers. * Expertise in low\-power system design, particularly for solar\-powered and battery\-powered devices. ### **Qualities for Success** * **Passion for Sustainability:** Care deeply about global food systems and environmental impact. * **Startup Mindset:** Thrive in a fast\-paced environment and take ownership across multiple responsibilities. * **Technical Leadership:** Lead through engineering expertise, sound judgment, and ownership of results. * **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Communicate effectively and build productive relationships across teams. * **Resourcefulness:** Develop cost\-effective solutions and troubleshoot real\-world field challenges. * **Adaptability:** Stay current with emerging technologies and navigate new challenges. * **Mentorship:** Share knowledge and help elevate the work of colleagues and partners. **What We Offer** ----------------- At Arable, you will join dedicated team players who bring together diverse expertise and a passion for building a more sustainable future. You’ll find no shortage of lively conversation around the lunch table about the food we eat and how it is produced. We are a fast\-moving startup committed to providing a rewarding employee experience through our work, team, compensation, and benefits, including: * Excellent medical, dental, vision, life, and disability benefits, and a 401(k) program. * Opportunities to work closely with customers who are eager for our products and make a positive impact on their livelihoods and the world. * A focus on community involvement and career development. We are an equal\-opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Engineer I - Deployment

Requirements Education: * Bachelor's Degree in Robotics, Mechatronics, Computer Science, or related field, preferred * Equivalent work experience in relevant technical field may also be considered. Experience: * 1 year of experience in deploying and/or supporting robotic systems. * 1 year of experience in either software development or technical support. * 1 year of experience in managing and supporting Windows and Linux operating environments. Computer Skills: * Proficient in Linux, Microsoft Office Suite, HTML, Confluence, and Jira. Additional Requirements: * Proven ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues, collaborate with cross\-functional teams, and create clear technical documentation. * Excellent verbal and written communication skills. * Commitment to exceptional customer service, with the flexibility to participate in on\-call rotations and adapt to changing priorities in a fast\-paced environment. * Ability to understand and link related business requirements with corporate strategies and capabilities. * Proficient in conducting Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for intricate system issues. * Working knowledge of ROS/ROS2, version control, and networks (such as DNS, DHCP, SSL, OSI Model, and TCP/IP). * Possess a mix of technical prowess and adeptness in supporting our Autonomy system. * Ability to adapt in dynamic environments, apply strong problem\-solving skills, think creatively, manage projects effectively, and exhibit a high level of drive and motivation. * Ability to have a consulting mindset, a deep sense of accountability, meticulous attention to detail, a fervor for software and operational issue resolution, expertise in technical support, and a collaborative spirit within the Autonomy team. * Willingness and ability to relocate to assigned client deployment locations, either temporarily or for extended periods, based on project needs. * Flexibility to support varying deployment timelines, including changes in duration, location, and schedule as customer requirements evolve. * Ability to work primarily on\-site at customer facilities to support implementation, operations, troubleshooting, and customer engagement. * Eligibility to travel and reside at client locations in compliance with company policies and applicable regulations. Competencies: * Communicating Complex Concepts * Customer/Market Focus * Decision Making and Critical Thinking * Effective Communications * Effective Presentations * Flexibility and Adaptability * Overcoming Resistance to Change * Troubleshooting Technical Problems Other Details Work Hours: * Third Shift: Generally, 9:00 pm \- 5:30 am with occasional irregular hours depending on workload. 5 shifts/week. Travel Requirements: * Moderate (50%\-75%) Compensation: * This is a salary position paid biweekly. About Us ArcBest® (Nasdaq: ARCB) is a multibillion\-dollar integrated logistics company that helps keep the global supply chain moving. Founded in 1923 and now with 14,000 employees across 250 campuses and service centers, the company is a logistics powerhouse, using its technology, expertise and scale to connect shippers with the solutions they need — from ground, air and ocean transportation to fully managed supply chains. ArcBest has a long history of innovation that is enriched by deep customer relationships. With a commitment to helping customers navigate supply chain challenges now and in the future, the company continues to invest in purpose\-built technology such as ArcBest View\[1] ™, its digital logistics platform that brings quoting, booking, shipment visibility and reporting into one connected experience.
