jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer, AI
jobs.description: Arrowhead Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (Nasdaq ARWR) is a commercial stage biopharmaceutical company that develops medicines that treat intractable diseases by silencing the genes that cause them. Using a broad portfolio of RNA chemistries and efficient modes of delivery, Arrowhead therapies trigger the RNA interference mechanism to induce rapid, deep, and durable knockdown of target genes. RNA interference, or RNAi, is a mechanism present in living cells that inhibits the expression of a specific gene, thereby affecting the production of a specific protein. Arrowhead's RNAi\-based therapeutics leverage this natural pathway of gene silencing. Arrowhead is focused on developing innovative drugs for diseases with a genetic basis, typically characterized by the overproduction of one or more proteins that are involved with disease. The depth and versatility of our RNAi technologies enables us to potentially address conditions in virtually any therapeutic area and pursue disease targets that are not otherwise addressable by small molecules and biologics. Arrowhead is leading the field in bringing the promise of RNAi to address diseases outside of the liver, and our clinical pipeline includes disease targets in the liver and lung with a promising pipeline of preclinical candidates. Arrowhead's corporate headquarters is in Pasadena, CA with research and development teams in Madison, WI \& San Diego, CA, and a state of the art manufacturing facility in Verona, WI. Our employees are nimble, science\-driven innovators who are collaborating to bring new therapies to patients in need. **The Position** This is a newly created, green\-field role and the first Forward Deployed Engineer, AI hired within the company. The person in this role will partner directly with business and scientific stakeholders across multiple functions to identify high\-value problems and build and deploy AI\-driven solutions that solve them. Because there is no existing playbook for this function, the Forward Deployed Engineer will help define how AI solutions are scoped, built, and delivered internally, working hands\-on across the AWS, Azure, Databricks, and Microsoft technology stack alongside the Data Platform Engineer, DevOps Engineer, and Databricks/AWS platform teams. This role requires someone comfortable operating with ambiguity, moving quickly from problem discovery to a working solution, and embedding directly with internal teams to understand their workflows before proposing and shipping AI tools that fit how they actually work. *Responsibilities* * Partner directly with stakeholders across R\&D, clinical, manufacturing, commercial, and other business functions to identify, scope, and prioritize opportunities for AI\-driven internal solutions. * Design, build, and deploy agentic AI workflows and applications that solve real operational and scientific problems, working end\-to\-end from prototype through production. * Establish foundational engineering practices, standards, and reusable patterns for AI solution delivery, since this is the first role of its kind in the organization. * Work closely with the Data Platform Engineer to access, model, and productionize data needed for AI solutions across Databricks and AWS. * Collaborate with the DevOps Engineer to build reliable CI/CD pipelines, deployment processes, and monitoring for AI applications across AWS/ Databricks inside a MS environments. * Leverage the Databricks platform and AWS services (e.g., Bedrock, Lambda, S3\) to build and orchestrate agentic AI workflows and applications, primarily by composing and integrating existing foundation models rather than training new ones. * Integrate solutions with Microsoft/Azure tools (e.g., Azure AI services, M365\) where appropriate to meet business needs. * Rapidly prototype proof\-of\-concepts with internal teams, gather feedback, and iterate quickly to move validated solutions into production. * Document architecture, decisions, and delivery patterns to build a repeatable internal playbook for future forward\-deployed engineering work. * Act as a hands\-on technical resource embedded with business teams, translating ambiguous business problems into concrete technical solutions. **Requirements** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including building and deploying production\-grade applications. * Hands\-on experience with AWS cloud services and Azure/Microsoft cloud services. * Experience working with Databricks, including data engineering, notebooks, and/or ML workflows. * Strong proficiency in at least one modern programming language (e.g., Python, SQL, or similar) used for building data and AI applications. * Demonstrated experience building agentic workflows and applications with generative AI and LLM\-based approaches (e.g., orchestration frameworks, tool use, retrieval\-augmented generation) to solve practical business problems. * Proven ability to work independently in ambiguous, undefined environments and to build solutions from the ground up without an established playbook. * Strong cross\-functional communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts for non\-technical business stakeholders and vice versa. **Preferred** * Knowledge of the pharmaceutical, biotech, or life sciences industry is desirable but not required. * Experience with Databricks certifications, AWS certifications, or Microsoft Azure certifications. * Prior experience in a "forward deployed engineer," solutions engineering, or embedded engineering role, working directly with business teams rather than in a purely centralized product function. * Experience with LLMOps/agent\-ops tooling and practices for deploying, monitoring, and evaluating agentic workflows in production. * Familiarity with regulated\-industry considerations (e.g., data privacy, validation, GxP) relevant to deploying AI solutions in a pharma environment. * Experience building internal tools, chatbots, or agentic AI applications using modern LLM frameworks. * A builder mindset with the initiative to define scope and process in a green\-field function. Arrowhead provides competitive salaries and an excellent benefit package. Candidates must have current, valid authorization to work in the country where this role is located. California Applicant Privacy Policy

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, ML Evaluation & Introspection Infrastructure
jobs.description: **Who we are** Aurora’s mission is to deliver the benefits of self\-driving technology safely, quickly, and broadly. The Aurora Driver will create a new era in mobility and logistics, one that will bring a safer, more efficient, and more accessible future to everyone. At Aurora, you will tackle massively complex problems alongside other passionate, intelligent individuals, growing as an expert while expanding your knowledge. For the latest news from Aurora, visit aurora.tech or follow us on LinkedIn. **What we are looking for** We’re searching for a **Senior Software Engineer, ML Evaluation \& Introspection Infrastructure** to join our Behavior Analysis team, reporting to the team’s engineering manager. Aurora’s trucks already haul freight on Texas highways with no one on board, and every new version of the learned model that drives them has to prove, on real driving data, that it is better and safer than the one before. Behavior Analysis builds the systems that make that call: the evals that compare model versions, the embedding search that makes every driving scenario findable, and the introspection tools that show why a model did what it did. Engineers build more than 100 training and eval datasets a week through our tools. We’re a small team, so each engineer owns whole systems, and we work agent\-first: our tools are built for AI agents to drive as easily as engineers do. You’ll own core pieces of that loop and help lead what comes next: putting LLMs, VLMs and agents to work on analysis, so questions that take days to answer today take minutes. **In this role you will** * Build and scale evaluation pipelines that compare model versions on large driving datasets: offline evals, slice\-based metrics, regression detection, and model\-vs\-model reports. * Own embedding and vector\-search pipelines over driving data, versioned per model, so engineers can search, cluster and compare how any model represents the world. This is where you’d start: owning embedding generation and search end to end. * Build model introspection infrastructure (attention, attribution, ablations) that turns “why did the model do that?” from a research project into a query. * Help define how frontier LLMs, VLMs and agents change ML analysis here: triaging, labeling, clustering and summarizing driving scenarios and eval results. We already have a prototype using LLMs for data curation, and you’d help decide where it goes next. * Work side by side with the ML engineers training these models to decide what to measure, then make those measurements trustworthy, observable and cheap enough to run on every candidate model. * Build the web app and CLI that engineers and AI agents use to find datasets, training runs, evals and their costs, designed with agents as first\-class users. **Required qualifications** * Typically 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience building backend, data or ML infrastructure. * Strong Python, and proficiency with SQL. * Designed and operated large\-scale batch or data pipelines on cloud infrastructure, including backfills, retries and cost management. * Built systems that measure or evaluate something: metrics, experimentation, evaluation or analytics platforms. * Experience with distributed compute and container orchestration (e.g. Kubernetes, AWS Batch or similar). **Desirable qualifications** * ML evaluation infrastructure: eval harnesses, golden datasets, regression detection, A/B model comparison. * Embeddings and vector search, or model introspection and interpretability tooling. * Using LLMs, VLMs or agentic workflows to automate analysis, labeling or data curation. * Autonomous vehicles, robotics or other large\-scale sensor data. * Observability for data systems (metrics, alerting, SLOs), and everyday use of AI coding agents. * Coming from backend or data engineering and want to learn ML evaluation? Apply anyway: we’ll teach you the ML side. *For roles based in Mountain View, CA:* The salary range for this position is $162,000 \- $260,000 per year. Aurora’s pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, the successful candidate’s starting base pay will be determined based on factors including job\-related skills, experience, qualifications, relevant education or training, and market conditions. These ranges may be modified in the future. The successful candidate will also be eligible for an annual bonus, equity compensation, and benefits. **Working at Aurora** At Aurora, we bring together extraordinarily talented and experienced people united by the strength of our values. We operate with integrity, set outrageous goals, and build a culture where we win together — all without any jerks. We believe in\-person work increases collaboration, empathy, and our ability to lead effectively. As a result, Aurorans are expected to work from the office at least 3 days per week, with some roles requiring more frequent in\-office presence, up to 5 days per week, based on operational needs. Our Careers page provides insight into what it is like to work at Aurora, and you can find all the latest updates in our Newsroom. **Our commitment to safety** At the core of everything we do is our commitment to safety. Building best\-in\-class self\-driving technology will take time, and we believe that each employee at Aurora has a role in contributing to safety, every step of the way. Aurora expects commitment to our safety policies from every employee, and seeks candidates who take an active responsibility, can contribute to building an atmosphere of trust, and invest in the organization’s long\-term success by prioritizing working safely, no matter what. **Our commitment to inclusion** Aurora considers candidates without regard to their race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, pregnancy status, parent or caregiver status, ancestry, political affiliation, veteran and/or military status, physical or mental disability, or any other status protected by federal or state law. Aurora considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state, and local law. We are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at careersiteaccommodations@aurora.tech. *For California applicants, information collected and processed as part of your application and any job applications you choose to submit is subject to Aurora’s California Employment Privacy Policy.*

jobs.title: Mid-Level and Senior Software Engineers - Rust
jobs.description: **Company Description** Founded and headquartered in Switzerland, Avaloq is continuously expanding its global footprint with around 2,500 colleagues in 12 countries, and more than 170 clients in 35 countries. We are an industry\-leading provider of wealth management technology and services for financial institutions around the world, including private banks and wealth managers, investment managers, as well as retail and neo banks. Our research led approach and continual innovation is powered by the passion and creativity of our colleagues. We are always looking for talented people to join us on our mission to orchestrate the financial ecosystem and democratize access to wealth management. Avaloq offers the opportunity to work closely with some of the world’s leading financial institutions as we jointly develop and shape careers. Championing a collaborative, supportive and flexible work environment empowers our colleagues to reach their full potential. **Job Description** Avaloq’s R\&D Lab is building a SaaS, API\-first, composable banking platform. You will help develop its Rust backend, creating financial technology where precision, quality and scalability matter, while working closely with engineers in Fort Lauderdale and Zurich. These 3 roles are among the first engineering roles at our new Fort Lauderdale development center, offering significant scope for ownership as the team grows. You will work directly with clients, see how your solutions are used and bring those insights back into the product. The role includes onboarding with the Zurich team, collaborative mornings and productive afternoons, with regular travel to Switzerland and occasional travel to client sites. **Our stack** Rust with Tokio and the AWS SDK for Rust. Serverless\-first on AWS, using Lambda, DynamoDB, SQS and S3, with GitHub Actions for CI/CD. Clients integrate through our APIs and the Model Context Protocol (MCP). We do not run containers. **Useful domain experience** Depending on the role, relevant experience may include wealth and asset management, discretionary portfolio management, investment performance and attribution, portfolio valuation and rebalancing, benchmarks and fees, or US investment taxation, including tax lots, cost basis, holding periods, wash sales, corporate actions, withholding and tax reporting. What you'll do: * Design, develop and test Rust backend services for complex financial products, with a focus on accuracy, scalability and reliability. * Translate complex financial rules and mathematical concepts into precise, efficient and testable software, accounting for numerical precision and edge cases. * Build scalable solutions using historized, non\-relational data models and asynchronous, event\-driven architectures. * Contribute to technical specifications, design discussions and code reviews, using AI coding agents while maintaining rigorous review standards and accountability. * Own features through the development lifecycle, from implementation and automated testing to deployment and monitoring, working alongside Platform and SRE engineers. * Work directly with clients and domain specialists to analyse product questions, solve problems and bring insights back into product development. **Qualifications** * Strong programming foundations in a statically typed language such as Rust, C\+\+, Java, Scala, Kotlin, C\#, Go or TypeScript. * Master’s degree or PhD in computer science, mathematics, physics or a related quantitative field. * Strong modelling skills, including experience or understanding of historized data, effective dating, immutability and audit trails. * Strong analytical ability and intellectual curiosity, with the ability to quickly learn new technologies and complex financial domains. * Clear and confident communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts effectively to both technical and business audiences. * Ability to work independently within a distributed team and travel to Switzerland and client sites when required. It would be a real bonus if you have: * Production Rust experience, or experience with another systems/strongly typed language such as C\+\+, Haskell, OCaml or Scala. * Experience in wealth or asset management technology, including investment performance, portfolio construction/rebalancing, or tax, accounting and other rule\-heavy financial software. * Experience with AWS serverless and event\-driven architecture, particularly Lambda, DynamoDB, SQS, S3 and API Gateway, or related distributed\-systems technologies. * Experience with AI\-assisted engineering, client\-facing product development, research or open\-source software. **Additional Information** This role includes onboarding with the existing team in Zurich, regular travel to Switzerland and occasional travel to client sites. We realize that managing work life balance is a challenge we all face in our daily lives and in order to support with this we are pleased to offer hybrid and flexible working for most of our Avaloqers to maintain work life balance and still continue our fantastic Avaloq culture in our global offices. In Avaloq we are proud to embrace diversity and understand the success of our business is built on the power of different opinions, we are whole heartedly committed to fostering an equal opportunity environment and inclusive culture where you can be your true authentic self. We hire, compensate and promote regardless of origin, age, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other fantastic traits that make us all unique, we have done our best to write this advert in an inclusive and neutral way. Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations. \#LI\-Hybrid

BAM is seeking a full stack software developer to join its team. Experience with JavaScript frameworks, writing custom JavaScript with popular JS libraries, and advanced web technologies and techniques. * Experience with Database Design, Data Modeling, SQL, and Database Administration * Familiarity with cloud platforms, particularly AWS, and experience in integrating cloud services into software solutions. * Experience in microservice and modular Proficiency in C\# and .NET Core. * Hands on Angular development in an enterprise implementation. * Understanding of user centric design software tools. * Database design and enterprise data modeling with PostgreSQL. * Restful patterns and understanding of API endpoints. * Experience with AWS services for cloud computing. * Excellent problem\-solving and troubleshooting abilities. * Strong communication, interpersonal, and teamwork skills. * Git version control proficiency. * Enterprise experience with CI/CD pipelines. * Proven involvement in agile work environments. * Able to identify and utilize standard software design patterns. * Familiarity with containerization and orchestration tools like Docker and Kubernetes. **Preferred Skills** (not mandatory but a plus):* Hands on OutSystems development in an enterprise implementation. * Familiarity with containerization and orchestration tools like Docker and Kubernetes. * Familiarity with ASP.NET MVC,and Kendo UI. * Hands on use of typescript. * Understand and have experience with GitHub. * CI/CD pipeline setup and management. * Experience with AWS DynamoDB. * Knowledge of OpenSearch (Elasticsearch) for search and analytics. * Familiarity with Large Scale Scrum agile practices for software delivery. * Security\+ certification. jobs.title: Security Analyst
jobs.description: **Company Description** BCC Software develops innovative software and data solutions that power critical customer communications for organizations across North America. With more than 45 years of industry leadership, we combine deep postal expertise with modern technology to help our customers streamline operations, improve efficiency, and drive growth. **Job Description** The Security Analyst supports BCC Software’s cybersecurity program by defining, validating, and reporting on security controls to protect company assets and sensitive information and reduce cyber risk. This role uses recognized frameworks, third\-party audits, and defined service\-level agreements to guide security governance, operations, and continuous improvement. IT owns day\-to\-day system administration. Essential Functions * Strengthen identity security using Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, phishing\-resistant MFA, and Privileged Identity Management (PIM). * Integrate, deploy, support, and continuously improve security tools and the Microsoft security stack, including Defender XDR, Microsoft Sentinel and KQL, and Microsoft Intune security capabilities. * Oversee the managed detection and response (MDR) provider, including escalations, tuning, and service reviews. * Own the vulnerability and exposure management program, establish remediation SLAs, verify remediation evidence, and report status, exceptions, and risk trends. * Lead incident response and serve as the primary security contact during incidents; maintain playbooks, escalation procedures, tabletop exercises, and on\-call expectations. * Establish Azure cloud security guardrails for landing zones and oversee Defender for Cloud, Azure Policy, and related cloud security controls. * Own data protection controls through Microsoft Purview sensitivity labeling and data loss prevention for customer data and personally identifiable information. * Enforce the AI Usage Policy and govern risks associated with Microsoft Copilot oversharing, shadow AI, and SaaS discovery. * Manage third\-party and vendor security risk, including due diligence, recurring reviews, evidence collection, and customer security questionnaires. * Manage security ticket workflows for access reviews and phishing reports; define response SLAs and verify supporting evidence. * Create and maintain security documentation, including policies, the risk register, incident response records, and audit evidence. * Align the security program with NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) 2\.0, CIS Controls, SOC 2 Type II, USPS licensing security requirements, and cyber insurance attestations. * Validate ransomware resilience through evidence of immutable backups and recurring recovery testing. * Manage the security awareness training program and work across teams to reinforce security policies, controls, monitoring, and best practices. * Provide backup support for network, server, and cloud administration as needed, without assuming primary responsibility for routine administration. * Assist with security\-related budgets and purchases. * Serve as liaison with security and IT professionals at BlueCrest and Platinum. * Develop and manage security reports and dashboards for management. **Qualifications** * 5\+ years of cybersecurity operations experience or equivalent experience. * Strong understanding of secure network architecture and networking principles. * Knowledge of Windows, macOS, and Linux operating systems. * Hands\-on security experience with Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Azure, including Entra ID, Conditional Access, phishing\-resistant MFA, PIM, Defender XDR, Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Intune security capabilities, Defender for Cloud, and Azure Policy. * Ability to review the security configuration and risk posture of network infrastructure, including Juniper and Cisco switches and Fortinet firewalls. * Experience supporting SOC 2 Type II audits, including control validation and evidence collection. * Familiarity with NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) 2\.0 and CIS Controls. * PowerShell scripting and KQL query skills for security operations, investigation, and automation. * Ability to respond quickly to critical problems and willingness to participate in an on\-call rotation. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to define security SLAs, evaluate evidence, report risk, and communicate requirements to technical and business stakeholders. * Understanding of adversary tactics and tooling (MITRE ATTACK; e.g., Cobalt Strike and Mimikatz) sufficient to detect, hunt, and validate controls. * One or more relevant security certifications are preferred, including Microsoft Certified: Security Operations Analyst Associate (SC\-200\), Azure Security Engineer Associate (AZ\-500\), Identity and Access Administrator Associate (SC\-300\), or CISSP. **Additional Information** **Work Location** This position may be based anywhere within the United States. Occasional travel is expected to data center facilities, customer locations, or BCC Software headquarters in Rochester, New York. Candidates who live within driving distance of the Rochester office are strongly preferred. **Physical Demands** This is primarily an office\-based role requiring extended periods of sitting and frequent use of hands for typing, writing, and operating standard office equipment. The position requires effective verbal and written communication. Occasional standing, walking, bending, reaching, or lifting of office supplies or small equipment up to 25 pounds may be required. Visual acuity sufficient for reading, computer work, and document review is necessary. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position. **Position Type and Expected Hours of Work** This is a full\-time, exempt position. Standard hours are Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Eastern Time, with time zone flexibility for employees located elsewhere in the U.S., as coordinated with the manager. Because BCC Software supports operations and customers across U.S. time zones, staggered coverage may be advantageous. The role serves as the escalation contact for critical security incidents, including those raised by the managed detection and response provider, and participates in on\-call rotation with defined after\-hours response expectations. Periodic evening and weekend work is required for planned maintenance windows, security testing, and incident response. **AAP/EEO Statement** BCC Software provides equal employment opportunity to all individuals regardless of age, race, color, creed, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions), gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression (including transgender status), national origin, veteran or military status, marital status, genetic information, physical or mental disability, familial status, reproductive health decisions, status as a victim of domestic violence, or any other basis protected by applicable laws and regulations. Further, the company takes affirmative action to ensure that all applicants and employees are treated without regard to any of these characteristics during the application process and/or employment. Discrimination of any type will not be tolerated.

Minimum twelve (12\) years’ experience in Shipbuilding of which a minimum of seven (7\) years in testing. Previous supervision of multiple trades preferred. Onboard ship engineering experience will be considered in leu of shipbuilding experience. Subcontract management a plus. Ability to supervise and coach individuals. Proactive manner demonstrating interpersonal skills. Requires knowledge of and ship terminology, and Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) standards Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite software including Word, Excel, Project and Outlook Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, general business periodicals, professional documents, Company policies/procedures, and governmental regulations. Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from senior management, employees, government officials, and the public. Ability to read and interpret blueprints. This plan is available for inspection upon request by emailing* *hr@birdon.us**.* *If you are an individual with a disability and would like to request a reasonable accommodation as part of the employment selection process, please contact* *hr@birdon.us* *for further assistance.*

jobs.title: Senior Vice President, Full-Stack Engineer
jobs.description: BNY is seeking Engineers who amplify team impact through technical leadership and force‑multiplier behaviors. In this role, you will elevate those around you by raising engineering standards, accelerating delivery, applying sound technical judgment to complex problems, providing thought leadership and coaching others. You will use AI\-enabled capabilities to improve how work gets done, while ensuring what ships is secure, scalable, resilient and truly worth building. This role is located in Pittsburgh, PA or New York, NY. In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways: * Multiply team impact through hands‑on technical leadership, mentorship, and setting a high engineering bar. * Build trust, share credit, and strengthen cross\-functional execution. * Design and build fit‑for‑purpose architectures that balance simplicity, quality, scale, and security. * Simplify systems and workflows by removing friction, toil, and unnecessary handoffs. * Create durable reusable patterns, guardrails, and tooling that accelerate team delivery. * Quickly ramps\-up in new domains, technologies, and problem spaces, adapting as needs evolve. * Apply strong engineering fundamentals across software design, data, testing, and distributed systems. * Use AI\-enabled tools deliberately across design, coding, testing, review, and documentation, while keeping strong human accountability for high‑risk decisions, verification, and final quality. * Build software with a reliability‑first mindset, incorporating secure coding practices, observability, testing, and disciplined rollout/rollback strategies. * Ensure production systems meet required levels of resiliency, performance, scalability, and operability. To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following: * Bachelor's degree in computer science engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent work experience required. * 10\-14 years of experience in software development required; experience in the securities or financial services industry is a plus. * Strong proficiency in Java, Spring Boot, SQL, and the design of RESTful and streaming‑based APIs. * Hands‑on experience delivering cloud‑native solutions, including microservices, containerization, and modern deployment patterns. * Working knowledge of NoSQL and distributed data stores, selected and applied appropriately at scale. * Experience leveraging AI‑enabled capabilities, including GenAI or ML‑driven services, to enhance developer productivity, system intelligence, or customer outcomes, with a pragmatic understanding of responsible use, scalability, and integration into enterprise platforms.

OpenTelemetry, ELK, Datadog, or equivalent), including instrumenting a service and designing alerts people trust * Strong Linux fundamentals and comfort operating in a bare\-metal or hybrid environment rather than a fully managed cloud * Professional experience incorporating AI\-assisted development tools (Gemini, Cursor, Claude Code, or similar) * Comfortable with all aspects of the software development lifecycle, including design, implementation, testing, and rollout * Exhibits curiosity and seeks to understand before offering solutions * Communicates proactively in a remote environment by keeping the team informed, surfacing blockers early, and moving work forward * Applies analytical thinking to ambiguous problems **Bonus points for:** * Proficiency in Java * Experience scale * Experience with time\-series databases and query languages such as PromQL * Experience automating hardware lifecycle work: burn\-in, failure detection, drive replacement, decommissioning * Experience with discovering and implementing performance improvements, including CPU and IO * Understanding of Linux internals and file systems * Familiarity with hard drive performance and optimization, including host\-managed SMR * Experience building and interpreting models, dashboards, or reports **Required for all Backblaze Employees:** * Good attitude and willingness to do whatever practices * Relentless attention to detail * Excellent interpersonal skills and good oral/written communication * Excellent troubleshooting and problem solving skills **Backblaze Perks:** * Healthcare jobs.title: Director, Full stack AI Engineer
jobs.description: What Makes Us a Great Place to Work We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the \#1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally. Who You’ll Work With You will be part of a team building Bain’s integrated suite of agentic decisioning tools that gives large organizations always\-on intelligence across their most important growth decisions. The role sits at an intersection few organizations can offer: the analytical depth and client access of a top\-tier consultancy, the technical ambition of a product company, and engineering work at the frontier of applied AI. You will work inside Bain’s standing product team, building software that helps the world’s largest companies answer the questions that drive their business: where to invest, where to focus, and how to win. The impact of what you build is direct and immediate, and the platform compounds in value with every release. **The platform has two layers working together:** an agentic core and a set of decision modules, each solving a distinct commercial problem. The build lifecycle is connected to the real world: as case teams work alongside clients across industries and geographies, that feedback flows straight back to engineering and into the product. Every client engagement makes the platform smarter, broader, and more resilient. This is a startup inside an established company. You get genuine early\-stage ownership and real influence over architecture and product direction, backed by Bain’s global scale, client relationships, and leadership commitment; the pace of a startup with the runway of a global firm. We are looking for engineers who see how to make a product better and bring that instinct to every sprint without being asked, and who are comfortable with problems that do not have a known answer. The work involves real\-time decision engines, cloud\-native infrastructure, and data problems with no off\-the\-shelf answer. Experience with agentic systems matters: tool and context protocols such as MCP, evaluation harnesses, memory design, and entity resolution across messy enterprise data. This is applied AI in production, at scale, with real users depending on what you build. The field is moving quickly and the team is built to move with it, so the willingness to keep learning counts for as much as what you already know. Where You’ll Fit Within the Team The Full\-stack Engineer owns the build and operation of the product interfaces and backend services that surface Growth AI Performance System capabilities to users across the full suite: the dashboards, workflow tools, scenario planning interfaces, and output views that Expert Consultants, specialists, and senior client stakeholders use in live commercial engagements. This is a platform\-wide role within the Agentic Core and Interface team: you are building for all three product modules, not for one. You will work closely with the Design Lead and Designer on the front\-end, with AI Engineers on the integration of agentic and LLM\-powered capabilities into the interface layer, and with the Data Engineer on the data access and API layer that feeds what users see. You are responsible for the quality, reliability, and performance of the full stack: from the API surface that serves domain model outputs through to the React components that render them for users. This is also a people\-leadership role. You will be the line manager for a small team of mid\- to senior\-level engineers within the Agentic Core and Interface team, owning their day\-to\-day work, performance, and growth: running weekly check\-ins, serving as the point of escalation, writing mid\-year and annual performance reviews, and setting professional development plans that build the team’s fluency with AI\-assisted engineering practices. You will work across the platform and product modules focused on marketing ROI, brand, and pricing strategy, building interfaces that make complex analytical outputs navigable and credible for professional users who need to act on them quickly. The users of this product are sophisticated; the interfaces need to be fast, dense, and unambiguous. This role has direct client proximity. You will engage with consulting teams to understand how the interfaces are being used in live engagements, where performance or reliability is creating problems, and what engineering changes are needed. What You’ll Do Building and shipping product interfaces * Build and ship end\-to\-end product f ontext * Familiarity with design system implementation: able to translate design token specifications, component documentation, and interaction guidelines into engineering conventions that a team can build from consistently * Active use of AI\-assisted coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code, or equivalent) to accelerate development, prototype faster, and raise the engineering productivity floor of the team Experience * 10 or more years in full\-stack software engineering roles with significant hands\-on building responsibilities across both frontend and backend * Direct experience managing a team of engineers: running performance reviews, professional development planning, and day\-to\-day people management, in addition to technical leadership * Track record of building and shipping production applications with data\-dense analytical interfaces that real professional users depend on * Experience leading the engineering implementation of a design system or component library across a multi\-feature product * Experience mentoring engineers and setting engineering standards within a team * Experience in client\-facing or consulting\-adjacent environments where interface decisions have direct consequences for how professional users trust and act on what they see is a strong advantage * Experience working in agile, cross\-functional product teams; strong troubleshooting and production issue resolution skills Education Associate’s degree / Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, or a related technical field; or an equivalent combination of education, training, and experience. U.S. Compensation Information Compensation for this role includes base salary, annual discretionary performance bonus, 401(k) plan with an annual employer contribution based on years of service and Bain’s best in class benefits package (details listed below). Some local governments in the United States require a good\-faith, reasonable salary range to be included in job postings for open roles. The estimated annualized compensation for this role is as follows: * In Illinois, the good\-faith, reasonable annualized full\-time salary range for this role is between $196,000\-235,250; placement within this range will vary based on several factors including, but not limited to experience, education, licensure/certifications, training and skill level * In Massachusetts, the good\-faith, reasonable annualized full\-time salary range for this role is between $204,750\-$245,750; placement within this range will vary based on several factors including, but not limited to experience, education, licensure/certifications, training and skill level * Annual discretionary performance bonus * This role may also be eligible for other elements of discretionary compensation * 4\.5% 401(k) company contribution, which increases after 3 years of service and is 100% vested upon start date Bain \& Company’s comprehensive benefits and wellness program is designed to help employees achieve personal independence, protection and stability in the areas most important to you and your family. * Bain pays 100% individual employee premiums for medical, dental and vision programs, offering one of the most comprehensive medical plans for employees without impacting your paycheck * Generous paid time off, including parental leave, sick leave and paid holidays * Fully vested 401(k) company contribution * Paid Life and Long\-Term Disability insurance For all other locations, the good\-faith, reasonable annualized full\-time salary range for this role is commensurate with competitive geographic market rates for this role and will vary based on several factors including, but not limited to experience, education, licensure/certifications, training and skill level. It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer - CFA
jobs.description: Baker Hill builds commercial and small\-business loan origination software used by banks and credit unions. We’re building our next\-generation cash flow analysis product, and we need a Forward Deployed Engineer – Cash Flow Analysis (CFA) who can sit with bankers, understand how they actually spread and analyze C\&I and complex CRE lending, and turn that into working AI\-powered software. You’ll embed with customers and design partners, build and deploy solutions in their real environments with their real documents, and carry what you learn back to our product and engineering teams. This role combines credit analyst fluency with hands\-on technical skill. You can spread a rent roll and a borrowing base, and you can also ship code. **Essential Functions/Job Duties** * Embed with bank and credit union credit teams to observe, document, and improve how they spread financials, normalize statements, and calculate DSCR, global cash flow, and NOI\-based metrics * Build, configure, and deploy AI\-assisted workflows for document extraction, statement classification, spreading, adjustments, and narrative generation, then tune them against real customer data * Rapidly prototype solutions in the field (extraction pipelines, spreading templates, validation rules, integrations) and take the proven ones back to product and engineering for productization * Own technical delivery for pilots and design partner implementations, from kickoff through production, including data mapping, integration with origination and core systems, and customer enablement * Apply C\&I expertise: working capital and borrowing base analysis, EBITDA normalization and add\-backs, covenant testing, seasonality, concentration risk, and multi\-entity operating companies * Apply complex CRE expertise: rent roll and T\-12 analysis, NOI normalization, stabilized vs. as\-is underwriting, lease rollover and tenant concentration, construction and lease\-up projections, owner\-occupied vs. investor properties, and global cash flow across sponsor and guarantor portfolios * Build evaluation harnesses that measure accuracy, explainability, and auditability against analyst\-spread benchmarks, and report results to customers and internal teams * Identify edge cases (complex ownership structures, cross\-collateralized relationships, K\-1 flows, messy scans) and turn them into test sets, feedback for the AI team, and product requirements * Be the voice of the customer in roadmap discussions, with evidence from the field rather than opinion * Support sales and client success with technical demos, proofs of concept, and credibility in front of credit officers and executives * Stay current on credit policy, regulatory expectations, model risk management guidance, and competitive offerings **What Success Looks Like** * First 90 days: Learn our current CFA capabilities, architecture, and customers; shadow analysts end to end across C\&I and CRE; ship a first working prototype against real customer documents * 6 months: Lead one or more design partner pilots live in production, with a benchmark showing accuracy and analyst time saved * 12 months: Field\-proven AI capabilities folded into the core product, with a repeatable deployment playbook and satisfied reference customers **Who You Are** You’re a credit analyst who learned to code, or an engineer who learned to read a credit memo. You get energy from being in the room with the customer, you’re comfortable being handed a messy rent roll and a deadline, and you’re honest about where AI works, where it doesn’t, and where a banker will insist on checking the work. **Skills/Qualifications Required** **Required** * BA/BS in Finance, Lending Operations, Business, Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field. * 5\+ years of hands\-on experience spreading financial statements and performing cash flow analysis in a bank, credit union, or lending environment, or in a fintech role directly supporting those workflows * Demonstrated specialization in both C\&I and complex CRE underwriting * Strong working knowledge of business and personal financial statements, tax returns, and cash flow methodologies (UCA, EBITDA\-based, global cash flow, DSCR, NOI\-based CRE analysis) * Proficiency in at least one programming language (Python preferred) and comfort with SQL, APIs, JSON, and scripting for data transformation and integration * Experience building or deploying software solutions in customer environments, such as implementation engineering, solutions engineering, technical consulting, or similar * Strong communication skills with both bankers and engineers, and the ability to explain technical tradeoffs to a chief credit officer * Willingness to travel to customer sites 50% * One\-hour SAFe overview; to be completed within the first 90 days of employment. **Preferred** * Hands\-on experience with LLMs, prompt engineering, retrieval, intelligent document processing, or ML evaluation * Experience with spreading software or loan origination and credit analysis platforms * Familiarity with bank security, data privacy, and model risk management requirements * Background in construction lending, SBA lending, or credit risk review * Experience in fintech or banking software * Formal credit training (RMA, credit analyst programs) or a degree in finance, accounting, computer science, or a related field * A recognized AI or AI platform fundamentals credential; or to be completed within the first year of employment **STANDARD REQUIREMENT** Use AI responsibly and in alignment with policy, including ongoing learning, and incorporate AI into routine tasks such as drafting communications, summarizing meetings, and organizing information. As the organization’s AI champion, this role is additionally expected to model that standard visibly, help colleagues meet it, and surface policy questions and risks rather than working around them. **This role is expected onsite if candidates live near Carmel HC office. Candidates should expect to extensive travel to and from client sites. Candidates must be able to commit to 50% travel to be successful in this role.** *Disclaimer:* *The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by individuals assigned to this position. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required. Management reserves the right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this position at any time as business needs evolve.*

jobs.title: Network Engineer
jobs.description: Bank of Bird\-in\-Hand is built on integrity, excellence, and teamwork. When you join the Bank of Bird\-in\-Hand team, you’ll be appreciated and celebrated for who you are every day. Bank of Bird\-in\-Hand is actively seeking a **Network Engineer** to join our team in Paradise. This role is responsible for the reliable, secure, and efficient operation of the Bank’s wired, wireless, and wide area network infrastructure. This hands\-on role configures, maintains, monitors, and troubleshoots network technologies across the data center, branch offices, administrative locations, and mobile banking environments. The position supports Fortinet firewalls and security services, Aruba switching and wireless platforms, internet and private network connectivity, VPN services, routing, segmentation, and related monitoring tools. This is a wonderful opportunity to join a community bank and make an impact in the local area! Responsibilities: * Configure, administer, monitor, and maintain the Bank’s local area, wide area, wireless, internet, and virtual private network infrastructure across data center, branch, administrative, and mobile locations. * Administer next generation firewalls and related security services, including access policies, NAT, routing, VPN tunnels, firmware updates, configuration backups, logging, and availability monitoring. * Configure and support switches and wireless access points, including VLANs, link aggregation, spanning tree, PoE, secure wireless networks, and device lifecycle maintenance. * Monitor network availability, utilization, performance, and capacity; investigate alerts and trends and implement corrective actions before they affect business operations. * Troubleshoot and resolve complex network connectivity, latency, packet loss, routing, switching, wireless, DNS, DHCP, VPN, and carrier\-related issues. * Serve as an escalation resource for network incidents and participate in major incident response, service restoration, root cause analysis, and corrective action planning. * Implement approved network designs, standards, security controls, and configuration baselines in partnership with the Systems Architect, Information Security, and other engineering resources. * Plan and execute network installations, upgrades, replacements, migrations, and maintenance activities with appropriate testing, change control, rollback planning, and post\-implementation validation. * Coordinate with telecommunications carriers, managed service providers, equipment vendors, and technology partners to resolve service issues and deliver network changes. * Maintain accurate network diagrams, configurations, IP address assignments, circuit records, device inventories, support procedures, and recovery documentation. * Support network segmentation, secure connectivity, and access controls for business systems, third\-party services, voice, wireless, and other technology platforms. * Perform periodic reviews of firewall rules, device configurations, firmware levels, support status, capacity, and network resiliency; document findings and complete assigned remediation activities. * Participate in disaster recovery and business continuity exercises by validating network dependencies, alternate connectivity, recovery procedures, and communications paths. * Provide technical support for projects and operational initiatives, share knowledge with IT staff, and participate in an on\-call rotation and scheduled after\-hours maintenance as required. * Perform other duties as required. Education and Experience: * Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline; equivalent combination of education, training, and relevant experience may be considered. * Minimum five (5\) years of hands\-on experience supporting enterprise network infrastructure in a multi\-site environment. * Practical experience administering next generation firewalls, including policies, site\-to\-site and remote\-access VPNs, routing, firmware maintenance, troubleshooting, and security services. * Practical experience configuring and supporting switches and wireless access points, including VLANs, trunking, link aggregation, spanning tree, PoE, SSIDs, authentication, and wireless troubleshooting. * Strong working knowledge of TCP/IP, IPv4 subnetting, DNS, DHCP, NAT, VLANs, VPNs, QoS, switching, routing, and common network diagnostic tools. * Experience supporting WAN and internet connectivity, carrier circuits, branch networks, network monitoring, configuration backup, performance analysis, and incident troubleshooting. * Ability to create and maintain accurate network diagrams, device inventories, configuration standards, implementation plans, and support procedures. * Experience in financial and/or banking sector, and familiarity with core systems, such as Jack Henry, is strongly desired. Here at Bank of Bird\-in\-Hand, we have a comprehensive benefit package for those who qualify. Below are the range of benefits we offer to meet the needs of our employees: * Competitive Medical, Dental, Vision Coverage * 401(k) Retirement Plan with 4% Match * Company Paid Life, STD, and LTD * Health Savings Account (HSA) \& Flexible Spending Account (FSA) options * Paid Time Off (PTO), Volunteer Time Off (VTO), and Birthday PTO * 12 Paid Holidays * Tuition Reimbursement * Company Events and Picnics ***Equal Opportunity Employer*** The employment policy of Bank of Bird\-in\-Hand is to provide equal opportunity to all persons. No employee or applicant for employment will be discriminated against because of race, color, religion, creed, sex, pregnancy, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, genetic information, military, and/or veteran status, or any other Federal or State legally protected classes.

jobs.title: Data Platform Engineering Manager
jobs.description: Berkshire Hathaway Homestate Companies, Workers Compensation Division, is looking for a Data Platform Engineering Manager to lead the team responsible for the organization's enterprise data platform and is accountable for its performance, reliability, security, scalability, and cost efficiency. This individual oversees the selection, implementation, operation, and continuous improvement of the technologies that store, process, and move data across the organization. The position requires broad expertise across relational, NoSQL, and analytical data platforms, with responsibility for developing and strengthening these capabilities within the team. The Manager leads day\-to\-day platform operations, including 24x7 support and incident response, and ensures delivery through Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and GitOps practices aligned with the Autonomous Composable Development (ACD) model. **ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES** ------------------------------ ### **TEAM LEADERSHIP AND DEVELOPMENT** * Directly supervises Database engineers day\-to\-day direction, workload prioritization, performance management, 1:1s, and reviews aligned to the IC level framework. * Accountable for developing the team’s depth across relational, NoSQL, and analytical platforms, and for raising automation, IaC, and GitOps proficiency. * Accountable for closing the gap between defined standards and demonstrated team practice. * Manages on\-call rotation scheduling and escalation coverage. * Surfaces risks, gaps, and disagreements in writing at the time they are identified rather than after work is underway. * Resolves cross\-team blockers directly with peer leaders and escalates only what cannot be settled at that level. ### **DATA PLATFORM OWNERSHIP** * Owns the operational data store estate: OLTP and NoSQL across MS SQL, Cosmos, and equivalents. Recommends the right store for a given workload rather than defaulting to a single engine. * Owns transformation and data movement: ADF, Airflow, and the replacement of the HVR and SSIS approaches currently in place. * Operates the analytical data platform — OneLake and the Bronze, Silver, and Gold tiers — to the same standards as the relational estate. * Selects technology within each category, and is accountable for the reliability, performance, and cost of what is chosen. * Manages data platform cost, licensing, and capacity per organizational guidelines. ### **AUTOMATION AND DELIVERY** * Defines standards for GitOps schema management, IaC provisioning, and lifecycle automation. Authors and reviews T\-SQL, PowerShell, and IaC templates (Terraform, Azure DevOps) for database provisioning and schema deployment. * Accountable for moving the team’s work from manual execution to self\-service — including database change management through Liquibase or equivalent tooling, and the automation of environment refreshes. * Responsible for the team’s participation in cross\-team automation initiatives, including timely delivery of post\-configuration requirements, provisioning inputs, and integration constraints to partner engineering teams. * Champions Claude and LLM tooling for schema documentation, data lineage, query optimization, and automation; mentors engineers on advanced usage. ### **DATABASE OPERATIONS, RESILIENCE AND PERFORMANCE** * Remains hands\-on in the design, implementation, and administration of the data platform estate — Azure SQL, Managed Instance, SQL Server, and the relational, NoSQL, and analytical platforms adopted over time. Serves as the final technical escalation point for complex incidents. * Owns redundancy planning, high availability design, and failover execution across the estate, including Always On availability groups, geo\-replication, and tested failover procedures. Validates HA/DR through regular testing and drives remediation of single points of failure. * Defines monitoring standards on Dynatrace and oversees performance, availability, and capacity monitoring across the data platform estate. Leads complex performance tuning and bottleneck resolution. * Participates in the 24x7 on\-call rotation. Reviews post\-incident reports and drives remediation to closure. ### **STANDARDS, COMPLIANCE AND CROSS\-TEAM LEADERSHIP** * Implements and enforces enterprise data classification, PII handling, retention, and audit compliance requirements within the data platform estate; partners with Security on data security aligned with NYDFS Part 500 and SOC requirements. * Ensures team adherence to documentation and change management standards; reviews and approves change records before implementation. * Leads tooling evaluations and vendor assessments; coordinates with the Director on capacity planning, budgeting, and staffing. * Represents the data platform in cross\-functional work with DevOps, Application Engineering, Security, and Analytics, and resolves technical boundaries between teams directly. * Communicates technology trade\-offs and platform risk to Director and VP levels; authors aform, Azure DevOps, PowerShell). Experience automating database provisioning and schema deployment. * Clause or LLM usage for data engineering preferred. * Track record designing and operating data systems in regulated industries preferred. ### **TECHNICAL/FUNCTIONAL KNOWLEDGE** * Expert\-level SQL Server 2016–2022, Azure SQL, and Managed Instance. Working knowledge of Microsoft Fabric. * Familiarity with relational and NoSQL platforms beyond the Microsoft stack — Postgres, MySQL, Cosmos, Mongo — sufficient to evaluate and recommend the right store for a given workload. * ETL/ELT patterns and tooling (Azure Data Factory, SSIS, Fabric pipelines, HVR, Databricks) and medallion and lakehouse patterns. * Terraform, Azure DevOps, Git\-based workflows, PowerShell, and Python. Repository and GitOps fluency sufficient to review and direct the team’s IaC contributions. * Dynatrace monitoring. Advanced Claude/LLM usage for data engineering and automation. * NYDFS Part 500, SOC audit compliance, and PII handling. ### **LANGUAGE ABILITY AND COMMUNICATION** * Presents technology decisions and trade\-offs to Director, VP, and Analytics leadership. * Authors standards, runbooks, change records, performance feedback, and investment proposals that are clear, defensible, and financially grounded. * Communicates status, risks, and team capacity to the Director proactively and in writing, without requiring prompting. * Bridges technical data concepts and business outcomes for non\-technical stakeholders. ### **ON\-CALL REQUIREMENTS** This position is required to participate in a scheduled on\-call rotation. On\-call responsibilities include responding to critical incidents, system alerts, and operational emergencies outside of normal business hours. Active participation in the on\-call program is a mandatory condition of employment and will be evaluated as part of performance reviews. **WHAT WE OFFER** ----------------- * Work From Home Program (up to 2 days per week upon eligibility) * Modernized Historical Setting in East Sacramento * Free Lot Parking * Paid Time Off * Paid Holidays * Retirements Savings Match * Group Health Insurance (Medical, Dental, and Vision) * Hospital Indemnity Insurance * Life and AD\&D Insurance * Long Term Disability Insurance * Accident and Critical Illness Insurance * Flexible Savings Accounts * Paid Community Volunteer Day * Employee Assistance Program * Tuition Reimbursement Program * Employee Referral Program * Diversity, Equity and Inclusion Program *This pay scale is an estimate of the salary range the employer reasonably expects to pay for the position based on potential employee qualifications, operational needs and other considerations consistent with applicable law. The actual salary may be above or below the range. The pay scale applies only to this position and only if it is filled in Sacramento, California. The pay scale may be different for other positions or in other locations.* **ABOUT US** ------------ With more than 50 years in business, BHHC has grown from a regional organization to a national insurance group, offering insurance products from coast to coast. Relationships are the cornerstone of our culture, and we believe in doing the right thing. That means we invest in our business in every way possible to deliver on our mission and demonstrate that people are what powers our success. Our commitment to financial strength and integrity means our customers can rest assured that we will be there when it counts. At BHHC we embrace diversity and foster an environment where our people can be their authentic selves. Our differences make us stronger and better together, which fosters a harmonious workplace—something we truly value. We’ve created an approachable and collaborative atmosphere. Here you’ll find a welcoming workplace where everyone can feel valued, supported, and inspired to do great work. Together, we raise the bar by being curious, remaining customer\-focused, and operating with integrity.

Some of our awards include: * 4x Top Private Companies award winner (Austin Business Journal) * 4x Fastest Growing Companies award winner (Austin Business Journal) * 4x Top Technology Firm (Construction Executive Magazine) * 2x Top Tech Employer in Austin (Austin Business Journal) * 2x Best Places to Work (Forbes, BuiltIn) * 1x Best CEO Nomination (Austin Business Journal) * 1x Top 10 Startups in Austin (LinkedIn) This role is based at our Austin, TX headquarters. Our team works in office together, with added flexibility available through our work\-from\-home allowance. Our dog\-friendly office features a fully stocked kitchen, on\-site fitness room, and hosts quarterly company\-wide team events. This role is not eligible for fully remote work. **The Role** Billd is looking for a Chief Technology Officer to lead our combined Product and Technology team and join the executive team. We are well into our AI transformation as a company, and our development team is AI\-first. Our vision is “building new financial and technology products to empower subcontractors to do the best work of their lives.” As CTO, you will own the technology and product strategy behind that vision, including the platform that powers Material Financing, Pay App Advance, Flex Line, and Predictable Pay, and you will build it hands\-on alongside that nimble, talented, AI\-first team. Reporting to the CEO, you will lead product, engineering, Salesforce, QA, and IT, and partner closely with the GM of Financial Products. Success in this role looks like a highly capable Product and Technology team that punches above its weight, deploying products our customers love and use every day. The ideal candidate is a technology executive with deep fintech and AI experience who thinks strategically but also gets into the details. You will make the hard engineering and architecture calls yourself, and as a member of the executive team you will help lead the next growth phase of our business. You spend time with customers to understand where technology can open new business opportunities, you treat security and compliance as part of the architecture, and you enjoy developing the people around you. **Key Responsibilities** Executive Leadership and Strategy * Serve on the executive team and help lead the next growth phase of the business, contributing to company strategy and reporting on technology to the Board as needed. * Set Billd’s technology and product strategy and own the roadmap in partnership with the executive team. AI Leadership * Lead the next stage of Billd’s AI transformation, both in how we build software and in the products and tools our customers and teams use every day. * Track emerging AI models, tools, and practices, and bring the ones that matter into how Billd works. Hands\-On Engineering and Architecture * Own platform architecture and make the hard engineering and architecture decisions, including build\-versus\-buy. * Write, review, and ship code alongside the team. * Own delivery, reliability, and uptime of Billd’s platform. * Build on our AI\-first development practices, including AI coding agents, automated testing, and clear review standards, that raise the bar on speed and quality. Product, Customers, and Business Opportunity * Own the product vision and roadmap, partnering with the VP of Product on strategy, prioritization, and delivery of customer\-facing products. * Work closely and directly with customers, partners, and others in the industry to understand market needs and key use cases. * Collaborate with the executive team to identify growth opportunities and turn them into products that create new value for our customers and new revenue for Billd. * Build processes for gathering customer feedback and usage data, and use them to measure product\-market fit and prioritize what we build next. * Partner with the GM of Financial Products to deliver the technology behind Billd’s financial products. Security, Compliance, and Data * Own information security, IT, cloud infrastructure, and physical facilities, including SOC 2 compliance, and ensure the platform meets the security and compliance standards expected of a financial services company. * Own Billd’s data platform, including warehouse, databases, and governance, so every team can get trusted answers on its own, increasingly through AI. Team Leadership * Recruit and hire top product and engineering talent as the business grows. * Lead, mentor, and develop the Product and Technology team for professional growth and retention. * Manage the technology budget, tools, and vendors, investing where each dollar creates the most impact. Skills and Qualifications * 12\+ years in software engineering, including 5\+ years leading engineering and product teams as a CTO, VP of Engineering, or Head of Product and Engineering. * B2B fintech experience in commercial credit, payments, working capital, or embedded finance. * AI\-forward in practice: you have personally built with LLMs and AI coding agents and led an AI\-first development team. * Hands\-on technical depth; you still write and review code and are comfortable in our stack: Python (FastAPI), Vue and TypeScript, PostgreSQL, and AWS. * Deep expertise in security and compliance for regulated financial data. * Experience managing cloud operations for reliability, scalability, and security in AWS. * Has led a company through SOC 2 compliance, from readiness through audit, and kept it maintained. * Track record of leading high\-output engineering and product teams in a startup or growth\-stage company. * Product leadership experience: has owned a product roadmap tied to customer outcomes and business results. * Comfortable in front of customers and partners, and able to connect what we build to the opportunities it creates for the business. * Proven ability to mentor and develop engineers. * Salesforce platform experience is strongly preferred. * B2B SMB or payments\-platform experience is a plus. * Experience presenting to a Board of Directors is a plus. * Challenges how things have always been done; picks the best modern tool for the job and changes course when the evidence changes. * Executive presence; communicates technology strategy clearly to the executive team, partners, and customers, and just as clearly to engineers. **Why Billd?** Billd is committed to diversity and is proud to be an equal\-opportunity employer. jobs.description: Block is one company built from many blocks, all united by the same purpose of economic empowerment. The blocks that form our foundational teams — People, Finance, Counsel, Hardware, Information Security, Platform Infrastructure Engineering, and more — provide support and guidance at the corporate level. They work across business groups and around the globe, spanning time zones and disciplines to develop inclusive People policies, forecast finances, give legal counsel, safeguard systems, nurture new initiatives, and more. Bring yours to Block. #### **The Role** Employee Experience Engineering (EXE) is part of Block's Corporate Engineering organization, responsible for building and operating the engineering platforms, services, and integrations that improve the employee experience. Our work supports the employee journey from hiring and onboarding through ongoing access to corporate services. We develop internal applications, automate employee workflows, and integrate enterprise systems to deliver seamless, reliable, and scalable experiences. experience across hiring, onboarding, and ongoing access to corporate services. * Build and maintain APIs and integrations connecting internal platforms, enterprise applications, and third\-party services. * Own software solutions end\-to\-end, from technical design and implementation through deployment, monitoring, and ongoing support. * Collaborate with Product, Design, Corporate Engineering, People Technology, Security, and other cross\-functional teams to translate business needs into technical solutions. * Provide technical leadership through architecture discussions, code reviews, mentoring, and engineering best practices. * Improve application performance, reliability, observability, and maintainability. * Contribute to technical roadmaps, architectural decisions, and long\-term platform improvements. * Explore emerging technologies, including AI\-powered capabilities, to improve employee workflows and engineering productivity. #### **You Have** * 8\+ years of professional software engineering experience building and operating production applications. * Strong full\-stack development experience, including modern frontend and backend technologies. * PostgreSQL or MySQL. * Strong understanding of software architecture, system design, data structures, and engineering fundamentals. * Experience with distributed systems, service reliability, and observability. * Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and production monitoring. * Ability to independently drive complex technical projects and collaborate across engineering teams. * Strong communication skills, customer empathy, and a passion for delivering excellent employee experiences. #### **Nice to Have** * Experience building internal enterprise applications or employee\-facing platforms. * Experience integrating HR, identity, access management, or other enterprise systems. * Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, particularly AWS. * Experience with authentication, authorization, and secure API integrations. * Experience automating employee lifecycle workflows, including hiring, onboarding, and access provisioning. * Experience with AI\-assisted development or integrating AI capabilities into applications. * Experience improving developer productivity, engineering workflows, or internal platforms. **Why Join EXE?** You'll have the opportunity to build software that directly improves how employees experience Block, from their first interaction with the company through their everyday work. Our goal is to bring the same level of engineering quality, thoughtful design, and reliability to our internal products that Block delivers to its customers. We’re working to build a more inclusive economy where our customers have equal access to opportunity, and we strive to live by these same values in building our workplace. Block is an equal opportunity employer evaluating all employees and job applicants without regard to identity or any legally protected class. We will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records for employment in accordance with state and local laws and “fair chance” ordinances. We believe in being fair, and are committed to an inclusive interview experience, including providing reasonable accommodations to disabled applicants throughout the recruitment process. We encourage applicants to share any needed accommodations with their recruiter, who will treat these requests as confidentially as possible. While there is no specific deadline to apply for this role, U.S. roles are typically open for an average of 55 days before being filled by a successful candidate. Please refer to the date listed at the top of this job page for when this role was first posted. Block takes a market\-based approach to pay, and pay may vary depending on your location. Zone A: $217,800—$326,800 USD Zone B: $207,000—$310,400 USD Zone C: $196,100—$294,100 USD Zone D: $185,200—$277,800 USD **Application Guidelines** Candidates may submit up to 9 active applications within a 60\-day period. Reapplications to the same role are accepted 90 days after a previous application has been reviewed. **Use of AI in Our Hiring Process** We may use automated AI tools to evaluate job applications for efficiency and consistency. These tools comply with local regulations, including bias audits, and we handle all personal data in accordance with state and local privacy laws. Contact us here with hiring practice or data usage questions. *Every benefit we offer is designed with one goal: empowering you to do the best work of your career while building the life you want. (NYSE: XYZ) builds technology to increase access to the global economy.
