jobs.description: Available in 2 locationsAvailable in 2 locations See allSee all **Senior DSP Engineer** ----------------------- Available in 2 locations Framingham, Massachusetts, United States of America Remote, Massachusetts, United States of America Category: Engineering Job ID: R29309 Brand: Bose Corporation, U.S.A Posted Date: October 19th 2026 widget: Full time **Description** --------------- At Bose Corporation, we believe sound is the most powerful force on earth — and for over 60 years, we have been a company built on innovation, excellence, and independence. Privately owned, fiercely customer\-focused, and driven by our values, we continue to lead industries and transform lives through sound. Today, Bose Corporation is entering an exciting new era. Across multiple global Business Units and Global Functions, we are shaping the future of audio technology, automotive, luxury, and premium experiences. We invite you to join us in this transformation. **Job Description** =================== At Bose, we believe sound is the most powerful force on earth. We bring together research, engineering, and a passion for audio to create experiences that people love. Join us to turn advanced signal processing into reliable, reusable technology that reaches products across multiple platforms and form factors. **Role Overview** We are seeking a **Senior DSP Engineer** to develop, port, optimize, integrate, and validate audio signal processing software for embedded platforms. You will independently own substantial DSP components or workstreams, taking algorithms from reference models through production deployment. You will turn MATLAB/Simulink models and research implementations into robust C/C\+\+ components that can be reused across audio products. The work combines practical DSP engineering, target optimization, and hands\-on integration, with an emphasis on audio quality, testability, and maintainability. This role is based onsite in Framingham, MA, working closely with algorithm, systems, firmware, hardware, and QA teams. You will learn and work within Bose’s proprietary audio technologies and collaborate with ML and ANC/ANR engineers as needed. **Key Responsibilities** * Implement, port, and validate DSP algorithms for embedded audio applications, translating reference models into production\-quality C/C\+\+. * Independently own DSP components from implementation planning through integration, verification, and release, while communicating progress, risks, and technical tradeoffs. * Develop modular, reusable processing blocks and integrate them into configurable audio chains and embedded frameworks. * Apply fixed\-point and floating\-point techniques, selecting appropriate numerical representations and validating behavior against reference models. * Profile and optimize compute, memory, latency, and real\-time performance on DSP and embedded targets such as Cadence HiFi, ARM, and Qualcomm Hexagon. * Build unit tests, reference test vectors, and automated regression tests, documenting numerical accuracy, audio behavior, and target performance. * Debug algorithm and system integration issues on reference and product hardware using lab equipment, debuggers, and profiling tools. * Collaborate with firmware engineers on interfaces, build environments, and integration dependencies, adapting implementations as requirements evolve. * Contribute to design and code reviews, maintain clear technical documentation, and provide guidance to less experienced engineers. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. * 8\+ years of relevant DSP or embedded software development experience, with substantial hands\-on DSP implementation work. * Strong DSP fundamentals and practical experience implementing signal processing algorithms for embedded or real\-time systems. * Strong C/C\+\+ programming skills and MATLAB/Simulink experience for algorithm analysis, modeling, and validation. * Experience implementing fixed\-point and floating\-point algorithms and evaluating numerical accuracy and hardware trade\-offs. * Hands\-on development experience with at least one relevant DSP or embedded processor architecture, such as Cadence HiFi, ARM, or Qualcomm Hexagon. * Demonstrated ability to independently take DSP components through implementation, optimization, integration, and validation. * Strong debugging and profiling skills, with experience diagnosing performance, memory, and real\-time processing issues. * Experience with automated testing, version control, code reviews, and clear engineering documentation. * Strong communication and collaboration skills, and the ability to work onsite in Framingham, MA. **Preferred Qualifications** * Master’s degree in a relevant engineering discipline. * Experience with audio DSP, including equalization, dynamics processing, filtering, sample\-rate conversion, spatial audio, or voice processing. * Processor\-specific optimization using SIMD/vector intrinsics or assembly, including Cadence HiFi, ARM Neon/Helium, Qualcomm Hexagon, or x64 SIMD. * Experience developing reusable DSP libraries and integrating low\-latency audio processing into RTOS or embedded Linux systems. * Experience with Embedded Coder or similar code\-generation tools, Python\-based validation, or continuous integration. * Experience deploying ML algorithms or partnering with ANC/ANR controls engineers. \#LI\-hybrid \#LI\-remote At Bose, you're inspired to be and do your best and are rewarded for your unique talents! Our compensation is thoughtfully tailored to your skills, experience, education, and location, and goes beyond base salary. The hiring range for this position in the primary work location of Framingham, Massachusetts is: $138,100\-$189,850\.The hiring range for other Bose work locations may vary.\&\#xa;\&\#xa;In addition to competitive base pay we offer rewards including bonus programs, comprehensive health and welfare benefits, a 401(k) plan, plus exclusive perks designed to support your wellbeing, and a generous employee discount where you can immerse yourself in our products and experiences. We are a proudly independent company—driven by purpose, guided by our values, and united by a belief in the power of sound. As the world leader in audio experiences, we’re creating what’s next—pushing boundaries and delivering transformative sound experiences for people everywhere. Join us and make your next career move a mic\-drop. Let’s Make Waves.

jobs.title: Director Cybersecurity
jobs.description: We are seeking a hands\-on Director of Cybersecurity to lead the design, implementation, operation and continuous improvement of Bridgewater Bank’s cybersecurity architecture, engineering, and technology controls. This role combines strategic leadership with direct technical involvement across Azure, Microsoft 365, hybrid infrastructure, identity, SaaS platforms, applications, APIs, integrations, automation, and defensive security technologies. The Director is responsible for developing, coordinating, and executing cybersecurity capabilities aligned to the NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF), including security architecture, identity and access management, security operations, threat and vulnerability management, incident response, and cyber resilience. The role leads the implementation and ongoing effectiveness of technology security controls designed to protect the bank's systems, applications, data, and customers. The position partners closely with the Information Security Officer, Internal Audit, Compliance/ERM, and technology and business leaders to ensure alignment between cybersecurity operations, governance, risk management, and regulatory expectations. The Director also leads technology control assurance activities, supports Internal Audit and regulatory examinations, coordinates control testing across IT teams, and drives timely remediation and closure of identified issues. **RESPONSIBILITIES:** * Lead technical architecture, standards, strategic roadmap development, vendor evaluation, and technology investment recommendations for Azure, Microsoft 365, hybrid infrastructure, SaaS platforms, web technologies, APIs, integrations, automation, and application enablement. * Own the technical strategy and control design for Microsoft Entra ID/Azure AD, identity and access management, Conditional Access, phishing\-resistant multifactor authentication, single sign\-on, SAML/OIDC federation, SCIM/JIT provisioning, privileged access, service identities, and joiner\-mover\-leaver lifecycle controls. * Lead technical cybersecurity incident response activities, including preparation, detection, containment, eradication, recovery, lessons learned, and coordination with the Information Security Officer and Bank’s Leadership Team. * Collaborate with IT teams and the Information Security Officer to design and implement comprehensive security strategies, including controls, monitoring, vulnerability management, and reporting. * Lead threat intelligence meetings and oversee the collection and analysis of relevant security information to proactively mitigate risks. * Define and operate a technology control testing program (design and operating effectiveness) aligned to NIST CSF; coordinate testing execution across IT and control owners and report results, themes, and remediation needs. * Manage technology audit and examination workflows, including coordination through Optro, remediation planning, issue tracking, validation of corrective actions, and closure reporting. * Manage penetration test reporting and governance: coordinate scoping and deliverables with providers, communicate results to stakeholders, track remediation, and ensure retesting/closure activities are completed. * Develop and deliver technology risk, controls, and audit status reporting to stakeholders including the Information Security Officer, CIO/CTO, ERM/Risk, Compliance, Internal Audit, and management/Board\-level committees as applicable; escalate emerging risks and control gaps with clear recommendations. * Lead technical cybersecurity assessments of third\-party technology providers and partner with business and operational leaders to evaluate risk and implement appropriate security controls. * Serve as a technical resource for key security functions including access controls, data loss prevention, SIEM/SOAR, and cloud/network/endpoint security. * Own the technology audit readiness and response program, serving as the primary point of coordination for Internal Audit and regulatory examinations; manage audit/exam planning, walkthrough coordination, evidence collection/quality review, and timely delivery of responses. * Manage and maintain technology risk and security governance documentation, including policies, standards, procedures, control narratives, control evidence requirements, and audit\-ready artifacts. * Identify, report, and remediate vulnerabilities across networks, servers, and endpoints. * Manage security information and event management solutions for compliance and incident response. * Lead security technology initiatives and continuous improvement efforts across identity, detection, monitoring, data protection, security automation and defensive security platforms. * Partner with the Information Security Officer to support technical security education and awareness initiatives technology staff and employees. **QUALIFICATIONS:** * 8\+ years of progressive experience in cybersecurity, cloud or infrastructure engineering, enterprise r, Purview, Entra ID, Conditional Access, and related security technologies. * Demonstrated experience securing hybrid infrastructure, cloud platforms, SaaS applications, networks, endpoints, web applications, APIs, and related security technologies through architecture, monitoring, vulnerability management, and control implementation. * Strong understanding of security operations, threat intelligence, incident response, vulnerability management, penetration testing, security monitoring, SIEM/SOAR, and root\-cause analysis. * Demonstrated ability to develop technology standards, reference architectures, roadmaps, resilience strategies, configuration baselines, diagrams, runbooks while evaluating vendors, solutions and emerging technologies. * Experience supporting technology controls programs in highly regulated environments, including NIST\-based control frameworks, internal and external audits, regulatory examinations, issue remediation, and GRC tooling such as Optro. * Strong understanding of resilient architecture, business continuity, disaster recovery, backup protection, recovery testing, and security considerations for high\-availability services. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical issues into clear risk, business impact, options, and recommendations for technical teams, executives, auditors, regulators, and Board\-level audiences. * Industry certification such as CISSP, CCSP, CISM, GIAC, Microsoft Cybersecurity Architect Expert, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or equivalent is preferred. **ABOUT BRIDGEWATER BANK:** Picture yourself at one of the Twin Cities’ best places to work, surrounded by people who challenge you, support you, and inspire you to be your best. Welcome to Bridgewater Bank. We’re on a mission to be the finest entrepreneurial bank in the Twin Cities. Like true entrepreneurs, we run fast and lean. We are in constant evolution and the runway for personal and professional growth is long. People are our strength, and that’s why we’ve created and sustained an award\-winning culture that promotes growth and celebrates the big and little wins along the way. At the end of the day, we believe competitive salaries, top\-tier benefits, a hybrid work model, and transparency into the business is a given. Working together toward something meaningful with people you enjoy is just a bonus! **COMPENSATION \& BENEFITS:** The typical annual base pay range for this role is between $144,500 \- $190,000\. jobs.title: Design Engineer - Built World
jobs.description: **About Build** --------------- AI for the Built World: Build has created the agentic AI stack for institutional real estate, automating complex development and acquisitions workflows 90% faster than humans to accelerate the world's most important built projects \- digital infrastructure, energy, industrial \- from concept to completion. Our mission is to accelerate and amplify the world's most important built projects \- inventing a better way to build through a collaboration between human experts and agentic AI. We envision a future where the world's buildings are driven from concept to completion, autonomously. Without delays, cost, and complexity. Enabling people to deliver a magnitude more deals. To make decisions, build relationships and create. To start, we're partnering with the world's biggest built world institutions from $T alternative assets investors, prolific developers and even governments to push the frontier of what's possible. We're backed by c\-suite from Blackstone and OpenAI alongside the world's best venture capital firms. Join us in shaping the future of the Built World and exponentially accelerate your career in the process. We welcome you to do your life's work here. **About the role** ------------------ This role exists to make sure Build designs the way the best engineers do. The Design Engineer brings an engineering lens to data centers, power and energy infrastructure, and the wider built environment, and takes projects through design: from concept and feasibility to a coordinated, buildable scheme. You are the source of truth for how a project actually gets engineered when the loads are large, the timelines are tight and the stakes are high. You can expect to: * Take live projects through design: site and capacity studies, concept design, MEP, electrical and mechanical systems, and critical facilities design. * Size and lay out power, cooling and resilience systems for data centers and energy infrastructure, and pressure\-test them against cost, schedule and constructability. * Work alongside Build's domain experts and engineers to turn design judgment into workflows, rules and checks that can be encoded into software. * Run proofs\-of\-concept for new design workflows by doing the work yourself, with an engineer supporting you on Build's systems. * Own design quality from an engineering perspective. If an output wouldn't survive review by a serious design firm, it's your job to surface and fix it. * Act as a credible peer to developers, operators, utilities and design consultants, speaking their language. * Feed what you learn on projects back into the core product. **What we're looking for** -------------------------- * Hands\-on design experience on data centers, mission\-critical facilities, or power and energy infrastructure. * Strong grounding in MEP: electrical distribution, mechanical and cooling systems, redundancy (N\+1, 2N) and critical facilities design. * Experience at a leading engineering or design firm (e.g. Arup, Jacobs, Burns \& McDonnell, Corgan, HDR, Syska Hennessy), or on a hyperscaler or colocation design team. * Taken projects from concept through detailed design, coordinating across disciplines and with contractors. * Comfortable with numbers and tools: load calcs, single\-line diagrams, BIM/Revit, and spreadsheets or scripts to move fast. * Bias to ownership and speed. You'd rather ship a working answer today than a perfect one next month. **Nice to haves** ----------------- * PE licence (or on track), or chartered engineer status. * Exposure to utility interconnection, on\-site generation, BESS or grid\-scale energy projects. * Experience with design automation, generative design, or scripting (Python, Dynamo, Grasshopper). * A degree in mechanical, electrical or civil engineering, or architectural engineering. **How to win at Build** ----------------------- Growing Build requires a radically different approach to company building. As a company we're focused on one outcome: winning. That means we move fast, work with intensity, and demand excellence from ourselves. We operate with intensity but create an environment that allows for a lot of fun together. The result is that we're one of the fastest shipping teams in vertical AI, partnering with the best to automate the world around us. Performance and teamwork are the core of Build's operation. We look for those who are able to do both, who often exhibit a particular ability for; Velocity: You are relentless in asking the right questions to set direction. Once you find the right direction you go all\-in. Excellence: You obsess with being the best. For you, excellence is a non\-negotiable standard rather than an aspiration. Long time horizons: You choose to be in something for the long run, because that's where most of the returns are realized. Ownership: You take full ownership of the outcomes. You're meticulous in your pursuits and believe you can actively shape your environment rather than adapt to it. Customers: You have a passion for the built world and those who shape it. You probably have a quirky hobby or story that relates to your love for building. Integrity: You chose to do the right thing even when it isn't easy. Trust: You only work with people you can trust because it's the only way to do truly extraordinary things. Yield: You have a burning need to see a result on every action you take and you're always looking for routes to do more with less. **What we offer** ----------------- Radical autonomy, real ownership: High standards. Minimal bureaucracy. You own problems end\-to\-end, choose how the work gets done, and are accountable for exceptional outcomes. Ownership is matched with meaningful, generous equity. An accelerated founder's track: Build is for builders. If you want to learn what it actually takes to create a generational company \- Product judgment, execution speed, and accountability \- there is no faster path than building from zero when everything is for grabs. Elite teammates, uncompromising bar: You work with people who think clearly, execute relentlessly, and take full ownership. The team you build becomes the company you build. Growth here is not just professional; it reshapes how you operate and in return how Build operates. Perpetual adventure: We attract the strongest of the strange. Extraordinary experiences are part of the culture \- from the food we eat together to the space we occupy. Intensity is intentional. Shape the built world: We are rebuilding how the physical world gets made. Our software doesn't live in the abstract \- it turns into real projects breaking ground because we exist. We work with the largest institutions, push the frontier of AI, and watch our decisions translate directly into the world around us. Compensation Range: $150K \- $220K

The dollars come from a number of sources, including the property owners who pay into the funds on behalf of their employees, and as such, requires those who oversee and manage the money to be highly skilled financial management people. 32BJ Benefit Funds will continue to drive innovation, equity, and technology insights to further help the lives of our hard\-working members and their families. Please take a moment to watch our video to learn more about our culture and contributions to our members: youtu.be/hYNdMGLn19A **Job Summary:** Under the direction of the Manager, Data Science, we’re looking for an early\-career **Associate AI Solutions Developer** with practical experience in software, data, or automation. In this role, you will use Python and existing AI and data platforms to build, test, and improve applications and workflows, which may include classical Machine Learning and Large Language Models. The work will also involve using AI coding assistants to explore code, draft or refine changes, configure coding agents or subagents, and create tests. You will review and validate AI\-generated work and understand the code you submit. This role applies existing AI capabilities; it does not involve training or developing AI models from scratch. Your responsibilities will include owning agreed assignments from clarification through implementation, testing, and documentation, with support from your supervisor and experienced teammates. Your supervisor will help set priorities, review your approach, and provide coaching through formal weekly check\-ins, brief daily discussions to share progress and resolve blockers, and hands\-on training. As your skills grow, there will be opportunities to take on broader assignments and greater responsibility. Depending on the project, you may use Python, Visual Studio Code, PyCharm, GitHub, Databricks and its AI Gateway capabilities, Microsoft Fabric, Microsoft Foundry, and related enterprise data and AI platforms. AI coding assistants may include GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Genie Code, or Codex. You are not expected to know every tool when you start; the team will provide training and support. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities:** * Work with your supervisor and teammates to understand business needs, agree on priorities, and define manageable assignments. Clarify requirements, share progress, and raise questions or blockers. * Take responsibility for completing agreed assignments through implementation, testing, and documentation, incorporating feedback from your supervisor and teammates. * Build and improve small applications, agents, and AI\-assisted workflows that support clearer member experiences or more efficient internal operations. * Write and debug Python scripts or application features that process data, automate tasks, or connect approved data sources, APIs, models, and business tools. * Use approved AI coding assistants to support development tasks, such as understanding a codebase, drafting or refining code, configuring coding agents or subagents, and creating or updating tests. Review and validate suggestions before using them. * Build and test prototypes and updates to existing solutions. Review your approach with your supervisor and seek guidance and approval for changes affecting system design, security, or production use. * Test workflows with representative questions and tasks. Record whether results are useful, accurate, consistent, and timely; investigate failures and implement improvements within your assigned scope. * Use GitHub, Azure DevOps and follow team practices for version control, testing, documentation, and code review. Support experienced teammates as changes are prepared for use and monitored. * Work with data scientists, data engineers, business partners, IT, and security colleagues to understand data sources, operational needs, and privacy and security requirements. * Explore relevant tools and capabilities and share practical findings and suggestions with the team. **Qualifications (Competencies):** * 1\-3 years of professional experience in software development, data, analytics, automation, or a related technical field. Candidates with less professional experience may be considered if internships, fellowships, or substantial projects demonstrate the capabilities below * Experience writing and debugging Python scripts or small application features that process data, automate tasks, or connect systems. You should be able to explain how the code works, how you investigated problems, and how you verified the results, including contributions developed with AI assistance. * Experience completing a technical project or assignment that solved a practical problem. You should be able to describe the purpose, your contribution, the challenges you encountered, and how you tested the result. * Hands\-on experience using AI tools in software development through work, an internship, coursework, or a personal project. Examples include using an AI coding assistant to understand, write, refine, or test code. You should be able to explain how you reviewed its suggestions and checked their accuracy. * Familiarity with Git or another version\-control tool for tracking changes and collaborating on code. * Familiarity with structured data, such as CSV files or JSON, and experience using basic SQL or Python to inspect and organize data. * Ability to explain technical work clearly, clarify requirements, share progress, incorporate feedback, and recognize when to seek help. * Willingness to follow established procedures for handling sensitive information. * ***Preferred Qualifications:*** + Experience connecting applications or workflows to APIs, data sources, or business tools. + Exposure to automated testing or collaborative code review. + Experience with Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, Microsoft Foundry, or a similar enterprise data or AI platform. + Experience configuring an AI agent, coding agent, subagent, or workflow. + Experience working with regulated or sensitive data including but not limited to insurance and financial domains. **Soft Skills (Interpersonal Skills):** * Curiosity about emerging AI technologies and a preference for testing assumptions through hands\-on experimentation rather than theoretical assessment. * Willingness to report findings objectively, including results that do not support a preferred or previously proposed approach. * Ability to clearly communicate technical findings, limitations, tradeoffs, and recommendations to technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Comfort working with ambiguous or loosely defined problems and the ability to translate them into testable questions with measurable success criteria. * Ability to collaborate effectively across data science, engineering, IT, security, and governance teams, incorporating their requirements early in the development process. * Attention to detail and follow\-through in maintaining versioned, documented, and reproducible work. **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related STEM field, or comparable practical experience through education, internships, projects, or work experience. **Reasoning Ability:** build capacity planning methodology, and combine business growth forecasts to complete resource expansion and configuration optimization so that capacity is delivered on time, reliably and cost\-effectively. \- Drive the build\-out of a unified compute pool with co\-located training and inference workloads; jobs.title: System Admin, Windows (I, II, III, or IV)
jobs.description: **Our Vision: Be the best at what we do. We aim to engage the exceptional and embrace operational excellence to best deliver connectivity and technology solutions that advance our communities and customer’s lives. It’s a challenging goal, but we have a winning team that is looking to grow. Help keep the Microsoft infrastructure behind C Spire’s cloud, data center, and enterprise environments reliable and secure. Depending on your experience, you’ll contribute to or lead administration work across Windows systems, identity, virtualization, and Azure—including the foundations that support AI workloads. This role is open at Levels I through IV, with scope and technical leadership aligned to the level of hire.**Responsibilities:** **What You Will Do** In all of your duties, you will have a relentless, obsessive, yet disciplined approach to manage all details to perfection and deliver desired results. * Design, build, and operate cloud, data center, and enterprise Windows systems, progressing from implementation under senior guidance at Level I to architecture and delivery across multiple projects at Level IV. * Administer supported server, identity, endpoint, productivity, cloud, virtualization, and virtual desktop environments, including Windows Server, Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Intune, Office 365, Exchange, Azure, VMware vSphere, KVM, VMware Horizon, and Citrix. * Install, upgrade, patch, test, monitor, and troubleshoot systems; provide technical support, participate in on\-call coverage, and document findings and actions when escalating issues. * Identify risks before they affect customers, investigate incidents, and drive lasting fixes—with responsibility for complex escalations and systemic improvements increasing at senior levels. * Build and secure the Windows, identity, and Azure foundations for AI workloads in partnership with AI and data teams, applying appropriate access, logging, and data\-handling controls. * Use, develop, and ultimately set build, deployment, and automation standards; apply PowerShell, DSC, and Ansible, with Python used in senior\-level engineering work. * Use AI\-assisted tools for appropriate engineering, troubleshooting, and documentation tasks, verify their output before use, and establish team review practices at Level IV. * Design for high availability, backup, and disaster recovery, and apply established security and quality practices—defining cross\-team controls and standards at Level IV. * Collaborate with business analysts, product development, implementation, support, vendors, and other teams to deliver effective service and make sound technical decisions. * Grow technical ownership by sharing knowledge and improving a supported technology at Level II, leading designs and mentoring engineers at Level III, and setting technical direction and developing engineers across the team at Level IV. This role offers room to deepen your technical expertise and broaden your ownership as you advance through the engineering levels. Depending on your starting level and development, it can provide a foundation for senior or principal engineering, architecture, or technical leadership. **Qualifications:** **What You Will Bring** As a C Spire team member you will bring a relentless obsession to be the best in our industry and a winning mentality, determined to outsmart and outdo competitors. You will have a single\-minded commitment to unbeatable internal customer and external candidate experience. To support our IT infrastructure team you will have an unapologetic passion for innovation and technology and an uncompromising drive toward continuous improvement. In addition to that, we require: **System Admin I** * Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems or Computer Science, or equivalent experience. * At least 1 year of hands\-on administration experience with technologies such as Windows Server, Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID, Office 365, Azure services, VMware or KVM virtualization, Citrix, or monitoring systems. * Basic networking, backup, disaster recovery, and high\-availability experience, plus exposure to scripting or automation. * Strong written and verbal communication skills. * Curiosity about using AI tools in engineering work and awareness of associated security and data\-privacy risks. **System Admin II** * All System Admin I requirements. * At least 3 years of hands\-on experience across multiple supported technologies, which may include SQL, Azure Virtual Desktop, VMware Horizon, or load balancers. * Advanced knowledge of at least one supported technology and intermediate knowledge of networking, backup, disaster recovery, and high availability. * Hands\-on PowerShell automation experience and sound judgment when applying AI tools to engineering work. **System Admin III** * All System Admin I and II requirements. * At least 5 years of hands\-on enterprise engineering experience, advanced knowledge of three or more supported technologies, and expert depth in at least one technology recognized by peers. * Advanced networking, backup, disaster recovery, and high\-availability experience. * A proven record of leading the design and implementation of production systems and mentoring less experienced engineers. * Hands\-on PowerShell automation experience. **System Admin IV** * All System Admin I, II, and III requirements. * At least 7 years of hands\-on enterprise engineering experience, advanced knowledge across a majority of supported technologies, and expert depth in several, recognized inside and outside the team. * Experience designing networking, backup, disaster recovery, and high availability at scale. * A proven record of leading architecture and delivery of complex production systems and developing other engineers. * Deep PowerShell automation experience, experience with Python, DSC, or Ansible, and the ability to present technical recommendations to leadership. * Sound judgment in setting security and data\-privacy guardrails for AI\-assisted engineering. We will give special consideration to candidates who have: * Monitoring system administration experience. * Windows Failover Cluster or Microsoft SQL administration experience. * Software deployment and patching experience. * Networking experience with virtual and physical switches and load balancers. * Modern Windows management experience, such as Intune or Azure Arc. * Experience migrating Windows workloads from VMware to KVM or other open virtualization platforms. * Experience supporting AI or data platforms, such as Azure AI services, GPU\-enabled compute, or containers and Kubernetes. * Infrastructure\-as\-code experience, such as Terraform or Bicep. * Certifications in one or more supported technologies, such as Microsoft, VMware VCP, or Citrix. * PowerShell exposure at Level I, and Python, DSC, or Ansible experience at Level III. **What You Will Gain** A great workplace needs more than dental coverage, though we provide that and excellent health insurance. But that’s just the start. We make sure working at C Spire is the best career experience around. And Forbes has named us one of America's Best Midsize Employers multiple times because of it. We also offer: * Competitive Compensation Package * Blue Cross Blue Shield Health Insurance * Tuition Assistance Programs * Complimentary Wireless Service \& Device\* * 401k Match * Teladoc Telemedicine * WellBeacon Wellness Program * Paid Talent Referral Opportunities * Tailored learning paths for every position **Physical Requirements And Working Conditions** The role requires sitting for long periods and using a computer keyboard and/or mouse while viewing a screen. It also requires a flexible schedule shared with other department members, including an on\-call rotation. * Complimentary wireless service and device available to team members in our wireless footprint. *If you want to work hard, achieve a lot, and make a difference, then C Spire is the place for you.*

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: C.H. Robinson is seeking a **Senior Software Engineer** to join our Plan/Optimizer team within Technology. Our mission is to build the intelligent planning platform that helps customers answer one of the most challenging questions in logistics: *What is the optimal way to move freight through my network?* As part of this team, you will develop platforms and services that combine optimization, automation, business rules, and operational intelligence to generate actionable shipment plans at scale. You'll work on systems that evaluate thousands of potential transportation decisions while balancing cost, service, utilization, constraints, and customer\-specific business objectives. The technology you build powers Navisphere Optimizer and other planning capabilities that enable customers to minimize transportation spend, maximize trailer utilization, reduce total miles traveled, and improve supply chain performance. We're looking for engineers who enjoy tackling difficult distributed systems and decisioning problems and who are excited by the intersection of software engineering, optimization, AI, and logistics. If you're passionate about building highly automated systems that help customers make better decisions, we'd love to hear from you. This role can be based only in MN, IL or Kansas City **Duties \& Responsibilities** * Design and build the next generation of C.H. Robinson's planning and optimization platform that helps customers make intelligent freight planning decisions at scale * Contribute to the technical roadmap and architectural direction of optimization, planning, and workflow orchestration services * Design, develop, and operate resilient, scalable, and highly available cloud\-native services that support critical supply chain planning capabilities * Build platforms and services that evaluate transportation constraints, business rules, cost, service levels, capacity, and customer objectives to generate actionable shipment plans * Design and develop proof of concepts (POCs) to evaluate emerging technologies and validate new approaches to optimization, automation, and intelligent decisioning * Develop APIs, event\-driven Scientists, Architects, and business stakeholders to translate customer needs into scalable technical solutions * Design systems that balance configurability, maintainability, and performance while supporting diverse customer planning scenarios * Mentor and influence other engineers through technical leadership, design reviews, code reviews, and knowledge sharing * Evaluate and leverage AI\-assisted development tools, intelligent automation, and emerging technologies to improve engineering productivity and platform capabilities * Stay current on advancements in distributed systems, optimization technologies, AI, automation, and modern software engineering practices **Required Qualifications** * 6\+ years of experience designing and implementing large\-scale software products or distributed systems that span multiple applications and services * Experience leading technical design and delivering complex initiatives from concept through production * Experience developing proof of concepts and transforming innovative ideas into scalable production solutions * Experience with modern development languages and frameworks (ex. .NET Core, C\#) * Experience designing and developing cloud\-native applications and services (ex. Azure, AWS, GCP) * Experience with relational and non\-relational databases (ex. SQL Server, Oracle, MongoDB, Cosmos DB, Elasticsearch) * Experience with microservices, CQRS, event\-driven architectures, asynchronous messaging, and eventually consistent systems * Experience with streaming platforms and integration technologies (ex. Git, GitHub) * Experience delivering end\-to\-end features including backend services, APIs, integrations, and operational tooling * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to evaluate tradeoffs and navigate complex technical challenges * Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to explain complex concepts to technical and non\-technical audiences * Proven ability to deliver results in fast\-paced environments while balancing multiple priorities and ambiguity * Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, MIS, or related field; jobs.title: APPLICATION DEVELOPER III
jobs.description: JOB PURPOSE: The Application Developer III supports the building of the organization's multi\-tenant healthcare SaaS platform on Microsoft Azure. The platform serves multiple enterprise clients and supports daily operations, including member enrollment and eligibility checks, scheduling, care\-coordination workflows, document management, configurable forms and assessments, letters, reporting, and team communication. The role helps ensure each tenant's data remains strictly isolated and supports secure data exchange with payers and other vendors through APIs and integrations. The position contributes across the whole stack, including APIs, databases, front\-end, cloud infrastructure, and AI features, while setting technical standards for the development team. This senior full\-stack development role supports the advancement of a rapidly growing healthcare platform that is in active development. JOB RESPONSIBILITIES: Build features end to end. The back end is an ASP.NET Core API that uses CQRS with MediatR, FluentValidation, and EF Core. The front end is TypeScript, built with React Native for Web (Expo), Redux Toolkit, and RTK Query. Drive the implementation and evolution of our multi\-tenant architecture, with strict data isolation between tenants, strong access controls, and efficient use of resources. Build secure, versioned REST APIs with:Microsoft Entra ID / JWT authentication role\- and capability\-based access control field\-level permissions checks that a user may access each specific record audit logging that meets HIPAA requirements Build and maintain integrations: X12 EDI 270/271 eligibility, e\-signature, contact\-center phone systems, SFTP file exchange, and Microsoft Graph. These run on Azure Service Bus, Azure Functions, and background services. Extend the platform's workflow automation engine, which runs on events and schedules and is built on Durable Task. Work on real\-time features (SignalR) for notifications, chat, and live updates. Build AI features with Azure OpenAI, keeping PHI exposure to a minimum and a person in the loop:an assistant that can call tools document search that answers with citations (Azure AI Search) AI sorting of incoming documents live speech transcription (Azure Speech) that suggests form answers for a user to accept Design SQL Server schemas with our data team, write and tune complex queries, and fix EF Core performance problems on large tables. Ship through GitHub Actions to Azure: container images on App Service (via Azure Container Registry), Azure Functions and Azure Static Web Apps, monitored with Application Insights. Review code, mentor junior and mid\-level developers, and raise the bar on testing (xUnit, Moq, Jest, React Testing Library), documentation and architecture. Work closely with product owners, the data team, and other engineers in an Agile team: sprint planning, stand\-ups, backlog refinement, and retrospectives. Solve hard production problems anywhere in the stack, from slow screens and query plans to authorization failures and Azure configuration. Schedule: 8:30AM – 5:30PM Weekly Hours: 40 Location: On\-Site, 136\-65 37th Avenue, Flushing, NY 11354 QUALIFICATIONS: Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field. Required Skills \& Experience Backend 7\+ years building production systems with C\# and ASP.NET Core, including large\-scale, distributed systems. Strong REST API design and security: OAuth 2\.0 / OpenID Connect, JWTs, API keys, validation, error handling, and versioning. You know how to prevent unauthorized record access (IDOR) and leaking internal details in error messages. Strong SQL Server skills: schema design, complex queries and stored procedures, indexing, execution plans and tuning for high data volumes. Production experience with Entity Framework Core, including mapping to existing database\-first schemas, query performance, and migrations. Experience with clean, layered architectures: CQRS/MediatR, repository and unit\-of\-work patterns, dependency injection. Frontend 5\+ years with React: function components and hooks, state management with Redux Toolkit / RTK Query or similar, and performance tuning for large, data\-heavy applications. Expert TypeScript and modern JavaScript (ES6\+), including async patterns. Responsive, accessible UI built on a shared design system and utility CSS such as Tailwind. Experience connecting complex APIs to the UI: loading, error, and permission states, real\-time updates, and server\-side paging, sorting, and filtering. Azure Hands\-on experience with Azure App Service (including container deployments), Azure SQL, Azure Functions, Service Bus, Blob Storage, and Key Vault. Microsoft Entra ID sign\-in and authorization for web apps and APIs. Monitoring and troubleshooting with Azure Monitor and Application Insights. Familiarity with Docker and CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions preferred). AI Experience shipping LLM features in production apps, ideally on Azure OpenAI: prompt des tegration and end\-to\-end testing. Swagger/OpenAPI and API tools such as Postman. Expert Git skills in a branch\-and\-pull\-request workflow. Front\-end tooling such as npm/pnpm and modern bundlers (Metro, Webpack, or Vite). Preferred Qualifications: Proven track record of building and deploying complex multi\-tenant SaaS applications at scale. React Native and Expo, especially React Native for Web; NativeWind and Gluestack UI. Healthcare experience: HIPAA, PHI handling, Medicaid/Medicare eligibility, X12 EDI (270/271\), HL7 or FHIR. Workflow and messaging systems: Durable Task / Durable Functions, Service Bus, outbox and idempotency patterns. Real\-time applications with SignalR. Azure AI Search, Azure AI Speech, or document\-processing and PDF\-generation pipelines. Python for automation, data processing, or AI/ML work. Experience leading Agile ceremonies or improving team processes. Open\-source contributions or active involvement in technical communities. Soft Skills Excellent problem\-solving and debugging skills; you find the root cause, not just the symptom. Clear written and spoken communication with both technical and non\-technical people. A natural mentor who builds a collaborative, supportive, high\-performing team. Self\-motivated and always learning, including new technologies and the healthcare domain. Able to influence technical decisions and drive best practices across the team. Physical Requirements Individuals must be able to sustain specific physical requirements essential to the job. This includes, but is not limited to: Standing – Duration of up to 6 hours a day Sitting/Stationary Positions – Sedentary position for a duration of up to 6\-8 hours a day for consecutive hours/periods. Lifting/Push/Pull – Up to 50 pounds of equipment, baggage, supplies, and other items used in the job scope using OSHA guidelines, etc. Bending/Squatting – Have to be able to safely bend or squat to perform the essential functions under the scope of the job. Stairs/Steps/Walking/Climbing – Must be able to maneuver stairs safely, climb up/down, and walk to access work areas. Agility/Fine Motor Skills \- Must demonstrate agility and fine motor skills to operate and activate equipment, devices, instruments, and tools to complete essential job functions (i.e., typing, use of supplies, equipment, etc.) Sight/Visual Requirements – Must be able to read documentation, papers, orders, signs, etc., and accurately type/write documentation, etc. Audio Hearing and Motor Skills (Language) Requirements – Must be able to listen attentively and document information from patients, community members, co\-workers, clients, providers, etc., and intake information through audio processing with accuracy. In addition, one must be able to speak comfortably and clearly with language and motor skills for customers to understand an individual. Cognitive Ability – Must be able to demonstrate good decision\-making, reasonableness, cognitive ability, rational processing, and analysis to satisfy essential functions of the job. **Disclaimer:** Responsibilities and tasks outlined in this job description are not exhaustive and may change as determined by the needs of the company. We are an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer. patterns * Familiarity with Entity Framework Core, Dapper, or other ORMs (and knowing when to use native SQL) **Interview Policy \& Privacy Notice:** ======================================= A video jobs.title: Field Engineer-Mission Critical Data Center Project
jobs.description: **Why Work for Century Builders** Century Builders is a growing leader in mission critical construction, delivering complex hyperscale data center projects with a strong focus on safety, precision, and teamwork. jobs.title: Production Engineer II
jobs.description: Crusoe is on a mission *to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster. We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy\-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI. We're looking for problem\-solving, opportunity\-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services. If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high\-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe. ### **Start Your Infrastructure Career at the Center of the AI Buildout** This is an entry point into Production Engineering, not a stepping\-stone support role. You'll be one of the engineers keeping a multi\-billion dollar, rapidly scaling AI cloud business online, from every GPU cluster to every customer workload and every SLA, while you build the foundational skills that turn into a Senior and Staff\-level infrastructure career. We're hiring several Production Engineer II roles as we build out the next generation of our reliability organization. We'll determine which team is the best fit for you after the interview process, based on your background, interests, and where your strengths line up with our needs. The work ranges from broad, cross\-domain operations to deeper specialization in compute, storage, or networking, depending on the team. **What You'll Work On** * Triage and resolve production incidents: parse logs, correlate signals across services, and drive issues to root cause using logs, telemetry, and profiling * Write real automation and tooling in Python or Go to reduce manual toil, including remediation scripts and health checks that catch problems before customers do * Build and improve monitoring, alerting, observability, and telemetry so the team can see problems before they become incidents * Participate in on\-call rotations, respond to alerts, and contribute to blameless post\-mortems * Work directly with senior and staff engineers on real production engineering problems, and grow into more autonomy quickly **Depending on Your Team** * Own the health and reliability of production infrastructure supporting Crusoe's AI cloud, whether working cross\-domain or going deep in one area * Build breadth across Crusoe's infrastructure stack and grow toward a specialization (compute, storage, networking, or continued breadth) over time * On some teams, go deep on one specialization (compute and GPU fleet reliability, storage and distributed storage systems, networking fabric and SDN, Managed AI, Inference, or Managed Cloud) * On hardware\-focused teams, help keep our GPU fleet, including NVIDIA and AMD hardware, running reliably under real production AI workloads * Run validation testing on configuration changes, firmware updates, and infrastructure modifications before they touch production * Learn directly from senior and staff engineers who own the hardware and reliability standards for their domain, and grow toward owning more of that surface area yourself **What You'll Bring** * A CS or EE degree, bootcamp, or equivalent hands\-on experience, plus genuine interest in infrastructure and systems reliability over application development * 3 to 5 years of working proficiency in Python or Go. You're comfortable writing and debugging real code, not just shell one\-liners * Familiarity with Linux fundamentals: processes, networking, filesystems, and how hardware and software interact * Comfort in a fast\-paced, high\-ownership environment with a real on\-call rotation * Strong communication skills. You'll write incident summaries and work with engineers across compute, storage, and networking, not just your own team **Mindset** * Curiosity about how distributed systems fail and a habit of asking "why" past the first answer * Openness to either broad cross\-domain work or early specialization in one domain, depending on where the team needs you **Nice to Have** * Exposure to Kubernetes or container orchestration (not required, we'll teach you what matters here) * Exposure to GPUs, HPC environments, kernel internals, or systems and validation engineering coursework or projects * Prior on\-call, NOC, IT ops, or lab/systems administration experience, plus personal projects, open source contributions, or coursework touching distributed systems, low\-level systems, or hardware **What This Role Is Not** * **This is a role that focuses on reliability, not pure Software Engineering**. You won't be building product features. You'll be keeping GPU, storage, or networking infrastructure healthy and reliable under real production load. * **Not a role where scripting is optional**. You need working proficiency in Python or Go on day one. Real automation work starts immediately, not after a year of ramping. * **Not a help desk or NOC ticket\-passing role**. You'll do real engineering: writing automation, debugging distributed systems, and contributing to design discussions. * **Not a low\-ownership job**. You'll carry on\-call and be expected to grow into more autonomy quickly. * **Not primarily a Kubernetes or orchestration\-tooling job**. Managing a Kubernetes cluster isn't the bar. We're looking for people curious about what's happening below that layer, in the hardware and systems themselves. **Benefits** * Industry competitive pay * Restricted Stock Units in a fast growing, well\-funded technology company * Health insurance package options that include HDHP and PPO, vision, and dental for you and your dependents * Employer contributions to HSA accounts * Paid Parental Leave * Paid life insurance, short\-term and long\-term disability * Teladoc * 401(k) with a 100% match up to 4% of salary * Generous paid time off and holiday schedule * Cell phone reimbursement * Tuition reimbursement * Subscription to the Calm app * MetLife Legal * Company paid commuter benefit; $300 per month **Compensation** Compensation will be paid in the range of $140,000 to $165,000\. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant's education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer - Trust and Safety
jobs.description: #### **What's in it for you?** Ready to make a serious impact? Millions of people already rely on Calendly, and we're still in the midst of exciting product growth — it's a fantastic time to join us. Everything you'll work on here will accelerate your career to the next level. If you want to learn, grow, and do the best work of your life alongside the best people you've ever worked with, then we hope you'll consider allowing Calendly to be a part of your professional journey. **About the team \& opportunity** Millions of people use Calendly to book meetings, and most of that happens on public booking pages where anyone with a link can schedule time. That openness is what makes Calendly easy to use, and it's also what makes it a target. The **Trust \& Safety** team keeps Calendly safe without slowing anyone down. We protect everyone who interacts with Calendly: the hosts who share their links, the invitees who book with them, and the email and SMS providers and partners who rely on us to send responsibly. Our work covers three areas: preventing and responding to abuse, protecting the deliverability and compliance of the messages Calendly sends, and keeping messaging costs predictable as the platform grows. Most of our problems are adversarial. We often can't rely on knowing who someone is, so we judge behavior, patterns, and content instead. Attackers change tactics all the time, so we build signals that last from one attack to the next. And we take false positives seriously, because blocking a real customer costs more than letting a spammer through. Engineers work closely with our Trust \& Safety Operations team, who see abuse first and shape what we build. In this role, you will report to the Engineering Manager for the Trust \& Safety team. **A day in the life of a Full Stack Engineer at Calendly** On a typical day, you will be working on: * Building and improving the systems that detect and stop abuse across sign\-up, booking, and messaging, such as spam, phishing, bots, and fraudulent SMS traffic. * Improving the reliability, deliverability, and compliance of the email and SMS notifications Calendly sends. * Shipping new detection carefully: measuring how it performs on real traffic before it acts on accounts, and weighing false positives against false negatives. * Responding to active abuse, including during on\-call, by stopping the damage fast, then replacing quick fixes with durable ones. * Building tools that help our Trust \& Safety Operations team review accounts faster and understand why the system took each action. * Partnering with Product, Operations, and Data to define requirements and measure the impact of what we We seek highly qualified candidates committed to a career in teaching, mentoring and research excellence in the department of Electrical Engineering. jobs.title: Senior Principal Software Engineer, Cloud Architecture
jobs.description: **Who we are** At CarGurus (NASDAQ: CARG), our mission is to give people the power to reach their destination. We started as a small team of developers determined to bring trust and transparency to car shopping. Since then, our history of innovation and go\-to\-market acceleration has driven industry\-leading growth. In fact, we're the largest and fastest\-growing automotive marketplace, and we've been profitable for over 15 years. **What we do** The market is evolving, and we are too, moving the entire automotive journey online and guiding our customers through every step. That includes everything from the sale of an old car to the financing, purchase, and delivery of a new one. Today, tens of millions of consumers visit CarGurus.com each month, and \~30,000 dealerships use our products. But they're not the only ones who love CarGurus—our employees do, too. We have a people\-first culture that fosters kindness, collaboration, and innovation, and empowers our Gurus with tools to fuel their career growth. Disrupting a trillion\-dollar industry requires fresh and diverse perspectives. Come join us for the ride! **Role overview** CarGurus is hiring a Senior Principal Software Engineer to be the hands\-on cloud architect within our Engineering Platform (EP) organization. We have finished a large lift\-and\-shift to AWS. The next step is helping 300\+ engineers build cloud\-native, SaaS\-ready software that is resilient, secure, and built to scale. In this role you will work hands\-on, side by side with the teams doing the work. You won't belong to a single squad. Instead, you will go wherever the hardest system and cloud architecture problems are, partner with teams to solve them, and leave behind patterns that others can reuse. **What you'll do** * Own system architecture as it connects to cloud architecture: shape how services, data, and jobs map onto AWS, and lay out practical paths from old architectures to new ones. * Partner with Product Engineering teams on their architecture problems. This may mean working closely with a team for a period of time to prototype, help unblock them, and leave behind an architecture they can own. * Act as the technical lead for our AWS relationship. You'll work with AWS solutions architects on service guidance and roadmaps. * Build proofs of concept and reference implementations in code, using Terraform, Python, Java, and similar tools, that teams can build on and that can evolve into standard patterns over time. Explain the trade\-offs behind each one. * Work with Cloud Enablement to advance AWS self\-service and guardrails: HCP Terraform workflows, Sentinel policies, IAM, and account and sandbox strategy. * Design architecture with cost in mind across cloud and AI spend, including attribution, tagging, and controls. * Lead architecture for SaaS maturity and compliance readiness, covering disaster recovery and business continuity, security, performance, dependency ownership, and standardizing our cloud accounts. * Guide architecture for agentic workloads on AWS, such as AgentCore Gateway, Bedrock, OAuth, and machine\-to\-machine identity, in partnership with InfoSec. * Collaborate with our Technical Leadership Team to shape technical direction. Record decisions in ADRs and RFCs and spread them across teams. * Mentor senior engineers and run workshops on cloud\-native best practices. **What you'll bring** * 10\+ years of software engineering experience, including 5\+ years designing and running production systems on AWS. * A software engineer first: you write production\-quality code in at least one of Java, Python, TypeScript, or Go. * Fluent in infrastructure as code with Terraform. * Deep AWS expertise across networking (VPC, Transit Gateway, VPC Lattice), IAM, serverless (Lambda, Batch, API Gateway), containers (EKS), and managed data stores. * Focused on security: least\-privilege IAM, OAuth2/OIDC, and designing for compliance. * Bring a forward\-deployed mindset: you would rather build the prototype than only review the design, and you can still write the think paper that sets direction. * Lead through influence and collaboration without ego. You build trust with engineers, managers, and executives, both inside and outside your own organization. * Write clearly and can explain technical trade\-offs to technical and non\-technical audiences. * Think about cost: you treat cost efficiency as a design requirement. **Working at CarGurus** We reward our Gurus' curiosity and passion with best\-in\-class benefits and compensation, including equity for all employees, both when they start and as they continue to grow with us. Our career development and corporate giving programs, as well as our employee resource groups (ERGs) and communities, help people build connections while making an impact in personally meaningful ways. A flexible hybrid model and robust time off policies encourage work\-life balance and individual well\-being. Thoughtful perks like daily free lunch, a new car discount, meditation and fitness apps, commuting cost coverage, and more help our people create space for what matters most in their personal and professional lives. CarGurus may require in\-person interviews as part of our hiring process, particularly for positions based in our Boston and Dublin offices. Candidates selected for an in\-person interview will be notified in advance. Please be aware that travel expenses are the responsibility of the candidate. **We welcome all** CarGurus strives to be a place to which people can bring the ultimate expression of themselves and their potential—starting with our hiring process. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, or sexual orientation. We foster an inclusive environment that values people for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. That's why we hope you'll apply even if you don't check every box listed in the job description. We also encourage you to tell your recruiter if you require accommodations to participate in our hiring process due to a disability so we can provide the appropriate support. We want to know what only you can bring to CarGurus. \#LI\-Hybrid

jobs.title: Field Service Engineer - PET/CT
jobs.description: This Field Service Engineer will service the Southern California region with a focus on PET/CT cameras. **CAREER LEVELING:** This job description applies to all Field Service Engineer career levels, FSE I through FSE IV. Candidates are placed at the appropriate level based on a combination of relevant experience, demonstrated technical skill and proficiency, equipment and modality specialization, certifications and training, troubleshooting capabilities, and overall scope of expertise. Individual level and title will be determined based on the candidate’s qualifications and the needs of the organization. **POSITION SUMMARY:** The **Field Service Engineer** is responsible for the installation, integration, calibration, preventative maintenance, troubleshooting, repair, and performance optimization of advanced diagnostic and molecular imaging equipment, including PET, PET/CT, CT, SPECT, and SPECT/CT systems from a variety of manufacturers. The FSE applied knowledge of electronics, mechanics, instrumentation, computer systems, software, optics, control systems, and imaging technology to diagnose equipment issues, develop technical solutions, and ensure systems operate safely, accurately, and in accordance with manufacturer, company, and regulatory standards. Field Service Engineer serves as a technical resource to customers, providing responsive service and developing strong customer relationships to support customer satisfaction, contract stability, and continued business success. **ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:** To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each of the following essential functions satisfactorily. * Install, service, maintain, calibrate, troubleshoot, modify, upgrade, and repair diagnostic and molecular imaging equipment at customer locations, including PET, PET/CT, CT, SPECT, and SPECT/CT systems. * Perform system installations and integrations using technical expertise and independent judgment to ensure equipment is properly configured for the customer’s clinical and technical environment. * Diagnose and resolve equipment failures by evaluating electronic, mechanical, software, networking, control, and imaging\-system components; determine root cause, implement corrective action, and verify system performance following repair. * Perform preventive maintenance, testing, validation, refurbishment, and system modifications in accordance with manufacturer specifications and company standards. * Evaluate system performance and troubleshoot components and subsystems, including circuit boards, microprocessors, power systems, sensors, detectors, motors, gantry components, patient tables, and related equipment. * Analyze system data and performance trends to identify technical issues and optimize equipment reliability, safety, and image quality. * Provide technical consultation, support, and training to customers regarding equipment operation, system performance, software functionality, maintenance requirements, and technical concerns. * Respond to customer service needs promptly and provide on\-site support consistent with contractual requirements and customer expectations. * Maintain regular communication with customers to assess satisfaction, address unresolved concerns, and support strong customer relationships. * Communicate effectively with customers, team members, leadership, technical support, and other internal departments; share relevant customer feedback, competitive information, equipment opportunities, and potential sales leads as appropriate. * Independently manage, prioritize, and schedule assigned service activities to meet customer needs, internal requirements, and contractual response commitments. * Accurately document service activity, including equipment condition, troubleshooting performed, repairs completed, parts used or recommended, modifications, technical findings, and required follow\-up. * Ensure all service activities comply with applicable FDA, ISO, radiation safety, manufacturer, Quality Management System (QMS), Quality Management Procedures (QMI), Work Instructions (WI), and other company or regulatory requirements. * Complete and maintain required technical, OEM, safety, and compliance training and certifications for supported systems. * Maintain assigned tools, test equipment, documentation, parts, and other resources necessary to perform field service responsibilities. * Maintain established performance standards and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). * Remain current on imaging technology, electronics, software, system architecture, equipment upgrades, and company products and services through ongoing technical education and training. * Provide technical assistance and knowledge\-sharing to other Field Service Engineers and internal teams as appropriate. * Perform other duties as assigned. **Minimum Qualifications**: * Associate degree in Electronics, Biomedical Equipment Technology, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline OR equivalent military training (BMET Program) * 2\+ years of experience servicing diagnostic or molecular imaging equipment * Demonstrated knowledge of electronics, electrical systems, mechanical systems, computer hardware/software, networking, instrumentation, and diagnostic troubleshooting. * Ability to read and interpret technical documentation, schematics, diagrams, service manuals, specifications, and system data. * Valid Driver’s License **Preferred Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Biomedical Equipment Technology, or a related discipline **The Perks!** * Medical, Dental, Vision Insurance with HSA/FSA options * Company\-Paid Life Insurance, AD\&D, Short\-Term and Long\-Term Disability Coverage * Additional supplemental insurance options * Paid Time Off – Including Vacation, Sick, and Holiday Time * 401(k) with employer match * Employee Discount Program * Employee Assistance Program * Wellness Program * Professional License fee reimbursement * Employee Referral Program * Continuing Education \& Tuition reimbursement **Physical Demands:** * Must be able to lift/push/pull up to 75 pounds * Ability to stand, bend, kneel, crouch, and work in and around large imaging equipment in confined spaces * 40% standing, 20% walking, 40% sitting **Working Conditions:** * Work is performed at hospitals, clinics, imaging centers, and physician offices. Work may also be performed at a home office. * Up to 75% travel may be required in varying weather and driving conditions. Travel may be extensive and include overnights depending on customer needs. **Occupational Exposure:** Work involves exposure to potentially dangerous and hazardous materials. Work involves moderate exposure to unusual elements such as extreme temperatures, dirt, dust, fumes, odors, loud noises, and confined spaces. **Occupational Accommodations Statement:** The physical demands and work environment characteristics described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. *The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. They are representative to those knowledge, skills, and abilities that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the role.* ***An Equal Opportunity Employer*** *We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability, genetic information, or any other status protected by law or regulation. It is our intention that all qualified applicants are given equal opportunity and that selection decisions be based on job\-related*

jobs.title: AI Engineer / Search Engineer
jobs.description: **Overview** Certified Technical Experts, Inc. (CTE) is seeking an experienced **AI Engineer / Search Engineer** to support the Federal Labor Relations Authority’s Intelligent Document Processing and AI\-Enabled Search initiative. The project will modernize FLRA’s Microsoft SharePoint repository containing **PDF documents** into a structured, searchable knowledge repository supporting OCR, document classification, metadata extraction, relationship mapping, semantic search, vector search, natural\-language queries, and source\-grounded responses. The AI Engineer / Search Engineer will be responsible for designing, implementing, tuning, testing, and supporting the AI and enterprise search components of the solution. The role will focus on **Azure AI Search, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Document Intelligence, semantic and vector search, embeddings, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), metadata\-driven retrieval, document classification, and source\-grounded question answering** within FLRA’s approved Microsoft 365 GCC/Azure environment. **Key Responsibilities** * Design and implement AI\-enabled search capabilities for FLRA’s bargaining unit records. * Configure and optimize **Azure AI Search** indexes, fields, filters, analyzers, semantic configurations, and vector search. * Implement keyword, Boolean, full\-text, metadata, semantic, and vector\-based search capabilities. * Develop and support **natural\-language question answering** and source\-grounded responses using Azure OpenAI or other approved AI services. * Implement **Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG)** patterns using FLRA documents, extracted metadata, and search indexes. * Generate, store, and manage embeddings used for semantic and vector retrieval. * Ensure AI\-generated responses cite or reference the originating Government documents. * Support document classification, metadata extraction, and confidence scoring using Azure AI Document Intelligence and related AI capabilities. * Develop logic for identifying and maintaining relationships among bargaining unit records, including amendments, consolidations, reorganizations, revocations, successorship determinations, and related cases. * Develop and tune relevance\-ranking strategies to improve search accuracy and usability. * Configure metadata filters and structured retrieval using FLRA\-required fields such as agency, bargaining unit, labor organization, case number, docket number, certification type, dates, region, and location. * Support human\-in\-the\-loop validation workflows for reviewing AI\-generated classifications and metadata. * Develop evaluation methods for search quality, retrieval relevance, classification accuracy, metadata extraction, and AI response quality. * Tune prompts, retrieval strategies, chunking approaches, embeddings, and search configurations based on testing and Government feedback. * Implement guardrails to ensure AI responses remain grounded in authorized FLRA content and do not generate unsupported information. * Support automated ingestion and indexing of newly received documents. * Work closely with the Azure Platform \& Integration Engineer to integrate AI/search services with SharePoint, APIs, Azure services, and application components. * Participate in system integration testing, UAT, defect resolution, production deployment, monitoring, and performance tuning. * Maintain technical documentation covering AI models, prompts, search configurations, index schemas, evaluation methods, and operational procedures. * Follow Federal security requirements, including CUI protection, FedRAMP\-authorized services, least\-privilege access, and NIST SP 800\-53 controls. **Required Skills** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or related field, or equivalent professional experience. * **5\+ years of software, search, AI, machine learning, or data engineering experience.** * **3\+ years of hands\-on experience with enterprise search, AI/ML, or cloud\-based AI
