jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Description** Chooch helps build and run the best Computer Vision AI applications that make cameras intelligent, enhancing productivity \& revenues, while reducing operational costs. Chooch has been named a leading computer vision platform by IDC. **Role Description** We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer (US\-based) to join our team. This is a full\-time, hybrid role with frequent hands\-on experience with customer projects in the Bay Area. The Machine Learning Engineer will be responsible for the successful design, accuracy, and backbone behind our Computer Vision AI applications. This includes data preparation, training, configuring neural networks, deploying networks in real customer locations, and refining computer vision algorithms for healthcare, manufacturing, and retail customers. This role requires frequent interaction with technical and non\-technical customers while working closely within our solutions engineering teams. The Machine Learning Engineering role has opportunity to grow, lead technical projects, and improve current processes while providing meaningful feedback to our product and solutions teams. **Product Description** Chooch AI is a computer vision platform that helps hospitals automate supply room monitoring and inventory management. Using fixed cameras and AI, the platform continuously tracks supplies in storage areas and updates on\-hand counts in real time. When inventory levels fall below defined thresholds, replenishment orders are automatically generated and sent to ERP systems, eliminating manual counts and barcode scanning. Hospitals using Chooch AI significantly reduce critical stockouts, optimize inventory levels, and improve supply chain staff productivity. By turning supply rooms into self\-managing systems, Chooch AI enables clinical and supply chain teams to focus more time on patient care. Responsibilities/What you'll do at Chooch: * Design, train and fine\-tune models for object detection, classification, segmentation, tracking and anomaly detection on real customer video and images. * Adapt pretrained and foundation models (YOLO\-family detectors, ViTs, CLIP\-style and vision\-language models) to new customer use cases with limited labeled data. * Own data pipelines end to end: curation, labeling guidelines, augmentation, synthetic data, and dataset versioning. * Optimize models for production and edge hardware using quantization, pruning, distillation, ONNX export and TensorRT, hitting agreed latency and accuracy targets. * Build evaluation suites with clear metrics (mAP, precision/recall, false\-alarm rates per camera\-hour) and catch regressions before release. * Deploy and monitor models in production, diagnose drift and failure cases, and close the loop with retraining. * Work with product, solutions engineers and customers to turn vague requirements into measurable model specs. * Write clean, tested, reviewed code and contribute to shared ML tooling. Nice to have * Experience with vision\-language models (CLIP, LLaVA\-style models) or open\-vocabulary detection. * Multi\-object tracking and video analytics (re\-identification, action recognition, temporal models). * Few\-shot learning, active learning, or synthetic data generation for low\-data domains. * MLOps tooling: MLflow or Weights \& Biases, Kubernetes, Triton Inference Server, CI/CD for models. * Domain experience in Healthcare, retail and supply chain, manufacturing inspection, workplace safety or video surveillance. Key Components * Model Development and Optimization: Design, develop, and optimize machine learning models for computer vision applications. * Data Management: Collaborate with ML engineers to ensure the collection, processing, and maintenance of high\-quality datasets necessary for model training and testing. * Algorithm Implementation: Implement state\-of\-the\-art computer vision algorithms to improve system accuracy and performance in real\-world scenarios. * Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Work closely within the solutions engineering team to integrate machine learning models into the broader product and systems. * On\-Site Travel and Field Testing: Many of our projects are live deployments with major fortune 500 customers – testing new, innovative ML technologies. Traveling on site is sometimes needed to see the environment, test in the real\-world, and ensure the technology is operating as expected. * Performance Evaluation: Regularly evaluate the performance of computer vision models, using both qualitative and quantitative methods, and iterate to enhance accuracy and efficiency. * Research and Innovation: Understanding of the latest developments in machine learning and computer vision, applying innovative approaches and technologies to solve complex challenges. * Stakeholder Engagement: Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into effective technical solutions. * Problem\-Solving: Address and troubleshoot complex problems that arise during the development and deployment of computer vision systems. The ideal candidate should be deeply passionate about machine learning and its real\-world applications, particularly in improving and leveraging state\-of\-the\-art neural networks to make an impact. **Requirements** * 3–5 years of industry experience building ML systems, with at least 2 years focused on computer vision. * BS or MS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Math or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * Strong Python and hands\-on experience with PyTorch (or TensorFlow) for training and debugging deep learning models. * Shipped at least one computer vision model to production, and can explain the trade\-offs made along the way. * Solid grasp of CNN and transformer architectures for detection, segmentation and classification. * Experience with OpenCV and image/video processing: decoding streams, preprocessing, augmentation. * Working knowledge of model optimization for inference (ONNX, TensorRT, quantization or similar). * Comfortable with Docker, Git, Linux and training on GPUs in a cloud environment (AWS/Azure). * Sound ML fundamentals: loss functions, overfitting, class imbalance, evaluation metrics and experiment design. * Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining model behavior to non\-ML stakeholders. **Benefits** Chooch offers extensive benefits including health, dental, vision insurance, 401K with 3% match, extensive PTO, and life insurance policies included.

jobs.title: Senior Network Engineer
jobs.description: **About CloudCover** CloudCover is a global IT service provider specializing in third\-party maintenance (TPM) and IT lifecycle management. Backed by in\-house L1–L3 engineers, OEM subject\-matter experts, and a global field service network, CloudCover helps partners and their customers simplify complex infrastructure operations. Its CoverIT™ platform unifies third\-party maintenance, professional and managed services, monitoring, contracts, assets, and ticketing into a single operating model across desktop and data center environments, while MonitorIT™ adds AI\-enabled proactive monitoring. A SOC 2–certified organization with 24/7 global support, CloudCover enables partners to deliver white\-labeled, enterprise\-grade services that reduce cost, improve uptime, and drive predictable recurring revenue. For more information, visit cloudcover.it. **Job Description:** CloudCover has a customer seeking a Senior Network Engineer with Pharma background for a 6\-12 month Hybrid position located in Hampton, NJ. This is a Hybrid, full\-time engagement: on\-site in the Hampton, NJ office Monday through Thursday, and remote on Fridays, with availability during core Eastern Time business hours. We’re seeking an experienced Senior Network Engineer to design, build, and optimize secure Azure cloud network infrastructure for life sciences clients. Engaged as a consultant for a six\-month, full\-time hybrid engagement based in the customers Hampton, NJ office, you will lead hands\-on delivery of enterprise\-grade hybrid and cloud networking, including landing zone connectivity, hybrid integration, network security, and automation. You will work alongside the delivery leads and client IT teams in regulated (GxP) environments where documentation, change control, and audit readiness matter as much as technical execution. This role requires direct and prior experience working within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or broader life sciences industry. Candidates without life sciences experience will not meet the requirements for this position. **Responsibilities** * **Architecture \& Design:** Design and implement Azure network topologies (hub\-and\-spoke and/or Virtual WAN), including VNets, subnetting, peering, user\-defined routes, and IP address management aligned to Azure landing zone best practices. * **Hybrid Connectivity:** Build and maintain ExpressRoute and site\-to\-site/point\-to\-site VPN connectivity between on\-premises data centers, lab and manufacturing sites, and Azure, including BGP routing and redundancy design. * **Network Security:** Configure and manage Azure Firewall and/or third\-party NVAs, NSGs and ASGs, Application Gateway with WAF, Azure Front Door, DDoS protection, and Private Endpoints/Private Link to enforce segmentation and zero\-trust principles. * **DNS \& Traffic Management:** Design hybrid name resolution using Azure Private DNS and DNS Private Resolver; implement load balancing and traffic routing for business\-critical applications. * **Infrastructure as Code:** Develop and maintain reusable network deployments using Terraform and/or Bicep, integrated with Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines. * **Monitoring \& Operations:** Implement network monitoring and diagnostics using Network Watcher, Azure Monitor, and Log Analytics; troubleshoot connectivity, latency, and routing issues and drive root\-cause resolution. * **Migration Support:** Plan and execute network readiness for workload migrations to Azure, including cutover planning, maintenance windows, and rollback procedures. * **Governance \& Compliance:** Apply Azure Policy and security baselines; produce design specifications, configuration records, and test evidence to support infrastructure qualification and change control in GxP environments. * **Knowledge Transfer:** Create runbooks, network diagrams, and as\-built documentation, and transition operational ownership to client IT teams by engagement close. **Required Qualifications** * 8\+ years of enterprise network engineering experience, including 4\+ years designing and supporting Azure networking in production. * Deep hands\-on expertise with ExpressRoute, VPN Gateway, VNet peering, UDRs, and BGP routing. * Strong experience with Azure Firewall and/or enterprise firewall platforms (e.g., Palo Alto, Fortinet, Check Point), including NVA deployments in Azure. * Proficiency with Terraform and/or Bicep, plus scripting in PowerShell, Azure CLI, or Python. * Solid understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, load balancing, network segmentation, and zero\-trust architecture. * Proven ability to work independently as a contractor, managing your own time and deliverables with minimal supervision. * Able to work on\-site in Hampton, NJ four days per week (Monday through Thursday) for the full engagement. * Authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship. **Preferred Qualifications** * Microsoft Certified: Azure Network Engineer Associate (AZ\-700\); Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ\-305\) or Azure Administrator (AZ\-104\). * Cisco CCNP/CCIE, Palo Alto PCNSE, or equivalent networking certifications. * Experience in life sciences or other regulated industries, including familiarity with GxP, computer system validation (CSV), and 21 CFR Part 11 considerations. * Experience with Azure Virtual WAN, SD\-WAN integration, Microsoft Entra ID, and Microsoft Defender for Cloud. * Background supporting connectivity for laboratory, manufacturing, or clinical systems. **Key Competencies** * **Technical Ownership:** Takes end\-to\-end accountability for designs, from whiteboard through deployment and documentation. * **Security Mindset:** Builds with least privilege, segmentation, and auditability as defaults, not afterthoughts. * **Problem Solving:** Diagnoses complex, cross\-domain connectivity issues quickly and methodically. * **Client Communication:** Explains technical trade\-offs clearly to client IT leaders, quality teams, and non\-technical stakeholders. * **Documentation Discipline:** Produces clear, accurate, inspection\-ready artifacts suitable for regulated environments. **Work Environment** * Hybrid, full\-time engagement: on\-site in the Hampton, NJ office Monday through Thursday, and remote on Fridays, with availability during core Eastern Time business hours. * Occasional evening or weekend work may be needed for scheduled maintenance windows and cutovers. * As an independent contractor, you determine how the work is performed to meet agreed deliverables, supply your own computer and remote workspace, and are responsible for your own taxes, insurance, and benefits. Client system access is provisioned per client security requirements. * Engagement terms, rate, and deliverables are governed by a separate consulting agreement and statement of work.

jobs.title: Staff Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description: Collectors is the leading creator of innovative technology that provides value\-added services for collectors worldwide. We grade, authenticate, vault, and sell millions of record\-setting collectibles, all while modernizing and digitalizing the process to further our mission of helping collectors pursue their passions. We’re always on the lookout for talented people to join our growing team. Our services span collectible trading cards, autographs, comic books, coins, video games, event tickets, and memorabilia. Our subsidiaries include PSA, PCGS, Beckett, SGC, and Card Ladder. Since our founding in 1986, we have graded and authenticated millions of items. We employ more than 3000 people across our headquarters in Santa Ana, California and offices in New Jersey, Texas, Florida, Japan, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Canada, Mexico, Germany, the UK, and France. As part of our interview process, we request that candidates have their cameras on during video interviews. This helps foster meaningful conversation and allows us to create an experience that closely resembles our standard working environment. Certain interview steps may take place by phone. For remote roles, and at our discretion, candidates may be asked to participate in an on\-site interview as part of the final stages of the process. We understand there may be occasional circumstances requiring accommodation and are happy to discuss them as needed. Your recruiter will be able to clarify expectations and answer any questions you have. We're transforming the collecting experience with technology that brings authentication, grading, and trading into the modern era. Our products are equalizing the playing field by providing tools that make complex research analytics (including pricing, scarcity reports, and historic sales data) accessible to every collector, old or new. Our engineering mission is to democratize technology while promoting innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning throughout the organization. We're looking for a Staff Applied AI Engineer to join the Applied AI function at Collectors. This is an embedded, build\-first role with portfolio\-level ownership: you'll own a full business domain, decide which problems in it are worth solving with AI, and build and ship the solutions end\-to\-end. You'll still prototype fast and prove value in business terms, but your impact compounds beyond your own builds: the patterns you establish, the assets you make reusable, and the roadmap you shape become the way the whole team ships in your lane. This is not a traditional software engineering role, and it's not an architecture\-only role either. We're looking for a product\-minded builder who leads through shipped work: someone who can walk into an unmapped business domain, earn the trust of its leaders, build the first few wins personally, and then turn those wins into a durable portfolio. You'll report to the Head of Applied AI. Remote or hybrid candidates will also be considered. We believe that there is significant value in in\-person collaboration. ### **What You'll Do** * Own a business domain, not just a use case. You'll be accountable for the AI opportunity across an entire lane (for example Operations, Marketplace, or Finance): mapping the workflows, sizing the opportunities, and deciding what gets built, in what order, and why. * Build the hardest use cases yourself. You spend the majority of your time hands\-on. You take the first, riskiest, or most technically demanding builds in your lane from prototype through production, adoption, and measured impact. * Turn one\-off wins into reusable patterns. You notice when three builds share a shape, extract the common asset (a connector, an eval harness, a workflow pattern), and make it something every builder on the team can pick up. * Define success up front and prove it at portfolio level. You instrument outcomes before you build, and you can stand in front of the domain's leadership and account for the cumulative value your lane has delivered. * Design for earned autonomy. You build agents with the traces, evals, and human\-in\-the\-loop gates that let them graduate to more autonomy on evidence, not on elapsed time, and you help set that standard for others. * Operate as a power user of frontier AI. Use Claude, OpenAI, and our orchestration platform daily as your primary tools, and bring a strong, current point of view on models, harnesses, and tooling that informs the team's platform choices. * Win trust at the leadership level. Your stakeholders are function leaders, not just operators. You navigate competing priorities, secure sponsorship, and keep skeptical partners engaged through delivery. * Multiply the builders around you. You review designs and code, unblock senior and mid\-level engineers, raise the hiring bar as an interviewer, and make the people around you measurably better. * Build production grade applications around AI systems. You can design and implement the application layer a  you hold yourself accountable for whether the portfolio moved the numbers, not just whether things shipped. * A force multiplier. You have a track record of making other engineers better through review, mentorship, patterns, or tooling, and people you've worked with would say so unprompted. * A clear communicator. You're equally comfortable with operators on the floor, engineers in review, and executives in a readout, and you can carry a room that started out skeptical. * A continuous learner. You believe staying excellent in this field means never standing still. You actively track the latest models, tools, and techniques as they ship, form your own view on what matters, and bring the best of it back to the team. Salary Range: *The salary range for this position is* $165,848\-$269,259\. *Actual compensation on this range varies based on a variety of non\-discriminatory factors, including location, job level, experience, and skill set. This role may be eligible for bonuses, commissions, or other forms of compensation, please ask your recruiter for details.* Reasons To Join Us: * Health Insurance: All full\-time employees are eligible to enroll in Medical, Dental, and Vision * Additional Benefits: Full\-time employees are eligible for fertility, commuter, and educational assistance benefits * 401(K) Matching Plan: We are proud to offer a competitive 401k matching plan to our employees to support their future financial goals * Vacation: All salaried employees are eligible for flexible time\-off. * Holiday Pay: All regular, full\-time employees are eligible for ten company paid holidays * Employee Discounts: Employees receive discounts on select grading services for approved submissions * Flexible Hours: Many of our teams offer flexible schedules with varying shifts and will work with you to accommodate your needs * Fun Working Environment: Our team members are invited to participate in celebrations, holiday events, and team building activities Additional Resources: Collectors Tech Blog , PSA * Collectors uses e\-Verify to validate your ability to work legally in the United States. We are aware that there are instances where individuals are receiving job offers that fraudulently allege to be from Collectors or one of our business units. This type of fraud can be carried out through false websites, through fake e\-mails claiming to be from the company or through social media. We never ask for personal information such as your bank account, Social Security numbers or National IDs, nor do we send or request payments for the purchase of business\-related equipment. If you suspect fraud, please reach out to interviewfraud@collectors.com. *We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, national origin, gender, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital or parental status, disability, veteran status, or other class protected by applicable law. We believe that a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills will better service the diverse community of collectors we support.* *If you require an accommodation to apply or interview with us due to a disability or special need, please email* *interviewaccommodation@collectors.com.* *U.S. residents: for disclosures relating to personal information we collect during the employment application and recruitment process, please see our* *Privacy Notice for U.S. Applicants* *.* For New York Residents: In connection with hiring, Collectors Universe, Inc. uses an automated employment decision tool (Brighthire) to assist in evaluating candidates. Collectors Universe, Inc. began using this tool in October 2026\. In accordance with NYC Local Law 144, a summary of the most recent independent bias audit of this tool is available from Brighthire . jobs.title: AI App Lead
jobs.description: Confiz is seeking an AI App Lead in Denver, CO. As the AI Lead you own both the architecture and the hands\-on delivery of AI\-powered applications built on Databricks, Python, and React. You set technical direction for a team of data, ML, and full\-stack engineers while still writing production code yourself. You will design LLM, RAG, and agentic systems on the Databricks Lakehouse, expose them through Python services, and deliver them to users through React front ends. You build secure, scalable, cost\-efficient production solutions, and you are accountable for making sure the code matches the architecture. **Responsibilities** * Leads the end\-to\-end architecture of AI solutions, including LLM applications, RAG pipelines, and agentic workflows, from data ingestion to the user interface. * Designs and builds data and ML pipelines on Databricks using Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, MLflow, Databricks Workflows, and Mosaic AI (Model Serving, Vector Search, Agent Framework). * Builds and reviews production Python services (FastAPI or similar) that expose models, retrieval, and agents through secure, well\-documented REST APIs. * Architects and contributes to React (TypeScript) front ends for AI experiences, such as chat interfaces, streaming responses, source citations, and human\-in\-the\-loop review screens. * Selects LLM providers and models (e.g., Databricks\-hosted foundation models, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic) and retrieval options based on quality, latency, cost, and data\-governance fit. * Establishes LLMOps and MLOps practices: model and prompt versioning, automated evaluation, tracing, monitoring, drift detection, and retraining. * Produces architecture and design artifacts for complex AI applications and is accountable for ensuring the delivered code meets them. * Leads code and architecture reviews, and mentors engineers on RAG, agent design, prompt engineering, and evaluation. * Ensures solutions meet security, privacy, and compliance standards, including Unity Catalog access controls, PII handling, guardrails, audit trails, and responsible AI practices. * Identifies and automates fixes for recurring issues to improve the operational stability and cost efficiency of AI workloads. * Translates business requirements into technical architecture in partnership with product owners and stakeholders, clearly communicating trade\-offs to both technical and non\-technical audiences. **Requirements** * 10\+ years of software engineering experience, including 3\+ years designing and delivering AI/ML systems in production and hands\-on work with generative AI. * Demonstrated experience leading engineers and setting technical direction, while remaining hands\-on in code. * Advanced Python: production services, async programming, testing, packaging, and PySpark. * Hands\-on Databricks Lakehouse experience: Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, MLflow, Databricks Workflows, and Spark\-based processing; experience with Model Serving and Vector Search. * Strong React with TypeScript: component architecture, state management, API integration, and streaming or real\-time UIs. * Deep understanding of LLMs, RAG architectures, agentic systems, prompt engineering, LLM evaluation, and model fine\-tuning. * Proven experience designing scalable distributed systems, REST APIs, and microservices, with a solid grasp of system design and security principles. * Strong SQL, data modeling, ETL/ELT pipeline design, and data governance. * Experience with Azure, AWS, or GCP AI and data services. * Hands\-on infrastructure\-as\-code experience (Terraform, Bicep, or CloudFormation), including Databricks Asset Bundles (DABs) for versioning and deploying jobs, pipelines, and model serving endpoints through CI/CD. * Proficient in CI/CD, Git, automated testing, and the full software development life cycle. * Strong stakeholder communication: able to translate architecture into business value for technical and non\-technical audiences. **Nice to Have** * Databricks certifications, such as Generative AI Engineer Associate, Machine Learning Professional, or Data Engineer Professional. * Experience with agent and orchestration frameworks (LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, DSPy) and the Model Context Protocol (MCP). * Experience with vector databases beyond Databricks Vector Search, such as Pinecone, Weaviate, or pgvector. * Exposure to Docker and Kubernetes. * Experience with Next.js, design systems, and accessible UI development. * Prior experience in client\-facing, pre\-sales, or solutioning capacity. * Experience in a regulated industry such as financial services. We have a global team of amazing individuals working on highly innovative enterprise projects \& products. Our customer base includes Fortune 100 retail and CPG companies, leading store chains, fast growth fintech, and multiple Silicon Valley startups. What makes Confiz stand out is our focus on processes and culture. Confiz is ISO 9001:2015 (QMS), ISO 27001:2022 (ISMS), ISO 20000\-1:2018 (ITSM) and ISO 14001:2015 (EMS) Certified. We have a vibrant culture of learning via collaboration and making workplace fun. People who work with us work with cutting\-edge technologies while contributing success to the company as well as to themselves. To know more about Confiz Limited, visit https://www.linkedin.com/company/confiz/

jobs.title: Associate Director of Legal Data Analytics
jobs.description: **Associate Director of Legal Data Analytics** **Contact Discovery Services, LLC** Location: Remote Start Date: Negotiable A leading eDiscovery technology and consulting firm headquartered in Washington, DC is looking for an Associate Director of Legal Data Analytics in the eDiscovery space to focus on designing and implementing client\-specific solutions throughout the EDRM. The qualified candidate should have extensive experience with workflows supporting complex litigations and investigations. We take a consultative approach in working with our clients and managing cases and an extensive knowledge of the full EDRM, legal case management, and litigation lifecycle is important. This role demands a strong leader who can partner effectively with all levels of the organization. This position offers an excellent opportunity to play a foundational role in our expanding Advisory Services team, helping transform strategic vision into practical, defensible, client\-facing AI solutions within the eDiscovery industry. The ideal candidate will bring deep technical expertise in Generative AI and Machine Learning (ML), along with strong communication skills to effectively explain complex concepts to clients and internal stakeholders. **DUTIES OF THE POSITION:**#### **Technical Strategy \& Execution (Focus on ML \& Generative AI)** * Prompt Engineering \& Refinement: Lead the creation, testing, and continuous refinement of advanced Generative AI prompts and strategies (e.g., using tools like Relativity aiR/eDiscovery AI) to maximize accuracy, efficiency, and defensibility of outputs. * AI Auditability \& QC Protocol: Assist in the design and implement the technical framework for the AI Auditability Protocol, ensuring all ML and Generative AI outputs are transparently logged and auditable (including full prompt history and system parameters) for legal defensibility. * Model Optimization: Collaborate with the Engineering Team to integrate, test, and optimize both Generative and Non\-Generative AI models within our custom workflows, ensuring optimal performance and accurate results. * Development of New Technology: Analysis of off\-the\-shelf tools and make recommendations for new offerings. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Backend
jobs.description: Crazy Maple Studio is a rapidly growing entertainment and technology company with offices in the San Francisco Bay Area and Los Angeles. We specialize in mobile gaming, digital reading, and streaming, bringing together a global team to create innovative, engaging entertainment experiences for audiences worldwide. Our flagship platform, **ReelShort**, is a leading vertical streaming app in the U.S., with more than 8 million daily active users (DAU). Through its short\-form episodic content, ReelShort delivers compelling stories designed for today’s mobile\-first audiences. Our portfolio also includes **Chapters**, an interactive storytelling platform featuring immersive drama, fantasy, and romance experiences, and **My Fiction**, a platform dedicated to discovering and creating serialized romance stories. In 2025, Crazy Maple Studio was recognized as one of the **Global Most Loved Workplaces**, reflecting our commitment to fostering a culture that values creativity, innovation, collaboration, and employee well\-being. At Crazy Maple Studio, we’re passionate about pushing creative boundaries, exploring new possibilities in digital entertainment, and building experiences that connect with audiences around the world. **Position Overview:** We’re looking for builders. We don’t want ticket\-closers, and you won’t need a 40\-page spec. We’re putting together a small vanguard team, led directly by our executive team, with one mission: find out what AI can really do for entertainment, then ship it. ReelShort already entertains millions of people around the world. This team works outside the normal roadmap. You might take an idea on Monday, have a working demo by Friday, and put it in front of real users soon after. Some experiments will fail fast. The ones that work could become the company’s next big product. If you’ve been waiting for a place where your work gets seen, your judgment is trusted, and your growth isn’t capped by a ladder, this is it. **Why This Team:** * You work directly with the leadership. There are no layers. Your ideas get heard, and your work is seen by the person who makes the call. * Zero\-to\-one, every time. You build new things instead of maintaining old ones. * Help shape the stack. This is a brand\-new team with no legacy code. The tools we choose now are the ones we’ll scale on, and you’ll help choose them. * AI is the job, not a side project. You’ll use the newest models and tools every day, and you’ll be paid to explore what comes next. * Real ownership. You own what you build, from the first line of code to the user metrics after launch. * We invest in your future here. We offer sponsorship for strong performers. **Responsibilities:** * Design and build the backend systems behind new AI\-powered apps, from first prototype to serving real users at scale * Help choose and set up our stack, from languages and databases to deployment and CI/CD * Connect large language models (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or open\-source) to our products through a unified gateway, so we can switch models, control costs, and track spend by feature * Build the APIs our mobile apps depend on, along with the data foundations that show us what’s working * Own reliability for the services you build: monitoring, debugging, and fixing what breaks * Try new AI infrastructure and research, and turn what you learn into proposals **Requirements** * Around 2–5 years of experience building backend systems that real users depend on * Strong in at least one backend language, such as Python, TypeScript (Node.js), Go, or Java * Solid experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, or similar), plus caching and queues (Redis, SQS, Pub/Sub, or similar) * Deployed services on AWS or GCP using containers or serverless (ECS, Cloud Run, Lambda, or similar), and set up CI/CD (GitHub Actions or similar) * Kubernetes experience is not required. We keep infrastructure lean at this stage * Daily user of AI coding tools, with the drive to go much deeper * Fast learner who moves quickly and is comfortable with ambiguity * Self\-directed, low ego, and willing to do the unglamorous work a zero\-to\-one product needs * Hands\-on experience with LLM APIs, RAG, vector databases, or agent frameworks a plus * Experience with LLM gateways (such as LiteLLM) or tracking inference costs a plus * Infrastructure\-as\-code experience (Terraform, Pulumi, or similar) a plus * Experience with media pipelines or AI image, video, or audio generation a plus * Experience with machine learning or model fine\-tuning a plus * Additional language capability (Mandarin) a plus, though not required **Immigration Support** * H\-1B transfers welcome * On OPT or STEM OPT? We’ll register you for the H\-1B lottery * Green card sponsorship for strong performers * Legal and filing fees are covered by the company **How We Hire** Four steps, with no marathon onsite: * Intro call * Take\-home technical exercise * Technical interview * Conversation with our CEO Logistics * Five days a week, onsite in Sunnyvale, CA * Occasional evening availability to sync with teams in other time zones **Benefits** Crazy Maple Studio, Inc. provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. Our target salary range for this role is between **$120,000 and $150,000**. Actual starting salary within the range will depend on various considerations, including: work experience, skills, specializations, and training. This role also offers medical insurance, a 401(k) retirement plan, and a range of additional employee benefits and perks.

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: Crescent is a differentiated U.S. energy company committed to delivering value through a disciplined, returns\-driven growth through acquisition strategy and consistent return of capital. Our long\-life, balanced portfolio combines significant cash flow from stable production with a deep, high\-quality development inventory. Crescent is a top three producer in the Eagle Ford basin and a scaled operator in each of the Permian and Uinta basins. Crescent’s leadership is an experienced team of investment, financial and industry professionals that combines proven investment and operating expertise. For more than a decade, Crescent and our predecessors have executed on a consistent strategy focused on cash flow, risk management and returns. Through disciplined and accretive investments, we have successfully tripled the size of our company since going public in December 2021 while maintaining a strong balance sheet. Crescent Energy is seeking an AI Engineer to build practical AI solutions and help employees use them effectively. This role combines hands\-on software and AI engineering with employee education and community building. You will work with teams across engineering, operations, finance, and IT to turn business needs into secure, dependable applications, and to help colleagues learn where AI can add value in their work. The successful candidate enjoys both building and teaching: improving AI applications through code, testing, and evaluation while creating useful learning experiences that help employees adopt AI with confidence. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== **AI Engineering** ------------------ * Design, build, test, and support AI applications, assistants, and workflow automation for operational, technical, financial, and business needs. * Contribute to the shared AI platform and its specialized applications through software development, data and API integrations, user interfaces, and workflow capabilities. * Improve AI application behavior through clear instructions, prompt and context design, retrieval, tool use, and workflow logic. * Develop representative evaluation cases and regression checks; investigate failures and improve accuracy, source grounding, task completion, and reliability using test results and user feedback. * Compare model and application changes using consistent evaluation methods, considering quality, security, response time, and operating cost. * Integrate AI applications with approved databases, business systems, APIs, and document repositories while respecting access controls and data handling requirements. * Use validated data sources and deterministic calculations for numerical results, with AI supporting retrieval, explanation, and communication. * Apply sound engineering practices, including code review, automated testing, deployment pipelines, logging, monitoring, documentation, and support. **Employee Education and Community** ------------------------------------ * Build an active internal community of AI users and champions across business functions. * Plan and facilitate practical workshops, demonstrations, office hours, and learning sessions for employees with different levels of experience. * Create clear, reusable learning materials and examples based on real Crescent workflows, including how to review AI outputs and handle company information appropriately. * Gather employee questions, feedback, use cases, and adoption barriers; translate recurring needs into improvements to AI applications, evaluations, and learning resources. * Partner with subject matter experts and technical colleagues to keep training accurate, useful, and aligned with available capabilities. * Measure whether education and AI tools are helping employees, using participation, continued engagement, user feedback, and workflow outcomes. **Required Qualifications** =========================== * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, data science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * Professional software development experience building and supporting applications. * Hands\-on experience developing applications powered by large language models or other AI techniques. * Proficiency in a modern programming language and SQL, with experience working with structured and unstructured data. * Experience working with APIs, enterprise systems, and software testing. * Ability to explain technical ideas clearly, listen to business needs, and collaborate with technical and nontechnical colleagues. * Strong problem\-solving skills and sound judgment about AI limitations, data confidentiality, and when human review is needed. **Preferred Skills and Experience** =================================== * **Upstream oil and gas experience** , especially in production, drilling and completions, reservoir engineering, reserves and economics, or asset evaluation. * **Experience facilitating employee learning or an internal technical community** , including workshops, office hours, demonstrations, or champion networks. * **Experience improving AI application quality** through evaluation datasets, regression testing, error analysis, and structured comparison of changes. * Experience with retrieval\-augmented generation, AI agents, model tool use, or multi\-step workflows. * Familiarity with cloud hyper\-scalers, Snowflake or industry applications such as ARIES, WellView, or ProCount. * Experience delivering software or learning programs that achieve measurable improvements in productivity, analysis, decision\-making, or employee confidence. **What Success Looks Like** =========================== * Employees are able to find practical guidance, get help, and use approved AI capabilities with confidence. * Employee feedback and recurring business needs lead to clear improvements in AI applications and learning resources. * AI application changes are supported by evaluation evidence and reliable software practices. * AI solutions deliver useful, measurable improvements to Crescent workflows. *Crescent Energy is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender/pregnancy, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status or any other legally protected status. Crescent Energy is also committed to compliance with all fair employment practices regarding citizenship and immigration status. If you require accommodation to complete the application process, please let us know by contacting* *recruitment@crescentenergyco.com* *.*

jobs.title: DIRECTOR, HEAD OF AI ENGINEERING & AUTOMATION
jobs.description: **About Cresset** Cresset is a firm built by clients, for clients. As an independent, award\-winning multi\-family office and private investment firm, we are reimagining the way wealth is experienced. Our purpose is to help ensure that both wealth and life are fully optimized\*\*—integrated, intentional, and aligned with each client’s vision of success. We provide access to the caliber of talent, ideas, and investment opportunities typically available to the largest single\-family offices and institutions. Our approach is personalized, entrepreneurial, and client\-first. Cresset was built to endure. We are creating a 100\+ year firm—one focused on delivering an exceptional experience, not only for the families we serve but for the team that serves them. Recognized by Barron’s among the nation’s top multi\-family offices,\* Cresset is guided by long\-term relationships, shared success, and a belief that wealth should serve a life well lived. **Job Description** Cresset is seeking a highly execution\-oriented Head of AI Engineering \& Automation to lead the delivery, integration, and scaling of AI\-powered solutions across the firm. This role is responsible for operationalizing the firm’s AI strategy—translating prioritized initiatives into production\-grade workflows, systems, and tools that are embedded into how teams work every day. Reporting to the Chief Technology Officer and working in close partnership with the Head of AI Strategy, this leader ensures that AI initiatives are effectively implemented, adopted, and optimized to deliver measurable business impact. You will work closely with Technology, Data, and business teams across Advisory, Investments, Client Service, Operations, and Marketing to design, build, and scale AI\-enabled capabilities that improve efficiency, enhance client experience, and drive firm\-wide productivity. **Key Responsibilities** **AI Solution Delivery \& Execution** * Own end\-to\-end delivery of AI initiatives, from requirements gathering through deployment, scaling, and ongoing optimization. * Translate prioritized use cases and strategic objectives into actionable implementation plans, technical designs, and deliverables. * Ensure AI solutions are production\-ready, reliable, and aligned with enterprise architecture standards. **Workflow Automation \& Process Transformation** * Analyze and redesign business processes to incorporate AI, automation, and intelligent workflows. * Identify opportunities to reduce manual effort, increase speed, and improve accuracy across core functions. * Build scalable frameworks and reusable components to accelerate automation across the organization. **Technology Integration \& Architecture** * Partner with Technology and Data teams to integrate AI capabilities into enterprise systems. * Oversee APIs, data pipelines, and system integrations required to support AI\-enabled workflows. * Ensure seamless interoperability across internally built systems and third\-party platforms. **Vendor Implementation \& Management** * Partner with the Head of AI Strategy on vendor selection, then lead implementation, configuration, and ongoing management of AI tools and platforms. * Manage relationships with external vendors and development partners to ensure timely, high\-quality delivery. * Monitor vendor performance and optimize platform utilization to maximize value. **Adoption, Enablement \& Change Management** * Drive firm\-wide adoption of AI tools and workflows through training, onboarding, and embedded support. * Ensure solutions are intuitive, accessible, and aligned with user needs to maximize engagement and usage. * Partner with business leaders to embed AI into team workflows and performance expectations. **Program Delivery \& Performance Management** * Own and maintain a clear, prioritized execution roadmap aligned with the firm’s AI strategy. * Establish delivery standards, timelines, and governance for AI and automation initiatives. * Track and report on adoption, performance, and ROI of deployed solutions, continuously improving outcomes. **Continuous Improvement \& Innovation** * Stay current on emerging AI tools, automation platforms, and best practices. * Rapidly test, iterate, and scale new capabilities to enhance the firm’s AI ecosystem. * Support integration of new capabilities into existing systems, including those related to M\&A activities. **Partnership with Head of AI Strategy** * The Head of AI Strategy defines the vision, priorities, and roadmap for AI across the firm. * The Head of AI Automation \& Enablement owns execution—ensuring those priorities are successfully delivered, adopted, and scaled. This role serves as the critical bridge between strategy and implementation, providing feedback on feasibility, performance, and adoption to continuously refine the firm’s AI strategy. **Qualifications** * 10\+ years of experience in technology delivery, digital transformation, automation, or enterprise systems implementation. * Proven track record of delivering and scaling workflow, automation, or AI\-driven solutions in complex organizations. * Strong hands\-on experience with system integrations, APIs, workflow automation tools, and enterprise platforms. * Familiarity with AI tools and capabilities, including large language models, copilots, and intelligent automation. * Experience managing vendors, implementation partners, and cross\-functional delivery teams. * Strong program and project management skills, with the ability to execute across multiple concurrent initiatives. * Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions and deliver measurable outcomes. **Preferred Experience** * Experience in financial services, wealth management, or a regulated industry. * Familiarity with enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, Snowflake, Box, and workflow automation tools. * Experience with low\-code/no\-code platforms, RPA, or AI\-enabled productivity tools. * Background in process engineering, systems architecture, or enterprise integration. **What Success Looks Like** * AI\-powered workflows embedded across core business functions * High adoption and sustained usage of AI tools across teams * Seamless integration of AI capabilities into enterprise systems * Significant reduction in manual processes and operational inefficiencies * Measurable improvements in productivity, scalability, and client experience **What We Offer:** At Cresset, we focus on people first. As a service business, our people are our assets. Engaging our clients and employees is our highest priority. Starting salary is $175,000 \- $200,000\. Salary will be based on factors including, but not limited to, experience, licenses/certifications, industry knowledge, and geographic location. Cresset offers a competitive compensation package including an annual incentive and a benefits package to all full\-time employees including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, 401(k) retirement plan, health savings accounts, short and long\-term disability insurance, voluntary critical and accident insurance, and pre\-tax parking and transportation programs. **Equal Employment Opportunity** It is the policy of Cresset to ensure equal employment opportunity (EEO) for all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy (including childbirth, lactation, or related conditions), national origin or ancestry, age, disability, veteran status, uniformed servicemember status, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a parent, genetic information (including testing and characteristics), or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. It is Cresset’s policy to comply with applicable laws concerning the employment of persons with disabilities, including reasonable accommodation for applicants and employees with disabilities. **Everything Starts With Culture.** **Our Vision** We exist to optimize wealth and elevate life—giving clients the time, clarity, and trusted partnership to pursue what matters most. **Our Values** * Disclosures related to awards, recognitions, and rankings available here. * Barron's Top 100 RIA Firms (issued 09\.2026\). Based on data from July of the prior year through June of the award year. Rankings are determined using a proprietary methodology that considers qualitative and quantitative factors. Cresset paid a licensing fee to use the Barron's award logos. \*\*Wealth Optimized, Life Elevated refers to the firm’s philosophy and process in providing advisory and planning services and is not intended to convey a guarantee of results. Cresset refers to Cresset Capital Management, LLC and its respective direct and indirect subsidiaries and controlled affiliates. For a full list of Cresset subsidiaries and controlled affiliates, please see cressetcapital.com/disclosures/.

jobs.title: AVP, Engineering
jobs.description: **Who We Are** Cross River builds the infrastructure behind the world's most innovative financial products. Our technology and capital solutions power payments, cards, lending, and digital asset capabilities that move money safely, instantly, and inclusively — trusted by leading fintechs, enterprises, and disruptors across the globe. Our mission is simple: to build the financial infrastructure that expands access and opportunity for all. Guided by a culture of collaboration, curiosity, and purpose, Cross River has been named one of *American Banker's* Best Places to Work in Fintech year after year. Whether you're designing code, solving regulatory puzzles, or developing strategy, you'll join a team where innovation and integrity drive everything we do — and where your work helps shape the future of finance. **What We're Looking For** We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead and grow our Payments team (**official title: "*****AVP, Engineering*****").**. This is a hands\-on leadership role—approximately 60% engineering and 40% people and project management. We are looking for someone who takes ownership, identifies high\-impact opportunities, and thrives in a fast\-paced environment. **Engineering Responsibilities (\~60%):** * Design, develop, and deliver scalable software modules and components * Build backend systems using .NET 10, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, RabbitMQ, Docker and AWS **People \& Project Management Responsibilities (\~40%):** * Lead, mentor, and support a team of engineers and QA professionals with empathy, trust, and a focus on individual growth * Foster a culture that promotes sharing ideas, taking calculated risks, and learning from setbacks * Plan, triage, and prioritize work across multiple initiatives with lifecycles ranging from two weeks to three months **Qualifications:** * 8\+ years of experience in software engineering (a mix of front\-end, back\-end, API, security, and other best practices), with progressive leadership or management responsibilities * 6\+ years of experience with C\#, .NET Core, and the Microsoft development ecosystem deployed via AWS * 6\+ years of experience in real\-time data management (SQL, NoSQL, caching) * 4\+ years of experience in DevOps disciplines (GIT or Azure Devops, Terraform, Python) * 3\+ years of experience leading, managing engineering teams and interfacing with product and business organizations **Ideal Candidate:** * Experience in the financial industry (FinTech or traditional banking) * Fully understands the business logic to drive the most relevant engineering solution \#LI\-KR1 \#LI\-Remote Salary Range: $170,000\.00 \- $210,000\.00 Cross River is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Cross River does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non\-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need. *By submitting your application, you give Cross River permission to email, call, or text you using the contact details provided. We will only contact you with job related information.*

jobs.title: Software Engineer V (Engineering Lead)
jobs.description: As the Engineering Lead for the Bank Processing project, you will own the technical design and hands\-on development of CrossLink’s bank processing platform. You will build backend services, integrate with banking partners, and deliver secure, reliable transaction processing from initial development through production. This role is primarily focused on architecture, coding, and technical problem solving, with the ability to guide and mentor one or two engineers as needed. **PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES** * Own the platform architecture and technical design, translating business and banking requirements into practical software solutions. * Personally develop, test, and maintain backend services, APIs, and transaction processing workflows. * Design data models and processing logic for payments, disbursements, reconciliation, and reporting, with a focus on accuracy and auditability. * Implement validation, duplicate prevention, error handling, and recovery mechanisms to protect transaction integrity. * Work with the CTO, business stakeholders, compliance, IT, and banking partners to clarify requirements and resolve technical dependencies. * Establish code quality and testing practices; review contributions and document architecture, interfaces, and operational procedures. * Guide and mentor one or two engineers as needed, coordinating work and resolving technical blockers while remaining an active contributor. * Troubleshoot complex issues and support deployment, monitoring, performance tuning, and production readiness. * Communicate progress, technical tradeoffs, risks, and resource needs to management. * Perform other duties as required. **KNOWLEDGE AND SKILL REQUIREMENTS** * Bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related technical discipline required. * 5–10 years of software development experience, including ownership of complex backend systems from design through production. * Strong communication skills and the ability to work independently, explain technical decisions, and collaborate across departments. * Advanced programming skills in Java, C, C\+\+, Go, or an equivalent backend language, with substantial recent hands\-on coding experience. * Strong knowledge of backend architecture, API design, system integration, and reliable transaction processing. * Strong relational database and SQL skills, including schema design, transactions, query optimization, and data integrity; PostgreSQL experience preferred. * Proficiency in troubleshooting and debugging complex applications, including performance and production issues. * Experience with source control, automated testing, CI/CD, logging, and monitoring. * Ability to build secure systems that handle sensitive data. * Ability to lead technical work, review code, and mentor a small number of engineers while maintaining substantial individual development responsibilities. **ADDITIONAL PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** * Experience with banking, payment processing, financial systems, or refund transfer platforms. * Familiarity with ACH/NACHA files, settlement, and reconciliation. * Experience developing APIs and backend services in Golang. * Experience serving as a technical lead or mentoring engineers on a small project team. * Knowledge of IIS and .NET development. * Experience with AWS CodeDeploy and CodeBuild. * Familiarity with frontend frameworks such as React or Angular. * Experience working in an agile environment using Jira or similar tools. * Experience with the AWS ecosystem, including compute and deployment services such as EC2 and ECS.

jobs.title: Principal Technical Strategist - NextGen (Remote)
jobs.description: As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI\-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission\-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI\-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you. **About the Role:** Our Product CTO organization includes a team of Technical Strategy leaders that bring outstanding ideas, the ability to execute, and teamwork to a strategic, high future impact organization. The primary responsibility of this role is to define and drive the company's technical vision, product strategy, and platform narrative for our Next\-Gen SIEM and Log Management products. This role requires deep technical knowledge in AI, SIEM/SOAR, log management, and data analysis and a functional understanding of actual real\-world deployments, extended use\-cases, and customer motivations. The ideal candidate doesn't just advise on strategy: they define what we build, why, and in what order, and they articulate how NGSIEM anchors CrowdStrike's platform consolidation story. jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer

Now, DV group affiliates include two broker dealers, a cryptocurrency market making firm, and a bourgeoning investment adviser. **Overview:** We're looking for a senior level DevOps Engineer to join a small, high\-impact team that builds and operates the infrastructure powering DV's trading systems. Drive adoption by onboarding teams, building dashboards, tuning alerts, and scaling ingestion for growing workloads. * **CI/CD and GitOps:** GitLab pipelines, ArgoCD for Kubernetes deployments, Artifactory for artifact management. Build reusable CI components, improve secrets integration, and support trading desks onboarding to the platform. * **Infrastructure automation and tooling:** Build and maintain automation for provisioning, configuration management, and self\-service tooling that enables teams across the firm to move faster without depending on DevOps for every change. * **Platform adoption and support:** Work directly with trading desks and development teams to onboard them to the platforms we build. Cluster lifecycle, troubleshooting, networking, storage, RBAC. Experience with Cluster API, bare metal provisioning, or multi\-cluster management is a strong plus. * **Observability:** Production experience with Prometheus, Grafana, and alerting. Familiarity with Mimir, Loki, Tempo, or Thanos for scaled metrics, logs, and traces. Understanding of OpenTelemetry (collectors, exporters, instrumentation). * **GitOps and CI/CD:** Experience with ArgoCD, Flux, or similar GitOps tools. Building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or equivalent). Artifact management (Artifactory, Nexus, or similar). * **Infrastructure as Code:** Terraform and/or Ansible for provisioning and configuration management. * **Linux systems:** Strong fundamentals — systemd, networking, storage, performance troubleshooting. * **Programming:** Go or Python for automation, tooling, and scripting. Comfortable reading and writing YAML and Helm charts. * **Communication:** Ability to work directly with trading desks and development teams who depend on the platforms you build. You'll be explaining K8s concepts to people who aren't K8s experts. **Preferred Skills:** * Experience working at a trading firm — understanding the urgency and reliability requirements of systems that support P\&L\-impacting workloads. * Experience with Kubeflow, Airflow, or ML pipeline orchestration. * Experience with advanced Kubernetes networking (CNI plugins, network policies, service mesh). * Experience with Kafka or event streaming platforms. * Experience operating on\-prem infrastructure (not just cloud) — bare metal servers, IPAM, storage systems. * Thoughtful use of AI coding assistants and interest in AI\-assisted operational tooling. **Why This Role:** * **Ownership, not tickets.** This is a growing team that built and owns the entire platform. You'll have direct impact on infrastructure that trading desks depend on daily. * **Modern stack, real scale.** Kubernetes at scale, a full observability platform, GitOps everywhere — all on\-prem in a high\-performance trading environment. * **Greenfield opportunities.** Bare metal K8s, advanced observability, automated dependency mapping, AI infrastructure — there's no shortage of interesting projects. * **Small team, big impact.** You won't get lost in a 50\-person platform org. Every engineer on this team shapes the direction of the platform. **Benefits:** * Discretionary bonus eligibility * Medical, dental, and vision insurance * HSA, FSA, and Dependent Care Options * Employer Paid Group Term Life and AD\&D insurance * Voluntary LTD, Life \& AD\&D insurance * Flexible Vacation policy * Retirement plan with employer match *DV* *is not accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms. jobs.title: Practice Systems & Applied AI: Legal AI Engineer, Corporate
jobs.description: **Practice Systems \& Applied AI: Legal AI Engineer, Corporate** ***Information Services Department*** ====================================================================================================== Debevoise \& Plimpton LLP is a premier law firm with market\-leading practices, a global perspective, and strong New York roots. The role requires the judgment and credibility to engage directly with Partners, Counsel, Associates, and clients on how AI can be used responsibly to improve corporate legal workflows and client service. This position is intended for an experienced attorney or legal innovation professional with strong knowledge of corporate legal practice and exceptional communication and presentation skills. **RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDE, BUT ARE NOT LIMITED TO:** * Collaborate with the Head of Practice Systems \& Applied AI to execute the Firm’s AI strategy and expand the responsible use of AI across corporate practices and client engagements. * Independently prepare for and lead client\-facing presentations, meetings, demonstrations, trainings, and continuing legal education programs on AI concepts, capabilities, risks, and legal use cases. * Serve as a subject\-matter expert for lawyers engaging with clients on AI, helping them clearly explain the Firm’s capabilities, approach, governance, and experience. * Advise corporate clients on the practical application of AI within legal departments and matter teams, including use\-case development, workflow design, adoption considerations, and responsible\-use practices. * Partner directly with Partners, Counsel, and Associates in the Corporate Department to understand legal workflows, identify high\-value AI opportunities, and develop practical approaches for integrating AI into corporate client work. * Apply knowledge of corporate legal practice to assess how AI may support drafting, review, diligence, transactions, fundraisings, M\&A, capital markets, private equity matters, and other corporate legal processes. * Serve as a hands\-on resource for lawyers seeking to use AI on specific matters, including guidance on use\-case selection, workflow design, prompt development, quality control, and attorney review. * Develop corporate practice\-specific AI guidance, demonstrations, use cases, talking points, playbooks, and training materials for lawyers and client teams. * Support pitches, requests for proposals, client alerts, panel discussions, and other business development efforts by contributing AI\-related content and presenting the Firm’s approach to legal AI. * Educate attorneys on how to speak with clients about AI accurately and credibly, including how to discuss capabilities, limitations, risks, governance, and potential value. * Translate legal and client needs into clear business and functional requirements for the Applied AI Engineering \& Solutions team and other technical stakeholders. * Support the evaluation and rollout of new AI tools by assessing their relevance to legal practice, developing adoption strategies, and helping lawyers incorporate approved capabilities into their work. * Contribute to the Applied AI roadmap by identifying corporate practice and client priorities, evaluating potential impact, and recommending initiatives for research, development, or implementation. * Prepare communications, briefings, and recommendations for Firm leadership and other stakeholders regarding AI adoption, corporate client activity, practice opportunities, and emerging legal\-industry developments. * Stay abreast of advances in AI, legal technology, legal\-service delivery, client expectations, professional responsibility, and industry practices to ensure the Firm’s guidance remains current and practical. **QUALIFICATIONS:** * J.D. required; minimum of three years working as a practicing attorney, legal innovation professional, knowledge management attorney, practice support attorney, or similar law firm professional. * Demonstrated knowledge of corporate legal practices, transactional matter workflows, attorney work product, and the delivery of legal services in a corporate practice context. * Proven ability to independently lead presentations, meetings, trainings, and substantive discussions with clients, lawyers, and senior stakeholders. * Experience advising lawyers or clients on AI, legal technology, knowledge management, innovation, legal operations, or technology\-enabled legal\-service delivery. * Strong working knowledge of generative AI, large language models, prompt design, AI\-assisted legal workflows, and the opportunities and limitations of AI in legal practice. * Experience developing legal or business requirements and working with technical teams to design, evaluate, or implement technology solutions. * Experience supporting client development, pitches, requests for proposals, client training, or other business development initiatives preferred. * Understanding of confidentiality, privilege, data governance, professional responsibility, privacy, and ethical considerations associated with the use of AI in legal services. * Proven track record of leading complex, cross\-functional initiatives from initial opportunity identification through implementation, adoption, and ongoing support. **REQUIRED****SKILLS:** * Exceptional presentation and public\-speaking skills, with the ability to lead credible and engaging discussions with clients, Partners, Firm leadership, attorneys, and professional staff. * Deep understanding of corporate legal practice areas and the ability to analyze workflows across different corporate matter types, transactions, and stages of legal work. * Strong understanding of AI concepts and legal use cases, with the ability to explain capabilities, limitations, risks, and technical concepts in clear, practical language. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to develop executive briefings, client materials, training content, demonstrations, and practice\-specific guidance. * Strong judgment, professional credibility, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and navigate sensitive client, practice, and organizational considerations. * Ability to translate legal and corporate client needs into clear use cases, functional requirements, implementation priorities, and recommendations for technical teams. * Strong organizational and project\-management skills, including the ability to manage multiple corporate client, practice, training, and implementation initiatives in a fast\-paced environment. TO APPLY: A resume is required to apply for this position. Please tell us your salary requirements and where you saw this position posted. Send required materials to: Human Resources jferrigno@debevoise.com 212\.909\.8310 Debevoise \& Plimpton LLP is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran or any other legally protected category in accordance with U.S. law. jobs.description: ### **Minimum qualifications:** * Experience developing software with large language models, agentic workflows, tool use, or retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG). * Experience designing evaluation datasets, automated rating systems, or conducting error analysis and prompt optimization for generative models. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Experience collaborating cross\-functionally across research, product, and platform engineering teams to take novel AI features from prototype to production. * Demonstrated ability to design experimental setups, analyze model telemetry, and define reproducible metrics for complex features. **About the job** ----------------- Join DeepMind’s mission to solve intelligence and benefit humanity by building the next generation of agentic AI. In this role, you will architect the systems that allow Gemini to discover, retrieve, and execute modular capabilities (skills) across Google, DeepMind, and third\-party ecosystems. Your work will bridge foundation model intelligence and real\-world execution spanning dynamic context engineering (system instructions), low\-latency routing algorithms, and automated evaluation frameworks. jobs.title: Engineer / Technical Project Manager — Junior to Mid-Level
jobs.description: **Job Title:** Engineer / Technical Project Manager **Experience Level:** Junior to Mid\-Level / 1–5 years in engineering, energy systems, project management, or related technical field **Education Level:** Engineering degree preferred; related technical field (energy systems, environmental science, applied science) acceptable **Location:** Must be based in Alaska; Anchorage office presence preferred, Anchorage residents will be expected to come to the office 2–3 days/week when not traveling **Travel:** Site visits to rural Alaska communities expected; frequency determined by project portfolio **ABOUT THE ROLE** DeerStone Consulting is growing its technical team and looking for someone ready to dig in. This is not a support role where you sit behind a senior engineer waiting to be handed tasks; you will own projects. Smaller ones at first, with senior oversight, but yours. You’ll also contribute to larger, more complex efforts alongside our senior technical staff, which means you’ll get exposure to the full project lifecycle fast: development, design, grant support, community engagement, construction coordination, and commissioning. DeerStone is a fast\-moving consulting firm. Projects come in varied shapes, clients have urgent needs, and the work spans technical, relational, and logistical terrain that isn’t always neatly defined. We need someone who is smart, adaptable, and genuinely interested in figuring things out; someone who sees a new challenge as an opportunity, not a problem. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 1\. Project Ownership: Independently manage smaller\-scale renewable energy projects (solar PV, BESS, microgrid) from scoping through construction coordination, with senior technical oversight. 2\. Technical Support: Support senior engineers and project managers on complex multi\-community or large\-scale energy projects; contribute to technical analysis, modeling, design, and documentation. 3\. Technical Analysis: Assist with energy system modeling, equipment evaluation, feasibility analysis, and technical report writing. 4\. Grant \& Proposal Contribution: Contribute to grant applications and funding proposals with technical content, data, and narrative support. 5\. Community Engagement: Engage with Tribal and community clients in a respectful, culturally aware manner; participate in community meetings and stakeholder coordination. 6\. Field Work: Travel to project sites in rural Alaska for site assessments, installation support, and community visits. 7\. Documentation \& Reporting: Maintain accurate project files, schedules, and documentation; contribute to client reporting. 8\. Professional Growth: Grow technically, professionally, and in your understanding of the communities we serve. **QUALIFICATIONS** * 1–5 years of experience in engineering, energy systems, project management, or a related technical field * Engineering degree preferred (mechanical, electrical, civil, energy systems, or related); a related technical degree with strong demonstrated skills is acceptable * Interest in or exposure to renewable energy systems: solar PV, battery storage, microgrids, or hybrid power * Strong organizational skills with the ability to juggle tasks across multiple active projects without dropping things * Clear, confident communicator, in writing and in person, with technical and non\-technical audiences alike * Willingness to travel to rural and remote communities in Alaska, including via small aircraft **WHAT WE’RE REALLY LOOKING FOR** We work in a fast\-paced consulting environment where you get thrown into a lot of things and need to figure them out. The best people on our team are curious, resilient, and energized by variety. Formal experience matters less to us than the right attitude and the ability to learn quickly. Specifically, we’re looking for someone who: * Is genuinely interested in rural Alaska, energy access, and the communities we serve, not just the technical work * Picks things up fast and doesn’t wait to be told exactly what to do * Brings a good attitude into difficult, ambiguous, or high\-pressure situations * Is honest about what they know and what they don’t, and goes and finds out * Wants to grow into a full project and client lead over time Hands\-on experience is a big plus. Field work, installation, construction support, O\&M, or anything that got you out of the office and into the work. Prior exposure to grant writing, technical reporting, rural communities, or Alaska Native culture will make you stand out. EIT or PE candidacy is welcomed but not required. **COMPENSATION \& WORK ENVIRONMENT** DeerStone is a small consulting firm. Compensation is pay\-only; we do not offer a traditional benefits package. Instead, pay is structured to be inclusive of benefits, and we offer a Simple IRA with up to 3% employer matching contributions. What we do offer is a lot of flexibility. We believe in accountability to projects and clients, not to a rigid schedule. We accommodate life, as long as you show up when it counts: for your clients, your team, and your commitments. This position must be based in Alaska. When not traveling, we expect in\-office presence 2–3 days per week (Anchorage) to support team building, collaboration, and the kind of working relationships that make a small firm function well. **HOW TO APPLY** Apply directly through this listing; *must include a Cover Letter.* Job Type: Full\-time Pay: $105,000\.00 \- $165,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Flexible schedule Ability to Commute: * Anchorage, AK 99503 (Required) Ability to Relocate: * Anchorage, AK 99503: Relocate before starting work (Required) Work Location: Hybrid remote in Anchorage, AK 99503

jobs.title: Associate Systems Engineer, Data Management
jobs.description: **Associate Systems Engineer, Data Management** Our field sales professionals rely on proactive technical support during the sales process – and our expert Systems Engineering team always steps up to the mark. We lead the development and implementation of complex and specialized products, applications, services and solutions. From delivering sales presentations and product demonstrations, to developing detailed installation or system integration plans, we ensure customers get the innovative, relevant, interoperable solutions they need. jobs.description: At TriForza, we use technology to drive digital transformation and advance customer experiences across the oral health industry to promote access to affordable and quality care for everyone – with no one left behind. Your work will help create a more stable and scalable technology environment that supports our teams, products, and broader business goals. Washington Dental Service and its affiliates, including Arcora Foundation, Delta Dental of Washington, and TriForza Corp. intends to offer the selected candidate a base pay within this range, dependent on job\-related, non\-discriminatory factors such as experience.
