Washington Dental Service and its affiliates, including Arcora Foundation, Delta Dental of Washington, and TriForza reserve the right to change the responsibilities at any time with or without notice. * Provision and deploy workloads in AWS and Azure to support our SaaS platform offerings. * Write and maintain infrastructure\-as\-code using HCL, OpenTofu, and Terraform to provision and configure cloud infrastructure, building on established modules and patterns. * Automate repetitive operational tasks using Python, Node.js, Bash, and/or PowerShell to reduce manual effort and improve efficiency. * Right\-size and tune cloud resources to improve performance and manage infrastructure cost * Support the implementation and ongoing improvement of CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps and AWS CodeDeploy. * Assist with containerizing and running workloads using Docker, Kubernetes, and Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS). * Use Git for branching, pull requests, code reviews, and other day\-to\-day development and delivery workflows. * Build and maintain monitoring, logging, dashboards, and alerts that provide visibility into system health and support reliability and incident response. * Help maintain technical documentation, standards, and runbooks to support consistent engineering practices and day\-to\-day operations. These requirements are representative of the knowledge, skills, and abilities required to successfully perform the essential functions of the role. * 2 years previous experience working with the systems and requirements listed below. * Experience working with Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP) through work, internships, coursework, or hands\-on projects. * Familiarity with Linux, including command\-line navigation, file systems, permissions, and other common operating system tasks. * Experience working with infrastructure\-as\-code using Terraform and HCL, including reading and updating existing configurations. * Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and experience using Azure DevOps, AWS CodeDeploy, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, or a similar tool. * Experience using Git version control, including branching, pull requests, and code reviews. * Understanding of DNS concepts, including record types, name resolution, caching, and delegation. * Understanding of cloud networking concepts, including subnets, routing, VPCs, and public and private connectivity. * Experience using at least one scripting language, such as Python, Node.js, Bash, or PowerShell, to complete technical tasks or automate work. * Experience with Ansible or another configuration management tool is preferred, especially for Windows automation. Washington Dental Service and its affiliates, including Arcora Foundation, Delta Dental of Washington, and TriForza are Equal Opportunity employers. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. jobs.description: **Career Fulfillment \& Culture** ================================= People come to work for Deque because of what we do: enable businesses and organizations to make their sites and apps accessible to everyone, including people with disabilities. The personal fulfillment employees feel here is unparalleled. In addition to the altruistic nature of our jobs, the organizational structure is extremely flat and welcoming. Women\-owned and operated, Deque CEO Preety Kumar is internationally revered for her down\-to\-earth personality and work ethic. Deque's core values are central to our culture of customer satisfaction. Do you share them? * Innovation with results that matter * Deliver what you promise * Can\-do attitude * Open, direct \& respectful communications * We care deeply * We practice humility At Deque, you'll work with the best and brightest minds in the industry, sharing best practices, tackling new issues and uncovering new approaches. Accessibility Consultants at Deque also love their jobs because of the support systems in place. Deque experts regularly contribute to W3C Accessibility Working Groups and collectively hold more CPACC, WAS, \& CPWA certifications issued by the IAAP than any accessibility testing company in the world. **Position Description** ------------------------ We're looking for a passionate, self\-motivated **Senior Full\-Stack Engineer** to help us develop within our Axe Monitor product and component libraries. Front end work is done primarily in TypeScript and ReactJS. Backend work is a combination of Node.js and Java. This position will be expected to contribute to all aspects of the high volume, industry leading scanning solution. This role serves as our primary engineering anchor during US Eastern business hours. You will drive backend architecture (Java / Spring Boot / SQL) and independently investigate and resolve production customer issues when overseas team members are offline. On the frontend, you'll work with TypeScript, Node.js, and ReactJS. We're AI\-first and we mean it. You'll use AI to write and review code, including other people's, and you'll help build the context and practices that make AI effective on this codebase. What we're hiring for is the judgment on top of that: AI raises how much code you can produce, which raises the value of being able to tell when it's wrong. Axe Monitor is a large, long\-lived system, and getting good output from an agent here takes someone who understands it. Our team is fully remote and has flexible working hours. **Primary Responsibilities** ---------------------------- * **US Eastern Anchor:** Take ownership of investigating, troubleshooting, and resolving production customer issues during US Eastern business hours. * **Backend Core:** Build high\-volume services, scanner engines, data pipelines, and database queries using Java, Spring Boot, Hibernate, and SQL. * **Frontend Components:** Maintain and build accessible UI components and APIs in TypeScript, Node.js, and ReactJS. * **Critical AI Engineering:** Leverage AI tools to accelerate delivery while strictly reviewing AI\-generated code for security, logic, and accuracy. **Requirements** ---------------- * **Backend Depth:** 4\+ years of full\-stack engineering experience, with strong backend depth in Java, Spring Boot, Hibernate, and relational databases. * **Frontend Skills:** 2\+ years of experience with TypeScript, Node.js, and ReactJS. * **Skeptical AI Mastery:** Proven experience using AI tools effectively alongside the critical judgment to catch AI errors and edge cases. * **Production Troubleshooting:** Demonstrated ability to query databases, trace code, and resolve live production issues independently. * **US Hours Alignment:** Ability to work dedicated 9 AM – 5 PM US Eastern business hours. * **Enterprise Background:** Experience building complex software in large enterprise environments (finance, insurance, big tech, or scaled SaaS). * **Public Code:** Active GitHub profile with inspectable code (Java samples preferred). * **Accessibility Basics:** Basic web accessibility knowledge. (Expertise built on the job). **Preferred Skills** -------------------- * Foundational familiarity with web accessibility principles (WCAG, accessible DOM patterns, ARIA) and a commitment to building domain expertise alongside industry leaders. * Claude Certified Developer \- Foundations (CCDV\-F) credential (or equivalent practical experience). **About Deque** --------------- Deque (pronounced dee\-cue) is a web accessibility software and services company, and our mission is Digital Equality. We believe everyone, regardless of their ability, should have equal access to the information, services, applications, and everything else on the web. We work with enterprise\-level businesses and organizations to ensure that their sites and mobile apps are accessible. With over 475,000 extensions installed and over 5,000 audit projects completed, Deque is the industry standard. Join our growing family as we work to make the web a better place for everyone. **Job Location** ---------------- Remote (US East/Central timezone with full 9 AM – 5 PM US Eastern hour alignment) **How to Apply** ---------------- Submit your resume and link to your public GitHub profile. Deque is committed to providing Equal Employment Opportunities. Reference and background checks will be required. The expected salary range is $120,000 – $145,000 but is subject to change based on the skills, abilities, and experience of each candidate. jobs.title: Lead AI Architect
jobs.description: **Company Description** Domino’s is a purpose\-inspired, performance\-driven company powered by exceptional people who are committed to feeding the power of possible—one pizza at a time. Founded in 1960 as a single store in Ypsilanti, Michigan, Domino’s has grown into the largest pizza company in the world, with more than 22,300 stores across 90\+ markets. Our success is built on the strength of our people, technology, and franchise system. As a leader in innovation, we continue to transform the pizza and QSR industry while creating opportunities for team members to learn, grow and thrive. If you're ready to make an impact, build a meaningful career and help shape what's next, there's a place for you at Domino's. **Job Description** As Lead AI Architect, you own the technical architecture for Domino's enterprise AI platform – spanning classical AI, generative AI, and agentic AI. This is the senior individual\-contributor technical authority on AI: you set the direction for how AI capabilities are built, served, orchestrated, and governed, and you drive outcomes through design authority and influence rather than direct reports. You own the reference architecture and the paved road teams build on, and the build\-depth judgment for every incoming ask – production now, minimum viable, scaffolded as a contract for later, or deliberately deferred rather than quietly dropped. This is a deeply hands\-on role for an architect who has delivered AI platforms and solutions at enterprise scale – someone who knows why a technique works and when it survives contact with enterprise data, latency budgets, unit economics, and governance, and who still builds prototypes and reference implementations. Our environment is Azure\-primary with Databricks. **Responsibilities** Architecture Ownership and Direction * Own the enterprise AI reference architecture end to end, establishing scalable standards, principles, and design patterns across business groups. * Own the roadmap for agentic systems platforms, translating business objectives into sequenced technical strategy, milestones, and a build\-depth decision for every use case with explicit, traceable reasoning. * Design and maintain the paved road for AI development – golden patterns for building, serving, evaluating, and integrating models and agents, with an API\-first integration default, MCP by exception against explicit criteria, and guardrails inherited rather than bolted on per team – so teams ship without re\-solving solved problems. * Guide optimization of AI compute and token usage as adoption scales, and lead build\-versus\-buy, model, and framework decisions with evidence – benchmarks, cost per answer, real\-load latency. Semantic Search, Retrieval and RAG Architecture * Chunking, embedding and indexing: design chunking strategy per content type and tune size, overlap, and boundaries against measured retrieval quality; select and evaluate embedding models; own re\-embedding and versioning. * Query construction and hybrid retrieval: implement query rewriting, decomposition, and expansion; combine dense and sparse retrieval with fusion and re\-ranking; manage the recall\-versus\-precision and latency trade\-off explicitly. * Retrieval and response evaluation: instrument recall, precision and faithfulness against curated golden datasets; ground answers in the certified semantic layer and knowledge graphs where they outperform vector retrieval; design for graceful abstention over confident wrong answers. Generative AI Portfolio * Define prompt and instruction management standards – versioning, templating, context budgeting, and regression testing on prompt or model changes. * Own the AI gateway and multi\-model routing, matching each request to the right model on complexity, cost, latency, and quality, and own the benchmarking discipline for how models are compared, selected, and re\-tested as the landscape shifts. * Establish the evaluation harness as a launch gate – offline/online evaluation, LLM\-as\-judge with human calibration, A/B and shadow testing, and an explicit quality threshold we won't launch below. * Hold a clear, evidence\-based position on when prompt engineering suffices versus when fine\-tuning or customization is warranted, and define caching strategy as a deliberate cost and latency lever. Agentic AI Portfolio * Architect the orchestration layer that chains agents, tools, retrieval, and human review – orchestration as the enforced contract, domain agents scoped by journey and business context, and a reusable skills and tool layer where reusability actually lives. * Design memory and context management with an explicit position on what persists, for how long, and under what access rules; define enterprise standards for tool/function calling and MCP server contracts. * Establish agent guardrails – authorization scope, permission models, approval and escalation paths, sandboxing, fallback behavior, and safe failure – plus step\-level tracing, regression data ingestion, transformation pipelines, chunking and indexing strategies, vector and hybrid retrieval, knowledge graphs, metadata models, lineage, provenance, data quality, and access controls, including grounding conversational experiences in structured data (text\-to\-SQL, multi\-turn dialogue). * Model evaluation and production lifecycle engineering. Experience establishing evaluation frameworks and benchmarks (recall@k, NDCG, groundedness, LLM\-as\-judge), automated testing, release controls, model and prompt versioning, observability, quality monitoring, incident response, rollback, and ongoing improvement using MLOps and LLMOps principles. * Security, privacy, responsible AI, and governance. Ability to build identity, authorization, privacy, model security, human oversight, regulatory controls, and auditability into the architecture from the start. Must understand AI\-specific threats such as prompt injection, sensitive\-data leakage, unsafe agent actions, and model or software supply\-chain risk. * Scalability, reliability, performance, and AI economics. Ability to make quantitative architecture decisions on latency, throughput, concurrency, availability, capacity, inference architecture, compute utilization, quality\-versus\-performance trade\-offs, consumption forecasting, and cost optimization, including AI FinOps at scale. * Business and value\-oriented solution architecture. Ability to translate business strategy into qualified AI use cases, measurable outcomes, target\-state architectures, investment priorities, and delivery roadmaps. Must separate value\-producing opportunities from technology demos and tie solutions to operational or financial KPIs. * End\-to\-end delivery with hands\-on technical credibility. Demonstrated ability to move from discovery and architecture through experimentation, production deployment, and operational improvement. Able to build or review prototypes (Python, SQL, Spark), validate assumptions, review implementation designs, diagnose cross\-layer failures, and defend technical trade\-offs, with production depth in DevSecOps, Infrastructure as Code, Kubernetes, and model serving. * Technical leadership and stakeholder influence. Experience defining reusable patterns and standards, leading architecture reviews, mentoring engineers and architects, and aligning product, data science, engineering, infrastructure, security, and business teams. Creates clarity in ambiguity, leads with integrity and humility, and communicates well with executives and practitioners alike. * Substantial enterprise AI delivery experience. A strong record of leading complex AI or ML solutions in production at enterprise scale, typically 10\+ years across software, data, or ML engineering with significant architecture leadership. **Preferred Qualifications** * Hands\-on experience with Microsoft environment: Azure (AI Foundry and Agent Service, Azure OpenAI, Azure ML, AI Search, API Management, Functions), Databricks and Copilot Studio; agent frameworks such as LangGraph or Semantic Kernel and MCP. * Experience in retail, restaurant, e\-commerce, or supply chain with high\-volume, real\-time workloads and streaming (Kafka, Event Hubs) and model risk management. * Production multi\-agent systems and agent runtimes, policy\-aware agent gateways with authenticated tool routing and server registries, and GPU\-accelerated serving stacks. * Contributions to open\-source AI projects, published work, or recognized community involvement. **Additional Information** Benefits: * Paid Holidays and Vacation * Medical, Dental \& Vision benefits that start on the first day of employment * No\-cost mental health support for employee and dependents * Childcare tuition discounts * No\-cost fitness, nutrition, and wellness programs * Fertility benefits * Adoption assistance * 401k matching contributions * 15% off the purchase price of stock * Company bonus All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer, Analytics & Data Platform
jobs.description: **Who We Are** ============== DV is the leader in digital performance solutions, helping our advertiser and agency partners Verify the quality of their digital campaigns, Optimise to improve performance and Prove that they’re achieving their business outcomes, through unbiased 3rd party data and analytics. DV’s mission is to be the definitive source of transparency and data\-driven insights into the quality and effectiveness of digital advertising for the world’s largest brands, agencies, publishers, and digital ad platforms. Since 2008, DV has helped hundreds of Fortune 500 companies gain the most from their media spend by delivering best\-in\-class solutions across the digital advertising ecosystem, helping to build a better industry. Learn more at www.doubleverify.com. **About the Role** ================== **Role Overview** ----------------- You will join the Data \& Analytics Platform (DAP) team within the Pinnacle engineering organization. The DAP team owns and operates two data consolidation platforms — Quantum (contract\-driven, next\-gen) and Analytics 2\.0 (SQL\-driven, legacy) — that ingest, transform, and serve billions of records daily from social platforms, measurement systems, and third\-party partners. The data powers Looker dashboards, customer\-facing reports, and downstream APIs used across DoubleVerify's product suite. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Platform Abstraction \& Design: Design and maintain the YAML\-based "Contract" system that allows users to define data entities, transformations, and SLOs without writing low\-level orchestration code. * Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Develop the translation engine that converts user contracts into automated dbt models, Airflow DAGs, and Snowflake objects. * API Development: Transition the platform from static configuration files to a dynamic, API\-first architecture, enabling programmatic creation of data artifacts. * Self\-Service Enablement: Build tooling and guardrails that allow business units to deploy their own data solutions while maintaining global standards for governance and security. * Performance \& Scale: Optimize the "translation" layer to ensure that generated jobs are efficient, cost\-effective, and leverage the full power of the Snowflake/dbt stack. * Developer Experience (DevEx): Act as the "Product Manager" for your platform, gathering feedback from internal users to simplify the data development lifecycle. * Design and build data pipelines that process billions of records a day across consolidation, semantic, and externalization layers using the DV Internal Data Platform — a self\-service, contract\-driven architecture where pipelines are defined via YAML contracts and automatically deployed to Snowflake, Airflow, and Looker. * Develop and extend the Contract Interpreter — a Python library (Pydantic, Jinja2\) that reads contract driven platform based YAML and generates dbt models, Airflow DAGs, and environment configurations for each deployment environment (dev, stg, prod). * Lead new initiatives and integrations with the world's largest social platforms (YouTube, TikTok, Meta, Snapchat, Reddit, Netflix, etc.) to measure ad performance end\-to\-end. * Build and maintain the semantic layer — design LookML models, explores, and views that translate consolidated data into customer\-ready analytics through Looker. * Implement and maintain observability — build monitoring, alerting, watermarking, and data consistency checks to ensure pipeline reliability and data freshness at scale. * Leverage AI agents and tooling — contribute to and use the team's AI agent workspace (meta\-repo with AGENTS.md context files, skills, and MCP integrations) to accelerate development, automate workflows, and encode institutional knowledge for AI\-assisted engineering. * Design schema evolution and data migration strategies — manage schema versioning, backward compatibility, incremental vs. full\-refresh deployments, and large\-scale data backfills. * Work in multi\-functional agile teams with end\-to\-end responsibility for product development and delivery — from contract definition to customer\-facing data. * Collaborate directly with engineers from partner platforms on API development and data integration specifications. * Train and mentor a team of software engineers. **Who You Are** =============== **Required Experience \& Qualifications** ----------------------------------------- * Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field. * 5\+ years of experience in a Data Engineering or related role. * Strong SQL skills — advanced querying, performance tuning, window functions, and complex transformations at scale. * Proficiency in Python — building libraries, data processing scripts, and automation tooling (experience with Pydantic, Jinja2, or similar templating frameworks is a plus). * Deep experience with Snowflake — schema design, Snowpipe, streams, tasks, materialized views, clustering, and query optimization. * Experience with dbt (data build tool) — building and maintaining models, macros, custom materializations, and incremental strategies. * Experience with orchestration tools — Airflow / Cloud Composer, DAG design, scheduling, and monitoring. * Experience with cloud platforms — GCP (GCS, BigQuery, Cloud Composer, Kubernetes) or equivalent. * Strong understanding of data warehousing concepts — dimensional modeling, star/snowflake schemas, slowly changing dimensions, fact/aggregate table design, and data consistency patterns. * Experience with CI/CD pipelines — GitLab CI, Flyway migrations, or similar deployment automation. * Experience with AI\-assisted development tools — Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar AI coding assistants. Experience building or contributing to AI agent context files (AGENTS.md), skills, or meta\-repo patterns is a strong plus **Preferred Experience \& Qualifications** ------------------------------------------ * Experience building or working with contract\-driven / configuration\-driven data platforms where pipelines are generated from declarative specifications (YAML, JSON schemas). * Experience with Looker / LookML — building semantic models, exploring, aggregating awareness, and dashboard development. * Experience with Kafka — schema registries, topic management, and streaming data integration. * Experience with data quality and observability frameworks — automated testing, watermarking, data integrity validation, and SLA monitoring. * Experience with Terraform or infrastructure\-as\-code for managing cloud resources. * Familiarity with data mesh principles — federated data ownership, data products, and self\-service platform design. The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on a number of non\-discriminating factors, including qualifications for the role, level, skills, experience, location, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at DV. The estimated salary range for this role based on the qualifications set forth in the job description is between $107,000\- $212,000\. This role will also be eligible for bonus/commission (as applicable), equity, and benefits. The range above is for the expectations as laid out in the job description; however, we are often open to a wide variety of profiles, and recognize that the person we hire may be more or less experienced than this job description as posted. **Not\-so\-fun fact:** Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of job criteria, women and other marginalized groups tend to only apply when they check every box. So if you think you have what it takes but you’re not sure that you check every box, apply anyway!

jobs.title: Builder Developer II/III/IV (Senior Agentic Software Engineer)
jobs.description: ECI is hiring senior\-level **Builder Developers** (Senior Agentic Software Engineers) focused on rewriting how enterprise software is built, tested, and operated using AI. **The Mission:** Use AI to build autonomous agents and workflows that transform legacy ERP systems into modern, AI\-driven platforms. You are not maintaining old code, you are building the future. If you enjoy 4\-hour "alignment meetings" and writing Jira tickets for things an agent could do in 3 seconds, you’re going to hate it here. **Builder** is not just a title; it is a measure of **autonomy, architectural complexity, and "Agentic Leverage."** While a traditional "Senior Software Engineer" might be focused on completing tickets, a **Builder is focused on automating workflows** and owning the execution of AI\-driven modules. ### **Here are the Builder levels we are hiring:** * **BUILDER 2 (Senior):** Focuses on **Agentic Implementation**. This is the "Engine Room" of the team. They don't just use AI; they build the agents. They can take a legacy module and build a LangGraph or CrewAI flow to modernize it with minimal supervision. * **BUILDER 3 (Lead):** Focuses on **Systemic Orchestration**. They design the "Guardrail Layers" and the "Eval Frameworks." They ensure that the agents built by the team are deterministic, cost\-effective, and scalable. * **BUILDER 4 (Principal/Architect):** Focuses on **The Meta\-Platform**. They build the internal "Builder Tools" that the other three levels use. They are looking at the 12\-month horizon of model capabilities and ensuring the ERP architecture is ready for "Autonomous Operation." **Core DNA (Shared Foundation)** * **AI\-Native Workflow:** Use AI tools to accelerate development, testing, and documentation 10x faster than traditional methods. * **Agentic Implementation:** Build, debug, and deploy autonomous agents (LangGraph, AutoGen, Playwright\-LLM hybrids) that navigate complex ERP schemas and business logic. * **Legacy\-to\-Modern Bridge:** Treat 20\-year\-old legacy systems as puzzles for AI\-driven modernization. * **Deterministic Mindset:** Build for 100% reliability with automated validation, evals, and guardrails. **What You’ll Actually Do** * **Build Execution Agents:** Move beyond RAG into **Action**. Build agents that can navigate an ERP schema, identify a data discrepancy, and suggest a fix. * **Automate the "Untestable":** Use AI to wrap legacy business logic in modern unit tests and documentation. * **Prompt Engineering \& Evals:** Use frameworks like **DSPy** to move from "vibes\-based" prompting to programmatic, optimized instructions. * **Rapid Prototyping:** Turn a "what if" into a working AI\-driven feature in days, not months. **The Stack** Python, SQL (Postgres/SQL Server), TypeScript, OpenAI/Anthropic, pgvector/Qdrant, LangChain/LangGraph, dbt, Apache Hop/Airflow, Docker, Weights \& Biases, OpenTelemetry. And, any other tool that helps us achieve greatness. **Who You Are** * **The "Early Adopter" Archetype:** You were using GPT\-3 before it was cool and had a local Llama running the week it leaked. You spend more time on **r/LocalLLaMA**, **GitHub Trending**, and **X (AI Twitter)** than on LinkedIn. * **Agent\-First Thinker:** You don't think in "functions"; you think in "capabilities." You’ve built at least one autonomous agent or complex LLM chain that actually *does* something useful. * **The "Manual Task" Hater:** You have a physical reaction to repetitive work. If you have to do a task twice, you’ve already started drafting the Python script or agentic workflow to automate it. * **Technically Fearless:** You aren't intimidated by spaghetti legacy code. You see a 20\-year\-old undocumented ERP module as a goldmine for AI\-driven refactoring and modernization. * **Rigor over Hype:** While you love the latest models, you care about **Evals**. You know the difference between a "cool demo" and a "production\-grade agent" that handles financial data with 100% accuracy. * **The Tribe Member:** You want to work in an environment where your "AI hacks" and custom automation scripts are celebrated as your greatest contribution, not hidden as "side projects." **Why Join Us?** * **The "Final Boss" of Complexity:** ERPs are the ultimate challenge for AI. If you can automate a General Ledger or a global supply chain, you’ve mastered the hardest problem in software. * **Agentic Autonomy:** We don't do "tickets." We do missions. You’ll have the freedom to choose the models, frameworks, and agent architectures you believe will win. * **The BUILDER Tribe:** You won't be the "only AI person" in the room. You’ll be part of a 4\-person squad of like\-minded enthusiasts who are all obsessed with moving 10x faster. * **No Red Tape:** If the agent works and the evals pass, we ship. We don't have a "Change Management Committee." We have a "Does It Work?" policy. * **The Final Boss:** ERP data is the hardest problem in software. If you want an easy life, go build another photo\-sharing app. If you want to win the game, let’s go!

jobs.title: Network Security Governance & Architecture Engineer
jobs.description: Eaton’s Corporate Sector division is currently seeking a Network Security Governance \& Architecture Engineer. The position will be based at our facility in Beachwood, Ohio. The role is eligible for a hybrid work setup (3 days in office, 2 days remote each week). The expected annual salary range for this role is $146000 \- $215000 a year. This position is also eligible for a variable incentive program. Please note the salary information shown above is a general guideline only. Salaries are based upon candidate skills, experience, and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations. The Network Security Governance \& Architecture Engineer maintains a compliance and risk\-based security strategy, architecture guardrails and control requirements that govern how Eaton's networks are designed, connected and defended \- including emerging architectures such as SASE/SSE, SD\-WAN, cloud and multi\-cloud networking, ZTNA, private wireless/5G, edge and OT/IoT connectivity. The role translates threat intelligence, regulatory obligations, and Zero Trust principles into enforceable standards, reference designs and measurable assurance, and governs adoption through architecture review, exception management and risk reporting rather than day\-to\-day execution. The engineer is the Cybersecurity authority for network security architecture, standards and compliance. Cybersecurity retains accountability for security requirements, architecture guardrails, control intent, compliance interpretation, assurance and risk oversight; Infrastructure and Network Engineering retain responsibility for design implementation, configuration, maintenance and run\-state operations; Security Operations retains responsibility for detection engineering, tuning and 24x7 monitoring. This role sets the requirements and verifies outcomes \- it does not operate the controls. **What you’ll do:** ------------------- * Own network security standards, guardrails and reference architectures: Define requirements, approved patterns and target\-state reference designs for segmentation, secure connectivity, remote access, network access control, firewall and policy management, DNS security, web/proxy controls, encrypted\-traffic visibility and privileged network access. Maintain a published standards portfolio with clear ownership, review cadence, deviation criteria and a documented exception process. * Translate threat intelligence into control strategy: Assess adversary tactics, techniques and procedures affecting enterprise, cloud, remote\-access, product\-connected and industrial network paths, and convert them into prioritized standard changes, control requirements and detection intent. Focus on the strategic requirements rather than the tuning of individual rules. * Define detection requirements and validate coverage: Specify the network telemetry, logging standards and detection use cases required across SIEM, NDR, firewall, proxy, DNS, VPN and SASE/SSE platforms, and validate that coverage exists for priority attack paths. Partner with Security Operations \- who builds and tunes the detection content \- to close telemetry and coverage gaps and to correlate network signal with identity, endpoint and cloud events. * Direct risk\-informed threat hunting: Set hunt priorities and hypotheses based on MITRE ATT\&CK, Eaton's threat profile and known architectural weaknesses; sponsor and review hunts executed with Security Operations; and convert findings into standards, control and telemetry improvements with tracked owners. * Advance Zero Trust and segmentation strategy: Own the multi\-year target\-state model for trust boundaries, microsegmentation, least\-privilege connectivity and containment across IT, cloud, OT and product\-connected networks. Define maturity milestones, sequencing and adoption criteria, and partner with Infrastructure and Enterprise Architecture to align secure designs with operational and business requirements. * Run the network control assurance program: Establish a repeatable, risk\-based program to verify that required network controls are implemented and effective \- including control testing scope, evidence standards, configuration and exposure\-path review, exception governance and aging, and remediation prioritization based on exploitability and business impact. Report results into governance forums with accountable owners. **Qualifications:** ------------------- **Basic Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution * Minimum 10\+ years of experience in information security, network engineering or security architecture * Minimum 4 years’ experience in setting security standards, architecture requirements or governance for enterprise networks. * Eaton will not consider applicants for employment immigration sponsorship or support for this position. This means that Eaton will not support any CPT, OPT, or STEM OPT plans, F\-1 to H\-1B, H\-1B cap registration, O\-1, E\-3, TN status, I\-485 job p ception and risk committees. • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical risks and requirements to engineering, operations and business stakeholders.• Deep working knowledge of enterprise and modern network architectures, including routing and switching, firewalls, proxies, VPN, DNS, NAC, segmentation, secure remote access, SASE/SSE, SD\-WAN, ZTNA and cloud/hybrid network services. * Experience defining telemetry, detection and logging requirements and interpreting network security data from SIEM, NDR, packet analysis or comparable platforms. **Success Measures:** * Network security standards, guardrails and reference architectures are current, practical, testable and demonstrably adopted by accountable operating teams. * Network telemetry and detection coverage improve for priority threats, critical assets and high\-risk attack paths. * Threat intelligence and hunt findings are translated into effective detections, control improvements and tracked remediation. * Segmentation, containment and secure\-connectivity controls measurably reduce lateral movement and blast\-radius risk. * Exceptions and control gaps have clear owners, risk context, remediation plans and aging visibility. * Incident\-response teams receive timely network analysis and reusable improvements from investigations and exercises. * New network technologies and architectures are adopted only with approved security requirements, documented risk decisions and defined guardrails in place before deployment. * Network\-related audit, regulatory and customer\-assessment findings are minimal, and required compliance evidence is produced on demand without ad\-hoc effort. * The Zero Trust and segmentation target\-state roadmap shows measurable year\-over\-year progress against defined maturity milestones. All positions may require participation in video and in\-person interviews as part of the hiring process. All candidates will be evaluated based on job\-related competencies, and all candidates’ privacy rights and data security will be protected in accordance with applicable laws. We are committed to ensuring equal employment opportunities for all job applicants and employees. Employment decisions are based upon job\-related reasons regardless of an applicant's race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, marital status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by law. Eaton believes in second chance employment. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction history will be considered regardless of their arrest or conviction history, consistent with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, the California Fair Chance Act and other local laws. You do not need to disclose your conviction history or participate in a background check until a conditional job offer is made to you. After making a conditional offer and running a background check, if Eaton is concerned about conviction that is directly related to the job, you will be given the chance to explain the circumstances surrounding the conviction, provide mitigating evidence, or challenge the accuracy of the background report. To request a disability\-related reasonable accommodation to assist you in your job search, application, or interview process, please call us at 1\-800\-836\-6345 to discuss your specific need. Only accommodation requests will be accepted by this phone number. We know that good benefit programs are important to employees and their families. Eaton provides various Health and Welfare benefits as well as Retirement benefits, and several programs that provide for paid and unpaid time away from work. Click here for more detail: Eaton Benefits Overview. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer (Applications), Full Stack
jobs.description: Many structural heart patients suffer from heart failure with limited options. Our Implantable Heart Failure Management (IHFM) business's AI, Product and Platforms organization is at the forefront of addressing these unmet patient needs through pioneering technology that enables early, targeted therapeutic intervention. Our innovative solutions are not just transforming patient care but also creating a unique and exciting environment for our team members. It is our driving force to help patients live longer and healthier lives. Join us and be part of our inspiring journey. At Edwards Lifesciences, the Implantable Heart Failure Management (IHFM) AI, Product and Platforms organization designs and builds the software and data products that clinicians and patients depend on. As a Staff Software Engineer (Applications), Full Stack, you set the web application architecture across the front end, the BFF, and supporting services, drive modernization at scale, and personally build the patterns and tooling multiple teams adopt. Based in Irvine, CA, you'll join a high\-impact medtech innovation hub in the heart of Orange County, collaborating in person with cross\-functional teams to shape patient\-focused technology. **How you'll make an impact:** * Web architecture, built. Set the web application architecture across the front end and its consumption of Platform APIs, including design system implementation, API contract patterns, navigation, feature flags, and modularization, and personally build the reference implementations. * Modernization at scale. Drive the Angular to React and BFF to Platform APIs migrations across teams, progressively retiring the BFF layer, and make monorepo and rendering strategy (server\-side, static, and client\-side) decisions backed by working prototypes. * API and platform partnership. Partner with Platform engineers on API and gateway design that serves the application layer well, contribute server\-side code to Platform\-owned services where it unblocks client work, design integrations with third\-party and EMR / EHR systems, and bring client constraints into product roadmap discussions. * Cloud\-native patterns. Set the cloud deployment patterns for web applications (containers, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code) in partnership with Platform and DevOps and build the reference pipelines teams adopt. * Mobile partnership. Partner with the Mobile track on shared API contracts, design system parity, and cross\-surface architecture, so that web and mobile evolve coherently. * Standards. Set engineering standards across the web application ecosystem for code quality, accessibility implementation, performance budgets, API design, and test strategy. * Design control at scale. Shape how application design outputs, verification evidence, and traceability are produced across teams, in partnership with Software Systems and Process Development. * Multiplier. Mentor P3 engineers, set the hiring bar at this level, and multiply team output through the architecture and tooling you build. **What you'll need (Required):** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field plus 8 years, or Master's degree plus 6 years. * Recognized depth in web application architecture, with hands\-on fluency in React, Angular, Platform API and gateway consumption (REST and GraphQL), and at least one server\-side language, plus working knowledge of mobile client architecture. * A track record of setting technical standards adopted across multiple teams. * Experience leading a large\-scale frontend or API modernization, such as Angular to React or BFF to Platform APIs. * Experience designing and operating cloud\-deployed applications at scale, including containers, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code. * The ability to embed quality and traceability into a secure software development lifecycle (SSDLC), including CI/CD and automated testing. **What else we look for (Preferred):** * Experience in medical device software (SaMD), or other regulated classes of device software, under IEC 62304, ISO 13485, IEC 62366\-1, and FDA design controls. * Experience with experimentation, feature flag, and modular build infrastructure. * Experience across the UI framework and design system ecosystem, such as Material UI, Chakra UI, Radix UI, Tailwind UI, shadcn/ui, IBM Carbon, or Ant Design. * Experience with EMR / EHR integration (HL7, FHIR, IHE) and clinical workflows. * Experience with container orchestration (Kubernetes) and infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation, or CDK). Aligning our overall business objectives with performance, we offer competitive salaries, performance\-based incentives, and a wide variety of benefits programs to address the diverse individual needs of our employees and their families. For California, the base pay range for this position is $121,000 \- $171,000 (highly experienced). The pay for the successful candidate will depend on various factors (e.g., qualifications, education, prior experience). Applications will be accepted while this position is posted on our Careers website. Edwards is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer including protected Veterans and individuals with disabilities.

jobs.title: ML Platform Engineer, Distributed Training
jobs.description: **About Egen:** Egen is a fast\-growing and entrepreneurial company with a data\-first mindset. We bring together the best engineering talent working with the most advanced technology platforms, including Google Cloud and Salesforce, to help clients drive action and impact through data and insights. We are committed to being a place where the best people choose to work so they can apply their engineering and technology expertise to envision what is next for how data and platforms can change the world for the better. We are dedicated to learning, thrive on solving tough problems, and continually innovate to achieve fast, effective results. If this describes you, we want you on our team. *Want to learn more about life at Egen? Check out these resources in addition to the job description.* Meet Egen Life at Egen Culture and Values at Egen Career Development at Egen Benefits at Egen **About the opportunity** ------------------------- We're looking for an engineer who is equally at home running a GPU training platform and the large\-scale model training that runs on it. You'll be embedded with a healthcare and life\-sciences AI client that trains foundation models on a large GKE\-based H200 and GB200 cluster. The client is reorganizing so that its foundation\-model platform and its agent platform teams work more closely together. The role centres on the training stack and the scientists who use it. Solid infrastructure knowledge and experience are required, but the client already has strong SRE and infrastructure capacity, so running the cluster isn't the focus: you'll partner with that team and understand the training workloads well enough to tune, benchmark, and debug them end to end. You'll work alongside other Egen engineers and client scientists, and you'll own your area outright. ### **What You Will Do:** ### **Training platform** * Work with the client's infrastructure team on the GKE training platform (GPU node pools, job queueing and scheduling, quota and capacity) from the training workload's side. * Diagnose and fix platform failures at the root (for example a controller that keeps running out of memory) rather than restarting them. * Tune multi\-node GPU networking (RDMA/GPUDirect, NCCL) for training throughput. ### **Distributed training** * Run, scale and debug multi\-node distributed training with PyTorch (FSDP, DeepSpeed, Megatron or NeMo\-style) and Ray Train. * Profile jobs and remove bottlenecks across compute, memory, input pipelines and interconnect. ### **Benchmarking and evals** * Design and run performance benchmarks for the cluster and training stack: throughput, scaling efficiency, cost per run. * Build and maintain model evaluation harnesses so changes to the platform or training recipes are measured, not assumed. * Instrument training and the platform with telemetry and monitoring, and keep end\-to\-end pipeline tests running against what users actually run. **Ownership on the client team** * Treat the platform as your own: proactively find issues, plug gaps and propose solutions before anyone asks, keep the team informed of status and risks, and look after the scientists who use it. * Explain and defend your design decisions to client engineers and scientists in detail. * Stay effective while the client's priorities and team structure change. ### **Your Technical Toolkit:** * **Core Languages**: Mastery of Python and shell scripting * **AI/LLM Ecosystem**: Extensive experience with Google Gemini, GPT\-4, or LLaMA; deep knowledge of Prompt Engineering and Fine\-tuning * **Data \& Search**: Expertise in Vector Databases (Vertex AI Vector Search, pgvector, etc.) and implementing Semantic Search * **Infrastructure**: Hands\-on experience with Google Cloud (Vertex AI) and building scalable software architectures * **Frameworks**: Proficiency in LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar orchestration layers * **Mindset:** A strong software engineering foundation—you write clean, maintainable code and understand the full SDLC ### **Basic Qualifications:** * 5\+ years of engineering experience, with recent hands\-on work on GPU training infrastructure and large\-scale training. * **Strong Python software engineering:** production\-quality code, tests and code review. Coding is central to this role, not an afterthought. * **GKE and GPU scheduling:** Kubernetes on Google Cloud with GPU node pools, job queueing (Kueue or similar), and capacity and quota management. * **Distributed PyTorch and Ray Train:** has personally run and debugged multi\-node training jobs. * **RDMA and GPU networking:** GPUDirect/RDMA, NCCL tuning, multi\-node GB200 (or H200\) topology. * **Benchmarking and evals:** has designed performance benchmarks and model evaluations, and used them to make decisions. * Deep enough understanding to explain how and why a system works, without leaning on AI coding tools to carry the reasoning. * A track record of visible ownership: present, communicative, and accountable on a demanding team. ### **Personal Attributes:** ### **Nice to have** * Healthcare or life\-sciences data (genomics, clinical, biomedical), and working under HIPAA. * Observability and telemetry for training platforms: metrics, tracing, alerting, end\-to\-end pipeline testing. $159,300 \- $219,245 a year This position may be hired at multiple levels. Final leveling is determined during the interview process based on a candidate's experience, skills, and interview outcomes, and the applicable salary range will align with the final level assigned. Compensation is determined based on factors including experience, expertise, interview performance, and geographic location, where applicable. **Compensation \& Benefits:** This role is eligible for our competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package to support your well\-being: * Comprehensive Health Insurance * Paid Leave (Vacation/PTO) * Paid Holidays * Sick Leave * Parental Leave * Bereavement Leave * 401 (k) Employer Match * Employee Referral Bonuses Check out our complete list of benefits here \- \>https://egen.ai/people/\#benefits **Important:**All roles are subject to standard hiring verification practices, which may include background checks, employment verification, and other relevant checks. **EEO and Accommodations:** Egen is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to inclusion, diversity, and equity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. Egen will also consider qualified applications with criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. Egen welcomes and encourages applications from individuals with disabilities. Reasonable accommodations are available for candidates during all aspects of the selection process. Please advise the talent acquisition team if you require accommodations during the interview process. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Senior Scientist I, Cheminformatics
jobs.description: Eikon Therapeutics is a new biopharmaceutical company employing revolutionary technology at the intersection of chemistry, engineering, computation, and biology to discover novel treatments for life\-threatening diseases. Eikon's discovery platform is built on groundbreaking innovations from its founders (Nobel Prize, 2014\), culminating in the creation of microscopes which enable real time, molecular\-resolution measurements of protein movement in living cells, thereby unlocking otherwise intractable classes of proteins as drug targets. **Position** We seek a Senior Scientist with a demonstrated ability of successfully applying Cheminformatics and ML technologies to drive the discovery programs. You will collaborate closely with computational chemists, medicinal chemists, software engineers and machine learning experts to turn assay and structure\-activity data into interpretable information for decision making. As an integral member of our Drug Discovery team, you will make a real and direct impact on accelerating the drug discovery process and ultimately benefiting patients. **About You** You're a cheminformatics expert who loves to solve difficult problems and are not discouraged by challenges. You have a passion for drug discovery and thrive in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment. You are curious, love challenges, and enjoy pushing the edge of technology to solve important problems with creative solutions. You're collaborative by nature, resourceful, open\-minded, data\-driven, and can operate with a sense of urgency. **What You'll Do** * Develop and apply cheminformatics data\-mining algorithms for the analysis of molecular modeling, virtual screening, and structure\-activity relationship (SAR) analysis. * Process and analyze chemical and biological datasets to evaluate properties such as drug\-likeness, ADMET properties, dosing, etc. * Utilize molecular fingerprints, descriptors, and similarity metrics for compound clustering, classification, and regression. * Assist in development, maintenance, and monitoring of AI/ML models used for property prediction. * Optimize data pipelines for processing and storing chemical structures using cheminformatics toolkits (e.g., RDKit). * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to integrate computational approaches into curation and analysis workflows. * Maintain best practices in data integrity, reproducibility, and documentation of QSAR AI/ML models. * Provide guidance on the application of modern cheminformatics, ML/AI methods for library design (e.g. diversity, focused, fragment, DEL) and analyzing large datasets from HTS campaigns to building predictive models from them. * Routinely employ expert knowledge and analysis of SAR, physiochemical and ADMET properties. * Work alongside medicinal chemists to further triage emerging hits from HTS. * Collaborate closely with our data science team to integrate cutting edge AI/ML tools into our chemistry and drug discovery processes. **Qualifications** * Ph.D. plus 5 years of relevant experience; or Master's plus 14 years of relevant experience; or Bachelor's plus 16 years of relevant experience. * Expertise in cheminformatics data analysis, data mining, and machine learning models to solve drug discovery problems. * Expertise with ligand\-based design approaches, QSAR, multiparameter optimization to rationalize SAR and design novel molecules. * Expertise in scientific programming languages such as python, with experience using RDKit and other cheminformatic libraries and data analytics (Spotfire, DataWarrior, D360\). * Experience in virtual screening, HTS triaging, hit calling, and diversity analysis. * Familiar with commercial platforms and ELN/registration systems (Schrödinger, OpenEye, MOE, Dotmatics, DataBricks, KNIME). * A track record of publications, patents and/or conference presentations in computational chemistry and/or drug discovery. * Excellent problem\-solving abilities and the ability to work in a fast\-paced, dynamic research environment. * Strong communication skills with the ability to convey complex scientific concepts to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. At Eikon, employee compensation also includes bonus and equity compensation, in addition to several generous benefit programs, including: * 401k plan with company matching * Medical (premiums covered by Eikon at 95%), dental and vision insurance (premiums covered by Eikon at 100%) * Mental health and wellness benefits * Weeklong summer and winter holiday shutdowns * Generous paid time off and holiday policies * Life/AD\&D Insurance (premiums covered by Eikon at 100%) and optional supplemental employee\-paid life/AD\&D policies * Enhanced parental leave benefit * Daily subsidized lunch program when on\-site The expected salary range for this role is $178,000 to $215,250 depending on skills, competency, and the market demand for your expertise. Eikon is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and will consider all qualified applicants for employment. We are currently not accepting any new third\-party agencies or firms at this time. Please do not forward unsolicited agency resumes to our website, employees or Human Resources. Eikon Therapeutics will not pay fees to any third\-party agency or firm associated with unsolicited resumes.

jobs.title: Banner Modernization Engineer
jobs.description: Ellucian powers innovation for higher education, partnering with approximately 3,000 customers across 50 countries, serving more than 21 million students. Ellucian's AI\-powered platform, trained on the richest dataset available in higher education, drives efficiency, personalized experiences, and strengthened engagement for all students, faculty and staff. These solutions and services span the entire student lifecycle, including data\-rich tools for student recruitment, enrollment, and retention to workforce analytics, fundraising, and alumni engagement. The **Banner Modernization Engineer (Solutions Architect)** is a hybrid role on SaaS Modernization projects designed to fulfill multiple functions by combining outcomes previously delivered by a Solution Architect (SA), Technical Architect (TA), and integration engineer into a single, versatile position. The role will directly support SaaS go\-lives for customers, reduce delivery duration and effort, and improve repeatability and scalability by strategically leveraging AI, automation, reusable assets, and modernization accelerators to improve delivery processes. jobs.title: Principal IC Package Design Engineer
jobs.description: **About Ethernovia, Inc.** Ethernovia is developing the future of Ethernet\-based networks to realize the full potential of software\-defined and autonomous vehicles, robotics and other intelligent machines. Founded in 2018, the company's breakthrough data transport and acceleration technology is ushering in a new era of connectivity and capabilities in the vehicle and at the edge, including highly reliable autonomy, over\-the\-air servicing and AI\-backed applications. Ethernovia's co\-founders are serial technology entrepreneurs with multiple prior successful ventures together. We are well\-funded and backed by some of the worlds' leading technology investors, having secured **$154M** ($90\+M Series\-B and $64M Series\-A) in **total funding** to date: * Ethernovia Raises Over $90 Million Series B to Scale Leading\-Edge Autonomy and Physical AI Networking Chips * Ethernovia Raises $64 Million to Accelerate the Revolution of Vehicle Networks \| Business Wire + (financial backers include: Porsche SE, Qualcomm, AMD, Western Digital, Maverick Silicon, Socratic Partners, Conduit Capital, and CDIB\-TEN Capital) Ethernovia has been recognized in EE Times' prestigious list of the Top 100 Startups for 2025\. * March 2026: Ethernovia Announces HSB\-Enabled Networking Board for NVIDIA Holoscan Platforms * January 2024: Our CEO Ramin Shirani Named MotorTrend Software\-Defined Vehicle Innovator Awards Winner (ethernovia.com) * September 2023: Continental and Ethernovia Announce Partnership to Develop Automotive Switch in 7nm \- Ethernovia * **Connected Car News: Helios, Continental, Ethernovia, Avanci, BMW, Mapbox, Porsche, SEMA, Honda, UltraSense, Flex Logix, Diodes Inc., Garmin, Toyota \& Caruso \| auto connected car news** With talented employees on 4 continents, we have filed 50\+ patents to date. Join Ethernovia's team to make a lasting impact on the future of packet processor\-centric networking solutions to support the real\-time sensor, Physical AI, and control data demands of software\-defined autonomy across vehicles, robots and intelligent machines. Come share in our success with pre\-IPO shares, competitive compensation, and great benefits while growing your knowledge and career with world class talent. We are looking for talented engineers and leaders who have an entrepreneurial spirit and want to drive cutting edge designs from concept to silicon to the future of mobility. **Principal IC Package Design Engineer** **Summary:** We are seeking a visionary and deeply technical Principal IC Package Design Engineer to lead the architecture, design, and execution of advanced packaging solutions for our **next\-generation Ethernet switches and PHYs**. You will be responsible for the entire package lifecycle—from early\-stage feasibility and architectural definition to detailed layout, signal/power integrity (SI/PI) co\-design, thermal management, and mass production release. This role requires a blend of **deep technical expertise in advanced packaging technologies** (e.g., **Flip\-Chip BGA**, high\-density substrates) and the leadership capability to collaborate across Silicon Design, Systems/PCB, Reliability, and external OSAT vendors. #### **Key Responsibilities** * **Package Architecture \& Feasibility:** Lead the definition of package concepts, substrate stack\-ups, bump/ball maps, and pinouts to optimize for system cost, electrical performance, and thermal constraints. * **Detailed Package Design:** Execute **complex, high\-speed, multi\-layer package layouts** (**FCBGA, FCCSP**, SiP) utilizing industry\-standard EDA tools. * **SI/PI \& Thermal Co\-Design:** Partner closely with Signal/Power Integrity and Thermal engineers to ensure package designs meet stringent targets for high\-speed SerDes (56G/112G\+), power delivery networks (PDN), and thermal dissipation. * **Substrate Design Integration:** Define design rules and manage substrate layout, routing optimization, and manufacturing constraints (DFM/DFA). * **OSAT \& Vendor Management:** Drive technical engagements with leading substrate suppliers and OSATs. Evaluate vendor capabilities, negotiate design rules, and resolve manufacturing/assembly issues during NPI (New Product Introduction) and production ramp. * **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Act as the bridge between Silicon IC Design and System/PCB teams to ensure seamless chip\-package\-board co\-design and optimization. * **Technology Roadmap:** Stay at the forefront of semiconductor packaging trends (e.g., advanced organic substrates, glass substrates, co\-packaged optics) to influence Ethernovia's long\-term hardware roadmap. #### **Qualifications \& Skills** #### **Required Experience:** * **Education:** B.S. in Electrical Engineering, Materials Science, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field. * **10\+ years of direct experience** in IC package design and architecture, ideally within high\-speed networking, automotive electronics, or high\-performance computing (HPC). #### **Technical Expertise:** * **Advanced Packaging:** Proven track record of delivering high\-volume, complex **Flip\-Chip BGA (FCBGA)**, System\-in\-Package (SiP), and **multi\-chip module (MCM)** designs. * **EDA Tools:** Expert proficiency in package design suites such as Cadence Allegro Package Designer (APD), SiP Layout, or Synopsys 3DIC Compiler. * **Signal \& Power Integrity Foundations:** Strong understanding of electromagnetic theory, transmission lines, crosstalk, and PDN concepts. jobs.title: Senior Tax Professional - AI Tax Engineer
jobs.description: **Join Filed as an AI Tax Engineer: bring your expertise to the platform tax professionals rely on, work alongside a team of CPAs, and help shape where the profession goes next. Full\-time, on\-site in New York.** **Filed is building the first AI tax preparer trusted by America's accounting firms.** The accountant is irreplaceable. The work surrounding them isn't. Filed takes on that surrounding work, from the moment client documents arrive to the plan a firm hands back, so tax professionals can spend their time on judgment, advice and the client relationship. Filed works inside the software firms already use (CCH Axcess, UltraTax, Lacerte, Drake and ProConnect) across individual, business, trust and exempt organization returns. We're backed by Northzone, Neo, Raine and Day One Ventures. Read more in TechCrunch. ### **What we should tell you about the role** Filed is built for tax professionals, by a team that includes them. Our CPAs sit at the center of the company. They decide what quality means in everything Filed does, and they shape what we build next. As an AI Tax Engineer, you'd join that team. This is a strategic role. You'll bring years of practice experience to the product, work with our product and engineering leads on where Filed goes next, and work directly with the firms that run on it. Your judgment ends up in a platform used by firms across the country, instead of staying inside one practice. We think the profession deserves better than the busywork that has grown up around it, and that the people doing this work should spend their time on the parts that need their expertise. This role is how we make sure Filed delivers on both. We hire for this role on a rolling basis rather than to a fixed headcount. If you're the right person, we'd rather meet you now than wait for a req to open. ### **Here's why this is a terrible job** * You won't sign returns anymore. If client work is the part you love most, this may not be the right fit. * There's no off\-season. Firms rely on Filed year\-round, so we need someone fully committed to this role. * There's no established playbook. The role is new, and you'll help define it. * We're building something new, so not everything we try will work the first time. ### **Here's why it's the best career choice you'll make** * Your expertise shapes a platform used by firms across the country. * You'll see how dozens of firms run their practices, and help raise the standard for all of them. * No billable hours or utilization targets. * Tax expertise drives product decisions here. You'll be at the table when they're made. * You'll help move the profession toward more advisory work and less busywork, from inside the company building what comes next. ### **The teammate we're looking for** * Has years of practice behind them and strong views on how the work should be done. * Cares about the profession and wants to see it valued for judgment, not hours. * Can explain a technical tax position clearly to people outside tax. * Is curious about how technology can change the work. * Is comfortable pushing back on anyone, including us. ### **What you'll be responsible for** * Being a tax expert at the center of how Filed works, alongside our team of CPAs, and setting the standard for quality across everything we ship. * Partnering with product and engineering to decide what we build next, from document intake through to tax planning. * Working closely with customer firms, understanding how they run their practices, and turning that into product direction. ### **Your hard skillset** * Licensed CPA with at least 5 years of experience. * Based in or able to commute to New York. * Deep experience in at least one of CCH Axcess, UltraTax, Lacerte, Drake or ProConnect. * Comfortable across individual and business returns, including partnerships and K\-1s. ### **Your soft skillset** * Clear writing.
