jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting \& Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally. **The Role** Are you a builder who has already shipped AI that changed how a business runs? Fanatics wants you. We're hiring full\-time Applied AI Engineers to join a small, senior team that sits at the center of how Fanatics transforms itself with AI. Our goal is simple and ambitious: make Fanatics a leaner, faster, more automated company. Each Applied AI Engineer works like a tiger team: embed with a business function, find its biggest bottlenecks, replace slow, manual work with AI agents and workflows that actually run in production, then move on to the next challenge. This is a doer's role, not an advisory one. You'll own problems end to end: define them, design the solution, build it, prove it works, and drive adoption. You'll have real autonomy, executive visibility, and a direct line to leadership, with joint reporting to the CFO and Corporate AI Transformation Lead. We're looking for someone with prior experience doing applied AI work at a startup or fast\-growing company, who is used to moving quickly with limited resources and is ready to bring that pace to a global brand. **What You'll Do** * Embed within corporate functions across the business, find the workflows where AI can remove the most manual effort or unlock the most growth, fix them, then rotate to the next function. * Design, build, and deploy production\-grade agents and agentic workflows using frontier models (Claude, GPT, Gemini) and the modern agent stack: MCP servers, agent SDKs, orchestration tools, browser and computer use, and evals. * Move fast: take a high\-impact use case from concept to working solution in weeks, not quarters, and prove it with measurable results. * Think in systems and bias toward solving the problem, not toward building for its own sake. Sometimes the right answer is a custom agent; sometimes it's configuring an existing tool. * Partner with business leaders to be accountable for outcomes, and help them rethink how their teams operate in an AI\-first way. * Call balls and strikes: pressure\-test whether a problem is worth automating, what "good" looks like, and how to measure ROI. * Help set the bar for AI across the company, including tool evaluation, security and InfoSec coordination, governance, and best practices. * Spread the practice: document and showcase wins, coach colleagues, and help build a company culture that automates by default. **What We're Looking For** * 3\+ years of experience in applied AI or software engineering, including time at a startup or fast\-growing company where you shipped AI\-powered products or automations to real users. * A track record of building and deploying custom agents or agentic workflows with frontier LLMs that solved real business problems, not just prototypes. * Fluency with the modern AI stack: LLM APIs, MCP, agent frameworks (Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK, LangGraph, or similar), prompt engineering, RAG, and evaluation methods. * Strong coding skills (Python preferred) and the judgment to pick the right tool for the job, including buying or configuring instead of building. * Comfort operating independently in ambiguity, with a high bar for speed, ownership, and follow\-through. * A strategic mindset paired with a "get it done" attitude; you can tell the difference between a cool demo and a business outcome. * Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to earn trust and drive change with senior business leaders. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, Software Engineering, or a related field preferred; equivalent practical experience welcome. * Bonus points if you're a fan of sports, collectibles, or fandom culture (because we're a little obsessed). **Why You'll Love It Here** * Real ownership of high\-visibility problems, with exposure to every part of Fanatics and direct access to senior leadership. * A chance to be part of a small, hand\-picked team shaping how a global sports and collectibles company becomes AI\-first. * Backing for your work: dedicated headcount, budget, and executive sponsorship to get things done. * Competitive salary and comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage. * 401(k) plan with company match. * Generous paid time off, paid holidays, and parental leave. * Wellness benefits and a learning \& development stipend. * NYC office with daily in\-person collaboration. * Employee discount on Fanatics products and (yes) some sweet Fanatics swag. **Final Word** If you've built AI that moved a business and you're ready to do it at global scale, let's talk. This is where the doers build. By submitting your application, you agree to our terms of service and acknowledge you have read our Candidate Privacy Policy. *Fanatics will never ask candidates for money, banking information, or other sensitive personal information as part of the interview process. If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Fanatics recruiting, please do not respond and report it* *here**.*

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer, Operations
jobs.description: **About Fervo Energy** ---------------------- Fervo Energy (NASDAQ: FRVO) is a modern power company developing next\-generation geothermal resources to meet the growing demand for affordable, reliable, 24/7 carbon\-free energy. Our mission is to transform geothermal into America's most dependable and affordable source of clean, around\-the\-clock power. By combining innovations in horizontal drilling, fiber\-optic sensing, and advanced reservoir engineering, Fervo has developed a repeatable approach to building utility\-scale enhanced geothermal systems. Our flagship Cape Station development in Utah is planned to deliver 500 MW of firm, carbon\-free power, and we are advancing a development pipeline of more than 50 GW. Join us and work alongside world\-class engineers, geoscientists, operators, project builders, and business leaders working to make geothermal a cornerstone of a more reliable, affordable, and sustainable energy future. **Position Description** ------------------------ The Electrical Operations Engineer will serve as the technical authority for all electrical systems at Cape Station, Fervo's flagship geothermal power facility in Milford, UT. This role will own the reliability and integrity of Cape Station's medium\- and high\-voltage power systems, generation interconnection, protection and control infrastructure, and electrical safety program. This role is operational at its core: the ideal candidate is not primarily a designer, but an engineer who keeps a 24/7 power generation facility running safely and at full output. You will work closely with operations, maintenance, engineering, and EHS teams to diagnose problems fast, execute improvements, and build the electrical systems and programs that enable Fervo to scale. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * **Electrical System Ownership and Reliability:** Serve as the site technical authority for all electrical systems, including MV/HV distribution, ORC generator step\-up transformers, switchgear, motor control centers (MCCs), variable frequency drives (VFDs), and auxiliary power systems. Monitor electrical system performance and develop data\-driven reliability improvement programs targeting availability, efficiency, and power quality. Lead root cause analysis (RCA) and after\-action reviews (AARs) for electrical failures, outages, and near\-misses, and track corrective actions to closure. Work with maintenance to prioritize reliability upgrades, define preventive maintenance strategies, and develop maintenance procedures for critical electrical assets. Maintain accurate as\-built single\-line diagrams, electrical schematics, and equipment documentation. * **Protection, Control and Interconnection:** Own the site protection and control philosophy, including relay coordination, settings management, and protection scheme documentation for generation and distribution systems. Manage and maintain the grid interconnection agreement and SCADA/metering systems in coordination with the transmission owner and off\-taker. Support commissioning, testing, and acceptance of new generation units, including relay testing, functional verification, and interconnection requirements. Serve as the primary technical interface with the utility, ISO, and off\-takers on electrical and interconnection matters. * **Electrical Safety Program:** Own and continuously improve the site electrical safety program in compliance with NFPA 70E, OSHA 29 CFR 1910\.269, and applicable NEC and IEEE requirements. Maintain arc flash hazard analysis and labeling, and ensure equipment is appropriately rated and labeled for operational conditions. Develop, maintain, and enforce energized electrical work permitting, lockout/tagout (LOTO), and electrical safe work practices. Provide electrical safety training and technical mentorship to operations and maintenance personnel. * **Small Capital Project Development and Execution:** Identify, scope, and develop small capital electrical improvement projects from concept through commissioning and handover. Prepare AFEs, project scopes, cost estimates, and schedules for management approval. Manage vendors, contractors, and internal stakeholders through project execution, ensuring delivery on time and within budget. Apply a design philosophy of safety, simplicity, and rapid deployment, optimizing for speed\-to\-power\-production without sacrificing integrity. * **Engineering Standards and Documentation:** Own and maintain the site electrical design basis, equipment specifications, and engineering standards. Support and review electrical scope within the MOC program, ensuring changes to electrical systems are properly evaluated and documented. Provide technical input during electrical equipment procurement, and review contractor and vendor electrical deliverables. Support PSSR activities for new electrical systems and modifications prior to energization. * **Safety and Culture:** Model and reinforce a safety\-first culture across all enginee ing roles at operating industrial, power generation, or utility facilities; operational experience is required, and pure design backgrounds will not be considered without significant field exposure * Hands\-on experience with MV/HV electrical systems, switchgear, transformers, MCCs, VFDs, and associated protection and control equipment * Working knowledge of relay protection principles and experience managing protection settings and coordination studies * Demonstrated experience owning or significantly contributing to an electrical safety program, including NFPA 70E compliance, arc flash analysis, and energized work permitting * Experience developing and executing small capital projects, including scoping, cost estimation, and contractor management * Strong technical writing and communication skills, with the ability to produce clear engineering documents and present findings to leadership and external stakeholders * High ownership mindset with the ability to manage multiple workstreams independently in a fast\-moving, resource\-constrained environment ### ***Preferred*** * Experience with utility or ISO interconnection requirements and SCADA/metering systems (strongly preferred) * Experience with power generation facilities (geothermal, ORC, gas, solar\+storage, or similar), though not required * Professional Engineer (PE) license (Electrical) or active pursuit of one **Location** ------------ This position may be based in Houston, TX or within the Milford, UT corridor (Salt Lake City to Cedar City). Cape Station is a remote, industrial site that operates 24/7 to deliver firm, zero\-carbon energy to the grid. The Electrical Operations Engineer will work a standard Monday\-Friday (5/2\) schedule with regular travel to and presence at Cape Station. Due to the continuous nature of plant operations, this role also requires availability for emergency call\-outs after hours, on weekends, and holidays as needed. **Benefits \& Perks** --------------------- * Fervo offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, financial well\-being, and life outside of work. Benefits for eligible employees include: * Medical, dental, and vision plan options * Employer\-paid basic life insurance and short\-term and long\-term disability coverage * A 401(k) plan with up to 6% match * Flexible paid time off and paid parental leave * Family\-building, fertility, hormonal health, pregnancy, postpartum, and parenting support through Carrot * A dependent care FSA for eligible child and elder care expenses * An annual Lifestyle Spending Account for eligible wellness expenses, including fitness, financial planning, pet insurance, and pet care * Employee ownership opportunities through Fervo's Employee Stock Purchase Program, as well as stock option grants and bonus opportunities for eligible roles Benefits and programs are subject to eligibility requirements and may change. **Our Workplace** ----------------- Fervo Energy highly values having employees work in the office to foster collaboration and strengthen our company culture. This role follows a hybrid schedule, with team members expected to work in the office three days per week. Fervo considers this in\-office schedule an essential function of the role. Your recruiter can share more information about the schedule. **Equal Opportunity Employer** ------------------------------ Fervo Energy is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, creed, gender, religion, marital status, registered domestic partner status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, sex, genetic information, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other consideration made unlawful by federal, state, or local law. Fervo also prohibits discrimination based on the perception that an individual has any of these characteristics or is associated with a person who has or is perceived as having any of these characteristics.

jobs.description: **Location** ------------ New York, NY; Austin, TX; San Francisco, CA; Seattle, WA; U.S. Remote **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- On\-site **Department** -------------- Security \& Corp IT **Compensation** ---------------- * $224K – $344K • Offers Equity *To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base pay ranges for all US\-based job postings. Our compensation package includes base salary, equity for all full time roles, benefits, and, for applicable roles, commissions plans.* *This range reflects a good\-faith estimate based on the applicable pay scale, the range previously established for this role, the compensation of individuals currently in equivalent positions, and/or the budgeted amount for the position. Actual compensation may vary based on experience, qualifications, and other factors.* *We welcome compensation discussions if this range doesn't meet your requirements. Outstanding candidates may be eligible for adjusted terms, plus meaningful equity that ensures you benefit directly from the company's long\-term performance.* *Total compensation may also include equity in the form of restricted stock units.* **About Fluidstack** ==================== We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built \- but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it. We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them \- with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization\-scale infrastructure for AI. **We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!** **How We Operate** ================== * **Be a barrel.** Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role. * **Insane urgency.** We drive everything forward as fast as possible. * **Reason from first principles.** Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins. * **Love of the game.** The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward. * **Build something that actually matters.** If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world. **The Security \& Corp IT Team** ================================ **The Security \& Corp IT team protects the people, systems, and infrastructure behind the largest AI compute buildout in history.** Examples of key problems the team is working on: * Build detection and response coverage across cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure), endpoint, and identity telemetry for a company whose attack surface spans corporate IT and gigawatt\-scale data center infrastructure. * Run incident response end to end, from first alert through containment, remediation, and postmortem, without a large SOC to fall back on. * Stand up detection\-as\-code pipelines so every detection is versioned, tested, and deployed like software rather than hand\-edited in a console. * Harden corp IT foundations (identity, device management, access) so security scales with headcount instead of lagging it. **Role Scope** ============== * Build the detection engineering function from the ground up: telemetry pipelines, detection content, alert routing, and response runbooks, with coverage you can defend against a threat model, not just a tool checklist. * Own detection\-as\-code end to end, writing detections across cloud and endpoint sources with tests, version control, and CI so a bad rule never ships silently. * Lead incident response for high\-severity events, driving containment and root cause, and closing out each incident with detections that catch the same class of attack next time. * Drive automation of triage and enrichment in Python (or similar) so alert volume scales without proportional headcount. * Partner directly with leadership on security strategy, translating threat landscape and detection gaps into a prioritized roadmap with clear tradeoffs. * Work across corp IT and infrastructure teams to get the telemetry, logging, and access you need, and to fix the root causes your detections keep surfacing. **What We're Looking For** ========================== **The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly,** **tell us where you would.** * 8\+ years in security operations, detection engineering, or incident response, with time spent at a high\-growth tech company, cloud\-native infrastructure provider, or top\-tier MDR/threat intel firm. * You've built or scaled a detection engineering function, not just operated inside one: you can point to the program, the pipeline, and the coverage that exist because of you. * Deep hands\-on experience writing detections against cloud telemetry (AWS, GCP, or Azure control plane and audit logs) and endpoint telemetry (EDR event streams, OS\-level signals). * Strong scripting and automation skills in Python or similar, enough to build and maintain detection\-as\-code pipelines yourself rather than spec them for someone else. * Incident response experience at a company operating at significant scale, where you led response under pressure and your postmortems changed how the company operates. * You operate as a technical lead without heavy management overhead: you set direction, make the calls, and do the work. * You work well across corp IT and infrastructure teams in a fast\-moving environment, and you get telemetry and fixes shipped by making the case, not by escalating. * Bonus: experience securing GPU clusters, HPC environments, or physical data center infrastructure, or contributions to open\-source detection content (Sigma, community rule sets). We are committed to pay equity and transparency. Fluidstack is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Fluidstack will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law. *You will receive a confirmation email once your application has successfully been accepted. If there is an error with your submission and you* ***did not*** *receive a confirmation email, please email careers@fluidstack.io with your resume/CV, the role you've applied for, and the date you submitted your application\- someone from our recruiting team will be in touch.* Compensation Range: $224K \- $344K

jobs.title: Senior Penetration Tester
jobs.description: Forward Financing is a financial technology company based in Boston, Massachusetts with team members throughout the United States, Dominican Republic, and Canada. The company is on a mission to unlock the capital that fuels small businesses across America. Recognized as a Best Place to Work by Built In Boston and certified as a Great Place To Work, Forward is investing in its employees, technology, and customer experience – with long\-term success in mind every step of the way. As a Senior Penetration Tester, you'll find the vulnerabilities in Forward Financing's software before an attacker does. You'll pentest our core systems along with the AI systems and agents our engineers are shipping, and help shape how we test software that AI helped write. Our engineering organization is moving fast with AI, and our security testing needs to move at the same pace. **In this role you will:** * Conduct manual penetration tests against each of our systems, and build the AI\-assisted tooling and automation that extends how much ground those tests can cover. * Help define how we pentest AI. Bring us new ideas for testing LLM applications, agents, and agent\-generated code, and build the ones that work into our regular testing. * Triage findings from our SAST tools, fix the vulnerabilities that are real, and tune the rules that produce false positives. * Perform secure code review across web applications, APIs, and AWS infrastructure. * Build tooling and security services within the Forward application stack, including AI\-assisted tooling that speeds up the security team's own work. * Support the test\-to\-production review process so AI\-built work is security\-reviewed before promotion. * Explain risk to engineers in enough detail that they can prioritize and fix what you found. **Why you should apply:** * Shape a growing function: Our security program is early enough that your work sets the standard. You'll have influence over how we test, what tooling we build, and how we secure AI\-built software. * Mission driven company: Forward is a trusted source of fast, flexible funding for small businesses that have often been underserved by traditional financing options. When you join the team, you will help ensure all small businesses have access to the financial support they need to succeed. * Flexibility is a top priority: Our employees are empowered to choose where they want to work (whether that’s from home, in the office, or a combination of both) with flexible hours. **Role Requirements:** ---------------------- * 5\+ years in application security, offensive security, or product security. * Hands\-on pentesting and code\-review depth across web applications, APIs, and cloud infrastructure (AWS). * A hacker mentality. You're curious about how systems break, and you keep pulling on threads after the scanner comes back clean. * Interest in using AI to solve problems, whether that's in your own workflow or in the systems you're testing. * Understanding of AI/LLM attack surface: prompt injection, insecure agent tool use, and vulnerabilities characteristic of AI\-generated code. * Experience with modern programming languages such as Ruby, Python, TypeScript, or Go, and with secure SDLC practices. * Ability to communicate risk and priorities to other security and software engineers. * Typically has a Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or equivalent technical degree, or equivalent industry experience. **Nice to have:** ----------------- * Experience pentesting or red\-teaming LLM applications and agentic systems. * OSCP/OSWE or comparable offensive certifications. * Experience contributing to bug\-bounty or external testing programs. * Background in fintech or other regulated environments. **Compensation:** ----------------- **Annual Targeted Salary:** $143,000\-$183,000 CAD **Annual Target Bonus:** 10% At Forward Financing, we're committed to fair and transparent compensation. We believe in providing a compensation package that recognizes your skills, experience, and the unique value you bring to our team. We take a market\-basedapproach to pay, regularly reviewing benchmark data to ensure our compensation remains competitive, equitable, and aligned with our performance\-driven culture. Final offers are determined by a variety of factors, including the candidate's qualifications, relevant experience, specific skills, and internal equity. This approach ensures that our compensation is competitive and equitable. Your recruiter will provide specific details on the expected base and variable earnings as it pertains to this specific role. This position is to fill an existing vacancy. **Total Rewards:** ------------------ Additionally, we offer a comprehensive total rewards package, including but not limited to: medical, dental, vision, a flexible time\-off policy, paid parental leave, RRSP match, wellness reimbursement, volunteering days, annual professional development budget, and charitable donation match. Forward is proud to be a remote\-first company, keeping workplace flexibility a top priority for our employees. As a business, we are focused on impact; we are more concerned with your contributions to the success of the company than where you get your work done. To help facilitate in\-person collaboration, employees are welcome to work from one of our premiere office locations. When we aren’t collaborating to drive business and support our customers, we’re finding virtual and in\-person ways to get to know our colleagues, celebrate team wins, and have fun together! **Our Culture: The Forward Compass** ------------------------------------ The Forward Compass is the standard we hold for ourselves and one another—guiding how we lead, collaborate, and show up every day to move in the same direction. * **Back the Builders:** We are wired to fuel customer progress, not just provide support. * **Rooted in People:** We create an environment that balances deep connection with the extreme ownership and honesty required to reach our highest potential. * **Flying V:** We move through coordinated effort with speed and urgency to achieve what no individual could do alone. * **Always Forward, Never Finished:** We pursue growth with a relentless drive that keeps us ahead of the competition. **About Us:** Forward Financing is a fintech company based in Boston, Massachusetts with team members throughout the United States, Dominican Republic, and Canada. The company is on a mission to unlock the capital that fuels small businesses across America. Whether facing challenges accessing traditional financing or simply needing a convenient, flexible solution, Forward is committed to funding more of the millions of small businesses nationwide. By simplifying the requirements, streamlining the process, and using advanced proprietary technology, Forward is often able to deliver approvals within hours and funds that same day – giving more businesses the financial opportunity they need to thrive. Plus, with their dedicated teams and award\-winning service, customers get personalized support when they need it most. Since 2012, Forward has expanded access to capital by providing over $4\.8 billion in funding to more than 92,000 small businesses. The company is A\+ rated by the Better Business Bureau with an Excellent / 4\.7 stars rating on Trustpilot.com. Recognized as a Best Place to Work by Built In Boston and certified as a Great Place To Work, Forward is dedicated to empowering both its team and the customers they serve, helping them succeed and thrive. **Equal Opportunity Employment Information** -------------------------------------------- It is the policy of Forward Financing to ensure equal employment opportunity without discrimination or harassment on the basis of race, religion, national origin, status, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital or domestic/civil partnership status, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by law. We welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities. Please let us know should you require any accommodations. As part of our commitment to a streamlined and equitable hiring experience, we use AI tools to assist with candidate screening and assessment. Compensation Range: $145K \- $183K

jobs.description: **Data Engineer** California College Guidance Initiative * Full\-Time * Remote Within California With Occasional Travel All Candidates Must Currently Live Full\-Time in California * **Overview of Role** The California College Guidance Initiative (CCGI) is looking for a data engineer to join the Cloud Infrastructure Team. As part of the team, you will be a key contributor in the expansion, refinement, and continued development of CCGI’s infrastructure utilizing Snowflake and Amazon Web Services (AWS), as well as continuing to build out our data analytics and engineering tools . The ideal candidate has extensive experience building out data ETL/ELT workloads, including the testing, maintenance, and refinement of containerized workloads in cloud architectures. The Data Engineer should also have experience successfully scaling up an organization’s data intake from batch to streaming data, as well as automating data delivery. This person is comfortable working with data storage and can troubleshoot data accessibility via SQL, Python, shell scripting, AWS, Snowflake, and take on a leadership role in special projects when needed. Additionally, this person should have experience developing technical documentation and implementing security governance protocols. While there are no direct supervisory responsibilities for this position, the ideal candidate will have proactively and successfully collaborated with other subject matter experts to move time\-bound projects to completion. Additionally, the ideal candidate will have experience working with K\-12 or education data and/or have an interest in large educational systems and the equity challenges students face when navigating such systems. We work to solve large scale, system\-level problems. You must be comfortable working with unknowns and ambiguous solutions, as well as passionate about promoting public education and advancing educational equity. This role reports to the Director, Cloud Infrastructure. **What Will You Be Doing?** * Lead the development, maintenance, and optimization of batch and streaming ETL/ELT processes, including the development, refinement, and containerization of data loading and processing using event driven architecture and workflow orchestration. * Develop, containerize, test and maintain workflows within integrated development environments (IDEs) using AWS cloud services, Snowflake data warehouses, Python and SQL scripts, dbt, and shell scripts. * Review, redesign, and expand data models supporting data warehousing and self\-service business intelligence architecture to create fully automated data pipeline(s) from staged or streamed data to organization of data warehouse objects and producing access via reporting, alerts or API access. * Design and implement data pipeline automation requiring Python scripting and SQL statements, integrating with systems such as Salesforce, Slack and AWS services using serverless, cloud servers and containerized systems. * Participate in meetings, research processes, requirement collection, data analysis, and collaborate with the key project collaborators.stakeholders of your projects. * Develop and maintain expert knowledge of CaliforniaColleges.edu data, systems, and business processes. * Continuously improve data pipelines and architecture by staying updated on industry trends and best practices. Other duties as assigned by your supervisor. * **What Technical Skills Do You Need?** * Relevant BA/BS in Computer Science, Statistics, Informatics, Information Systems, or another quantitative field. * Minimum of three (3\) years of experience as a Data Engineer or a related role. * Ability to build processes supporting data transformation, data structures, metadata, dependency, and workload management. * Advanced proficiency with cloud data warehousing analytical tools such as Snowflake, Redshift, Spark, Kafka, etc. * Expert SQL knowledge (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, etc.) and understanding of relational databases, query authoring and optimization, as well as working familiarity with a variety of databases. * Advanced proficiency using ETL tools like Jupyter Notebooks, dbt, Talend, etc. * Advanced proficiency with scripting languages like Python, Scala, R, etc. * Advanced proficiency building and optimizing data pipelines and data sets. * A successful history of manipulating, processing and extracting value from large structured and unstructured datasets. * Demonstrated ability to consistently develop strong technical documentation * Advanced certifications such as SnowPro Core, AWS Cloud Practitioner Certification, or AWS Certification, Solutions Architect \- Associate are a plus Experience working with K\-12 data and/or education data is encouraged * **What Intangibles Do You Need?** * Strong data analysis and decision\-making skills with the ability to take abstract brainstorming and generate concrete proposals for action. * Ability to advance projects without detailed supervision, prioritize tasks, California’s educational institutions—K\-12 Local Education Agencies (LEAs), the California Community Colleges (CCC), the California State University (CSU), the University of California (UC), and the California Student Aid Commission (CSAC)—to smooth the path to college and career for all California students, especially those who have been underrepresented in higher education. CCGI advances efforts to improve students’ transitions from K\-12 to higher education by streamlining the college and financial aid application processes, while providing educators with the information necessary to inform data\-driven counseling practices and real\-time decision\-making. CCGI achieves this work through management of CaliforniaColleges.edu, the State of California’s official college and career planning platform for 6th\-12th grade students. The platform is free for LEAs and serves as an infrastructure for postsecondary planning, data\-driven student guidance, and the sharing of student records from K\-12 LEAs to California’s public higher education systems and CSAC. documentation. * Define requirements for clinical claims data products across claim types such as inpatient, outpatient, professional, ancillary, and pharmacy/Rx. * Support design and validation of value\-based care performance, clinical program analytics, and executive dashboards. * Support UAT planning, gold\-standard test case definition, regression testing, dual\-run reporting, stakeholder communications, and production transition planning. * AI/ML Collaboration and Product Modernization * Partner with AI architects, data scientists, and engineers to identify where deterministic rules, configurable business logic, an aims analytics, actuarial, clinical policy, provider analytics, value\-based care, or data product team. * A healthcare technology, claims editing, grouper, risk The Maintenance Engineer I plays a critical role in ensuring the operational efficiency and safety of real estate properties. or certification in facilities management, electrical, HVAC, or a related technical field. * Familiarity with local building codes and OSHA safety standards. * Strong troubleshooting and jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description: At GSK, we unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. Our ambition is to positively impact the health of 2\.5 billion people over the next decade. We are building a future where state\-of\-the\-art software, AI, and machine learning enable us to discover new therapies and personalized medicines that drive better outcomes for patients—at reduced cost and with fewer side effects. The Applied AI team sits at the intersection of business need and technical capability within the AI/ML department. We directly support business units with AI/ML\-related challenges, acting as ambassadors for responsible AI across the organization. Roche’s Research and Early Development organisations at Genentech (gRED) and Pharma (pRED) have demonstrated how these technologies accelerate R\&D, leveraging data and novel computational models to drive impact. Seamless data sharing and access to models across gRED and pRED are essential to maximising these opportunities. Within the CoE organization, the Data and Digital Catalyst (DDC) organisation drives the modernisation of our computational and data ecosystems and integration of digital technologies across Research and Early Development to enable our stakeholders, power data\-driven science and accelerate decision\-making. jobs.description: **About Genex Systems** Genex Systems is a Women\-Owned Small Business (WOSB) headquartered in Newport News, VA. Candidates selected for this role will be considered pending the outcome of the award decision, and Genex will follow up with next steps as soon as it's finalized.* *Anticipated start date: On or about March 25, 2027 (dependent on contract award)* **Lead the Database Behind the World's Largest Pavement Study** Every highway agency that designs a road to last draws, directly or indirectly, on decades of real\-world pavement data. That data lives in one place: the Federal Highway Administration's LTPP Information Management System. As our **Senior Database Engineer**, you'll be the technical lead keeping it accurate, secure, and available, and you'll guide it through its move from a legacy platform to a modern one. **About the Program** The Long\-Term Pavement Performance program began in 1987 under the Strategic Highway Research Program, and FHWA has run it since 1992\. It is the largest pavement performance monitoring effort in the world, tracking roughly 2,500 in\-service highway test sections across the United States and Canada. Its database holds more than 35 years of pavement performance, materials, traffic, and climate data, and researchers and engineers worldwide access it through LTPP InfoPave, FHWA's official public portal for the data. The work is based at FHWA's Turner\-Fairbank Highway Research Center in McLean, VA, the agency's federally owned national research facility, home to 15 laboratories. FHWA is now moving the LTPP database off a legacy relational platform onto a modern, cost\-effective one, and this role leads the database side of that transition. **What You'll Do** * Lead technical and database administration support for the LTPP database and related pavement research databases * Plan and execute the database work for the migration from the legacy platform to the new one * Design, build, and maintain tools for data upload, validation, quality control checks, processing, and extraction * Implement and maintain security, backup, and recovery procedures, and support the system's security authorization (Certification \& Accreditation) and Data Quality Act compliance * Prepare the annual public LTPP Standard Data Release for InfoPave, including computed parameters, metadata, and outside data sources such as NASA MERRA\-2 weather data * Design schema enhancements and new data tables, and integrate new data sources * Mentor database engineers and coordinate with FHWA IT and the InfoPave team **What You'll Need (Required)** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, or Engineering (or equivalent technical experience) * 8 years of relevant experience across database design, data warehousing and related programming, database administration, and data validation and processing * Expert\-level proficiency with Oracle RDBMS and Microsoft SQL Server **Nice to Have (Preferred)** * Experience with LTPP data, InfoPave, or other large engineering or scientific research databases * Experience migrating legacy Oracle systems to cloud databases (AWS RDS/Aurora, PostgreSQL, Azure SQL) * Oracle Certified Professional (OCP) or a cloud database certification * Python\-based ETL and data pipeline development **Compensation \& Benefits** **Salary:** Competitive salary based on education level and years of applicable experience. Genex Systems offers a comprehensive benefits package, including: * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance * 401(k) retirement plan with employer matching * Flexible Spending Account (FSA) * Employer\-paid life insurance and dependent life insurance * Short\-term and long\-term disability * Paid time off (PTO) and paid federal holidays * Tuition assistance programs **Location \& Work Arrangement** * **Location:** McLean, VA * **Arrangement:** Hybrid, combining remote work with onsite work at FHWA's Turner\-Fairbank Highway Research Center * **Expected start date:** On or about March 25, 2027 **Additional Requirements** * **Background investigation:** You must successfully complete a U.S. Department of Transportation background investigation. * **Work Authorization:** Visa sponsor available for qualified candidates. * **Key Personnel Commitment:** This is a Key Personnel position. jobs.title: Staff Security Data Engineer
jobs.description: About GitHub: GitHub is the world’s leading platform for agentic software development — powered by Copilot to build, scale, and deliver secure software. Over 180 million developers, including more than 90% of the Fortune 100 companies, use GitHub to collaborate, and more than 77,000 organisations have adopted GitHub Copilot. Locations: In this role you can work from Remote, United States Overview: GitHub is changing the way the world builds secure software and we want you to help change the way we secure GitHub. GitHub’s Security Operations team detects, responds, and investigates sophisticated threat activity targeting GitHub and our users. We're looking for an experienced data engineer to help define and maintain the infrastructure, data, and policies that we rely on. In this role, you will design, build, and maintain scalable, reliable data infrastructure across Azure using technologies including Terraform, Kusto, and Airflow. You will own foundational capabilities such as data pipelines, compute clusters, tables, and data models that enable security monitoring, detection, threat hunting, incident response, and investigations. You will also help define and maintain security telemetry policy, ensuring that critical security data is available, trustworthy, appropriately governed, and useful throughout its lifecycle. This is an opportunity to join a high\-impact, highly collaborative Security organization that helps drive secure outcomes for GitHub, our customers, and the broader open source software community. If you have deep experience building cloud\-scale data platforms, can lead strategically across organizational boundaries, and are motivated to solve complex security data and infrastructure challenges, we want to hear from you! Responsibilities: * Design, build, and maintain secure, reliable, and scalable data infrastructure in Azure, and AWS, including Terraform\-managed resources, Kusto clusters and tables, and Airflow\-orchestrated ETL pipelines * Lead cross\-organizational initiatives to onboard new security telemetry, and identify and close visibility gaps * Establish and advance data governance practices for security telemetry, including highly sensitive data sources * Define and drive adoption of security telemetry policies and standards, partnering with Security teams and service owners to identify and remediate gaps * Provide technical leadership to projects focused on the data platforms and infrastructure that supporting security monitoring, threat detection, hunting, investigations, and incident response Qualifications: Required Qualifications:* 10\+ years experience in security analysis, security research, cyber security, security engineering, or relevant area + o OR Associate's Degree AND 9\+ years experience in security analysis, security research, cyber security, security engineering, or relevant area + o OR Bachelor's Degree AND 8\+ years experience in security analysis, security research, cyber security, security engineering, or relevant area + o OR Master's Degree AND 6\+ years experience in security analysis, security research, cyber security, security engineering, or relevant area + o OR Doctorate AND 4\+ years experience in security analysis, security research, cyber security, security engineering, or relevant area + o OR equivalent experience. * 5\+ years of hands\-on experience building and maintaining cloud scale Azure infrastructure * 3\+ years of deep experience with Kusto and KQL, Apache Airflow, Terraform, and Python in production environments * 2\+ years experience leading complex initiatives across organizational boundaries , aligning stakeholders, and translating operational requirements into durable technical solutions. Preferred Qualifications:* Experience collaborating with Security Operations and Engineering teams around security telemetry requirements * Experience supporting Security Operations disciplines such as Threat Detection, Incident Response, Threat Intel, and/or Red Teaming * Experience leveraging AI workflows, where appropriate, to drive improved security outcomes * Experience designing near\-real\-time telemetry ingestion using Azure Event Hubs or comparable technologies * Experience establishing observability, reliability, data\-quality, and cost\-management practices for data platforms GitHub Leadership Principles: **GitHub values** * Customer\-obsessed * Ship to learn * Growth mindset * Own the outcome * Better together * Diverse and inclusive **Manager fundamentals** * Model * Coach * Care **Leadership principles** * Create clarity * Generate energy * Deliver success Who We Are: GitHub is the world’s leading AI\-powered developer platform with 150 million developers and counting. We’re also home to the biggest open\-source community on earth (and 99% of the world’s software has open\-source code in its DNA). Many of the apps and programs you use every day are built on GitHub. Our teams are dreamers, doers, and pioneers, leading the way in AI, driving humanitarian efforts around the globe, and even sending open source to Mars (and beyond!). At GitHub, our goal is to create the space you need to do your best work. We’re remote\-first and offer competitive pay, generous learning and growth opportunities, and excellent benefits to support you, wherever you are—because we know that people flourish when they can work on their own terms. Join us, and let’s change the world, together. EEO Statement: GitHub is made up of people from a wide variety of backgrounds and lifestyles. We embrace diversity and invite applications from people of all walks of life. We don't discriminate against employees or applicants based on gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, religion, age, national origin, citizenship, disability, pregnancy status, veteran status, or any other differences. Also, if you have a disability, please let us know if there's any way we can make the interview process better for you; we're happy to accommodate!

jobs.title: AI Software Engineer
jobs.description: **AI Software Engineer – Agentic AI \& Python** ----------------------------------------------- Location: Jersey City, NJ — Onsite Annual Base Salary: $85,000–$120,000 **Build What’s Next at Globant** -------------------------------- We are seeking an **AI Software Engineer** to build secure, production\-ready AI agents and digital copilot capabilities. In this role, you will combine software engineering, data engineering, and applied AI to deliver intelligent workflows for research, summarization, and follow\-up activities. You will work across agent orchestration, enterprise integrations, retrieval pipelines, model delivery, and user\-facing experiences, with a focus on security, reliability, and responsible AI. **What You Will Do** -------------------- * Design, develop, and troubleshoot agent components, including orchestration logic, tools, and task queues supporting research, summarization, and follow\-up workflows. * Build and maintain Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers that provide secure access to CRM systems, client and product reference data, document stores, calendars, and email, enforcing user entitlements on every call. * Write secure, high\-quality production code in Python, and review, debug, and improve code written by others. * Develop retrieval pipelines for product, pricing, legal, and client documents, including ingestion, chunking, embedding, indexing, and citation metadata to ensure answers are traceable to their sources. * Build data pipelines and feature engineering jobs on Databricks to prepare CRM, transaction, and engagement data for model training and copilot retrieval. * Contribute to MLOps workflows for propensity, next\-best\-action, and opportunity\-scoring models, including training jobs, automated testing, and promotion of model artifacts from development through user acceptance testing (UAT) to production. * Develop the copilot’s user\-facing experience and streaming interactions using AG\-UI, including human\-in\-the\-loop review before communications are sent to clients or changes are written to CRM. * Create agent evaluations, including offline test sets, groundedness and citation checks, CI/CD regression suites, and LLM\-as\-judge scoring. * Instrument services with OpenTelemetry tracing to support observability and troubleshooting. * Use enterprise\-authorized AI\-assisted development tools while validating generated outputs for correctness, performance, and security. * Identify opportunities to eliminate recurring issues or automate remediation to improve the operational stability of agents and model services. * Contribute to a team culture rooted in diversity, opportunity, inclusion, and respect. **What You Bring** ------------------ * Formal training or certification in software engineering concepts and at least 3 years of applied experience. * Hands\-on experience in system design, application development, testing, and operational stability. * Proficiency in Python and at least one additional language, such as Java, TypeScript, or SQL. * Experience building and consuming APIs and event\-driven services in a cloud environment. * Experience with data processing frameworks such as Apache Spark and large structured datasets. * Working knowledge of LLM application development, including prompting, tool calling, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), and evaluation. * Experience using approved AI\-assisted software development tools, with sound judgment when validating their outputs. * Understanding of responsible AI practices, data sensitivity, and secure handling of inputs and outputs. * Solid understanding of agile delivery practices, CI/CD, application resiliency, and security. * Practical cloud\-native experience, including containers and Kubernetes; AWS experience is preferred. **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Experience with agent frameworks such as Google ADK or LangGraph and protocols such as MCP, A2A, or AG\-UI. * Experience with vector search and retrieval systems such as OpenSearch, pgvector, or FAISS, including reranking and document parsing. * Experience with Databricks, MLflow, and Delta Lake or Apache Iceberg. * Exposure to model serving on Kubernetes and monitoring for drift, latency, and accuracy. * Familiarity with Salesforce or other CRM platforms, including their APIs and data models. * Front\-end development experience with TypeScript and React for conversational or assistant interfaces. * Exposure to payments, treasury services, commercial cards, or sales enablement processes. * Familiarity with Terraform and infrastructure as code. **Ready to Make an Impact?** ---------------------------- Join Globant and help build secure, reliable AI\-powered experiences that connect enterprise data with meaningful business workflows.

jobs.title: AI/ML Engineer, Global Banking & Markets, RIA Engineering
jobs.description: **What We Do** At Goldman Sachs, our Engineers don't just make things – we make things possible. Change the world by connecting people and capital with ideas. Solve the most challenging and pressing engineering problems for our clients. Join our engineering teams that build massively scalable software and systems, architect low latency infrastructure solutions, proactively guard against cyber threats, and leverage machine learning alongside financial engineering to continuously turn data into action. Drive new businesses, redefine finance using AI, and seize opportunities at market speed. In an era defined by AI, Engineering isn't just central – it's the driving force behind our business. Our dynamic environment demands innovative strategic thinking and immediate, impactful solutions. Ready to push the limits of digital possibility? Begin your journey here. **Who We Look For** We are seeking a **Senior AI Engineering Expert** with deep expertise in leveraging the latest and greatest **AI tooling** to drive developing solutions on the **Java/JVM based ecosystem**. You will be responsible for architecting and implementing production\-grade AI solutions that integrate directly into our existing Java\-based microservices. Your primary focus will be on building scalable, type\-safe, and observable AI "Agentic" workflows that automate collateral management, risk monitoring, and advisor support. **How You Will Fulfill Your Potential** * **System Integration:** Architect and implement end\-to\-end AI pipelines (RAG, Agentic workflows) that integrate seamlessly with existing enterprise APIs, legacy databases, and microservices. * **Scalability \& Performance:** Optimize inference latency and manage token costs for large\-scale deployments serving thousands of internal and external users. * **Evaluation \& Governance:** Establish robust evaluation frameworks to measure model accuracy, mitigate hallucinations, and ensure compliance with enterprise security and privacy standards. * **Cross\-Functional Leadership:** Collaborate with tech leads, security leads, and software teams to identify high\-impact AI use cases and define technical roadmaps. * **Continuous Innovation:** Stay at the forefront of Generative AI, multimodal models, and autonomous agents, recommending strategic pivots as the technology evolves. * **Enterprise RAG Pipelines:** Build robust Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems using Java\-based ETL pipelines to ingest and index unstructured custodial data (e.g., legal agreements, market news) into vector databases. * **Performance \& Observability:** Leverage **Spring Boot Actuator** and **Micrometer** to monitor LLM latency, token usage, and model drift within our standard enterprise monitoring stack. * **Regulatory Compliance (Audit\-by\-Design):** Implement "Human\-in\-the\-Loop" (HITL) patterns and structured logging to ensure all AI\-driven lending decisions are explainable and compliant with 2026 SEC/FINRA standards. * **System Modernization:** Lead the transition of traditional batch\-oriented Java processes to real\-time, event\-driven AI architectures using **AWS MSK** and similar tools. **Required Technical Skills** * **Core Java:** Expert\-level proficiency in **Java 21\+** (utilizing Virtual Threads/Project Loom for high\-concurrency AI inference). * **AI Frameworks:** Hands\-on experience with **leading AI frameworks / tools**. * **Enterprise Stack:** Deep experience with **Spring Boot 3\.x**, **JPA, Sybase**, and **Maven/Gradle**. * **Data \& Search:** Proficiency in **SQL** and integration with enterprise vector stores (e.g., Milvus, Weaviate, or Pinecone) via Java clients. * **Messaging \& Integration:** Experience with **Apache Kafka** or **RabbitMQ** for orchestrating asynchronous AI agent tasks. * **Cloud Infrastructure:** Deployment experience on **AWS** usingSDKs. **Qualifications** * **Experience:** 6\+ years in Java software engineering, with at least 3 years focused on AI/ML integration in production. * **Domain Knowledge:** Understanding of RIA workflows, collateral eligibility, and the regulatory landscape of asset\-based lending. * **Education:** Degree in Computer Science, Financial Engineering, or a related field. Please note we will only respond to applications for which we have an interest. **Salary Range** The expected base salary for this New York, New York, United States\-based position is $150,000\-$300,000\. In addition, you may be eligible for a discretionary bonus if you are an active employee as of fiscal year\-end. **Benefits** Goldman Sachs is committed to providing our people with valuable and competitive benefits and wellness offerings, as it is a core part of providing a strong overall employee experience. A summary of these offerings, which are generally available to active, non\-temporary, full\-time and part\-time US employees who work at least 20 hours per week, can be found here. We Offer Best\-In\-Class Benefits Healthcare \& Medical Insurance We offer a wide range of health and welfare programs that vary depending on office location. These generally include medical, dental, short\-term disability, long\-term disability, life, accidental death, labor accident and business travel accident insurance. Holiday \& Vacation Policies We offer competitive vacation policies based on employee level and office location. We promote time off from work to recharge by providing generous vacation entitlements and a minimum of three weeks expected vacation usage each year. Financial Wellness \& Retirement We assist employees in saving and planning for retirement, offer financial support for higher education, and provide a number of benefits to help employees prepare for the unexpected. We offer live financial education and content on a variety of topics to address the spectrum of employees’ priorities. Health Services We offer a medical advocacy service for employees and family members facing critical health situations, and counseling and referral services through the Employee Assistance Program (EAP). We provide Global Medical, Security and Travel Assistance and a Workplace Ergonomics Program. We also offer state\-of\-the\-art on\-site health centers in certain offices. Fitness To encourage employees to live a healthy and active lifestyle, some of our offices feature on\-site fitness centers. For eligible employees we typically reimburse fees paid for a fitness club membership or activity (up to a pre\-approved amount). Child Care \& Family Care We offer on\-site child care centers that provide full\-time and emergency back\-up care, as well as mother and baby rooms and homework rooms. In every office, we provide advice and counseling services, expectant parent resources and transitional programs for parents returning from parental leave. Adoption, surrogacy, egg donation and egg retrieval stipends are also available. Benefits at Goldman Sachs Read more about the full suite of class\-leading benefits our firm has to offer. Opportunity Overview CORPORATE TITLEVice President OFFICE LOCATION(S)New York JOB FUNCTIONSoftware Engineering DIVISIONGlobal Banking \& Markets SALARY RANGEUSD 130,000 \- 260,000

processing, and halt or quarantine failures. * Reconcile data across Databricks layers and against downstream outputs such as pricing tools, at the portfolio, group, member, and claim level, using assurance with a strong focus on backend automated testing. * Hands\-on experience building automated data tests with Soda, dbt, or similar frameworks. * Strong SQL skills (Spark SQL a plus) and familiarity with Python. * Experience with Airflow or similar orchestration tools, and with Databricks or a similar lakehouse environment (Delta Lake). * Familiarity with version control and CI/CD. * Solid understanding of testing principles, including functional, integration, and regression testing, applied to data pipelines. * Excellent analytical, debugging, and root\-cause skills. * Strong learn and take on new responsibilities. Compensation may grow over time through merit\-based increases, promotions, and company\-wide adjustments. jobs.title: Senior Network Engineer
jobs.description: Harbor IT is a leading Managed Service Provider (MSP) specializing in delivering cutting edge Cybersecurity, IT, and Cloud Services to a diverse portfolio of clients. We pride ourselves on our commitment to excellence, innovation, and customer satisfaction. Harbor IT is backed by investment firm Worklyn Partners since 2022 and has built a national platform through acquisition and rapid organic growth. Our mission is to manage our clients’ technology and mitigate their cyber risks, so that they don’t have to. **POSITION OVERVIEW** The Senior Network Engineer is Harbor IT's technical authority for network design and delivery, owning the architecture, engineering standards, and delivery quality for networking engagements across the client portfolio. This role leads pre\-sales design work, drives complex network implementations, and sets the technical standard for Harbor IT's networking domain \- spanning LAN/WAN, wireless, SD\-WAN, network security, and next\-generation campus and branch architectures. The Senior Network Engineer has deep hands\-on expertise with Extreme Networks and Fortinet platforms, both of which are core to Harbor IT's networking stack and required experience for this role. Beyond delivery, this role contributes to the practice by developing standards, reviewing peer designs, mentoring junior engineers, and engaging clients as a trusted advisor on infrastructure strategy. The ideal candidate brings enterprise\-class architecture experience, strong vendor platform depth, and communication skills to operate effectively in both technical and client\-facing contexts. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** * Own network architecture and design across Harbor IT's professional services engagements including campus LAN, WAN, SD\-WAN, wireless, and network security deployments. * Serve as technical lead and delivery authority on complex network implementations \- providing hands\-on engineering support and directing engineers and field resources through project execution. * Lead pre\-sales solution design for networking opportunities including discovery sessions, architecture documentation, bill\-of\-materials development, and technical proposal support. * Design, configure, deploy, and validate Extreme Networks (campus switching, wireless, ExtremeCloud IQ) and Fortinet (FortiGate, FortiSwitch, FortiAP, FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer) solutions as primary Harbor IT\-supported platforms. * Develop and maintain Harbor IT's networking architecture standards, design templates, and configuration baselines to drive consistency and reduce delivery risk across the engineering team. * Conduct network assessments and health reviews for existing clients, producing findings reports and remediation roadmaps that translate technical risk into business language. * Collaborate with solutions architects and account managers during pre\-sales to validate scope, identify technical risk, and produce accurate statements of work. * Mentor and develop junior and mid\-level network engineers through project participation, design reviews, and direct technical coaching. * Maintain working knowledge of relevant vendor ecosystems including competitive platforms, licensing models, support structures, and roadmap direction. * Represent Harbor IT's networking practice in client\-facing settings including architecture reviews, executive briefings, and technology strategy discussions. **QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS** * Expert\-level hands\-on experience with Extreme Networks platforms including campus switching (EXOS/VOSS), wireless (ExtremeCloud IQ, AP series), and network management \- required. * Expert\-level hands\-on experience with Fortinet platforms including FortiGate firewalls, FortiSwitch, FortiAP, FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer, and FortiClient EMS \- required. * Strong architecture and design depth across LAN/WAN, campus networking, SD\-WAN, network segmentation, VLANs, routing protocols (BGP, OSPF), and next\-generation firewall policy design. * Demonstrated ability to translate business requirements into network architecture designs and produce clear, client\-ready documentation including diagrams, BOMs, and design rationale. * Experience leading network deployments as the senior technical resource \- coordinating field engineers, managing vendor resources, and validating final configurations against design intent. * Solid understanding of network security principles including zero\-trust segmentation, NGFW policy, NAC, and secure SD\-WAN as applied to enterprise and mid\-market environments. * Strong written and verbal communication skills \- able to present architecture recommendations to both technical and non\-technical audiences and contribute to pre\-sales proposals. * Comfortable operating in an MSP professional services environment with concurrent client engagements, billable utilization expectations, and cross\-functional coordination with PMs, architects, and account teams. **EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE** * Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Network Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline. Equivalent experience considered. * 7\+ years of network engineering and architecture experience, with at least 3 years in a senior architecture or lead engineer role. * Hands\-on Extreme Networks experience required. ExtremeCloud IQ or EXOS/VOSS certification strongly preferred. * Hands\-on Fortinet experience required. NSE 4 minimum required, NSE 7 or higher strongly preferred. FortiGate and FortiManager expertise essential. * Additional certifications a plus: CCNP (routing and switching or enterprise), CWNA/CWSP, SD\-WAN vendor certifications. * MSP or consulting delivery background preferred over pure enterprise IT \- experience managing multiple concurrent client environments is a meaningful differentiator. **WORK ENVIRONMENT** * Senior technical role within Harbor IT's Professional Services department, operating in an EOS\-managed, growth\-stage MSP environment with shared accountability across engineering, architecture, and project delivery functions. * Remote\-first with occasional travel to client sites for network assessments, project deployments, and architecture reviews \- infrequent but expected. * Direct client exposure across enterprise, healthcare, agribusiness, and defense\-adjacent verticals with complex, multi\-site network environments. **BENEFITS** * Competitive base salary commensurate with experience * Health, dental, and vision insurance * 401(k) with company match * Unlimited PTO Base salary 150\-175K range

Network Monitoring and Operational Efficiency*** **Develop automated network health checks, performance reporting, and operational dashboards.** * **Integrate automation workflows with monitoring and observability platforms.** * **Assist in automating incident response, alert enrichment, and routine remediation procedures.** * **Support network configuration compliance and drift detection.** * **Analyze recurring operational issues and recommend automation\-based improvements.** * **Improve network availability and operational efficiency through proactive automation.** **5\. Security, Compliance, and Change Management*** **Ensure automation solutions comply with organizational security policies and network standards.** * **Apply secure scripting practices, credential management, and role\-based access controls.** * **Support automated network configuration auditing and compliance reporting.** * **Follow established change management, testing, approval, and deployment procedures.** * **Maintain appropriate documentation and audit trails for automated network changes.** * **Collaborate with cybersecurity teams to support network hardening and vulnerability remediation.** **6\. Documentation and Collaboration*** **Create and maintain technical documentation for automation scripts, workflows, APIs, and operational procedures.** * **Develop standard operating procedures (SOPs) and troubleshooting guides.** * **Participate in technical design discussions, peer reviews, and automation planning sessions.** * **Collaborate with cross\-functional engineering t s.** * documentation and operating procedures.** * **Attention to Detail: Commitment to accuracy, testing, security, and operational stability.** * **Continuous Improvement: Willingness to learn new technologies and improve existing automation processes.** * **Accountability: Ability to independently complete assigned engineering tasks and communicate progress.** **Level 2 Engineering Expectations****The Network Automation Engineer II is expected to demonstrate the following capabilities:*** **Independently develop and maintain automation solutions of moderate complexity.** * **Troubleshoot automation failures with limited supervision.** * **Translate documented operational requirements into functional automation workflows.** * **Participate in automation design and Born in Y Combinator (S23\) and backed by a16z, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo with over $200M raised, we power critical operations for global enterprises worldwide. This is a strategic role, not a support role. Our customers are adopting a new kind of technology, and you will guide them from first deployment to a fully scaled AI operation. We are especially interested in candidates with a logistics background who can earn the trust of large, complex organizations and speak the language of their operations teams. What You Will Do * Own a portfolio of large enterprise accounts and act as the primary day\-to\-day and executive\-level contact. * Drive adoption and time\-to\-value by defining success metrics with each customer, such as resolution time, load coverage, calls automated, and cost savings. * Run regular business reviews that translate performance data into clear business outcomes and next steps. * Identify and lead expansion opportunities into new use cases, business units, and geographies, partnering closely with Sales. * Partner with forward\-deployed engineers and deployment strategists to scope, launch, and iterate on new workflows. * Monitor account health, anticipate risk, and lead renewals with a clear view of value delivered. * Capture customer feedback and turn it into actionable input for Product and Engineering. * Build repeatable playbooks, onboarding materials, and best practices as the Customer Success function scales. What You Bring * 4 to 7 years in Customer Success, Account Management, or a similar customer\-facing role at a B2B SaaS or technology company, with experience managing enterprise accounts. * **Preferred:** Hands\-on logistics, freight, or supply chain experience (for example at a freight broker, 3PL, carrier, shipper, or logistics technology company), ideally managing large, multi\-stakeholder accounts. * A track record of driving adoption, retention, and expansion, with comfort owning renewal and growth targets. * Strong executive presence and the ability to communicate with both operators on the floor and C\-level stakeholders. * Comfort with data. You can read usage and performance metrics, build a clear narrative around them, and recommend next steps. * Technical curiosity. You do not need to code, but you should be comfortable discussing integrations, APIs, workflows, and AI concepts with customers and engineers. * A bias for ownership and speed, with the ability to thrive in ambiguity at a fast\-growing startup. Nice to Have * Experience with AI, automation, or voice products. * Familiarity with TMS, WMS, or CRM systems. * Spanish, Portuguese, or another language, given our LatAm and international customer base. * Prior experience at an early\-stage or high\-growth startup. Why Join Us * Join a world\-class team of engineers and builders. * Backed by top investors including a16z, Y Combinator, Base10, Prysm Capital, and Eurazeo. * Have ownership and autonomy of projects and are encouraged to ship. * Comprehensive benefits including healthcare, dental, and vision coverage. * Competitive salary \+ equity in a high\-growth startup. Our Operating Principles **Extreme Ownership** We take full responsibility for our work, outcomes, and team success. No excuses, no blame\-shifting. If something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it is not “your job.” If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We do not wait for someone else to solve it. We lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us. **Craftsmanship** Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for “just fine.” We sweat the details because details compound. We aim to deliver jaw\-dropping outcomes by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build, even when nobody is watching. **We are “majos”** Be friendly and have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine and honest, but kind. “Majo” is our way of saying: be a good human. Be approachable, helpful, and warm. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego. **Urgency with Focus** Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. Move fast, but in the right direction. We prioritize ruthlessly, act decisively, and stay aligned. We are running a high\-speed marathon, not a sprint with no strategy. **Talent Density and Meritocracy** Hire only people who can raise the average; exceptional performance is the passing grade. Ability trumps seniority. We reward contribution, not titles or tenure. **First\-Principles Thinking** Strip a problem to physics\-level facts, ignore industry dogma, and rebuild the solution from scratch. We do not copy\-paste solutions. Compensation Range: $120K \- $180K

jobs.title: Civil Engineer - Water and Sewer (Perm/FT/Benefits)
jobs.description: Job Description Summary: An employee in this class, with general supervision from a higher\-level engineer, applies engineering principles to the planning, design, and construction of major projects, prepares specifications and contracts for proposed projects, and may serve as a supervisor in engineering projects. Job Description: Salary Range: $47,980\.00\-$156,678\.00/Annually **BUDGETED SALARY: $65,000\.00 \- $100,000\.00/Annually** Essential Duties: * Engages in the planning, design, and construction of water and sewer mains, plants, and pump stations. * Trains new personnel in planning, design, and management of water and sewer systems. * Reviews reports, designs, and construction plans prepared by consulting engineers to comply with County specifications and project objectives. * Prepares preliminary and final cost estimates for water and sewer projects. * Prepares specifications for different water and sewer system projects. * Prepares reports, designs, and construction plans for different water and sewer system projects. * Performs and/or reviews cost\-benefit analysis for different water and sewer system project alternatives. * Prepares different water and sewer system studies and reports, including but not limited to, water audit reports, Adequate Public Facility reports, water and sewer systems capacity reports, and sewer systems Infiltration \& Inflow studies. * Prepares, maintains, and analyzes different databases and spreadsheets of water and sewer systems to be used in different studies, reports, and hydraulic modeling. * Prepares, maintains, and calibrates GIS\-based water and sewer hydraulic models. * Interprets State and County ordinances, rules, regulations, and policies at a field level. * Acts as project manager on relatively complex planning, design, and construction projects. * Coordinates with the maintenance to conduct sewer pumping stations drawdown tests, fire hydrant tests, sewer cleaning, CCTV inspections, and sewer manhole inspections.
