Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities: * Thorough knowledge of engineering theory, principles, and practices as applied to the water and sewer systems planning, design, and construction, preparation of plans, specifications, and cost estimates for a variety of engineering projects * Knowledge of GIS\-based hydraulic modeling of water and sewer systems, design and construction management of water and sewer mains, pumping stations, reservoirs, water and sewer treatment processes, water quality management, and pollution controls * Knowledge of wastewater and water treatment, hydrology, hydraulics, water chemistry, and biology * Strong knowledge of the design and operation of sewer pump stations and water booster stations * Skill in interpreting and analyzing engineering designs, plans, and specifications, and resolving problems * Ability to review plans, specifications, and calculations prepared by consulting architects and engineers for completeness, accuracy, and engineering feasibility * Ability to perform engineering design work involving the analysis, selection, modification, and adaptation of standard engineering practices, methods, and techniques * Ability to prepare technical forms, reports, change notices, and other correspondence * Ability to collect and analyze data and compile reference material * Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with associates, developers, consulting architects, engineers, contractors, electricians, instrumentation technicians, and the public * Ability to stand for prolonged periods of time * Ability to bend, stoop, kneel, climb, or sit, depending upon work assignment * Ability to drive a County vehicle in carrying out some assignments. jobs.title: Principal RF Electrical Engineer
jobs.description: HawkEye 360 is seeking a Principal RF Electrical Engineer and Team Lead on the Space Team. The Space Team's mission is to design, build, and test small commercial satellites that provide revolutionary RF geospatial analytics. You will lead electrical and RF design of our space platforms, with emphasis on digital, analog, and power electronics design as well as RF payloads including Software Defined Radios (SDRs), RF front ends, and antenna systems. You'll oversee PCB design from schematic capture through layout and manufacturing while also defining and executing performance tests to verify mission requirements. You will lead a small team of RF and Electrical Engineers, providing technical guidance and mentorship while remaining hands\-on with design and test activities. This role requires strong Electrical and RF Engineering expertise, excellent communication skills, and the ability to work cross\-functionally with mechanical, software, payload, and systems engineering teams. **Your main responsibilities will be:** * Design digital, analog, and power electronics for satellite flight hardware while overseeing team execution of schematic capture, PCB layout, RF chain design, and power subsystem development to ensure technical accuracy and on‑schedule delivery. * Lead PCB design and layout activities with attention to RF design considerations including controlled impedance, grounding, shielding, power distribution, and signal integrity. * Establish engineering best practices, design standards, and review processes to maintain high reliability and consistency across all hardware designs. * Facilitate root‑cause analyses and corrective action efforts, aligning engineering teams around data‑driven problem solving for flight hardware anomalies. * Manage task planning, delegation, and technical roadmapping to ensure the RF/EE team meets program milestones from concept through flight qualification. * Work closely with PCB Contract Manufacturers (CMs) to ensure quality control and timely delivery of flight hardware. * Design and develop RF payload architectures and Software Defined Radio systems for space\-based RF collection missions. * Develop test procedures and automation scripts to characterize SDR and RF front\-end Performance. * Support spacecraft integration and testing efforts, including the design of Electrical Ground Support Equipment (EGSE), flatsats for functional testing, and satellite flight hardware testing. * Perform first article hardware unit testing, including reception inspection, burn\-in testing, thermal validation, and hardware checkouts. **Your skills and qualifications:** **Essential education and experience:** * Bachelor's degree in RF/Electrical Engineering or related field. * 10\+ years of hands\-on experience designing and testing RF electronics, including SDRs, mixers, filters, amplifiers, and receiver chains. * Expertise in PCB design and layout (Altium or similar) including schematic capture, component selection, and layout for mixed\-signal and RF applications. * Strong Understanding of power electronics, high\-speed digital design, and analog circuit design. * Strong understanding of RF fundamentals (impedance matching, S\-parameters, noise figure, linearity, etc.) and software\-defined radio architectures. * Experience using lab equipment such as Spectrum Analyzers, Network Analyzers, Signal Generators, Noise Figure Analyzers, and RF test chambers. * Hands\-on flight hardware experience (satellite integration, RF lab testing, prototyping, troubleshooting). * Experience handling ESD\-sensitive components and operating in cleanroom environments. * Strong communication skills to explain complex technical concepts to cross\-functional stakeholders. * 1\+ years of technical leadership, project leadership, or team lead experience. **Desirable:** * Experience working in the smallsat or space industry with RF payloads or communication systems. * Experience designing for radiation environments (TID and Proton) * Experience with version control (git) and modern engineering workflows. * Proficiency with Python, MATLAB, C\+\+, or other coding languages for RF analysis and test automation. * Experience with RF simulation tools (ADS, CST, Genesys, HFSS, Scikit\-RF, Emerge, or similar) and RF modeling. * Familiarity with CAD (NX, SolidWorks, etc.) to support electro\-mechanical integration. **Company Overview:** HawkEye 360 is equipping defense, intelligence, and national security leaders with mission\-critical signals intelligence to enable faster, better decision making. By detecting, geolocating, and characterizing radio frequency emissions worldwide, HawkEye 360 delivers trusted domain awareness and early warning indicators to the US Government and allied partners. Our space\-based collection, proprietary signal processing, and AI\-powered analytics transform knowledge of RF spectrum into a strategic advantage. Proven by operational mission success, HawkEye 360 is redefining how signals intelligence strengthens national and global security. *HawkEye 360 is committed to hiring and retaining a diverse workforce. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, making decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, national origin, age, veteran status, disability, or any other protected class.*

jobs.title: Architect-Network Engineer
jobs.description: **Lifepoint Health has an opportunity for an Architect\-Network Engineer!** **You must be authorized to work in the United States without employer sponsorship.** **Location: Remote** **Travel: Travel up to 25% (To facilities)** **Job Summary** The Network Security Architect is responsible for responsible for the enterprise architecture, design, and technical direction of Lifepoint Health’s network infrastructure across routing, switching, wireless, SD\-WAN, data center, and cloud connectivity in a large, distributed healthcare environment. This role is within the Network Engineering team, who has responsibility for translating business, clinical, and security requirements into scalable, resilient, and supportable network solutions. The architect develops and maintains network design standards, reference architectures, and technology roadmaps; leads design and pilot efforts for new and emerging technologies; and provides technical leadership, mentoring, and escalation support from other network teams. Working across Network Services, Network Security, Infrastructure, Cybersecurity, application teams, and vendor partners, this role ensures solutions align with the overall IT infrastructure roadmap and are delivered in partnership with Network Services for ongoing operational support. The position serves as a subject matter expert and trusted advisor to IT leadership, presenting solutions, diagrams, and cost analyses appropriate to technical, executive, and financial audiences. **Essential Functions** **Architecture \& Design** * Leads network architecture, planning, design, and engineering efforts across routing, switching, wireless, SD\-WAN, data center, and cloud connectivity, ensuring solutions are scalable, resilient, and aligned with the overall IT infrastructure roadmap and business needs. * Designs, pilots, and validates network solutions and new technologies, and supports their implementation with Network Engineering, Network Services, and other IT teams. * Evaluates emerging technologies and recommends adoption as they relate to the organization’s network strategy, including supporting business cases and cost analysis. **Standards and Governance** * Works with management to develop, communicate, implement, and maintain network design policies, standards, reference architectures, and procedures. * Ensures consistent design documentation and diagram standards, including high\-level diagrams for IT leadership and low\-level diagrams for engineering teams. * Participates in lifecycle and standardization planning for network hardware, software, and licensing to maintain supportability and reduce risk. **Collaboration and Stakeholder Engagement** * Collaborates with Network Services, Network Security, infrastructure, cybersecurity, and application teams to gain input and consensus and to deliver secure, compliant network solutions. * Builds and maintains relationships with the user community, remote IT staff, infrastructure teams, and vendors to understand business and clinical needs related to the design of new networking technologies. * Leads virtual whiteboard and design review sessions describing current state and solution options for given use cases. * Presents solutions in the format appropriate for the audience, including cost analysis for financial teams. **Technical Leadership and Support** * Supports department staff in the analysis, resolution, and documentation of network issues; analyzes and resolves complex errors escalated by Tier 1 \& Tier 2 teams. * Participates in major incident response and root cause analysis, and recommends design changes that prevent recurrence. * Coaches, mentors, and provides feedback to less experienced team members regarding departmental procedures, policies, and standards that pertain to Network Engineering. * Continually enhances knowledge of network architecture, emerging technologies, and company standards to support departmental objectives and professional growth. **Qualifications** **Education** * Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related technical field, or equivalent technical experience. * One or more intermediate to advanced industry\-recognized certifications preferred, such as Cisco CCNP/CCIE, Aruba ACMP/ACMX, Palo Alto Prisma SD\-WAN, Arista ACE, Fortinet NSE, or CompTIA Network\+. Current or previously held certifications are acceptable. **Experience** * Minimum of ten (10\) years of experience as a Network Engineer in a large\-scale inter\-network environment with proven complex network design experience. * Demonstrated experience developing network design standards, leading technical design initiatives, and delivering infrastructure projects at enterprise scale. * Additional experience with SD\-WAN solutions such as Palo Alto Prisma SD\-WAN, Viptela, Fortinet, or Meraki preferred. **Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities** * Established expertise with enterprise network technologies, including configuration of Aruba, A  architectures (802\.11\), and data center networking, including Ethernet topologies and network segmentation. * Expertise in routing protocols (OSPF, BGP, EIGRP, static routes) and SD\-WAN policy design with Palo Alto Prisma SD\-WAN, Viptela, Fortinet, or other SD\-WAN solutions. * Knowledge of firewall platforms, and of network security integration. * Knowledge of telecom services (MPLS, broadband, DIA) and of Azure and Google Cloud connectivity. * Experience with network management and observability platforms such as LogicMonitor, Aruba Central, Meraki Dashboard, and Prisma SASE/Strata Cloud Manager. * Working knowledge of network automation, scripting, and modern productivity tools to improve engineering efficiency and reduce manual effort. * Skilled in protocol analysis and problem determination. * Ability to manage projects, ensuring projects are clearly defined, systematically executed, and results oriented, in adherence with project management best practices, processes, and standards. * Established skills to coach and mentor less experienced Network Engineers. * Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to communicate technical information to technical and non\-technical audiences, including executive leadership. * Ability to work independently and in a cross\-functional team, providing appropriate and timely feedback to senior team members and management as required. **Organizational Expectations** * Maintains compliance with applicable regulatory requirements and supports hospital and department policies, procedures, and standards. * Consistently supports the mission, vision, values, and goals of the hospital and Lifepoint Health. * Acts in a positive, proactive, and professional manner when interacting with employees, leaders, physicians, patients, visitors, and community partners. * Maintains confidentiality, complies with HIPAA requirements, and handles sensitive business and patient information appropriately. * Demonstrates accountability for workplace safety and completes assigned education, training, and mandatory requirements in a timely manner. * Maintains required licensure, certification, and professional credentials, if applicable, in good standing. **Work Environment** * Remote based position * Business hours from 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. Monday through Friday (40 hours weekly)\- schedules may vary based on business necessity * Well\-lit, ventilated, and climate\-controlled office and hospital environments with routine office equipment. In hospital settings, the individual may be exposed to hazards and unusual elements that require appropriate safety precautions. * Travel up to 25% as required for business needs, including potential overnight travel by land and/or air. **EEOC Statement** “Lifepoint Health is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Lifepoint Health is committed to Equal Employment Opportunity for all applicants and employees and complies with all applicable laws prohibiting discrimination and harassment in employment.” We employ and provide care to people from all walks of life. We are committed to promoting healing, providing hope, preserving dignity and producing value with an inclusive workforce in which diversity is leveraged, respected, and reflective of the patients, family members, customers and team members we serve.Lifepoint Health is a leader in community\-based care and driven by a mission of Making Communities Healthier. Our diversified healthcare delivery network spans 29 states and includes 63 community hospital campuses, 32 rehabilitation and behavioral health hospitals, and more than 170 additional sites of care across the healthcare continuum, such as acute rehabilitation units, outpatient centers and post\-acute care facilities. We believe that success is achieved through talented people. We want to create places where employees want to work, with opportunities to pursue meaningful and satisfying careers that truly make a difference in communities across the country.

jobs.title: IT Manager
jobs.description: At Heart Aerospace we develop the ES\-30, a regional hybrid\-electric airplane with a capacity of 30 passengers, an electric zero\-emission range of 200 km and an extended hybrid range of 400 km. Heart is targeting type certification of the ES\-30 by the end of the decade. **Your mission** As IT Manager, you would be responsible for building and maintaining IT infrastructure that the Heart engineering team relies on to do their work effectively and securely. You will report to the Head of Software, inside of the Engineering Organization. You will own both engineering IT systems and corporate infrastructure, including the corporate network infrastructure and enterprise IT systems. Your primary objective is to work side by side with engineers to identify bottlenecks and friction in the development process, and solving those problems with creative and automated solutions. **Key responsibilities include but are not limited to:** * Own the IT roadmap and operating model for a fast\-moving startup including standards, priorities, tradeoffs, and delivery. * Partner with Engineering, Operations, and Finance to translate ambiguous needs into clear, pragmatic requirements and projects. * Design and operate enterprise IT systems, including identity and access management (IAM), document storage, conferencing systems, etc. * Build and maintain a mixed\-device environment across Windows, macOS, and Linux: provisioning, baseline configuration, patching, endpoint security, and device lifecycle management. * Own network and remote access architecture for office, lab and hangar environments. * Own SaaS and vendor lifecycle management: evaluation, procurement, license management, renewals, and security reviews. * Establish documentation and self\-service resources: onboarding guides, acceptable use policies, secure data handling, and IT SOPs. * Plan for scale. Define when to hire an internal IT Systems Administrator and which functions should remain with external support vs. brought in\-house. **You'll Bring These Qualifications:** * 7\+ years of progressive IT experience (systems administration, IT operations, or IT engineering), including ownership of core infrastructure. * Hands\-on experience with Windows and macOS administration and lifecycle management; practical experience supporting Linux users and workflows. * Experience implementing and administering identity systems (SSO, MFA) and access controls. * Working knowledge of networking fundamentals (VLANs/segmentation, firewalls, VPN/secure remote access, Wi\-Fi) in an office/lab setting. * Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English. * Passion for aircraft and Heart's mission. **These Qualifications Would Be Nice to Have:** * Experience with Microsoft 365\. * Experience with public cloud systems (AWS, Microsoft Azure, GCP). * Exposure to hosting commercial or in house developed engineering applications. * Experience managing vendors. * Experience in early\-stage or high\-growth environments where speed, pragmatism, and strong judgment matter. * Experience with SOC 2 or ISO 27001\. **Base Pay Range:** **$150,000****—****$180,000 USD**

jobs.title: Senior Network Engineer
jobs.description: **Position Title:** Senior Network Engineer **Location:** Indianapolis, IN **Starting Pay for position:** $100K \- $130K per year, depending on qualifications and experience. JOIN OUR TEAM! **About Herff Jones:** Indianapolis\-based Herff Jones is the leading provider of graduation and educational products and services designed to inspire achievement and create memorable experiences for students. Herff Jones’ products include class rings and jewelry, caps and gowns, diplomas and announcements as well as motivation and recognition programs. Focused on building long\-term relationships through a nationwide network of over 1,400 employees and sales partners, the professionals at Herff Jones have been helping elevate the student experience throughout the lifelong journey of education for more than 100 years. For more information about Herff Jones, please visit www.herffjones.com. **Your Opportunity:** The Herff Jones IT Team is seeking a Senior Network Engineer to join our Infrastructure Services team. This role is the senior technical owner of the enterprise network across our multi\-site, datacenter, and cloud environments: the person who designs it, keeps it resilient and secure, and drives it forward. The Senior Network Engineer partners closely with the Security, Systems, and Cloud Engineering teams and serves as the top escalation point for network issues. **Key Responsibilities:** Network Architecture \& Engineering * Design, implement, and maintain LAN, WAN, wireless, and datacenter networks across multiple sites, including routing, switching, SD\-WAN, and remote access. * Design and maintain secure hybrid connectivity between on\-premises sites and public cloud environments. * Identify and eliminate single points of failure and capacity constraints to improve network resiliency and scalability. * Develop and maintain network standards, reference designs, and documentation, including diagrams, IP address management, and configuration baselines. * Contribute to the multi\-year infrastructure roadmap for the network domain. Network Operations \& Incident Response * Serve as the senior escalation point for network incidents; lead troubleshooting and root cause analysis for Priority 1–2 issues. * Implement and tune network monitoring and alerting for availability, performance, and capacity. * Plan and execute network changes and maintenance windows, with rollback plans, following the Change Management process. * Participate in an on\-call rotation for after\-hours support. Automation \& Vendor Management * Automate configuration management, backups, and compliance checks using scripting and infrastructure\-as\-code practices. * Manage relationships with carriers and network vendors, ensuring services and deliverables align with internal architectural standards. * Support budget planning, hardware lifecycle forecasting, and circuit management. * Mentor engineers and support staff and contribute to cross\-training and knowledge sharing. Additional Responsibilities Other duties as assigned. **What You Will Bring to the Table:****Required Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Network Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent work experience). * 7\+ years of network engineering experience in multi\-site enterprise environments, including at least 3 years in a senior or lead role. * Expert knowledge of routing and switching (BGP, OSPF, VLANs, spanning tree), TCP/IP, DNS, and DHCP. * Hands\-on experience with next\-generation firewalls, site\-to\-site and remote access VPN, and network segmentation. * Experience with SD\-WAN, enterprise wireless, and hybrid cloud networking. * Strong troubleshooting skills, including packet capture and analysis, and experience with network monitoring platforms. * Scripting skills (Python or PowerShell) for network automation. * Disciplined approach to documentation and change management. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Industry networking certifications such as Aruba ACMP, AWS Certified Advanced Networking – Specialty, Cisco CCNP Enterprise or CCIE, Fortinet NSE 7, Juniper JNCIP, Microsoft AZ\-700, Palo Alto Networks PCNSE, or equivalent. * Experience with IT/OT or industrial network environments. * Familiarity with PCI DSS network requirements and with NIST or CIS frameworks. * Experience with network automation and infrastructure\-as\-code tools (e.g., Ansible, Terraform, or similar). * Experience directing network consultants or managed service providers. **Soft Skills:** * Strong problem\-solving and analytical mindset. * Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders. * Composure and sound judgment under pressure during outages and high\-severity incidents. * Collaborative and proactive attitude with a focus on continuous improvement. * Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. security through tenant isolation, service authorization, secure model loading, and protection of customer inputs and outputs. * Partner with ML and Platform Engineering teams to integrate security into infrastructure design and development workflows. ### **Cloud \& Platform Security** * Design, implement, and maintain security controls across Linux, Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure, networks, Identify and remediate vulnerabilities and configuration risks across production systems. ### **Security Operations \& Risk Management** * Develop and maintain detection and response capabilities for infrastructure and AI\-specific security threats. * Investigate and respond to potential credential compromise, unauthorized data access, model theft, and compromised workloads. * Conduct threat modeling and security assessments across AI/ML systems and infrastructure. * Build and execute a prioritized security engineering roadmap focused on measurable risk reduction. * Partner cross\-functionally to implement practical security improvements without compromising system performance, scalability, or reliability. **Requirements:** * Strong hands\-on experience in Security Engineering, Infrastructure Security, Platform Security, or a related technical discipline. * Deep understanding of Linux, Kubernetes, networking, and cloud infrastructure security. * Experience designing and implementing security controls across complex, distributed production environments. * Strong knowledge of identity and access management, workload isolation, encryption, secrets management, and least\-privilege principles. * Experience securing CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, and software dependencies. * Ability to identify, investigate, and remediate security vulnerabilities and infrastructure threats. * Proficiency in scripting or programming languages such as Python, Go, or Bash. * Experience partnering with Infrastructure, Platform, or ML Engineering teams to implement security solutions. * Strong technical ownership, sound judgment, and the ability to prioritize security risks in a fast\-paced environment. * A hands\-on, collaborative approach with the ability to independently drive security initiatives from design through deployment. **Compensation \& Benefits** * We offer a competitive and thoughtfully structured compensation package designed to align with impact, experience, and long\-term growth. * **Base Salary:** The anticipated salary range for this role is **$200,000 \- $300,000**, depending on experience, skills, scope, and location. * **Bonus:** This role is Bonus eligible and may participate in the Company's discretionary annual bonus program. * **Equity:** In addition to cash compensation, employees are eligible to participate in the company’s stock option program and share in Higgsfield’s long\-term growth. * **Benefits:** We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support employees professionally and personally, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a competitive 401(k) retirement plan with company matching, and additional benefits and perks. * The opportunity to work on ambitious AI products alongside a highly experienced, fast\-moving, and international team. * Significant ownership, direct impact, and opportunities for professional growth as the company scales. This is a **hybrid role based in the San Francisco Bay Area**. Team members are expected to work from our San Francisco office **three full days per week**, with the remaining days worked remotely and are expected to be available during agreed working hours and to maintain sufficient overlap with the relevant team’s time zone. jobs.title: Manufacturing Technician
jobs.description: **Job Overview** ---------------- The Manufacturing Technician provides hands\-on support to production operations through equipment setup, machine changeovers, troubleshooting, process improvement, and technical support. This role works closely with Manufacturing Engineering and production teams to optimize processes, support new tooling and equipment implementation, conduct process studies, and drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance safety, quality, and productivity. The starting pay for this position ranges from $20 to $25 an hour, depending on experience. **A Day In The Life** --------------------- Every day at Hubbell is different and you’ll contribute in many ways. On any given day, you’ll make a difference by: Operating, setting up, and programming CNC equipment while assisting operators and troubleshooting setup\-related issues. Reading, interpreting, and understanding blueprints, electrical schematics, and work instructions. Developing a detailed understanding of processes and equipment to identify and resolve process issues through troubleshooting, data analysis, and cross\-functional collaboration. Supporting process validation projects, including equipment set\-ups, engineering studies, and testing activities. Developing and updating manufacturing documentation and tracking process performance metrics. Supporting execution of projects including DMAIC, Lean, 5S, cost reduction, and continuous improvement initiatives. Inspecting completed jobs and ensuring work areas are clean and organized. Ensuring equipment remains in safe operating condition Verifying conformance of work to specifications delivering quality workmanship that meets engineering and customer requirements. Working in a timely, efficient manner to meet all daily performance objectives Maintaining tools and equipment in proper working conditions. Reading and understanding posted bulletins, regulations, rule books, manufacturer manuals, and other job\-related documentation. Setting up machines, changeovers, adjusting, and calibrating manufacturing equipment to support safe and efficient production. Troubleshooting equipment, tooling, process, and quality issues while performing root cause analysis and implementing corrective actions. Providing daily technical support to production teams to maximize productivity and minimize downtime. Performing preventive maintenance activities and minor equipment repairs. Conducting inspections and supporting quality initiatives to maintain product and process standards. Utilizing technical knowledge of CNC programming, precision measuring instruments, GD\&T, SPC, Lean Manufacturing principles, and ERP/MRP systems. (Preferred) Following instructions; both written and verbal; from the lead person and production supervisors. Following all safety procedures and wearing required PPE. Must be able to work overtime as required. **What will help you thrive in this role?** ------------------------------------------- High school diploma or equivalent. Associate degree preferred. . A minimum of 3 years experience as a technician or operator in a manufacturing environment. Physical Requirements Ability to stand and walk for extended periods (Full shift). Ability to frequently: reach, grasp, push, pull, twist and bend. Occasionally: kneel/squat. Ability to Grasp/Lift/Push/Pull/Carry up to 35 pounds. Ability to wear required personal protective equipment (PPE). Ability to perform repetitive motions. Work Environment While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly exposed to work near moving mechanical parts. The employee is occasionally exposed to vibration. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate. Ability to work in an environment with airborne dust, noise, and temperature fluctuations. **Hubbell Incorporated** Hubbell creates critical infrastructure solutions that power our customers, communities, people and the planet. Our company is strategically aligned around enabling grid modernization and electrification. As more products plug in to an aging grid, Hubbell solutions enable the transition to a more reliable, resilient and efficient energy infrastructure. Founded in 1888 our innovation has made us a leading global manufacturer of high quality electrical and utility solutions enabling customers to operate critical infrastructure reliably and efficiently. The company operates in two segments. Hubbell Utility Solutions (HUS) enable the grid to conduct, communicate and control energy across utility applications and Hubbell Electrical Solutions (HES) are essential to managing power across a wide range of industries and applications. Our vertical market solutions can be applied to markets including Data Centers, Renewables, Commercial Buildings, Industrial, Telecom and Transportation. Supporting both of our business segments is our corporate and Hubbell Unified Business Solutions teams that provide consistent process, tools technologies across our businesses. We are committed to operating sustainably and ethically while promoting an inclusive and supportive culture for our people to grow and develop in their careers. Our employees proudly work and serve our communities from our headquarters in Shelton, CT, across the United States and around the globe. **Hubbell Utility Solutions** Hubbell Utility Solutions (HUS) enable the grid to conduct, communicate and control energy across utility applications. HUS provides the critical components that allow the grid to reliably transmit and distribute energy, as well as the communications and controls technologies to make the grid smarter and more flexible. jobs.description: **What We Do:** Cybercrime is growing, and more businesses are getting hit by threats that used to target only the biggest organizations. Every day, you can see that commitment in how we stand with our customers and how we show up for each other. **Reports to: Engineering Manager** **Location: Remote US** **Compensation Range: $200,000 \- $220,000 base plus bonus and equity** **About the Team** Huntress protects the small and mid\-sized businesses that attackers assume can't afford a security team. The Detection Platform team builds the engines and pipelines that turn billions of raw telemetry events into the signals our 24/7 SOC acts on. Every detection Huntress ships, across endpoint, identity, SIEM, and third\-party EDR, runs through systems this team owns. We measure ourselves on two things: time to detection and detection engine uptime. **About the Role** We're hiring a Staff Software Engineer to help build and rebuild these systems without disrupting the SOC that depends on them, and to make their behavior predictable under load. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role: you'll lead major workstreams, set direction that other engineering teams build against, and write and review production code every week. **What You'll Own** * **Detection engine and pipeline modernization.** We're rewriting our detection engine to support the full Sigma v2 specification, including stateful correlation of patterns across many events over time. In parallel, we're reworking several existing detection pipelines and building new ones, moving off the bespoke per\-product detectors we've accumulated and onto a common platform. You'll lead major workstreams across both and own the validation approach that proves a reworked pipeline still behaves like the one it replaces, so we can turn old paths off knowing we haven't lost anything. * **Reliability and behavior under load.** A detection pipeline that quietly stops producing signals is worse than one that crashes loudly, and detection volume spikes for reasons we don't always control. You'll build the guarantees that make quiet failure impossible: end\-to\-end latency measurement, liveness coverage, and alerting that fires when expected work stops arriving. You'll also build the mechanisms that keep a spike bounded and recoverable. * **Event schemas and data contracts.** Our schema and transformer layer are what several other engineering teams build their detections against. You'll help drive toward a coherent internal standard and build the validation and drift\-detection tooling that catches upstream changes before they break detections. **What We're Looking For** **Required** * Deep experience designing, building, and operating production distributed systems at scale, primarily in Go, with the range to work across several layers of the stack. * You have replaced or substantially re\-architected a live, high\-throughput system without breaking its consumers, and you can walk us through how you proved the new path was equivalent, staged the cut\-over, and decided it was safe to retire the old one. * Experience with high\-volume event or data pipelines, and a good feel for how they behave under load: where things queue, where they fall behind, and what happens to correctness when they do. * Strong operability instincts. You design observability in rather than retrofitting it, and you've built alerting that catches the absence of expected work, not just errors. * Demonstrated technical leadership across team boundaries. You've set a direction that other teams had to build against and raised the engineering bar around you, without needing positional authority. * Judgment about production quality: when a system is good enough to ship, when it needs more evaluation, and when it shouldn't ship at all. * Hands\-on experience with AI coding tools, and a point of view on using them well, where correctness is a security outcome. **Strongly Preferred** * A background in security operations or security engineering: time spent writing or tuning detections, or working in a SOC. You know what makes a detection maintainable, how fast noise erodes a SOC's trust in its tooling, and why a missed detection is a different class of failure than a noisy one. * Experience with detection\-as\-code or other rule\- and DSL\-driven systems, including the parsing and evaluation work that supporting a specification properly entails. * Experience building platform tooling for non\-engineer authors such as rule writers, analysts, and researchers, where the product surface is a language, an API, and a feedback loop. * Ruby on Rails experience. Some of our pipeline and application code is Rails, and you'll occasionally read and review Ruby. It's a nice\-to\-have, not a requirement; we'll help you ramp. **Our Stack** You'll work primarily in Go across our detection engines, pipelines, and the services around them, with Kafka, Temporal, Redis, ClickHouse, Elasticsearch, and Kubernetes across AWS and Azure. Some of our pipeline and application code is Ruby on Rails. Detection logic is written in Sigma. We don't expect prior experience with all of it, and we're not screening on the list; Go is the one language we'll assess directly in interviews. jobs.description: **Job Title \- Design Engineer** **IMI plc** We are a global specialist engineering company that creates breakthrough solutions. Climate Control offers hydraulic solutions for water\-based heating and cooling systems to achieve a perfect indoor climate with minimal energy consumption. Our leading brands have been used in over 100,000 building projects worldwide and offer products and solutions in three key areas: Pressure maintenance and water quality, regulation, control and actuators, and thermostatic control. **Role Overview** The Design Engineer will support IMI Climate Control’s Americas business by developing, adapting, and sustaining engineered product solutions that meet regional customer, application, regulatory, and manufacturing needs. This role applies established engineering principles with increasing independence, partners closely with global engineering teams, and helps translate global platforms into practical solutions for the Americas market. The role offers the opportunity to contribute to new product development, product localization, design improvements, technical problem solving, and cross\-functional project execution with colleagues across engineering, product management, operations, quality, and commercial teams. **Work Environment:** On\-site **Key Responsibilities** * Develop and maintain product designs, drawings, models, specifications, and engineering documentation in alignment with IMI standards, customer requirements, and applicable regional codes or market expectations. * Partner with global engineering teams to adapt global product platforms, design practices, and technical standards for Americas\-specific applications, installations, and customer requirements. * Support engineering projects from concept through release by completing design calculations, design reviews, prototype support, validation activities, and change documentation. * Collaborate with product management, operations, quality, supply chain, and commercial teams to resolve technical issues, improve manufacturability, and support delivery of customer\-focused solutions. * Analyze product performance, field feedback, manufacturing data, and customer input to identify design improvements, cost reduction opportunities, and product reliability enhancements. * Prepare clear technical communication, design summaries, engineering change requests, and project updates for cross\-functional stakeholders in the Americas and global engineering network. * Follow IMI engineering, quality, safety, and compliance processes while contributing to a culture of continuous improvement, technical discipline, and responsible business conduct. **Critical Competencies for Success** * Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Engineering Technology, or a related technical discipline; equivalent applied engineering experience may be considered where appropriate. * Applied design engineering experience with the ability to complete moderately complex assignments, make sound technical recommendations, and know when to escalate risks or decisions. * Strong working knowledge of engineering drawings, 3D modeling, product documentation, tolerance analysis, design for manufacturability, and engineering change control. * Experience designing products for HVAC systems, including an understanding of how products are applied in heating, cooling, and hydronic control systems. Familiarity with relevant industry requirements and legislation, such as pressure equipment guidelines, product safety expectations, material compliance, and regional certification needs, is important to ensure robust and compliant product solutions. * Ability to take initiative and work with a high degree of self\-leadership in a small local R\&D group, including identifying priorities, driving tasks forward independently, and seeking input or alignment when needed. * Ability to collaborate across regions, time zones, and functions, including working effectively with global engineering teams to align technical solutions to Americas market needs. * Clear problem\-solving approach, with the ability to evaluate technical data, identify root causes, compare options, and communicate practical recommendations to technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Customer and business orientation, with an understanding of how design decisions affect product performance, manufacturability, quality, cost, delivery, and regional competitiveness. * Ability to travel on a limited basis to support engineering reviews, supplier or manufacturing collaboration, customer applications, testing, or project implementation as business needs require. **What IMI Can Offer You** At IMI, one of our top priorities is to create an inclusive culture of health. Reasonable accommodations may be made for individuals with disabilities. Please contact the talent team to discuss the specific Work Conditions and Physical Requirements of this role. Master data is the foundation the business builds on—the parcels we evaluate, the addresses we serve, the customers we connect, and the network we operate—and this role owns that foundation: the platform that holds it, the governance that keeps it trustworthy, and the assurance that every team has the data they need to do their best work. leadership. **Location:** Jacksonville, FL preferred; remote considered **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** * Own the MDM platform roadmap, backlog, and priorities; make the tradeoff calls; and take part in architecture and design reviews, including sequencing technical debt against feature work. * Discover what stakeholders and data consumers across the business need, translate that into requirements, and validate that what is delivered meets them. * Coordinate delivery with the team that builds and maintains source integrations and platform features, keeping releases moving on a predictable cadence. * Own the company\-wide data governance framework for the core data domains: parcel, address, customer, service, and network. * Establish and maintain data ownership across the organization—defining which system is authoritative for which attribute, documented, versioned, and agreed—building consensus with source system owners, including the Manager, GIS, and escalating decisions that need senior leadership input to the sponsors. * Own the rules that turn source data into trusted golden records, including attribute mapping, authority, and identity resolution and matching. * Run structured working sessions with system owners, data stewards, and platform maintainers to agree the governance rules for each source, then verify the results against live data. * Define data quality standards, monitor performance against them, and partner with system owners to raise quality at the source. * Ensure changes flowing back to source systems are governed, audited, reversible, and human\-approved. * Establish data stewardship as a routine function—defining the roles, daily queues, service expectations, and escalation path—and enable stewards and consumers with the training and documentation that keeps the program durable through role changes. * Serve data consumers across Commercial, Design, Network Operations, Finance, Support, and OSP—including downstream analytics and reporting—with clean, well\-documented data products, and onboard new data sources as the business adds capabilities and enters new markets, including markets added through acquisition. * Define and report the measures that show data health and program progress, in terms the business cares about. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in a relevant field, or equivalent experience. * 6\+ years in data product management, data governance, master data management, business systems analysis, or a closely related discipline. * Demonstrated ownership of a data platform, data product, or governance program from requirements through adoption, including establishing the ownership models, stewardship roles, quality standards, and operating rhythm that sustain it. * Strong understanding of master data concepts: golden records, survivorship and authority rules, entity resolution and matching, deduplication, lineage, and audit. * Working understanding of data architecture: relational and spatial data modeling, schema design and normalization tradeoffs, ETL and ELT patterns, and when synchronization should be batch rather than event\-driven. * Experience integrating and reconciling data across multiple operational systems, including REST APIs, webhooks, and event\-driven or queue\-based sync, and the failure modes that come with them (idempotency, retries, ordering, and reconciliation when a write\-back fails partway). * Familiarity with modern application development practices—version control, code review, CI/CD, environment promotion, and release management—enough to take part in a design review, judge technical debt honestly, and follow what an integration is doing in the code. * Fluency in SQL and the habit of working directly with data rather than relying on summaries. * Excellent written communication, including documenting a decision so that it survives turnover and putting a clear recommendation in front of senior leadership. * Ability to build alignment among stakeholders who do not report to you—across Engineering, Construction, Commercial, and Network Operations—and to make a decision and see it adopted. * Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information, including PII, with sound judgment and integrity. * Proficiency with Microsoft 365\. * Experience in telecommunications, utilities, broadband, or infrastructure development a plus. * Familiarity with geospatial or location data, and with parcel and address data in particular, a plus. * Exposure to platforms such as ArcGIS and Vetro FiberMap, an ISP billing or OSS/BSS system, or an address verification service a plus. * Experience with commercial MDM or data governance tooling such as Profisee, Informatica, Reltio, Collibra, or Alation a plus. * Working knowledge of Python (the language the platform is built in) a plus. * Experience with a modern analytics stack such as Snowflake, dbt, or Sigma a plus. * Experience building a data program in a high\-growth, multi\-market environment, including integrating data from acquisitions, a plus. * Certification such as CDMP, DGSP, or a recognized product management credential a plus. * Other duties as assigned. **What Success Looks Like** * Teams across the business work from one trusted source for parcel, address, customer, and service data, and trust it enough to make decisions on it. * Data ownership is clear: every core attribute has a named authoritative system and a named accountable owner, documented and agreed across the organization. * Data stewardship runs as a routine function, with daily queues worked to a known service level, and governed changes reach source systems accurately and safely—every one audited, reversible, and human\-approved. * Data quality is measured and improving, market over market, as the footprint grows. * New sources and newly acquired markets are onboarded on a repeatable path, and the data foundation actively supports building and delivering great networks to our customers. * Senior leadership has clear, current visibility into data health and program progress. jobs.title: Senior IT Engineer
jobs.description: **About InVita Healthcare Technologies** InVita Healthcare Technologies delivers the world’s most comprehensive human biologics software solutions managing blood, organ, and tissue workflows, enabling unmatched visibility and compliance to improve patient outcomes and save lives. Trusted by blood organizations, organ procurement organizations, hospitals, forensic laboratories, public health agencies, and government institutions worldwide, InVita's solutions empower organizations to fulfill their mission, optimize operations, and better serve their communities. Learn more at **invitahealth.com****.** **Job Title:**Senior IT Engineer **Department:**Information Technology **Reporting to:**Chief Information \& Security Officer **Location:** Baltimore, MD (Hybrid– In\-Office 3 days per week) **Hours of work:** Typical hours of work are from 8:30 AM until 5:30 PM local time Monday through Friday. Flexibility of Working Hours dependent on location. Additional hours may be necessary as needed. This position is exempt from overtime. **Compensation:** $85,000 \- $100,000 annually. Range is commensurate with experience. **Position Summary** The Senior IT Engineer is a senior technical member of the global Information Technology team responsible for the administration, support, security, and continuous improvement of the company’s corporate technology environment. This is primarily a hands\-on technical position, with approximately 10–15% of the role dedicated to team coordination, operational leadership, and management responsibilities. The Senior IT Engineer serves as the designated second\-in\-command to the Global IT Manager and assumes responsibility for day\-to\-day IT operations when the Global IT Manager is unavailable. In addition to technical responsibilities, this position owns selected vendor relationships and contracts, coordinates defined IT initiatives, mentors other IT team members, and assists the Global IT Manager with maintaining consistent technology standards and operating practices across the company’s global locations. **Role Expectations** The Senior IT Engineer is expected to spend the majority of their time performing technical and operational work. Approximately 10–15% of the position will involve delegated leadership responsibilities, including coordinating team activities, managing selected vendors and initiatives, mentoring other IT personnel, and acting on behalf of the Global IT Manager when required. This position does not replace the Global IT Manager’s responsibility for overall IT strategy, personnel management, budgeting, and organizational leadership. Rather, it provides operational depth, technical leadership, and management continuity within the global IT organization. **Key Success Measures** Success in this position will be measured by the reliability and security of assigned systems, effective resolution of complex technical issues, quality and consistency of IT operations, successful management of assigned vendors, adherence to corporate technology standards, contribution to integration initiatives, development of other IT team members, and the ability to maintain effective IT operations when acting on behalf of the Global IT Manager. **Key Responsibilities** **IT Operations \& Engineering**: * Provide senior\-level administration and support for the company’s corporate technology environment. * Administer and maintain identity, endpoint, collaboration, networking, security, and productivity platforms. * Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues escalated from other members of the IT team. * Implement and maintain standardized configurations for corporate endpoints, applications, and infrastructure. * Manage user accounts, access permissions, authentication, endpoint configuration, and related lifecycle activities. Support employee onboarding, offboarding, equipment provisioning, account changes, and access reviews. * Identify opportunities to automate routine IT processes and improve operational efficiency. * Maintain appropriate monitoring, alerting, documentation, and operational procedures for supported systems. **Deputy IT Leadership:** * Serve as the designated second\-in\-command for global IT operations. * Act on behalf of the Global IT Manager during vacations, absences, or other periods when delegated responsibility is required. * Coordinate daily IT priorities, workload, escalations, and operational issues when acting for the Global IT Manager. * Provide guidance and technical direction to other IT team members. * Assist with prioritization and assignment of support requests, projects, and operational activities. * Escalate significant operational, security, personnel, or business issues to appropriate leadership. * Participate in IT planning, prioritization, and operational decision\-making with the Global IT Manager. * Provide continuity of IT leadership without removing the position’s primary focus on hands\-on technical work. **Vendor \& Contract Owners maintain system documentation, configuration standards, procedures, inventories, and operational runbooks. * Maintain accurate documentation for systems and services within assigned areas of responsibility. * Develop procedures that enable other IT personnel to effectively support systems and services. * Participate in problem management and root\-cause analysis for recurring or significant IT issues. * Recommend and implement improvements to reliability, security, supportability, and employee experience. **Qualifications** * Significant experience in information technology, systems administration, infrastructure, endpoint management, or a related technical role. * Demonstrated ability to independently manage and troubleshoot complex IT systems and services. * Experience supporting Microsoft 365, Entra ID/Azure AD, endpoint\-management platforms, and enterprise collaboration technologies. * Experience with Windows and macOS enterprise environments. * Working knowledge of networking, identity and access management, endpoint security, authentication, and cloud technologies. * Experience managing or coordinating third\-party technology vendors. * Ability to coordinate the work of other technical personnel and provide direction during operational issues. * Strong troubleshooting, organizational, documentation, and communication skills. * Ability to work effectively with employees and technical teams across multiple geographic locations and time zones. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with Microsoft Intune and Jamf. * Experience supporting geographically distributed or international organizations. * Experience participating in mergers, acquisitions, or technology integrations. * Experience within a healthcare, SaaS, technology, or regulated environment. * Familiarity with SOC 2, HIPAA, ISO, NIST, or similar security and compliance frameworks. * Experience managing technology contracts, licensing, and vendor renewals. * Microsoft, Apple, security, cloud, ITIL, or other relevant technical certifications. **Physical Demands and Work Environment:** The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the functions. While performing the duties of this position, prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer may be required. Additionally, the employee is regularly required to talk or listen. The employee frequently is required to use hands or fingers, handle, or feel objects, tools, or controls. The employee is occasionally required to stand, walk, sit; reach with hands and arms; climb or balance; and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 15 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this position include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, and the ability to adjust focus. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate. *This job description in no way states or implies that these are the only duties to be performed by the employee(s) incumbent in this position. Employee(s) will be required to follow any other job\-related instructions and perform any other job\-related duties requested by any person authorized to give instructions or assignments.* *This document does not create an employment contract, implied or otherwise, other than an "at\-will" relationship.* *InVita provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.* **The pay range for this role is:** 85,000 \- 100,000 USD per year(Maryland)

jobs.title: Full Stack Developer, Digital Services
jobs.description: **Full Stack Developer** **Base Salary**: $145,000 **Location**: Seattle, Denver, Minneapolis, Charlotte **Work Model**: Onsite **Travel Requirements**: 10\-15% travel required **Reports To**: Senior Full Stack Developer, Manager **About Indigenous Pact PBC, Inc:** Established in 2017 Indigenous Pact PBC, Inc., a certified B\-Corporation, set out on a mission to create health equity for American Indians and Alaskan Natives. As part of a global movement of certified B\-Corporations, we aim to balance purpose and profit by meeting the highest social, environmental, legal, and public standards to build a more sustainable and inclusive economy. Indigenous Pact's dedicated, experienced, and knowledgeable team brings decades of experience working in Indian Country. We help strengthen and improve the sustainability of Tribes and Tribal Organizations' health, wellness, and long\-term care programs and services. Indigenous Pact specializes in developing customized and turn\-key solutions to generate sustainable revenue, increase healthcare access, and improve health outcomes for all Native Americans. **Job Summary:** Indigenous Pact is seeking a talented and experienced Full Stack Developer to join our healthcare technology team. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable web applications using modern backend and frontend frameworks while advancing Indigenous Pact's healthcare technology platform and AI\-enabled capabilities. You will collaborate with cross\-functional teams to build innovative solutions that improve patient care, optimize healthcare workflows, and ensure compliance with healthcare standards and regulatory requirements. This role will help establish reusable application components, shared services, and development standards that can be leveraged across Indigenous Pact's technology ecosystem. The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering fundamentals with a passion for emerging technologies, intelligent automation, and practical AI solutions. **Essential Job Functions:** * Full Stack Development: Develop and maintain scalable web applications utilizing backend and frontend frameworks for dynamic and responsive user interfaces * Solutions Architecture \& Integration: Design scalable solutions and integrate applications with third\-party healthcare systems through APIs and interoperability services * Provider\-Facing Application Development: Design and develop applications that support clinical workflows, patient management, scheduling, documentation, and care delivery processes * Telehealth \& Digital Care Solutions: Develop and enhance telehealth applications, virtual care capabilities, remote monitoring tools, and integrated communication solutions * Enterprise Platform \& Automation Development: Develop shared services, reusable application components, automation capabilities, and development standards that support multiple solutions across the Indigenous Pact technology ecosystem * AI\-Enabled Solutions Development: Design, develop, and support AI\-enabled capabilities that improve care delivery, business operations, workflow automation, decision support, and user experiences * Cloud, Data \& Security: Develop secure, scalable healthcare applications leveraging cloud services while ensuring compliance with HIPAA and healthcare security standards * Testing \& Quality Assurance: Perform testing, code reviews, and quality assurance activities to ensure reliable, secure, and high\-performing solutions * Documentation \& Support: Maintain technical documentation and provide ongoing support for deployed applications and services * Innovation \& Continuous Improvement: Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend solutions that improve healthcare outcomes and operational efficiency **Required Skills/Abilities:** * Proficiency in modern frontend application development using React, Svelte, or equivalent frameworks * Proficiency in Python application development and modern backend development frameworks * Proficiency in SQL and relational database design * Experience developing and consuming RESTful APIs * Familiarity with Azure cloud services and modern application deployment practices * Experience integrating third\-party applications, APIs, and services * Strong analytical, debugging, and problem\-solving skills * Ability to design scalable, maintainable, and reusable software solutions * Experience with, or strong interest in, AI\-enabled applications, intelligent automation, and emerging technologies * Strong communication skills with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders **Education and Experience:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or related field preferred * 3\+ years of full stack software development experience building modern web applications * Experience designing, developing, testing, and supporting production web applications * Experience building and integrating RESTful APIs and third\-party services * Experience working with SQL databases and modern cloud\-hosted application architectures * Experience collaborating with business stakeholders and cross\-functional technology teams * Experience supporting healthcare, care delivery, or business applications preferred * Experience with AI\-enabled applications, intelligent automation, healthcare interoperability (HL7/FHIR), and/or HIPAA\-compliant solutions preferred **Physical and sensory demands:** * This position will require extended periods of sitting, typing, and working on a computer screen. * Close vision is required for computer work. **Working environment:** * Expected working hours of 8:00am to 5:00pm. * Occasional travel to Indigenous Pact work sites may be required. **Why Choose Indigenous Pact?** Building a strong culture and exhibiting our core values is important to us. When you join Indigenous Pact, you are joining a team that values: * **Empathy** is at the heart of everything we do—we listen, we understand, and we put ourselves in the shoes of others, whether it's our teammates, our clients, or the communities we serve. * **Wisdom** is about learning from experience, being thoughtful in our work and making decisions that are grounded in knowledge and insight. It's about taking the time to get things right. * **Bravery** is having the courage to take bold risks, challenging the status quo, and knowing that growth happens when we push our limits. * **Transformation** drives us to continuously grow—both as a company and as people. It's about not being afraid to change and to keep pushing forward in the pursuit of excellence. Visit our Careers page (https://www.indigenouspact.com/careers) where we encourage you to learn more about the characteristics that are important to us (and we hope you bring them as well) such as Healthcare\-focused, growth mindset, self\-motivated, collaborative, resilient and adaptable. Beyond the job opportunity and incredible culture, we also offer: * Indigenous Pact's PTO Policy includes vacation, wellness and 11\+ company\-paid holidays * Competitive benefits including 401(k), Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance * Open, transparent lines of communication with leadership * Committed to giving back to improving our communities and environmental impact * A development\-focused environment where you have autonomy to drive your career path *Indigenous Pact is an equal opportunity employer, and we are dedicated to fostering an inclusive and barrier\-free work environment for all employees and candidates. Preference will be given to qualified native applicants; however, all qualified individuals are encouraged to apply. Must be able to provide Indian Preference documentation if claimed. If accommodation is required during any stage of the recruitment process, please contact any member of our HR team. We thank all applicants for their interest; however, only those selected for interviews will be contacted.*

jobs.description: Posted Date 10/17/2026 Description Full\-stack Engineer 5 (Senior Manager, IC) Do you love building and pioneering in the technology space? Do you enjoy solving complex business problems in a fast\-paced, collaborative, inclusive and iterative delivery environment? At Capital One, you'll be part of a big group of makers, breakers, doers and disruptors who solve real problems and meet real customer needs. We are seeking **Full\-stack Software Engineers** who are passionate about leveraging cutting\-edge open source frameworks and emerging technologies. In this role, you’ll be at the forefront of driving a major transformation across Capital One. Risk Tech is responsible for transforming risk management into a real time, intelligent discipline powered by modern products and technical capabilities. Our mission is divided into two primary functional pillars: Risk Management Tech (RMT), which develops the frameworks and tools for monitoring risks, testing controls, and managing regulatory requirements; and AML and Compliance Tech (ACT), which ensure our products are delivered ethically and in strict compliance with BSA/AML regulations and global laws. Reinforcing these pillars are our commitment to Architecture \& Engineering Excellence. Our Architecture team bridges the gap between business strategy and technical execution through a customer centric, domain oriented lens, while our Engineering Excellence team empowers our talent to build better, more resilient systems every day. Together, we ensure that Risk Tech isn't just a safeguard\- it's a competitive advantage. **What You’ll Do:** * Lead a portfolio of diverse technology projects and a team of developers with deep experience in distributed microservices, and full stack systems to create solutions that help meet regulatory needs for the company * Share your passion for staying on top of tech trends, experimenting with and learning new technologies, participating in internal \& external technology communities, mentoring other members of the engineering community * Collaborate with digital product managers, and deliver robust cloud\-based solutions that drive powerful experiences to help millions of Americans achieve financial empowerment * Utilize programming languages like Java, Scala, Python, Go, Node.js, JavaScript and TypeScript, Open Source RDBMS and NoSQL databases, Container Orchestration services including Docker and Kubernetes, and a variety of AWS tools and services * Provide technical leadership across multiple teams, shaping system architecture and long\-term technology direction * Drive end\-to\-end design and implementation of large\-scale, distributed, or cloud\-native systems with high reliability and performance requirements * Partner with architects and product leaders to define platform roadmaps and shared services strategy **Basic Qualifications:** * Bachelor's Degree or higher in Computer Science or a related quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Engineering) * At least 6 years of experience in software engineering (Internship experience does not apply) * At least 3 years of experience with public cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure), cloud\-based productivity tools, or virtualization technologies **Preferred Qualifications:** * Master’s Degree in Computer Science or a related field * 9\+ years of experience coding with more than two of the following: Go, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Rust, C\#, Scala * 5\+ years of experience contributing to open source frameworks * 5\+ years of experience with front\-end JavaScript or TypeScript frameworks * 5\+ years of experience creating synchronous and asynchronous APIs * 4\+ years of experience with database and database management systems * 4\+ years of experience with AWS, GCP, Azure, or cloud\-based productivity tools or virtualization technologies * 4\+ years of experience with CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, and automated testing frameworks * 4\+ years of experience using Git\-based version\-control systems (e.g., Git, GitHub, Bitbucket) * 4\+ years of experience troubleshooting technical issues within cloud environments * 3\+ years of experience mentoring senior engineers and driving professional development within technical teams * 2\+ years of experience leveraging observability to identify and optimize performance bottlenecks in distributed systems * 1\+ year of experience leading architectural design reviews and influencing enterprise\-wide technical standards and methodologies * 1\+ year of experience establishing and enforcing coding standards and design patterns across teams * 1\+ year of experience implementing observability and reliability practices at scale * Experience leveraging modern AI\-based coding tools and IDE copilots * Experience influencing technology strategy at the portfolio or business unit level * Experience with interactive AI tooling to accelerate productivity, utilizing capabilities beyond basic code  nical standards and methodologies * 1\+ year of experience establishing and enforcing coding standards and design patterns across teams * 1\+ year of experience implementing observability and reliability practices at scale * Experience leveraging modern AI\-based coding tools and IDE copilots * Experience influencing technology strategy at the portfolio or business unit level * Experience with interactive AI tooling to accelerate productivity, utilizing capabilities beyond basic code completion * Experience leading cross\-functional engineering efforts or large\-scale technical initiatives ***Capital One will consider sponsoring a new qualified applicant for employment authorization for this position.*** The minimum and maximum full\-time annual salaries for this role are listed below, by location. Please note that this salary information is solely for candidates hired to perform work within one of these locations, and refers to the amount Capital One is willing to pay at the time of this posting. Salaries for part\-time roles will be prorated based upon the agreed upon number of hours to be regularly worked. Cambridge, MA: $229,900 \- $262,400 for Full\-stack Engineer 5 McLean, VA: $229,900 \- $262,400 for Full\-stack Engineer 5 Richmond, VA: $209,000 \- $238,500 for Full\-stack Engineer 5 Candidates hired to work in other locations will be subject to the pay range associated with that location, and the actual annualized salary amount offered to any candidate at the time of hire will be reflected solely in the candidate’s offer letter. Incentives could be discretionary or non discretionary depending on the plan. Capital One offers a comprehensive, competitive, and inclusive set of health, financial and other benefits that support your total well\-being. Learn more at the Capital One Careers website. Eligibility varies based on full or part\-time status, exempt or non\-exempt status, and management level. This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days.No agencies please.
