jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer II - Enterprise Foundations
jobs.description: **We're transforming the grocery industry** At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers. Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table. **Instacart is a Flex First team** There’s no one\-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in\-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work. **Overview** ============ Enterprise Foundations is the engineering team responsible for the architectural and integration work that allows Instacart's Retailer Platform to scale across the world's largest grocers. Our work spans omnichannel integrations — bringing products like FoodStorm catering and Caper Carts onto unified Instacart platform rails — enterprise extensibility (sandbox environments, configuration systems, retailer\-facing tooling), and the cross\-cutting data isolation work that allows Instacart's ML and Data Engineering teams to safely build bespoke models on top of the platform. As Instacart's enterprise retail business expands to hundreds of partner brands and new international markets, this team's work is foundational to how the platform matures. We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer II to own and ship one of the team's most complex multi\-quarter work\-streams — at the seam of omnichannel identity, international storefront search expansions, and partner\-owned integrations that we ultimately operate ourselves. You'll be the technical DRI for your area: framing the problem, designing the systems, driving the rollout, and codifying the patterns so the rest of Enterprise Platform can adopt them without your direct involvement. You'll work closely with Staff engineers on the team who set the team\-wide architectural thesis, and partner across Connected Stores, Professional Services, Commerce, Search, Data Engineering, and ML to land integrations that hold up across organizational boundaries. **About the Job** ================= * Own a multi\-quarter integration workstream end to end — for example, unified customer identity across FoodStorm and Storefront Pro, international storefront and search expansion for enterprise retailers, or consolidation of bespoke retailer\-vertical services onto shared Instacart platform rails — from problem framing through design, implementation, rollout, and deprecation of legacy paths. * Drive the technical direction for your area: write the ERDs, propose the options, make and defend the trade\-off calls, and bring partner teams along through design reviews and written artifacts that read clearly for first\-time readers. * Lead vendor and cross\-team integrations where Instacart will eventually own the system — push for the right observability, fallback behavior, and cost/latency guardrails up front, and challenge partner designs early rather than inheriting them at handoff. * Build reusable patterns, frameworks, and templates that other engineers across Enterprise Foundations and adjacent teams adopt with minimal hand\-holding; treat "system at a glance" docs and migration runbooks as first\-class deliverables. * Operate hands\-on as a senior individual contributor on the highest\-leverage technical work in your area; raise the bar on design quality, code quality, observability, and operational rigor. * Mentor more junior engineers in your area, delegate well\-defined implementation pieces while retaining overall technical ownership, and act as a credible technical peer to senior and staff engineers in adjacent organizations. **About You** ============= **Minimum Qualifications** ========================== * 7\+ years of backend software engineering experience, with a track record of owning complex, multi\-quarter projects end to end as a senior individual contributor. * Demonstrated ability to act as the technical DRI for cross\-team workstreams — framing problems proactively, proposing options with clear recommendations, identifying risks early, and driving execution through to adoption. * Experience designing and shipping distributed systems and integrations that span multiple services, teams, or external partners in a production environment with real customers. * Strong proficiency with backend technologies in production environments (e.g., Ruby/Rails, Python, Go, or similar), along with relational databases, distributed data systems, and cloud infrastructure (e.g., AWS or GCP). * Track record of producing durable technical artifacts — ERDs, design docs, runbooks, and reusable patterns — that other engineers can build on without ongoing direct support. * Demonstrated ability to operate in ambiguous, high\-growth environments where partner roadmaps and integration commitments are still maturing, with a record of driving clarity and forward motion through that ambiguity. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. **Preferred Qualifications** ============================ * Direct domain experience in commerce platforms, omnichannel retail, OMS, POS, catering systems, or connected\-store / in\-store technology. * Experience with customer identity, account linking, or SSO integrations across multiple consumer\-facing surfaces. * Experience building or scaling search, retrieval, or ranking systems, including integrations with third\-party search providers. * Background working on international expansion — localization, data residency, multi\-region infrastructure, or in\-country compliance requirements. * Experience leading vendor or partner\-owned integrations where the system is ultimately operated and owned by the integrating team. * Experience designing per\-tenant configuration, isolation, and extensibility for multi\-tenant enterprise platforms. \#LI\-Remote Instacart provides highly market\-competitive compensation and benefits in each location where our employees work. This role is remote and the base pay range for a successful candidate is dependent on their permanent work location. Please review our Flex First remote work policy here. Offers may vary based on many factors, such as candidate experience and skills required for the role. Additionally, this role is eligible for a new hire equity grant as well as annual refresh grants. Please read more about our benefits offerings here. For US based candidates, the base pay ranges for a successful candidate are listed below. CA, NY, CT, NJ $230,000 \- $242,500 USD WA $220,000 \- $232,000 USD OR, DE, ME, MA, MD, NH, RI, VT, DC, PA, VA, CO, TX, IL, HI $211,000 \- $222,500 USD All other states $192,000 \- $202,500 USD

Our scalable medical imaging platform connects clinicians to a powerful imaging ecosystem that is fast, smart, and tapped into the data they need, no matter their location. To learn more, visit intelerad.com and follow Intelerad on LinkedIn and Twitter. **Job Description** Role Overview The Database Manager leads the team responsible for designing, building, and operating the database architecture that powers Intelerad's medical imaging solutions. This role owns the database strategy and standards behind our PACS, RIS, and enterprise imaging platforms, ensuring the systems that store and serve healthcare data remain scalable, secure, and highly available. Beyond technical direction, this role builds and develops a high\-performing team of database engineers and architects — hiring, coaching, and setting clear goals that connect individual growth to team and business outcomes. The Database Manager partners closely with software engineering, DevOps, infrastructure, and product leadership to align database strategy with product roadmaps, and represents database considerations in decisions that affect system reliability and patient care. Key Responsibilities * Lead, hire, and develop a team of database engineers and architects, setting clear performance and development goals, conducting regular check\-ins, and building a team capable of supporting Intelerad's current and future database needs. * Own the database architecture strategy and standards for Intelerad's medical imaging platforms, ensuring designs are scalable, secure, capacity planning, and ensuring robust backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity practices are in place. * Establish and enforce database security protocols and compliance frameworks, infrastructure, and product leadership to align database strategy with product roadmaps, evaluate and select database technologies, and lead major migrations, upgrades, and modernization initiatives. **Qualifications** **Qualifications \& Experience** * 7\+ years of experience in database architecture, design, and administration * 2\+ years directly managing or leading database engineers or architects. * Demonstrated expertise with both relational databases (Oracle, PostgreSQL, SQL Server) and NoSQL databases (MongoDB, Cassandra) in large\-scale, high\-availability environments. * Proven experience setting database security protocols and compliance frameworks, with direct experience in healthcare data protection and HIPAA compliance. * Experience with cloud database platforms and services on AWS, Azure, or GCP, including database migration strategies and hybrid architectures. * Demonstrated ability to hire, coach, and develop technical talent, and to communicate database strategy and trade\-offs clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. **Preferred Qualifications \& Special Requirements** * Experience with medical imaging systems architecture (PACS, jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer – Power Systems & Battery Energy Storage (BESS)
jobs.description: **Mechanical Engineer – Power Systems \& Battery Energy Storage (BESS)** **Jelec USA \| Katy, TX (Houston Area)** **Job Type: Full\-Time \| On\-Site** **Help Engineer the Future of Power Infrastructure** At Jelec, we're developing innovative power solutions for some of the world's most demanding applications, including AI data centers, advanced Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), industrial power conversion, and distributed power generation. As demand for AI computing and reliable electrical infrastructure continues to accelerate, we're designing and manufacturing next\-generation equipment that supports high\-power energy storage, power management, and mission\-critical electrical systems. We're looking for a technically driven Mechanical Engineer with strong SolidWorks and sheet metal design experience who enjoys solving challenging engineering problems and turning innovative ideas into real, manufactured products. This is a hands\-on engineering opportunity where you'll work closely with electrical engineers, manufacturing teams, and project managers to develop equipment from initial concept through production, testing, and deployment. If you enjoy designing mechanical systems, solving complex packaging challenges, and seeing your designs come to life on the manufacturing floor, we'd like to hear from you. **What You'll Do** * Design and develop mechanical components, assemblies, and enclosures for battery energy storage systems, power conversion equipment, and industrial electrical systems. * Create detailed 3D models, assemblies, and manufacturing drawings using SolidWorks. * Design sheet metal components and assemblies, including cabinets, enclosures, frames, brackets, panels, and structural supports. * Develop manufacturing\-ready sheet metal designs that consider bending, welding, fabrication tolerances, assembly, and material utilization. * Design and optimize equipment layouts for electrical component integration, cable routing, cooling systems, and service accessibility. * Collaborate with electrical engineering teams to integrate batteries, power electronics, transformers, and other industrial equipment. * Support the mechanical design of liquid\-cooled and air\-cooled electrical systems, including thermal management and equipment packaging. * Generate bills of materials (BOMs), fabrication drawings, and engineering documentation. * Work directly with manufacturing personnel to address production challenges, improve designs, and optimize manufacturability. * Participate in prototype development, design reviews, equipment testing, and continuous product improvement. * Evaluate materials, fabrication processes, and mechanical designs to improve product performance, reliability, and cost. * Take ownership of mechanical design projects from concept through final production. **What We're Looking For** **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a closely related engineering discipline. * Minimum of 3 years of professional mechanical engineering experience. * Strong proficiency in SolidWorks, including 3D modeling, complex assemblies, detailed drawings, and sheet metal design tools. * Hands\-on experience designing sheet metal parts and assemblies for manufacturing. * Understanding of sheet metal fabrication processes, including laser cutting, bending, welding, and assembly. * Knowledge of geometric dimensioning and tolerancing (GD\&T), engineering drawings, and mechanical design principles. * Experience designing mechanical assemblies, equipment enclosures, cabinets, or industrial products. * Ability to develop manufacturing\-ready drawings and detailed bills of materials. * Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to work independently. * A practical engineering mindset with an understanding of how mechanical designs translate into real manufactured equipment. **Highly Desirable Experience** Candidates with experience in one or more of the following areas will receive strong consideration: * Industrial electrical enclosures, control cabinets, or power distribution equipment * Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) and battery cabinet design * Thermal management systems, liquid cooling, heat exchangers, and HVAC integration * Electrical equipment packaging and high\-power electronics integration * Containerized equipment and modular industrial systems * Structural design of equipment frames, skids, and support structures * Design for Manufacturing and Assembly (DFMA) * Sheet metal fabrication equipment and processes * SolidWorks PDM or other engineering document management systems * Design of equipment for outdoor environments, transportation, vibration, and industrial operating conditions * Industrial equipment manufacturing, testing, and product development Prior battery energy storage experience is not required. We are particularly interested in mechanical engineers with strong SolidWorks capabilities, sheet metal fabrication knowledge, and experience developing industrial equipment who are excited to apply their expertise to emerging energy technologies. **Why Join Jelec?** **Work on Exciting Technology** Help design and manufacture advanced power equipment supporting AI data centers, battery energy storage, and next\-generation electrical infrastructure. **Engineering Ownership** Our engineers have the opportunity to take projects from early design concepts through production and final testing. You'll see your designs transformed into real products. **Direct Connection to Manufacturing** Unlike roles where engineering and manufacturing are separated, you'll work closely with the people fabricating and assembling your designs. This creates opportunities for immediate feedback, continuous improvement, and hands\-on problem\-solving. **Technical Growth and Innovation** You'll encounter challenging mechanical design problems involving equipment packaging, thermal management, complex assemblies, and industrial manufacturing. **Competitive Compensation and Benefits** * Annual base salary: $100,000–$150,000 * Compensation based on demonstrated technical capability, SolidWorks proficiency, sheet metal experience, and ability to independently execute engineering projects * Medical insurance * Dental insurance * 401(k) retirement plan * Paid time off (PTO) **Who Will Succeed Here?** We're looking for someone who genuinely enjoys designing and building things. Someone who can take a concept, develop it in SolidWorks, understand how it will be fabricated, and work with manufacturing to make it better. You should be comfortable spending time both at your engineering workstation and on the manufacturing floor, collaborating with the teams responsible for building your designs. You don't need to come from the energy storage industry. You might currently work in industrial equipment, electrical enclosures, automation machinery, metal fabrication, power generation, or another manufacturing\-focused engineering environment. What matters most is your mechanical design capability, SolidWorks expertise, understanding of sheet metal fabrication, and desire to solve challenging engineering problems. If you're looking for an opportunity to make a meaningful technical contribution while working on cutting\-edge power and energy infrastructure, we encourage you to apply. **Join Jelec and help design the next generation of energy and power infrastructure.** Pay: $100,000\.00 \- $150,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Paid time off Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Engr, Software 1
jobs.description: To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology. **Group/Division** The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high\-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. KLA's Central Engineering organization is made up of nine Centers of Excellence (CoEs) spanning disciplines like automation, motion control, sensors, platform design, and packaging. Each CoE contributes not only technical deliverables but also deep expertise, best practices, and advanced tools that elevate both what we build—and how we build it. **What You'll Do** In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high\-impact work across your area of expertise. **Responsibilities** -------------------- Engineers in the Software team will be working on building and maintaining infrastructure vital for large scale experimentation and deployment of HPC solutions. Domains in which a successful candidate will be encouraged to chip in, will include, data management and data loading, support for machine learning and deep learning model training. jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description: Government technology has failed citizens, veterans, public servants, and service members for decades. Kaizen powers America’s application layer. We replace the legacy systems federal agencies run on with modern software, built with craft. The ticketing platform a resident uses to visit a presidential library. The marketplace DoW uses to procure counter\-drone systems to protect lives and critical infrastructure. The system a Veteran uses to access benefits. We build systems of record, of national consequence. Our AI\-native modules and harness allow us to do so in weeks, not years. This year, our revenue has grown 35x. Next year, our software will serve over 100 million Americans across dozens of federal agencies. Founded in 2022 and based in New York City and DC, Kaizen has raised $35 million from NEA, a16z, Accel, 776, and Carpenter Capital. **The Role** ------------ We built an internal tool called Bidbuddy. Before it existed, someone on our team spent eight hours a week scraping procurement sites, pulling RFPs by hand, and reading them to figure out which ones were worth chasing. Now one system does the scraping and the first pass of analysis. Those eight hours went back to the people doing the actual work of winning. That's one tool. We need many more, and most of them don't exist yet. Kaizen is about 40 people supporting software that reaches 40 million residents across 50\+ agencies in 17 states, and the only way that math holds is if the company runs on tools instead of hours. This role owns that. You'll go department by department, find where the time goes, and build the thing that takes it back. Sometimes that's an internal app. Sometimes it's an automation nobody notices. Sometimes it's teaching a team to use AI properly, which is often the highest leverage thing available. Then you roll it out and stay on it until people actually use it. We already have the list, and it's long. **Location** ------------ This is a hybrid role based out of our New York. Candidates must reside in New York or be able to commute to New York City to work out of our office at least four times a week (Monday \- Thursday). **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Own internal tools end to end, from the hallway conversation that surfaces the problem through architecture, build, rollout, and the week two fixes. * Build AI powered internal systems in the mold of Bidbuddy: document parsing and analysis, agentic workflows, automated research and routing, and tooling that turns hours of manual work into minutes. * Work directly with leads across Proposals, Customer Ops, Sales, Design, and Engineering to find where the time is going, and translate half\-formed asks into something worth building. * Drive AI enablement across the company. Every person at Kaizen should know how to get the most out of these tools. * Support the external analytics layer inside Kaizen's platform, so customers have clear, actionable data at their fingertips * Back up the deployment team during an implementation **What You'll Bring** --------------------- * 2 to 5 years of engineering, data, or applied AI experience, or work that makes the years irrelevant. Slope matters more than seniority * Something you built end to end that a team still uses today: an internal application, an automation, a tool that changed how people work. Not a prototype, not a demo * Genuine fluency with AI tools. You've shipped with them, not just explored them, and you can name where they failed you and how you caught it * Strong SQL and enough data modeling to work in an existing warehouse and ship a model when the job calls for it * The ability to take a vague problem from a non\-technical stakeholder and come back with the right scope, not the requested one * Low ego, high output. You do the unglamorous rollout work because that's what makes the build matter **Strong Candidates May Also...** --------------------------------- * Have built internal tooling at a company where the hard part was getting hundreds of people to change how they work * Come out of forward deployed or solutions engineering at an AI or developer tools company, where the job was making software work inside someone else's mess * Know N8N, Zapier, or similar deeply enough to have a view on when not to reach for them * Have built in government, healthcare, or another environment where getting it wrong has consequences **What Kaizen Offers** ---------------------- **Health \& Insurance** * 100% coverage across the board: medical through Oxford/United (Gold and Platinum PPO plans), dental through Guardian PPO, and vision through Beam — all fully covered for employees, with 100% coverage for dependents. * $100,000 in fully paid life insurance. FSA and Dependent Care FSA. * One Medical membership, on us — same\-day primary care, 24/7 virtual visits, and offices all over the city. * Fertility and family\-building support through Carrot. * 401(k) through Guideline, with a 2% company match. **Family \& Time Off** * 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave for birthing parents. 10 weeks fully paid for non\-birthing parents. * Unlimited PTO, with a two\-week minimum (we mean it when we say take time off!) * Closed for all federal holidays. * Company\-wide winter break the week of Christmas. * Company offsites throughout the year. **Office \& Remote Setup** * Up to $750 one\-time home office or desk setup stipend for NYC\-based employees. $500 for remote employees. * $50/month commuter benefit (company contribution). * Expensed lunch while in the office. * Dinner and Uber rides home will be expensed if you choose to work in the office past 7pm. * Company\-provided laptop of your choice. **Wellness** * NYC employees: Fully covered gym membership at Grindhouse — right across the street from our office at 47 W 17th St (and in Williamsburg). A $225/month value, on us. * Non\-NYC employees: $100 per month, dedicated to gym / physical fitness reimbursement. **Stipends** * $100/month utility stipend. * $250/quarter home cleaning stipend * $500/year professional development. * $250/year recreation. * $300/quarter pet care stipend. Compensation Range: $150K \- $200K

jobs.title: Enterprise Architect
jobs.description: Attention: Kapitus is aware that individuals posing as recruiters may be communicating with job seekers about supposed positions with Kapitus. Kapitus has received reports that the content and method of communication can vary, but messages may contain requests for payment (e.g., fees for equipment or training) and/or for sensitive financial information. Kapitus will **never** ask a candidate for employment for payment or financial information during the initial application or interview process. All open positions are posted in location specific employment portals available at www.kapitus.com/careersAll legitimate Kapitus job postings on employment sites will direct candidates to complete an application through these portals before completion of the hiring process. Candidates with additional questions or concerns regarding any recruiting communications or Kapitus' recruiting process in general should email **recruiting@kapitus.com** **Please note: This position is 100% remote for candidates residing in Virginia. Candidates residing in Maryland and Washington, DC are also encouraged to apply and must be willing to work a hybrid schedule from our Arlington, VA office.** Kapitus has helped small and midsize businesses access capital for two decades, funding roughly $2 billion to date and building toward $6 billion and beyond. We originate, decision, fund, and service financing every day across a growing set of products and partner channels. As we scale, we are investing in the technology foundation that growth depends on, and we are creating our first dedicated Enterprise Architect role to lead it. This is a build\-and\-shape role, not a maintain role. You will define the target\-state architecture for the entire lending lifecycle, stand up the architecture practice that keeps it coherent, and sequence the modernization that unlocks the next phase of growth. You will work shoulder to shoulder with engineering, product, data, and security leaders, and your decisions will reach the platform that moves real money for real businesses. **What You Will Do:** * Own the end\-to\-end architecture. Produce and maintain a living, current, AI\-crawlable map of how a deal flows from lead through decisioning, funding, servicing, and collections, and the systems, data stores, integrations, and owners behind it. Make it the single reference the whole organization trusts. * Set the target state and sequence the path to it. Define the modernization roadmap, including the core\-platform runtime uplift, decoupling decisioning from the core, the move toward a modern lending core, and the environments and infrastructure\-as\-code that let change ship safely. Sequence the work against the product roadmap so each initiative unblocks a business outcome. * Establish the canonical data model. Define Kapitus\-owned data models for the core decisioning inputs (credit bureau, cash flow, KYB), and a vendor\-adapter layer so data providers plug in behind a stable internal contract. This removes single\-vendor lock\-in and enables failover and champion\-challenger testing. * Integrate the data and AI architecture, and keep it coherent. Partner closely with the Chief Data and AI Officer's organization so the data platform, the analytics and reporting products, the cross\-team decisioning\-data pipeline, and the machine\-learning and model\-deployment lifecycle fit cleanly into the enterprise architecture. Hold the operational\-versus\-analytical data split (real\-time to the transactional store, analytical to the warehouse), define the ownership boundaries and contracts where data, engineering, and product meet so nothing sits orphaned between organizations, and maintain how that domain fits the overall picture as it evolves. * Lead integration and event\-driven architecture. Shape the API and eventing standards (REST, webhooks, event buses), the partner\-API contract, and the middleware that connects Salesforce, the core platform, AWS services, and third parties. * Design for security and resilience from the start. Make authentication, secrets management, least\-privilege, audit logging, disaster recovery, high availability, and observability first\-class attributes of every design, in a regulated\-lending context. * Stand up architecture governance. Run a lightweight, respected practice: architecture principles, decision records (ADRs) with real trade\-off analysis, a design\-review gate, and build\-versus\-buy and total\-cost\-of\-ownership discipline. Keep it enabling, not bureaucratic. * Partner, do not dictate. Bring product, engineering, the data and AI organization, and security into architecture decisions early through joint, rolling planning, and translate technical choices into business terms for executives and into clear guidance for engineers. * Govern responsible AI enablement. Shape the guardrails and standards for AI\-assisted development and for model deployment and governance, in partnership with the data and security organiza ility** – Up to 10% annually * **Health Insurance:** Comprehensive medical, dental, and employer\-paid vision plans through UnitedHealthcare (UHC), with various coverage levels available to meet the needs of our employees and their families. Additional perks through UHC include: Sweat Equity, free subscription to the Calm App, UHC rewards, Real Appeal, and Quit For Life. * **Flexible Spending Account:** Set aside pre\-tax dollars from your paycheck to pay for qualified out\-of\-pocket medical, dental, vision, pharmacy or dependent care expenses. * **Lifestyle Spending Account:** Employer sponsored post\-tax benefits that allow reimbursement for expenses related to physical, mental and financial well\-being. * **100% Company Paid Insurances:** Kapitus fully covers the cost of basic short\-term and long\-term disability insurance, as well as vision insurance, ensuring our employees have comprehensive protection without any personal expense. * **Voluntary Insurance:** Supplemental life insurance as well as enhanced short\- and long\-term disability coverage are available through Mutual of Omaha, providing additional security for our employees. Additionally, Colonial Accident and Hospitalization insurances are also available, offering further protection against unforeseen events. * **Paid Maternity and Parental Leave:** Beyond state\-mandated leave policies, Kapitus provides company\-paid maternity and parental leave, supporting our employees during important family milestones. * **Commuter Benefits:** We offer pre\-tax benefits on parking and commuter expenses to cover travel to and from work. * **LifeBalance Program:** Enhance your lifestyle with our LifeBalance membership, which offers discounts on outdoor activities, the arts, health, and fitness. Additional benefits include: + Pet and car insurance discounts. + Financial services such as LegalShield. + Relaxation and stress management tools. * **Plum Benefits Discount Program:** Access exclusive discounts on shows, travel, car rentals, and more, enriching your personal and family life. * **Tuition Reimbursement:** Pursue further education with up to $5,000 annually in tuition reimbursement, plus opportunities to attend relevant conferences and career development events. Managed through our LSA plan, Kapitus Academy. * **Travel Reimbursement:** We also offer travel reimbursement for all work\-related travel, supporting your involvement in career and personal development activities. * **Paid Time Off and Sick Time.** * **Retirement Benefits**: Our 401K plan is managed through Fidelity. To support your long\-term financial goals, the company provides a 25% match on your contributions, up to 6% of your annual salary. **About Kapitus:** Kapitus is one of the most reliable and respected names in small business financing. As both a direct lender and a marketplace built with a trusted network of lending partners, we can provide small businesses with the financing they need when, and how it is needed. We have spent our entire existence building a culture that makes us excited to come to work in the morning. Our company is fast paced, teammates need to be self\-directed and have an internal motivation to do the right thing, even when the right thing takes a lot of hard work. We show our teammates our appreciation by offering great benefits, competitive pay and solid opportunity for growth. **Company Mission:** At Kapitus, our mission is to help small business owners grow their organizations by providing tailored, transparent, and ethical financing solutions. We invest in every business owner's story and we are dedicated to building lasting relationships to champion their goals. We promise to keep the best interests of our clients at the center of the financing process by operating with transparency, fairness, and integrity. **Consideration will be given to qualified remote candidates residing in states where Kapitus and/or one of its subsidiaries has an established physical presence.**

jobs.title: Backend Software Engineer, SDK
jobs.description: **About LaunchDarkly Engineering** ---------------------------------- LaunchDarkly helps engineering organizations ship software and AI with speed, safety, and control. Our platform gives teams the confidence to release gradually, target experiences to the right audiences, learn through experimentation, understand what is happening in production, and respond quickly when risk appears. Our engineers build the systems, services, SDKs, developer tools, cloud infrastructure, and product experiences that make this possible. The work spans high\-scale distributed systems, reliable data and event pipelines, intuitive enterprise workflows, and AI\-powered capabilities that help teams manage the next generation of software delivery. LaunchDarkly's SDKs are used in systems that perform trillions of feature flag evaluations each day, giving our engineering work a direct connection to the reliability and customer experience of software around the world. As the company grows, we are expanding beyond traditional feature management into experimentation, observability, and AgentControl—helping customers control more of the software and AI lifecycle. That creates an unusually broad set of technical challenges, visible customer impact, and room for engineers to shape what comes next. We believe in the power of teams. We work with humility, openness, curiosity, and care; we value clear communication, thoughtful technical judgment, inclusive collaboration, and a strong sense of ownership. We encourage people to apply even when they do not meet every qualification listed below. We are interested in the experience, perspective, and potential you would bring to the role. **About the Job** As a Software Engineer on LaunchDarkly's SDK team, you will build the primary touchpoint that our customers interact with on a daily basis. You'll work with multiple technologies across our 35\+ SDKs while enabling customers of all kinds to feature flag their code. When working on our SDKs, you'd be contributing to much more than thin client wrappers. Our SDKs are feature\-rich agents with strong emphases on performance, concurrency, and resiliency \- all while following idiomatic practices for their tech stack. LaunchDarkly serves trillions of feature flags daily to customers all around the globe, and every flag is handled by our SDKs. This team has a major impact not only on our company, but on our customers (and their customers). We are growing fast and we need your help writing the next chapter in our story. #### **Responsibilities:** * Contribute to development for SDKs in supported platforms: + Implement new features and improvements to meet customer performance and resiliency requirements + Keep up to date with the latest development practices * Collaborate with our engineering and product teams to drive the implementation and release of major features * Actively maintain our open\-source repositories * Identify areas of improvement and advocate for best practices * Have an active voice in shaping both technology and product decisions #### **Basic Qualifications:** * Demonstrable experience building libraries and packages used by other developers * Polyglot background with an ability to context switch between languages quickly * 5\+ years experience with at least two of the following: .NET/Go/Ruby/Python/NodeJS/Java * Experience with the following is a plus: + C\+\+/Erlang/Haskell/Lua + AI SDKs + Observability SDKs + Mobile development * Strong computer science fundamentals * Committed to working in a communicative, collaborative environment * Self‐starter and problem solver, willing to solve difficult problems and work independently when necessary * Strong testing background: experience building unit, integration, load tests, and benchmarks * Experience writing production\-ready code with emphasis on quality and maintainability * Experience contributing to open\-source software #### **Logistics:** * This is a remote role, with opportunities to visit the office in the Bay Area, California, for team offsites * The SDK team is spread between Eastern and Pacific time zones #### **Highlights:** * You will work collaboratively with a team of highly experienced engineers who are amazing at the craft of engineering and building SDKs * Your contributions will be publicly visible as the SDK team develops LaunchDarkly's open\-source SDKs in public * LaunchDarkly uses our own SDKs. You will have opportunities working with the other teams within LaunchDarkly * In this role, you can learn about many programming languages and frameworks * You will have opportunities to strongly influence roadmap and prioritization **Pay:** *Target pay ranges based on Geographic Zones\* for Level 3:* * Zone 1: *San Francisco/Bay Area or NYC Metropolitan Area, Boston, Seattle* \- $171,200 \- $235,400\*\* * Zone 2: *Irvine, LA, Monterey, Santa Barbara, Santa Rosa, Austin, Portland, Philadelphia, Chicago \-* $154,100 \- $211,860 \*\* * Zone 3: *All other US locations \-* $145,500 \- $200,090 \*\* *LaunchDarkly operates from a place of high trust and transparency; we are happy to state the pay range for our open roles to best align with your needs. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location.* * *Within the United States, our geographic pay zones are defined by counties surrounding major metropolitan areas.* *\*\*Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), health, vision, and dental insurance, and mental health benefits in addition to salary.* #### **About LaunchDarkly:** Modern software delivery was supposed to be the foundation for a thriving digital business but reality has proven otherwise. Slow, inefficient development cycles, costly outages, and fragmented customer experiences are preventing developers from building their best software. The LaunchDarkly platform helps developers innovate on new features faster while protecting them with a safety valve to instantly rewind when things go wrong. Developers can target product experiences to any customer segment and maximize the business impact of every feature. And by gradually rolling out new application components, they escape nightmare "big\-bang" technology migrations. The LaunchDarkly platform was built to guide engineers to the next frontier of DevOps by: * Improving the velocity and stability of software releases, without the fear of end customer outages * Delivering targeted experiences by easily personalizing features to customer cohorts * Maximizing the business impact of every feature through the ability to experiment and optimize * Coordinating the release and optimization of software to provide consistent experiences across mobile platforms and device types * Improving the effectiveness and productivity of engineering teams, by providing insights into engineering cadence and stability At LaunchDarkly, we believe in the power of teams. The Lead manages the application security engineering team, sets the working standards that engineering teams follow, runs the AppSec tooling estate, and performs and directs application\-level testing. Strategy, budget, and executive reporting sit with the Global Enterprise Security Architect; the Lead is accountable for delivery against that strategy, for the technical quality of the program, and for the performance and development of the team. mean time to remediate, SLA adherence, and exception backlog • Maintain the application security exception and risk acceptance register, escalating material risk to the Global Enterprise Security Architect Technical Ownership • Own the AppSec tooling estate end to end: SAST, SCA, DAST, secrets scanning, and container and IaC scanning, including deployment, tuning, rule management, and pipeline integration • Lead tooling proof of concept exercises, define evaluation criteria, run technical bake\-offs, and produce recommendation documentation for architecture review • Perform and direct internal application penetration testing, manual code review, and threat modeling on Tier 1 and high\-risk applications • Triage findings across all sources, validate exploitability, remove false positives, and drive remediation with owning engineering teams • Manage third\-party penetration test scoping, vendor coordination, finding validation, and retest closure • Maintain and enforce guardrails for AI\-assisted development, including approved AI coding tools, agentic tooling, MCP server usage, and dependency provenance controls addressing supply chain and slopsquatting risk Team Leadership and People Management • Build, lead, and develop the application security engineering team, including onshore staff and LGCC offshore engineering resources • Own hiring for the function: role definition, interview loop design, candidate assessment, and onboarding • Conduct performance reviews, set individual objectives, and manage performance concerns in partnership with HR • Define career paths, technical skill matrices, and individual development plans for application security engineers • Allocate work and manage team capacity against the program roadmap and inbound intake demand • Provide technical mentorship on secure code review, exploitation technique, tooling operation, and finding write\-up quality • Provide input to headcount planning and offshore resourcing requests for review by the Global Enterprise Security Architect • Define runbooks, playbooks, and repeatable procedures so that AppSec operations are not dependent on individual knowledge • Manage day\-to\-day coordination and handoffs across US, UK, MENA, and APAC time zones Cross\-Functional Partnership • Partner with Engineering, DevOps, Platform, and Product teams to embed controls into delivery workflows with minimal friction to release velocity • Act a thically while staying true to our independent culture and empowered business model. platforms. * Design and implement Lakehouse architectures supporting analytics, business intelligence, and advanced data processing. * Evaluate existing data environments and recommend modernization strategies. * Partner with business stakeholders, engineering teams, and technology leadership to translate business requirements into technical solutions. **Databricks Implementation \& Engineering** * Lead the design, configuration, deployment, and optimization of Databricks environments. * Architect and implement data pipelines using Databricks, Apache Spark, PySpark, Python, and SQL. * Design architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold) and other appropriate data modeling frameworks. * Configure and optimize Databricks workflows, compute resources, and data processing performance. * Support migration of legacy data warehouses, ETL processes, and data platforms into Databricks. * Implement CI/CD processes, infrastructure automation, and deployment best practices. **Data Governance, Security \& Optimization** * Design and implement data governance frameworks utilizing Databricks Unity Catalog. * Establish data quality, lineage, access control, and security standards. * Ensure solutions meet enterprise security, compliance, and data management requirements. * Optimize platform performance, scalability, reliability, and cloud infrastructure costs. * Develop architectural documentation, technical standards, and implementation guidelines. **Technical Leadership \& Collaboration** * Serve as the subject matter expert for Databricks architecture and implementation. * Provide technical leadership and guidance to data engineers, developers, and cross\-functional teams. * Lead architecture discussions, design reviews, and technical decision\-making. * Collaborate with cloud infrastructure, DevOps, analytics, and business intelligence teams. * Identify opportunities to improve data accessibility, platform efficiency, and overall data capabilities. **Required Qualifications** * 8\+ years of experience in data architecture, data engineering, data warehousing, or related technical disciplines. * 3\+ years of hands\-on experience with Databricks, including designing and implementing enterprise solutions. * Demonstrated experience leading at least one end\-to\-end Databricks implementation, from architecture and initial setup through production deployment. * Strong understanding of Databricks Lakehouse architecture, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, and Apache Spark. * Advanced proficiency in Python, PySpark, and SQL. * Experience designing and implementing scalable ETL/ELT pipelines and data integration solutions. * Strong experience with at least one major cloud platform: Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform. * Experience with cloud\-based data storage, data warehouses, and distributed processing technologies. * Strong understanding of data modeling, data governance, data security, and performance optimization. * Experience migrating or modernizing legacy data platforms into cloud\-based architectures. * Ability to develop architecture diagrams, technical documentation, and implementation roadmaps. * Strong communication skills with the ability to collaborate with technical teams and business stakeholders. **Preferred Qualifications** * Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional or Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate. * Databricks Certified Data Architect (if applicable to current certification offerings) or other advanced Databricks credentials. * Experience implementing Databricks in multiple enterprise environments. * Experience with Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake Storage, AWS Glue, Amazon S3, or similar cloud services. * Experience with Terraform, infrastructure as code, and automated deployment pipelines. * Familiarity with dbt, Airflow, or other orchestration and transformation technologies. * Experience integrating Databricks with Power BI, Tableau, or other analytics platforms. * Understanding of streaming data architectures and real\-time processing. * Experience supporting machine learning, AI, or advanced analytics workloads. * Experience with enterprise data platform modernization initiatives. **What Success Looks Like** * Successfully architect and implement a production\-ready Databricks environment. * Establish scalable, repeatable, and well\-governed data architecture standards. * Deliver reliable data pipelines and integration frameworks that support enterprise reporting and analytics. * Improve data processing performance, accessibility, and operational efficiency. * Provide technical leadership that enables engineering teams to effectively develop and maintain solutions within Databricks. **Ideal Candidate Profile** The ideal candidate is a hands\-on architect who has personally designed, built, and implemented Databricks environments, rather than someone whose experience is limited to maintaining or developing within an established platform. They should be comfortable owning technical architecture decisions, guiding implementation teams, solving complex data challenges, and translating business needs into scalable enterprise data solutions.

jobs.title: Lead AI Platform Engineer
jobs.description: **Overview** ------------ A career with us means you’ll work alongside exceptional people and be empowered to reach your professional and personal goals. Our employees are at the foundation of what enables MassMutual to deliver on our purpose to help people secure their futures and protect the ones they love. We embrace the idea that we all are stronger and better through our support for one another. We strive to create a culture where employees feel valued and are celebrated for who they are. **Job Description** ------------------- **The Opportunity** MassMutual’s AI Platform Engineering team is seeking an impact\-driven AI Platform Engineer, to apply the AI platform where it matters most: improving how MassMutual builds and runs technology. Embedded directly with IT teams across the portfolio, you will diagnose where engineering and operational effort goes, design and hands\-on deliver AI\-enabled solutions across the full software development lifecycle, including cybersecurity, and prove the results with data. You will pair enterprise\-level strategy with deep implementation skill, turning what you learn in the field into reusable patterns and platform capabilities. **The Team** This is a unique opportunity to work on the team that builds and operates the platform powering MassMutual’s AI initiatives. The team operates at the intersection of cloud infrastructure, AI/ML systems, and developer experience—delivering foundational capabilities that shape how the entire organization builds and deploys AI. We partner closely with AI engineering, product, and cloud engineering teams across the enterprise, and we invest in growth through a culture of peer learning, candid feedback, and shared technical standards. This team is defined by a shared commitment to engineering excellence, clear documentation, and the kind of technical leadership that makes hard problems tractable. **The Impact** * Embed with IT portfolio teams and deliver outcomes hands\-on—work shoulder to shoulder with engineering and operations teams, moving quickly from discovery to working solution to production, in their real environments, toolchains, and constraints. * Apply the AI platform across the full SDLC—requirements and design, code generation and review, test automation, CI/CD, release, legacy modernization, and production support—to measurably improve build and run efficiency. * Build and ship the hard parts yourself—agentic workflows, integrations with existing engineering and operations toolchains, evaluation harnesses, and automation—then package successes into reusable accelerators, playbooks, and reference implementations other teams can adopt. * Embed security and responsible AI into every engagement—threat modeling for AI use cases, secure pipelines, access and secrets management, software supply chain integrity, audit logging, and human\-in\-the\-loop controls. Translate governance and compliance requirements (e.g., NIST AI RMF, OWASP LLM Top 10\) into practical controls teams can adopt without slowing delivery. * Define the AI\-enabled engineering strategy for the IT portfolio—assess workflows across teams, prioritize opportunities by measurable value, and translate them into a sequenced roadmap with clear business cases. * Establish baselines and measure results—define build and run efficiency metrics (e.g., cycle time, deployment frequency, quality, toil, incident volume, time to resolve, and cost), track adoption and return, and report outcomes to senior IT leadership. * Serve as the senior technical escalation point for the most complex adoption and integration challenges across teams. Run design reviews, provide deep technical feedback, and pair with engineers on the gnarliest problems. * Close the loop with platform engineering—translate field learnings into prioritized capability requests, ADRs, and design input that improve the platform, without owning core platform build. * Drive adoption through influence—lead change with directors and engineering leaders across the portfolio, communicate technical trade\-offs clearly to technical and executive audiences, and represent the platform to senior stakeholders. * Raise the technical bar across the organizationby mentoring leads and senior engineers, running enablement and communities of practice, and setting the standard for AI\-assisted engineering—without managing anyone directly. **The Minimum Qualifications** * 12\+ years total experience in software engineering, DevOps/platform engineering, SRE, security engineering, or solutions engineering, including 5\+ years at lead, staff, or principal level with multi\-team or enterprise\-wide technical scope. * Proven record of delivering measurable build and run efficiency gains in large, complex IT environments—from strategy through hands\-on implementation. * Forward\-deployed or customer\-facing engineering experience: embedding with teams, running discovery, shaping ambiguous problems into working solutions, and driving ad ifics of the assistance you need. California residents: For detailed information about your rights under the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), please visit our California Consumer Privacy Act Disclosures page. MassMutual will accept applications on an ongoing basis until such time as a candidate has been offered employment. The job description includes the main duties of this position, which may evolve over time. You may be required to perform other duties not listed. It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. Salary Range: $172,000\-$225,700 **Award\-Winning Culture** -------------------------- MassMutual is guided by a single purpose: We help people secure their future and protect the ones they love. As a company operated for the benefit of our members and participating policyowners, we are defined by mutuality and our vision to provide financial well\-being for all Americans. It’s more than our company structure — it’s our way of life. We are a company of people protecting people. Our company exists because people are willing to share risk and resources and rely on each other when it counts. We strive to build a thriving community where everyone is valued, included, and feels that they belong. At MassMutual, we Live Mutual. **How We Work** --------------- MassMutual’s flexible workplace approach combines the importance of connecting in person and the flexibility of working remotely. Our hybrid model puts collaboration first with employees coming in at least three days per week to our spectacular campus settings and also enjoying the flexibility of remote Fridays, company\-wide remote weeks, and a bank of flexible remote weeks to use throughout the year. **Benefits for the whole you (and your loved ones)** ---------------------------------------------------- There’s more to your life than your job and there’s more to your aspirations than a paycheck. We take a holistic view of compensation and benefits that provides the flexibility to create a healthy balance in your life for work, family, and community. We offer the benefits you’d expect, like medical, dental, 401(k), and generous vacation time, but we also offer ones you might not expect, like three paid days for volunteering, a $1,250 annual Well\-Being Wallet, and up to 320 hours of caregiver leave. Explore some of our offerings below. ### **Paid Time Off** * In addition to generous vacation time, paid holidays, and flexible holidays, MassMutual offers 'take care' time to care for yourself or someone you love—whether for physical illness or mental health. ### **Health \& Well\-Being** In addition to top\-line medical and dental coverage, personalized mental health solutions, on\-site and virtual health coaching, and much more, MassMutual reimburses employees up to $1,250 per year for eligible expenses supporting mental, physical, and financial well\-being. ### **Financial Well\-Being** In addition to competitive salaries and bonuses, educational assistance programs, and much more, MassMutual offers up to a 10% total 401(k) benefit, consisting of a 5% company match and a 5% annual contribution. ### **Taking Care** MassMutual offers generous maternity and parental leaves, as well as bereavement leave to mourn the loss of a loved one (and the employee defines 'loved one'). In addition, we offer up to 320 hours of caregiver leave to help employees support loved ones in times of need. ### **Giving Back** MassMutual offers three paid days for employees to volunteer with eligible nonprofits of their choice, and the MassMutual Foundation matches employee donation dollars to eligible nonprofit organizations up to $5,000 annually. ### **Commuter Benefits** MassMutual offers a Qualified Commuter Program through which eligible employees can pay qualified workplace commuting expenses with before\-tax dollars, as well as a commuter wallet option for employees based at Boston and NYC campuses.

The developer will work closely with product owners, data engineers, Foundry Ontology specialists, technology architects, and business stakeholders to translate user requirements into secure, maintainable, production\-ready solutions. **RESPONSIBILITIES** -------------------- ### **Solution Design and Development** * Design and develop application solutions on Palantir Foundry, with primary responsibility for the application and user experience layers built on top of the Ontology. * Build custom applications using OSDK, TypeScript, and React, integrating Ontology objects, relationships, Actions, and Functions to support structured data and unstructured content. * Leverage Foundry capabilities, including Workshop, Functions, and AIP, to streamline operational workflows, enable AI\-powered experiences, and support informed decision\-making. auditability, and policy enforcement across AI services and agents * Proficiency in Python, SQL, and modern data engineering practices, including CI/CD and Git\-based development. * Hands\-on jobs.title: Staff Software Integration Engineer
jobs.description: **Merlin (NASDAQ: MRLN)** is a publicly traded aerospace and defense company building a non\-human pilot to deliver full\-stack autonomy for any aircraft from takeoff to touchdown. The Merlin Pilot autonomy system powers a growing range of aircraft and mission profiles and has been proven through hundreds of autonomous flights from Merlin's global flight test facilities, including Kerikeri, New Zealand; Smithfield, Rhode Island; and soon, Bedford, Massachusetts. Headquartered in Boston, Merlin is expanding its organization to accelerate the development and deployment of its autonomy platform, helping customers solve some of aviation's most pressing challenges, from pilot shortages to improving flight safety. Backed by some of the world's leading investors prior to its public listing, Merlin continues to advance the certification and commercialization of autonomous flight across commercial and defense aviation. ### **About You:** You are a hands\-on systems software engineer who takes ownership of complex software and hardware integration efforts, from architecture through deployment and operation. You write disciplined, maintainable code and troubleshoot methodically across real\-time applications, Linux hosts, networks, and physical equipment. You work independently, collaborate across engineering disciplines, and help other engineers build on what you deliver. As part of Merlin’s Virtual Test Environments (VTE) team, you will own software connecting aircraft avionics, hardware\-in\-the\-loop test environments, simulation models, and flight\-test data systems. Your work will enable engineers to exercise aircraft systems before flight, observe their behavior, and capture and replay data to investigate issues. ### **Responsibilities:** * Own the architecture, development, and sustainment of real\-time I/O software and telemetry infrastructure supporting aircraft integration benches and simulation environments. * Develop modern C\+\+ software on embedded Linux targets to interface with avionics hardware, manage periodic execution and watchdogs, and integrate generated aircraft simulation models. * Develop and maintain hardware abstraction layers using UEI PowerDNA equipment, vendor SDKs, low\-level I/O APIs, and device drivers. * Integrate ARINC 429, CAN, serial, and discrete I/O using aircraft interface control documents; validate message encoding, signal mapping, update rates, and error handling. * Develop and maintain asynchronous Rust services that ingest multiple telemetry sources, synchronize and order samples, and stream data to flight\-test displays and recording systems. * Implement robust binary protocols and network interfaces using UDP, TCP, and messaging technologies such as ZeroMQ, accounting for packet loss, ordering, buffering, and client liveness. * Build capabilities for timestamp alignment, session recording, data retrieval, and simulation replay that make integration issues reproducible. * Maintain cross\-compilation, packaging, and deployment workflows for ARM Linux targets and Linux hosts, including Yocto SDKs, CMake, Debian packages, systemd, Docker, and Docker Compose. * Establish automated verification through unit tests, hardware integration tests, parser fuzzing, and Python\-based smoke tests and tooling. * Partner with avionics, aircraft software, flight dynamics, and flight test engineers to reproduce aircraft integration conditions in the lab and resolve issues across software and hardware boundaries. ### **Qualifications:** * Strong proficiency in modern C\+\+, including resource management, concurrency, error handling, and maintainable systems software design. * Experience developing timing\-sensitive software on Linux, including fixed\-period execution, watchdogs, thread synchronization, and reliable startup and shutdown. * Deep familiarity with Linux host and embedded systems, including services, permissions, networking, software builds, deployment, and system\-level diagnostics. * Experience integrating avionics or comparable hardware interfaces, including ARINC 429, and the ability to interpret and implement interface control documents. * Experience developing binary serializers and parsers, with attention to byte order, framing, validation, malformed inputs, and protocol compatibility. * Strong understanding of UDP/TCP networking and asynchronous data pipelines, including buffering, packet loss, ordering, backpressure, and connection management. * Experience with embedded Linux cross\-compilation and deployment using vendor SDKs and build systems such as CMake. * Proficiency in Python for engineering tools, test automation, and data\-processing workflows. * Experience developing Rust services, or substantial experience with asynchronous systems programming and the ability to become productive in Rust. * Experience with automated testing, continuous integration, Git\-based version control and code review, and Jira or comparable issue tracking. * Demonstrated ability to own  ur Boston lab to integrate and troubleshoot equipment. ### **Nice to Have:** * Direct experience with UEI PowerDNA/PDNA SDKs or comparable data acquisition and avionics interface platforms from vendors such as NI or Ballard. * Experience with async Rust using Tokio, channels, serde, and axum. * Familiarity with ARINC 429 labels, SDI/SSM fields, CAN messaging, MIL\-STD\-1553, and RS\-232/RS\-422 serial communications. * Experience with IRIG time, NTP, clock alignment, and timestamp\-ordered merging of asynchronous data sources. * Experience with Curtiss\-Wright IADS or similar flight\-test telemetry, ground\-station, or engineering data\-display systems. * Experience with Yocto SDKs, ARM targets, Debian packaging, systemd services, and Linux device\-driver development or troubleshooting. * Familiarity with flight dynamics and integrating generated six\-degree\-of\-freedom aircraft models into real\-time execution environments. * Experience with GoogleTest, pytest, parser fuzzing, and CI/CD pipelines such as GitHub Actions, including self\-hosted runners. * Experience with Docker\-based deployment on lab or edge systems, S3 data storage, and automated simulation replay workflows. * Experience with REST APIs, JSON schema validation, Cap’n Proto, SQL, or diagnostic interfaces using GL Studio, React, or HTML5\. * Aviation experience through professional work, flight simulation, or a pilot’s license. The compensation range provided is reflective of **base salary only**, and is a good\-faith estimate based on a wide range of factors. The actual offer will be determined by a variety of factors including the candidate's qualifications, skills, experience, education, and training. Highly competitive equity grants are considered part of Merlin's total compensation package. Additionally, Merlin offers top\-tier benefits for full\-time employees. This position is based on\-site at Merlin HQ in Boston, MA. Once you’re here, you’ll enjoy a variety of on\-site perks designed to make your workday enjoyable and convenient. These include catered lunches featuring a rotating menu of delicious options, an assortment of snacks to keep you fueled throughout the day, and a selection of beverages, including coffee, tea, and other drinks, to keep you refreshed. Our goal is to create an environment where you can thrive both professionally and personally. Merlin Labs offers an innovative, entrepreneurial, and team\-focused startup environment. We also offer a top\-notch benefits package (health, dental, life, flexible paid time off, and 401k with match) and work/life integration. Being part of the Merlin team allows you to become part of a small team that supports professional development while working together to achieve our mission. Merlin Labs is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, genetic information, sex (including pregnancy), gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, military service or obligation or disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law. All job offers are contingent upon the candidate passing background and reference checks. At this time, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or consider candidates who require visa transfers. Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future. In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire. If you require reasonable accommodation in completing an application, interviewing, completing any pre\-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to: people@merlinlabs.com Merlin Labs does not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than directly from candidates.

jobs.title: Principal Cloud Engineer
jobs.description: POSITION SUMMARY: This position leads the design, build, operation, and continuous improvement of MSD’s Amazon Web Services (AWS) cloud platform across manufacturing, commercial, CRO, and SaaS business segments, operating as a player\-coach who provides technical direction, sets standards, and develops engineers while remaining deeply hands\-on in architecting cloud infrastructure, automating delivery pipelines, and supporting production workloads. The Principal Cloud Engineer leads the Cloud Engineering and DevOps teams and partners closely with company stakeholders, Cybersecurity, Enterprise Systems, Software Engineering, the Methodical Mind product team, and the BAL CRO organization. The role champions automation, secure\-by\-design infrastructure, GxP and 21 CFR Part 11 alignment, and measurable business outcomes from MSD’s cloud investment. DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: * Lead, mentor, and develop the Cloud Engineering and DevOps teams: set technical direction, establish engineering standards and runbooks, conduct performance management and career development conversations, and recruit and onboard new talent. * Architect, build, and operate MSD’s AWS environment across multiple accounts using AWS Organizations, Control Tower, and a landing\-zone reference architecture; design for high availability, security, scalability, and recoverability. * Stay deeply hands\-on: write and review production Terraform, author CI/CD pipelines, debug production incidents, optimize cluster and database performance, and contribute code that the team will live with for years. * Own and evolve MSD’s Infrastructure\-as\-Code standard (Terraform preferred; CloudFormation and CDK as needed), including module libraries, state management, branching and review patterns, and integration with CI/CD. * Operate and extend MSD’s container and compute platforms (Amazon ECS, EKS/Kubernetes, EC2, Lambda, and serverless services) and the cluster\-management, ingress, observability, and security tooling around them. * Design and operate MSD’s cloud networking foundation — VPC, Transit Gateway, Direct Connect, hybrid connectivity to on\-prem (Nutanix AHV) and partner environments, Route 53, and edge services — in alignment with security and compliance requirements. * Own the CI/CD platform (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or comparable) and the developer\-platform tooling that accelerates delivery while enforcing required quality, security, and validation controls. * Partner with Cybersecurity on cloud security engineering: IAM, KMS encryption, secrets management, GuardDuty, Security Hub, AWS Config, vulnerability management, and SIEM (SIEMonster/Wazuh) integration; lead remediation of cloud security findings. * Lead Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices: define SLOs/SLIs, on\-call rotations and incident response, observability standards (CloudWatch, CloudTrail, OpenSearch, Prometheus/Grafana, distributed tracing), capacity planning, and disaster\-recovery testing. * Partner with Enterprise Systems, Software Engineering, Methodical Mind, and BAL Services teams on cloud\-native solution design, application onboarding, and migration patterns; provide architectural guidance and design reviews. * Support MSD’s regulated environment: ensure cloud platforms, deployment processes, and change\-control practices align with FDA 21 CFR Part 11, GxP, ISO 27001, and SOC 2 expectations; contribute to validation, audit, and assessment activities. * Manage strategic vendor relationships (AWS, IaC and platform tooling vendors, managed service providers) and serve as the senior technical voice in vendor architecture and capacity discussions. * Develop and own the cloud platform roadmap; partner with IS/IT leadership on multi\-year planning, budgeting, and capability investment decisions. EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS: * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, or related discipline; equivalent combination of education and experience considered. Master’s preferred. * Minimum 10 years of progressive experience in cloud engineering, infrastructure engineering, platform engineering, or DevOps roles. * Minimum 7 years of hands\-on AWS engineering experience across core services (EC2, ECS, EKS, Lambda, S3, RDS/Aurora, DynamoDB, VPC, IAM, KMS, CloudFront, API Gateway, Route 53, CloudWatch, CloudTrail). * Minimum 3 years of demonstrated people\-leadership experience: managing engineers (direct reports or formal tech leads), setting goals, conducting performance reviews, and developing team capability. * Strong, demonstrable Infrastructure\-as\-Code experience with Terraform (preferred), CloudFormation, and/or AWS CDK at scale, including module design and reuse, state management, and CI\-integrated workflows. * Deep experience operating containerized workloads on Amazon ECS and/or Amazon EKS (Kubernetes), including cluster lifecycle, autoscaling, ingress, service mesh, and platform tooling (Helm, ArgoCD, or comparabl tten and verbal communication skills, including the ability to articulate technical trade\-offs to executive audiences and external auditors and to author architecture decision records, runbooks, post\-mortems, and roadmap narratives. * A professional presence and strong interpersonal skills for interacting in a courteous, timely, and diplomatic manner with all levels of employees as well as other parties/stakeholders involved in the company to influence and drive consensus on cloud architecture, engineering standards, and platform adoption * Demonstrated propensity to be creative, collaborative, proactive, and self\-motivated in the execution and completion of assigned accountabilities. * Ability to provide day to day guidance/mentoring to others in a consistently supportive and collaborative approach. * Continuous\-learning mindset; tracks AWS service releases, emerging cloud\-native patterns, platform\-engineering practices, and AI\-assisted infrastructure tooling relevant to MSD’s roadmap. * Strong critical thinking and sound judgment in handling ambiguous, cross\-functional technical problems with competing priorities and regulatory constraints. PHYSICAL DEMANDS: * This position requires the ability to communicate and exchange information, utilize equipment necessary to perform the job, and move about the office and facilities. WORK ENVIRONMENT: * This position is performed in a traditional office environment, or a hybrid model. **COMPENSATION SUMMARY** The annual base salary for this position ranges from $131,600 to $205,625\. This salary range represents a general guideline as MSD considers other factors when presenting an offer of employment, such as scope and responsibilities of the position, external market factors, and the candidate’s knowledge, skills, abilities, education and experience. Employees may qualify for a discretionary or non\-discretionary bonus in addition to their base salary. These annual bonuses are intended to recognize individual performance and enable employees to benefit from the Company's overall success. **BENEFITS SUMMARY** At MSD, we offer a comprehensive benefits package to support our employees' well\-being and financial security. In addition to competitive salaries, our benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage, along with prescription benefits. We provide a 401(k) plan with company matching, flexible spending accounts, and company\-paid short\- and long\-term disability insurance as well as group life and accidental death and dismemberment insurance. Our offerings also encompass paid vacation, paid sick leave, paid holidays, and paid parental leave, along with an employee assistance program. Additional voluntary perks include a fitness club membership contribution, pet insurance, identity theft protection, home and auto insurance discounts, and optional supplemental life insurance. **EEO/AA STATEMENT** MSD is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where all individuals are treated with respect and dignity. The team partners across engineering, operations, and business functions to modernize data ecosystems and enable data\-driven decision making. **Position Overview:** Micron is seeking a Senior AI Automation Data Engineer to design, build, and scale modern enterprise data platforms that support AI, automation, analytics, and digital transformation initiatives. This role will focus on cloud\-based data solutions, enterprise data modernization, and the development of secure, governed, and AI\-ready data products! **Responsibilities:** * Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines and integration frameworks for structured and unstructured data. * Build and optimize cloud\-based data solutions using Snowflake and AWS and/or GCP technologies. * Lead modernization efforts by migrating legacy data platforms and implementing ETL/ELT architectures. * Develop AI\-ready datasets and data products that enable analytics, machine learning, generative AI, and automation initiatives. * Establish data governance, security, monitoring, and CI/CD standard processes to ensure reliable and compliant data platforms. **Minimum Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field. * 5\+ years of professional experience in data engineering, data platform development, or related subject areas. * 3\+ years of experience working with cloud\-based data ecosystems and enterprise\-scale data environments. * Hands\-on experience with Snowflake, AWS and/or GCP, SQL, and Python in production environments. * Experience designing ETL/ELT pipelines, implementing data warehousing solutions, and applying CI/CD and Infrastructure\-as\-Code methodologies. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience implementing modern data architectures such as Data Fabric, Data Mesh, or similar frameworks. * Experience supporting AI, machine learning, generative AI, or retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) solutions. * Hands\-on experience with at least one of the following: dbt, Apache Airflow, Databricks, Apache Spark, Kafka, BigQuery, or Redshift. * Experience working with vector databases, semantic search, knowledge graphs, or enterprise search technologies. * Previous experience supporting semiconductor manufacturing, industrial operations, or large\-scale enterprise environments.
