jobs.title: Senior Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description: **Overview** Are you a customer\-obsessed software engineer who is passionate about using AI to solve complex, real\-world problems? The Azure Engineering Operations (EngOps) team’s mission is to transform Microsoft Cloud customers into fans. Through deep engineering engagements with customers and teams across Microsoft, we analyze and amplify customer needs and drive improvements in cloud quality, security, and reliability. Our culture of growth mindset and empowerment is central to who we are and how we work. Our ACES CODE engineering team is building domain\-specific agents and intelligent services that are transforming Azure customer support and product quality, moving from reactive, human\-only workflows toward AI\-first systems that resolve customer issues and product repairs at Azure scale. We are seeking a Senior Applied AI Engineer to design, build, and operate production agentic AI services. In this hands\-on individual contributor role, you will translate customer and business problems into scalable technical solutions involving LLM orchestration, retrieval\-augmented generation, agent workflows, tool integration, and AI evaluation. You will write production\-quality code, own significant service components, lead technical execution within projects, and help other engineers adopt sound software and applied AI engineering practices. Every day, our customers stake their businesses and reputations on our cloud. You can help Azure EngOps provide the world\-class cloud services they need to succeed. Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees, we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day, we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. **Responsibilities** Design and build production AI services: Develop scalable agentic AI solutions using LLM orchestration, RAG pipelines, agent workflows, tool integrations, memory and state management, and human\-in\-the\-loop experiences. * Lead through hands\-on engineering: Write, review, test, and maintain production\-quality C\# and Python code. Build reusable components, reference implementations, and engineering patterns that accelerate team delivery. * Own end\-to\-end technical delivery: Translate customer support scenarios and product requirements into technical designs, then take solutions through implementation, testing, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. * Build evaluation\-driven AI systems: Develop evaluation frameworks using rubrics, golden datasets, simulations, judge models, and offline and online evaluation. Use measurable quality thresholds to guide agents from experimentation toward production operation. * Engineer for production quality: Ensure services meet requirements for correctness, reliability, availability, latency, scalability, maintainability, cost, and safety. * Implement secure and responsible AI patterns: Apply privacy protections, prompt\-injection defenses, least\-privilege tool access, identity and authorization controls, data boundaries, approval gates, auditability, and fail\-safe behavior. * Integrate with Azure services and data sources: Ground agent responses and actions in trusted, current signals by integrating with Azure data sources, APIs, and cloud\-native services. * Operate services in production: Implement CI/CD, automated testing, feature flags, staged rollouts, tracing, logging, metrics, and alerting. Diagnose production issues, participate in incident response, and drive corrective improvements. * Make evidence\-based technical decisions: Evaluate models, frameworks, prompts, retrieval approaches, and architectural options using experiments and production telemetry. Balance quality with reliability, latency, cost, maintainability, and operational complexity. * Drive measurable customer impact: Instrument solutions and use data to improve automation quality, case\-volume reduction, resolution time, engineering efficiency, and customer satisfaction. * Provide technical leadership within projects: Lead design reviews, resolve technical challenges, coordinate implementation across contributors, and align partner teams around shared interfaces and delivery goals. * Mentor and raise engineering capability: Support other engineers through code reviews, technical guidance, reusable documentation, and practical coaching in applied AI and production software engineering. * Collaborate across organizational boundaries: Partner with product managers, researchers, platform engineers, Azure service teams, and support\-domain experts to deliver durable solutions and shape future platform capabilities. **Qualifications** **Required Qualifications:** Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 4\+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C\+\+, C\#, Java, JavaScript, or Python OR equivalent experience.**Other:** Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings: Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud Background Check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Familiarity with Azure services (Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Azure Functions, Cosmos DB, or similar cloud\-native technologies).Experience building or integrating with LLM\-based systems (prompt engineering, RAG, or agent frameworks). Experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and production observability. Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, and system design fundamentals. Experience building and shipping agentic AI services or multi\-agent workflows in production. Experience with Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Agent Framework, or comparable enterprise AI platforms. Experience designing AI evaluation systems using rubrics, golden datasets, judge models, simulation, adversarial testing, and offline or online evaluation. Experience with RAG systems, including indexing, retrieval, ranking, grounding, citation, knowledge freshness, and access control. Experience implementing agent\-security patterns such as prompt\-injection defense, identity propagation, least\-privilege tool access, data\-boundary enforcement, approval gates, and auditable actions. Experience building reliable distributed services with strong standards for scalability, resiliency, performance, observability, and cost efficiency. Experience with infrastructure as code, container orchestration, feature management, and staged production deployment. Demonstrated ability to lead technical execution, influence design decisions, and mentor engineers without formal people\-management authority. Experience collaborating with product, platform, research, and partner engineering teams on complex co\-development initiatives. Strong business judgment and experience connecting engineering investments to customer and operational outcomes. Background in customer support engineering, supportability, diagnostics, or customer\-experience platforms is a plus. * \#EngOps \#EngOpsACES Software Engineering IC4 \- The typical base pay range for this role across the U.S. is USD $119,800 \- $234,700 per year. jobs.title: Senior Penetration Testing Engineer
jobs.description: **Overview** The Business Security Assurance Pentest Team tests Microsoft products and services in regulated industries, including commerce, healthcare, finance, HR and legal. More and more of these products are built on generative AI, AI agents, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations. As a **Senior Penetration Testing Engineer**, you'll find vulnerabilities across traditional systems and AI systems and help scale how we test them. Join us in this exciting opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry and help shape the future of cybersecurity at Microsoft. Your intelligence, creativity, and dedication will be key to elevating our organization's security standards. Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. In alignment with our Microsoft values, we are committed to cultivating an inclusive work environment for all employees to positively impact our culture every day. **Responsibilities** * Plan, research and run manual penetration tests that simulate real\-world attackers against Microsoft services, cloud infrastructure, identity, APIs and applications in regulated industries. * Test LLM\-powered and agent\-based applications for prompt injection (direct and indirect), jailbreaks, system\-prompt and sensitive\-data leakage, insecure output handling, misuse of tool and function calls, excessive agent permissions, and abuse of agent memory and context. * Assess the security of agents and MCP servers: tool permissions, authentication and authorization between agents and tools, trust boundaries between agents, and how far an attacker can get when an agent is compromised. * Assess the AI supply chain and data pipelines, including retrieval (RAG) data sources, vector stores, model and plugin provenance, and the risk of poisoned training or fine\-tuning data. * Chain findings across application, cloud, identity, and network layers into realistic attack paths that show business and customer impact. * Clarify priorities and dependencies across groups, explain key security issues to upper management, and work with partners to put fixes in place. * Use AI agents to speed up recon, triage and regression testing, with clear guardrails and human sign\-off. * Keep up with new attack research and turn it into team guidance, training and awareness across the Microsoft Security community. **Qualifications** **Required Qualifications:** * Master's Degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or related field AND 3\+ years experience in security or related field * OR Bachelor's Degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or related field AND 4\+ years experience in security or related field + OR equivalent experience. **Other Requirements:** Candidates must be able to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:* **Microsoft Cloud Background Check:** This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter. **Preferred Qualifications:** * 5\+ years of hands\-on penetration testing or red teaming across cloud (Azure, AWS, GCP), web and API, identity, and network. * Hands\-on experience assessing LLM applications or AI agents in production or pre\-production, using the OWASP LLM Top 10, OWASP Agentic AI guidance and MITRE ATLAS. * Understanding modern AI architectures: retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), agent orchestration frameworks, function and tool calling, MCP, and cloud AI platforms such as Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Amazon Bedrock or Vertex AI. * Strong coding in Python plus one or more of C\#, Go, PowerShell, JavaScript/TypeScript or Rust. Able to turn research into tools you can run in engagements. * Experience with tools such as Burp Suite Pro, Metasploit, Cobalt Strike or Sliver, AI tooling etc . * Familiarity with governance and regulatory frameworks relevant to regulated industries: NIST AI RMF, EU AI Act, ISO 27K, HIPAA, PCI\-DSS, SOC2 etc. * Experience with APT emulation, purple teaming, threat intelligence, or bypassing operating systems and security control mitigations, including AI guardrails and content filters. * Certifications such as OSCP, OSEP, GPEN, GWAPT or GXPN, and AI\-security credentials. * Strong teamwork, comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to mentor peers and learn new attack techniques quickly. You will implement user interfaces in React and TypeScript, while also contributing to the backend services and APIs — built primarily in Kotlin and Java and hosted on AWS — that power those experiences. You will consume and help design APIs, maintain a consistent, high\-quality user experience, and collaborate with User Experience, Product Management, Information Experience, and other development teams to provide features that bring value to our customers and help them secure their collaboration culture. **AI\-First Engineering at Mimecast** Mimecast is an AI\-first engineering organization. Our teams actively leverage AI\-powered development tools across all facets of engineering, from code development to testing, documentation, and operations. We're looking for engineers who don't just use AI tools but champion their adoption and establish new ways of working. **What You’ll Do:** * Implement full stack code for assigned projects — from front\-end interfaces to backend services and APIs — starting with well\-scoped pieces and growing toward owning small features end to end, with an eye toward supportability, testability, and a consistent user experience. * Write unit, integration, and system tests across the frontend and backend of your team's code. * Test, debug, and troubleshoot across the Incydr web stack, from the UI down to backend services. * Partner with teammates to ship end\-to\-end features spanning UI and services. * Contribute to infrastructure\-as\-code and help manage deployment of services owned by the team. * Assist with production issues and escalated customer questions for the web application and services owned by the team. * Participate in the team’s on\-call rotation to support production services and respond to incidents as needed. * Document code and review code and design docs from others. * Demo progress on team deliverables. * Participate in story mapping and authoring sessions. * Contribute to process improvement efforts within engineering. * Participate in design discussions and code reviews, asking questions, contributing, and accepting feedback. * Learn about new things and jobs.title: Project Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Description** **Mission Critical Group (MCG)** is an end\-to\-end power solutions and services provider that accelerates time\-to\-power and delivers scalable, resilient infrastructure for mission critical environments. By integrating engineering, manufacturing, modular deployment, and lifecycle services under one platform, we streamline execution and bring complex projects online faster \- without compromising performance. With a robust U.S. manufacturing network, MCG supports data centers, power generation, healthcare, oil \& gas, pharmaceuticals, semiconductors, and industrial facilities where uptime is non\-negotiable. Mission Critical Group designs, manufactures and provides value\-added services for customers requiring critical power solutions. Powering a new electric world for a brighter, more secure future. **Job Description** The Project Engineer provides technical support and coordination across the engineering portfolio to help meet customer, project, and production requirements. This role serves as a central coordination point among engineering, project management, sales, procurement, quality, production, customers, vendors, and external engineering partners. The Project Engineer organizes technical information, supports planning and prioritization, tracks schedules and deliverables, reviews drawings, models, bills of materials, calculations, and related documentation, and helps resolve technical issues throughout the project lifecycle. fabrication, assembly, and closeout. **Accountabilities:** * Provide technical coordination and support across the engineering portfolio, including new product, customer project, production support, continuous improvement, and sustaining engineering activities. * Support the planning, assignment, prioritization, scheduling, and delivery of engineering work performed by internal teams, external engineering firms, vendors, and contract resources. * Develop and communicate clear scopes of work, technical requirements, priorities, milestones, and expected deliverables for assigned engineering activities. * Serve as a technical coordination point among engineering, project management, sales, procurement, quality, production, customers, vendors, and external engineering partners. * Gather, organize, and distribute drawings, specifications, standards, customer requirements, design inputs, and other technical information needed to complete assigned work. * Track project status, engineering deliverables, open questions, decisions, changes, approvals, and due dates; identify risks or delays and escalate concerns to the appropriate leader. * Review drawings, 3D models, bills of materials, calculations, specifications, and other engineering deliverables for completeness, accuracy, consistency, manufacturability, and alignment with company, customer, and applicable engineering requirements. * Identify technical gaps, discrepancies, and nonconformities; coordinate corrections, approvals, and follow\-up actions with the responsible stakeholders. * Coordinate responses to technical questions, design changes, redlines, requests for information, shop\-floor feedback, and field issues to support timely resolution and accurate revisions. * Maintain organized project records, revision histories, transmittals, approvals, action logs, and other technical documentation throughout the engineering lifecycle. * Support engineering workload visibility, resource coordination, and communication of capacity, quality, responsiveness, and recurring issues to management. * Support continuous improvement by standardizing engineering handoffs, submittal requirements, templates, design\-review practices, and coordination processes. * Work collaboratively with internal and external stakeholders to ensure engineering outputs support safety, quality, engineering environment. * Perform other job\-related responsibilities as assigned. **Qualifications** * High School Diploma, equivalent, or any combination of education and experience that demonstrates the ability to perform the job duties * Two or more years of relevant engineering, design, drafting, manufacturing support, project coordination, or technical review experience preferred. * Familiarity with CAD systems, including SolidWorks, preferred. * Working knowledge of engineering design principles, technical documentation, drawing and model review practices, tolerances, bills of materials, change control, and manufacturing methods. * Ability to read, interpret, organize, and evaluate engineering drawings, 3D models, specifications, bills of materials, calculations, and P\&IDs for accuracy, completeness, and compliance. * Ability to apply independent technical judgment, identify design gaps or nonconformities, coordinate input from multiple disciplines, and recommend practical solutions. * Strong attention to detail. * Excellent time management skills, ability to self\-motivate. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to coordinate effectively across departments and with customers, vendors, and engineering partners. * Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite, required. * Understanding the forming of sheet metal work and capabilities preferred. * Ability to pass a background check and drug screen. **Additional Information** **A Note to our Recruitment Partners:** We really appreciate the interest, but MCG currently manages hiring through our internal team. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Atlas Clusters Security
jobs.description: MongoDB is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join the Atlas Clusters Organization. The organization is responsible for building MongoDB Atlas, our database as a service offering and fastest growing product. Atlas allows users to deploy fault\-tolerant, secure, globally distributed MongoDB clusters in just minutes. This includes developing software to interface with the three major cloud providers (AWS, Azure, and GCP) in order to bring security, durability, availability, and performance to all deployments of MongoDB. Atlas Clusters Security builds the security experience that Atlas customers depend on for mission\-critical applications. Across the organization we own cluster networking, data encryption, database authentication, and related controls. This role sits on the Encryption \& Compliance team. We own Encryption at Rest with customer\-managed keys (Bring Your Own Key) across AWS, Azure, and GCP, including private networking to customer key management systems. We also own the security and compliance work that lets Atlas serve highly regulated markets, including government offerings and internal credential management. You will design and operate these systems in production, lead fleet\-wide rollouts, and partner with customers when encryption or key\-management issues hit their clusters. This role can be based remotely within the U.S. in the Pacific, Mountain, or Central time zones only. ### **What you'll do** * Build and design new features for MongoDB Atlas * Contribute to and lead complex technical projects * Work closely with product and design teams, considering the user's perspective while building technical solutions * Work with customers and support engineers to fix issues * Collaborate with team members to develop our codebase, best practices, and design principles * Learn from and mentor other team members * Join an on\-call rotation to support Atlas' production services ### **We're looking for someone who** * Has at least 5 years of professional software development experience * Is skilled at writing large\-scale, distributed backend systems in a compiled language (Java, Go, etc.) * Has experience with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, GCP) * Has led the launch of a new feature and maintained it in production * Is eager to solve tough problems * Has excellent communication skills * Is curious, collaborative, and motivated * Nice to have: experience with cloud key management (KMS / Key Vault / Cloud KMS), IAM, private networking, or encryption in a production SaaS environment ### **Success Measures** * In 3 months, you'll have shipped code into production and collaborated with the team to solve tough problems * In 6 months, you'll have contributed to a large project and joined our on\-call rotation * In 12 months, you'll have designed new features, led development work, and become a go\-to expert on Encryption at Rest, customer\-managed keys, or a related part of the system ### **About MongoDB** MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB's unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud\-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi\-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure. With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI\-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we're powering the next era of software. Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It's what makes us MongoDB. To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we're committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees' wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. jobs.title: Senior Business Data Engineer
jobs.description: Nex is on a mission to help families rediscover the joy of movement. Created by parents for parents, Nex combines technology and play to deliver fun, social, and interactive experiences powered by natural body motion, encouraging kids and adults to move more, play more, and have fun together. Nex Playground, the company's award\-winning active play system, is purpose\-built to get families moving year\-round, with safety and privacy as core considerations in its intentional design. It is certified kidSAFE\+ COPPA compliant and built to support healthy, active play for all ages and abilities. Nex Playground features a growing library of 50\+ experiences, including motion and dance games, fitness and educational experiences, and Nex Originals. Content includes collaborations with partners like Hasbro, Sesame Workshop, and NBCUniversal. jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist
jobs.description: **About Nexon** Nexon America is a branch of Nexon Co., Ltd., a global video game publisher and leading developer of online virtual worlds for PCs, consoles, and mobile devices. Nexon proudly offers celebrated franchises like MapleStory and Mabinogi that have been enjoyed by millions of players for over two decades. When we founded our Nexon America branch in 2006, we made it our goal to bring those unique games to western players using a player\-first approach. We achieve that goal by applying our team’s outstanding free\-to\-play expertise and live game support to every decision, every day. But we’re committed to more than our games! Here at Nexon America, we’re all about open communication, diversity, mutual respect, and collaboration, so we can bring out the best in each other. Nexies find support, friendship, and career growth all in one place! And because we know a healthy work\-life balance is the key to happiness, Nexies also enjoy flexible hours, a hybrid work model, and extra perks like food trucks, happy hours, and team events. It’s why we’ve earned the Great Place to Work certification for 6 years running! We’re looking to expand our team with passionate individuals who want to learn, play, and grow with us. Ready for a new challenge? **Summary of Position** Nexon America is looking for a talented Sr. Data Scientist to help Nexon’s game business through data\-driven insights and solve critical business problems by developing advanced machine learning algorithms. The Sr. Data Scientist is passionate about games, analytics, and applying advanced data science techniques to improve player experience, retention, and monetization. The Sr. Data Scientist collaborates with our Data teams, Business teams, Security team, and other stakeholders to implement data science models into live production systems. The Sr. Data Scientist brings fresh perspectives to inform decision\-making toward better player experience by translating player voice into insights. We are currently working in the office 2\-3x a week in a hybrid work model. **Job Responsibilities** * Apply your expertise in quantitative analysis, data visualization and data mining to tell the story behind numbers and find relevant insights for partners and leadership * Build and evaluate the ML models and statistical methods to provide Insight \& Recommendation and solve the business problems * Establish scalable, automated processes for large scale data extraction, model development, model validation, model deployment, and its monitoring * Research and develop state\-of\-the\-art machine learning, data mining, statistical modeling solutions, and language models to understand game business and key business behaviors, such as player acquisition, retention, and monetization * Maintain clear and comprehensive documentation of the models and analysis results, and present the results to the stakeholders clearly and effectively * Work closely with other data scientists, data analysts, data engineers, and other stakeholders to understand project requirements, provide valuable insights, and advanced solutions. * Mentor other engineers and scientists and contribute to their growth by providing guidance and advice. * Lead the improvement of the team’s process. * Other duties as assigned **Work Experience** * 5\+ years of proven professional working experience as a Data Scientist or related field (Advanced degrees may substitute for part of the required experience.) **Education, Professional Training, Technical Training or Certification** * BS (MS/PhD Preferred) in quantitative discipline (e.g. Computer Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, or a related field) **Knowledge/Skills** * Expertise in machine learning and statistical analysis approaches such as classification, clustering, regression, statistical inference, collaborative filtering, natural language processing, experimental design, social networking analysis, etc. * Experience managing advanced analytics projects which solve complex analytical problems using data exploration and analysis skills * Experience working with unstructured data (e.g., text, logs, JSON, images) * Expertise in evaluating, automating, deploying, and monitoring models in production systems * A true passion for understanding customer behavior on\-platform and in\-game * Expert analytical and problem\-solving skills, plus the ability to innovate and work with strong initiative * Strong skills in statistical methods (e.g. hypothesis testing, time series modeling) * Strong SQL skills and strong Python skills; familiarity with Jupyter Notebook * Familiar with modern data platforms, and cloud systems (e.g. Snowflake, AWS) * Professional large language models and MLOps experience is a plus. * Online gaming experience is a BIG PLUS! Management has the right to add or change duties and job requirements at any time. **Nexon’s Benefits and Perks** We offer medical, dental and vision plans for you, your spouse or domestic partner and your children. Employees who enroll in the high deductible health plan receive an annual employer contribution to a health savings account and company paid hospital indemnity benefits. We also provide company paid life, AD\&D, short\-term and long\-term disability benefits as well as access to voluntary life and AD\&D for yourself and your dependents, flexible spending accounts, a 401(k) savings plan with a company match, and pet insurance. Nexies are encouraged to take advantage of our monthly wellness credit, participate in lunchtime yoga, and enroll in language classes. We host bi\-monthly catered lunches, monthly happy hours, and maintain a well\-stocked snack bar. To help you maintain a good work life balance, we offer paid time off, sick days, company holidays, and a year\-end break. Nexon is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, protected veteran status, or any other basis protected by applicable law and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability. **Compensation Description for Pay Transparency (annually)** The base salary range for this position in El Segundo, CA is $140,000 \- $180,000 annually. Our salary ranges are determined by market data based on position and level. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum salaries for that position. An individual’s pay is determined by factors including, but not limited to, a candidate’s qualifications, skills, experiences, relevant education or training, and location. Base pay is one part of the Total Rewards package that is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work. This role may be eligible for additional discretionary bonuses/incentives, however the salary range listed in this job posting reflects the base salary only. **Beware of Recruitment Scams** We have been made aware of fraudulent recruitment activities by individuals falsely claiming to represent Nexon America. Our recruiters will only contact you from official company email addresses ending in @nexon.com and will follow a formal interview process. **We will never** request for payment or personal financial information such as photos of government\-issued identification during the recruitment process or offer a job without a formal interview process. If you receive suspicious email, we advise you to mark the email as junk or spam, so your email provider will block future messages from the sender.

jobs.title: Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET), QA - AI Systems
jobs.description: **About Nexxa** =============== Nexxa is building the best AI systems for heavy industries, enabling machines, systems and operations to think, decide and act autonomously across manufacturing, large\-scale infrastructure, logistics and legacy environments. Our mission is to translate deep technical breakthroughs into operational reality, solving some of the hardest systems\-level problems in industry. **Role Overview** ================= We’re looking for a Senior / Staff SDET to own quality for Nexxa’s AI agent systems, combining deep test automation with hands\-on manual and exploratory testing. Our agents plan, call tools, and take multi\-step actions autonomously in industrial environments. You’ll write production\-grade code to build evaluation harnesses, simulation environments, and CI/CD quality gates, and you’ll also get hands\-on with the agents yourself: probing behavior, reviewing traces, and validating releases where automation alone can’t judge whether the agent did the right thing. You’ll work closely with ML engineers, backend engineers, and Forward Deployed Engineers to define what “good” looks like for an agent operating in high\-stakes industrial settings, then build and run the systems and processes that measure it continuously. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== **Automation and Infrastructure** * Design, build, and maintain test frameworks, evaluation harnesses, and regression suites for LLM\-based agents, covering reasoning quality, tool\-call correctness, task completion, and multi\-turn coherence. * Build automated pipelines that run evals and test suites on every model, prompt, or tool\-integration change, and integrate them into CI/CD as enforceable quality gates. * Develop simulators, mocks, and sandbox environments for industrial systems and tool APIs so agents can be tested safely, repeatably, and at scale. * Implement API, contract, integration, and end\-to\-end tests for the services, tools, and orchestration layers that agents depend on. * Develop performance, load, and reliability tests for agent workflows, including failure injection and resilience testing. **Manual and Exploratory Testing** * Perform hands\-on exploratory testing of agent behavior, including new capabilities, ambiguous or underspecified requests, long multi\-turn sessions, and unusual operational scenarios that scripted tests don’t anticipate. * Manually review agent traces and outputs to judge reasoning quality, appropriateness of actions, and safety, and use those findings to improve automated checks. * Execute manual regression and release verification passes in staging and customer\-like environments before new agent capabilities ship. * Conduct manual red\-teaming sessions (prompt injection, jailbreaks, tool misuse, unsafe actions) in partnership with security teams, then convert successful attacks into automated test cases. * Support user acceptance testing and pilot rollouts with Forward Deployed Engineers, capturing real\-world failures and feeding them back into test suites. * Write clear test plans, test charters, and bug reports, and maintain manual test documentation where automation isn’t yet practical or cost\-effective. **Datasets, Metrics, and Quality Strategy** * Create and manage golden datasets and labeled test sets, including edge cases, ambiguous inputs, and adversarial prompts specific to industrial and operational contexts, with tooling for versioning and drift detection. * Design rubrics and run human\-in\-the\-loop evaluations where automated scoring isn’t reliable enough. * Define and instrument quality metrics beyond simple accuracy (groundedness, hallucination rate, task success rate, latency/cost tradeoffs, and safety violations) and build dashboards to track them over time. * Test agent behavior across the full action loop (planning, tool selection, tool execution, error recovery, and final output), not just the final response. * Investigate and triage failures where the root cause could be the model, the prompt, the tool/API, or the orchestration logic, and turn them into reproducible, actionable bug reports. * Establish quality bars, release criteria, and sign\-off processes for new agent capabilities, blending automated gates with manual verification. * Decide what to automate and what to keep manual, and continually shift repeatable manual work into automation. * Mentor engineers on testing strategies and test\-driven practices for probabilistic, LLM\-driven systems. * Advocate for testability, observability, and tracing in agent architecture from day one. **Qualifications** ================== * 5\+ years as an SDET, QA engineer, or software engineer with a strong testing focus, with demonstrated ownership of test strategy and automation for complex distributed systems. * Proven experience in both manual and automated testing, including exploratory testing, test planning, and writing high\-quality bug reports. * Strong programming skills (Python preferred) with a software engineering mindset: clean, maintainable, well\-reviewed code for frameworks, data pipelines, and tooling. * Experience building test frameworks and infrastructure from the ground up, not just writing test cases within an existing framework. * Hands\-on experience with CI/CD systems (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins) and containerized test environments (Docker, Kubernetes). * Experience testing APIs and microservices, including contract, integration, and end\-to\-end testing. * Hands\-on experience testing LLM\-based products, chatbots, or AI agents, and an understanding of why traditional deterministic assertions break down for generative systems. * Practical experience with eval frameworks or tooling (e.g., promptfoo, DeepEval, RAGAS, LangSmith) or a track record of building your own. * Understanding of how LLM agents work: prompting, tool/function calling, context management, RAG, memory, and orchestration frameworks. * Experience designing test data and labeled datasets, including sourcing, sampling, and managing dataset drift over time. * Familiarity with LLM\-specific failure modes: hallucination, prompt injection, context poisoning, tool misuse, goal drift, and non\-determinism. * Comfort operating in ambiguity, defining what “correct” means for a task when there’s no single right answer. * Strong written communication skills for turning fuzzy quality signals into clear, actionable findings for engineering and product stakeholders. **Preferred** ============= * Experience with human\-in\-the\-loop evaluation workflows (labeling pipelines, inter\-rater reliability, rubric design). * Experience with performance and load testing tools (e.g., k6, Locust) and chaos or fault\-injection testing. * Background in ML/data science sufficient to read model evals and statistical significance. * Experience red\-teaming or doing adversarial/security testing on ML systems. * Familiarity with observability and tracing tools for LLM applications (e.g., LangSmith, Arize, Langfuse, Weights \& Biases) and general observability stacks (OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Datadog). * Experience testing systems in industrial, IoT, or operational technology (OT) environments, including industrial protocols (OPC UA, MQTT, Modbus) or simulation and hardware\-in\-the\-loop setups. * Experience supporting UAT, pilots, or customer\-facing validation of complex products. * Experience setting up test and eval infrastructure from scratch at a startup or fast\-moving team. **What We’re Looking For** ========================== * An engineer who is equally comfortable writing a test framework and sitting down to break an agent by hand. * Someone who can build rigorous evaluation systems for problems that don’t have a single right answer, and who knows when human judgment is the right tool. * A systems thinker who enjoys turning ambiguous agent behavior into measurable, trustworthy signals. * A strong collaborator who partners well with ML engineers, backend engineers, and Forward Deployed teams. **Why Join** **Nexxa.AI****?** ============================== * **Innovative Environment:** Play a critical role in transforming heavy industries through groundbreaking AI and automation technologies. * **Collaborative Culture:** Be part of a team that values innovation, discipline, and continuous improvement. * **Professional Growth:** Benefit from significant opportunities for career development and advancement. * **Competitive Compensation:** Enjoy a comprehensive salary and equity package reflective of your expertise and contributions. If you’re passionate about AI quality and eager to help define what trustworthy autonomous systems look like in heavy industry, we’d love to connect.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer – Large-Scale LLM Memory and Storage Systems
jobs.description: NVIDIA Dynamo is a high\-throughput, low\-latency inference framework for serving generative AI and reasoning models across multi\-node distributed environments. Built in Rust for performance and Python for extensibility, Dynamo orchestrates GPU shards, routes requests, and manages shared KV cache across heterogeneous clusters so that many accelerators feel like a single system at datacenter scale. As large language models rapidly outgrow the memory and compute budget of any single GPU, this platform enables efficient, resilient deployment of cutting\-edge LLM workloads. We are seeking a Principal Systems Engineer to define the vision and roadmap for memory management of large\-scale LLM and storage systems. **What you'll be doing:** * Design and evolve a unified memory layer that spans GPU memory, pinned host memory, RDMA\-accessible memory, SSD tiers, and remote file/object/cloud storage to support large\-scale LLM inference. * Architect and implement deep integrations with leading LLM serving engines (such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT\-LLM), with a focus on KV\-cache offload, reuse, and remote sharing across heterogeneous and disaggregated clusters. * Co\-design interfaces and protocols that enable disaggregated prefill, peer\-to\-peer KV\-cache sharing, and multi\-tier KV\-cache storage (GPU, CPU, local disk, and remote memory) for high\-throughput, low\-latency inference. * Partner closely with GPU architecture, networking, and platform teams to exploit GPUDirect, RDMA, NVLink, and similar technologies for low\-latency KV\-cache access and sharing across heterogeneous accelerators and memory pools. * Mentor senior and junior engineers, set technical direction for memory and storage subsystems, and represent the team in internal reviews and external forums (open source, conferences, and customer\-facing technical deep dives). **What we need to see:** * Masters or PhD or equivalent experience * 15\+ years of experience building large\-scale distributed systems, high\-performance storage, or ML systems infrastructure in C/C\+\+ and Python, with a track record of delivering production services. * Deep understanding of memory hierarchies (GPU HBM, host DRAM, SSD, and remote/object storage) and experience designing systems that span multiple tiers for performance and cost efficiency. * Distributed caching or key\-value systems, especially designs optimized for low latency and high concurrency. * Hands\-on experience with networked I/O and RDMA/NVMe\-oF/NVLink\-style technologies, and familiarity with concepts like disaggregated and aggregated deployments for AI clusters. * Strong skills in profiling and optimizing systems across CPU, GPU, memory, and network, using metrics to drive architectural decisions and validate improvements in TTFT and throughput. * Excellent communication skills and prior experience leading cross\-functional efforts with research, product, and customer teams. **Ways to stand out from the crowd:** * Prior contributions to open\-source LLM serving or systems projects focused on KV\-cache optimization, compression, streaming, or reuse. * Experience designing unified memory or storage layers that expose a single logical KV or object model across GPU, host, SSD, and cloud tiers, especially in enterprise or hyperscale environments. * Publications or patents in areas such as LLM systems, memory\-disaggregated architectures, RDMA/NVLink\-based data planes, or KV\-cache/CDN\-like systems for ML. jobs.title: Staff Platform Engineer
jobs.description: Description: **Job Summary:** The Staff Platform Engineer sets the technical direction for the platform and solves infrastructure problems that span teams. jobs.title: Analytics Engineer 5 - Ads Identity & Signals
jobs.description: At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode \- pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting\-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next. In 2022 we launched a new lower\-priced, ad\-supported tier, and we are building an in\-house, world\-class ad\-tech ecosystem to give our members more choice and to offer advertisers a premium, better\-than\-linear\-TV experience. We are looking for the founding members of this new business area for Netflix. The Identity \& Signals team builds the identity foundation of the Netflix ads business — the graph and matching systems that let us recognize the same person or household across signals, devices, and partner data sources, and that determine which signals we can responsibly and accurately use for targeting, measurement, and reporting. We build and maintain the identity graph, run and evaluate entity\-matching and resolution pipelines, and manage relationships with identity providers so that advertisers and internal teams can trust the signals underneath every campaign. This is a foundational role on a small, high\-leverage team. You will build the analytics and data infrastructure that powers identity matching and graph construction — designing the tables, pipelines, and metrics that let the team and its stakeholders understand match quality, coverage, and drift over time. You'll work end\-to\-end: from raw signal ingestion, through matching logic and graph construction, to the dashboards and data products that make identity health visible and actionable across the company. **In This Role, You Will** * Design, build, and maintain the data models and pipelines that support identity graph construction, entity matching, and identity resolution across first\-party and third\-party signals. * Partner with data engineering and software engineering to productionize matching logic, ensuring pipelines are scalable, well\-tested, and monitored for data quality and drift. * Build metrics, dashboards, and analytics that quantify match rate, match quality, coverage, and graph stability, and that surface anomalies before they affect downstream campaigns. * Work closely with data science to evaluate and improve matching algorithms, providing the clean, well\-documented data and features needed to test and iterate on models. * Manage and evaluate the analytics relationship with external identity providers (e.g., Experian, TransUnion, LiveRamp), including onboarding new sources, validating match performance, and monitoring ongoing data quality. * Translate identity graph and matching concepts — nodes, edges, match confidence, deterministic vs. probabilistic matching — into clear, actionable insights for product, sales, and other non\-technical stakeholders. * Collaborate with product and cross\-functional partners to define identity requirements, evaluate trade\-offs (accuracy vs. coverage vs. privacy), and prioritize roadmap work. Communicate technical decisions, trade\-offs, and results clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences at all levels of the company. * **We Are Looking For** * 5\+ years of experience as an analytics engineer, data engineer, or similar role working with large\-scale data. * Experience working with graph data structures and graph\-based data models (e.g., property graphs, graph databases, or graph analytics on top of relational/columnar stores). * Familiarity with entity matching / identity resolution concepts — deterministic and probabilistic matching, fuzzy matching, blocking/candidate generation, and match quality evaluation. * Knowledge of, or direct experience working with, identity providers such as Experian, TransUnion, LiveRamp, or similar data/identity partners. * Strong SQL and Python skills, with experience building and maintaining production data pipelines. * Experience designing data models, metrics, and dashboards that make complex technical systems understandable to non\-technical stakeholders. * Demonstrated ability to collaborate closely across data engineering, software engineering, data science, and product teams. * Ability to work independently, drive your own projects, and make compelling cases for prioritization. Embodies the Netflix values while bringing a new perspective to continue improving our culture. * **Nice To Have** * Experience with ad\-tech identity concepts — cross\-device identity, household graphs, cookie/ID deprecation, or media measurement. * Experience with graph databases or graph\-processing frameworks (e.g., Neo4j, Neptune, GraphFrames, or similar). * Familiarity with our ML/data stack (Metaflow) or comparable large\-scale data tooling. * Experience working with privacy\-sensitive data and an understanding of relevant data governance and privacy considerations for identity data. * Experience applying GenAI to boost developer/analytics productivity. Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. The range for this role is $330,000\.00 \- $566,000\.00\. This compensation range will vary based on location. Netflix provides comprehensive benefits including Health Plans, Mental Health support, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer match, Stock Option Program, Disability Programs, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, Family\-forming benefits, and Life and Serious Injury Benefits. We also offer paid leave of absence programs. Full\-time hourly employees accrue 35 days annually for paid time off to be used for vacation, holidays, and sick paid time off. Full\-time salaried employees are immediately entitled to flexible time off. See more details about our Benefits here . Netflix is a unique culture and environment. Learn more here . Inclusion is a Netflix value and we strive to host a meaningful interview experience for all candidates. If you want an accommodation/adjustment for a disability or any other reason during the hiring process, please send a request to your recruiting partner. We are an equal\-opportunity employer and celebrate diversity, recognizing that diversity builds stronger teams. We approach diversity and inclusion seriously and thoughtfully. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service. Job is open for no less than 7 days and will be removed when the position is filled.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Data Science
jobs.description: **Job Description** ------------------- **The Opportunity** We are looking for a **Senior Manager of Data Science** to lead and evolve a team of data scientists and ML operations engineers responsible for improving how customers discover and shop for products across our digital experiences. The team works across personalization, recommendations, search and browse relevance, customer and product understanding, experimentation, and measurement. This leader will help evolve our Data Science organization from primarily building and evaluating models toward a broader mission: understanding customer problems, identifying the right interventions, measuring what actually creates value, and turning successful approaches into reusable capabilities that improve the shopping experience at scale. ***Note: This position is offered as a hybrid role in the Seattle, WA area. You must be willing to work in office at the Nordstrom Seattle office for a minimum of 4 days per week to be considered for this position.*** **What You Will Lead** * Set the data science strategy for personalization, recommendations, search, browse, and digital product discovery. * Partner with Product, Engineering, UX, and business leaders to identify the highest\-value customer problems before deciding on a technical solution. * Establish clear hypotheses, success measures, targets, guardrails, and decision criteria before significant experimentation begins. * Move the team beyond asking only “Did model B outperform model A?” toward understanding why customer behavior changed, who benefited, and whether the change created meaningful customer and business value. * Build a strong experimentation and measurement discipline that connects model performance to customer behavior, conversion, revenue, long\-term engagement, and other meaningful outcomes. * Develop the team's capabilities in experimentation, causal reasoning, optimization, personalization, recommendation systems, ranking, and customer understanding. * Identify repetitive data science work that should be standardized, automated, or turned into reusable capabilities. * Use GenAI and emerging AI capabilities to increase the speed of research, experimentation, evaluation, and learning, not simply to generate code faster. * Champion AI\-native ways of working across the team, including agentic architectures and LLMs in decisioning where they add value. * Partner with Engineering to create scalable systems and platforms that allow successful scientific approaches to be reused broadly. * Build, coach, and develop a high\-performing team of data scientists and ML operations engineers, raising expectations for scientific rigor, customer understanding, business judgment, and technical excellence. * Create an environment where scientists are expected to challenge assumptions, frame problems clearly, and recommend actions rather than simply report results. **What Success Looks Like** Within the first 12 months, this leader will have: * Established a clear operating model for how Data Science frames problems, defines success, runs experiments, and makes recommendations. * Increased the amount of team capacity spent on customer understanding, problem definition, experimentation strategy, and decision\-making. * Reduced repetitive manual work through standardized tools, workflows, and reusable capabilities. * Improved the connection between offline model metrics, online experiments, customer outcomes, and business results. * Developed a clear roadmap for how GenAI changes both the team's workflow and the capabilities it provides to customers and internal partners. * Strengthened the team's technical and leadership talent to support the next stage of growth. **What We Are Looking For** * 10\+ years of hands\-on experience in Data Science or Machine Learning roles. * 3\+ years managing Data Science, Applied Science, or Machine Learning teams working on customer\-facing products. * Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (e.g., statistics, computer science, mathematics, engineering) or equivalent practical experience; advanced degree preferred. * Deep experience in at least one of the following: personalization, recommendation systems, search/ranking, customer modeling, marketplace optimization, or digital commerce. * Strong knowledge of experimentation, statistical measurement, and causal inference. * Demonstrated ability to connect scientific work to product and business decisions. * Experience moving teams from bespoke model development toward reusable platforms, frameworks, or scalable capabilities. * Experience applying modern machine learning and GenAI techniques to real customer or business problems, including daily use of AI tools (e.g., Claude Code) and agentic or LLM\-based approaches in decisioning. * Hands\-on comfort with Python and SQL and working with large\-scale data (e.g., BigQuery), enough to read, review, and guide the team's code and outputs. Familiarity with open\-source AI resources (e.g., Hugging Face, OpenRouter) and cloud ML platforms (Google Vertex AI, AWS) is a plus. * Strong product and business judgment; able to distinguish technically interesting work from work that materially improves customer outcomes. * Proven ability to lead organizational change, establish new standards, and raise the performance bar of an existing team. * Strong people leadership, including hiring, coaching, performance management, succession development, and creating strong technical leadership within the organization. * Ability to communicate complex scientific ideas in clear language and influence senior Product, Engineering, and business leaders. **The Mindset We Value** You believe the job of Data Science is not simply to build models. This is an applied data science role, not a research or reporting function: you identify the problem, propose a solution, iterate quickly, and deliver with Engineering. You start with the customer and the decision that needs to be made. You use science to reduce uncertainty, test assumptions, understand what actually works, and help the organization make better decisions. You see AI as an opportunity to eliminate repetitive work, increase the speed of learning, and expand what a small team can accomplish. jobs.title: Systems Administrator (IT & Infrastructure)
jobs.description: **\*Roles and Responsibilities:\*** Domains, Subscriptions \& Assets \- Maintain the company's domain portfolio, including registrar accounts, DNS records, SSL/TLS certificates, and email authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC). Track renewals so nothing expires. \- Manage software and SaaS subscriptions: track licenses, owners, renewal dates, and costs; flag unused or duplicate tools; coordinate renewals and cancellations. \- Maintain IT asset and inventory records for hardware, software, and licenses. **Systems Administration \& Help Desk** \- Provide technical support for laptops, desktops, peripherals, and common software, including device setup, imaging, and onboarding/offboarding. \- Administer Microsoft 365 and Azure (Entra ID): user accounts, groups, licenses, MFA, and access management. Assist with conditional access and data protection (DLP) policies. \- Install, configure, and maintain local servers (Windows and/or Linux), including virtualization, file shares, storage, and server hardware. \- Support network infrastructure (firewalls, VPN, switches, wireless) and troubleshoot connectivity issues. **Security** \- Deploy and manage endpoint protection and patching across servers and endpoints, following a documented patch schedule and change process. \- Review security logs and alerts, escalate issues, and help operate our internal AI\-assisted network security auditing tools. \- Manage backups, retention policies, and periodic restore tests; support disaster recovery planning. \- Collect and maintain evidence for recurring security controls (e.g., SOC 2\) and assist with audit requests. **Basic DevOps** \- Support the engineering team with Azure resource administration, access requests, and environment housekeeping. \- Write and maintain scripts (PowerShell, Bash, or Python) to automate routine admin tasks. \- Assist with CI/CD pipelines, deployments, and monitoring under the guidance of senior engineers. **Documentation** \- Document system configurations, procedures, and troubleshooting steps so knowledge is shared and repeatable. **\*Required Skills \& Experience:\*** \- 2–4 years of experience in IT support, systems administration, or a related role. \- Solid troubleshooting skills across hardware, software, and networking, including help desk support for laptops and desktops. \- Hands\-on experience with Microsoft 365 administration and basic Azure/Entra ID user and access management. \- Working knowledge of DNS, domains, and SSL certificates. \- Experience administering Windows and/or Linux servers. \- Familiarity with endpoint protection, patch management, and backups. \- Organized and detail\-oriented, comfortable tracking renewals, licenses, and inventory. \- Clear written and verbal communication; able to document work and explain technical issues to non\-technical colleagues. \- Eager to learn and take on new responsibilities as you grow in the role. \*Nice to Have (we'll train on these):\* \- Scripting experience (PowerShell, Bash, or Python). \- Exposure to Azure cloud services, CI/CD tools (e.g., Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions), or containers (Docker). \- Experience with RMM tools, firewall administration, or virtualization platforms (Hyper\-V, VMware). \- Familiarity with security compliance frameworks (SOC 2, GDPR) or audit evidence collection. \- Certifications such as CompTIA A\+, Network\+, Security\+, or Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate / Microsoft 365 Fundamentals. Pay: $75,000\.00 \- $80,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Life insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Sec Systs Software Programmer
jobs.description: **Company Description** The **Security Systems Software Programmer** reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards. The Security Systems Software Programmer is responsible for designing, developing, customizing, and maintaining software applications that support enterprise physical security technologies. This role focuses on integrating and enhancing systems such as access control, video management, intrusion detection, visitor management, and identity management. The Security Systems Software Programmer blends software engineering expertise with a strong understanding of physical security infrastructure and standards. The Security System Programmer will be well rounded and experienced in Access Control and Video Management Systems. The Security System Programmer will keep clear records of information used during system commissioning. All password, IP schemes, device labeling schemes and any other information use in the process will be included in the records kept. **Job Description** **RESPONSIBILITIES** * Develop and maintain applications, APIs, scripts, and automation tools supporting physical security platforms. * Customize and configure access control and video management systems (e.g. Genetec, Software House). * Build interfaces between security systems and enterprise applications (HRIS, ITSM, IAM). * Implement system integrations * Design workflows and connectors for identity lifecycle automation across security systems. * Develop data exchange pipelines between physical and logical security systems. * Troubleshoot and resolve software and configuration issues with security systems. * Maintain documentation, code repositories, and version control. * Perform system health checks, patching, and software upgrades. * Ensure solutions comply with cybersecurity, privacy, and physical security standards. * Follow secure coding practices and participate in code reviews. * Support auditing, reporting, and access control governance requirements. * Work closely with Physical Security, IT, Networking, and Cybersecurity teams. * Partner with vendors and integrators to support system enhancements and deployments. * Provide technical guidance on system design and architecture. * Optimize access control and video management system by placing devices on maps and linking devices including cameras, card readers, input and outputs. * Basic locking hardware knowledge * Provide feedback to determine improvements needed in installation process * Able to Read Construction Drawings and Line Diagrams **Qualifications** **Required****:** * Must possess one or more of the following: + Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science plus two (2\) years of software programming experience; OR + Associate's Degree in Computer Science plus four (4\) years of software programming experience; OR + High school or equivalent plus six (6\) years of software programming experience. * Experience and familiarity with common security tools such as access control, video management system, Event Management, and Vulnerability Management tools. * Proficiency in programming/scripting languages. * Experience with APIs, SDKs, and integration frameworks. * Hands\-on work with enterprise access control or video management systems. * Strong understanding of databases (SQL, PostgreSQL, or MongoDB). * Ability to maintain effective working relationships with colleagues, users, contractors, and vendors. * Ability to resolve problems by breaking down issues, finding possible solutions, and working with the appropriate stakeholders to find solutions to complex problems. * Ability to lead effective projects, communicate clearly throughout their execution, and complete them in a timely manner. This includes determining the appropriate scope, deconstructing tasks, and successfully performing and measuring success of sprints. * Ability to comprehend and integrate complex computer technology and software into an effective information systems security program. * Requires on the job experience programming of the following: + Genetec + Software House CCure * Genetec system certifications. (Within six months of employment) * Software House certifications. (Within six months of employment) **Preferred:** * Experience with: Identity and access management (IAM) workflows, Cloud platforms, and Enterprise messaging tools (RabbitMQ, Kafka, Azure Service Bus). * Knowledge of security system protocols (OSDP, Wiegand, ONVIF). * Familiarity with cybersecurity best practices (NIST, ISO 27001\). **Additional Information** Northwestern Medicine is an equal opportunity employer (disability, VETS) and does not discriminate in hiring or employment on the basis of age, sex, race, color, religion, national origin, gender identity, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation or any other protected status. **Background Check** Northwestern Medicine conducts a background check that includes criminal history on newly hired team members and, at times, internal transfers. If you are offered a position with us, you will be required to complete an authorization and disclosure form that gives Northwestern Medicine permission to run the background check. Results are evaluated on a case\-by\-case basis, and we follow all local, state, and federal laws, including the Illinois Health Care Worker Background Check Act. **Artificial Intelligence Disclosure** Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools may be used in some portions of the candidate review process for this position, however, all employment decisions will be made by a person. **Benefits** We offer a wide range of benefits that provide employees with tools and resources to improve their physical, emotional, and financial well\-being while providing protection for unexpected life events. Click on or copy and paste URL to your browser to view detailed benefits information https://jobs.nm.org/benefits Please refer to the Benefits Eligibility by Employment Classification to determine benefits eligibility for job postings. **If sign\-on bonus is included in a job posting eligibility is as followed:** Internal employees and rehires who left Northwestern Medicine within 1 year are not eligible for the sign\-on bonus. jobs.title: Sr. Systems Sales Engineer
jobs.description: **Hungry, Humble, Honest, with Heart.** **The Opportunity** Are you a passionate and collaborative technical professional with a knack for solving complex problems and the ability to build trusted relationships with customers? If so, you’ll thrive in our team at Nutanix, where you will play a pivotal role in transforming customer challenges into innovative solutions, all while working alongside a group of dedicated experts in the field of Enterprise Cloud Technology. **About the Team** The Sr. Systems Sales Engineer will be a part of the Systems Engineering \& Solution Sales organization, which consists of over 800 customer\-focused technical sales professionals. This team is centered around identifying and matching technology opportunities with customer business challenges and objectives, primarily focusing on the government and educational sectors. The culture is collaborative and consultative, fostering an environment where team members are seen as trusted resources by sales, customer success teams, and business partners alike. The mission at Nutanix is to empower government and educational agencies through transformative solutions that enhance their operations and deliver on their commitments to the communities they serve. If hired, employee will be in an “at\-will position” and the Company reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, Company or individual department/team performance, and market factors. jobs.title: Sr. Embedded Software Engineer
jobs.description: Overview: At Spacelabs Healthcare, you make a difference. Every member of our worldwide team plays an integral role in improving treatment and helping providers deliver exceptional care to their patients. From newborns to centenarians, more than 60 million people benefit each year from the advancements we make in patient monitoring and management, care coordination and clinical decision support. Driven by the belief that anyone who seeks care could be a member of our own family, our team is dedicated to solving the greatest challenges the healthcare system currently faces, including the need to enhance the patient experience, improve population health, reduce costs, support care team well\-being and advance health equity. As part of our mission, we take pride in creating services and technologies that are personalized and tailored to support the needs of healthcare providers anywhere in the world. Because while we may not be at a patient’s bedside, their health is still in our hands. The Senior Embedded Software Engineer will be a member of the Spacelabs R\&D engineering team working on and leading the development of Spacelabs Patient Monitoring and Connectivity (PMC) products. This position requires a deep understanding of solid design and development practices and the ability to apply those to Spacelabs product development. The person will be accountable for developing and delivering software that supports the next generation Enterprise products. They will work with other cross\-functional members to provide technical software level expertise, and solutions to engineering problems. A key element of this role includes advocating for and designing products that meet the functional, performance and cybersecurity needs of our customers. A strong systems approach to product development will be necessary in this role. You will spend your time as a hands\-on engineer and a technical leader. Understand and design to existing interface specifications. * Design, write, debug, document and release software used for communication, storage and analysis of patient physiological information. * other engineers to high standards while maintaining friendly, respectful relationships. * Be passionate about software engineering with a strong sense of ownership for the code that you and your team write. * Seek self\-improvement and are adaptable to suggestions and feedback. * Uphold the company’s core values of Integrity, Innovation, Accountability, and Teamwork. * Demonstrate behavior order for corrective action to be implemented and to avoid recurrence of the problem. * Duties may be modified or assigned at any time to meet the needs of the business.
