jobs.title: Sr. Applications Engineer, San Francisco
jobs.description: **Senior Machine Vision Applications Engineer** =============================================== * **San Francisco, CA · Applications · Full\-time, in office** * **Compensation:** 150K \- 190K, plus annual performance bonus up to 20% * **Travel:** Up to 50%, typically lower. **ABOUT OVERVIEW.AI** --------------------- Overview.ai is bringing cutting\-edge AI computer vision to manufacturing, solving inspection problems that were previously not solvable with traditional machine vision. We're a full\-stack company: we deploy GPU\-powered cameras on production lines, run inference on the edge, and operate a platform that supports large fleets of devices deployed worldwide. We're growing extremely fast. Our customers love the product because it works: high accuracy, fast deployment, and an operator\-friendly experience that makes real factory rollouts possible, not just pilots. **THE OPPORTUNITY** ------------------- We're looking for an experienced Machine Vision Applications Engineer to own complex vision applications from initial feasibility through production deployment. You'll be our go\-to technical expert for optics, lighting, image acquisition, and inspection performance, working hands\-on in our San Francisco lab and directly with customers on real manufacturing challenges. This isn't a purely research or advisory role. You'll build vision systems, evaluate hardware, lead proof\-of\-concept testing, troubleshoot difficult inspection problems, and make technical recommendations that directly influence customer deployments and product development. We're looking for someone who has already solved challenging machine vision problems in industrial environments and wants to apply that expertise to the next generation of AI\-powered inspection. **WHY THIS ROLE IS EXCITING** ----------------------------- * **Own complex vision challenges:** Lead the technical approach for applications where optics, lighting, image quality, and inspection reliability make the difference. * **Be the vision expert:** Serve as a technical resource for Applications, Sales, Product, and Engineering. * **Shape our technology:** Your evaluations and findings will directly influence hardware decisions, application development, and deployment strategies. * **Bridge traditional and AI vision:** Apply deep machine vision fundamentals to inspection problems that conventional systems struggle to solve. * **Stay hands\-on:** Work directly with cameras, lenses, lighting, real customer parts, and production environments. **WHAT YOU'LL OWN** ------------------- * **Advanced vision application development:** Lead feasibility studies, proof\-of\-concept testing, and technical validation for complex industrial inspection applications. * **Optics and lighting design:** Select, configure, and optimize cameras, lenses, lighting, filters, and optical components for challenging inspection requirements. * **Technical ownership of the SF lab:** Drive vision experimentation, testing standards, hardware evaluation, and application development. * **Inspection performance optimization:** Troubleshoot image quality, environmental variability, false rejects, missed defects, and inspection consistency. * **AI vision workflows:** Work with image collection, labeling, model training, and evaluation to optimize AI\-based inspection performance. * **Customer application support:** Partner with customers and field teams to troubleshoot vision challenges and ensure successful deployment on production lines. * **Technology evaluation:** Assess emerging vision technologies and recommend improvements to our hardware and inspection capabilities. * **Technical leadership:** Mentor less experienced engineers, establish best practices, and provide technical guidance across teams. * **Cross\-functional collaboration:** Work closely with Product and Engineering to translate application challenges into product improvements. **WHO YOU ARE** --------------- **Required** * 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in industrial machine vision, vision applications engineering, or optical inspection systems. * Deep understanding of machine vision fundamentals, including optics, lenses, lighting, sensors, image acquisition, and camera configuration. * Proven experience designing, building, and optimizing industrial vision systems for real manufacturing applications. * Strong understanding of lens selection, field of view, working distance, depth of field, resolution, and optical trade\-offs. * Experience with advanced lighting techniques and solving challenging image acquisition problems. * Demonstrated ability to independently lead vision feasibility studies and proof\-of\-concept projects. * Experience troubleshooting inspection performance in production environments. * Familiarity with traditional machine vision tools and inspection techniques. * Working knowledge of AI\-based vision, including classification, object detection, segmentation, and model evaluation. * Strong technical communication skills, including documenting findings and explaining technical trade\-offs to customers and internal teams. * Comfortable working directly with hardware, running experiments, and solving problems independently. * Based in the San Francisco Bay Area and able to work primarily from our SF office. **Strong Preferences** * Experience with deep learning\-based industrial inspection. * Familiarity with telecentric optics, advanced lighting configurations, and precision inspection. * Experience with high\-speed production lines, challenging defect detection, or variable manufacturing environments. * Exposure to PLCs, industrial automation, triggering, and production\-line integration. * Experience working directly with manufacturing customers. * Experience mentoring engineers or serving as a technical subject matter expert. **WHY OVERVIEW.AI** ------------------- * **Extreme growth and real\-world impact:** We're not just building demos. We're deploying AI systems on real production lines, at scale. * **Talent density:** Work alongside world\-class engineers across AI, embedded systems, and enterprise deployment. * **Front\-row seat to AI in manufacturing:** Help shape how manufacturers adopt the next generation of inspection technology. * **Technical ownership:** Your expertise will influence real engineering decisions and customer outcomes. * **Global exposure:** Solve challenging applications for some of the world's most advanced manufacturers.

jobs.title: Functional Software Engineer
jobs.description: Obsidian Systems is a software engineering consultancy that builds production systems for capital markets and other regulated industries. Our clients include market infrastructure providers, national exchanges, and global financial institutions. Much of our work today centers on the Canton Network, the privacy\-enabled blockchain adopted by major capital markets institutions, where Obsidian is one of the most experienced engineering firms in the ecosystem. We're a remote\-first, globally distributed team that values ownership, curiosity, and clear communication. We believe the best ideas come from people who ask difficult questions, take responsibility for their work, and collaborate openly to solve challenging problems. **About the Role** We're looking for a **Functional Software Engineer** to join our engineering team and contribute to challenging client projects across our technical domains. You'll design, develop, and maintain software using functional programming principles, working with engineers and client teams to turn complex requirements into robust, maintainable solutions. Depending on the project, your work may involve backend systems, domain modelling, distributed systems, financial infrastructure, blockchain applications, or developer tooling. This role is suited to an engineer who enjoys reasoning about complex systems, values strong types and clear abstractions, and sees software development as more than simply making code work. Knowledge in every technology is not necessary. We value strong engineering fundamentals, a willingness to learn, and the ability to apply sound technical judgment to unfamiliar problems. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * Design, implement, test, and maintain reliable software using functional programming principles. * Develop clear, composable, and maintainable solutions to complex engineering problems. * Apply strong typing, domain modelling, and abstraction to improve software correctness and reliability. * Collaborate with engineers, technical leads, and client stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver effective solutions. * Contribute to the design and architecture of systems, making thoughtful trade\-offs between correctness, simplicity, performance, and maintainability. * Write automated tests and use appropriate techniques to validate system behaviour. * Review code, share technical knowledge, and contribute to engineering standards. * Investigate and resolve complex technical issues across existing systems. * Communicate technical decisions clearly and explain trade\-offs to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Adapt to different client environments, codebases, and technical challenges. * Contribute to continuous improvement across our engineering practices, tools, and delivery processes. **Key Requirements** -------------------- * 5\+ years of professional experience developing and delivering production software. * Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, testing, and software design. * Experience with functional programming, either professionally or through substantial projects. * Ability to reason about complex problems and translate requirements into well\-structured software. * Strong debugging and problem\-solving skills. * Commitment to code quality, correctness, and maintainability. * Ability to communicate effectively and collaborate with other engineers. * Willingness to learn new technologies and work across different technical environments. **Preferred Requirements:** * Experience with Haskell, Scala, OCaml, F\#, Clojure, or another functional programming language. * Familiarity with type systems, algebraic data types, pattern matching, and immutable data structures. * Experience with strongly typed domain modelling and functional design patterns. * Exposure to distributed systems, concurrent programming, or backend infrastructure. * Experience in blockchain, financial infrastructure, capital markets, or other domains where correctness and reliability are particularly important. * Familiarity with property\-based testing and other techniques for validating complex software behaviour. * Experience with Nix or reproducible development environments. * Experience working in an engineering consultancy or collaborating directly with client teams. **How We Work** --------------- At Obsidian Systems, we believe great work comes from thoughtful people who take ownership, communicate openly, and enjoy solving difficult problems together. These principles guide how we work every day. Own Your Work, Protect Your Team * We take full ownership of our responsibilities while supporting the people around us. We believe accountability creates trust, and clear ownership allows teams to move quickly without stepping on one another's work. Don't Settle for Superficial * We aim to understand problems deeply rather than treating symptoms. We ask questions, challenge assumptions, and make unknowns explicit so we can build durable solutions instead of temporary fixes. Be Honest Proactively * We communicate openly and early. Raising risks before they become problems helps our team and our clients make better decisions. We value transparency over avoiding uncomfortable conversations. Get to It * Many of the challenges we solve have never been solved before. We don't wait for perfection; we start, learn, iterate, and move forward. Progress comes from taking the next concrete step. If you're excited by continuous learning and playing a real role in building the next generation of financial market infrastructure, you'll feel at home at Obsidian.

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager - Okta Identity Governance
jobs.description: **Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human** Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real\-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence. jobs.title: Senior Staff Product Manager
jobs.description: **About OpenLoop** ------------------ OpenLoop was co\-founded by CEO, Dr. Jon Lensing, and COO, Christian Williams, with the vision to bring care anywhere. Our telehealth support solutions are thoughtfully designed to streamline and simplify go\-to\-market care delivery for companies offering meaningful virtual support to patients across an expansive array of specialties, in all 50 states. **About the Role** ------------------ OpenLoop is the digital health infrastructure powering modern medicine. Healthcare and non\-healthcare brands use our white\-label platform to launch, scale and run virtual and hybrid care without the operational complexity. We bring together one of the largest telehealth clinician networks in the country, nationwide payer coverage, integrated pharmacy and lab partners, EHR connectivity, 24/7 patient support and full revenue cycle management. Our partners put their brand on the front end, and everything behind it runs on us. We serve more than 3 million patients a year and power over 300,000 visits a month. We're hiring **Senior Staff Product Managers** across every product and engineering pillar: * **Patient Care:** the core platform patients and clinicians use every day * **Client Experience \& Forward Deployment:** helping partners launch, integrate and scale on OpenLoop * **Platform Reliability \& Infrastructure:** the APIs, integrations and systems everything else depends on * **Data \& AI:** our data foundation and the AI capabilities built on it What makes this Senior Staff and not Staff is **scope and leverage**. You won't just run a roadmap. You'll set the direction for a whole product domain, shape strategy with the VP of Product, and make decisions that affect multiple teams. You'll work in a company that's still building its processes, and you'll help define them. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * **Set the vision.** Define where your domain needs to be in 12–24 months, why, and the sequence to get there. Make the case to leadership and get teams aligned behind it. * **Inspire and align.** Turn strategy into a narrative the whole company can repeat, and keep teams energized through shifting priorities. * **Own outcomes, not output.** Tie your roadmap to measurable results: partner growth, patient outcomes, revenue and operational efficiency. Be accountable for them. * **Define success.** Set the 3–5 metrics your domain is accountable for, review them regularly with leadership, and course\-correct openly when they miss. * **Lead without authority.** Drive decisions across engineering, design, data, clinical, operations and go\-to\-market. Make hard tradeoffs visible and resolve them. * **Build AI that earns its place.** Find where AI creates real value for patients, clinicians and partners, then ship it with human review by design, evals before launch and monitoring after. * **Work AI\-native.** Use AI every day for research, prototyping, analysis, specs and prioritization, and help the product team do the same. * **Turn ambiguity into a plan.** Take messy, over\-scoped or conflicting asks and turn them into a phased plan you can defend, including a clear statement of what you're not doing. * **Stay close to the field.** Spend time with partners, clinicians and patients. Bring that evidence back so recurring gaps get fixed once, in the platform. * **Raise the bar.** Mentor PMs, sharpen how we write, prioritize and ship, and help shape a product org that's scaling fast. **Who You Are** --------------- ### **Required Qualifications** * 10\+ years of product management experience, including significant time owning complex, multi\-team products at Staff level or equivalent. * Startup or high\-growth experience: you've built products where priorities shift, processes are still forming and you wear more than one hat. * Demonstrated product leadership: you've set strategy for a product area, influenced senior leaders, and can name the outcomes you personally drove. * Track record of influencing senior leaders and aligning engineering, design, and business teams (e.g., legal, security, operations, sales, support) around a shared plan, including resolving conflicting priorities. * Strong partnership with engineering and design: you understand technical constraints, make sound tradeoffs and earn trust across functions. * A record of tying product work to business outcomes (revenue, retention, cost, customer impact) and building the business case for investment. * Ability to tell a compelling story about where the product is going, in a way that motivates engineers, customers, and executives alike. * Experience mentoring or leveling up other PMs, and shaping how a product org plans, writes, and ships. * Comfort operating in complex environments with real constraints, such as regulation, security requirements, or deep integrations with third\-party systems. * Hands\-on AI product experience: you've built or shipped AI\-powered features and can explain how you measured quality and what you did when the model got it wrong. * AI\-native in your own work: you use AI tools every day as part of how you do the job. * The ability to move between multi\-year strategy and the detail of data, a PRD or a prototype. * Clear communication with executives, engineers and customers, including delivering unwelcome news early. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience in healthcare, digital health or another regulated domain (HIPAA, clinical workflows, payer, pharmacy). * Experience with B2B2C, platform, API or white\-label products. * Experience in client\-facing or forward\-deployed product roles. * Familiarity with EHR or practice\-management integrations. * A technical background in engineering, data or ML. **Our Benefits** ---------------- In addition, for salaried positions you would also be eligible for: * Medical, Dental, and Vision plans * Flexible Spending/Health Savings Accounts * Flexible PTO * 401(k) \+ Company Match * Life Insurance, Pet insurance, and more **Our Company** --------------- We have a relatively flat organizational structure here at OpenLoop. Everyone is encouraged to bring ideas to the table and make things happen. This fits in well with our core values of Autonomy, Competence and Belonging, as we want everyone to feel empowered and supported to do their best work. Sound like a good fit? We’d love to meet you.

jobs.title: Hardware Test Engineer
jobs.description: **About Optivolt** ------------------ Optivolt’s mission is to overshoot humanity’s energy supply by reimagining solar. America is at an inflection point. We need reliable energy fast. The grid is aging. And solar, the only technology that deploys quickly enough, is still constrained by technology frozen in time. To close this gap, we build intelligent solar systems that think and adapt to real world conditions. Optivolt solar systems understand the sun, the weather, shading, harsh conditions, and optimize energy flow in real time. Every Optivolt panel is designed with an aerospace power electronics brain sealed inside to make solar more powerful and cost effective than ever in any condition. The next step is putting it everywhere. In the home as Optivolt Home Solar and in the field as Optivolt Solar Fields. Hyper performant, controllable, reliable solar that works for everyone, everywhere. **Our Team \& Traction** ------------------------ Optivolt is a team of some of the best builders and doers in the world, drawing from incredible talent pools in aerospace, electrical engineering, design\-led organizations. We ultimately will win by designing and building the world’s best solar energy products. But chiefly important, our organization is a lab for those devoted to solving some of the toughest problems in energy. Everyone is expected to contribute to the mission meaningfully. Clear communication, rapid iteration, and strong work ethic is the floor for anyone on our team. To date we’ve shipped over 20,000 units and have companies worth billions of dollars relying on our solar architecture. **Why we are looking for you** ------------------------------ As a Hardware Test Engineer at Optivolt, you will build the test infrastructure and validation systems that allow us to develop reliable, high\-performance solar products quickly. You will own hands\-on electrical and system\-level testing, from prototype characterization to automated regression, field validation, and production test development. **What you’ll do** ------------------ * **Build test systems that engineers rely on.** Design and maintain test benches for Hub, power electronics, and integrated solar systems. * **Automate repetitive validation work.** Develop automated test scripts, fixtures, instrumentation interfaces, and data collection systems. * **Measure what matters.** Characterize electrical performance, efficiency, communications, thermal behavior, and protection functions. * **Find the edge cases early.** Run functional, environmental, stress, and firmware/hardware regression testing. * **Make failures reproducible.** Build hardware\-in\-the\-loop or other automated system validation where useful. * **Turn measurements into answers.** Analyze data, reproduce failures, isolate root causes, and partner with engineers on fixes. * **Work across hardware and firmware.** Write repeatable test plans, acceptance criteria, procedures, and concise reports. * **Bring validation into production.** Support certification testing, outdoor trials, and end\-of\-line manufacturing test. **What we’re looking for** -------------------------- * **You have tested real hardware.** 3\+ years of hands\-on hardware test, validation, or electrical engineering experience. * **You know how to measure electrical systems.** Strong electrical fundamentals and ability to read schematics and debug circuits. * **You can write useful test automation.** Experience with oscilloscopes, power analyzers, electronic loads, DAQs, and bench instrumentation. * **You are comfortable with lab equipment.** Python proficiency for automation, analysis, and instrument control. * **You can debug across disciplines.** Experience building test fixtures and repeatable validation processes. * **You know how to build repeatable tests.** Ability to distinguish hardware, firmware, communications, and system\-level failure modes. * **You own problems through resolution.** Strong experimental rigor, documentation, and ownership. **Preferred skills** -------------------- * **Experience with DC\-DC converters,** solar, batteries, or embedded controllers. * **Familiarity with environmental chambers** and accelerated reliability testing. * **Experience with SCPI, LabVIEW, CAN, UART,** SPI, or similar interfaces. * **Experience building production test equipment** and dashboards. **Additional requirements** --------------------------- * Willingness to work extended hours as needed to support critical milestones * Everyone at Optivolt is required to participate in on call support for customers * Must be based in San Francisco, CA **Pay and benefits** -------------------- The estimated starting base salary range for this role is $150K\-210K depending on level, location and experience, plus a generous pre\-IPO equity package Other benefits include comprehensive health coverage, unlimited PTO, plus extra fun perks!

jobs.title: Principal Electrical Engineer, AI Infrastructure Hardware
jobs.description: Our OCI Hardware Development organization designs server and rack\-scale systems and works closely with partners to develop and integrate new platforms for demanding AI and enterprise workloads. We’re seeking an experienced System Technical Lead with strong hands\-on board design expertise to join our team in Burlington, Massachusetts. You’ll own board designs and lead engineering work across Oracle teams and development partners to help design and deliver Oracle’s next generation of servers and rack\-scale systems. Your work will span component selection, schematic capture, electrical analysis, and PCB implementation alongside CAD designers and signal and power integrity engineers. You’ll also help shape system architecture and lead technical reviews with joint design manufacturing (JDM) and original design manufacturing (ODM) partners, evaluating designs, resolving trade\-offs, and driving design changes. The role calls for someone equally comfortable designing a board and leading its integration into a complete platform. You’ll remain hands\-on through prototype bring\-up, lab debug, and validation, and stay involved through production and sustaining engineering. You’ll see your engineering decisions take shape in hardware deployed across Oracle’s cloud. The position is based on site at our Burlington engineering campus, where hands\-on lab work and daily collaboration with engineering partners are central to the role. * Develop and own board designs, including component selection and qualification, schematic capture, board floor planning, and electrical design analysis using industry\-standard CAD tools. * Design and integrate processor, accelerator, memory, power delivery, storage, and networking circuitry, including high\-speed interfaces and sideband/control buses such as PCIe, DDR, Ethernet, SPI, and I2C/I3C. * Define PCB design constraints and work closely with CAD designers on stackup, component placement, and routing. Collaborate with signal and power integrity engineers on pre\-layout and post\-layout analysis to achieve electrical performance and manufacturability targets. * Develop board and system validation plans and coordinate their execution. Perform hands\-on prototype bring\-up, rework, debug, and root\-cause analysis using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and other lab equipment; implement and verify corrective actions. * Help shape server and rack platform architecture, defining electrical requirements, system interfaces, and validation criteria. Resolve trade\-offs in performance, reliability, power, cost, and manufacturability. * Provide technical leadership across electrical, mechanical, FPGA, firmware/software, validation, compliance, and operations engineering, working with Oracle teams, technology partners, and JDM/ODM engineers from concept through volume production. Establish clear technical ownership, coordinate engineering work across teams, resolve dependencies, and drive timely engineering decisions. * Lead architecture, schematic, PCB layout, and validation reviews to ensure product requirements, quality objectives, and compliance targets are met. Identify design gaps and integration risks, document required changes, and work with internal and partner engineers to implement and verify them. * Coordinate hardware/firmware interfaces, power sequencing, system management, and diagnostics with engineering teams to resolve integration issues and improve platform reliability and serviceability. * Partner with project managers and engineering leads to define milestones, prototype deliverables, validation schedules, and risk mitigation plans. Communicate technical progress, dependencies, and risks, and recommend actions to keep development on track. * Author and maintain engineering documentation, including system and board specifications, block diagrams, bills of materials, hardware/firmware interface definitions, test reports, and configuration guides. * Work with component vendors, manufacturing, operations, and supply chain teams on new product introduction (NPI), resolving build issues and meeting cost and production readiness objectives. Support sustaining engineering through field issue resolution, alternate component qualification, and component end\-of\-life transitions. Mentor and support junior engineers, share design and debugging expertise across teams, and improve engineering practices based on lessons from development and production. * Success in this role depends on earning the trust of engineers across disciplines and working effectively with internal teams and development partners. You’ll bring people together to resolve technical disagreements, make sound design decisions, and keep development moving. **Qualifications** **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field and 7 years of technical engineering experience; or a master’s degree in these fields and 5 years of experience; or a doctorate in these fields and 3 years of experience; or 11 years of technical engineering experience. * Relevant experience in server, storage, or compute platform development, combining hands\-on board design with cross\-functional technical leadership. * Demonstrated ownership and execution of complex board designs, including component selection, schematic capture, electrical analysis, floor planning, and PCB implementation using tools such as Cadence Concept and Allegro. Experience guiding CAD designers and conducting detailed schematic and layout reviews. * Practical knowledge of high\-speed signal and power integrity, PCB stackup, routing constraints, and power delivery, with experience applying these principles in collaboration with specialist engineers. * Hardware design experience incorporating high\-performance CPUs (Intel, AMD, or ARM\-based) and relevant combinations of GPUs, DDR memory, PCIe interfaces, power regulation, storage, networking, and sideband/control buses. * Hands\-on board bring\-up, debug, root\-cause analysis, and prototype validation using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and other lab equipment, including development and execution of test plans. * Experience bringing hardware through the product lifecycle, from requirements and concept development through detailed design, system integration, validation, and production, with an understanding of sustaining engineering. * Demonstrated ability to lead hardware engineering work across internal teams and JDM/ODM design partners, translate system requirements into technical deliverables, establish design ownership and acceptance criteria, and resolve cross\-functional dependencies. * Experience leading technical reviews of externally developed hardware, including schematics, PCB layouts, bills of materials, and validation results. Ability to document required design changes, assess their impact on integration and qualification, and work with partner engineers to implement and verify them. * Ability to develop clear engineering documentation and communicate design trade\-offs, progress, and risks to engineering leadership, program stakeholders, and partner teams. Excellent collaboration, communication, and mentoring skills, with the ability to influence technical decisions across organizational boundaries. * **Preferred Qualifications** * Recent board design experience with advanced server platforms, including multi\-socket designs, Intel or AMD CPUs, NVIDIA or AMD accelerators, PCIe Gen5 and later, DDR memory technologies, NVIDIA NVLink, or other advanced interconnects. * Knowledge of hardware/firmware integration, system diagnostics, software architecture, or platform firmware such as BIOS/UEFI and BMC. * Recent experience serving as a system technical lead, technical project lead, or technical program lead for data center server, storage, or GPU platforms while maintaining hands\-on board design responsibilities. * Experience developing and deploying hardware platforms for cloud or hyperscale data centers, including rack\-level integration. * Experience working directly with JDM/ODM engineering teams through NPI, including prototype builds, design qualification, engineering change control, manufacturing readiness reviews, and production ramp. Familiarity with global safety, electromagnetic compatibility (EMC), and environmental compliance requirements and certification processes. * **Location** : Not Remote \| On\-Site in Burlington, MA

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer - Evals
jobs.description: **About this role** You'll own evaluation of Honcho end to end, the instrument that tells a research\-driven team whether their identity representations are actually getting better. Plastic Labs builds the memory and identity layer for the agentic world, and the product works. It's a complex multi\-agent harness with real black\-box behavior, so the job is defining what "better" means for representations that change over time, without ground truth, and building the machinery that measures it. If you love constructing measurements from nothing, reading traces to find what's actually broken, and shipping the fix yourself, you'll feel at home here. **What You'll Do** Design the evals. Define the scores and decide what "better" means for an entity representation that changes over time, and keep that definition current as the product and methods move. Build the pipelines and harnesses. Data in, labels, versions, reruns, judges: the machinery that lets the team ask a new question this week and get an answer this week. Run them and harvest insights. Read the traces and results, find what's actually broken, not what's easy to measure, and propose fixes that produce higher\-fidelity representations. Build simulation agents at scale. The ceiling on iteration speed is how many entities can be modeled and measured at once. You raise it. Own the loop end to end. The question, the pipeline, the rerun, the writeup. Nothing gets scoped and handed off, and nothing waits on someone else's sprint. **Work experience** * **Must have**: Designed,​ built,​ and ran evals end to end (LLMS) **Education** * Degree in computer science,​ mathematics,​ statistics,​ or a related quantitative field **Skills** * **Must have:** Production\-​quality Python (tests,​ maintenance,​ release cadence) * 3\+ years of experience 3\+ years designing and owning LLM evaluation * PyTorch,​ Hugging Face,​ Weights \&​ Biases.​ Data pipeline tooling (Hydra,​ Kafka,​ SQL) a plus **Nice\-to\-have** * Work on memory,​ identity,​ personalization,​ agent evaluation,​ or agentic optimization.​ * Shipped research:​ first or co\-​author at NeurIPS,​ ICML,​ ICLR,​ or equivalent,​ OR self\-​published open\-​source work of comparable quality Join us to be at the forefront of AI innovation! Bring your passion for machine learning/AI\-based analysis to develop impactful models that drive strategic decisions across industries while working with the latest technologies in a collaborative environment that values your expertise! Pay: $220,000\.00 \- $300,000\.00 per year Application Question(s): * Are you able to work in\-person at our NYC office full\-time? * Describe your experience designing and building a production ML evaluation system from scratch — particularly when you had no ground truth or existing benchmark to rely on. * What's your trackable research experience? Share a first\-author paper or significant open\-source project and explain your specific contribution. * Can the candidate be on\-site? If not, is the candidate willing to relocate? * What is their salary expectation? Education: * Bachelor's (Required) Experience: * designing and owning LLM evaluation: 3 years (Required) Location: * New York, NY (Required) Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Lead Infrastructure Security Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About the Company** We are a renewable energy and ocean technology company committed to rapidly developing and deploying technologies that will ensure a sustainable future for Earth by unlocking the vast energy potential of its oceans. Our focus is on capturing civilizational levels of ultra\-low\-cost renewable energy for applications including computing and affordable renewable fuels delivered to shore. The company is a public benefit corporation headquartered in Portland, Oregon, and backed by leading venture capitalists, philanthropic investors, university endowments, and private investment offices. We operate as an idea meritocracy in which the best ideas change the company's direction on a regular basis. Our staff have worked at organizations such as SpaceX, Blue Origin, Boeing, Tesla, Apple, Virgin Orbit, Astra, Google, Amazon, Microsoft, New Relic, Bridgewater, Raytheon, Disney Imagineering, and the US Army and Air Force, as well as research universities, startups, and small companies across a range of industries. ### **About the Job** Our core technology is the node, a device that produces energy in the ocean's harshest conditions for years at a time without human maintenance or intervention. As a Lead Infrastructure Security Engineer, you will help scale our security capabilities as we develop technology to harness renewable energy from the ocean. Working closely with the Head of Information Security, you'll strengthen our infrastructure and software security through threat modeling, architecture reviews, automation, and incident response. Candidates should possess broad security infrastructure and engineering skills, as well as professionally useful software engineering skills, and be able to quickly come up to speed with languages and frameworks with which they have not previously worked. Candidates should have strong interpersonal skills and be able to thrive in a creative, scrappy, and collaborative environment in which the best ideas change the company's direction on a regular basis. ### **Responsibilities** * Assist the Head of Information Security with building out the InfraSec and SecEng functions at Panthalassa. * Conduct infrastructure, code, and service architecture reviews to provide security guidance. * Lead engineers in threat modelling service and deployments. * Work with the Head of Information Security to define culturally useful security metrics. * Assist in interviewing and onboarding of other Security personnel. * Assist with incident response and handling now while we grow, and provide escalation support for incidents later as we have grown. * Integrate, maintain, and automate security scanning tools (SAST, DAST, SCA, and secrets management) directly into our CI/CD pipelines. * Build and integrate agentic security tools for Panthalassa needs. * Conduct hands\-on threat modeling and architectural design reviews for new features and deployments before code is written. * Perform manual and automated reviews as well as targeted penetration testing on platforms and internal components. * Help manage the company's external Vulnerability Disclosure or Bug Bounty programs and translate regulatory compliance requirements into practical engineering tasks. ### **Required Qualifications** * 6\+ years of experience with Infrastructure Security and general Security Engineering processes. * 2\+ years of experience as a Team Lead or Manager of a Security team. * Both broad in general and deep in places Security foundational knowledge. * Experience with using AI systems and agents for security outcomes in a professional capacity. * Deep hands\-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and modern infrastructure tools like Docker, Kubernetes, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC). * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or equivalent practical experience. ### **Desired Qualifications** * Experience with software development work related to mechanical engineering environments. * Hands\-on experience with industry\-standard security tools (e.g. Snyk, GitHub Advanced Security, Burp Suite, Fortify). * Familiarity with the OWASP Top 10, CWE Top 25, and secure design patterns. The above qualifications are desired, not required. We encourage you to apply if you are a strong candidate with only some of the desired skills and experience listed. ### **Additional Requirements** * Travel to conferences, vendors and test sites as needed. * Intermittently able to work longer hours and weekends to support critical needs. While we expect a lot of each other, we also offer a high degree of autonomy and work\-life balance, including flexible PTO and flexible working hours. ### **Compensation and Benefits** If hired for this full\-time role, you will receive: * Cash compensation of $180,000 \- $250,000\. * Equity in the company. We're all owners and if we're successful, this equity should be far and away the most valuable component of your compensation. * A benefits package that helps you take care of yourself and your family, including: + Flexible paid time off + Health insurance (the company pays 100% of gold\-level PPO plan for full\-time employees, their partners, and dependents) + Dental insurance (the company pays 100% for full\-time employees, their partners, and dependents) + Vision insurance (the company pays 100% for full\-time employees, their partners, and dependents) + Disability insurance (the company pays 100% for a policy to provide long\-term financial support if you become disabled) + Ability to contribute to tax\-advantaged accounts, including 401(k), health FSA, and dependent care FSA * Relocation assistance to facilitate your move to Portland (if needed). ### **Location** This is a flexible hybrid position based in Portland, Oregon. You may work remotely most of the time, but are expected to come into the office when in\-person collaboration or business needs make it beneficial. The frequency of in\-office work is not fixed and may increase as the company grows. For this reason, we encourage candidates to live in or near Portland. We may consider fully remote arrangements for exceptional candidates.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Agent Identity Management
jobs.description: **Who We Are** -------------- Pindrop is a cybersecurity company delivering continuous identity verification across voice, video, and digital interactions. Powered by the Pindrop Intelligence Network, our unified trust platform helps enterprises answer three critical questions: **Is this identity synthetic?** Detect AI\-generated and manipulated voice and video. **Is this identity risky?** Identify fraud, suspicious behavior, and other risk signals. **Is this identity known?** Authenticate identities using voice, device, behavioral, and other signals. Pindrop brings this intelligence together across purpose\-built trust engines to help organizations make informed decisions in real time — protecting customers, workforce interactions, and emerging AI\-driven interactions. Pindrop protects billions of high\-risk interactions for enterprises, including leading financial institutions, insurers, and healthcare organizations. Its technology is informed by more than 8 billion real\-world interactions annually and protected by 300\+ patents. Recognized by TIME as one of the 10 Most Influential Software Companies of 2026 and by Inc. for Best in Business for Innovation, Pindrop is backed by leading investors including Andreessen Horowitz, IVP, and CapitalG. ### **What you'll do** AI agents are becoming participants in customer and enterprise interactions. Organizations need more than a signal that a caller or participant is AI: they need to establish who the agent is, whom it represents, what it is permitted to do, and what evidence supports that decision. Pindrop is extending its real\-time identity trust platform to help enterprises safely service authorized AI agents across communication channels, with verifiable identity, delegated authorization, risk\-based controls, and auditable proof of access. As Senior Product Manager, Agent Identity Management, you will take primary ownership of this emerging product area\-from customer validation and product strategy to MVP execution, customer adoption, and commercialization. You will work autonomously with Research, Engineering, Security, Design, and go\-to\-market teams, making informed technical and commercial trade\-offs while building a scalable enterprise offering. This is a hands\-on individual\-contributor role for someone who owns outcomes, not just a feature backlog. * Own the product vision and roadmap for agent identity management: agent identification, identity verification, authorization signals, and secure servicing decisions, beginning with real\-time voice interactions and expanding as customer needs validate. * Lead customer discovery with enterprises, contact center leaders, security and identity teams, and agent ecosystem partners; translate workflows, threat models, and trust requirements into prioritized product opportunities. * Define end\-to\-end experiences for agent registration or discovery, verified agent claims, delegated user or business authority, risk\-based step\-up, policy integration, and evidence\-rich audit trails \- with clear boundaries between Pindrop and enterprise decisions. * Partner with Research, Engineering, and Security to evaluate technical approaches such as cryptographic identity assertions, public\-key verification, anti\-spoofing, replay protection, and trust signals; make pragmatic tradeoffs across security, usability, interoperability, and time to market. * Drive early\-access programs, prototypes, and customer pilots; establish hypotheses, measurable success criteria, and fast feedback loops to validate product\-market fit and a repeatable deployment model. * Work with adjacent Pindrop product teams to connect agent identity capabilities with deepfake detection, authentication, risk intelligence, and real\-time policy/orchestration workflows. * Shape integrations and ecosystem strategy across enterprise contact center platforms, agent providers, and identity infrastructure. jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff, Research Scientist - Safety Environments
jobs.description: **About Plato** =============== Plato is an applied research lab building the foundational infrastructure to train specialized AI agents. We turn real\-world data streams into high\-fidelity simulated environments that generate the training signal needed to make capable models. Our work supports frontier labs, hyperscalers, and enterprises building AI systems for complex, high\-stakes work. Today, only a handful of players can train models for capable work. Compute and algorithms are rapidly commoditizing, but reinforcement learning data remains the bottleneck. Plato is changing that by automatically scaling training environments from proprietary real\-world data. **Why Apply** ============= * Work with the frontier: Build safety environments and benchmarks that research teams at leading AI labs can use to measure emerging capabilities and misaligned behavior. * Real ownership: Help set Plato’s safety evaluation agenda, from the research questions worth testing to the evidence we share with lab partners. * Research to production: Work with engineers to turn experimental designs into runnable environments, with a short path from an idea to an evaluation labs can use. **The Role** ============ Plato is hiring an individual contributor researcher to design safety environments and benchmarks, starting with evaluations that measure how well AI models can improve themselves and other models. You will establish a new research direction at Plato, designing safety\-relevant benchmarks and working with engineers to turn them into runnable environments. Your initial focus will be measuring AI R\&D capabilities, including experiment design, model training, and research replication. You will also investigate reward hacking, sabotage, deception, and other misaligned behavior. The work spans research design, empirical evaluation, and failure analysis, with substantial ownership of the research agenda. Some environments may also be used in training to reduce the behaviors they reveal. **What You’ll Do** ================== * Design Safety Benchmarks: Measure AI research automation and self\-improvement. Define tasks, baselines, budgets, and success criteria that separate meaningful progress from superficial completion. * Build Safety Environments: Design environments that expose reward hacking, sabotage, deception, and failures to follow intended constraints. * Hold the Evaluation Bar: Investigate contamination, grader weaknesses, task ambiguity, and shortcuts that could make a result misleading. * Track Frontier Capabilities: Run experiments with current models, inspect trajectories and failures, and measure how capabilities change across models and over time. * Work with Engineering: Turn research designs into reproducible environments with clear scoring, useful instrumentation, and documented limitations. * Share the Findings: Translate results into benchmark releases, research reports, and concrete recommendations for lab partners. **Required Qualifications** =========================== * Recent Research: Hands\-on work in frontier\-model evaluation, benchmarks, or AI safety in the past one to two years. * Research Track Record: Meaningful contributions to papers, released benchmarks, public reports, or comparable empirical work. We care about the quality of your work and your contribution more than credentials or years of experience. * Current Model Knowledge: Practical familiarity with current frontier models and a specific, evidence\-based view of their capabilities, limitations, and likely development. * Experimental Judgment: You can explain what an evaluation measures, how it could be gamed, and which conclusions its results do and do not support. * Research Ownership: Ability to turn an ambiguous question into a concrete experimental design and collaborate closely with engineers to implement it. * Safety Focus: Interest in measuring safety\-relevant capabilities and behavior, including the tradeoffs when evaluation environments are also used for training. * Bay Area Based: Based in the San Francisco Bay Area, or willing to relocate. **Preferred Qualifications** ============================ * Designed and released a benchmark, particularly for AI R\&D, long\-horizon agents, dangerous capabilities, or AI control. Relevant reference points include RE\-Bench, MLE\-bench, and PaperBench. * Experience in an independent evaluation or safety organization, a frontier lab safety team, or pre\-deployment testing with labs or government evaluation bodies. * Direct research on models conducting ML experiments, training or improving other models, replicating papers, or completing extended research tasks. * A software engineering background or programming skills that let you implement environments, evaluation harnesses, and analysis tools yourself. * Experience publishing rigorous empirical research, including work at major machine\-learning venues. Compensation Range: $275K \- $450K

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff - AI/ML Infrastructure Engineer, RL Post-training
jobs.description: **About Us** ============ Preference Model is a superintelligence data research company. We build RL environments for training capable, better\-aligned superintelligences. Almost every aspect of how a model behaves is shaped by the reward signals it's trained on. The biggest problem with AIs today is that they don't always do what we intend. Sometimes that's because they aren't capable enough, and sometimes it's because they aren't aligned. Both problems come down to the training objectives. We're trying to address both of these issues in the most direct, highest leverage way available to us, which today means researching how to build RL environments better, not just for the AIs of today but for the AIs as they will be when they outsmart us. Over the past year, we've built RL environments for several frontier labs, and we're backed by $16M in seed funding led by a16z. Our founding team has previous experience on Anthropic’s data team building data infrastructure, and datasets behind Claude. **About the Role** ================== Frontier research moves only as fast as its infrastructure permits. Building solid infrastructure is foundational to our mission of pushing self\-directed learning as far as it can go. We are looking for **Senior** **ML Infrastructure Engineers** to build the infrastructure and systems that power the **frontier of post\-training on large language models**. This role involves building scalable infrastructure to enable high\-throughput systems and shape how our research is run, bringing us closer to models that can train themselves on what they aren't yet good at. **What You Will Do** ==================== * Design, build, and scale the compute, scheduling, and data infrastructure that powers post\-training research on our in\-house RL environments * Develop and maintain core ML framework primitives and internal tooling that researchers rely on daily, accelerating reproducible experimentation and reducing time from idea to result * Build evaluation and benchmarking infrastructure, monitoring, logging, and debugging tooling, and automated testing and deployment systems, so failures are caught early and infrastructure stays reliable as it scales * Partner directly with Research Engineers to translate research needs into infrastructure requirements, and ship fast in response to their feedback **What We are Looking For** =========================== * Strong software engineering fundamentals and hands\-on experience building production\-grade LLM inference and training infrastructure (ideally from the ground up) * Experience building LLM training/inference internals such as transformers, distributed training, and working on inference libraries like vLLM, SGLang, Megatron * Experience working on RL training frameworks like Slime, veRL, Ray Train, SkyRL, Miles * Significant experience and understanding of distributed systems principles, and have hands\-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP) and container orchestration (Kubernetes), building systems for high\-throughput, low\-latency workloads * Have experience with data engineering tools and building robust, scalable data pipelines * Proficiency in core ML frameworks such as PyTorch or JAX * Can balance production rigor with the pace of fast\-moving research, and communicate infrastructure tradeoffs clearly to researchers who aren't infra specialists **What We Offer:** ================== * Competitive cash and equity compensation (\>90th percentile) * Ownership and autonomy in a fast moving startup environment * Opportunity to work alongside senior and staff engineers from frontier labs and infrastructure companies, plus top ML engineers * Health, vision, dental, benefits * 401K match * Lunch provided everyday onsite * Weekly snack orders * Visa sponsorship \& relocation support available **We value diverse perspectives and experiences. If you're excited about this role but don't check every box, we still encourage you to apply.** Compensation Range: $200K \- $350K

You will work with various technologies to ensure compliance with our Information Security Policies and help protect our organization from cyber threats. **Key Responsibilities** Security Administration – 60% Administer Premier’s cyber security services across laptops, servers, email, network, and cloud platforms. Tools and Testing – 20% Using approved tools; perform security tests and audits, analyze results, and provide recommendations to ensure applicable systems are operating in accordance with Premier Information Security Policies, Standards, and Procedures. Work closely with the vulnerability management tools and triage vulnerabilities in accordance with Premier’s vulnerability policies and procedures. Work closely with the SOC analysts and the SIEM, focus on reporting and alerting to provide Premier a more proactive and optimized Cybersecurity posture Corrective Action – 10% Perform investigation and reporting of security violations of the Corporate Information Security Policies and Standards. Participate with in\-depth inquiries, assessing potential damage, and implementing corrective action. Perform Incident handling and response of security violations based on predefined criteria and triggers Compliance – 5% Assist in eDiscovery and other forensic investigations based on legal or regulatory needs Privacy – 5% Assist in auditing, testing, and preventing Data Leak of sensitive or regulated data using appropriate tools. Assist Privacy team, when necessary, to assist with the generation of reports and generating watch lists. **Required Qualifications** Work Experience: Years of Applicable Experience \- 2 or more years Education: High School Diploma or GED (Required) **Preferred Qualifications** Skills: * Ability to communicate effectively with diverse audiences, both internally and externally. * A strong grasp of network protocols, topologies, and security concepts is crucial for understanding how data flows and where potential vulnerabilities might exist within a network. * Proficiency in working with a SIEM and triaging incidents. * Understanding the steps involved in responding to a security incident, including containment, eradication, and recovery, is vital for mitigating damage from cyberattacks. Experience: * On the job work experience or internship in a relatable field such as cyber security, network administration, disaster recovery or digital forensics. * 0\-12 months years of experience in cyber security Education: * Bachelor’s degree preferred Additional Job Requirements: * Remain in a stationary position for prolonged periods of time * Be adaptive and change priorities quickly; meet deadlines * Attention to detail * Operate computer programs and software * Ability to communicate effectively with audiences in person and in electronic formats. * Day\-to\-day contact with others (co\-workers and/or the public) * Making independent decisions * Ability to work in a collaborative business environment in close quarters with peers and varying interruptions Working Conditions: Remote Travel Requirements: No travel required Physical Demands: Sedentary: Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally, and/or a negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects, including the human body. jobs.title: Head of Software Development
jobs.description: **Head of Software Development / Senior Full\-Stack Developer** About PrintGlobe Founded in 1995, PrintGlobe is an established and growing e\-commerce company specializing in promotional products, branded merchandise, and custom printing solutions. With approximately $20 million in annual revenue, we serve businesses, educational institutions, and government organizations nationwide. Our proprietary technology is central to our success, supporting everything from internal business operations and order management to our customer\-facing e\-commerce websites. We are seeking an experienced, hands\-on **Head of Software Development / Senior Full\-Stack Developer** to help maintain, improve, and expand our technology platforms while providing technical leadership to our development team. Position Overview This is a hands\-on technical leadership position for an experienced software engineer who is equally comfortable writing code, managing complex infrastructure, troubleshooting production issues, and leading development initiatives. The successful candidate will help oversee two primary technology environments: * **Internal Business Applications:** Our proprietary internal software platform, built around Microsoft SQL Server, which supports essential business operations, order processing, and related workflows. * **E\-Commerce \& Web Infrastructure:** Our custom\-built e\-commerce websites, backend applications, APIs, databases, Linux servers, and associated integrations. We are looking for a dependable, resourceful professional who can take ownership of technical challenges, work effectively with existing custom\-built applications, and deliver practical improvements that support our continued growth. This is not a purely managerial position. Strong hands\-on technical capabilities are essential. Key Responsibilities **Software Development \& Technical Leadership** * Lead the maintenance, troubleshooting, enhancement, and modernization of our proprietary applications and e\-commerce platforms. * Actively participate in backend programming, debugging, application development, and code reviews. * Provide technical direction and oversight to internal developers and external technical resources. * Work closely with company leadership to prioritize development initiatives and translate business requirements into technical solutions. * Establish sound development practices, documentation, testing procedures, and deployment processes. * Evaluate existing architecture and recommend improvements that increase reliability, performance, security, and scalability. * Manage development priorities and help ensure projects are delivered on schedule. **Linux Server Administration \& Infrastructure** * Administer, maintain, secure, and troubleshoot production Linux server environments. * Monitor server health, resource utilization, uptime, and application performance. * Diagnose and resolve server, application, networking, and infrastructure issues. * Configure and optimize web servers and supporting services. * Implement appropriate server security, patching, monitoring, backup, and recovery practices. * Support application deployments, production releases, and infrastructure improvements. * Respond to urgent production issues and help minimize service interruptions. **Backend Development \& API Integrations** * Develop, maintain, and troubleshoot backend application functionality. * Build and support JSON/REST APIs and integrations with internal and external systems. * Diagnose application errors, integration failures, and performance bottlenecks. * Work with existing custom codebases and improve their maintainability and reliability. * Support integrations between e\-commerce websites, internal applications, vendors, and third\-party services. **Database Development \& Optimization** * Work extensively with Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL, and other SQL\-based database environments. * Troubleshoot database performance, inefficient queries, and data\-related application issues. * Develop and optimize SQL queries, stored procedures, and database integrations. * Support database architecture, data integrity, security, and reliability. * Identify opportunities to improve database and application performance. **E\-Commerce Platform Support** * Maintain and improve established, custom\-built e\-commerce websites. * Troubleshoot production issues affecting website functionality, performance, and customer experience. * Support web server configuration, application deployment, and ongoing production operations. * Collaborate with business stakeholders to implement new website features, integrations, and operational improvements. * Help ensure our platforms remain secure, reliable, scalable, and available. Required Qualifications * 10\+ years of professional software development and/or systems engineering experience. * Demonstrated experience leading software development projects or technical teams. * Advanced Linux server administration, troubleshooting, security, and performance optimization skills. * Strong backend programming skills, including the ability to understand, debug, and improve existing applications. * Significant experience with Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL, SQL development, and database performance troubleshooting. * Experience developing, maintaining, and integrating JSON/REST APIs. * Strong understanding of web server configuration, deployment processes, and production application support. * Experience supporting established, custom\-built e\-commerce websites or other business\-critical web applications. * Familiarity with application architecture, version control, testing, and software deployment practices. * Ability to troubleshoot complex issues spanning application code, databases, servers, and integrations. * Strong organizational, communication, and problem\-solving skills. * Ability to work independently in a remote environment while collaborating effectively with a team. * Dependability, accountability, and willingness to respond to urgent production issues when necessary. Preferred Qualifications * Experience modernizing legacy applications without disrupting ongoing business operations. * Familiarity with e\-commerce order processing, ERP systems, inventory management, and payment integrations. * Experience managing production web infrastructure and improving website security. * Familiarity with cloud hosting, infrastructure monitoring, automation, and CI/CD processes. * Experience in a growing, entrepreneurial, mid\-sized company. * Proven ability to balance hands\-on technical contributions with team leadership and project management. What We're Looking For Our ideal candidate is an experienced developer and technical leader who enjoys solving difficult problems and making existing systems work better. You don't need a large team or elaborate processes to be effective. You understand how to prioritize work, diagnose issues, make sound technical decisions, and deliver results. You are comfortable moving between high\-level architectural discussions and hands\-on technical work, whether that involves optimizing a SQL query, debugging an API integration, troubleshooting a Linux server, or helping a developer resolve an application issue. You take ownership of problems, communicate clearly, and understand that reliability, responsiveness, and business continuity are essential in an e\-commerce environment. What Success Looks Like During your first year, you will be expected to: * Develop a thorough understanding of our internal applications, databases, websites, and infrastructure. * Establish effective working relationships with our development team and business leadership. * Improve the stability, performance, and security of our production systems. * Reduce recurring application and infrastructure problems. * Establish clear development priorities and consistent delivery practices. * Deliver meaningful improvements to our internal business applications and customer\-facing websites. * Develop a practical roadmap for improving our technology as the company grows. Pay: $130,000\.00 \- $150,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Flexible schedule * Health insurance * Paid time off * Retirement plan Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Software Engineer II
jobs.description: At ProService, we exist to empower employers to succeed in Hawai?i. More than 3,000 local businesses rely on us for payroll, HR, and benefits, and many run their day on tools like Toast, QuickBooks Online, and NetSuite. When those systems talk cleanly to ours, a restaurant owner closes payroll without re\-keying hours. When they don’t, a small business loses time it doesn’t have. This role owns that connection. You’ll build and run the integrations marketplace that links our customers’ business systems to our HR platform, blending strong engineering with real product ownership. Success looks like customers connecting in minutes, data that stays accurate without manual work, and problems fixed before anyone has to report them. **IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL** * Design, build, and launch integrations with platforms like Toast, QuickBooks Online, and NetSuite using OAuth 2\.0, webhooks, and polling * Own the integrations marketplace end to end, including the catalog, connect and disconnect flows, connection health, and a roadmap prioritized with Product * Architect reusable serverless patterns on AWS (Lambda, EventBridge, SQS, DynamoDB) in Python, TypeScript, and React/Next.js so each integration ships faster than the last * Partner directly with customers on bespoke integrations with ProService APIs, and with vendor developer programs on sandbox access, certification, and API changes * Build monitoring and alerting that catches sync failures before customers notice * Uphold code quality through testing, code reviews, and CI/CD, and support production reliability through on\-call rotations **IS THIS ROLE RIGHT FOR YOU?** This is an ownership role, not a ticket queue. You’ll ship at least one production\-ready integration per quarter and keep owning it after launch, including joining the on\-call rotation to resolve critical issues within hours. You’ll also talk directly with customers and partners to shape what gets built next. These expectations are not optional — they’re the job. You’ll share them with a team that reviews each other’s code and treats incidents as chances to learn, not to assign blame. The role also takes patience. Partner APIs change, certifications move at their own pace, and many decisions are judgment calls between fast and durable. The team works on Hawai?i Standard Time, so Southern California candidates should expect a workday that starts mid\-morning and runs into the early evening. **WHAT YOU’LL BRING TO THE TEAM** You’ve shipped production\-grade software in a SaaS or product\-driven environment, and you’ve built third\-party integrations that stay reliable. That means experience with OAuth 2\.0 token lifecycle, webhooks, pagination, data mapping, and vendor API versioning. You’re fluent in AWS serverless, Python, TypeScript, React/Next.js, and Git\-based Agile workflows. Accounting, POS, time and labor, or payroll familiarity is a strong plus. So is experience with partner certification programs or with AI/LLM APIs for data mapping. **You’re probably a fit if:** * **You enjoy the detective work of making systems agree.** *You trace a mismatched record through logs, payloads, and mappings to its root cause, so the customer’s numbers line up every time after.* * **You make sound calls between fast and durable.** *When an API change collides with a deadline, you weigh a quick patch against a retry\-safe fix and choose the path that keeps customer data safe.* * **You keep your commitments when priorities compete.** *You juggle a new build, a production fix, and a partner certification, and everyone waiting on you knows when their piece is coming.* * **You adjust quickly when the ground shifts.** *When a vendor deprecates an endpoint mid\-sprint, you re\-plan and keep customers connected without them noticing.* * **You translate between technical and non\-technical worlds.** *You explain trade\-offs in plain language and bring Product, Support, and customers in early, so what you ship solves the real problem.* **WORK LOCATION** **Honolulu, Hawaii — Hybrid \| Orange County or Los Angeles, CA — Remote** We welcome applications from candidates based in Hawaii, who would work a hybrid schedule out of our Honolulu office, as well as fully remote candidates based in Orange County or Los Angeles. Hawaii\-based candidates are preferred, followed by candidates in Orange County. Remote candidates must be available during Hawaii Standard Time (HST / UTC\-10\) business hours. Hawaii (Hybrid): In office Tuesday – Thursday \| Option for Remote Monday \& Friday Southern California (Remote): Hours: Hawaii Standard Time (HST / UTC\-10\) **COMPENSATION** The base compensation for this position is $110,000\.00 – $137,000\.00 per year depending on experience and qualifications. **WHY PROSERVICE** ProService is a Hawaii\-based PEO combining payroll, HR, and benefits expertise with purpose\-built technology — all backed by the best local service in the islands. Backed by Silver Lake and recognized as one of Hawai?i’s Best Places to Work for 20 consecutive years, we’re a team of high performers united by one mission: Empowering Employers to Succeed in Hawaii. * **A PROhana unlike any other.** We assume the best in each other, give feedback focused on what’s right—not who’s right—and show up every day. This isn’t just a workplace. It’s a community. * **Do work that matters.** You’ll see exactly how your contributions move the needle—meaningful problems, real decisions, and a seat at the table. * **Grow without a ceiling.** Internal roles post first, and we reimburse certifications, conferences, and memberships. Your growth is our growth. * **Compete, collaborate, and win together.** High expectations, real accountability, and a team of experts ready to help you push through any obstacle. * **Total rewards built around your whole life.** Fully paid healthcare, 401(k) matching, paid parental leave, student loan assistance, employee assistance programs, and paid time off—just to name a few.

jobs.description: **Department Information** -------------------------- **This position is only open to Colorado state residents.** **New employees to the State will be paid biweekly. There are 26 biweekly pay periods in a year.** **About CDOT** CDOT employees make a difference by providing freedom, connection, and experience to the traveling public, while also keeping them safe. The State of Colorado offers competitive medical, dental and vision insurance, life and disability insurance, and flexible spending and health savings accounts. Visit the State of Colorado benefits for details, current premium rates and a summary video about benefits. Perks include Colorado Employee Assistance Program (CSEAP) counseling, wellness, credit union membership and employee discount program. Visit CDOT Benefits for details. The eligible list created from this announcement may be used to fill current and future vacancies for a period of up to 6 months. **Description of Job** ---------------------- **About the Work Unit** The purpose of the work unit is to plan, design, and administer projects assigned. This includes a wide range of activities that span from planning through project development, advertisement, and construction to completion. These activities support all of the “investment categories” for the Mission of the Colorado Department of Transportation (CDOT). **About the Position** Duties at the EIT levels are closely planned to provide experience in, and develop practical application of professional engineering processes, theories, laws, principles, and techniques related to transportation/highway engineering. Projects are assigned and applied through a combination of formal instructions and on\-the\-job training and require the application of knowledge, judgment and experience acquired as a Civil Engineer college graduate. Provides entry level engineering design and construction support for the unit. Work typically includes utilization of most of the practices and methodologies of the agency under the guidance and supervision of a fully\-operational Professional Engineer or Project Engineer. This position builds upon basic engineering theories, concepts, and principles; attains Engineer Intern registration, if they do not already have it; and progresses toward a professional engineer license. Completed engineering work is reviewed by higher level engineers. **Your duties and responsibilities will include, but are not limited to, the following** * **Duties performed under the guidance and supervision of a licensed engineer.** * Assist with plans, organize and conduct engineering projects requiring the application of professional engineering processes, theories, laws, principles, conceptual models, and techniques related to highway engineering * Assist with oversight/oversee the work of contractors, reviewing the work for compliance with plans, specifications, and procedures. * Accountable for contract administration. * Verify that the contractor’s equipment, materials, workmanship, and products are in conformance with the contract plans and specifications by performing detailed inspections and maintaining proper documentation. * Check and compile documentation that reports quantities of work performed and assuring the contractual acceptability of the work. * Prepare and approve payments for the contractor. * Assist with applying the plans, specifications, and M \& S Standards to inspect the work progress by contractors to assure conformance. * Assist with documenting and approving progress and final contract payments due for work completed and accepted by reviewing pay documentation prepared by staff. * Consult with the PE to recommend appropriate changes in the contract to minimize potential costs and delays and to compose contract change orders using appropriate methods for cost and schedule evaluations. * Attend assigned training classes and studies CDOT manuals to enhance knowledge necessary to perform the job duties. * Learn to support the PE with assigned projects using practical applications of professional engineering processes, theories, laws, principles, and techniques related to highway engineering. * Learn to assist the PE with documentation for design\-related decisions;
