jobs.title: Security Engineer
jobs.description: **About Qualitate** Qualitate is building the AI\-native primary intelligence platform for enterprises, investment firms, and asset managers. We automate the entire primary research workflow, from study design and expert recruitment through AI\-moderated interviews and insight synthesis – replacing weeks of manual research with hours of high\-signal output. Expert research is a broken industry dominated by legacy incumbents with expensive, manual, and slow services. Investment and corporate strategy teams spend hundreds of hours coordinating intermediaries, scheduling expert calls, and synthesizing insights across fragmented providers. The process takes weeks to produce short\-lived intelligence. Qualitate transforms this workflow by autonomously conducting expert discussions at scale using AI. Qualitate’s AI Moderator interviews thousands of experts simultaneously each month, capturing forward\-looking purchasing plans, competitive displacement, and real\-time ROI signals. The platform turns these interviews into quantified, time\-series outputs tracking over 10,000 public and private companies, queryable instantly in natural language. Our customers include some of the world’s largest enterprises, hedge funds, PE firms, credit investors, and venture capital firms. **The Role** Join Qualitate as our first dedicated security engineer. At 45 people, the security program you build is the one the company will scale on. You’ll harden our cloud environment, build logging, monitoring, and detection, remediate findings from penetration tests, and serve as the security reviewer on design docs for new features and architecture changes. You’ll also lead ISO 27001 from start to finish: scoping, risk assessment, implementing controls, and getting us through the certification audit, with evidence collection automated instead of tracked in spreadsheets. This is a high\-ownership role. You’ll be a part of our founding engineering team to define our security architecture and roadmap, and you’ll write and ship production code, not just review it. Our customers are hedge funds, PE firms, and large enterprises with demanding security requirements, so the systems you secure and the certifications you earn directly shape how fast we grow. The problems are specific to our platform: protecting confidential expert interviews and customer research, securing an AI system that runs thousands of interviews a month, and reaching ISO 27001 without slowing engineering down. You’ll report to our CTO, lead our response when something goes wrong, and partner with our VP of Compliance and Legal on policy, customer security reviews, and our broader compliance program. We’re looking for someone with 4\+ years of security engineering experience, including hands\-on compliance work, who thrives in fast\-moving environments where the surface area is wide and the team is lean. **Who This Role Is For** * **4\+ years of experience in security engineering.** Ideally some of it at a startup or high\-growth SaaS company where you secured cloud infrastructure hands\-on and also helped build a compliance program. * **Strong Cloud and infrastructure security skills.** Experience securing AWS or GCP environments, including IAM, network security, logging and monitoring, secrets management, and encryption. You can read and write infrastructure\-as\-code. * **Penetration testing rigor.** You can contribute to a production code base and address issues raised in a penetration test. * **ISO 27001 experience.** You’ve helped take a company through ISO 27001 certification, including scoping the ISMS, running risk assessments, writing the Statement of Applicability, implementing controls, and managing the audit. SOC 2 Type II experience is a plus. \[You’ve built the technical controls behind an ISO 27001 or SOC 2 Type II certification, such as access management, logging, vulnerability management, and encryption, and automated evidence collection rather than tracking it in spreadsheets. Familiarity with ISMS scoping, risk assessments, or the Statement of Applicability is a plus.] * **Fluent with AI models and agentic coding tools.** You use AI in your daily workflow, understand the security and data governance risks of building with LLMs, and know how to defend against risks like prompt injection and data leakage. This is core to how we work. * **High ownership, low ego.** You work independently, communicate proactively, and don’t wait to be told what to build. You’re comfortable making architecture decisions and defending them in code review. **What Sets You Apart** * Hands\-on experience with security tooling such as SIEM, EDR, CSPM, and vulnerability or container image scanning, and with compliance automation platforms like Vanta or Drata. Bonus if you’ve built reusable guardrails or libraries that make the secure path the easy path for other engineers. * Experience securing LLM\-based applications and agentic systems, including red\-teaming AI features for prompt injection, data exfiltration, and tool misuse. * Experience building technical controls for data segregation and access, ideally in financial services or expert networks where MNPI and client confidentiality matter. * Security certifications such as ISO 27001 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor, CCSP, AWS Security Specialty, or OSCP. * Background in financial services and/or market research. **Compensation \& Benefits** * **Base salary:** $160\-220K base salary, based on experience. * **Equity:** Meaningful early\-stage grant with upside tied to company growth. * **Benefits:** Health coverage, flexible PTO, paid holidays. * **Location:** Full\-time, in\-person in New York City Mon\-Weds, remote Thurs\-Fri. **What to Expect Working at Qualitate** * **Excellence.** You’ll be held accountable to an exceptionally high bar for quality and impact. * **High velocity.** Fast\-paced environment in terms of growth, decision\-making, and time to impact. * **High agency.** Ownership over how you work, not just what you work on. We hire people we trust to figure it out. * **A builder’s mindset.** You’ll create the processes, playbooks, and systems that define how this company scales. * **Shared ambition.** A small, early team disrupting the multi\-billion dollar market research industry with AI. * **Joy.** We work hard and genuinely enjoy working together. Dedication to our work is matched only by our passion for fostering an enjoyable, collaborative work environment. Qualitate is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply.

jobs.title: DHA-EOSS Software Developer, Applications (FM Application Developer)
jobs.description: Description: Quantum Sky is searching for a qualified **Software Developer, Applications** (FM Application Developer) to join our technical engineering team supporting the Defense Health Agency (DHA) E\-Commerce Operational Systems Support (EOSS) contract in Aurora, Colorado. Under this task order, our team maintains, sustains, and enhances the enterprise Oracle Federal Financials (OFF) application suite—the core financial engine of the DHA E\-Commerce System (ECS). Operating on Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) within MedCOI\-hosted Amazon Web Services (AWS) GovCloud East, OFF executes purchased care budget, accounting, and disbursement operations for the multi\-billion\-dollar TRICARE Private Sector Healthcare System. As a Journeyman Application Developer, you will collaborate with Senior FM Developers (LCAT 313\), Business Analysts, Database Administrators, and DHA Contract Resource Management (CRM) stakeholders to design, code, test, and maintain custom OFF extensions, forms, reports, automated workflows, and external system interfaces. **Responsibilities:**#### **1\. OFF Application Engineering \& Custom Extensions** * Perform full lifecycle development, sustainment engineering, and bug fixing across core Oracle Federal Financials COTS modules and DHA custom extensions, including: + **Core COTS Financial Modules:** General Ledger (GL), Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), Purchasing (PO), Cost Management, Federal Financials, and Sub\-Ledger Accounting (SLA). + **Specialized Custom Extensions:** Healthcare Claims Processing extensions, Pharmacy Module extensions, Office of General Counsel (OGC) Debt Management module, and Oracle Projects. + **Reporting \& Interfaces:** SplashBI transactional reporting, Oracle Developer Suite Forms \& Reports, Connect:Direct scripts, and Workflow Builder processes. * Develop, modify, and optimize SQL queries, PL/SQL packages, procedures, functions, database triggers, and batch concurrent programs executing in a UNIX/Linux RHEL environment. * Support claims\-to\-invoice conversion routines that interface healthcare claim data from the TRICARE Encounter Data System (TEDS) into OFF financial accounting structures. #### **2\. Federal Accounting \& Inter\-Agency Modernization Projects** Contribute to the implementation of mandated federal initiatives under the guidance of Senior Developers and Architects:* **Government Invoicing (G\-Invoicing):** Support development of data exchange objects, attributes, and automated settlement workflows for Intragovernmental Transactions (IGT) Buy/Sell activity using Treasury data standards. * **Central Accounting Reporting System (CARS):** Build and maintain ETL routines and database ingestion scripts to process the CARS Transactional Data Extract (CTDE) file, automating daily cash transaction reconciliation against Treasury disbursement data. * **Standard Financial Information Structure (SFIS / SLOA / CCAS):** Modify OFF accounting flexfields, database tables, and validation logic to maintain compliance with DoD Business Enterprise Architecture (BEA), Standard Line of Accounting (SLOA), and Common Cost Accounting Structure (CCAS). * **PRISM to OFF Interface Handshake:** Build and test automated commitment and obligation validation interfaces between OFF and Global Unison PRISM procurement software prior to contract modifications. * **DFAS DDRS \& WAWF Interfaces:** Maintain transaction generation files and connectivity schemas transferring financial ledger data to the Defense Departmental Reporting System (DDRS) and Wide Area Workflow (WAWF) via the Global Exchange (GEX). * **CRMSIT Payment Testing :** Assist in generating test claim data files, running cycle processing, and executing end\-to\-end payment simulations with TEDS during biennial integration testing. #### **3\. SDLC, Environment Governance \& Testing** * Maintain and manage code across **five (5\) isolated environments**: Development, System Test, QA/Pre\-Prod (User Acceptance Testing), Benchmark, and Production. * Conduct all development and unit testing strictly within the Development environment, accessed exclusively via the secure **DHA DCOPS Application Virtualization Hosting Environment (AVHE)**. * Adhere strictly to environment access segregation: developers are prohibited from direct data access in QA/Pre\-Prod and Production; package deployment scripts for DBA and system administrator execution. * Utilize enterprise Configuration Management tools (GIT / GitHub, Micro Focus SBM, HP Quality Center/ALM) for software versioning, branching, check\-in/check\-out, and defect tracking. * Author and execute comprehensive Unit Test plans, and support System Integration Testing (SIT) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT), capturing test artifacts and screen evidence. * Support resolution of application defects to meet contractual quality thresholds: 100% of major defects, 100% of moderate defects, and 95% of minor defects resolved prior to release. #### **4\. Cybersecurity gree from an accredited university in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical discipline. + *Experience Substitution Rule:* Fifteen (15\) years of documented experience in software applications development may be substituted in lieu of a bachelor’s degree. * **Experience Mandate:** + Minimum of one (1\) year of hands\-on experience in Oracle® Federal Financials R\-12 application development (utilizing Developer Suite Forms, Reports, and Workflow Builder) on a UNIX/Linux environment supporting an application of the size and complexity of DHA ECS OFF. **Required Technical Proficiencies:*** Hands\-on proficiency with Oracle E\-Business Suite (EBS) / Federal Financials R12 architecture, database schemas, table relationships, and concurrent program registration. * Proficiency in PL/SQL and SQL development, including stored procedures, packages, functions, triggers, and performance tuning (indexes, execution plans). * Practical experience utilizing Oracle Developer Suite (Forms 10g/11g/12c and Reports Builder) and Oracle Workflow Builder. * Experience developing and troubleshooting in a Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) or UNIX server environment utilizing shell scripting (Bash, Korn shell) and basic command\-line utilities. * Experience with source code version control tools (e.g., Git, GitHub, PVCS) and structured SDLC processes (IEEE 1074\). **Accounting Calendar Surges:** Due to the cyclical nature of federal healthcare accounting (End\-of\-Month, End\-of\-Quarter, and Fiscal Year\-End closeouts in September/October), developers must have the flexibility to work adjusted/extra hours between pay periods to support financial book closings. Any total hours in excess of 40 hours per week require advance approval from the Contracting Officer Representative (COR). **Desired:*** Functional familiarity with federal accounting concepts, including the United States Standard General Ledger (USSGL), Prompt Payment Act, Antideficiency Act, and Treasury financial standards. * Experience supporting interfaces to DoD or federal external systems (e.g., WAWF, GEX, SPS, TEDS, CARS, G\-Invoicing). * Familiarity with SplashBI reporting or Oracle BI Publisher template development. * Familiarity with AWS GovCloud hosting environments, Oracle WebLogic, and PKI/CAC authentication integrations. **Clearance:*** Active or favorably adjudicated Tier 3 (T3\) / NACLC investigation (SF\-86\). (Ability to obtain interim T3/IT\-II prior to onboarding). **Location:*** Aurora, CO About Quantum Sky: **Compensation:*** Compensation is unique to each candidate and relative to the skills and experience they bring to the position. The salary range for this position is typically between $140,000\-$153,000\. This does not guarantee a specific salary as compensation is based upon multiple factors such as education, experience, certifications, and other requirements, and may fall outside of the above\-stated range. **Benefits:*** Highlights of our benefits include Health/Dental/Vision, 401(k) match, Paid Time Off, STD/LTD/Life Insurance, Referral Bonuses, professional development reimbursement, and parental leave. The world the mission operates in is going post\-quantum, contested, and machine\-speed. Quantum Sky engineers the advantage across cyber, networks, software, and quantum because the mission demands dominance, not parity. We don't follow the map. We draw it. At Quantum Sky, we believe that success starts with our people. We foster a collaborative, innovative, and mission\-driven environment where every team member plays a critical role in shaping the future of technology. Are you ready to join \#TeamQuantumSky? jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Description** Recognized as the No. 1 site trusted by real estate professionals, Realtor.com® has been at the forefront of online real estate for over 25 years, connecting buyers, sellers, and renters with trusted insights and expert guidance to find their perfect home. Through its robust suite of tools, Realtor.com® not only makes a significant impact on the real estate industry at large, but for consumers, navigating the biggest purchase they will make in their life, by providing a user experience that is easy to use, easy to understand, and most of all, easy to make decisions. Join us on our mission to empower more people to find their way home by breaking barriers to entry, making the right connections, and building confidence through expert guidance. Who are we: Have an interest in making an impact for millions of consumers? Do you thrive in a cross\-collaborative environment? Are you ready to take on your next career challenge? If you want to pursue your professional goals as you help grow an innovative real estate tech company, this work is for you! We’re offering a dynamic opportunity for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Owners \& Sellers team. In this role, You will act as a foundational technical engineer running mission\-critical platforms that directly drive revenue, while taking charge of initiatives that improve the consumer experience and drive core business outcomes. Leverage the latest technologies, including Typescript, React, Node.js, NextJS, GraphQL, AWS, AI tools, and more, to accelerate your professional growth and achieve new heights in your career. Top Reasons to Apply: * Hands\-On Cloud \& DevOps Ownership You’ll own the infrastructure, not just the code. You will design AWS data pipelines and automate the toolchain (using Lambda, ECS, and CloudFormation) to enable instant service provisioning and zero\-friction deployments. * AI\-Driven Engineering Culture The team actively rewards engineers who leverage AI tools as a performance multiplier. You’ll be encouraged to use AI to write better code faster and accelerate development in a forward\-thinking environment. * Full\-Stack Scale \& Impact You will own the end\-to\-end architecture for the top builder listing site in the US. This means bridging complex AWS data pipelines with high\-velocity, SEO\-optimized React/NextJS frontends handling massive traffic. What you’ll do: * Develop and Maintain: Own systems and evolutions for key parts of the Owners \& Sellers platform, defining clear boundaries, contracts, and data models between services. Participate in and lead architectural discussions, contributing to technical design documents and implementation proposals. * Lead Complex Initiatives: Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Designers, and Engineers on cross\-squad initiatives end\-to\-end—from early discovery and technical design through implementation, rollout, and post\-launch iteration. * Full\-Stack Excellence: Maintain and improve the stability, readability, and scalability of the codebase, ensuring best practices across backend services and frontend architecture using React and Next.js. * Optimize Performance \& Reliability: Drive performance improvements and optimize Core Web Vitals (such as INP metrics) across our pages. Lead operational excellence by ensuring services meet SLAs, influencing incident response, and continuously reducing incident volume and MTTR. * Shape the Technical Roadmap: Partner closely with Product Managers, Engineering Managers, and Designers to define and sequence work that advances both business goals and platform health. * Leverage Cutting\-Edge Tooling: Utilize AI coding assistants and LLMs proficiently to accelerate development velocity, generate boilerplate, and troubleshoot complex debugging scenarios, while exercising critical judgment to verify outputs for security and accuracy. * Mentor and Elevate: Provide technical leadership within and across teams, coaching junior to Staff engineers, reviewing PRs for high\-risk changes, and aligning teams on shared patterns. What You’ll Bring: * 7\+ years of software engineering experience, including significant time in large\-scale, distributed systems * Deep full\-stack proficiency: Extensive experience in frontend web development with a strong focus on Typescript, React js and Apollo GraphQL combined with deep proficiency in backend languages like Node js and GraphQL. * AI Tooling Mastery: Proven proficiency using modern AI\-assisted SDLC environments and agents (e.g., Claude/Cursor/GitHub Copilot, \- based engineering agents) and drive AI adoption at scale * Cloud \& Infrastructure Expertise: Experience designing and operating cloud\-native services on AWS (EKS, containers like Docker, managed databases) with modern CI/CD orchestration (e.g., CircleCI, ArgoCD, Kubernetes). * Systems Design: Strong grounding in system design, data modeling, API design, responsive design principles, and CSS technologies like PandaCSS/CSS3\. * Observability \& Data\-Driven Mindset: Comfort working with observability tooling (metrics, logs, traces like NewRelic and Splunk) and using data to debug, optimize, and harden production systems. * Leadership \& Communication: A proven ability to set technical direction for a problem space, align multiple teams without formal authority, and clearly explain complex trade\-offs to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science/Engineering/related field or equivalent professional experience. How We Work: We balance creativity and innovation on a foundation of in\-person collaboration. Our employees work three days in our Austin headquarters where they have the opportunity to collaborate in\-person, adding richness to our culture and knitting us closer together. How We Reward You: Realtor.com® is committed to investing in the health and wellbeing of our employees and their families. Our benefits include: * Inclusive and Competitive medical, Rx, dental, and vision coverage. * 13 Paid Holidays and Flexible Time Off. * Immediate eligibility into Company 401(k) plan with 3\.5% company match. * Family forming benefits and Student Debt Retirement Savings Match program. * Tuition Reimbursement and 1:1 personalized Financial Planning Sessions. * 8 hours of paid Volunteer Time off. * Free snacks and refreshments in each office location. Realtor.com® is an Equal Opportunity Employer regardless of age, color, national origin, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, marital status, or disability status.

restricted\-data patterns, and Airflow integration. * Develop reusable TypeScript, Python, and/or Kotlin libraries and reference implementations for producing, consuming, validating, and moving data. * Contribute to Snowflake integration patterns, data exports, toolsets, and secure access paths without taking ownership of stakeholder\-specific data modeling. **Reliability, security, and operations** * Take pride in ensuring delive ation. * Familiarity with Avro or another schema and serialization system, data quality controls, compatibility management, and event\-driven design. * lead initiatives, make sound tradeoffs, and work effectively with product engineering, analytics, data science, security, and infrastructure partners. * Practical experience creating AI\-assisted developer workflows, agentic automation, reusable AI skills, or tool\-using LLM applications. * Understanding of AI safety and reliability practices, including grounded retrieval, permissions, support\-ticket automation. * Experience with one or more of TypeScript, Python, and Kotlin client libraries or SDKs. **Working style** * Enthusiastically own outcomes end to end, from design through implementation, testing, deployment, documentation, and operational support. * Prefer reusable platform capabilities over one\-off solutions. * Enjoy collaborating directly with end\-users to jobs.title: Full Stack Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: **Build What Matters at RevStar** **Position:** Full Stack Forward Deployed Engineer * **Reports To:** Product Manager/Engineering Lead * **Location**: Remote (AZ, FL, TX) * **Employment Type:** Full\-Time W2 **Job Summary** Ready to build sleek, enterprise\-grade cloud applications that blend high\-performance UI, cloud\-native backends, and modern search architectures? RevStar is an AI\-first innovation shop and AWS Advanced Tier Partner delivering end\-to\-end cloud, data, and AI solutions for forward\-thinking clients. We are seeking an experienced Full Stack JavaScript Web Developer to build responsive React frontends, architect secure Node.js microservices, and integrate modern AWS search and data pipelines. In this role, you will work in an agile, client\-facing environment where you turn complex business problems into production\-grade digital products. Above all, the ideal candidate embodies RevStar’s core values: * **Self\-Mastery**: We hold a high bar for how we think, communicate, and improve. * **Ownership:** We own outcomes, not just effort. * **Shared Destiny**: We rise or fall together. Your Impact Pillars Your engineering contribution is organized into four core pillars: 1\. **Frontend Architecture \& UI Delivery** * Build performant, accessible, and responsive web applications in ReactJS using modern JavaScript and TypeScript patterns. * Translate Figma mockups into reusable component libraries that drive consistent user experiences across client products. * Optimize client\-side performance, state management, and user interaction flows. 2\. **Backend Engineering \& AWS Integration** * Design and deploy secure, scalable RESTful APIs and backend microservices using Node.js, Express, and AWS serverless tooling (Lambda, API Gateway, ECS). * Model and manage structured and unstructured data using SQL and NoSQL databases (PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, RDS, S3\). * Maintain robust CI/CD pipelines, GitHub workflows, and automated testing suites to ensure production\-grade code quality. 3\. **Advanced Search \& Data Workflows** * Implement enterprise search, indexing, and data retrieval capabilities using Amazon OpenSearch and Kendra. * Collaborate with data engineers to build ETL pipelines that unify disparate client data sources into searchable, actionable jobs.description: **Role description** **Salesforce Forward Deployed Engineer** Build agents on Agentforce, extend them with custom MCP servers, and ship both alongside the people who use them. **EXPERIENCE** 6–9 years in Salesforce **What you’ll do** A Forward Deployed Engineer works where the business problem actually lives. You’ll embed with a business team, learn their process in enough detail to argue about edge cases, and then build the thing — in their org, against their data, with them watching. The feedback loop is days, not quarters. The work is a mix of three things. First, Agentforce: designing agents, topics, and actions on the platform, grounding them in Data Cloud, and tuning them until they behave in production. Second, custom MCP servers you design and write in Python, which connect agents (Agentforce and others) to systems and capabilities the platform doesn’t cover out of the box. Third, the core Salesforce engineering that makes both dependable: Apex, LWC, Flow, integrations, and a data model that holds up under real volume. **RESPONSIBILITIES** * Run discovery directly with business stakeholders — process walkthroughs, org audits, data profiling — and turn what you learn into a design, not a backlog of tickets. * Design, build, and deploy Agentforce agents: topics, instructions, guardrails, and actions backed by Apex, Flow, prompt templates, and APIs. * Ground agents in the right data using Data Cloud, retrieval, and the Einstein Trust Layer, with an eye on accuracy, latency, and cost. * Decide, case by case, whether a capability belongs in a native Agentforce action or a custom MCP server, and build the connection between them when it’s the latter. * Design and build custom MCP servers in Python that expose Salesforce objects, SOQL queries, Apex endpoints, and business actions as well\-scoped agent tools, with clear input schemas, useful error messages, and permissions that respect the org’s sharing model. * Build on\-platform: Apex (triggers, Queueable, Batch, async patterns), Lightning Web Components, Flow, Platform Events, and a data model you’d defend in review. * Integrate Salesforce with external systems — REST and GraphQL APIs, OAuth 2\.0 flows, Named Credentials, External Services, middleware — handling retries, idempotency, and rate limits properly. * Evaluate agent behavior end to end: write test cases, measure topic routing and action accuracy, and find failure modes before a user does. * Own deployment and quality — SFDX, scratch orgs, CI/CD, Apex test coverage that means something, and governor\-limit awareness as a design habit rather than a bug fix. * Leave documentation and runbooks behind, so the team you embedded with can operate what you built after you move on. **REQUIREMENTS** **Salesforce depth** * 6–9 years building on the Salesforce platform. * Production Apex at scale: bulkification, asynchronous patterns, governor limits, trigger frameworks. * Lightning Web Components and solid front\-end fundamentals (JavaScript, HTML, CSS). * Declarative fluency — Flow, validation rules, sharing and visibility — and judgment about when not to write code. * Data modeling, large\-data\-volume considerations, and integration architecture. * Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, or Experience Cloud in production. **Agentforce, MCP, and Python** * Hands\-on Agentforce experience: building agents with topics and actions, Prompt Builder, Agent Builder, and Data Cloud grounding. * Strong Python — you’ve shipped and maintained services, not just scripts. * Hands\-on experience building custom MCP servers or comparable LLM tool\-use integrations (function calling, agent frameworks, retrieval pipelines). * A working mental model of how LLMs fail, and the habit of designing tools that fail safely. * API design, authentication, and secrets handling in an environment with real compliance constraints. * Comfort with Git, CI/CD, containers, and cloud deployment. **How you work** * You’re effective in front of non\-technical stakeholders — you can run the meeting, not just attend it. * You move under ambiguity and know which corners are safe to cut in a prototype and which ones aren’t. * You write clearly. Design docs, decision records, and handoff notes are part of the job. **BONUS** * Salesforce certifications — Agentforce Specialist, Data Cloud 360 Consultant, Platform Developer II, Application Architect, or Integration Architect. * Production Agentforce deployments with measurable business outcomes. * Data Cloud implementation experience beyond basic grounding. * Open\-source contributions to MCP servers, agent tooling, or the Salesforce developer ecosystem. * Prior consulting, solutions engineering, or forward\-deployed work at a product company. * Experience with evaluation frameworks for LLM applications. **Skills** **About RCG Global Services** At Myridius, we transform the way businesses operate. The success of Myridius is directly tied to the breakthroughs achieved by our clients. Together, we co\-create solutions that not only solve today’s challenges but also anticipate future trends. jobs.title: AI Data Operation Lead, Autonomy
jobs.description: Rivian Autonomy is seeking an AI Data Operation Lead to lead the people and processes that turn vehicle data into reliable training and evaluation datasets. Within the AI Platform organization, you will bring together labeling delivery, data quality, curation, and human review to support the development of our autonomous driving models. You will lead internal teams and external partners, with accountability for delivery, quality, and cost. This includes making sure the data we send for annotation is usable, that accepted labels meet the model teams' requirements, and that reviewers can turn difficult driving events into actionable feedback for engineering. You will work closely with Perception, Planning, Data Infrastructure, Eval Infrastructure, and Product to translate model\-development priorities into operational plans and provide evidence for release decisions. We are looking for a leader who can develop managers and specialists, make clear tradeoffs when demand exceeds capacity, and build an operation that improves as our models, tools, and vehicle fleet evolve.* **Lead the organization.** Set the operating plan for AI data operations, develop team leaders, and define responsibilities across employees, contractors, and vendors. Build capacity plans that account for annotation, quality review, and rework across concurrent programs. * **Deliver data that model teams can use.** Translate training and evaluation needs into labeling specifications, reviewer guidance, delivery milestones, and acceptance criteria. Work with model teams on taxonomy changes and keep delivery aligned with their development cycles. * **Improve data quality and yield.** Own the operational checks that determine whether collected vehicle data is ready for curation and labeling. Partner with collection and engineering teams to resolve sensor, calibration, and data\-quality issues before they consume downstream annotation capacity. * **Own vendor performance and spend.** Set service levels and quality expectations, evaluate suppliers, and manage capacity, pricing, and budgets with Finance and Procurement. Reconcile accepted work with invoices and address delivery or quality shortfalls through clear corrective actions. * **Develop human evaluation and triage operations.** Build review workflows with autonomy and systems engineers to investigate driving events, classify recurring failures, and assemble the evidence needed for root\-cause analysis. Feed those findings into scenario selection, evaluation datasets, and targeted data requests. * **Run the operation with consistent metrics.** Establish a shared view of accepted\-data volume, quality, turnaround time, backlog, rework, collection yield, and cost. Use these measures to identify constraints, allocate review capacity, and make delivery commitments teams can plan around. * **Improve tools and automation.** Partner with Data Infrastructure, Eval Infrastructure, and Applied General AI on labeling tools, prelabels, automated quality checks, and assisted triage. Define operational requirements and validate improvements against measured quality and reviewer effort before scaling them. * 10\+ years leading operations, including at least 5 years supporting autonomous vehicles, robotics, or complex machine\-learning programs, with responsibility for budgets or a P\&L. * Experience managing annotation partners across domestic and international locations, including commercial negotiations, staffing plans, and service delivery. * Enough technical depth in AI development to discuss data requirements and failure analysis with engineers and turn those discussions into clear work for operations teams. * A record of developing managers and specialists, establishing ownership, and adapting team structures as priorities change. * Strong analytical judgment: you can separate a quality problem from a capacity or tooling problem, test the cause, and follow through on the fix. * Clear communication across engineering, product, finance, and operations, with the ability to make prioritization decisions and explain their impact on delivery. **Bonus Points*** Direct experience supporting autonomous driving or other physical AI systems through data production and evaluation. * Experience applying large language models, multimodal models, or generative AI to annotation and human\-review workflows.

jobs.description: We are seeking a Staff Machine Learning Engineer to play a foundational role in building and deploying our next\-generation Large Driving Model (LDM) for the Rivian Autonomy stack. In this highly impactful role, you will own a full vertical of the LDM lifecycle, from large\-scale data curation and post\-training pipelines through to rigorous evaluation to implement and perfect specific, advanced driving capabilities. As a Staff Engineer, you will lead the AI strategy for these capabilities, serving as a primary technical authority. Your work will directly translate to the daily experience, comfort, and safety of our customers, which is critical to the core mission at Rivian. If you are passionate about pushing the boundaries of generative and foundation models in the physical world, shipping cutting\-edge improvements to customers, and driving technical consensus across a high\-performing team, we want to talk to you. * **End\-to\-End Vertical Ownership:** Spearhead the development of specific advanced driving capabilities by owning the full lifecycle within the Large Driving Model (LDM), including targeted data curation, post\-training alignment, and rigorous evaluation pipelines. * **Model \& System Design:** Examine and optimize all aspects of successful model design, ensuring high\-quality supervision, robust validation strategies, and scalable architectures capable of bridging the gap between offline LDM training and on\-road performance. * **Technical Leadership:** Act as a recognized technical authority within the Autonomy department, offering definitive guidance on current and future technology decisions, model architectures, and data strategies. * **Strategic Tradeoffs:** Possess an in\-depth grasp of the business, safety, and operational implications of various technology tradeoffs, effectively balancing them according to the company's timeline and product needs. * **Engineering Excellence:** Empower fellow engineers by architecting scalable, easily extendable, and collaborative ML systems and codebases. Establish best practices for the broader LDM team. * **Cross\-Functional Alignment:** Display the ability to influence technical roadmaps and foster consensus across perception, planning, and platform teams, even during challenging technical discussions. * **Production Focus:** Take charge of deploying, supervising, and enhancing the real\-world, on\-road performance of your models as they transition from the development phase into customer vehicles. * M.S. or Ph.D. in Machine Learning, Computer Science, Robotics, or a related field. * 7\+ years of industry experience working on complex, production\-grade Machine Learning systems, with a track record of operating at a Staff or Lead level. * Expert\-level knowledge and hands\-on experience with Python and PyTorch. Experience with large\-scale distributed training frameworks is highly preferred. * Deep expertise in state\-of\-the\-art foundation models, post\-training paradigms (fine\-tuning, alignment), and approaches for perception, prediction, or planning in the autonomous driving or robotics space. * Proven ability to own full ML data verticals, demonstrating mastery over data curation, synthetic data generation, and building robust evaluation frameworks for complex behavioral models. * Solid foundational understanding of linear algebra, geometry, optimization, algorithms, and data structures. * Exceptional communication skills with a demonstrated ability to set technical direction, guide the team toward it, and build consensus in a fast\-paced environment. * Passionately motivated to take ambiguous, complex ideas from development and validation all the way to a verified, shipping product. * Hands\-on approach: Proactively identifies systemic gaps, writes critical path code, and fills in technical voids where needed. * Prior experience with Automotive Self\-Driving stacks or similarly complex, safety\-critical Robotics Systems.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Realtime Analytics Platform
jobs.description: San Mateo, CA, United StatesEngineeringID: 47776 Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators. At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device.We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there. A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone. **Your Role:** -------------- Roblox's data infrastructure processes petabytes of data daily, powering analytics, ML, and product decisions for a platform serving 200M\+ daily active users. As a **Senior Software Engineer** on our **Real\-time Analytics Platform team**, you will design, build, and scale the core OLAP infrastructure powering sub\-second analytical queries across Roblox. Our team directly owns and operates **StarRocks** and **Apache Druid**, driving high\-throughput streaming ingestion and low\-latency MPP query processing. You will lead the next\-generation architecture of our real\-time analytics platform, combining high ownership and deep technical complexity to push the boundaries of MPP engine performance, streaming ingestion pipelines, and cluster scalability. **You Will:** ------------- * **Own and Scale Core OLAP Platforms**: Take end\-to\-end ownership of the architecture, operational health, and scalability of our high\-throughput OLAP engines, specifically **StarRocks** and **Apache Druid**. * **Optimize Query Engine Performance**: Dive deep into engine internals, cost\-based optimization (CBO), query planning, vectorized execution, memory optimization, and serialization efficiency to maximize throughput and maintain sub\-second latency under heavy concurrent load. * **Architect Streaming Ingestion Pipelines**: Design, build, and optimize real\-time data ingestion paths leveraging **Apache Kafka**, **Apache Flink** and native engine load mechanisms. * **Drive OLAP Data Modeling Best Practices**: Partner with infra, data science, and product engineering teams to guide data modeling for MPP databases, optimizing partitioning, bucketing, sort keys, and materialized views. * **Manage Cluster Infrastructure \& Capacity**: Lead cluster provisioning, lifecycle management, operations, and capacity planning using **Kubernetes** and **Terraform** across cloud environments. * **Advance Autonomous Interfaces**: Integrate AI/ML and LLM\-driven capabilities within our query platforms to enable automated self\-serve mechanisms and intelligent data discovery for engineers. **You Have:** ------------- * 6\+ years of experience building, designing, testing and maintaining production\-grade, large\-scale distributed systems. * **Deep OLAP \& MPP Engine Depth**: Strong hands\-on engineering or operational experience with **StarRocks** or adjacent OLAP engines such as **Apache Druid**, **ClickHouse**, **Apache Doris**, **Apache Pinot**, or **Trino/Presto**. * **Streaming \& Ingestion Architecture**: Proven track record implementing high\-volume streaming ingestion using **Apache Kafka**, **Apache Flink**, Routine Load / Broker Load, or Debezium/CDC pipelines. * **Data Modeling \& Query Optimization**: Expertise in OLAP schema design (partitioning, bucketing, sort keys, indexing) and tuning cost\-based SQL query engines for massive scale. * **Strong Engineering Foundations**: Robust proficiency in **Java**, **Go**, **C\+\+**, or **Scala**, with a track record of writing clean, highly performant distributed backend code. * **Infrastructure \& Orchestration**: Experience operating, troubleshooting, and provisioning data infrastructure at scale using **Kubernetes** and **Terraform** on AWS or GCP. * **Technical Leadership:** Demonstrated ability to influence technical direction across teams, mentor engineers, and drive alignment on complex cross\-cutting initiatives. * B.S. equivalent in CS or sufficient experience. * Bonus Points: + Core contributions to open\-source OLAP databases (StarRocks, Apache Druid, ClickHouse, Apache Doris). + Experience operating real\-time analytical platforms at consumer\-internet scale (100M\+ active users). All full\-time employees are also eligible for equity compensation and for benefits as described on **this page**. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Automotive Partnerships
jobs.description: Root was founded on the belief that car insurance is broken, and we set out to change it. We’re harnessing the power of technology to revolutionize this archaic, complicated industry. Using machine learning and mobile telematic platforms, we’ve built one of the most innovative insurtech companies in the world. **The Opportunity** As a Senior Software Engineer on the Automotive Partnerships team, you’ll build the technology that connects our products with leading automakers, mobility platforms, and automotive technology partners. You’ll help design and deliver reliable, scalable integrations across vehicle, cloud, and partner systems, turning complex technical and business requirements into seamless customer experiences. You’ll collaborate closely with product, design, engineering, and external partner teams to define technical strategy, navigate evolving industry standards, and bring new integrations from concept to launch. Beyond writing high\-quality code, you’ll shape architecture, establish engineering best practices, mentor other engineers, and help partners make sound technical decisions. This role is ideal for an experienced engineer who enjoys solving ambiguous, cross\-functional problems and building durable platforms at the intersection of software, connected vehicles, and strategic partnerships. **Salary Range**: **$136,500 \- $160,000** (Eligible for competitive bonus and equity offering) Root is a “work where it works best” company. Meaning we will support you working in whatever location that works best for you across the US. We will continue to have our headquarters in Columbus, Ohio. **How You Will Make an Impact** * Design, build, and maintain core services, APIs, and workflows * Own features end\-to\-end, from technical design through production support * Collaborate with product, design, engineering, and external partner teams to translate business needs into well\-architected technical solutions * Contribute to system design discussions and help evolve service architecture * Write high\-quality, well\-tested code and participate in thoughtful code reviews * Help identify and reduce technical debt while balancing delivery and maintainability * Mentor and support other engineers through pairing, code reviews, and knowledge sharing * Participate in on\-call rotations and contribute to operational excellence **What You Will Need to Succeed** * 4\+ years of professional software engineering experience working on production systems * Strong experience building backend services and APIs in Ruby on Rails * Experience working with distributed systems and cloud infrastructure * Comfort owning features and services with minimal oversight * Solid understanding of data modeling, performance, and system reliability * Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across disciplines * A pragmatic, product\-minded approach to engineering As part of Root's interview process, we kindly ask that all candidates be on camera for virtual interviews. This helps us create a more personal and engaging experience for both you and our interviewers. Being on camera is a standard requirement for our process and part of how we assess fit and communication style, so we do require it to move forward with any applicant's candidacy. If you have any concerns, feel free to let us know once you are contacted. We’re happy to talk it through. Consistent with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and the Civil Rights Act of 1964, it is the policy of Root to provide reasonable accommodation when requested by a qualified applicant or candidate with a disability, unless such accommodation would cause an undue hardship for Root. The policy regarding requests for reasonable accommodation applies to all aspects of the hiring process. If reasonable accommodation is needed, please contact recruiting@joinroot.com.

jobs.title: Global Sustaining Controls and Vision Engineering Manager
jobs.description: Founded in 1976, Samtec is a privately held, $950 million global manufacturer of a broad line of electronic interconnect solutions, including High\-Speed Board\-to\-Board, High\-Speed Cables, Mid\-Board and Panel Optics, Precision RF, Flexible Stacking, and Micro/Rugged components and cables. Samtec Technology Centers are dedicated to developing and advancing technologies, strategies and products to optimize both the performance and cost of a system from the bare die to an interface 100 meters away, and all interconnect points in between. With 40\+ international locations and products sold in more than 125 different countries, Samtec’s global presence enables its unmatched customer service. **Summary/Objective:** Lead and develop the global sustaining controls and vision engineering teams responsible for designing, building, programming, deploying, and troubleshooting electrical, pneumatic, machine vision, machine learning, and related software systems for manufacturing equipment. Ensure solutions meet internal customer time\-to\-market needs, associate safety expectations, inspection and quality requirements, scalability needs, and applicable compliance standards. **Essential Functions/ Responsibilities:** * Manage global sustaining controls and vision engineering teams supporting the dynamic requirements of Samtec operations and driving the advancement of new technologies. * Provide technical leadership for solutions that meet global process and machine safety, quality, compliance, repeatability, maintainability, and scalability standards. * Lead the global sustaining controls and vision engineering teams in prioritizing projects, managing resource allocation, project communications and progress tracking to ensure on\-time successful completion. * Lead and develop sustaining resources for core competencies across electrical hardware design, controls programming, machine vision, machine learning, and software development. * Establish and maintain best practices, design standards, programming standards, and consistent global solutions for the Sustaining teams that enable the Samtec roadmap. * Work collaboratively with internal customers and cross\-functional teams to resolve production equipment, inspection, controls, and software issues. * Collaborate and work with other Samtec engineering teams to develop and standardize processes and equipment designs. * Support the planning and execution of capital appropriation requests for development of new equipment and optimization projects. Support production teams for duplicate equipment builds / integrations. * Develop and maintain team KPI’s to track performance and measure the impacts to the business. * Establish analytics and machine learning into the workflows of the global teams. Work to proliferate and enable Samtec’s Scada system across released machine platforms. *“The responsibilities as defined are intended to serve as a general guideline for this position. Associates may be asked to perform additional tasks depending on strengths and capabilities”* **Preferred Experience:** * 7 \- 10 years related engineering experience in manufacturing. * 3\-5 years of management experience. * Proficient in control relays, pneumatic solenoids, pneumatic controls, motion controllers, servomotors, stepper motors, etc. * Motion Controller and PLC programming experience (Trio Motion Controller preferred). * Operator Interface programming experience (Red Lion preferred). * Knowledge and understanding of the SDLC, practices and patterns. * Operational knowledge of various programming languages and data storage technologies including Visual Studio, C\#, Visual Basic, SQL Server, Mongo DB, Angular, Blazer, Node, MongoDB, Dev Ops, etc. * Knowledge and understanding of PID loop control. * Proficient in Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint) * Working knowledge of 3D design software (preferably SolidWorks) * Excellent technical, problem solving and analytical abilities. * Must be able to sit / stand for at least 90 consecutive minutes. **Education:** * Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a relevant engineering degree (or equivalent experience).

jobs.title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About Sandbar** Sandbar is an interface company in New York City. We aim to expand human thinking. Our team has built software, ML, hardware, and consumer products across Meta, CTRL\-labs, Apple, Peloton, and Equinox. Our first product is Stream, is private voice ring that extends your thinking. Stream has been featured in WSJ, Bloomberg, Wired, and Time's Best Inventions of the Year. Join us in creating technology that extends human thinking. **About** We’re looking for a strong generalist engineer to connect Stream to the software people already use. Stream is a self extension that listens, remembers, and helps you think through conversation, and the more of your world it can reach, the more useful it becomes. Most software wasn’t built to work with an AI. Making it work means understanding how each application is built, finding the most reliable way in, and making that connection dependable for people who rely on it every day. You’ll own this work end to end, work directly with the founders, ship on the same real\-time Python services the rest of Stream runs on, and help shape how others build on Stream. **Responsibilities** * Build integrations between Stream and the apps, services, and AI tools people already use * Design how tools plug into Stream’s agent: tool definitions, result shaping, confirmation, and context passing * Own the integration layer end to end: OAuth and token lifecycle, least\-privilege scopes, webhooks, rate limits, retries, and real\-world failure modes * Build and operate MCP servers and clients in production * Work out reliable integrations for software without clean APIs * Instrument every integration so breakage is caught before users notice * Carry a share of the core backend and its on\-call rotation **Qualifications** * 5\+ years building software, with strong Python and comfort owning a live, real\-time service * Have shipped third\-party integrations in production: OAuth 2/OIDC, token refresh and revocation, webhooks, API versioning, and vendor quirks * Understand software architecture well enough to work with applications you didn’t write * Have integrated tools into an LLM agent that real users depend on, and been accountable for actions completing * Hands\-on MCP experience * Generalist range across backend, auth, client code, and agent logic; can take an open\-ended problem to a shipped result without a spec * Product sense for software that acts on someone’s behalf, including when the user isn’t looking at a screen * Communicate precisely and make tradeoffs explicit **Nice to have** * Connector or plugin work at an AI product * Browser automation (e.g. Playwright, Chrome DevTools Protocol) * Integration security: scoped credentials, secret storage, prompt\-injection defenses, audit logging * Voice or multimodal assistant experience * Developer documentation other engineers have built on **FTE Benefits** * Health, vision, and dental benefits * Company\-sponsored 401(k) * Unlimited PTO and sick time * Early stage equity Compensation Range: $190K \- $260K

jobs.title: Embedded Firmware Engineer
jobs.description: **Embedded Firmware Engineer** ------------------------------ **About SF MOTORS, INC. (dba SERES)** SF Motors is building the next generation of intelligent robotic systems that combine advanced mobility, autonomy, and human\-like adaptability. Our mission is to revolutionize how machines move, perceive, and interact in complex environments by integrating control engineering, artificial intelligence, and machine learning at every level of design. This position is based onsite at our Milpitas, CA office and requires regular in\-person attendance. ### **Duties and Responsibilities** * Develop and maintain firmware for humanoid robot controllers, joint actuators, and dexterous hands; contribute to firmware architecture. * Develop embedded C/C\+\+ firmware, peripheral drivers, and RTOS applications; support board bring\-up and hardware validation. * Implement CAN/CAN FD and Ethernet communication with deterministic timing and synchronized multi\-joint actuation. * Work with controls engineers to implement actuator control loops, sensor integration, and calibration. * Collaborate with software and controls engineers on firmware interfaces, data models, and SDK integration. * Implement fault protection, diagnostics, bootloaders, firmware updates, and configuration management. * Debug hardware and firmware integration issues; develop Python test tools and support regression and hardware\-in\-the\-loop testing. * Participate in design and code reviews; maintain technical documentation and support firmware releases. ### **Required Qualifications** * B.S., M.S., or Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. * 1\~3 years of professional embedded firmware development experience in industry, including hands\-on work with physical hardware. * Strong C proficiency and working knowledge of C\+\+, real\-time systems, interrupts, and concurrency. * Hands\-on experience with STM32, TI, Renesas, or similar MCUs, peripheral drivers, and an RTOS such as FreeRTOS or Zephyr. * Experience with PCB bring\-up, schematic interpretation, and oscilloscope, logic analyzer, and JTAG/SWD debugging. * Firmware experience in robotics, motor controllers, or multi\-axis systems, including CAN/CAN FD and motor control fundamentals such as FOC, PID, and encoder feedback. * Ability to develop and validate firmware, troubleshoot issues, and collaborate using Git and code reviews, with effective technical communication in English. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Professional working proficiency in English and Mandarin for collaboration with engineering teams and suppliers. * Experience with humanoid robots, joint modules, dexterous hands, and BLDC/PMSM motor control, including torque or impedance control. * Familiarity with EtherCAT, CANopen, Modbus, ROS/ROS2, Linux, SDK development, or simulation integration. * Experience with Python automation, embedded CI/CD, hardware\-in\-the\-loop testing, production calibration, or field diagnostics. Base salary range: $80,000–$120,000 per year. The actual base salary offered will depend on the candidate's experience, skills, qualifications, and other job\-related considerations. This position may also be eligible for additional compensation and benefits. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States, and verification of employment authorization will be required at the time of hire. SERES is an equal opportunity employer committed to a culturally diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, age, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability status, or protected veteran status.

jobs.title: Junior Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description: **Overview:** ARE you a junior software engineer who wants to understand how software actually works, not just how to make it compile? Are you the type of person who reads the stack trace before asking, who wants to know *why* the system is built the way it is, and who would rather learn from engineers with decades of production scars than from a tutorial? If you are early in your career and craving the kind of environment where you become exceptional rather than merely employed, this could be the opportunity for you. **About Sound Decisions:** This position is posted by Sound Decisions Recruiting on behalf of a client. Sound Decisions is a technical recruiting firm led by a software engineer, focused on matching engineering talent with strong teams. **Written From the Perspective of Our Client:** We focus on building highly scalable, reliable merchant payment technologies using the latest, most reliable technologies and engineering practices. We use modern AI tools to accelerate implementation, improve documentation and increase test coverage. AI is an engineering aid, not a substitute for judgment, communication, review or accountability. Our philosophy is explicit: AI exists to make the engineers already here more capable as they grow, and it is judged on whether it does. The core belief is that we grow through great minds, discussions and collaborations, and success is driven through a series of great judgments and decisions by people who love the craft of creating software. This role exists to give you Silicon Valley startup experience inside a structured, deliberate learning environment: a small senior team, real production scope early, and the time and mentorship to develop into an exceptional engineer. Your purpose in the first year is to develop a great understanding of the craft and excellent debugging skills, so that you become the bulwark between what AI produces and what reaches a customer. **What experience we're looking for:** * Working knowledge of software development fundamentals: data structures, complexity, state, and how a request moves from a browser to a database and back. We care more about how you reason than how long you have been paid to do it; there is no minimum years requirement. * Experience with, or demonstrated ability to learn, TypeScript and full\-stack web development. * Familiarity with Git and the core concepts of pull requests, merging, branching and code review. * A decent level of maturity with AI coding tools: you have used them on in personal or open source projects, you have been burned by them at least once, and you can describe what you check before you trust the output. * The ability to work independently on defined tasks while asking for help when appropriate, and the judgment to tell the difference. * Comparable experience counts. Building backend or full\-stack applications with Node.js and TypeScript is directly relevant; Scala and functional programming are valuable but not required. (Note: this experience does not have to come from a professional setting, but the expectation is that it can be delivered at a professional level.) **We expect** **You are learning Managing Up (working with your lead and senior engineers):** * Develop how to understand priorities: know which ticket matters this week and why. * Learn to provide solutions, not just problems: arrive with what you tried, what you found, and what you think. * Learn to anticipate needs: if a change touches the portal, you already checked who consumes it. * Build credibility: small promises kept, every time. **You will develop and learn** **The craft:** * How to debug from first principles: read the trace, form a hypothesis, isolate, prove it, then fix it. This is the skill AI cannot do for you and the one that makes you valuable. * How production payments software is designed for correctness under rules that change. * How a functional\-programming codebase (Scala) thinks, and why a type system is a design tool rather than a chore. * How to get precise, measurable output from AI tooling: clean instructions, scoped sessions, verification before merge. * How to write documentation and tests that a stranger can trust six months later. **What behaviors define success in this role:** * Attention to detail and the ability to spot ambiguities * proficient managing your time and accountable for your actions. * Great at communicating: clear writing and speaking in all channels, an active listener, and the wisdom to understand (OR ask) the forum in which ideas and concepts should be challenged. * Able to explain what you built and why to a senior engineer and to a business counterpart without hiding behind jargon. * Able to work with guidance, balance multiple activities, and meet deadlines, and to take instruction and turn it into shipped code without needing it repeated. * Operating with integrity. * Considerate of who's in the room and who needs to be in the room. * Taking notes in meetings for yourself and  open\-source experience building full\-stack applications, APIs, integrations or workflow automation. * Prior experience in a startup or similarly fast\-moving environment. * Experience using AI\-assisted development tools with a willingness to learn responsible review, testing and security practices. * Fintech or e\-commerce domain exposure. **Shared values:** * The team understands that a bug can take hours and a new feature can take minutes with AI, and has the ability to weigh those efforts correctly. Lines of code does not make the engineer, nor do shiny new buttons. * Committed to developing implementations of repeatable success through coding standards, knowledge repositories for AI, and implementing reliable, consistent solutions. * Retrospective learning on what can be done better in the future. * A dedication to quality assurance using the latest tooling, and a commitment to higher reliability and coverage through research\-driven, best\-practice implementations. * A commitment to delivering value to our customers through great engineering. **Role responsibilities:** * Contribute to software development across multiple projects and languages. * Maintain existing systems and implement new features in a full\-stack capacity. * Help translate product and business workflow requirements into practical software solutions. * Support prototyping of new products and integrations, including reference implementations and UML\-based integration mappings. * Create and maintain clear User Guides, API documentation, and implementation documentation. * Write unit, functional, and automated tests with guidance from senior engineers. * Use AI tools responsibly to accelerate learning, coding, debugging, documentation, and test creation, and validate everything they produce. * Participate in Git\-based code reviews and apply feedback constructively. * Follow the concepts of an agile process and contribute to planning, delivery, and continuous improvement. * Communicate clearly, raise risks early, and collaborate with teammates across engineering and product. **Day\-to\-day:** This role carries a full\-stack title and, since everyone here uses AI first, a good share of the work is maintenance across the stack: understanding existing code, extending it safely, and keeping the services that consume our common libraries and present data to merchants reliable. Early on you will work closest to the portal and the outlying services; as you learn the system you will take on non\-architectural tickets end to end, front end and back end, and you will be in the room for the design discussions that shape them. **Interview Process (estimate 4\-5 weeks):** * SD Screening * SD Ran Technical Discussion (not a coding test) * SD Ran Behavioral * First Client Interview * Technical Discussion \+ Working Session * CEO Meeting * In\-Person Fly Out Meeting (where a member of the engineering team will come and spend time in person) **Benefits that matter to you** **Medical/Dental/Vision:** * Our client covers 85% of the employee premium for medical, dental and vision and 30% of the Dependents premium. Medical benefits are provided by Anthem Blue Cross PPO. * Basic Life Insurance * Long\-term disability * FSA * Participation is available on the 1st of the month after the start date **Team Travel \& Events:** * Twice a year travel for inperson events with the team. **Remote Work Benefits:** * Monthly shared workspace reimbursement * Monthly work from home expense reimbursement **Retirement:** * A 401k and Roth IRA provided by Betterment. * All full\-time employees are eligible to participate in the plan after 1 month of employment. * Our client has a 100% match of the first 2% of deferred compensation to eligible employees. **Vacation Policy:** * Unlimited planned vacation days **Company\-wide day off:** * Each quarter everyone in the company takes 1 day off **Growth \& Mentorship:** * A dedicated focus and environment to help you develop into a great engineer.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Data Replication Engine (C++ / Databases)
jobs.description: **About Stelo** --------------- For over 30 years Stelo's products have freed organizations from the complexities and difficulties of static data pipelines. Our software is an enterprise\-class data replication tool that delivers data dynamically from anywhere to anywhere for BI analysis, reporting, and prediction, or for managing business operations, B2B interactions, and supply chains. Stelo combines powerful, purpose\-built software with world\-class service and support. From end\-to\-end expertise and problem ownership to deep knowledge of all operating systems, platforms, and database systems, Stelo gets customers up and running and keeps them there. **Stelo Software Engineer** --------------------------- Stelo is hiring a Software Engineer to work on the engine behind our data replication platform: the software that moves live data between Db2, Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, and cloud platforms such as Snowflake and Databricks, for customers who depend on it every day. The engine is built in C\+\+ and Java, and you will work in both. Our ideal candidate is a database engineer first and a strong C\+\+ programmer second. What sets this work apart is the database knowledge it demands. You understand how databases work, from the SQL on the surface to the drivers that carry it to the transaction logs underneath. We especially value experience with IBM Db2\. You work independently on a small remote team and own what you build through to production. You also use AI coding assistants as real leverage, as we do every day. You know what to build, you review generated code critically, and you prove it correct before it ships. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * Design, build, test, and maintain core components of the replication engine, from capture through apply. * Integrate with a wide range of sources and targets: Db2, Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, and MySQL; cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Kafka and Microsoft Fabric. * Keep replication correct, resilient, and fast across on\-premises and cloud environments, and tune data movement across CPU, memory, I/O, and network. * Work with support, QA, and product to investigate complex customer issues and ship robust, timely fixes and enhancements. * Help shape design decisions for the platform, including the internal APIs, data structures, and abstractions that simplify cross\-database support and configuration. * Write well\-documented, testable code, and review your teammates' code. **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- * Strong SQL and a working understanding of database internals, such as transaction logs, recovery, locking and isolation, query execution, or replication. * 5\+ years building production systems\-level or backend software in C\+\+ (for example databases, storage engines, distributed systems, message brokers, or other high\-throughput services). * Hands\-on ODBC or JDBC experience: connection lifecycle, statement execution, parameter and result\-set handling, and diagnostics (SQLSTATE, vendor error codes). * Solid command of multithreading and synchronization in C\+\+, including locks, condition variables, and thread\-safe data structures. * Cross\-platform C\+\+ development for Windows (Visual Studio, MSBuild) and Linux (GCC), including debugging and profiling on both. * Professional use of AI coding assistants, with the judgment to review and test what they produce. * Clear written and spoken communication, and comfort working on a fully remote, distributed team. * Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Experience with IBM Db2, especially journaling on Db2 for i. * Hands\-on experience with data replication, change data capture (CDC), ETL tools, or log\-based data movement. * Hands\-on experience with JDBC drivers and performance tuning across multiple relational databases. * Integration experience with Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery, or Microsoft Fabric. * Working proficiency in Java. * Networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, SSL/TLS) and experience diagnosing connectivity and performance issues in hybrid environments. * Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD practices. * Experience with gRPC and Protocol Buffers. **Structure and Compensation** ------------------------------ * The position is 100% remote, full\-time, and exempt * Stelo will provide all necessary computer equipment * Employee is responsible for providing a suitable workspace * Employee will be assigned a fixed weekly schedule * Candidate should expect to work Pacific time hours most days * Salary $130,000\-$180,000 commensurate with experience * Generous health insurance coverage, employee benefits and retirement matching **Why Work at Stelo?** ---------------------- Stelo's small, dedicated team has enjoyed a 100% remote workplace since the company's founding. We have working from home and the flexibility it offers down! Combined with Stelo's excellent benefits and an unwavering appreciation for work/life balance, Stelo is an environment where team members have a chance to stretch and grow along with the company. * 100% remote workplace * Competitive salaries * Medical insurance for you and your family * Monthly HSA contributions * 3 weeks paid vacation * 11 Stelo holidays * Matching retirement contributions * Annual bonuses

jobs.title: AI Senior Automation Engineer
jobs.description: **Put automation to work: Build the UiPath and AI automations that free our staff to focus on resident care.** We’ve been recognized by Newsweek and Plant\-A Insights Group as one of America’s Most Admired Workplaces for 2026! As an employee recently said, “I feel I have a lot of support. I feel like part of the team.” **Position Summary:** The Senior Automation Engineer builds automations that take routine execution work off operators and back\-office staff. The role is the Company’s senior hands\-on UiPath engineer, building RPA, API, and agentic automations and orchestrating them with UiPath Maestro, using code\-first tools where they fit better. The role is responsible for each automation end to end, from requirements through production support. The team works AI\-first and manages all code in Git. The primary duties of this position involve the performance of work requiring advanced knowledge in a field of science/learning, which require the consistent exercise of discretion and judgment. **Education/Qualifications:** * Must have a bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a closely related field of science/learning, or advanced knowledge of same through six (6\) or more years of demonstrated equivalent engineering experience in lieu of a degree. * A UiPath developer certification (e.g., UiPath Certified Professional Automation Developer) is preferred, or the ability to obtain it within six (6\) months of hire. * Must have a valid driver’s license and the ability to travel. **Experience:** * Six (6\) or more years of professional automation or software engineering experience, with a record of shipping production automations that take action in real business systems. * Three (3\) or more years of hands\-on production experience with UiPath, including Studio, Orchestrator, Robots, queues, and transactional frameworks (e.g., REFramework), with a record of automations running reliably in production. * Experience building unattended UiPath automations that run on Windows virtual machines and drive web\-based applications through the browser, ideally an EHR or similar clinical or financial system of record. * Experience with durable orchestration of long\-running, multi\-step processes and with building automations that recover gracefully from failure. Experience with UiPath Maestro (e.g., Maestro Flow, BPMN, or Case Management) is strongly preferred; comparable experience with code\-first orchestration engines (e.g., Temporal) is acceptable. * Production experience with code\-first browser automation using Playwright, and familiarity with AI\-driven browser automation frameworks such as Stagehand, for web portals and applications that lack clean APIs. * Daily working proficiency with Git: branching, pull requests, code review, and resolving merge conflicts, including source control of UiPath projects. * Demonstrated experience leading and being responsible for automation projects end to end: gathering requirements from business users, documenting the process (e.g., a Process Design Document), building, testing with users, deploying, and supporting the automation in production. * Experience automating against systems that lack clean APIs, including browser\-driven and document\-driven workflows (e.g., UiPath document processing), is strongly preferred. * Experience in a regulated environment (healthcare, finance, or similar) where automations act on sensitive data or systems of record is strongly preferred. * Healthcare or healthcare back\-office experience (insurance/payer requests, HR/payroll, admissions, AR, medical records) is an advantage. **Shift \& Wage:** * Full\-Time Opportunity Available * Shifts Needed: Varies **Advantages:** * **Make a Difference** – Be part of a team that strengthens AI processes to ensure and support quality resident care. * **Comprehensive Benefits** – Health, dental, vision, and retirement plans. * **Generous PTO** – Work\-life balance with paid time off and holidays. * **Team\-Oriented Culture** – Work with dedicated professionals who value excellence. * **Stability** – Join an organization with a proven track record in skilled nursing care. **Benefits and Perks\*:** * Benefit eligibility the first of the month following 30 days * Comprehensive benefit packages including medical, dental, and vision, and more. Health Savings Account available with employer contribution. * 401K through Fidelity * Employer\-paid life insurance (FT employees) * Robust Employee Assistance Program * Generous Paid Time Off (PTO) * Educational, leadership, and tuition opportunities * Various discount programs offered, including discounted childcare programs through Kindercare * Wellness programs offered through WebMD * Employee recognition programs * Culture of employees creating an IMPACT! * **Program details can vary amongst buildings. Please see HR for the facility\-specific benefit plans.** **We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All persons shall have the opportunity to be considered for employment without regard to their actual or perceived gender, race, color, national origin, religion, disability, age, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws and ordinances.**
