jobs.description: *To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.* Job Category Software Engineering Job Details **About Salesforce** Salesforce is the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all. Ready to level\-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce. What matters is that you can write clean, effective code and learn new languages quickly. Our software is constantly evolving, so we need engineers who can do the same. We also adapt to the diverse environments of our customers and deliver solutions that scale across disparate networks and infrastructure. You'll be on the forefront of something Salesforce has never done before. You'll learn how to unpack a problem and understand the costs and consequences of its solution, pick up new technologies and languages, and even develop them yourself, all within a collaborative community that will support and challenge you as you grow. **Responsibilities** * Work alongside motivated and talented engineers to bring cutting\-edge theory into customer\-facing practice * Build tools and pipelines to support ML and AI efforts * Design, build, deploy, and maintain production software and AI services, such as APIs, UIs, and agentic evaluators * Roll out scalable cloud architectures and the software that runs on them * Help with end\-user requirements gathering and executive presentations * Understand the toughest customer problems and devise thoughtful solutions AI/ML (7\-12 years for Lead, 4\-8 years for Senior) * Proficiency in multiple programming languages such as Python, Go, Java, or C\+\+ * Strong background in APIs, data modeling, and databases * dynamic environment * Excellent written and verbal communication skills * Proven collaborator who can manage internal and external stakeholders and drive consensus across diverse engineering and product teams * Solid understanding of security principles and best practices * Passion for continuous learning in AI technologies and enthusiasm for mentoring peers * A demonstrated, genuine AI\-first approach to engineering: using AI to move faster, build fluency across the stack, and contribute well beyond your core specialty * Experience using AI tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, Cursor) in development workflows * High level of authorship **Preferred Skills / Qualifications** * Experience with open\-source technologies such as Kubernetes, Envoy, Grafana, React, and Redux * UI and graphic design sensibilities Unleash Your Potential When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and *be your best* , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can *do your best* . Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world. jobs.title: Senior AI Data & Analytics Engineer II
jobs.description: **Who we are** Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video\-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. **About the role:** Want to build the data foundation powering AI and self\-serve analytics at scale? As part of Samsara's Marketing Data and Analytics (MDA) Engineering team, you will shape the technical roadmap alongside our BI and Data Science peers. You will architect core Databricks pipelines, Gold Layer tables, and semantic models, turning ambitious, ambiguous business challenges into high\-value data products, autonomous agents, and cross\-functional automation. This role is open to candidates residing in the US. **You should apply if:** * **You want to impact the industries that run our world:** Your efforts will result in real\-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely. * **You are the architect of your own career:** If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment. * **You're energized by our opportunity:** The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers. * **You want to be with the best:** At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. Youwill be surrounded by a high\-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best. **In this role, you will:** * Partner on defining the strategy and multi\-quarter roadmap for MDA's data and AI foundation. * Architect and own Samsara's marketing data infrastructure: ETL/ELT pipelines, Databricks Gold Layer tables, and the core data models that power segmentation, targeting, automation, and analytics. * Design the semantic layers, data dictionaries, and structured documentation that enable self\-serve BI and conversational analytics, partnering with the BI team to ensure core sales and marketing KPIs are built on trusted, well\-modeled data. * Translate ambiguous business questions from Marketing, Sales, and R\&D into clear requirements and scalable solutions, working autonomously without dedicated PM support and influencing decisions with data and sound reasoning. * Lead complex, cross\-team initiatives end to end: stand up new data pipelines and integrations quickly, manage risk across interdependent teams, and own the reliability and data quality of what ships. * Serve as the senior technical lead for the team's hardest problems: raise the bar for engineering quality and code review, remove bottlenecks that slow multiple teams, and mentor engineers and analysts. * Drive the strategic use of AI to solve ambiguous, high\-impact problems: build AI\-enabled data products and agents, with the integrations, retrieval pipelines, and evaluation practices that keep them reliable and trustworthy. * Identify and automate manual workflows with AI across Marketing and GTM teams, taking ideas from concept to prototype to production and influencing org roadmaps. * Ship high\-quality Python and SQL, increasingly by directing agentic coding tools, while holding a high bar for reviewing and verifying AI\-generated work before it reaches production. * Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices. **Minimum requirements for the role:** * 8\+ years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or AI engineering, including deep hands\-on data engineering experience. * Expert\-level Python and SQL, with strong hands\-on data modeling and DBT experience. * Deep experience with data warehouse and lakehouse architectures, ETL/ELT, and the modern data stack, including hands\-on Databricks (or similar, such as Snowflake or BigQuery).  re engineering background beyond data or AI engineering, with a track record of turning ambiguous, unfamiliar problems into well\-architected, delivered solutions. * Expertise in data visualization and building dashboards for sales and marketing KPIs. * Familiarity with go\-to\-market data and systems: CRM (e.g., Salesforce), marketing automation, web analytics, and MarTech tools. * Experience building interactive applications with Streamlit, Claude workflows, or web frameworks. * Data science, machine learning, or predictive analytics experience. * Comfort working in an exploratory environment, testing and iterating on new data sources and methodologies. **Total Rewards** At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high\-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above\-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance\-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high\-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above\-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time. Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long\-term success: a flexible, employee\-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here. **Flexible Working** At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in\-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on\-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable. **Belonging at Samsara** At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact. **Accommodations** Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process. **Our Commitment to Authenticity** We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information. **Fraudulent Employment Offers** Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us\-greenhouse\-mail.io or @mail3\.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: **SUMMARY:** The AI Engineer makes Saturn's data decision\-ready. The role builds one reliable data foundation across SAP S/4HANA, Ignition, Excel, and external market data, automates the reporting produced from it, and applies AI so that management receives analysis and recommendations directly, without the manual collecting, reconciling, and formatting steps in between. The role reports to the CFO and works with the Executive and Plant Leadership Teams. It is a hands\-on position: the incumbent builds the data models, reports, and AI solutions personally and is accountable for their accuracy. The role also makes the wider organization AI\-ready by raising data quality at the source, building skills across the functions, and setting the rules for responsible use of data and AI. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities:** include the following. Other duties may be assigned.**Data Quality and the Data Foundation*** Make high\-quality base data an organizational standard: define entry rules, master data discipline, and data quality measurement together with the functions, which remain accountable for the accuracy of the data they create. * Build and operate one data foundation that connects SAP S/4HANA, Ignition and production systems, Excel\-based sources, and external market data such as Nielsen, as a Single Source of Truth. * Establish consistent KPI and master data definitions and documented calculation logic, so that every report and every AI answer uses the same numbers. * Work with the functions to eliminate the causes of poor data rather than correcting data downstream. **Automated Reporting for Decision\-Making*** Automate the recurring executive and plant reporting so that management information is produced without manual collecting, reconciling, or formatting. * Inventory existing reporting, consolidate duplicates, and retire the manual spreadsheets that automated reporting replaces. * Deliver executive\-level output: few, clear views showing performance, drivers, and recommended action, so that leadership receives decisions to make rather than data to process. * Use AI to generate commentary, variance explanations, and meeting\-ready summaries from the underlying data, with human review before release. **Forward\-Looking Analytics*** Move reporting from describing the past to anticipating the future: forecasting, scenario and sensitivity analysis, and early\-warning indicators. * Apply AI and statistical methods across all available data \- financial, operational, machine, quality, and market \- to identify trends, anomalies, and predictive maintenance opportunities. * Quantify the financial impact of operational trends so that leadership sees the P\&L consequence, not only the metric. **AI Solutions and Automation*** Identify, prioritize, and implement AI and automation use cases across all functions, each with a business case and a measured benefit. * Build and maintain AI agents and automated workflows that connect to Saturn's systems and perform real work, rather than standalone chat usage. * Test and monitor the quality of AI output, and keep a human accountable for every decision. **Making the Organization AI\-Ready*** Build data and AI capability across the organization: train and coach employees at all levels in the practical, day\-to\-day use of AI, reporting, and automation tools. * Identify where AI changes how work is done, and lead the change so that new ways of working are adopted and the replaced routines are retired. * Make company knowledge and process documentation structured, current, and retrievable, so that both employees and AI systems can use it. * Set and maintain the rules for responsible use of data and AI, aligned with heristo group policy and recognized frameworks such as the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, ISO/IEC 42001, and the EU AI Act, including protection of customer\- and partner\-confidential data from external AI services. **ERP and Process Optimization*** Support the optimization of SAP S/4HANA and related business processes, ensuring that data, reporting, AI, and automation requirements are built into the system landscape. * Partner with KAM serv.it, PMO IT saturn petcare, functional teams, and external providers as the business\-to\-IT translator, and support process mapping and process mining. **Supervisory Responsibilities:** None**Qualifications:** To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.**Education and/or Experience:*** Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Business Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field; master's degree preferred. Equivalent demonstrated capability may be considered. * 5\+ years of hands\-on expe ge\-management skills, including the ability to present to executives. Candidates should be prepared to present examples of their own work. **Computer and Technology Skills \- Required:*** SQL at a working level: able to query, model, and transform data independently. * Advanced Excel and advanced proficiency in a modern business intelligence platform (Power BI preferred; SAP Analytics Cloud an advantage), including data modeling. * Practical experience extracting and modeling data from an ERP system, preferably SAP S/4HANA. * Hands\-on application of generative AI in a business setting: AI agents, workflow automation, retrieval over company documents, and the judgment to know where AI should and should not be used. **Computer and Technology Skills \- Preferred:*** Python, or an equivalent language, for data processing and automation. * Industrial and machine data: Ignition, historians, MES, OPC\-UA or MQTT. * A modern data platform such as Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Snowflake, SAP Datasphere, or SAP Business Data Cloud. * Statistical forecasting or machine learning; process mining tools such as Signavio or Celonis; familiarity with AI governance frameworks. **Language Skills:** Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions and procedural manuals. Ability to write routine reports and correspondence. Ability to speak effectively before groups of customers or employees of the organization. German language speaking skills is another advantage. **Mathematical Skills:** Ability to work with mathematical concepts such as probability and statistical inference, and ability to apply concepts such as: fractions, percentages, ratios and proportions to practical situations. **Reasoning Ability:** Ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists. Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form. **Physical Demands:** The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of the job, the employee is regularly required to use hands to finger, handle, or feel and reach with hands and arms. The employee is required to stand, walk, sit, and talk and hear. The employee must regularly lift and / or move up to 15 pounds, frequently lift and / or move up to 30 pounds and occasionally lift and / or move up to 50 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distant vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus. **Allergen Awareness** Products produced in this facility may contain the following allergens: Egg, Shellfish, Fish, Gluten. **Disclaimer:** The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this classification. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of personnel so classified. Job descriptions are not intended to create a contract, nor are they to be construed to constitute contractual obligations of any kind or a contract of employment between Saturn Petcare Inc. and any of its employees. The provisions of job descriptions have been developed at the discretion of management and may be amended or cancelled at any time by Saturn Petcare Inc. with or without notice. Employment with Saturn Petcare Inc. is voluntarily entered, and the employee is free to resign at will at any time, with or without cause. Similarly, Saturn Petcare Inc. may terminate the employment relationship at will at any time, with or without notice or cause, so long as there is not violation of applicable federal or state law.

jobs.title: Head of Service Delivery
jobs.description: We're Scan.com. We're building America's national imaging network: the infrastructure that connects patients, providers, and payers to faster, better\-value diagnostic imaging. Thousands of patients move through our platform every day, and each is a real person waiting for an answer to a healthcare concern. We exist to get them that answer faster. We manage the medical imaging pathway end\-to\-end. Providers order through a single point of entry, and from there, we run the entire medical diagnostic pathway. Managing the full pathway, rather than brokering pieces of it, is what lets us deliver imaging faster, at higher quality, and at a lower cost than the fragmented status quo. We're looking for a **Head of Service Delivery** at an exciting time. We've raised over $200m in funding to date, reached profitability, and are growing 100% year on year. Millions of people wait too long for a diagnosis. Come help us fix that. **WHAT YOU MIGHT BRING TO THE TABLE** ------------------------------------- You don't need to tick all the boxes to apply for this role. Whether it's your first role or your fifth role, we believe everyone can add value, learn, and grow. However, these might be some of the ways you are currently adding value: * Direct people\-management experience leading managers or team leads, not just individual contributors. * You are service\-obsessed and focused on how we deliver outstanding service to patients, partners, and colleagues alike. * A track record managing vendors within a healthcare operations role. * Experience managing third\-party vendor relationships, including contract negotiation and SLA governance. * Experience overseeing Workforce Management (WFM) — forecasting, scheduling, and intraday management. * Experience building or overseeing Quality Assurance (QA) programs, including audit frameworks and calibration. * A data\-first mindset, comfortable building and reading vendor and team scorecards. * Comfort operating at high speed without compromising on execution quality. * Strong communication skills, able to translate complex, cross\-functional work for executives and your own team alike. * Experience redesigning operational workflows around automation or AI, with results you can quantify: handle time, cost per order, headcount avoided. * Able to build a capacity model that forecasts both human and automated throughput, and shows where the next headcount dollar should go versus the next automation dollar. * Experience structuring vendor contracts for shifts in workload: volume flexibility, per\-outcome pricing, exit terms, and automation clauses. * Comfortable setting quality standards for automated and agentic systems, and holding Product and Engineering to them. * A working view on PHI and AI: what data can enter which tools, what a BAA must cover, and how to audit it. * Able to judge AI vendor claims. You can tell a demo from a deployed result and ask for the evidence. **WHAT YOU WILL ACHIEVE IN THIS ROLE** -------------------------------------- This role sits within Service Delivery, reporting directly to the SVP of Operations. You'll own two core pillars — Workforce Management (WFM) and Quality Assurance (QA) — plus our vendor partnerships, leading a small team of functional leads (a WFM Lead and a QA Lead) who run the day\-to\-day. As a scale\-up business, you can expect your role to develop over time. Here are some of the types of things you could be getting involved in: * Build, lead, and develop a team of functional leads across WFM and QA, growing their capability to run their pillars independently. * Own the end\-to\-end vendor lifecycle — sourcing, onboarding, contract structuring, performance management, and offboarding. * Set the strategy for Quality Assurance (QA) — audit frameworks, calibration, scorecards, and coaching feedback loops. You will also be standing up the infrastructure for product testing on behalf of operational functions. * Set the strategy for Workforce Management (WFM) — demand forecasting, staffing plans, scheduling, and capacity modeling — across internal and outsourced teams. * Standardize reporting across QA and WFM, including SLA/KPI dashboards and vendor and team scorecards. * Partner with the SVP of Operations on Service Delivery strategy, headcount planning, and budget for the function. * Represent Service Delivery in cross\-functional and executive conversations, translating team\-level performance into business impact. * Lead HIPAA compliance and data security oversight across all outsourced operations. \- Own the automation roadmap for Service Delivery. * Set and own a target for cost per order, defect rates, and key cost metrics * Rebuild WFM to forecast mixed human and automated capacity, so staffing plans and vendor commitments track the real demand curve, in real time. * Help set the quality framework for agentic workflows: error tolerance, escalation paths, human\-in\-the\-loop points, and audit coverage. * Act as the operational owne gineering on Courier automation. Define what good looks like, test it, and sign off before patient\-facing release. * Make AI\-assisted work the default across your team, and measure adoption and output gains at team level. * Lead HIPAA and data security oversight across outsourced operations and AI tooling, including vendor due diligence and BAAs. **AI REQUIREMENTS** ------------------- At Scan.com, AI isn't a side project; it's how we work. We expect everyone to use AI to think faster, remove drudgery, and multiply their output. What we care about is judgment: knowing when AI makes you sharper, when it doesn't, and how to use it responsibly around patient data. You don't need to be an engineer. You need to be someone who reaches for the best tool and gets more done as a result. **Tier 1 — AI\-Native** For this role, the expectation is that you are AI\-native. You build with AI directly, shipping, automating, or prototyping real work with LLMs and agents, and have clear judgment on where humans must stay in the loop. * You build with AI, not just alongside it. You've shipped, automated, or prototyped something real using LLMs, agents, or AI tooling. * You can explain a workflow you redesigned so a machine does the boring 80%. * You have a view on where agentic systems help and where a human must stay in the loop, especially in regulated, PHI\-adjacent work. **A VIEW ON OUR CULTURE** ------------------------- We're building something that matters. Every scan we speed up is a real person waiting on an answer, and that urgency runs through everything we do. We move fast, we own outcomes, and take pride in our output. If you like ambiguity, working with ambitious people, and want your work to visibly move the needle, you'll feel at home here. **HOW WE WILL INTERVIEW YOU** ----------------------------- We keep our interview process short and sweet. Here are the stages you can expect, but we might switch up the order depending on team availability: * 30\-minute introductory phone call with our Senior Talent Partner. * If it feels like there is an initial fit for all, we will invite you to a 45\-minute video call with the hiring manager. This is a more structured interview that will deep\-dive into the role and technical needs. * 'Scan Standard' interview, where our panel screens for values alignment and the success factors that matter at Scan.com. You will also be assessed on your AI fluency at the stage and depth relevant to this role (see AI Requirements above). * Meet the founders and/or other team members. Again, the length varies depending on how many people are involved and whether in person or via video call. * Offer! **WHAT WE OFFER** ----------------- We go beyond the basics with our benefits package. We believe great work starts with supporting our people. Here's what you can expect from us: * Salary range of **$150,000 \- $180,000** * Equity package * Flexible remote or hybrid work options * Dedicated personal development budget * Medical, vision, and dental coverage * 28\+ days of paid time off across PTO and wellbeing days, so you can show up at your best * Paid parental leave * 401k retirement plan * All the equipment you need to do your best work * Inclusive, people\-first policies designed by our team, for our team **DIVERSITY AT** **SCAN.COM** ----------------------------- Scan.com is committed to eliminating discrimination and encouraging diversity within our team. We strive to provide equality and fairness for all job applicants and employees and never discriminate on the basis of gender, marital status, age, race, ethnicity, religion, or physical differences. We are opposed to all forms of unlawful treatment and discrimination. Our ambition is for our team to be representative of society's diversity, and for every employee to feel respected and able to bring their best selves to work. If you need an accommodation to apply or interview, contact us at people@scan.com. We look forward to receiving your application!

jobs.title: ERP Developer
jobs.description: **Job Summary:** ---------------- The ERP Developer is responsible for developing, customizing, maintaining, and optimizing Servotronics' Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system. This role combines technical development with ERP reporting and data analysis to improve business processes, automate workflows, and support data\-driven decision making. Working cross\-functionally, the ERP Developer translates business requirements into scalable solutions while ensuring system reliability, data integrity, and compliance with development standards. **What you will do:** --------------------- * Develop, maintain and enhance ERP workflows, scripts and automations to meet business needs and improve system performance. * Partner internally within IT, externally with software vendors, and cross\-functionally with Operations, Finance, Supply Chain, Quality, and other departments to gather requirements, manage projects, and deliver effective technical solutions. * Create and maintain reports, dashboards, and KPI's; analyze ERP data to identify trends, resolve discrepancies, and support business decisions. * Support integrations with third\-party vendors, including EDI, customer portals, and automation tools. Validate data flows and maintain data accuracy and consistency. * Conduct unit and integration testing, resolve ERP and reporting issues, and support system upgrades and enhancements. * Respond to ERP\-related support requests submitted through the company's ticketing system, troubleshoot reported issues, document resolutions, and escalate complex problems as needed. * Identify opportunities to streamline workflows, reduce manual effort, improve reporting, and enhance operational efficiency. * Maintain technical documentation, report specifications, and user guides. Provide technical support and training on ERP functionality and reporting tools. * Follow established development, testing, and change control procedures while maintaining system security, reliability, and data integrity. * Perform additional responsibilities as required to support IT initiatives and cross\-functional projects. **What sets you apart:** ------------------------ ### **Qualifications:** **Required:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field. * Minimum of 2 years of experience in ERP development or enterprise application programming. * Proficiency in SQL and relational databases. * Experience with ERP development tools and reporting platforms (e.g., Crystal Reports, SSRS, or similar technologies) * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills. * Effective communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions. **Preferred:** * Experience with ERP platforms such as IQMS (EIQ)(DELMIAWorks), SAP, Epicor, or Oracle. * Experience with programming or scripting languages such as Python and PowerShell. * Experience with system integrations, APIs, and middleware tools. * Familiarity with manufacturing, finance, and/or supply chain operations. * Experience with Power BI, data visualization, KPI development, and/or advanced reporting. * Knowledge of source control, software deployment, and change management practices. ### **Competencies:** . Effective Communication . Follow Through . Analytical Thinking . Collaboration * Systems Thinking . Customer Focus . Self\-Directed ### **Physical Requirements:** **Hearing:** Adequate to perform job duties in person, over the telephone, and on the production floor. **Speaking:** Must be able to communicate clearly in person, over the telephone, and on the production floor. **Vision:** Visual acuity adequate to perform job duties, including visual examination of manufactured parts and reading information from printed sources and computer screens. **Other:** May require frequent lifting and carrying items weighing up to 30 pounds unassisted, including assisting coworkers when required. Adequate physical ability including sufficient manual dexterity to perform the requisite manufacturing duties. Requires frequent bending, reaching, repetitive hand movements, standing, walking, squatting and sitting, with some heavy lifting, pushing and pulling exerted regularly throughout a regular work shift. U.S. Applicants: EEO/AA Disability/Veteran Shift: First Shift Compensation: $70,000 \- $105,000

We are committed to investing in our employees, providing a dynamic and supportive environment for learning and professional growth. We offer competitive pay, generous benefits, and opportunities for advancement, but more importantly, we offer you the ability to make a real difference in the world.* *Together we can create a brighter, cleaner future for generations to come.* **Job Description** **Summary of Position** The Process Engineer is responsible for development of Standard Operating Procedures (SOP) and Standard Work Instructions (SWI), identifying and implementing improvement projects, conducting root cause analysis for production and maintenance issues, and collaborating with the operations team on program deliverables. Additionally, you will be involved in equipment evaluation, compliance with standards and legislation, and mentoring and training newer team members. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** * Lead the Development of Standard Operating Procedures (SOP) and Standard Work Instructions (SWI). * Support the production team with data and analysis toward resolving other issues including those outside of engineering scope. * Hands\-on root cause analysis on production, engineering, equipment, and maintenance issues. * Identify and implement kaizen projects to improve productivity \& efficiency. * Projects and process improvements (implementation, analysis, and process improvements). * Process Control Specification. * Process Control Flow Chart. * Support Equipment Runoff @ OEM. * Collaborate with the Operations Team on Program Deliverables. * Lead the development of VSM (Value Stream Map) for Production lines across all sites. * PFMEAs Review / Simulation Review / Control Plans / Launch Deliverables. * Support Plant Equipment Install / Debug / Launch / Continuous Improvement. * Actively participate in meetings with the plants to support and meet the project deliverables. * Support all sites with troubleshooting activities, provide solutions and support for process concerns or improvement. * Automation troubleshooting, new equipment installation and modifications. * Process equipment evaluation to implementation. * Ensure equipment and systems comply with relevant standards and legislation. * Establishes equipment installation board and review weekly/daily with OEM and contractors. * Develop and lead trial runs at all sites. * Coaching / Mentoring / Training of newer / less experienced team members. * Support the quotation of machinery or equipment required for the processes. **Additional Requirements:** * Ability to work overtime and weekends when required. * Must be able to travel up to 50% of the time. **Qualifications** **Skills** * Experience working with and troubleshooting robotics / controls systems, Control Logix PLCs and plant application controls and automation. * Skilled in Microsoft Office applications and AutoCAD software. * Good oral and written communication skills. Must exhibit professional and courteous communication / interaction under pressure. * Able to effectively work with external machine builders and system integrators for detail design, build and integration of later stages of machine system implementation. * Strong organizational skills and a high level of self\-motivation. * Demonstrated technical project management experience. * Strong logical and methodical reasoning capabilities. * Solid understanding of safety systems design. * Ability to effectively manage multiple issues in a fast\-paced work environment. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to resolve complex issues. **Traits** * Demonstrated ability to work effectively with cross\-functional team members. * Mechanical aptitude/interest. * Excellent inter\-personal and communication skills both written and verbal. * Team oriented. * Commitment to continuous learning. * High degree of attention to detail, precision and follow through. * Willing and able to work rotating shifts. * Be able to conceive and manage small projects. **Education and/or Experience** * Bachelor’s degree in Mechatronics, Electromechanical, Controls Technology or equivalent experience. * Minimum 2\-3 years of practical related experience within a high\-volume manufacturing environment. * Knowledge and experience in the application of Statistical Process Control, preferred. **Additional Information** **Compensation and Benefits** * Competitive Market Wages * Paid Time Off (vacation, sick, and holiday) * Employee Assistance Program * Medical/Dental/Vision Insurance Plans * Employee Assistance Program * Tuition Reimbursement Program * Employee Recognition Programs * Employee PV Panel Purchase Program Additional Information Silfab Solar is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. Any information provided during the application process will be maintained in accordance with applicable privacy laws and Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) requirements.

jobs.title: Principal Engineer, Platform Engineering
jobs.description: **Position overview** SingleStore is seeking a Principal Cloud Network \& Reliability Engineer to lead the architecture, reliability, and automation of the network foundations supporting our engineering organization. This is a senior hands\-on technical role spanning cloud networking, site reliability engineering, infrastructure automation, and platform architecture across AWS, GCP, Azure, and internal infrastructure. The ideal candidate combines deep networking expertise with strong software and infrastructure engineering skills. They should be comfortable operating across organizational boundaries, driving technical decisions, improving reliability, and identifying adjacent problems that need ownership rather than limiting themselves strictly to a predefined scope. This role also provides senior technical coverage during U.S. business hours and acts as a key architecture partner to Platform Engineering, Systems Engineering, IT, InfoSec, and product engineering teams. **What you'll do:** * Define cloud networking architecture and standards across AWS, GCP, Azure, and internal infrastructure. * Design and evolve routing, segmentation, firewalls, NAT, ingress/egress, DNS, VPN, private connectivity, and cloud\-to\-data\-center networking. * Lead technical direction for private\-access technologies such as Tailscale, Headscale, WireGuard, bastions, and related access patterns. * Establish SLOs, monitoring, alerting, recovery procedures, and operational standards for critical network services. * Lead diagnosis and mitigation of significant networking, connectivity, and infrastructure incidents, and drive permanent remediation. * Develop and maintain infrastructure using Terraform, OpenTofu, Terragrunt, Python, Go, or comparable technologies. * Build reusable infrastructure patterns and automation that enable safe self\-service for platform and engineering teams. * Improve infrastructure change safety through automated validation, required review, observability, change logging, and rollback practices. * Partner with Cloud Platform, Developer Platform, Systems Engineering, IT, InfoSec, and SRE teams on architecture that crosses networking, infrastructure, identity, security, and reliability domains. * Serve as a senior technical escalation point during U.S. business hours. * Create architecture standards, decision records, runbooks, and operational practices that reduce dependency on individual subject\-matter experts. * Mentor engineers and raise networking, infrastructure, and reliability expertise across the organization. * Identify architectural and operational gaps beyond the immediate networking domain and help drive them to resolution. **Your Experience:** * Deep experience designing and operating complex production cloud networks in at least one major cloud provider, with meaningful experience in a second. * Strong knowledge of routing, subnetting, segmentation, firewalls, NAT, DNS, VPN, ingress/egress, and private connectivity. * Demonstrated experience troubleshooting complex production network and infrastructure failures. * Strong hands\-on experience with Terraform, OpenTofu, Terragrunt, or comparable infrastructure\-as\-code technologies. * Experience building infrastructure automation using Python, Go, or a comparable programming language. * Strong SRE experience including observability, incident response, root\-cause analysis, recovery engineering, and reliability improvement. * Experience operating Kubernetes or adjacent cloud\-platform infrastructure. * Experience designing safe infrastructure change and deployment practices. * Ability to lead architecture decisions across multiple engineering organizations without formal authority. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, including architecture documents, standards, runbooks, and incident reviews. * Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers, distribute technical knowledge, and influence technical direction at Principal level. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience across AWS, GCP, and Azure. * AWS Transit Gateway, Cloud WAN, Direct Connect, PrivateLink, Route 53, or equivalent cloud\-network technologies. * GCP Cloud Router, Interconnect, Shared VPC, Private Service Connect, or equivalent technologies. * Azure Virtual WAN, ExpressRoute, Private Link, or equivalent technologies. * BGP and hybrid cloud/data\-center networking. * Tailscale, Headscale, WireGuard, or comparable private\-access technologies. * NetBox or other IPAM/DCIM platforms. * Kubernetes CNI or advanced Kubernetes networking experience. * Grafana, Prometheus, Mimir, Loki, CloudWatch, PagerDuty, Pingdom, or comparable observability tools. * Experience with IAM and identity technologies such as Okta, Keycloak, FreeIPA, OIDC, SAML, SCIM, JIT access, certificates, secrets management, or privileged\-access systems. * Experience building policy\-as\-code, infrastructure guardrails, or automated deployment controls. * Experience in large multi\-account, multi\-project, hybrid\-cloud, or enterprise\-scale infrastructure environments. **About us:** SingleStore delivers the cloud\-native database with the speed and scale to power the world's data\-intensive applications. With a distributed SQL database that introduces simplicity to your data architecture by unifying transactions and analytics, SingleStore empowers digital leaders to deliver exceptional, real\-time data experiences to their customers. SingleStore is venture\-backed and headquartered in San Francisco with offices in Sunnyvale, Raleigh, Seattle, Boston, London, Lisbon, Bangalore, Dublin and Kyiv. Consistent with our commitment to diversity \& inclusion, we value individuals with the ability to work on diverse teams and with a diverse range of people. *T**o all recruitment agencies: SingleStore does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to SingleStore employees. SingleStore is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third\-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with the Company.* SingleStore values individuals for their unique skills and experiences, and we're proud to offer roles in a variety of locations across the United States. Salary is based on permissible, non\-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location, and is just one part of our total compensation and benefits package. *For candidates residing in California, please see our* *California Recruitment Privacy Notice**. For candidates residing in the EEA, UK, and Switzerland, please see our* *EEA, UK, and Swiss Recruitment Privacy Notice.* Req ID: ENG00523

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description: Siteimprove is the leader in agentic content intelligence. Our platform brings accessibility, analytics, SEO/AEO, and content strategy together in one system, where AI agents work alongside marketing and digital teams to produce content that is accessible and easy to find. Every customer, user, and increasingly every AI agent that touches the Siteimprove platform goes through systems owned by the Access team: sign\-in, single sign\-on, federation with customer identity providers, and the authorization layer that decides who can see and do what. We're looking for a Software Engineer with real depth in authentication, authorization, and identity provider (IdP) systems. You'll design and build the services that secure the Siteimprove platform, work with enterprise and public\-sector customers' SSO setups, help us meet FedRAMP requirements, and shape how AI agents and machine clients authenticate against our APIs and MCP servers. This is a hands\-on role with a lot of technical ownership. You'll be one of the people others on the team, and across engineering, come to with identity questions. ### **What we will be doing** * **SSO and federation:** Build and run our login, session, MFA, and token services. Own SAML and OIDC integrations with customer IdPs (Okta, Entra ID, Ping, ADFS), from metadata and certificate rotation to enterprise edge cases. * **Provisioning:** Own the user lifecycle across SCIM, JIT provisioning, and deprovisioning. * **Authorization platform:** Evolve our centralized permissions and authorization services, including the models (RBAC, ABAC, ReBAC), APIs, and caching, so product teams get fast, consistent access decisions. * **Agent identity:** Define how AI agents, MCP servers, and integrations authenticate and get delegated, least\-privilege access through OAuth 2\.x (token exchange, scoped short\-lived tokens), with consent and auditability built in. * **Security and compliance:** Design against account takeover and token abuse. Implement FedRAMP identity controls (FAL2, signed and encrypted assertions, FIPS\-validated cryptography), and work with Security and GRC on audit evidence and addressing vulnerabilities. * **Reliability:** Raise the bar for reliability and observability on services where an outage means nobody can log in. * **Technical leadership:** Lead design reviews and build\-vs\-buy decisions, mentor engineers, and be the go\-to identity expert across engineering. * Travel may be required; a valid passport is required * Perform other duties as assigned ### **What we will require of you** * **Engineering depth:** 6\+ years of professional software engineering, with at least 3 years building or running authentication, authorization, or identity systems in production. * **Backend stack:** Strong backend skills in C\#/.NET or Java, and a willingness to work in whichever one a given service uses. * **Protocol expertise:** Deep, practical knowledge of OAuth 2\.0/2\.1, OpenID Connect, and SAML 2\.0: grant types, token formats JWT, PKCE, token lifetimes and revocation, and assertion signing and encryption. * **IdP experience:** Hands\-on experience with at least one IdP, whether in\-house, open source (such as Keycloak), or commercial (such as FusionAuth, Auth0, Okta, Entra ID, or Cognito), including integrating customer IdPs for enterprise SSO. * **Authorization design:** Experience designing authorization models and permission services that stay correct and fast at scale. * **Security mindset:** A solid grasp of identity threats (token theft and replay, session fixation, CSRF, open redirects, IdP\-initiated SSO risks) and how to design against them. * **Cloud\-native systems:** Experience building distributed services on AWS or Azure, including containers, CI/CD, and production observability. * **AI\-native delivery:** You use AI tools every day to understand code, generate tests, and ship faster. * **Clear communication:** You can explain a tricky identity trade\-off to engineers, product managers, and auditors. ### **What we will love about you** * Experience with FedRAMP, or other government compliance programs, and with NIST SP 800\-63 identity and federation assurance levels. * Experience with FIPS 140\-validated crypto modules, HSM or KMS\-backed key management, and certificate lifecycle automation. * Experience with policy engines or fine\-grained authorization systems such as OPA, Cedar, OpenFGA, or other Zanzibar\-style systems. * Familiarity with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) authorization spec, OAuth token exchange, or workload identity (CIMD, IAM roles for service accounts). * Experience with SCIM 2\.0\. * Experience leading a migration between identity platforms without disrupting customers. ### **What you'll love about us** We’re building the next generation of AI\-powered content intelligence, helping organizations unify accessibility, SEO/AEO, analytics, and content performance into one platform. If you’re energized by solving complex problems, working cross\-functionally, and contributing to a product with real\-world impact, we’d love to connect.### **In addition, we hope you will appreciate:** At Siteimprove, we're committed to supporting your wellbeing both at work and beyond. Our Denmark benefits are designed to help you thrive personally and professionally. **Rest and relaxation:** Generous time off including Danish holiday entitlements, five additional FF Days, child sick leave, and bereavement leave. **Comprehensive benefits**: Health insurance, company\-paid mobile phone support, and internet allowance to support your day\-to\-day needs. **Prepare for the future**: Danica pension with employer contributions to help support your retirement goals. The base salary for this role will fall within the posted range and is determined by experience, qualifications, and location.**Siteimprove is an equal opportunity employer** All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, disability, veteran status, age, marital status, pregnancy, genetic information, or other legally protected status. Siteimprove is a global corporation that has developed data practices to ensure your personally identifiable information is appropriately protected. Please note that personal information may be transferred, accessed, and stored globally as necessary for the uses and disclosures stated in accordance with our Privacy Policy at https://siteimprove.com/en/privacy/. **FedRAMP Authorization Notice for Job Postings** This position may involve access to systems, information, or customer environments that are subject to the Federal Risk and Authorization Management Program (FedRAMP). Where applicable, FedRAMP\-related responsibilities will be outlined in the job description. If the role includes FedRAMP\-related duties, candidates may be required to meet the following requirements: **Identity Verification:** Candidates must successfully complete federal I\-9 employment eligibility verification. **Citizenship/Residency Requirement:** Certain roles may be limited to U.S. citizens or lawful permanent residents if job duties include access to controlled systems, environments, or data. **Access Authorization:** Employment offers for applicable roles are contingent upon confirmation that the candidate meets the minimum access requirements associated with the FedRAMP authorization level required for the position. By applying, you acknowledge that, if the role includes FedRAMP\-related responsibilities, employment may be subject to these authorization and verification requirements. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description: Skillable is a 100% remote and virtual tech company that’s modernizing the world of training. Come share your professional magic with highly talented, driven and fun colleagues who believe in the power of “skilling.” Experience what a team focused on doing the right thing feels like! Our talented people are what makes us friendly and have fun! We work together to create amazing solutions and experiences for our customers and their clients. We utilize our employees’ personal strengths to help grow our company and ensure our team is living their best, authentic life. We share our appreciation for our team members regularly during all\-hands, a workplace appreciation tool, regular shoutouts in our Teams channels, social media, amongst more. Our remote\-first work environment blends work and life without the added pressure of commuting or feeling guilty about leaving early to visit the dentist. Come work with us and learn what teamwork and integrity blended with an emphasis on well\-being and balance can do for your career and lifestyle! We're an AI\-first engineering team, and we treat that as a discipline, not a shortcut. Every engineer here works with agentic coding tools — Claude Code and GitHub CoPilot are key drivers in our daily work, which changes the shape of the job: * You'll spend more of your time on design, decomposition and review, and less on typing. Agents handle much of the implementation; you own the architecture, the verification and everything that ships. * We invest in the system that makes AI effective: project context, custom agents and skills, MCP integrations and multi\-agent code review. Improving that system is engineering work here, and it's part of the role. * Judgment matters more, not less. Knowing when to hand work to an agent — and when not to — is a skill we hire for and grow. * Skillable's whole business is proving skills by doing. We hold our own work to the same standard: AI\-assisted or not, it isn't done until it's verified. The **Principal Software Engineer** is responsible for the technical shape of the team’s roadmap by choosing where their depth is the most beneficial, owning cross\-cutting architecture, foundational dept, and the tooling that makes their whole area deliver faster and with quality. Develop and optimize APIs, databases, UIs, design systems, and libraries written in either C\# or JavaScript/TypeScript. to ensure the product and technology roadmap is consistently delivered. **What You Will Do:** * Set the technical bar for a team; lead the design and scope of complex software features into well\-defined implementation plans, leveraging AI\-assisted development workflows to accelerate delivery while maintaining engineering rigor. * Guide and direct AI agents through feature development, serving as the primary architect, reviewer, and decision\-maker to frame the problem, set constraints and make the calls that ensure solutions are aligned with business requirements and technical standards. * Build effective scaffolding that enables AI tools to generate high\-quality, maintainable, and scalable code, project context management, reusable skills, agent workflows, prompt frameworks and automated quality checks. * Drive comprehensive automated testing and verification practices for every feature before release, ensuring unit tests and validation scenarios are tied back to the requirements. * Own the quality of all delivered software by rigorously reviewing AI\-generated output, challenging assumptions, finding the gaps, and validating that solution fully resolves the problem. * Identify and mitigate risks associated with AI\-assisted development, ensuring generated solutions meet expectations for security, maintainability, correctness, and long\-term sustainability. * Continuously raise the team capabilities in AI\-driven engineering by improving workflows, tooling, agents and best practices other engineers depend on for quality outcomes. * Create clarity for a team in undefined territory by framing the problem, setting constraints, and giving others a workable starting point where no pattern exists. * Makes the complex clear for technical and non\-technical audiences, facilitates healthy disagreements, and consult with others on technical input before making a group decision. * Create and maintain documentation of features, design decisions, configurations, and other key technical areas of the application. * Lead the collaboration with other developers, QA engineers, designers, and product experts in a cross\-functional scrum team. * Accountable for the team’s delivery, pace and quality by scoping and staging work across team members and representing them in cross\-functional meetings. * Define scope and estimation for proposed features leading to accurate cost and timeline estimates * Propose, prototype, and champion technologies and processes that continuously help Skillable advance integration solutions. * Mentor team members and establish standards by deve ekends, or holidays for emergency support or special events. * Experience with the following is appreciated but not strictly required: Authentication (e.g., OIDC, OAuth, SAML), NextJS, ExpressJS, and Building pipelines and DevOps practices. **Salary Range** The base salary for this position is $150,000 \- $200,000 annually. Consistent with applicable laws, compensation will be determined based on the candidate's level, relevant skills, qualifications, and experience along with requirements for the position and annual financial plans. Skillable is a distributed first team with employees working across the U.S., and we do not consider geography when determining compensation ranges. Pay range and current benefit offerings are effective for 90 days from posting date. Standard employment offerings are subject to potential change upon periodic review and analysis, at the discretion of Skillable. **What We Offer** We believe in providing a suite of benefits that ensure our employees know we appreciate them as people first. Skillable wants to be a company that promotes physical, emotional and all around well\-being through our benefit offerings! Subject to eligibility requirements, the Company offers comprehensive benefits including:* Fully remote with a monthly stipend to pay for office services and supplies * Medical (2 plan options), dental (2 plan options), vision, health savings account with generous employer contributions, healthcare spending accounts, dependent care spending accounts, EAP, group paid life insurance, group paid STD and LTD and voluntary life/AD\&D insurance, accident and critical illness options. * 401(k) with company match, tuition reimbursement, healthy lifestyle reimbursements. * Unlimited PTO, Paid holidays, bereavement leave, parental leave, caregiver leave and paid FMLA leave. * Privilege of logging off at 2:00 pm local time, every Friday for team members who are caught up on work and meeting deliverables. Full company closure during the 4th of July holiday week. * Reimbursement for up to $750 annually to use towards lifestyle choices that impact their wellness such as gym memberships, fitness classes or healthy meal plans, * Stipend of $200 a month for office expenses. * Access to pet insurance; access for employees and dependents to Skillable learning opportunities through our product and more! **Working Conditions:** The job conditions for this position are in a remote home office setting, requiring a space that supports privacy and focus to attend to regular and frequent video and voice calls. Employees in this position use PC and phone on an on\-going basis throughout the day. Periodic travel may be required equaling up to approximately 10% of the time. Skillable participates in E\-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I\-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work int he U.S. If E\-Verify cannot confirm that you are authorized to work, this employer is required to give you written instructions and an opportunity to contact Department of Homeland Security (DHS) or Social Security Administration (SSA) so you can begin to resolve the issue before the employer can take any action against you, including terminating your employment. **Fraud Prevention:** To protect candidates from recruiting scams, please note that our Talent Acquisition Manager will only contact applicants using the personal contact information provided when applying through our official careers page. If you did not apply but are being pursued about a position, our initial outreach will only occur through LinkedIn \- not via Indeed. If you receive an unexpected message directing you to apply through another website or from anyone other than our Talent Acquisition Manager, please treat it with caution. ***Skillable can only hire potential candidates with a primary residence in the following States: AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, ID, IN, KY, MA, ME, MI, MO, NC, ND, NE, NH, NV, NY, OH, OK, SC, TN, TX, UT, WA, WI.***

jobs.description: Snap Inc is a technology company. We believe the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate. jobs.title: Field HR Product Architect
jobs.description: **About Sol** ------------- Sol is an agentic HR system built for how work is changing. We're replacing the traditional HRIS with an AI\-native foundation. We are built for change, designed to scale, and reimagined with AI from the ground up, so HR leaders get a clear view of their workforce instead of a system everyone works around. At Sol, we're guided by three things: **people:** we hire driven, humble people and build to amplify their potential and our customers'; **imagination:** we challenge assumptions about our industry and how software gets built, then move fast once we've decided; and **durability:** we sweat the details to build a company that is meant to last. Day to day, that shows up as a bias toward writing things down over meetings, async communication by default, and flexible hours that respect how differently everyone works. We try new things, kill what isn't working, and hold a high bar without the politics or ego that slow good decisions down. Sol was founded by leaders who spent decades building the modern HR category, and is backed by Sutter Hill Ventures and NEA. Our first customers go live in early 2027 and we need you to make them wildly successful. **THE ROLE** ------------ Implementing an HRIS today means months of workshops, spreadsheets, hand\-built configuration, and testing, and most of what the company learned about itself leaves with the project team. Sol is built to change that. Our agent learns what a company is trying to achieve, guides it through the right questions, and infers what it can from existing systems and documents. People confirm and verify instead of handcrafting every setting, and the system keeps learning long after go\-live. You'll lead our first customer go\-lives, starting in early 2027\. Your job is to make each customer successful: live on schedule, and working differently because you were there. You'll drive the implementation process and design, paired with a Forward Deployed Engineer on data migration and integrations, and advise customers on best practices and what a new HR operating model looks like when the system does more of the work. You're also an extension of the product team. You'll be one of Sol's first users, an expert on what it can do, and the person who brings what you learn from every customer back to product and engineering. What you learn also teaches Sol's agent: you'll shape what it asks, what it recommends, and which decisions it makes on its own. The role is a mix of strategy consulting, project management, hands\-on configuration, product management, and product acceptance testing. You may know this kind of role as forward deployed, deployment strategist, or implementation lead. This role is hybrid: onsite 3 days in San Mateo to start and then San Francisco (we move next summer). **WHAT YOU'LL DO** ------------------ * **Scope each engagement.** Starting in pre\-sales, assess fit and go\-live readiness honestly, and decide what's in the first wave, what follows, and what the customer drives themselves. * **Keep go\-lives fast.** Getting customers live in a fraction of the time other systems take is core to Sol's value. Run the plan, chase decisions, clear blockers, and escalate early when something threatens the date. * **Guide process design.** Learn how work moves through the company today, including the steps outside any system, and decide the best form for each piece in Sol: configuration, a workflow, context for the agent, or left as is for now. Some customers need a light touch; others need an opinionated perspective. * **Lead change management.** Align stakeholders across HR, Finance, Legal, and IT. Run exec comms, a steering cadence, UAT, and sign\-off discipline so decisions stick. * **Shape the product.** Work with product and engineering regularly on what you're seeing in the field, and help decide what we build and automate next. * **Teach the agent.** Review what Sol's agent learns from each engagement, and help decide when it's ready to make a call on its own. * **Test before customers do.** Use new capability as it's built, and validate it against what our customers need. * **Hand off cleanly.** Partner with your FDE through testing, cutover, and hypercare, then roll off once the customer is stable and running on their own. **WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR** -------------------------- * Mid\-to\-senior HR Operations or HRIS experience, including leading HRIS implementations more than once. Ideally Workday or comparable (Dayforce, UKG, Oracle) at companies of 1,000\+ employees. * You've lived with the system after go\-live, and you know which design decisions hold up through the next comp cycle or audit. An HR Ops background is preferred; consultants who led design are welcome too. * You understand how org structure, jobs and positions, compensation, time and leave, and payroll and benefits data depend on each other. * You're comfortable telling a stakeholder no on scope, and you can keep a project on time without losing the room. * You write clearly, and you can turn messy implementation reality into something product and engineering can act on. * You're excited about what AI does to this work, including the parts of your own job it will take over. * You're high agency and comfortable building the playbook as you go. * **Bonus:** you've built a job architecture from scratch, or worked at a high\-growth tech company or early\-stage startup. **WHY NOW** ----------- We're early. Our first customers go live in early 2027, and how those go\-lives run will set the model for every customer after them. This is the chance to fix the implementation you always wished you'd had, from the vendor side, with the product team listening. Real ownership from the first week, and a short path to a decision when you need one. **COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS** ----------------------------- * Base range: $200,000\-$250,000 and significant early\-stage equity * Medical, dental and vision coverage * Mental health support (Talkspace), fertility care (Kindbody) and primary care access (Teladoc, One Medical) * FSA and dependent care accounts * Life and disability insurance * 401(k) * Untracked PTO and company holidays Sol is an equal opportunity employer. We don't discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. We're committed to building an inclusive workplace and providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.

and choreography vs. orchestration — applying these patterns to solve real customer architectural challenges. * Articulate the strategic business value of EDA to executive and technical audiences alike — connecting real\-time event streaming to tangible outcomes such as reduced time\-to\-insight, operational resilience, accelerated digital transformation, and the ability to scale AI\-powered applications on a live data fabric. * Confidently position Solace Event Brokers against competing messaging and streaming technologies — including Apache Kafka, IBM MQ, RabbitMQ, and cloud\-native brokers — articulating where Solace’s multi\-protocol support, hybrid/multi\-cloud event mesh, enterprise\-grade QoS, and dynamic topic routing create clear differentiation. * Challenge customers to evolve beyond request/response and batch architectures, guiding them through an EDA maturity model — from point\-to\-point integration and basic messaging to a fully distributed, event\-driven enterprise capable of supporting real\-time AI and autonomous systems at scale. **Solace Agent Mesh Subject Matter Expert** * Position Solace Agent Mesh Enterprise as the production\-grade foundation for agentic AI — bridging event\-driven infrastructure with LLM orchestration and multi\-agent workflows. * Demonstrate how Agent Mesh extends customers' existing Solace Event Mesh investment into agentic AI, reducing time\-to\-production for AI initiatives. * Articulate the platform's horizontal scalability, fault\-tolerant asynchronous messaging, and governance capabilities to both technical jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff (ML)
jobs.description: **Why you should join us** -------------------------- Solstice builds AI software that helps life sciences teams create, refine, and review pharmaceutical marketing content. We have worked with leading life sciences manufacturers and more than 50 pharma brands. Our backers include Transformation Capital, Twelve Below, Virtue, and the founders of Datavant, Commure, and Paradigm. The technical problems are concrete: find the right evidence in complex scientific material, identify claims accurately, and improve generated content using reviewer feedback and real product outcomes. You will work with proprietary data and a team that can put your improvements in front of customers. **About the role** ------------------ As a Member of Technical Staff in Machine Learning, you will improve the models, representations, and data that power Solstice's AI agents for creating, refining, and reviewing pharmaceutical marketing content. Your work will help agents find supporting evidence, use tools accurately, and incorporate reviewer feedback into better outputs. You will investigate failures across complete agent runs, form a testable hypothesis, implement a change, and establish whether it improves the customer's task. The intervention might be better training examples, a retrieval or ranking improvement, a different model or context strategy, or targeted fine\-tuning. You will choose an approach based on evidence and test its quality, reliability, latency, and cost before taking it into production. You will work directly with Applied AI engineers, who own the complete feature and workflow, and Fullstack AI engineers, who build the shared runtime, APIs, and product experiences. You will build prototypes and production components together, with primary responsibility for model and data improvements and the evidence that they generalize. **What you'll be working on** ----------------------------- * **Improve model behavior inside agents.** Diagnose failures in evidence selection, tool choice and arguments, and revisions based on feedback. Work with Applied AI to separate model or data limitations from missing context, tool failures, or workflow design problems. * **Make retrieval and grounding more accurate.** Develop and compare retrieval, reranking, and claim\-to\-evidence matching approaches across scientific documents and approved content. Measure whether the evidence actually supports the claim and helps the agent complete the task. * **Turn agent runs and reviewer feedback into useful data.** Build curated datasets from successful and failed runs, corrections, and targeted examples. Track provenance, resolve ambiguous labels, and keep held\-out evaluation cases separate from training and tuning. * **Implement and test substantive improvements.** Compare model choices, representations, context strategies, and learning methods with credible baselines and controlled experiments. Use targeted fine\-tuning or other model adaptation when the available data and results justify it. * **Measure complete\-task outcomes.** Evaluate intermediate tool behavior and the resulting artifact. Check repeated\-run reliability and generalization to unfamiliar documents and task variants. Calibrate automated judgments against human review and track quality alongside latency and cost. * **Ship improvements with the product team.** Integrate changes into production Python services and agent workflows. Use versioned data and models, staged releases, quality monitoring and rollback criteria, then investigate whether offline gains hold up in use. **What we're looking for** -------------------------- * Strong ML fundamentals and hands\-on implementation skills. You can reason about learning objectives, optimization, regularization, data quality, and generalization. * Strong Python and hands\-on experience building or improving LLM systems, retrieval systems, or agents. You can inspect tool\-call traces, reproduce failures, and implement the experiment or production change needed to investigate them. * Evidence of taking a data or model improvement into production and understanding what happened after deployment. * Sound experimental judgment: explicit hypotheses, credible comparisons, meaningful baselines, and care with leakage, noisy labels, and misleading aggregate metrics. * Depth in at least one relevant area, such as retrieval and ranking, representation learning, model adaptation, or learning from human feedback, with the ability to apply that depth to multi\-step agent tasks. * Judgment about the source of a failure. You can explain when to change the data or model, when to improve context or a tool interface, and how to design a comparison that distinguishes those explanations. * Practical software engineering skills for reproducible experiments, tested components, production integration, and debugging. * Clear communication and personal ownership. You can explain the tradeoffs, work with product and engineering partners, and follow through when results challenge your assumptions. Experience with scientific documents, human review feedback, or regulated enterprise products is useful. Healthcare or pharma experience is welcome but not required. We value demonstrated implementation and experimental judgment; a particular degree, publication record, or framework is not a substitute for that evidence. **Benefits** ------------ * Health, dental, and vision insurance * Ground\-floor equity opportunity * Visa sponsorship for O\-1, H\-1B, and TN visas * Unlimited PTO * 401(k) with a 4% company match * In\-office lunches five days a week * Professional growth stipend * Relocation support **Location and compensation** ----------------------------- New York City. Full time. On\-site. The base salary range is $200,000 to $300,000, plus equity, depending on experience and scope of responsibility. This is the same NYC compensation band as our Member of Technical Staff (Applied AI) role. Compensation Range: $200K \- $300K
