jobs.title: Data Security Engineer
jobs.description: **Description** --------------- Southern New Hampshire University is a team of innovators. World changers. Individuals who believe in progress with purpose. Since 1932, our people\-centered strategy has defined us — and helped us grow a team that now serves over 180,000 learners worldwide. Our mission to transform lives is made possible by talented people who bring diverse industry experience, backgrounds and skills to the university. And today, we're ready to expand our reach. All we need is you. **Make an impact — from near or far** At SNHU, you'll have the option to work remotely in the following states: Alabama, Arizona, Arkansas, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Idaho, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Mississippi, Missouri, Nebraska, New Hampshire, New Mexico, North Carolina, North Dakota, Ohio, Oklahoma, South Carolina, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, West Virginia, Wisconsin and Wyoming. We ask that our remote employees have access to a reliable internet connection and a dedicated, properly equipped workspace that is free of distractions. Employees must reside in, and work from, one of the above approved states. **The opportunity** The Data Security Engineer implements, operates, and helps improve the security controls that protect institutional data across the enterprise data estate, including analytics platforms such as Microsoft Fabric and Databricks, relational database platforms such as Azure SQL and SQL Server, and the pipelines and integrations that move data between them. This is a hands\-on engineering role in the data protection domain: encryption and key management, access and entitlement controls for data, data classification and labeling enforcement, masking and de\-identification, database security configuration, and secure data pipeline engineering. You will work alongside other security engineers, Security Operations, Data \& Analytics, Data Governance, Data Engineering, and other IT teams, and provides technical support and guidance to teams building or operating data solutions. You will report to the Deputy CISO. You will work 100% remotely from any of our approved states. **What you'll do:** * Implements and maintains data protection controls across the enterprise data estate, including classification and labeling enforcement, masking, tokenization, redaction, and de\-identification, so that controls reflect institutional data sensitivity and regulatory requirements. * Configures and operates encryption controls for data at rest and in transit, including platform\-native encryption, certificate management, customer\-managed keys (CMK), and key rotation, and manages keys, secrets, and credentials using approved vaulting services and managed identities. * Implements least\-privilege access models across data platforms, databases, workspaces, schemas, tables, pipelines, and service identities, and performs \[quarterly] entitlement reviews to identify and remediate excessive or orphaned access. * Hardens security configurations for Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Azure SQL, SQL Server, data lakes, and storage services, and assesses database permissions, schemas, stored procedures, queries, and audit settings for weaknesses that could expose or improperly alter institutional data. * Embeds security controls into data ingestion, transformation, orchestration, sharing, and export workflows, and secures the service identities, connectors, private endpoints, network paths, notebooks, jobs, and CI/CD processes that support them. * Protects non\-production environments by provisioning synthetic data or controlled production\-data extracts and enforcing approved masking and tokenization standards before data is copied out of production. * Automates control deployment, configuration assessment, evidence collection, and compliance validation using scripting, infrastructure\-as\-code (IaC), and platform APIs, and integrates data security telemetry with Security Operations to support investigation, containment, and corrective action for data\-related security events. * Documents and communicates the work: creates and maintains implementation guides, configuration standards, control mappings, and runbooks; participates in threat modeling and secure design reviews; and provides hands\-on technical support to teams designing, deploying, migrating, or troubleshooting data solutions. * Attendance, punctuality, and reliability are essential functions of this role * Other duties and responsibilities as assigned. Job responsibilities can change at any time, with or without notice. **Detailed responsibilities by domain** The eight primary duties above consolidate the following detailed scope. **Data security controls** * Design, implement, and maintain reusable data protection controls that enforce institutional security requirements across the enterprise data estate. * Translate data classification, sensitivity, and regulatory  s, analyze recurring findings and exceptions, and propose improvements based on data sensitivity, exposure, threat context, and business impact. * Support audits, risk assessments, and regulatory or contractual reviews by producing technical evidence that demonstrates the effectiveness of implemented controls. **Consulting, documentation, and collaboration** * Provide hands\-on technical support to teams designing, deploying, migrating, or troubleshooting data solutions. * Participate in threat modeling, secure design reviews, proof\-of\-concept evaluations, and technical risk assessments, identifying implementation risks and recommending practical control changes. * Create and maintain implementation guides, configuration standards, control mappings, runbooks, and operational procedures. * Participate in peer review and share practices that promote secure\-by\-design work across the enterprise data estate. **What we're looking for:** * Academic Degree(s) and/ areas of study: Bachelor's degree in information technology, computer science, information security or related discipline. Equivalent of experience in lieu of degree acceptable: Yes * Years of experience: 7\+ years of experience in information security, cloud engineering, database engineering, data engineering, or a related field, including 2\+ years focused on data protection or database security. * Professional Certification(s): none required. * Specialized knowledge: * The data protection lifecycle, including classification, encryption, key and secrets management, access and entitlement controls, monitoring, retention, and secure disposal. * Security capabilities of cloud data and analytics platforms and relational database platforms, including Azure SQL and SQL Server. * Azure identity, networking, storage, governance, and key management services, including relevant networking protocols and secure data\-access paths. * Regulatory, contractual, and policy requirements that apply to institutional data, such as \[FERPA, GLBA Safeguards Rule, PCI DSS, and applicable state breach notification laws]. * **Skills:** * Proficiency with SQL, including the ability to assess queries, permissions, schemas, and database security configurations. * Hands\-on implementation of classification, labeling, masking, data loss prevention (DLP), secure integration, monitoring, auditing, and logging controls in enterprise data environments. * Scripting and automation using platform APIs, infrastructure\-as\-code, or similar tooling to deploy and validate security controls. * Clear written and verbal communication with both technical and non\-technical audiences. \#LI\-Remote We believe real innovation comes from inclusion \- where different experiences, perspectives and talents are celebrated. So if you're wondering whether SNHU is right for you, take the leap and apply. You might be just the person we're looking for. If you have a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to fully engage in any part of the application or hiring process, please complete the Accommodation Request form or contact us at 603\-626\-9447\. A member from the Employee Accommodation Support Center will be in contact with you within two business days to discuss your request. **Compensation** The annual pay range for this position is $96,954\.00 \- $155,153\.00\. Actual offer will be based on skills, qualifications, experience and internal equity, in addition to relevant business considerations. We expect this position to be hired in the following target hiring range $107,132\.00 \- $144,945\.00\. **Exceptional benefits (because you’re exceptional)** You’re the whole package. Your benefits should be, too. As a full\-time employee at SNHU, you’ll get: * High\-quality, low\-deductible medical insurance * Low to no\-cost dental and vision plans * 5 weeks of paid time off (plus almost a dozen paid holidays) * Employer\-funded retirement * Free tuition program * Parental leave * Mental health and wellbeing resources

The contractor will own the runtime, access control, and deployment path that agents run on. Agents and MCP servers built by the team call internal APIs, Snowflake, and scientific applications on behalf of individual scientists, so the platform has to authenticate users through Entra ID, scope what each agent can reach, keep credentials out of agent code, and record what each agent did. In addition to the platform, the contractor will build MCP servers, agent skills, and other integrations as needed, and we expect the work to move between platform and integration as priorities shift. Areas of work: * **Agent runtime.** Stand up and operate the runtime that hosts agents and MCP servers, using Amazon Bedrock AgentCore or a comparable agent runtime, together with serverless (Lambda) and container (ECS or EKS) workloads. Define how a new agent or MCP server is packaged, deployed, versioned, and retired. * **Infrastructure as code.** Write and maintain the Terraform modules for the runtime, networking, gateways, and supporting services, so that a new environment, AWS account, or region is created from configuration. * **Gateway and access control.** Run the API gateway layer in front of agents and tools. Integrate Entra ID for user authentication, map Entra groups to the agents and tools each user can call, and implement token exchange so an agent calls downstream services with the requesting user’s permissions. * **Identity and secrets.** Design IAM roles and workload identity for agents and MCP servers, manage credentials for Snowflake and internal APIs through AWS Secrets Manager or equivalent, and automate rotation. * **CI/CD and observability.** Build the pipelines that test and deploy agents, MCP servers, and platform components. Instrument agent and tool calls with tracing, logs, and metrics so that latency, error rate, model usage, and cost can be reported per agent and per user group. * **MCP servers and integrations.** Build MCP servers and agent skills that connect agents to Snowflake, internal APIs, and scientific applications. Provide templates, a local development path, and documentation so that other teams can ship their own MCP servers and skills onto the platform without platform changes for each one. Key Responsibilities: * Develop and maintain production Python services, MCP servers, platform tooling, and CLI utilities. * Write and review Terraform for all platform infrastructure as part of daily workflow. * Deploy and operate agent, serverless, and container workloads across AWS accounts and environments. * Maintain the access\-control model for agents and tools and review new integrations for how they handle identity, secrets, and data scope. * Work directly with scientists, application developers, and IT security to decide what to build, and support adoption through documentation and hands\-on help. Qualifications: * Bachelor’s degree with 7–10 years of relevant experience, or a Master’s degree with 5 or more years of relevant experience. * Experience having built and run a shared internal platform used by other engineering teams, including its deployment path, support, and upgrades. * Strong AWS experience with both serverless (Lambda, API Gateway, Step Functions or similar) and container (ECS or EKS) workloads. * Experience with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore or a comparable agent runtime is strongly preferred. * Strong Terraform experience, including module design and multi\-account deployments. * Experience with API gateways and access control using Entra ID (Azure AD), including OAuth 2\.0 and OIDC flows. * Experience with cloud identity and secrets management: IAM, workload identity, Secrets Manager or Vault, and credential rotation. * Experience building CI/CD pipelines and observability for production services (tracing, structured logging, metrics, alerting). * Strong Python development skills with experience building production\-grade services or tooling. * Experience building LLM agents in production, including tool use, prompt and context design, and evaluation of agent behavior. * Experience building Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers or comparable tool integrations that let LLM agents call internal APIs and data sources. * Experience on a small team (roughly 3–10 engineers) where individuals own systems end to end, set their own priorities within a goal, and ship without a dedicated QA, SRE, or release function. * Routine use of agentic coding harnesses (Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex, or equivalent) as part of day\-to\-day development, with a view on where they help and where they do not. * Experience with Amazon Bedrock is a plus. * Experience with Snowflake or SQL\-based data access from services is a plus. * Experience in a life sciences, chemistry, or drug discovery environment is a plus. * Effective communicator who can work independently in a remote environment and collaborate with engineers, scientists, and IT security. Primary Location: United States (Remote — working hours within one to two hours of US Eastern preferred; West Coast considered) collaborate with both engineers and scientists. *Spectrix offers flexible schedules, competitive salaries, and a committed work environment to its employees; the company provides automatic benefits of life insurance and short and long term disability insurance. jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: **About the Role** Station 66 Networks is looking for a Data Engineer to build and maintain the systems that collect, process, and organise business data. You'll develop reliable data pipelines, manage data workflows, and help ensure that information is accurate, accessible, and ready for analysis. We're looking for someone who can approach technical problems methodically, write maintainable code, and take responsibility for the quality of data moving through our systems. You'll work with colleagues to understand data requirements, resolve pipeline issues, and improve the reliability of existing processes. **What You'll Do** * Build and maintain data pipelines that collect and transform information from different sources. * Develop data processing workflows that support reporting, analytics, and operational requirements. * Design and maintain databases, tables, and data models suited to business needs. * Validate incoming data and investigate missing, duplicated, or inconsistent records. * Monitor scheduled data jobs and troubleshoot pipeline failures. * Write and maintain scripts to automate data processing and routine maintenance tasks. * Improve the performance, reliability, and efficiency of data workflows. * Work with analysts, developers, and other stakeholders to understand data requirements. * Implement appropriate data quality checks and document validation procedures. * Maintain clear technical documentation covering data sources, transformations, dependencies, and pipeline operations. * Support data access controls and follow appropriate security and privacy practices. * Test changes before deployment and verify that data outputs meet expected requirements. * Identify recurring technical issues and recommend practical improvements. **What You'll Bring** * Experience in data engineering, database development, data integration, or a related technical role. * Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases. * Programming or scripting skills in Python or another suitable language. * Understanding of data pipelines, data transformation, and ETL or ELT processes. * Ability to investigate data quality issues and identify their underlying causes. * Familiarity with data modelling and database performance optimisation. * Understanding of version control, testing, and documented development practices. * Knowledge of cloud data platforms or data processing services is an advantage. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills. * Attention to detail when validating data and reviewing code. * Clear communication skills and the ability to work with technical and non\-technical colleagues. **What We Expect** We expect data to be checked carefully, code to be tested, and technical issues to be reported honestly. When a pipeline fails or a source produces unexpected results, you should investigate the cause, document your findings, and communicate the impact to the people who depend on that data. You'll also be expected to keep your work organised, follow agreed development practices, and look for practical ways to improve data quality and system reliability. We value engineers who take ownership of problems and explain technical limitations clearly rather than making assumptions about results. **Working Schedule** This is a full\-time position with a standard Monday–Friday schedule from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM. The work location was not specified in the information provided. **How to Apply** Submit your Resume highlighting your experience with data pipelines, SQL, programming, databases, and data transformation. Include examples of relevant projects, the technologies you used, and how you addressed data quality or processing challenges. **EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY** Station 66 Networks considers applicants based on relevant skills, experience, and qualifications, in accordance with applicable employment laws. Pay: $125,000\.00 \- $130,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Employee assistance program * Health insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Software Engineer II – Enterprise Application Development

What You'll Do: * Design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and support enterprise applications. * Analyze complex technical and business problems and develop effective solutions. * Work with business analysts, stakeholders, and technical team members to understand requirements and business processes. * Contribute to technical designs and application architecture. * Develop and support RESTful APIs, backend services, and system integrations. * Participate in peer code reviews and collaborative development practices. * Troubleshoot production issues, identify root causes, and implement lasting solutions. * Improve application performance, reliability, maintainability, and security. * Identify opportunities to automate, simplify, and improve applications and business processes. * Stay current with emerging technologies and contribute ideas that improve how we build and support software. What Sets You Apart: * A self\-starter who takes ownership and moves work forward without constant direction. * Naturally curious about how systems, technology, and the business behind them work. * An engaged contributor who brings ideas, asks questions, and looks for better ways to solve problems. * Comfortable working through unfamiliar problems and picking up new technologies. * Able to respectfully challenge existing approaches and contribute to technical decisions. * A strong communicator who works effectively with both technical and non\-technical people. * Takes pride in building quality software and improving the systems and processes around it. Required Qualifications: * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent education and experience. * 3–5 years of professional software development experience. * Strong understanding of software development fundamentals and strongly typed programming languages such as C\#, Java, Kotlin, or similar. * Proficiency with SQL and relational databases. * Professional experience developing or consuming RESTful APIs. * Proficiency working with Linux\-based containers and containerized applications. * Solid understanding of container orchestration concepts. * Experience with source control, code reviews, testing, debugging, and modern software development practices. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and collaboration skills. Preferred Qualifications: * C\# / .NET * Spring Boot * Kotlin * SQL Server * PostgreSQL * Docker * Linux / Ubuntu * Azure DevOps and Azure Pipelines * CI/CD practices * Microservices architecture * Automated testing * AI\-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Cursor, or similar Our Technology Our development environment includes: .NET \| Spring Boot \| Kotlin \| SQL Server \| PostgreSQL \| RESTful APIs \| Docker \| Azure DevOps \| Azure Pipelines \| Git \| Linux/Ubuntu You won't need experience with every technology listed. We value strong engineering fundamentals, adaptability, and the ability to learn. Our containerized environment is continuing to evolve, with container orchestration part of our longer\-term technology roadmap. Benefits: * Starting Pay: $85,000 \- $100,000/year salary. * 100% company paid retirement\- Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP). * Health, Vision \& Dental benefit package. * YMCA discount program. * Monday \- Friday (in office). As you grow into the role, you'll take on rotating after\-hours on\-call support. Why Join Us? You'll work on software that matters to the business, alongside a team that values collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement. You'll work across a diverse technology landscape, learn how a complex retail organization operates, and help shape the future of our applications. If you're curious, engaged, and want to build more than just software, we'd like to meet you. To help provide our employees with a safe work environment, we are a drug free workplace.

jobs.title: AI/ML Engineer
jobs.description: **About You** ------------- We’re seeking a senior technical leader whose background combines substantial AI/ML research expertise with hands\-on engineering experience. You’ll help shape the architecture and technical direction of our intelligent systems. The remit extends beyond implementation as an individual contributor: you’ll uncover unanswered questions, develop experiments to investigate them, and take ownership of AI development from initial research through production. Your experience should combine research depth, typically gained through a PhD or equivalent industry research, with substantial work making AI systems dependable on complex, real\-world production data. You’ve created evaluation frameworks, investigated LLM failure modes, and learned to distinguish impressive benchmark results from meaningful evidence of reliability. You bring informed perspectives on measuring AI performance and deploying systems safely in environments where the consequences matter. AI is central to both our products and our working practices. Across research, engineering, and operations, we make extensive use of AI tools to accelerate execution and support clearer thinking. Everyone is expected to adopt this approach. At a senior level, that means demonstrating how AI can amplify informed judgment without replacing it. Healthcare offers both extensive data and significant responsibility. We’re looking for someone who understands the importance of both. **Your Responsibilities** ------------------------- ### **AI Strategy \& Research** * Own the technical strategy for AI/ML across our clinical intelligence products, covering information extraction, summarization, reasoning, and retrieval. Carry that strategy through to implementation. * Assess weaknesses in existing systems, including inconsistent performance, missing coverage, and evaluation methods that overlook failures encountered in practice. * Follow developments in LLMs, clinical NLP, retrieval\-augmented generation, RLHF/RLAIF, agents, and structured prediction, bringing relevant advances into production. * Establish how we evaluate and benchmark models, prioritizing measures relevant to patient care rather than metrics selected simply because they are straightforward to collect. ### **Production Systems \& Engineering** * Develop and enhance production pipelines for clinical entity extraction, summarization, chart abstraction, and structured inference from unstructured clinical text. * Shape and refine our use of RAG, prompt engineering, fine\-tuning, and model selection, applying rigorous evaluation throughout. * Oversee secure AI deployment that complies with HIPAA and SOC 2, focusing on accuracy, auditability, and the risks associated with hallucinations. ### **Technical Leadership \& Collaboration** * Provide technical guidance on AI decisions, helping the team determine which approaches to explore, diagnose problems, and assess whether models are ready for release. * Partner directly with clinical subject matter experts to understand how outputs support clinical workflows, where they fall short, and how quality should be defined in practice. * Mentor engineers and strengthen the team’s understanding of AI/ML best practices, including effective use of AI tools in everyday technical work. **Required Experience \& Skills** --------------------------------- ### **Essential Requirements** * Substantial expertise in modern AI/ML, LLMs, NLP, information extraction, or a closely related discipline, supported by direct work with leading approaches rather than theoretical familiarity alone. * A PhD in ML, NLP, computer science, or a related discipline, OR comparable research depth evidenced by publications, substantial open\-source contributions, or impactful AI work in industry. * Experience creating and owning evaluation frameworks, including defining what to measure, accounting for Goodhart’s Law, and identifying regressions, rather than only executing existing evaluations. * Demonstrated experience progressing AI systems from research or prototypes into dependable production deployments, with a clear understanding of their limitations and the causes of failure. * At least 8 years of software engineering experience, predominantly focused on AI/ML systems. ### **Technical Expertise** * Fluency in Python, either PyTorch or JAX, and the core ML tooling used for training, fine\-tuning, inference, and quantization. * Practical experience working with LLMs through prompting strategies, RAG architectures, RLHF/preference tuning, instruction tuning, or model distillation. * Strong data capabilities spanning SQL, pipeline design, annotation tools, and dataset curation, alongside an understanding that data quality underpins much of AI performance. * Experience using NLP libraries such as Hugging Face and spaCy, together with production model\-serving infrastructure such as vLLM, TGI, or equivalent tools. * Skilled use of AI\-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or similar. You actively guide and scrutinize these tools rather than accepting their responses without challenge. You understand when to explore further, when to reject an output, and how to organize tasks to obtain useful results without overlooking subtle errors. ### **Working Approach** * An AI\-first approach grounded in practical understanding of where AI provides meaningful benefits and where it does not. This should be reflected in your coding, research, and daily problem\-solving. * The judgment to recognize when a model should not be released, balanced with the pragmatism to deploy imperfect systems where risks are understood and contained. * Comfort navigating open\-ended research questions, combined with the discipline needed to turn uncertain findings into production systems. * Genuine interest in the clinical domain and recognition of the responsibility involved in developing high\-stakes AI. ### **Additional Experience** * Familiarity with clinical NLP, healthcare data standards such as HL7 and FHIR, ICD/CPT coding, or previous healthcare AI work. * Experience in structured prediction, building medical knowledge graphs, or extracting information from clinical data. * Publications or applied research contributions covering NLP, LLMs, clinical AI, or evaluation methods. **Technology Environment** -------------------------- Python · PyTorch · Hugging Face · PostgreSQL · BigQuery · dbt · FastAPI · Google Cloud Platform · LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.) · Jupyter / Streamlit

Kubernetes operators and Helm charts is a plus. * Knowledge of container orchestration on\-premises using K8s or similar technologies is a plus. * Experience with DevOps best practices and infrastructure as code (Terraform, Ansible) is a plus. **Benefits** **Benefits Summary:** * **Medical:** Several plan options including PPO and HSA\-compatible plans from Anthem Blue Cross, most of jobs.title: Forward Deployed Accountant / Tax Technologist
jobs.description: We’re looking for a customer\-embedded tax professional who can turn TaxGPT into production\-ready workflows inside accounting firms: someone who speaks fluent tax, redesigns how work gets done, and feeds what they learn straight back into product. Remote (US) Full time We’re looking for a customer\-embedded tax professional who can turn TaxGPT into production\-ready workflows inside accounting firms: someone who speaks fluent tax, redesigns how work gets done, and feeds what they learn straight back into product. Remote (US) · Travel Required (Approximately 30–40%) · Full Time · Base Pay $100,000 to $120,000 \+ Variable Compensation $20,000 to $24,000 (20%) **About the Role** ------------------ TaxGPT is building the intelligence layer for tax. We’ve partnered with over 5,000 firms and 6,000\+ businesses, from lean CPA firms to global enterprises, to redefine how professionals research, collaborate, and execute tax workflows using AI. Recently named one of Business Insider’s 30 Early\-Stage Startups Most Likely to Become Tech’s Next Unicorns, we’re scaling the operating system for tax, accounting, and advisory firms. You will join as a founding Forward Deployed Accountant / Tax Technologist, our version of the forward\-deployed role pioneered in AI companies, adapted for tax and accounting. You will embed with TaxGPT customers (CPA firms, tax practices, and finance teams), map how work actually moves through the firm, configure and operationalize TaxGPT against those workflows, train teams to adopt, and surface field patterns that shape our product roadmap. This is not a pure software engineering role, and it is not classic customer success. You bring accounting and tax judgment into the room, redesign workflows with AI in the loop, and close the gap between what the product can do and what the firm needs done during research, prep, review, planning, and client delivery. You move quickly from discovery to durable playbooks, under tight feedback loops with real users and real client work. If you thrive in ambiguity, earn trust with partners and preparers alike, and want to help write how tax firms adopt AI, this is for you. ### **What You’ll Do** * Embed with TaxGPT customers to map tax and accounting workflows, de\-risk constraints (process, systems, seasonality, risk), and define crisp success metrics for each deployment. Design pilot* operationalize AI\-powered tax workflows: configure TaxGPT around firm processes for research, document analysis, prep support, review, memos, planning, and client work, then harden those workflows so they hold up in busy season. * Lead implementation and change: run kickoffs, build rollout plans, train partners, managers, preparers, and ops staff, and hand off durable playbooks and champions so wins scale beyond one engagement. * Work inside the product with customers: diagnose where a workflow breaks, find practical workarounds, stay on the problem until the firm can run it confidently day to day. * Partner with sales, success, and product on high\-value accounts: support complex activations, prove ROI (time saved, quality lifted, capacity unlocked), and help turn strong deployments into deeper adoption and expansion. * Surface field patterns (recurring prompts, failure modes, edge cases, training gaps, and missing capabilities) and feed them into TaxGPT’s product and engineering roadmap with concrete, reproducible examples. * Build the forward\-deployed playbook for TaxGPT: templates, evals of real tax tasks, onboarding kits, and implementation patterns that make the next firm faster than the last. * Travel to customer offices and industry events when in\-person presence will improve the work; join periodic company gatherings at our San Francisco headquarters. ### **What You’ll Need** * 3\+ years in public accounting, tax (prep, review, planning, consulting or compliance), firm operations, client accounting services, or a closely related role, ideally inside a CPA firm or tax practice. * Deep fluency in how accounting firms operate; you can speak credibly with a managing partner, a tax manager, a preparer, and an ops lead in the same week. * Proven ability to teach and drive change: you explain a new workflow plainly, notice when someone is lost, and adjust without making them feel behind. * Comfort getting into the details of returns, research memos, document packages, review notes, and busy\-season bottlenecks, and using judgment to redesign them with AI. * Strong bias for action under ambiguity: you scope open\-ended problems, ship a workable process fast, measure what matters, and iterate with real users. * Technical fluency with modern AI tools and tax/accounting software, not as a software engineer, but as someone who can configure products, learn systems quickly, and collaborate with product and engineering. * Clear, concise communication; low\-ego collaboration; appetite for pairing in person with customers and teammates. * Willingness to travel as customer work requires (typically periodic onsite visits and industry events). ### **Nice\-to\-Haves** * Active CPA, EA, or progress toward one; MST or strong tax specialization is a plus. * Experience implementing tax or accounting software (e.g., CCH Axcess, Thomson Reuters, Lacerte, UltraTax, Drake, practice\-management or document systems). * Prior role in tax technology, firm transformation, AI enablement, professional\-services implementation, or solutions consulting. * Early\-stage startup experience, or a track record of building the playbook while doing the work. * Familiarity with how AI copilots, retrieval workflows, and prompt/eval loops show up in professional services (you don’t need to build the models; you need to make them useful in tax work). * Experience leading training programs, change management, or process improvement inside a firm. ### **How We Define Success in This Role** A strong Forward Deployed Accountant / Tax Technologist: * Takes firms from signed contract (or strategic expansion) to confident, repeatable daily use of TaxGPT in live client work. * Leaves behind playbooks and champions, not one\-off heroics, so adoption survives busy season and staff turnover. * Turns messy, firm\-specific workflows into patterns that product and engineering can ship for the next hundred firms. * Earns trust as the tax\-domain voice of the customer inside TaxGPT, and as the TaxGPT expert inside the firm. * Measures outcomes that matter to partners: hours saved, review cycles shortened, capacity unlocked, risk reduced, and quality maintained or improved. ### **What We Offer** **Compensation:** Competitive base salary plus equity (range to be confirmed for this role) **Benefits:** Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision; 401(k) with match; life insurance; equity **Remote\-first:** Work from anywhere in the U.S., with customer travel as needed and occasional time at our San Francisco headquarters **Ownership \& impact:** Direct visibility into leadership, product strategy, and how thousands of firms adopt AI tax workflows **Growth:** High\-impact founding seat on a forward\-deployed function you help define **Culture:** We’re a high\-trust, high\-output team. Expect fast feedback loops, real ownership, and cross\-functional collaboration ### **Interview Process (indicative)** #### **Step 1: Quick Screen** Apply online and we’ll review your background quickly. #### **Step 2: Domain \& Workflow Deep Dive** Walk through how you’ve owned tax or firm workflows end to end (prep/review, planning, ops, or implementation) and how you’d approach embedding TaxGPT in a real firm. #### **Step 3: Virtual Interview(s)** Meet the hiring team to dig into customer\-facing judgment, change management, and how you partner with product. #### **Step 4: Leadership Interview** Meet with leadership (including CRO / founders as appropriate) on TaxGPT’s mission, the forward\-deployed charter, and the impact you could make. #### **Timeline** We aim to move quickly and keep candidates informed throughout the process.

You will measure uptime and availability against SLAs, time\-to\-detect, diagnostic coverage, and cost. and the programs and parts organizations so every detection flows into the right action with the right part, place, capability, and time * Set the engineering bar for architecture, software development lifecycle, data quality and governance, reliability, and on\-call — staying hands\-on enough to review modeling approaches * Represent Service Engineering's intelligence and analytics strategy to leadership and cross\-functional partners like firmware, platform engineering, product management, devOps, finance, design engineering, and myriad other software groups **What You'll Contribute to SLO definition and MTTR reduction efforts across the platform. * Collaboration \& Communication: * + Work closely with product managers, tech leads, and other engineers to deliver reliable, maintainable, and scalable solutions. Communicate technical decisions clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. **Requirements** What You Will Bring**Required Skills** * Strong proficiency in backend service development using C\#/.NET. * Strong proficiency in TypeScript and React for front\-end UI. * Experience building and operating software in both on\-premises/customer\-hosted environments and cloud\-native multi\-tenant environments, with an understanding of how debugging, deployment, and scaling differ between the two. * Hands\-on experience with AWS DynamoDB, RDS, SQS (or an equivalent cloud provider) in production environments. * Experience with microservices patterns (service discovery, API gateway, messaging/queueing, data partitioning). * Experience with automated testing at multiple levels. * AWS best practices. * Familiarity with observability tooling and practices (OpenTelemetry, structured logging, distributed tracing, metrics\-based alerting) to support proactive issue detection. Chromeleon, Cytiva UNICORN, Agilent OpenLab, along with knowledge of instrument integration pattern and practices is a strong plus. **Soft Skills Needed:** * Excellent verbal and written communication. * Strong collaboration skills in cross\-functional teams. * Analytical mindset with high attention to detail. **Why TetraScience*** Mission\-driven: your infrastructure directly enables scientific drug development processes that save and extend lives. * Builder culture: everyone ships — engineers, managers, and leadership. When you join our team, you’ll be part of a special collection of problem solvers, thought leaders, and innovators. Join us and take your place in space. The Digital Innovation Division (DID) is accountable for generating and executing integrated strategies, providing governance, and managing internal investments that form the foundation of Aerospace’s digital transformation. The Digital Innovation Division is seeking Senior Project Engineers to serve as technical project leads for initiatives within the corporate AI portfolio, reporting to the Director, AI Systems and Delivery. Each lead owns one initiative end to end: its technical approach, its requirements and architecture, its cost and schedule, and the working relationships with the engineers and subject matter experts whose work the capability depends on. jobs.description: The Director, AI Enablement \& Legal Engineering will partner with attorneys, business partners and technology teams to redesign legal workflows, implement technology\-enabled solutions, and create scalable ways of working that improve how legal services are delivered across Legal \& Global Affairs. As a key member of the LIFT team, this role will focus on AI\-enabled process engineering, workflow modernization, automation, knowledge enablement, and practical adoption of new tools and ways of working. The role will help translate legal practice needs into repeatable processes, operating models, and solutions that improve efficiency, consistency, scalability, and business impact. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== **Architect and Deploy AI Solutions** ------------------------------------- * Keeps legal data accurate, well\-organized, and responsibly used, treating it as the foundation AI capability is built on and improves alongside * Design end\-to\-end AI solutions, using LLMs, retrieval\-augmented generation, and agentic frameworks, for contract review, legal research, regulatory analysis, and compliance workflows. Build \& enhance the underlying document processing pipelines, including intake, parsing, chunking, embedding, and indexing, that turn contracts, playbooks, and regulatory filings into a system that supports fast, intelligent search and analysis * Hands\-on experience using AI\-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot to build and ship production solutions faster. * Establish testing, validation, and quality control practices so AI\-enabled legal work meets LGA's standards for accuracy and reliability. **Own Vendor and Technology Stack Strategy** -------------------------------------------- * Evaluate and influence the legal technology portfolio, including build\-versus\-buy decisions across platforms and specialized providers. * Track and report the return on investment of AI usage across the department to guide where further investment makes sense. * Assess external platforms, many of which already run on comparable AI capability, against the case for building in\-house and vice\-versa. Platform and build decisions should be made with a view toward where AI in Legal is heading, not just its current state. **Build AI Fluency and Legal Engineering Capability** ----------------------------------------------------- * Design enablement programs calibrated to where each practice area sits on the AI maturity curve, rather than a single training path for everyone. * Coach and develop talent toward legal engineering skills and help expand the existing network of AI\-advanced colleagues across practice areas. * Measure adoption and effectiveness to guide where further investment in tools or training makes sense. **Partner Across Senior Leadership** ------------------------------------ * Act as a trusted advisor to senior LGA leaders and cross\-functional partners in Technology, Finance, and HR on AI strategy and priorities. * Translate technical capability into practical, business\-relevant recommendations for non\-technical stakeholders. * Navigate a matrixed organization and competing priorities to keep initiatives moving. **Lead with a Service Mindset** ------------------------------- * Keep attorneys' and paralegals' daily experience at the center of every solution, so tools solve real friction rather than add process. * Stay responsive and available to legal teams as they adopt new workflows and tools. * Build trust through consistent follow\-through, not just technical delivery. **Qualifications** ================== **Required** ------------ * Juris Doctor from an accredited law school and licensed attorney in good standing. * 10\+ years of experience in legal practice, legal operations, legal technology, consulting, transformation, or related fields. * Demonstrated experience improving legal workflows, processes, service delivery, or operational effectiveness. * Strong understanding of legal processes, process redesign, legal technology, knowledge management, automation, and workflow tools. * Experience with AI\-enabled solutions, legal technology implementation, workflow platforms, or innovation initiatives. * Ability to influence and partner effectively with attorneys, senior legal leaders, technology teams, and business stakeholders. **Preferr****ed** ----------------- * Experience in Legal Operations, legal transformation, legal innovation, consulting, or legal technology organizations. * Expertise in process engineering, workflow design, Lean, Six Sigma, design thinking, product management, or related methodologies. * Experience with contract lifecycle management, matter management, legal intake, knowledge management, document automation, or workflow automation platforms. * Experience helping legal teams adopt AI\-enabled solutions, automation, or In this role, you will build scalable solutions that support Marvel Comics' Publishing Apps and Workflows, as well as innovative new products. jobs.title: Senior Manager, AI & Machine Learning Engineering
jobs.description: **Department Description:** At Disney, we’re storytellers. We make the impossible, possible. The Walt Disney Company (TWDC) is a world\-class entertainment and technological leader. Walt’s passion was to continuously envision new ways to move audiences around the world—a passion that remains our touchstone in an enterprise that stretches from theme parks, resorts and a cruise line to sports, news, movies and a variety of other businesses. Uniting each endeavor is a commitment to creating and delivering unforgettable experiences — and we’re constantly looking for new ways to enhance these exciting experiences. The Enterprise Technology mission is to deliver technology solutions that align to business strategies while enabling enterprise efficiency and promoting cross\-company collaborative innovation. Our group drives competitive advantage by enhancing our consumer experiences, enabling business growth, and advancing operational excellence. **Team Description:** We are the Finance Engineering \& AI team, and we exist to be Finance's technical partner — for FP\&A, Payroll, Controllership, and Tax \& Treasury alike — turning business process needs into working software and intelligent automation. Our AI Platform team designs and builds the intelligent automation layer that streamlines and scales finance workflows, while our Business Process Applications team owns and operates the core systems finance relies on every day. Together, we combine deep finance domain expertise with custom engineering to give Finance both a stable operational backbone and a path toward an increasingly automated future. **What You’ll Do:** Disney Financial Insights (D\-Fi) is a new platform reimagining how Finance teams and budget owners across Disney interact with financial data — replacing manual pulls, static reports, and email\-driven approvals with one AI\-powered, orchestrated experience built on top of Disney financial systems. We're hiring a Senior Manager, AI \& Machine Learning, as the founding engineering leader for this AI framework: a hands\-on manager and technical lead who will build and run a global engineering team based in Buenos Aires AR, delivering the AI/ML layer, the intelligent data foundation, software workflows/orchestration, and natural\-language experience that sits at the center of D\-Fi. This is a build\-from\-scratch mandate — you'll be shaping team structure, engineering practices, and technical architecture from an early stage (MVP in progress), not inheriting a mature system. This role is the primary technical point of contact for finance stakeholders \& cross\-functional partners and is accountable for translating the platform roadmap into a shipped, governed, production\-grade system. As the **Senior Manager, AI \& Machine Learning,** you'll be setting architecture, reviewing design decisions, and staying hands\-on enough to credibly evaluate trade\-offs your team brings you. This role is also expected to be hands\-on — stepping in on implementation, unblocking technical issues in real time, and reviewing code with the depth that comes from doing the work yourself, not just overseeing it. * **Own technical direction end\-to\-end.** Set architecture and technical strategy for the AI/ML and data layers underpinning D\-Fi, ensuring every capability — variance analysis, scenario modeling, the natural\-language experience — is built on a governed, semantic data foundation rather than one\-off pipelines. * **Be the stakeholder\-facing technical lead.** Act as the primary engineering liaison to finance business partners and leadership — translating challenging business needs into a scoped, buildable technical roadmap, and representing engineering trade\-offs credibly to technical and non\-technical partners and leaders. * **Own the AI/LLM roadmap.** This is the highest\-visibility and most sensitive capability on the platform — you'll guide its direction end\-to\-end to build and maintain trust in AI\-generated financial answers. * **Enforce governance by design.** Ensure role\-based access control (RBAC) is enforced at the data model level — not the application level — across all personas (Finance, Budget Owners, and any future personas), so speed and automation never come at the cost of data governance. * **Set the bar for engineering quality and delivery.** Establish practices for code review, testing, model evaluation, and release management across a geo diverse team and multiple disciplines. * **Own the build vs. integrate decisions.** Guide when the team builds custom capability versus integrates with existing systems (SAP, Cognos, EPM, Data Marketplace, NetDocs, Coupa, Clarity) * **Champion adoption broadly.** Partner with the business finance transformation leads on driving adoption across the enterprise — both finance workers and budget owners. **Required Qualifications \& Skills:** * 10\+ years of software and/or ML engineering leadership experience, with a strong track record of owning technical direction and architecture for complex systems end\-to\-end. * Demonstrated experience architecting and shipping production LLM/AI applications — not just prototypes. * Production experience with LLM application architecture — RAG pipelines, prompt engineering, and context/retrieval design at scale * Working knowledge of LLM orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, or equivalent) and vector databases/retrieval stores (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector, or Snowflake Cortex Search) * Strong data modeling background, ideally including semantic/governed data layers (not just raw pipelines) * Ability to read, write and review Python code * Working knowledge of modern web/full\-stack language or framework sufficient to guide UI\-layer architecture decisions * Familiarity with MLOps practices — model monitoring, retraining pipeline design, containerization, and CI/CD for ML systems * Experience working across distributed, cross\-timezone engineering teams, with the judgment to know what belongs in synchronous vs. asynchronous workflows. * Comfort operating as the primary technical voice in front of senior business stakeholders — able to translate finance/business problems into technical scope, and technical trade\-offs into business language. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Background building internal tools for finance organizations is a plus, but not required — genuine curiosity about the domain is. * Exposure to ERP/EPM platforms such as SAP, Oracle EPM, or Cognos, and/or experience integrating custom applications against enterprise system APIs * Experience working alongside or evaluating third\-party/consulting\-delivered engineering work, with the judgment to assess technical quality and architectural fit quickly **Required Education:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field; advanced degree a plus but not required given equivalent experience. \#TECHATDISNEY . jobs.title: Systems Engineer
jobs.description: **Who are we:** We’re a leading Northeast family\-owned food, agricultural products, and agricultural services organization headquartered in Pennsylvania. We provide animal nutrition and feeds; specialty protein production, processing, and marketing; on\-farm protein production services; and grain, fertilizer, and ingredient procurement. We’re a stable company with strong core values, great benefits, competitive wage structure, and a safe and healthy work environment. With over 850 team members, we're a growing company in an essential sector – agriculture! Learn more here: https://www.thewengergroup.com **What your day looks like:** **POSITION SUMMARY:** The Systems Engineer is responsible for the design, administration, reliability, security, and continuous improvement of the organization's enterprise infrastructure across corporate, manufacturing, and remote locations. The role provides hands\-on ownership of on\-premises virtualization, Microsoft Azure infrastructure services, enterprise backup and disaster recovery, storage platforms, Windows Server, and related core services. This position serves as a senior technical escalation point and project resource, helping ensure that business\-critical systems are resilient, recoverable, scalable, well documented, and aligned with operational and security requirements. The Systems Engineer balances day\-to\-day operational support with lifecycle planning, modernization, automation, and infrastructure project delivery. **ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:** * Design, implement, and maintain enterprise IT infrastructure, including physical and virtualized servers, cloud platforms, and storage solutions. * Develop and optimize hybrid cloud strategies (AWS, Azure, on\-premises) to ensure scalability, security, and cost efficiency. * Define system security architectures, including access controls, identity management, and compliance with best practices (NIST, ISO 27001, SOC 2\). * Evaluate and integrate emerging technologies such as AI\-driven automation, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible). * Manage Windows Server and Linux environments, ensuring high availability, performance, and security. * Administer and optimize virtualization platforms (VMware vSphere, Hyper\-V, Nutanix) for compute efficiency and workload distribution. * Implement backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity plans to mitigate risks and ensure uptime. * Optimize enterprise storage solutions (SAN, NAS, cloud storage) to support business applications and data growth. * Lead cloud migrations and optimization initiatives, ensuring a seamless transition to AWS, Azure, or hybrid cloud solutions. * Automate system deployments and configurations using PowerShell, Ansible, Terraform, or Python. * Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure automation and self\-healing systems. * Integrate cloud\-native security controls such as AWS IAM, Azure Security Center, and cloud SIEM solutions. * Implement and enforce system security best practices, including patch management, hardening, and monitoring. * Work closely with cybersecurity teams to mitigate risks, enforce Zero Trust security models, and comply with industry regulations. * Configure and maintain identity and access management (IAM) solutions, including Active Directory, SSO, MFA, and role\-based access controls. * Implement secure configurations and audit controls to support SOC 2, HIPAA, NIST, and ISO 27001 compliance. * Act as an escalation point for critical system incidents, ensuring rapid diagnosis and resolution. * Provide Tier 3 support for IT operations, troubleshooting hardware, software, and network\-related system issues. * Conduct root cause analysis for significant incidents and implement corrective measures to prevent recurrence. * Maintain detailed system documentation, including architecture diagrams, standard operating procedures, and incident reports. * Work closely with IT leadership, security teams, developers, and business units to align system strategies with company objectives. * Provide mentorship and training to junior engineers and IT support staff. * Lead IT infrastructure projects, including new office setups, cloud migrations, and security improvements. * Build relationships with vendors and service providers to ensure cost\-effective, high\-quality solutions. **EDUCATION \& EXPERIENCE:** **Education \& Certifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer In this role, you'll work closely with cross\-functional teams to build modern data pipelines, develop scalable solutions, and help clients unlock insights from their data. You’ll be supported by experienced architects and consultants while having the opportunity to grow your technical and consulting skills in a collaborative, client\-facing environment. **What You'll Do** * Develop ETL/ELT processes to transform and prepare raw data for reporting, analytics, and downstream applications * Collaborate with team members and clients to gather requirements, integrate data sources, and ensure high data quality * Build and maintain scalable, reliable data pipelines using tools like Azure Data Factory, AWS Glue, or Palantir Foundry * Assist in the development and optimization of data models and cloud\-based data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks, Redshift) * Support the creation of dashboards and data visualizations using tools like Power BI or Tableau * Participate in testing, documentation, and deployment of data solutions to ensure performance and reliability * Engage in project workstreams alongside more senior team members, gaining exposure to client interaction and delivery best practices ### **Who You'll Work With** * A team of collaborative, experienced consultants focused on solving complex business problems through data * Clients across industries who are looking to modernize their data platforms and make more informed decisions * Colleagues who prioritize curiosity, humility, and hands\-on problem\-solving A supportive environment where ongoing learning and mentorship are central to your professional growth ### **What You'll Bring** * 1\-5 years of professional experience in data engineering, analytics, or a related technical role * Proficiency in SQL and working knowledge of Python or another scripting language * Hands\-on experience with ETL/ELT processes and modern data tools such as Azure Data Factory, AWS Glue, Snowflake, or Databricks * Familiarity with cloud environments (AWS, Azure, Palantir Foundry or similar) and data modeling concepts * Understanding of data integration, quality, and performance tuning principles * Ability to work collaboratively on fast\-paced projects with a mix of technical and non\-technical stakeholders * Strong problem\-solving and communication skills * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field * Ability to legally work for any employer in the US without sponsorship **Bonus Points If You Have*** Experience with tools like Apache Airflow, dbt, or Palantir Foundry * Familiarity with big data technologies such as Spark, Kafka, or Redshift * Exposure to dashboarding and visualization tools like Power BI or Tableau * Certifications in cloud platforms or data engineeringtechnologies * Previous consulting firm experience ### **Why Thought Logic** * Work on transformations that matter, not slide decks that sit on shelves * Real responsibility and ownership over how work gets delivered and how clients experience us * Direct access to firm leadership and influence over how we grow and evolve * A culture that values depth over optics, outcomes over activity, and people over process * The chance to grow your career in a firm that's scaling thoughtfully and intentionally, not just chasing growth for growth's sake * The opportunity to flex in a continuous learner environment. Get access and exposure to the latest tools, technologies and trends in the data and AI space ### **About Thought Logic Consulting** At Thought Logic, we believe consulting should work differently. Since our founding, we’ve been on a mission to challenge the expected by bringing together the strategic depth of Big 4 experience with the personalized attention and agility you won’t find at traditional firms. We’re a functionally\-led, digitally enabled consultancy that exists at the intersection of business transformation and technology innovation. What sets us apart isn’t just what we do—it’s how we do it. We work side by side with Fortune 500 teams as player\-coaches, building lasting capability while delivering measurable outcomes. From our roots in Atlanta to our delivery across the country, we’ve grown by staying true to one simple principle: our clients’ success is our success. Thought Logic is an equal opportunity employer. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind and provide equal employment opportunities without regard to: race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Thought Logic conforms to both the spirit and letter of all applicable employment laws and regulations.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer – Back End
jobs.description: * **SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER – BACK END** **About Tillster** Headquartered in the USA, Tillster is the global leader in digital ordering and customer engagement solutions. For over a decade we have developed revolutionary self\-service, ordering and payments solutions – for mobile, tablet, online, kiosk, call center, and more – creating personalized interactions based on consumer preferences, language, and currency. Our platform is compatible with 15\+ unique POS systems, representing over 90% coverage in multi\-unit restaurants. We offer one platform: one scalable, enterprise class solution – to create world\-class digital engagement solutions. Our mission and passion are one in the same: Empower restaurants and consumers to engage and transact anywhere, anytime, and from any device \- one consumer at a time, one order at a time, billions of times over. In doing so, together we are transforming e\-commerce in restaurants and making the till grow for Tillster and our customers. **Are you a passionate Software Engineer with a knack for designing and developing quality software solutions? Tillster is the place for you—we are seeking an experienced Software Engineer.** **About the Role** As a Senior Software Engineer (SSWE), **BACK END** you will play a pivotal role in designing, developing, and maintaining our cloud\-based microservices. You will collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams to deliver high\-quality software solutions that meet business needs while following best practices, including design patterns, architectural patterns, thorough testing methodologies, **and modern AI developer tools to accelerate quality software delivery.** You will contribute to fostering an agile, collaborative, and high\-performing development environment. **What You'll Do** + Building highly scalable, secure, and high\-performance microservices using AWS and TypeScript. Apply key software engineering principles, design patterns, and architectural best practices. + Leverage state\-of\-the\-art AI developer tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, LLM reasoning models) to accelerate context gathering, boilerplating, test generation, and code refactoring. + Build and maintain microservices that communicate via well\-defined APIs, ensuring service modularity and scalability. + Implement robust unit tests, integration tests, and end\-to\-end tests to ensure high\-quality code. Work towards achieving high test coverage and adopting test\-driven development (TDD) where applicable. + Actively participate in Agile ceremonies (Scrum or Kanban) such as daily stand\-ups, sprint planning, retrospectives, and backlog refinement. Contribute to sprint goals and collaborate effectively with the team. + Conduct and participate in code reviews, ensuring adherence to coding standards, best practices, maintainability, and critically evaluating AI\-generated code outputs for security and correctness. + Participate in design sessions to help improve the overall architecture of the platform. + Work with stakeholders and product owners to understand requirements and come up with solutions. + Continuous learning: Tillster provides access to learning courses where you can beef up your skills in different areas as needed.**About You** + 5\+ years’ experience in design and development of service\-oriented Java, Python, C\#, Typescript (or any modern language) applications. + Experience in designing and building microservice\-based systems, ensuring high cohesion and loose coupling. + Languages: Any modern OOP language will do, but Typescript is preferred. + Comfortable integrating AI tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, ChatGPT/Claude) into your daily workflow to boost engineering velocity while maintaining deep critical code validation. + Experience implementing comprehensive testing strategies including unit tests, integration tests, and end\-to\-end tests. + Experience with relational or NoSQL data stores. + Expertise in applying industry\-standard design patterns and architectural patterns. + Ability to communicate effectively in English, with good verbal and written skills. + Experience working in an Agile environment (Scrum or Kanban), contributing to team\-driven development processes. + Understanding of security best practices in software development, including OAuth, JWT, encryption, etc. + Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science (or similar) or equivalent experience. + Prior experience with AWS serverless and companion technologies like DynamoDB, SQS, etc. would be great but not required. + Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with a mindset geared toward continuous improvement. + Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment, with the ability to handle ambiguity and changing requirements.**Thriving at Tillster** As a member of Tillster, you will embody our core values: + **Put Customers First:** Prioritize the needs and satisfaction of our customers in all decisions and actions appropriate to Tillster’s stage of development, resources, and stated goals. + **Collaborate:** Work together effectively, leveraging diverse perspectives to achieve common goals. + **Innovate:** Embrace creativity and pursue new ideas to drive progress and improvement. + **Operate from Data:** Use strong critical thinking skills to make informed decisions based on accurate and relevant data. + **Drive Results:** Focus on achieving tangible outcomes and delivering high performance. + **Own It:** Take responsibility for your actions and the success of your work. + **Be Passionate and Have Fun:** Bring enthusiasm to your work and enjoy the journey.**The Interview Process** + Recruiter interview with a Talent Acquisition specialist + AI\-assisted pair programming exercise / code review interview with our Back End Engineering Manager + Final interview with our Program leader TCE**Pay and Benefits (USA)** + **Salary** is $130,000 \- $155,000 DOE + **Health Benefits:** All full\-time, regular employees and their dependents are eligible for medical, dental, vision and FSA benefits. Additional health benefits include Healthcare and Dependent Care reimbursement programs, Employee Assistance Program (“EAP”) and Optum Care 24\-hour confidential medical counseling services. + **Holidays:** The company observes ten (10\) paid holidays per calendar year. + **Paid Time Off (PTO):** Full\-time, regular employees earn 15 days of PTO in the first 12\-months of continuous service, and 22 days in subsequent years. Eligible part\-time employees earn pro\-rated PTO. + **Retirement:** Effective with your employment start date, you will be eligible to participate in the 401(k) Plan. + **Education, Learning \& Development:** We offer college tuition and education assistance programs; Udemy Learning courses; and ongoing learning and development opportunities.**Making a Difference in the Tillster Way** Our business and product mission is to empower restaurants and consumers globally; by empowering, supporting, and nurturing the people who are part of the global Tillster team. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse work environment where every team member is respected, empowered, and encouraged to grow. To make this a reality, Tillster is dedicated to embracing diversity in all forms and is proudly an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, family/parental status, marital status, veteran status, disability, or any other protected status. **Follow us on:** Tillster: https://www.tillster.com/ Tillster Careers: https://www.tillster.com/careers LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/tillster/ **Local Candidates Strongly Preferred** **No Visa Sponsorship** **Principals only – no Agencies or calls please** **Tillster is proudly an Equal Opportunity Employer** **No Visa Sponsorship** **Principals only – no Agencies or calls please** **\-** **Tillster cares about the safety of all our employees—even those we’ve yet to hire** **RECRUITMENT FRAUD WARNING** We want to help you stay safe during your job search. Tillster will never: * Request personal/financial information during recruitment * Require payment or fees * Ask for sensitive PII before a formal job offer * Collect information via email or phone (only through secure channels) * Extend offers without in\-person or virtual interviews **Red flags:** All official communications come from @tillster.com addresses only **Suspicious activity?** Report immediately to Tillster HR, Legal, or Cyber Security teams. Compensation Range: $130K \- $150K
