jobs.title: Hiring for Senior AI Software Engineer (Agentic AI / AI Agents) | 10+ years of experience | USC
jobs.description: **Job Description** **Job Description – AI Agent Engineer (Claude SDK / AWS AgentCore / GitHub Actions)** **Duration: 3\+ Months (Extension Possible)** **Location: Los Angeles, CA (Hybrid)** Experience: 10 years overall, including hands\-on GenAI or agentic AI development. **Key responsibilities** * Design, develop, and implement AI agents using the Claude Agent SDK (formerly Claude Code SDK). * Build agent workflows using Python or TypeScript, including tool calling, MCP integrations, and API orchestration. * Deploy and manage AI agents on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Runtime. * Develop automated CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions for agent builds, testing, and deployments. * Configure AWS IAM, ECR, Docker/container packaging where applicable, and cloud security. * Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize production AI agent performance. * Implement secure authentication, logging, monitoring, and observability. **Additional Information** All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Hiring: AI Engineer / Generative AI Engineer | (Agentic AI,AWS Bedrock AgentCore,Claude Agent SDK,Langfuse) | Los Angeles, CA (Hybrid)
jobs.description: **Job Description** **Role:** **AI Engineer / Generative AI Engineer** **Duration: 3\+ Months (Extension Possible)** **Location: Los Angeles, CA (Hybrid)** ***Specialisation: Agentic AI, AWS Bedrock AgentCore, Claude Agent SDK, Langfuse, AI Observability \& Evaluation*** **Job Summary** We are seeking an experienced **AI Engineer** with strong hands\-on expertise in building, deploying, and monitoring production\-grade AI agents and Generative AI solutions using AWS technologies. The ideal candidate will have experience developing AI agents using **Claude Agent SDK**, deploying them on **Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Runtime**, automating deployments through **GitHub Actions**, and implementing **Langfuse for observability and continuous evaluation of agent traffic**. The role requires a strong combination of AI engineering, cloud deployment, data pipeline development, and LLM performance monitoring. **Key Responsibilities** **1\. Agentic AI Development** * Design, develop, and deploy AI agents using Claude Agent SDK and Python. * Build intelligent, autonomous agents capable of executing complex workflows and interacting with external tools, APIs, and knowledge bases. * Develop agent orchestration workflows with appropriate error handling, retry mechanisms, and guardrails. * Integrate AI agents with enterprise applications and data sources. **2\. AWS Bedrock \& AgentCore** * Deploy and manage AI agents using Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Runtime. * Develop scalable, secure, and production\-ready agent architectures on AWS. * Integrate agents with Amazon Bedrock foundation models and enterprise knowledge bases. * Implement agent authentication, access controls, logging, and runtime monitoring. **3\. Langfuse Deployment \& AI Observability** * Deploy, configure, and maintain Langfuse for comprehensive LLM and agent observability. * Integrate Langfuse with AI agents to capture traces, prompts, responses, tool calls, and execution metrics. * Monitor agent performance, response latency, token consumption, and operational costs. * Identify and troubleshoot production issues through distributed tracing and monitoring dashboards. **4\. Continuous Agent Evaluation** * Design and implement continuous evaluation frameworks for production AI agent traffic. * Evaluate agent responses for accuracy, relevance, hallucinations, task completion, and tool execution quality. * Develop automated evaluation pipelines using Langfuse, LLM\-as\-a\-Judge, and custom evaluation metrics. * Implement continuous feedback mechanisms to improve agent reliability and effectiveness. * Establish quality benchmarks and detect agent performance regressions. **5\. Data Pipelines \& Knowledge Base Integration** * Develop AWS Step Functions workflows integrating Amazon Textract and Amazon Comprehend for intelligent document processing. * Build document ingestion, preprocessing, and data transformation pipelines. * Implement vector database solutions, including document chunking, embedding generation, and vector indexing. * Integrate AI agents with Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines and enterprise knowledge bases. * Optimize retrieval performance and contextual accuracy. **6\. CI/CD \& Deployment Automation** * Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions. * Automate agent code builds, testing, deployment, and configuration management. * Implement deployment workflows for Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Runtime. * Integrate automated agent evaluations into CI/CD processes. * Apply DevOps best practices for version control, release management, and production monitoring. **Required Technical Skills** * **Programming:** Strong Python development experience. * **Agentic AI:** Claude Agent SDK, AI agent development, agent orchestration, tool calling. * **AWS AI Services:** Amazon Bedrock, Bedrock AgentCore Runtime, Step Functions, Textract, Comprehend. * **Observability:** Langfuse deployment, LLM tracing, monitoring, performance analysis. * **Evaluation:** Continuous agent evaluation, LLM\-as\-a\-Judge, evaluation metrics and automated testing. * **DevOps:** GitHub Actions, CI/CD pipelines, Git, deployment automation. * **RAG:** Vector databases, embeddings, chunking strategies, indexing, knowledge base integrations. * **Cloud:** AWS architecture, IAM, CloudWatch, security, and deployment practices. **Good\-to\-Have Skills** * Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, or other agent orchestration frameworks. * Experience with RAGAS, DeepEval, or similar LLM evaluation frameworks. * Familiarity with Amazon OpenSearch, Pinecone, FAISS, or pgvector. * Experience with Docker, Terraform, or infrastructure as code. * Knowledge of Model Context Protocol (MCP). * Experience with prompt engineering, guardrails, and AI governance. * Experience deploying enterprise Generative AI solutions in production environments. **Qualifications** * 6–8\+ years of software engineering, cloud engineering, or AI/ML development experience. * Strong hands\-on experience building Generative AI or Agentic AI applications. * Demonstrated experience deploying and supporting AI agents in production. * Strong understanding of AWS cloud services, LLM architectures, and automated deployment processes. * Ability to independently design, implement, troubleshoot, and optimize AI agent solutions. **Ideal Candidate Profile** A hands\-on AI Engineer who can take an agent from development through production deployment and ongoing evaluation. The candidate should be proficient in **Claude Agent SDK, AWS Bedrock AgentCore, Langfuse, GitHub Actions, and continuous AI agent evaluation**, with the ability to build reliable, scalable, and observable enterprise AI solutions. **Additional Information** All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Senior Software Developer
jobs.description: The Senior Software Developer designs, develops, and supports secure, scalable, and maintainable enterprise applications, APIs, cloud\-native services, data integration platforms, and AI\-enabled solutions. The position partners with business and technology stakeholders to translate business objectives into modern technology solutions that improve operational efficiency, reduce risk, enhance customer and employee experiences, and support organizational growth. The role applies expertise in Microsoft Azure, C\#/.NET, SQL Server, software architecture, integration, and emerging technologies to advance cloud adoption, automation, modernization, and engineering excellence while mentoring developers and contributing to long\-term technology direction. Position Goals * Enterprise Solution Delivery: Deliver scalable, secure, and maintainable technology solutions that support critical business functions and strategic initiatives. * Operational and Experience Improvement: Improve operational efficiency and customer and employee experiences through process automation, application modernization, and digital transformation. * Cloud, AI, and Data Enablement: Expand the effective use of cloud\-native technologies, AI\-enabled capabilities, enterprise data, and intelligent automation to create business value. * Technology Reliability and Risk Reduction: Maintain application security, performance, resiliency, data quality, and operational reliability while reducing technology and operational risk. * Engineering Excellence and Capability Development: Strengthen software engineering practices, reusable technology capabilities, team collaboration, and developer knowledge through mentoring and continuous improvement. Key Responsibilities Business Solutions and Digital Transformation * Partner with business leaders, product owners, architects, engineering teams, and other stakeholders to identify opportunities for process improvement, automation, and digital transformation. * Translate business requirements and objectives into scalable, secure, and maintainable technology solutions. * Design and deliver solutions that improve efficiency, reduce operational risk, and enhance customer and employee experiences. * Support strategic initiatives through modern applications, integrations, and digital services. Application, API, and Cloud Development * Develop and maintain enterprise applications, APIs, integrations, and shared technology services supporting critical business functions. * Design, develop, and support cloud\-native solutions using Microsoft Azure. * Build cloud\-based solutions that promote scalability, resiliency, flexibility, security, and maintainability. * Develop reusable components and services that accelerate solution delivery across the organization. * Apply modern programming languages, software architecture, distributed systems, design patterns, service\-oriented architecture, and event\-driven development practices. AI, Automation, Data, and Integration * Design and implement AI\-enabled capabilities that improve productivity, decision support, and business process automation. * Integrate enterprise data sources, services, and platforms to support AI\-driven applications, knowledge\-based assistants, and digital assistants. * Evaluate emerging technologies and identify opportunities to create business value through AI and automation. * Develop enterprise data integration solutions, data pipelines, reporting solutions, and business intelligence support services. * Support data modeling, database development, ETL/ELT processes, and data movement across relational and non\-relational platforms. * Promote timely, accurate, accessible, reliable, and high\-performing information exchange across business\-critical systems. Technology Excellence, Security, and Operations * Ensure solutions meet enterprise standards for security, performance, reliability, scalability, and maintainability. * Apply application security, identity and access management, secure authentication, role\-based authorization, and API security practices. * Monitor application health, troubleshoot technical issues, and proactively improve system performance. * Apply DevOps practices, version control, CI/CD automation, containerized deployment, automated testing, and application monitoring. * Contribute to architecture decisions, technical roadmaps, cloud adoption, and technology modernization efforts. Agile Delivery, Collaboration, and Technical Leadership * Participate in Agile delivery teams and contribute to planning, estimation, testing, execution, and continuous improvement activities. * Collaborate with business and technology stakeholders throughout solution design, development, implementation, and support. * Mentor developers and share software engineering and technology best practices. * Support a culture of collaboration, accountability, innovation, learning, and operational excellence. * Perform other duties as assigned. * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field required. * Minimum of 7 years of experience designing, developing, implementing, and supporting enterprise applications required. * Proficiency in modern programming languages and technologies, including C\#, .NET, JavaScript, PowerShell, and Python. * Demonstrated experience with distributed systems, service\-oriented architecture (SOA), event\-driven solution development, and secure API design and integration, including REST services, OAuth/JWT authentication, and API documentation tools such as OpenAPI and Swagger. * Strong understanding of software architecture, design patterns, scalability, performance, and security best practices. * Experience developing and supporting enterprise application integrations using SOAP services, XML\-based data exchange, and related messaging technologies. * Experience designing, developing, and supporting cloud\-native solutions on Microsoft Azure, including serverless computing, API management, messaging, data storage, application monitoring, and secure secrets management. * Proficiency in using Microsoft AI platforms and services to develop intelligent applications, knowledge\-based assistants, and AI\-driven automation solutions through modern retrieval, orchestration, and machine learning integration patterns. * Experience designing, developing, and supporting enterprise data integration solutions, including data modeling, database development, ETL/ELT processes, and data movement across relational and non\-relational data platforms. * Proficiency in DevOps practices, version control systems, CI/CD automation, containerized application deployment, automated testing, and Agile/Scrum delivery frameworks. * Strong understanding of application security principles, identity and access management, secure authentication protocols, role\-based authorization models, and enterprise API security best practices.

jobs.title: Research Engineer
jobs.description: Join our Team as a **Research Engineer**! **The Role:** We're looking for an innovative Research Engineer to explore emerging technologies and build proof\-of\-concept prototypes that advance robotics, automation, and operator assist technologies for next\-generation forklift and material handling equipment. You'll partner with cross\-functional teams to turn new ideas into practical technologies that improve operator effectiveness, productivity, and the customer experience. **What You'll Be Doing:** * Explore emerging technologies in robotics, automation, perception systems, computer vision, artificial intelligence (AI), and machine learning. * Design, build, and evaluate proof\-of\-concept prototypes. * Partner with mechanical, electrical, software, and robotics engineers to bring new concepts to life. * Design and execute experiments to validate concepts and system performance. * Analyze test data and recommend enhancements. * Share technical findings through reports, presentations, and engineering documentation. * Support patent development, technical publications, and future product concepts. * Identify opportunities to improve operator awareness, productivity, and customer value. **What We're Looking For:** * Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Robotics, Industrial Engineering, Computer Science, or a related engineering discipline. * 2\+ years of post\-graduation professional experience. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills. * Proficiency in Python, C/C\+\+, Java, or similar programming languages. * Familiarity with robotics and simulation tools such as ROS, MATLAB, Simulink, or Gazebo. * Ability to manage multiple priorities while working independently and collaboratively. * Curiosity, adaptability, and a desire to explore emerging technologies. **What Sets You Apart:** * Background in robotics, automation, computer vision, artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning, or autonomous systems. * Hands\-on experience designing, building, and testing prototypes. * Internship, co\-op, or professional experience in research and development (R\&D). * Familiarity with sensor integration, perception systems, autonomous vehicles, or mobile robotics. * jobs.title: Senior DevOps / Release Engineer
jobs.description: TrendAI™, the global AI security leader and enterprise business unit of Trend Micro, empowers organizations with full AI visibility and consolidated security that inspires confidence, drives innovation, and eliminates risk. At TrendAI™, we’re always seeking exceptional talent; people who want to collaborate with the best and push boundaries together. Here, your work goes beyond building a career. You will help protect what matters and play a vital role in shaping a safer, more trustworthy AI\-powered future. AI Fearlessly. Job Description: LOCATION On\-Site / Hybrid (Austin, TX) Position Summary TrendAI is seeking a Senior DevOps / Release Engineer to own the CI/CD, build, release, and infrastructure backbone for our on\-premises network security appliance, shipped as both physical hardware and virtual editions. The appliance is a large Java monolith built through Ant and gated primarily by GitHub Actions, with a shrinking legacy Jenkins footprint you will help retire as its current build\-toolchain versions reach end\-of\-life/end\-of\-support. A blocking\-mode agentic PR reviewer and an AI\-based PR responder already run in production against it: a live system to mature, not a greenfield one to invent. You will build automated gates protecting release branches, sign and stage releases, and keep self\-hosted runners and lab infrastructure healthy, balancing the rigor of physical/virtual lab release cycles with the modernization of cloud microservices and agentic automation. Secondary to that primary workload, you will extend the same CI/CD and infrastructure discipline to a companion set of Go and Node microservices deployed to AWS via Terraform/Terragrunt and the Serverless Framework. This is a senior IC role with broad autonomy over tooling and infrastructure decisions, and a mandate to push AI\-assisted automation into daily operations rather than treat it as a side experiment. Responsibilities 1\. Own and operate the scheduled CI/CD pipeline suite (regression/BVT, integration, UI/functional, and nightly or on\-demand workflows) for the on\-prem appliance across main and release branches, triaging failures daily and distinguishing real regressions from lab or environmental noise. 2\. Author, refactor, and maintain GitHub Actions workflows and reusable actions for the appliance product, including migrating the remaining legacy Jenkins jobs onto GitHub Actions ahead of their build\-toolchain's end\-of\-life/end\-of\-support window, workflow\-dispatch orchestration across multiple repositories, matrix builds, self\-hosted runner targeting, and secrets/permissions hygiene. 3\. Eliminate manual "build cop" duties by architecting and operating preventative branch gates: GitHub Merge Queue (or equivalent), speculative/batch merging, and automated flaky\-test quarantine that removes unreliable tests from the gate without removing signal, so main and release branches never break. 4\. Administer GitHub organization structure: repositories, branch protections, teams, user access, and the lifecycle of branches including cleanup of associated builds and artifacts when branches are deleted. 5\. Modernize and maintain build/lab infrastructure supporting the appliance (bare metal and virtual), driving the transition toward ephemeral runners, automated patching, and declarative infrastructure\-as\-code, on both direct\-managed hosts and machines shared with other teams. 6\. Manage code signing and release packaging for the appliance: sign builds destined for continuous regression use, track and apply detection or definition\-file updates through their PR lifecycle, and keep versioned build metadata consistent across the systems that consume it (test schedulers, release trackers). 7\. Eliminate manual release bookkeeping by designing automated release\-note and changelog generation from conventional commits and PR metadata (e.g., semantic\-release), so release readiness reporting requires no hand\-curated changelog page; coordinate fresh\-install of validation/scan targets (physical and virtual) against the latest signed build. 8\. Run, maintain, and administer third\-party security and quality scanning pipelines (SAST/SCA and vulnerability scanners such as Coverity and Black Duck) across products, including version upgrades and license/user administration for the platforms themselves, and automate the triage of actionable findings into tracked engineering work. 9\. Harden build environments by extending the OIDC\-based, short\-lived credential pattern already used in the microservices' CI (no static IAM keys) to appliance build and lab systems, replacing long\-lived static secrets and passwords with short\-lived, least\-privilege identity mechanisms. 10\. Extend the AI\-assisted automation already running in production (a blocking\-mode agentic PR reviewer gating findings before merge, an AI\-based PR responder) into new categories of repetitive operational work: triage, log/report summarization, release notes drafting,  administering static analysis platforms (Coverity, Black Duck, or comparable) at the license/version/user\-management level, not just as a consumer of their findings. 5\. Experience designing agentic or LLM\-assisted operational workflows end to end: identifying candidate tasks, building the automation, and defining the guardrails that keep it safe in a regulated or compliance\-sensitive environment. 6\. Experience designing merge\-queue or speculative\-merge systems (GitHub Merge Queue, Bors, Mergify, or comparable) and automated flaky\-test detection/quarantine that keep a shared branch continuously green without manual intervention. 7\. Cloud infrastructure experience (AWS, Azure, or GCP) including infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform/Terragrunt, CloudFormation, or comparable), useful for the microservices support scope. 8\. Container orchestration experience (Kubernetes or comparable) for deploying and operating microservices in staging or production. 9\. Experience owning or migrating artifact/container registries (e.g., Harbor, JFrog Artifactory, or comparable) at organization scale. 10\. Experience with the Serverless Framework or comparable (AWS Lambda, API Gateway) for microservice deployment automation. 11\. Experience leading or contributing to a CI/CD platform migration (e.g., Jenkins to GitHub Actions or another modern platform), including sequencing cutover so release branches stay protected throughout. About the team This team owns the CI/CD, build, and release infrastructure that powers our network security appliance family alongside our companion cloud microservices platform. We sit at the intersection of engineering, QA, and release management, keeping automated pipelines, build systems, and delivery gates running so the organization can ship with confidence. We take pride in eliminating manual toil, modernizing legacy build infrastructure with care, and championing AI\-augmented automation while holding an uncompromising bar for operational stability, security, and release integrity. What We Offer You: You're important to us. What matters to you, matters to us too. Trend Micro provides benefit options for you and your family. Here some of the top\-rated benefits that employees enjoy today: Comprehensive health benefits and paid time off package Pre\-partum, maternity, parental, medical leave and adoption assistance Mental Health Wellness Program \& Annual Wellness Incentive 401(k) with company match Pet Insurance Collaborative and innovative culture We are committed to fostering a professional, respectful, and inclusive work environment that promotes collaboration and high performance. We value diverse backgrounds and perspectives and welcome candidates who bring unique strengths and experiences. If you’re excited about this role and believe you can contribute and grow with us, we encourage you to apply. Be Passionate. Be Innovative. Be a Trender. This position does not offer sponsorship for work permit applications or renewals, either now or in the future. Candidates must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for employment\-based visa sponsorship, both currently and moving forward. The company will not sponsor applicants for U.S. work visa status for this role (including, but not limited to, H\-1B, L\-1, TN, O\-1, E\-3, H\-1B1, F\-1, J\-1, OPT, CPT, or any other employment\-based visa \#LI\-BM1 At Trend Micro, we embrace change, empower people, and encourage innovation in a connected world. Our diversity and multicultural workforce are key contributing factors to our success across the globe. Trend Micro provides equal employment opportunity for all applicants and employees. Trend Micro does not unlawfully discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy and childbirth or related medical conditions, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care leave status, veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, or gender identity.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (San Francisco)
jobs.description: **Shape the Future with TribalScale** ===================================== TribalScale is a digital innovation firm that helps organizations adapt and thrive in a rapidly changing world. We partner with clients to build transformative digital products, modernize technology platforms, and apply emerging technologies—including artificial intelligence—to meaningful business challenges. Our teams work closely with clients from strategy through execution. We value curiosity, ownership, practical innovation, and people who are comfortable turning ambiguity into action. **Our Digital Expertise** * **Transformation Experts:** We transform traditional business models into agile, AI\-powered ecosystems. * **Strategic Visionaries:** We navigate the uncharted waters of technological evolution. * **Product Virtuosos:** We orchestrate the creation of world\-class digital solutions. * **Code Optimizers:** We leverage AI to refine and perfect digital systems. **Our Technological Toolkit** * **Mobile \& Web Development:** (iOS, Android, React Native, React, Node.js) * **Voice\-Activated Platforms:** (Amazon Alexa, Google Home) * **Connected Ecosystems:** (Cars and Homes) * **Streaming Platforms:** (Roku, Fire TV, Android TV, tvOS) **The TribalScale Professional** You thrive in challenging environments where innovation is key. Your passion for technology is matched only by your drive to redefine its limits. You seek more than a job; you seek a calling—a chance to make a lasting impact on the digital landscape. **The Opportunity** ------------------- TribalScale is looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer to work at the intersection of software engineering, artificial intelligence, product development, and client delivery. In this role, you will embed with client and internal teams to understand complex business problems, rapidly design solutions, and deploy production\-quality software in real\-world environments. You will operate as both a hands\-on engineer and a trusted technical partner—translating business needs into working products while helping clients make sound technology decisions. You will be expected to understand more than models and prompts. You will help design the systems around AI models: the harnesses, agent loops, state graphs, tools, context, evaluations, observability, permissions, and human controls required to make AI applications useful and reliable in production. This role is ideal for an adaptable engineer who enjoys direct customer interaction, can move comfortably between discovery and delivery, and wants to see their work create immediate, measurable impact. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Partner directly with clients to understand their objectives, workflows, technical environments, data, and operational constraints. * Translate ambiguous business challenges into clear technical requirements, solution architectures, prototypes, and delivery plans. * Design and build AI\-enabled applications, agentic workflows, developer tools, APIs, data pipelines, and full\-stack products. * Engineer the harnesses around AI models, including prompts, tools, context, memory, permissions, runtime controls, observability, and feedback mechanisms. * Build and refine agent loops that support planning, tool selection, execution, observation, reflection, recovery, and termination. * Model complex workflows as graphs, state machines, or other orchestration patterns that coordinate models, tools, data, systems, and human approvals. * Create evaluation frameworks that measure task completion, accuracy, reliability, safety, latency, cost, and user value. * Develop rapid prototypes and proofs of concept, validate them with real users and representative evaluations, and evolve successful ideas into secure, scalable products. * Integrate solutions with client systems, enterprise data sources, cloud platforms, and third\-party services. * Work across the technology stack, contributing wherever needed—from user interfaces and backend services to AI infrastructure, data workflows, and deployment pipelines. * Implement appropriate safeguards, permission boundaries, approval steps, and fallbacks for autonomous and semi\-autonomous systems. * Instrument AI applications so teams can inspect traces, understand intermediate states, diagnose failures, and improve system performance. * Identify and address failure modes such as hallucinations, looping, brittle tool calls, context loss, prompt injection, non\-deterministic behavior, and unsafe actions. * Troubleshoot complex technical and operational issues in client environments. * Communicate technical decisions, risks, trade\-offs, and progress clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences. * Collaborate with product managers, designers, engineers, data specialists, security teams, and client stakeholders throughout the delivery lifecycle. * Establish strong engineering practices, including automated testing, documentation, observability, security, and continuous d nt frameworks, or related open\-source projects. * Experience working in regulated or complex enterprise environments. * Experience in consulting, professional services, solutions engineering, sales engineering, or another customer\-facing technical role. * A history of taking products from initial discovery through production launch and ongoing adoption. * Claude Certified Architect \- Foundations or Professional certification (or equivalent), with practical experience designing and implementing Claude\-based AI solutions, agentic workflows, and enterprise integrations. * Experience with agentic AI and harness\-driven development, including designing, building, and optimizing autonomous AI agents, multi\-agent workflows, tool integrations, and agent harnesses that support reliable, scalable, and production\-ready AI applications. **What Success Looks Like** --------------------------- In your first few months, you will have built trusted relationships with client and TribalScale teams, developed a strong understanding of the client's operating environment, and contributed working software to a meaningful business challenge. As you grow in the role, you will: * Turn loosely defined client needs into clear, executable technical plans. * Deliver AI\-enabled products that perform reliably outside of controlled demonstrations. * Establish evaluation and observability practices that make quality measurable and regressions visible. * Improve agent behavior by refining harnesses, loops, tools, graphs, context, and safeguards—not only by changing prompts or models. * Help client teams understand what their AI systems can do, where they can fail, and how they should be operated responsibly. * Create reusable technical patterns that accelerate future TribalScale engagements. * Become a trusted partner who can navigate uncertainty, solve difficult technical problems, and help promising ideas reach production. **Why TribalScale** ------------------- * Work on high\-impact challenges across industries and technology domains. * Build real products and production systems—not just recommendations or presentations. * Work directly with clients and see the impact of your decisions. * Explore emerging approaches to AI, agentic systems, product development, and software delivery. * Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams that value experimentation and continuous learning. * Influence both client outcomes and TribalScale's evolving technical practices. * Join an environment where ownership, diverse perspectives, and thoughtful innovation are encouraged. **Why Choose TribalScale** At TribalScale, collaboration is at the heart of our innovative approach. We don't simply work for clients; we form partnerships, building transformative solutions that redefine what's possible. Our team, once at the forefront of the mobile revolution, now leads the charge in AI\-driven innovation. We empower each team member to be a catalyst for change, adhering to our principles of meritocracy, empowerment, and transparency. Diversity isn't just celebrated—it's fundamental to our strength. Our mission to "Right the Future" is a call to action to make a significant impact in the world of innovation. **Diversity: Our Collective Strength** TribalScale proudly stands as a beacon of equal opportunity in employment and workplace culture. We are steadfastly committed to equal employment opportunity, transcending the boundaries of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, able\-bodiedness, or gender identity. We not only welcome but actively encourage applications from individuals of all abilities, ages, citizenships, marital statuses, and gender identities. Our commitment to inclusivity knows no bounds, and we stand ready to adapt our processes to ensure your comfort and success.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Description** **Extraordinary opportunity. Exceptional experience.** Sometimes in life, you find yourself in the right place, at the right time, looking at an opportunity so extraordinary it cannot be ignored. At Trucordia, our company is built on wildly successful businesses in our communities across the country, and now we’ve come together to create the next great insurance brokerage. We offer an unrivaled combination of people, tools and solutions, and deliver exceptional experiences and opportunities for our employees, clients and stakeholders. We celebrate both individual successes and collective accomplishments, making sure the industry recognizes the remarkable company we’re building together, as well as the impact we’re having on our clients and communities. Ranked as one of the fastest\-growing companies in the U.S. for three consecutive years, we have more than 5,000 team members across 200 offices across the country, who actively, genuinely care about our clients, each other and the quality of our work, and in every interaction, represent a company that people want to work for and do business with. **Trucordia Values** * We actively, genuinely **CARE** about our clients, each other and the quality of our work, and in every interaction, represent a company that people want to work for and do business with. * We **COLLABORATE** continuously because, together, we are more powerful and make amazing things happen for our clients and company. * We **LEAD** with intelligence, hunger, curiosity, energy and a future\-focused attitude of “what’s next”? * We are **RESULT\-ORIENTED**, growth\-focused and driven to out\-perform expectations of what an insurance brokerage can achieve. * We **CELEBRATE** both individual successes and collective accomplishments, making sure the industry recognizes the remarkable company we’re building together, as well as the impact we’re having on our clients and communities. **Job Description** Trucordia is a rapidly growing insurance brokerage that acquires agencies nationwide and brings their business onto shared systems and shared reporting. Every acquired agency arrives with its own systems, its own data, and its own way of counting things. The Data \& Analytics team turns that into one answer: a Snowflake warehouse fed from AMS360, Salesforce, HR, and finance systems, etc. modeled in dbt into conformed dimensions and facts (policies, premium, retention, producers, agencies, carriers), and served through Power BI, curated semantic views for AI, and internal web apps we design and build ourselves. Our governance framework (Entra\-synced roles, row\-level security, network and authentication policies) is code we wrote and maintain. We are hiring a Data Engineer to help us build and run that platform. This role sits within the Data and Technology organization on the Data \& Analytics team, a small, senior group that owns the full path from source system to decision. You will own dbt models and pipelines end to end, onboard new sources, keep the nightly run healthy, and make the platform faster, more trustworthy, and less dependent on any one engineer’s memory. You will work closely with our Integrations team, which migrates acquired agencies into AMS360, and with analysts and stakeholders in Sales, Operations, and Finance. **Duties and Responsibilities:** * Design, build, and maintain dbt models across our staging, intermediate, and mart layers, owning model performance, incremental strategies, tests, and documentation for the areas you take on. * Onboard new sources into Snowflake, from agency management systems to SaaS tools and flat\-file feeds, including profiling the data, agreeing on grain and keys with analysts, and writing the loads and quality checks. * Keep the nightly dbt run healthy: diagnose failures, fix root causes, and reduce the blast radius when an upstream source breaks. * Improve observability with freshness checks, row\-count and reconciliation tests, and alerting when a source or model drifts from expectations. * Tune Snowflake cost and performance, including warehouse sizing, clustering, query patterns, and task scheduling. * Contribute to our governance framework: role grants, Entra group sync, row\-level security policies, and the access\-config tables that gate our internal apps. * Build the backend data layer for the internal web apps we ship to the business and support deploys through our CI pipelines. * Partner with analysts and stakeholders to translate a business question into a model that answers it consistently, and document the result in model docs, runbooks, and decision notes in our Azure DevOps wiki. **Qualifications** * 3\+ years of professional experience building production data pipelines, with at least 2 years on a cloud data warehouse (Snowflake strongly preferred). * Strong SQL skills, including reading query plans, window functions, incremental logic, and slowly changing dimensions; comfortable profiling unfamiliar schemas and performing data quality analysis. * Hands\-on dbt experience in a production project: models, tests, macros, sources, exposures, and a CI workflow. * Proficiency in Python for data work: loading files, calling APIs, writing small services or scheduled jobs, and testing them. * Experience with Git\-based workflows, pull\-request review, and CI/CD pipelines. * Sound data modeling judgment: you can explain why a fact table has the grain it does and push back when a request would break it. * Strong written communicator who documents solutions and collaborates effectively with technical and non\-technical stakeholders. **AI Assisted Development Requirements:** * Proven, ongoing use of AI\-assisted development tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Copilot, Claude, Cursor, or similar) as part of daily development workflows. * Demonstrated ability to use AI to accelerate coding, debugging, refactoring, and learning new technologies or codebases. * Ability to critically review AI\-generated code for correctness, security, performance, and long\-term maintainability. * Hands\-on, habitual experience using AI in professional work, side projects, or personal experimentation; this role assumes AI is a core productivity multiplier. **Nice to have:** * Insurance brokerage or agency data experience: policies, premium, commissions, carriers, producers, retention. Familiarity with AMS360, Epic, or similar agency management systems is a real plus. * Salesforce data model and replication into a warehouse. * Snowflake governance features: row access policies, masking, network policies, or SCIM. * Azure ecosystem: Azure DevOps pipelines, Azure Functions, Entra ID. * Power BI semantic models, or experience feeding LLM and semantic\-layer tools from a warehouse. * FastAPI or another Python web framework. **Additional Information** **Please see our company Benefits:** * Medical, Dental, Vision * Life Insurance and AD\&D * FSA / HSA * Accident * Critical Illness * Hospital Indemnity * Supplemental Health Insurance * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) * Pet Insurance * 11 Paid Holidays * Flexible PTO * 401K *Trucordia Insurance Services, LLC and its affiliates (collectively, the “Company”) is aware of scams involving false offers of employment with the Company. The false offers use fake websites, email addresses, group chats and text messages. The Company does not (a) interview prospective candidates via instant message or group chat; (b) request banking or credit card information during the interview process; or (c) require candidates to purchase products or services or process payments on its behalf as a condition of any employment offer.* Trucordia is an equal opportunity employer. We believe that every employee has the right to work in an environment that is free from all forms of discrimination. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (Conversational AI)
jobs.description: ### **Why TrueML?** TrueML is a mission\-driven financial software company that aims to create better customer experiences for distressed borrowers. Consumers today want personal, digital\-first experiences that align with their lifestyles, especially when it comes to managing finances. TrueML’s approach uses machine learning to engage each customer digitally and adjust strategies in real time in response to their interactions. The TrueML team includes inspired data scientists, financial services industry experts and customer experience fanatics building technology to serve people in a way that recognizes their unique needs and preferences as human beings and endeavoring toward ensuring nobody gets locked out of the financial system. ### **About This Role:** TrueML is on a mission to humanize the recovery process for distressed borrowers through AI and machine learning. As our **Senior Product Manager** you will be the person who brings conversational AI to life inside our platform — across voice, chat, and the messaging channels our consumers and clients already use. ### **What You'll Do:** * **Roadmap \& Strategy:** Define and own the conversational AI roadmap across voice and chat, balancing consumer impact, client demand, operational readiness, and platform build\-vs\-adopt decisions. * **Conversation Design \& Omnichannel Integration:** Establish behavior standards for AI agents—including authentication, intent recognition, hardship handling, and human handoffs—ensuring a unified consumer experience across voice, chat, SMS, and email. * **Partnerships \& Technical Surface:** Manage vendor relationships and specify requirements for telephony and CRM/servicing system integrations. * **Performance \& Compliance:** Drive operational metrics (latency, containment, cost per resolution) while partnering with Legal and Compliance to adhere to regulatory frameworks like FDCPA, Reg F, and TCPA. * **Cross\-Functional Operational Readiness:** Prepare Operations, Client Success, and Compliance teams with training, runbooks, escalation paths, and key metrics prior to feature launches. ### **Who You Are:** * **Experience:** 5\+ years of 0\-1 Product Management experience, with a track record of shipping products that moved business metrics. Fintech, collections, lending, or other regulated financial services experience is a strong plus. * **LLM Experience:** You have shipped LLM\-based capabilities in production. You can reason about prompting, retrieval, evaluation, guardrails, latency, and failure modes well enough to partner credibly with engineers — and to know when an impressive demo is not yet a product. * **Conversational AI Fluency (hard requirement):** Hands\-on experience with voice agents, chat agents, IVR, or contact center technology. * **Strong Analytical Skills:** When you have a question about conversation or outcome data, you answer it yourself. * **The "Double\-Sided" Mindset:** Experience with B2B2C products, balancing what the client configures against what the consumer experiences. * **A Master of Ambiguity:** You thrive in "roll\-up\-your\-sleeves" environments where the path isn't always marked, turning conflicting inputs into solid, actionable plans. For U.S.\-based hires, the overall base salary framework for this role currently spans $136,000 to $180,000\. The applicable base salary range for any individual hire depends on the geographic labor market associated with the employee’s primary work location along with other factors such as relevant skills, experience, and qualifications. Geographic labor markets are divided into "tiers" based upon a number of factors, including cost of living. However, flexibility outside of standard business hours and occasional local or international travel may be necessary for global operations support, company meetings, training, offsites, and collaborative projects. This position primarily involves computer\-based work, requiring extended periods at a computer, participation in virtual meetings, and use of standard office technology. We will consider reasonable accommodations to enable individuals to perform the essential functions of the role. Maintaining a reliable internet connection and a professional work environment is expected. The ability to protect confidential company, employee, customer, and business information while working outside of a company office is also required. #### **Personally Identifying Information** We collect personal information for employment purposes. We do not sell personal information. Most of the information we have is provided to us by you and/or collected as part of the employment process. For more details on how we use, share, and delete personal information see our Privacy Policy. #### **Dedication to Diversity \& Inclusion** We are an equal opportunity employer. We promote, value, and thrive with a diverse and inclusive team. Different perspectives contribute to better solutions and this makes us stronger every day. jobs.title: Senior Network Security Engineer
jobs.description: **DO WHAT YOU LOVE!** Unique Vacations, Inc. \- an affiliate of the worldwide representative for **Sandals Resorts** and **Beaches Resorts** \- is seeking a forward\-thinking **Senior Network Security Engineer** to join its remarkable Miami\-based, in\-house team. **WHO ARE WE?** Unique Vacations, Inc. is an affiliate of the worldwide representative of **Sandals Resorts** and **Beaches Resorts.** We provide exclusive, marketing, public relations, advertising, promotions, and creative services to showcase the Luxury Included experience, which guests have come to adore for 40 years and counting for Sandals \& Beaches Resorts. You can learn more about the brands we represent by visiting www.sandals.com and www.beaches.com. We are ever\-dedicated to our customers, vendors, and our most precious commodity \- our TEAM! At Unique Vacations, Inc. we know our company is most powerful when everyone can make their mark. **When you do what you love, you will be empowered to create the future that you want!** **APPLY, CREATE, IMPACT:** If you’re ready to make an impact on one of the world’s most renowned hospitality brands, we invite you to apply for the **Senior Network Security Engineer** via our career portal: http://www.uvcareers.com/ **JOB DESCRIPTION:** The Senior Network Security Engineer is a hands\-on technical role responsible for managing and continuously hardening the network security controls and tools of Unique Vacations, Inc. (UVI) across its data centers, corporate offices, call centers, and cloud environments. The role owns FortiManager and the FortiGate security policies, FortiAnalyzer, FortiClient EMS and VPN user access, Darktrace network detection and response, and FireMon firewall policy management, and is a primary contributor to PCI DSS network compliance. The position partners closely with Network Engineering, which operates the firewalls and VPN gateways, as well as Systems Administration, the Security Operations team, managed security providers, and vendors. The role has no direct reports at this time and is based in Miami, Florida. **JOB ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:** **Firewall Security Management (FortiManager)** * Own FortiManager as the central security management platform, including policy packages, shared objects, threat feeds, naming standards, upgrades, and backups. * Define and maintain FortiGate security controls, including IPS, application control, web and DNS filtering, threat\-intelligence and geo\-blocking, and centralized IP and URL block lists. * Review firewall rule, NAT, and connectivity requests for business need, least privilege, and exposure before implementation by Network Engineering. * Perform periodic firewall rule reviews and track remediation of unused or overly permissive rules with Network Engineering. **Security Monitoring and Detection** * Administer FortiAnalyzer, ensuring reliable log collection, retention, reporting, and forwarding to the SIEM. * Administer the NDR platform (Platform: Network, Email, and Identity), including appliances, upgrades, model tuning, and integrations. * Build and maintain security alert integrations to Microsoft Teams and Jira using properly governed service accounts. **VPN User Access** * Own the VPN access model, including SAML authentication and AD/MFA group mapping, aligned with least privilege. * Manage FortiClient EMS (on\-premises and cloud), review and approve VPN access requests, and onboard contractors and vendors. * Troubleshoot user access issues and escalate gateway or infrastructure issues to Network Engineering. **PCI DSS and Firewall Policy Management** * Operate FireMon for device onboarding, scheduled compliance reports, and change reporting. * Perform quarterly network device audits, produce PCI DSS evidence, and drive remediation with Network Engineering. * Support the annual PCI network assessment and ensure changes do not expand PCI scope or weaken segmentation. **Incident Response and Operations** * Serve as a technical escalation point for network\-related security incidents, including blocking, isolation, and containment. * Participate in the Information Security on\-call rotation and follow the change\-management (CAB) process for all changes. **Projects, Documentation, and Vendors** * Lead the security workstreams of network, data center, and cloud (AWS and Azure) projects. * Create and maintain runbooks, standards, and inventories so that no knowledge depends on a single person. * Manage relationships and support cases with vendors and partners such as Fortinet, Darktrace, and FireMon. * Other duties as required by management. **COMPETENCE REQUIREMENTS:** To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. **Qualifications include:** **Fortinet Expertise:** Advanced hands\-on experience with FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer, FortiClient EMS, and FortiGate security features in a multi\-site environment. **Network Security:** Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, segmentation, NAT, IPS, VPN, DNS, and web filtering, with enough routing and HA knowledge to partner effectively with Network Engineering. **Detection and Compliance:** Experience with Darktrace or similar NDR, SIEM (Splunk preferred), and PCI DSS 4\.0 network requirements. **Identity and Automation:** Experience with Okta SAML and Active Directory, plus scripting or automation (Python, PowerShell, FortiOS CLI, or Power Automate). **Communication and Ownership**: Able to work independently, document thoroughly, and drive issues through validated closure. **EXPERIENCE:** Outlined below are the academic qualifications and length and type of experience deemed necessary by Unique Vacations Inc. in order to perform the role of **Senior Network Security Engineer** competently. **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Security, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline preferred. Equivalent relevant experience may be considered in lieu of a degree. **Experience:** 5\+ years of network security or network engineering experience, including 3\+ years administering Fortinet security platforms in an enterprise environment. * Experience supporting PCI DSS or other regulatory audits with network security evidence. * Experience with firewall policy management tools (FireMon, Tufin, AlgoSec, or Nipper) is preferred. * Certifications: Fortinet NSE 4 / FCP required or obtained within 6 months; NSE 7 / FCSS, CCNP Security, GIAC, or CISSP preferred. **BENEFITS:** We offer a full benefits package including: * Health * Dental * Vision * Employer paid life insurance, STD, and LTD * Sick days * Vacation days * 9 Holidays * Tuition assistance * Parental leave * 401K plan with a generous company match **Additional perk:** After 6 months of continuous employment, you may visit the resorts we represent at a discounted rate. Once you visit one of the properties, you will not only experience the best of what the brand has to offer but you will get to see first\-hand what makes us so passionate and most of all so “Unique”. **ABOUT UNIQUE VACATIONS:** Unique Vacations Inc. is an affiliate of the worldwide representative **of Sandals and Beaches Resorts** – exclusively providing, marketing, public relations, advertising, promotions, and creative services to showcase the Luxury Included experience, which the guests have come to adore for 40 years and counting for Sandals and Beaches Resorts. Designed for couples in love, Sandals Resorts boasts 19 Luxury Included resorts located on the Caribbean’s best beaches in Jamaica, Bahamas, Barbados, Antigua, Curaçao, St. Lucia, St. Vincent and Grenada. The family\-friend resorts for everyone, Beaches Resorts offers three magnificent locations in Jamaica and Turks \& Caicos. We are headquartered in sunny South Florida – a hop, skip and a jump from the glorious Caribbean islands. Learn more about the brands we represent at www.sandals.com and www.beaches.com.

jobs.description: **ABOUT THE ROLE \& TEAM:** At TelevisaUnivision, we are the world's leading Spanish\-language media company, reaching millions of consumers across digital, streaming, social, audio, linear television, and live events. As we continue expanding our global streaming platform, ViX, we are investing heavily in technology, data, and innovation to deliver exceptional subscriber experiences and drive long\-term business growth. The Principal Data Engineer will play a key role as a technical leader in the design, development, and deployment of our data platform. You will be critical in setting the architecture and multi\-year technical direction for our data platform, stay hands\-on with the hardest real\-time and batch data problems, and mentor junior and mid\-level engineers to raise the engineering bar across the team. The ideal candidate pairs deep hands\-on expertise in streaming and distributed data systems with the judgment to make long\-lived platform decisions, the influence to align teams without direct authority, and a genuine commitment to growing other engineers. **About You** ------------- You are a hands\-on technical leader who designs platforms, not just pipelines. You are equally comfortable writing production code, defending an architecture in a design review, pairing with a junior engineer on a tricky problem, and explaining trade\-offs to executives. You bring: * Expert\-level knowledge of Google Cloud Platform data services, especially BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Dataflow (Apache Beam), Cloud Composer, and Cloud Storage * Deep experience designing real\-time and event\-driven architectures with exactly\-once semantics, late\-arriving data, and schema evolution * Mastery of Python and SQL, and data transformation frameworks such as dbt * A track record of setting technical direction for a platform used by many teams, and seeing it through multi\-quarter delivery * Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Pulumi or Terraform * Excellent problem\-solving skills with the ability to design scalable and efficient solutions * Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively * Outstanding communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to partner across technical and non\-technical teams * A continuous improvement mindset and passion for mentoring and knowledge sharing * A passion for mentoring junior engineers and building a strong engineering culture **Your Day\-to\-Day (Responsibilities)** ---------------------------------------- **Data Platform Architecture, jobs.title: Senior Software QA Engineer
jobs.description: As a Senior Software QA Engineer, you are the quality owner for the platforms that originate, underwrite, close, and service our business purpose loans. You will define how we test, build the automation that makes releases fast and safe, and raise the quality bar across engineering teams working in an environment of high\-volume transactions, sensitive borrower and financial data, and third\-party integrations. This is a hands\-on role with broad influence. You will write code, shape test strategy, and mentor other engineers and QA team members on building quality in from the start. **Duties and Responsibilities** * Define and drive the test strategy for web, mobile, API, and back\-end systems, covering functional, regression, integration, performance, and security testing. * Design, build, and maintain automated test frameworks and suites, and integrate them into CI/CD pipelines so every release is validated automatically. * Review requirements and designs early, and partner with product managers and engineers to define acceptance criteria and catch defects before code is written. * Test the loan lifecycle end to end, including applications, underwriting rules, pricing, document handling, closing, funding, and servicing, along with the third\-party integrations behind them. * Verify that systems meet the security, privacy, auditability, and regulatory requirements of the lending industry, including correct handling of PII and financial data. * Own release readiness: triage and prioritize defects, run regression and smoke testing, and give clear go or no\-go recommendations. * Build and manage test data and environments that mirror real lending scenarios without exposing production data. * Track quality metrics such as defect escape rate, test coverage, and flaky test rate, and use them to improve how we build and ship. * Mentor engineers and QA team members, and promote testing best practices across teams.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description: As a Staff Software Engineer, you are a senior individual contributor who leads technical direction for a team or group of teams. You take on our most complex and ambiguous engineering problems, design the systems behind our loan origination, underwriting, and servicing platforms, and raise the quality of engineering across the organization. You will work in an environment of high\-volume transactions, sensitive borrower and financial data, and third\-party integrations. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role. You will still write code, but your largest impact comes from architecture, unblocking teams, and growing the engineers around you. **Duties and Responsibilities** * Lead the technical direction and architecture for systems owned by one or more teams, and align that work with the broader platform. * Break down ambiguous, high\-impact problems into clear plans, and drive them from design to delivery across teams. * Design systems for scale, reliability, security, and maintainability, and make pragmatic tradeoffs between them. * Write, review, and improve code in high\-impact and high\-risk areas, especially lending\-critical workflows such as underwriting, pricing, and closing. * Partner with product managers, QA, design, and business stakeholders to turn challenging business problems and vague requirements into clear technical plans. * Lead design reviews and technical decisions, building consensus across teams with different priorities. * Own the technical integrity of integrations with loan origination systems, credit bureaus, pricing engines, and other third\-party vendors. * Build security, privacy, auditability, and regulatory requirements into our systems, including correct handling of PII and financial data. * Mentor senior and mid\-level engineers, and set standards for code quality, testing, and operational excellence.

Evidence may include development of scripts or small utilities that automate system administration tasks, interact with APIs, or support data or metadata processing workflows * Must possess a collaborative approach to team operations, characterized by a willingness to share routine technical tasks, a receptive attitude toward constructive engineering feedback, and a patient demeanor when interfacing with project stakeholders and non\-technical staff **Preferred Qualifications** * Conceptual or hands\-on familiarity with cloud storage services (e.g., AWS S3, Glacier) * Working knowledge of automation concepts (such as CI/CD frameworks, GitLab CI, or Infrastructure as Code), as evidenced by academic coursework, open\-source contributions, or hands\-on projects * Foundational understanding of centralized logging and system monitoring platforms (e.g., Splunk or equivalent open\-source tooling) to support proactive troubleshooting * Conceptual or hands\-on familiarity with network\-attached/distributed storage platforms (e.g., TrueNAS, Ceph) * Exposure to deploying containerized workloads using Docker (Dockerfiles, Compose) validated through academic projects or personal home labs **Overtime Status** Exempt: Not eligible for overtime **Appointment Type** Regular **Salary Information** $80,000 minimum dependent on qualifications and experience **Hours per week** 40 **Review Date** 11/03/2026 **Additional Information** Must be legally authorized to work in the United States on your first day of employment without sponsorship from Virginia Tech. The application package needs to include a resume, cover letter addressing the candidate’s experience with the responsibilities associated with the position, and the required and preferred qualifications, and the names of three(3\) references and their contact information. The successful candidate will be required to have a criminal conviction check. **About Virginia Tech** Dedicated to its motto, *Ut Prosim* (That I May Serve), Virginia Tech pushes the boundaries of knowledge by taking a hands\-on, transdisciplinary approach to preparing scholars to be leaders and problem\-solvers. A comprehensive land\-grant institution that enhances the quality of life in Virginia and throughout the world, Virginia Tech is an inclusive community dedicated to knowledge, discovery, and creativity. The university offers more than 280 majors to a diverse enrollment of more than 36,000 undergraduate, graduate, and professional students in eight undergraduate colleges, a school of medicine, a veterinary medicine college, Graduate School, and Honors College. The university has a significant presence across Virginia, including Blacksburg, the greater Washington, D.C. area, the Health Sciences and Technology Campus in Roanoke, sites in Newport News and Richmond, and numerous Extension offices and research institutes. A leading global research institution, Virginia Tech conducts more than $650 million in research annually. Virginia Tech endorses and encourages participation in professional development opportunities and university shared governance. These valuable contributions to university shared governance provide important representation and perspective, along with opportunities for unique and impactful professional development. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer II
jobs.description: Virta Health is on a mission to reverse metabolic disease in one billion people. Current treatment approaches aren’t working—over half of US adults have either type 2 diabetes or prediabetes, and obesity rates are at an all\-time high. Virta is changing this by helping people reverse their metabolic condition through innovations in technology, personalized nutrition, and virtual care delivery reinvented from the ground up. We have raised over $350 million from top\-tier investors, and partner with the largest health plans, employers, and government organizations to help their employees and members restore their health and take back their lives. Join us on our mission to reverse metabolic disease in one billion people. This role is a blend of **real\-world impact, technical challenge, and modern tooling**. You’ll help build and evolve Virta’s **data engagement platform** — the system that turns partner and internally derived data into eligibility decisions and campaign\-ready member audiences. You’ll anchor the engineering behind **Member Marketing**, which ensures the right members hear about Virta at the right time, and the **Coverage Eligibility** data it depends on, which determines whether someone can access life\-changing care. You’ll create a **trusted, observable path** from raw data to member outreach: making identity, deployment context, data freshness, and transformation behavior explainable; designing safe recovery and replay mechanisms; and building **reusable data capabilities** that replace one\-off operational workflows. You’ll **modernize file\- and API\-based data exchange** through explicit contracts, automated validation, observable workflows, and event\-driven integrations where appropriate — reducing manual intervention without assuming every partner can adopt the same integration model. We work in an **AI\-augmented** way. You’ll bring sound judgment about where AI\-assisted tooling improves velocity, data\-quality investigation, and operations — and where deterministic controls are required for correctness and safety. If you’re excited to **own foundational data infrastructure**, **turn ambiguous growth requirements into durable technical contracts**, and **lead a squad solving hard data\-correctness problems**, this is a place where you can thrive. **Responsibilities** ==================== * **Design and own the data contracts and processing semantics** that make identity, deployment context, eligibility, audience attributes, deduplication, and field persistence explicit and testable across the data lifecycle. * **Build end\-to\-end observability and reconciliation** that explains how source records become downstream outcomes — including data freshness, expected filtering, rejected records, deduplication, safe replay, and repair of historical state. * **Lead technical discovery and delivery** of high\-impact work across Member Marketing and Coverage Eligibility, collaborating closely with Product, data, and external partners. * **Partner with Product and Growth stakeholders** to translate evolving audience and workflow requirements into reusable platform capabilities, keeping business policy cleanly separated from technical implementation. * **Design for correctness and auditability in regulated workflows**, including data provenance, consent and suppression controls, rollback, replay, and safeguards against incorrect or cross\-customer data use. * **Modernize legacy, file\-based processes** toward well\-contracted, event\-driven integrations with strong observability, resilience, and security. * **Own systems end\-to\-end** — from architecture through operations — driving improvements in reliability, partner experience, and long\-term maintainability. * **Apply an experiment mindset** (Build\-Measure\-Learn) to validate assumptions and focus on outcomes over output, using AI\-assisted tooling where it improves speed and quality without compromising correctness. **90 Day Plan** =============== Within your first 90 days at Virta, we expect you will do the following: ### **First 30 Days: Learn \& Connect** * **Understand Virta’s data ecosystem** — architecture, key data flows, systems for Coverage Eligibility and Member Marketing, and how partners interact with Virta’s platform. * **Get familiar with existing processes and pain points** around file\-based exchanges, partner onboarding, data quality, and incident patterns. * **Build relationships** with key stakeholders: engineering teammates, product managers, the data team, and partner\-facing roles. * **Observe real\-world partner data issues**, reviewing tickets, Slack threads, and postmortems to identify recurring themes. ### **Days 31–60: Contribute \& Experiment** * **Ship production code**: contribute meaningfully to an in\-flight initiative touching data flows or partner integrations. * **Identify and propose a targeted improvement** using the Build\-Measure\-Learn loop — e.g., automating a partner data\-quality check or protot ata domains**, such as eligibility, claims, EHR, or member marketing — especially in regulated or partner\-integrated environments. * Experience with **customer\-data, marketing\-automation, or audience\-activation platforms** such as Braze, Segment, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, or comparable systems. * Prior work **modernizing legacy data flows**, including migrations from SFTP/file\-based systems to API\- or event\-driven architectures. * Familiarity with **data quality frameworks**, lineage tracking, or automated anomaly detection in data pipelines. * Demonstrated use of **AI/LLM\-based tooling** in engineering work — e.g., for test generation, documentation, data mapping, or observability. * Previous roles where you've had to **influence without formal authority**, or drive change across teams or systems you didn’t own directly. **Our Work Stack** ================== We don’t expect candidates to know everything on day one, but here are some of the tools we currently use day\-to\-day: **Cloud \& Infrastructure** * Google Cloud Platform: GKE (Kubernetes), Workflows, Pub/Sub, BigQuery, CloudSQL, Memorystore, Gemini **Data \& Modeling** * SQL, BigQuery, dbt, data contracts, lineage, reconciliation, and data\-quality testing **Dev \& Collaboration** * GitHub \+ GitHub Actions for CI/CD * Google Workspace for docs, specs, and async collaboration * ChatGPT \+ OpenAI platform to accelerate development, testing, documentation, and product use cases **Languages \& Tooling** * Golang (primary language for backend services) * Python (for data tooling, automation, AI workflows) * JavaScript/TypeScript (for internal tools and platform UIs) **Values\-driven culture** ========================== Virta’s company values drive our culture, so you’ll do well if: * You put **people first** and take care of yourself, your peers, and our patients equally * You have a strong sense of **ownership** and take initiative while empowering others to do the same * You prioritize positive **impact** over busy work * You have **no ego** and understand that everyone has something to bring to the table regardless of experience * You appreciate **transparency** and promote trust and empowerment through open access of information * You are **evidence\-based** and prioritize data and science over seniority or dogma * You **take risks and rapidly iterate** Is this role not quite what you're looking for? Join our Talent Community and follow us on Linkedin to stay connected! *Virta has a location based compensation structure. Starting pay will be based on a number of factors and commensurate with qualifications \& experience. For this role, the compensation range is $176,500 \- $228,000\. Information about Virta’s benefits is on our Careers page at:* *https://www.virtahealth.com/careers**.* *As part of your duties at Virta, you may come in contact with sensitive patient information that is governed by HIPAA. Throughout your career at Virta, you will be expected to follow Virta's security and privacy procedures to ensure our patients' information remains strictly confidential. Security and privacy training will be provided.* *As a remote\-first company, our team is spread across various locations with office hubs in Denver and San Francisco.* *Clinical roles:* *We currently* ***do not hire*** *in the following states: AK, HI, RI* *Corporate roles:* *We currently* ***do not hire*** *in the following states: AK, DE, HI, ME, MS, OK, SD, VT.* *Virta uses Ashby as its applicant tracking system, which incorporates AI\-powered tools (provided by OpenAI, AWS, and Google Gemini) in certain aspects of the recruiting process, including application review, candidate screening, and interview note taking; your data is not used to train AI models, and all final hiring decisions are made by Virta Health personnel.* **For more information, see Virta’s AI Interview Resources page.** **https://www.virtahealth.com/careers/ai\-interview\-resources** Compensation Range: $176\.5K \- $228K
