jobs.title: Sr. Data Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us** Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid. At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world. Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you. **Job Description** **Role Summary** The Senior Data Engineer will play a key role in designing, building, and evolving large\-scale data platforms and services that power reporting, analytics, and data products across Visa. This role is focused on building scalable, reliable data pipelines and reusable platform capabilities across modern cloud and big data environments. You will work with technologies such as Spark, PySpark, Kafka, Hadoop, and Hive to support batch and real\-time data processing at enterprise scale. Beyond building individual pipelines, you will help improve how data engineering is done across the organization by automating delivery processes, strengthening observability and data quality, establishing engineering standards, and developing reusable frameworks that enable teams to deliver new data products faster and more reliably. You will work across engineering, analytics, and product teams to solve complex data challenges and help shape the future of Visa's reporting and analytics platforms. **What You'll Do** * Design, build, and optimize large\-scale data pipelines and data services supporting batch and real\-time processing. * Develop scalable solutions using technologies such as Spark, PySpark, Kafka, Hadoop, Hive, and cloud\-based data platforms. * Architect data pipelines, data models, and reusable frameworks that support enterprise reporting, analytics, and data products. * Build shared platform capabilities, services, and automation that can be adopted across multiple engineering teams. * Improve data pipeline performance and reliability through performance tuning, workflow optimization, monitoring, and observability. * Automate deployment and delivery processes to improve engineering efficiency and reduce the time required to bring new data capabilities to production. * Establish automated quality gates and validation practices to improve data quality, reliability, and operational stability. * Develop reusable blueprints and engineering patterns for new data services and data products. * Implement and strengthen data governance practices, including data lineage, metadata management, access controls, monitoring, and validation. * Troubleshoot complex performance and reliability issues across distributed data systems and identify opportunities for architectural improvement. * Partner with engineering, analytics, product, and other technical teams to design and deliver end\-to\-end data solutions. * Evaluate emerging technologies, including Generative AI, and identify opportunities to improve data engineering and platform capabilities. * Lead technical initiatives from concept through implementation and adoption, influencing engineering practices across teams. * Mentor engineers and contribute to technical design reviews, architecture discussions, and engineering best practices. **What We're Looking For** * Hands\-on experience designing and building enterprise\-scale data platforms, pipelines, or distributed data processing solutions. * Strong experience with technologies such as Spark/PySpark, Kafka, Hadoop, Hive, or comparable big data technologies. * Experience supporting both batch and real\-time/streaming data processing. * Experience designing scalable data architectures and solving performance, reliability, and data quality challenges. * Experience building reusable data platforms, frameworks, shared services, or engineering capabilities used across multiple teams. * Strong understanding of data quality, governance, lineage, metadata, observability, and operational reliability. * Experience automating data engineering workflows, deployment pipelines, testing, and quality controls. * Ability to independently diagnose complex distributed\-system and data\-platform issues and drive them through resolution. * Ability to influence technical direction and drive initiatives across teams without requiring direct authority. * Strong ownership and the ability to move technical initiatives from design through production and broader adoption. Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager. **Qualifications** Basic Qualifications: * 2\+ years of relevant work experience and a Bachelors degree, OR 5\+ years of relevant work experience. Preferred Qualifications: * Experience designing and operating data platforms at enterprise scale. * Advanced experience with Apache Spark and PySpark, including performance tuning and optimization. * Experience with Kafka or comparable streaming technologies and real\-time processing architectures. * Experience with orchestration technologies such as Apache Airflow. * Experience with Hadoop, Hive, distributed storage, and modern cloud data architectures. * Experience developing automated data quality, validation, monitoring, and observability frameworks. * Experience with data governance capabilities including lineage, metadata management, and access controls. * Experience designing reusable data engineering frameworks, shared services, or self\-service platform capabilities. * Experience improving CI/CD and automated delivery practices for data platforms. * Exposure to Generative AI and its application within data engineering or analytics environments. * Demonstrated ability to lead technically complex initiatives across multiple engineering teams. **Information for US Applicants** For roles located in the US, the estimated salary range for this position is $118,700\.00 to $ 183,600\.00 USD per year, which may include potential sales incentive payments (if applicable). Salary may vary depending on job\-related factors which may include knowledge, skills, experience, and location. In addition, this position may be eligible for bonus and equity.Visa has a comprehensive benefits package for which this position may be eligible that includes Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), FSA/HSA, Life Insurance, Paid Time Off, and Wellness Program.**Work Hours** Varies upon the needs of the department. **Travel Requirements** This position requires travel 5\-10% of the time. **Mental/Physical Requirements** This position will be performed in an office setting. The position will require the incumbent to sit and stand at a desk, communicate in person and by telephone, frequently operate standard office equipment, such as telephones and computers. **Visa is an EEO Employer** Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protect veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, New York Magazine
jobs.description: **Staff Software Engineer,** ***New York*** **Magazine** **Vox Media Group LLC** Vox Media Group LLC is seeking a Staff Software Engineer to help shape the technology behind New York Magazine’s journalism and consumer subscriptions business. Your primary focus will be the websites, publishing platform, and subscription experiences supporting *New York*, The Cut, Vulture, Intelligencer, The Strategist, Grub Street, and Curbed. You’ll also contribute to the NYMag mobile apps for iOS and Android. As a hands\-on technical engineering leader, you’ll help editors publish compelling stories, readers discover journalism they value, and subscribers get the most from their relationship with our brands. Your work will span editorial experiences and the subscriber journey, from registration and purchase through onboarding, account management, and ongoing engagement. You’ll partner with product, design, editorial, and consumer revenue teams to guide technical decisions and deliver improvements across web and mobile. You’ll also help advance our responsible use of AI and agentic workflows to increase delivery speed, expand engineering capacity, and improve efficiency. **Your responsibilities will include:** --------------------------------------- * **Lead complex engineering initiatives.** Translate product and business needs into technical plans, align collaborators around architectural decisions, and guide projects from discovery through delivery and operation. * **Build and improve consumer subscription experiences.** Develop subscription offers, checkout flows, promotions, gifting, onboarding, and account management features that support acquisition, conversion, and retention. * **Strengthen subscriber identity and access.** Improve the integrations connecting authentication, payments, subscription status, and content entitlements so readers can reliably access what they’ve purchased across web and mobile. * **Support experimentation and growth.** Partner with consumer revenue, product, and analytics teams to improve paywalls, registration experiences, and subscription journeys through reliable experiments and measurable results. * **Evolve our publishing platform.** Build reusable components, editorial tools, and reader experiences that support the distinct needs of our brands and make publishing easier. * **Contribute to the NYMag mobile app.** Partner with mobile engineers on reading experiences, content discovery, and subscriber features. Design APIs and content models that support consistent experiences across platforms. * **Guide incremental modernization.** Identify architectural risks and technical debt, improve developer workflows, and balance near\-term delivery with the long\-term maintainability of an established platform. * **Improve quality and reliability.** Investigate production issues, strengthen automated testing and observability, and address performance, accessibility, and security across publishing and subscription workflows. * **Champion responsible AI use.** Develop and refine AI\-assisted and agentic workflows for implementation, testing, debugging, review, and documentation. Protect sensitive information, validate generated changes, and maintain accountability for the resulting software. * **Help the team succeed.** Mentor engineers, lead constructive code and design reviews, document important decisions, and establish shared practices that improve the team’s effectiveness. **We’re looking for someone who brings:** ----------------------------------------- * Deep JavaScript expertise and substantial experience building and operating production web applications and Node.js services. * A track record of leading complex technical initiatives across systems or teams, with impact beyond their individual contributions. * Strong frontend fundamentals, including HTML, CSS, accessibility, browser behavior, and application performance, alongside experience with frameworks such as Vue or React. * Experience designing APIs, data models, and integrations, including reliable handling of authentication, authorization, and transactional workflows. * Sound judgment when evolving mature codebases, including knowing when to extend existing patterns and when to introduce new approaches. * Strong debugging and testing skills, with experience diagnosing problems across application, service, and data boundaries. * The ability to connect engineering decisions to reader experience and business outcomes, including subscription conversion, engagement, and retention. * Experience using AI development tools responsibly, including providing useful context, evaluating generated output, and recognizing when human review and decision\-making are essential. * Clear communication, collaborative technical leadership, and the ability to contribute to a TypeScript and React Native codebase. **Additional experience that would be valuable includes:** ---------------------------------------------------------- * Consumer subscriptions, digital media, ecommerce, or other businesses built around recurring customer relationships. * Paywalls, payment platforms, subscription billing integrations, identity systems, or entitlement management. * Experimentation platforms, conversion analytics, and customer lifecycle experiences. * React Native, Expo, or shipping applications for iOS and Android. * Content management systems, editorial workflows, PostgreSQL, Redis, or Elasticsearch. * Building reusable AI workflows, agent tooling, or automation that improves engineering productivity. Our web platform uses Node.js, Express, Clay CMS, Vue, and Handlebars. Our mobile app uses TypeScript, React Native, and Expo. You’ll work across these technologies and the services connecting content, customer accounts, and subscriptions. We value curiosity, trust, respect, and clear communication. We’re looking for someone who enjoys sharing knowledge, learning from colleagues, and helping the whole team succeed. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn’t match every technology listed. **PAY TRANSPARENCY** The salary range listed below represents the minimum and maximum base pay for this position at the time of this posting. Final salary offered to the candidate selected for the position will be based on factors including but not limited to the candidate's skills and experience. Pay Range $160,000 \- $220,000 USD **OUR DEI COMMITMENT** Vox Media is committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can show up as their authentic selves and create their best work. We recognize that great stories, platforms, products and services come from people with all manner of backgrounds and experiences. We recognize that our commitments require ongoing work and sustained attention, as well as adaptation to new insights and best practices. Vox Media is an Equal Opportunity Employer and qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, disability, national origin, protected veteran status, age, or any other status protected by applicable national, federal, state, or local law. Vox Media will also consider all qualified applicants with criminal histories in accordance with applicable Fair Chance laws. We are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations as part of the application process to candidates with disabilities. If you require a reasonable accommodation as part of the application process, please contact our recruiting team (recruitment@voxmedia.com). **WHAT COMES NEXT** Our recruiting team will go through applications in a timely manner. Please note that our recruiting team will only contact you from @voxmedia.com email addresses, never via text message. Read more about how our recruiting team operates, and how to protect yourself from recruitment fraud, here.

COMPLIANCE, GOVERNANCE \& SOLUTION INTEGRITY * Financial Controls and Compliance: Maintain rigorous standards for data integrity, ensuring all automated reports and workflows are fully compliant with regulatory and internal audit standards. * Technical Integrity: Oversee report administration and version control to ensure the longevity and reliability of deployed solutions. * Risk Mitigation: Ensure all self\-service tools are built with robust error handling and audit trails to prevent operational drift. jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Requirements** "We Power the Magic!" That's our motto at Disney Experiences Technology (DXT). Our team creates world\-class immersive digital experiences for the Company's premier vacation brands, including Disney's Parks \& Resorts. We are responsible for the end\-to\-end digital and physical Guest experience for all technology and digital\-led initiatives across Food \& Beverage, and Merchandise lines of business. This role sits within the Retail \& Restaurant Technology organization and supports the Point of Sale (POS) platform — the system that powers every merchandise and dining transaction across our parks and resorts. Our platform is a large\-scale, distributed, event\-driven system. We work with a polyglot stack (PHP, Go, Python, Java) that we are actively modernizing, and we need engineers who embrace the platform as it is while helping shape what it becomes. The main client of our services is the POS terminal itself — an Android\-based hardware device used by thousands of Cast Members every day — so reliability, performance, and thoughtful API design directly impact the Guest and Cast experience. The Lead Software Engineer will report to the Manager, Software Engineering. What You Will Do * Lead and personally build (hands\-on coding expected) scalable, well\-documented backend services and APIs across our polyglot platform — PHP and Go microservices today, with a growing Java/Spring footprint — from technical specification through production delivery. * Set architectural direction for the POS platform: translate complex functional, technical, and business requirements into solution and system designs, produce architecture diagrams and proof\-of\-concepts, evaluate technology choices, and ensure new solutions integrate cleanly with surrounding Disney systems. * Drive the modernization roadmap, playing a leading technical role in the migration of existing PHP and Go microservices into Java/Spring applications — defining migration patterns, sequencing, coexistence strategies, and quality gates so we modernize without disrupting daily park operations. * Own the full software development life cycle for your team's deliverables: planning, estimation, design reviews, code reviews, automated testing, CI/CD, release management, production support, and post\-incident root\-cause analysis. * Lead and mentor a team of backend Software Engineers — provide day\-to\-day technical direction, unblock engineers, review designs and code, grow junior talent, and foster a culture of engineering excellence and psychological safety. * Assess and communicate risk: identify technical, delivery, and operational risks early; give clear direction on trade\-offs; and escalate to leadership with well\-formed options and recommendations when decisions exceed the team's authority. * Design and operate event\-driven and streaming integrations using Amazon Kinesis and RabbitMQ, ensuring our transaction, inventory, and reporting flows are resilient, idempotent, and observable. * Steward our data layer, designing performant schemas and access patterns on Amazon Aurora (MySQL\-compatible), guiding ORM usage, and safeguarding transactional integrity for a system where every record represents real money and a real Guest. * Champion AI\-assisted engineering, embedding tools such as Claude, Cursor, and Codex into the team's daily workflow — from design and coding to testing and troubleshooting — and shaping responsible adoption practices that raise both velocity and quality. * Collaborate cross\-functionally with product owners, program management, architecture, QA, hardware/terminal teams, and vendor partners to align solutions with current and future business needs, and represent the team in tactical and strategic forums with all levels of leadership. * Support production, participating in on\-call rotations and go\-lives for a platform where availability matters most during the moments our Guests are creating memories. Required Qualifications and Skills * 7\+ years of progressive experience designing, building, and operating large\-scale, high\-volume backend systems and services, including 2\+ years leading engineers or serving as technical lead across the full software development life cycle. * Strong hands\-on expertise in PHP (modern PHP 8\+; experience with a major framework such as Laravel or Symfony) and Go (idiomatic Go for microservices; familiarity with common toolkits such as Gin, Echo, or gRPC\-Go). * Working proficiency in Java and Spring / Spring Boot, with the ability to lead the design and buildout of new Java services as part of our microservices migration. * Deep understanding of RDBMS fundamentals — schema design, indexing, query optimization, transactions, isolation levels — with hands\-on experience on Amazon Aurora and/or MySQL, and practical experience with ORMs (e.g., Hibernate/JPA) including knowing when *not* to use them. * Production experience with streaming and eventing architectures: Amazon Kinesis ts leadership be surprised. * Adaptable and curious — thrives in a fast\-changing, sometimes ambiguous environment, and treats an unfamiliar tech stack as an opportunity rather than an obstacle. * Collaborative and inclusive — works effectively with distributed/remote teams and fosters an environment where every engineer's voice is heard. Preferred Qualifications * Experience with Point of Sale, payments, retail, or restaurant technology, including operational realities of transaction\-critical systems. * Experience building for or integrating with Android\-based clients or embedded/terminal hardware, and designing APIs that serve intermittently connected devices gracefully. * Working knowledge of Python for scripting, tooling, or services. * Experience with React or a modern front\-end framework, enough to partner effectively with web engineers on end\-to\-end features. * Hands\-on experience leading a platform migration or re\-platforming effort (e.g., PHP/Go to Java, monolith to microservices, or vendor\-to\-in\-house transition). * Experience managing external vendor relationships and deliverables, including technical assessment of vendor work quality. * Familiarity with SRE practices: SLOs/SLIs, error budgets, chaos/resilience testing, and distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry). * Knowledge of security\-by\-design principles for services handling financial transactions. * Experience in the Disney, theme park, hospitality, or Food \& Beverage domain. to drive informed investment decisions and optimize field performance. **Key Responsibilities:** * Provide reservoir engineering support for development of Warwick’s operated Ardmore and/or Marietta development for Warwick WP3 assets, including spacing, well count, completions design, and flowback strategies. * Collaborate with geology and land teams on technical reviews, type curve maintenance, and updates for drilling locations. * Proactively identify and evaluate potential acreage trades or acquisitions aligned with geologic and reservoir performance objectives to enhance operated positions. * Support asset development and acquisition \& divestiture (A\&D) efforts through reservoir modeling, performance forecasting, and economic evaluation. * Prepare technical materials and present findings to the Investment Committee to support strategic decision\-making. * Analyze basin\-wide analogs and development trends in spacing and completions to recommend optimal field development strategies. * Evaluate existing well performance and flowback data, identify refrac candidates, and maintain accurate forecasts for base production. * Apply advanced reservoir engineering techniques—including decline curve analysis, original oil/gas in place (OOIP/OGIP) estimation, rate\-transient analysis (RTA), and EUR assessment—to drive key insights and optimize recovery. * Partner with operations and production teams to enhance well performance and ensure alignment of technical and operational objectives. * Assess smaller\-scale A\&D opportunities and support the evaluation of larger strategic transactions. **Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in Petroleum, Chemical, or Mechanical Engineering. * 5\+ years of reservoir engineering experience in unconventional development; Ardmore and/or Marietta basin experience preferred. * Proven success working in multidisciplinary teams, with strong collaboration, initiative, and innovation. * Analytical, detail\-oriented, and proactive, with sound judgment even in ambiguous situations. * Ability to work independently and take projects from concept to completion with minimal supervision. * Strong communication and presentation skills, including experience presenting to senior leadership. * Proficient in Aries, with solid working knowledge of Excel and Spotfire, Combo Curve or Whitson a plus * Committed to Through its Advanced Technology Center (ATC)—a collaborative ecosystem featuring state\-of\-the\-art hardware and software—WWT enables clients and partners to conceptualize, test and validate innovative technology and then deploy solutions at scale using its global integration and distribution capabilities. With more than 14,000 team members and over 60 locations globally, WWT's culture—grounded in core values and leadership philosophies—has been recognized by Fortune® and Great Place to Work for its commitment to innovation, trust and creating a great place to work for all. WWT provides products and services to large enterprise, global service provider and public sector clients in up to 130 countries across six continents. Softchoice, a World Wide Technology company, supports commercial and SMB markets in the U.S. and Canada. Want to work with highly motivated individuals on high\-performance teams? Join WWT today! **What will you be doing?** Successful candidates will have a background in full stack development and will be responsible for the translation of business needs into IT solutions with current programs, projects, and initiatives in mind. The ideal candidate for this position is detail\-oriented, highly innovative and has passion for learning both business and technical processes. At World Wide Technology (WWT) our vision is to be the best technology solution provider in the world. We have remained successful and continue to grow through the recent difficult economic conditions. We strive to build a profitable, growth company that's also a great place to work. **What is the IT Sales Solutions Team, and Why Join?** The IT Sales Solutions team exists to empower WWT's global sales organization and accelerate business outcomes. We support and optimize the technology ecosystem that enables the sales lifecycle—from opportunity identification to closed business—and deliver innovative, scalable tools that fuel the productivity and performance of our sales teams. By joining the IT Sales Solutions team, you will be part of a group dedicated to supporting one of the most critical engines of WWT's growth. You'll collaborate across business and technology teams to deliver high‑impact solutions that improve sales effectiveness, streamline operations, and unlock new strategic capabilities. This team is fast‑moving, collaborative, and deeply invested in creating scalable, modern solutions that help our sellers win. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to solutions that directly impact WWT's revenue engine and long‑term growth strategy. **Responsibilities** * Design, develop, and implement custom software and database application capabilities for a variety of legacy and modernized systems with limited oversight * Integrate AI capabilities into existing and new applications, leveraging LLMs, agents, and automation to enhance functionality and user experience * Contribute to a culture of AI literacy within the engineering team, sharing strategies for safe, ethical, and effective use of AI in software development and encouraging experimentation with new AI\-enhanced workflows * Stay current on emerging AI technologies, frameworks, and patterns; make recommendations for adoption where they add measurable value * Proactively participate in organizational web platform efforts such as quality assurance, upgrade survivability, and resiliency * Do your part in release and sprint planning, story creation, sprint testing, regression testing, user acceptance testing, demonstrations, retrospectives and solution releases * Ensuring product quality and timeliness of work, providing advice and guidance, resolving problems to meet engineering guidelines * Provide follow on support for post\-production release features including on\-call rotation support (approximately 1 week per quarter) * Provide technical mentoring for team members, including guidance on AI\-assisted development practices, architectural best practices, and technical roadmaps * Act as a member of a product team supporting teammates and collaborating with a proactive attitude to ensure product and team success * Perform other tasks as identified by your manager to enable team success

jobs.title: Principal Engineer - Reporting & Insights
jobs.description: **About the Role** ------------------ Millions of small businesses and their advisors use Xero reports and insights to decide what to do next. AI is changing how people understand their finances faster than any shift since the cloud, and Reporting \& Insights is where Xero meets that change. Over the next few years we’re evolving reporting and insights for the agentic era, where customers ask an AI about their numbers as often as they open a Balance Sheet. As the senior technical leader for Reporting \& Insights, you’ll set the multi\-year technical direction, from the reports businesses file to the insights that tell them what to do next. You’ll also help hire the first Reporting \& Insights engineers in Vancouver and decide how they work. **The Technical Challenges** ---------------------------- **Set a 3\-year architecture across Reporting \& Insights.** Reporting and Xero Analytics run on a mix of modern services and systems that have grown with Xero over many years. You’ll define one target state across both, decide how they build on Xero’s data platform, and secure the investment to get there. You’ll design for high throughput, low latency and resilience, so reporting and insights scale with Xero’s largest and most complex customers. **Evolve the platform without breaking trust.** Accountants file tax returns from these numbers, so correctness comes first. You’ll lead the evolution of the data foundations behind about 150 reports, sequenced across teams and organisational boundaries. Customers keep the numbers they trust, on foundations built for what comes next. **Make reporting and insights AI\-native.** AI changes what reporting and insights can be: answers to plain\-language questions, insights that reach customers where they work, and analysis that once took an accountant hours. Every answer still has to reconcile to the ledger. You’ll define the foundations: how agents query financial data safely, how answers stay grounded and explainable, and how we prove correctness at scale. We want teams across Xero to build on what you create. **Impact** ---------- In your **first six months** you’ll own the Reporting \& Insights architecture and set a direction for the data platform and the evolution of both products that engineering, Product and leadership back. **At twelve months you will have:** * Set a multi\-year technical strategy for Reporting \& Insights * Delivered new foundations for the first major report families, setting Reporting \& Insights up for its next phase of growth * Opened Reporting \& Insights to bigger businesses, with performance that scales to our largest customers * Put shared foundations for AI\-native reporting and insights into production * Grown the Lead and Senior Engineers around you and raised the technical bar across the group Beyond year one, you’ll shape where Reporting \& Insights goes next, and help steer Xero’s wider data and AI direction alongside the leadership team. **Ownership** ------------- You’re the senior technical voice for Reporting \& Insights. You own the multi\-year technical strategy and target architecture, and you make the calls that cross team and domain boundaries. You shape the roadmap with the GM and Product, decide where we invest in foundational capabilities, and align teams across regions behind one direction. You stay hands\-on where it counts: reference implementations, foundational frameworks and the hardest architecture problems **Who You’ll Work With** ------------------------ You’ll report to the GM of Engineering. You’ll partner with the engineering managers and teams across Reporting \& Insights, who know these products and their data in depth. You’ll shape the product and AI roadmap with the Reporting \& Insights Product leads. You’ll also work with Principal Engineers and platform teams across Xero, including the accounting core and data platform teams that own systems we depend on. **What You Bring** ------------------ **Must\-have:** * You’ve set technical strategy for a domain or portfolio over a 2 to 3 year horizon, and aligned multiple teams behind it. * You’ve led the evolution of a large, high\-traffic, correctness\-critical system across organisational boundaries. * You have depth in high\-throughput, low\-latency, resilient distributed systems and data\-heavy architecture, and you still contribute hands\-on where it matters. * You connect external shifts, AI above all, to product and architecture strategy, and you know where LLMs and agents belong in a system. * You grow leaders. You’ve mentored Lead and Senior Engineers into bigger roles, and your writing turns complex direction into decisions people act on. **Nice to have:** * Financial, reporting or analytics domain experience * LLM or agent\-based features in production * .NET and AWS * A presence in the wider tech community through talks, writing or open source **How We Work** --------------- We’re bold in our vision and pragmatic in execution, delivering useful improvements along the way rather than waiting for a large rewrite. We invest in AI to learn faster and focus effort on higher\-value problems, while engineers stay accountable for what they ship. We use shared frameworks to avoid reinvention, leaving teams room to innovate. Engineers own their work, including quality, reliability, and on\-call. Leaders set context and priorities, and engineers help shape the solutions. **Where We Work** ----------------- We offer a hybrid model that blends the flexibility of working from home with the collaboration of the office, including designated boost days in our modern office spaces. **This role is open to hybrid candidates in Vancouver, British Columbia, or San Mateo, California.** We also welcome applications from candidates across Canada interested in relocating to Vancouver, and from remote candidates in Seattle, Washington. **Our Hiring Process** ---------------------- * **TX phone screen** (45 minutes): a conversation with your Talent Specialist about your background, motivations and the role. * **Technical assessments:** a coding assessment and a systems design assessment, run through an independent third\-party provider and based on real\-world scenarios. * **Technical deep dive** (45–60 minutes): with a Principal Engineer and the hiring team. You'll walk through a past project you led, covering how you thought about it, executed it and led through its complexity. * **Values / Future Proof Xero** (45 minutes): how you show up day to day, aligned with Xero's values and capabilities such as adaptability, ownership, customer thinking and AI fluency. * **LEADership** (45–60 minutes): real examples of how you lead, influence and deliver in ambiguous, fast\-changing environments, assessed against Xero's leadership principles **Compensation \& Total Rewards** --------------------------------- At Xero, we value the impact and skills you bring to the team. We don’t just hire for a role; we invest in people. We believe in a Total Package philosophy \- which means your value isn't just a single number on a paycheque. While base salary is a core component, we look at your compensation through a holistic lens that includes equity, performance incentives, and world\-class benefits. The expected base salary range for this role in: * Washington, WA \& San Mateo, CA: **$287,000 \- $320,000 USD** Individual pay is determined by various factors, including geography, level of experience, and the specific skills you bring to the role. In addition to base pay, Xero’s roles are eligible for the following forms of variable compensation: * **Variable Pay:** Permanent employees are eligible to participate in our annual bonus and equity (RSU) programs. You may also be eligible for performance\-based cash or equity (RSUs) incentives depending on your role level, and company performance. * **Comprehensive Benefits:** Medical, dental, vision, 401(k) match, and 21 days PTO, 10 days of Wellbeing leave, 5 days of Xtra Leave, 1 volunteer day, 12 paid holidays, paid parental leave. Further information included on our **Xero Perks** page *Xero uses AI to help screen applications based on job\-related qualifications. These tools assist our recruiters but do not make automated hiring decisions. A human recruiter reviews all candidates before any hiring action is taken.*

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: #### **ABOUT** **XSOLLA** Xsolla is a global video game commerce company headquartered in Los Angeles. It helps developers from indie to AAA fund, distribute, market and monetize their games, and acts as merchant of record for 1,500\+ developers worldwide. For more information, visit xsolla.com. ### **The role** We are hiring a **Software Engineer, Web3** for **Xsolla****ZK**, Xsolla's Web3 ecosystem on a zkSync\-based L2\. It includes: * smart wallets built on account abstraction; * SDKs that game studios and partners use to bring players on\-chain; * infrastructure backend services for tokenizing in\-game items and currencies; * ecosystem dApps: a DEX, an NFT marketplace and an auction. This is a senior fullstack role: you work across backend, frontend and smart contracts. #### **WHAT YOU WILL OWN** * Features end to end: backend, frontend and production * The on\-chain / off\-chain architecture of your product: what lives in contracts, what lives in services, and how the two stay consistent. You make these decisions and justify them in writing * Security and correctness of what you ship: signing flows, interactions with contracts that hold user assets, keys and secrets * Production operation of your services, as part of the team's on\-call rotation #### **WHAT YOU WILL DO** * Build backend services in Go and TypeScript: chain indexing, transaction relaying, event processing, APIs for dApps and SDKs * Build infrastructure backend services for tokenizing in\-game items and currencies * Build dApp frontends in React: wallet connection, transaction signing, on\-chain state in the UI * Integrate smart wallets into products: accounts, paymasters, bundlers * Develop SDKs used by game studios and partners * Monitor services and contracts in production and take part in on\-call * Review code * Set up and maintain AI tooling in the repositories (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor: rules, context, harness) so the team uses it effectively ### **Required** **Experience** * 5\+ years of commercial software development, with senior\-level production experience across backend and frontend * dApps that you shipped to production and maintained **Web3 libraries and wallets** * viem and wagmi in production: clients and transports, contract reads and writes with typed ABIs, event subscriptions, wagmi hooks and connectors, caching and invalidation of on\-chain state * How wallet signers work: EOAs, browser and embedded wallets, smart accounts; personal\_sign (EIP\-191\) and typed data (EIP\-712\); the EIP\-1193 provider; network switching * Hands\-on experience with smart wallets: UserOperations, gas sponsored via paymasters, signature validation for contract accounts (ERC\-1271\) **Backend** * Go and TypeScript (Node.js) for production services * Processing on\-chain events: idempotency, reorg handling, retries * Asynchronous messaging and event\-driven design (Kafka, RabbitMQ or NATS): delivery guarantees, ordering, reprocessing * Relational databases (PostgreSQL) and caching (Redis) * Designing REST and gRPC APIs: versioning, backward compatibility **Frontend** * React and TypeScript: rendering model, state management, performance * Web security fundamentals: XSS, CSRF, CSP, safe handling of signatures and keys in the browser **Smart contracts** * Reading and understanding Solidity contracts and the EVM (storage, gas, call semantics, proxy upgrade patterns, access control) well enough to integrate with them safely and review changes * Common contract vulnerability classes (reentrancy, front\-running / MEV, oracle manipulation, signature replay) and how they affect the off\-chain side **Operations** * Containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes) at the level of deploying and debugging your own services * Observability (we use Datadog; experience with Prometheus, Grafana, ELK / Graylog or OpenTelemetry also counts): metrics, logs, tracing and alerting for services and contracts; diagnosing incidents in production **Engineering practices** * Testing: unit, integration, E2E * Git, CI/CD (GitLab CI or similar) **AI\-assisted engineering** * Daily hands\-on use of AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) for development and review, including configuring them for a repository **English** * Spoken English at B2 level or higher ### **Nice to have** * zkSync / ZK Stack and the specifics of the zk\-rollup stack * Designing, writing and testing smart contracts in Solidity with Foundry; deploying and upgrading them safely * Building ERC\-4337 infrastructure yourself (bundlers, paymasters); EIP\-6963, EIP\-5792 * DeFi: DEX and AMM mechanics * NFTs and marketplaces: ERC\-721, ERC\-1155, auction mechanics * L2 infrastructure: running nodes, indexers, bridges * Designing SDKs for external developers * Gaming domain experience #### **HOW WE WORK** * **Decisions in writing.** Significant technical decisions are written up as an RFC or ADR that lays out the options and trade\-offs. We discuss the document, not a blank whiteboard. * **AI is part of everyday engineering.** We use AI coding tools for development and review, and we treat configuring them for a codebase as real engineering work. #### **HOW WE HIRE** * **Intro call.** Your background, your motivation and the role. * **Technical interview.** Built directly on the *What you will own* and *Required* sections above. We won't ask about anything this posting doesn't promise. * **Bar raiser.** An engineer from outside the hiring team checks that you raise the overall engineering bar. #### **THE TEAM** You will work alongside product managers, designers, smart contract, backend and frontend engineers, QA and DevOps. #### **BENEFITS** We are passionate about fostering a supportive environment for our team, so we prioritize the physical, mental, and emotional well\-being of our employees and their families through a comprehensive Benefits Program. This includes medical, dental, and vision, PTO, and a personalized career roadmap for each employee. By investing in professional development through training and educational opportunities, we ensure that our team thrives both personally and professionally. Together, we're not just building a business; we're cultivating a community that values creativity, collaboration, and the transformative power of play. #### **EMPLOYMENT DETAILS** * **Location:** Remote (worldwide) * **Employment Type:** Full\-time * **Schedule:** 10:00–19:00 (flexible) * **Contract:** Employment agreement (entity or EOR arranged per candidate location) #### **EQUAL EMPLOYMENT STATEMENT** Xsolla is dedicated to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal\-opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, language, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, political beliefs, disability, age, marital status, social background or other characteristics. We are committed to compliance with all fair employment practices regarding citizenship and immigration status. #### **CONTACT** If you have questions regarding our hiring practices, please contact careers@xsolla.com. For more vacancies, visit xsolla.com/careers. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Telecom Engineer I

These values \- integrity, patient\-centered, respect, accountability, and compassion \- must guide what we do, as individuals and professionals, every day. The Senior Telecommunications Project Analyst supports all YNHHS sites including all YNHHS owned and leased locations, NEMG sites and YSM locations. Projects include building renovations, new buildings, acquisitions or telecommunications equipment migrations. The Analyst is responsible for coordinating all aspects of the project related to telecommunications. The analyst stays updated by attending weekly facility design meetings and customer meetings to understand business requirements. The Analyst designs solutions to meet the needs of customers and utilizes a consulting style approach to advise customers on how to best use available telecom products and services to support their business needs. Must be able to effectively manage multiple complex projects at the same time. Provides user training and post cutover support. Meets all project deliverables on time and within budget. EEO/AA/Disability/Veteran Responsibilities: * 1\. Project Coordination * + 1\.1 Attend all facility construction meetings * 2\. Project Finance * + 2\.1 Estimate costs for infrastructure, hardware, applications, accessories * 3\. Pinnacle Project Inputs * + 3\.1 Input projects into PinnacleTelemanagement System * 4\. Customer Service * + 4\.1 Continually demonstrates professionalism and respect for team mates and customers Qualifications: EDUCATION Bachelors or equivalent technical training and experience. jobs.title: Software Engineering Manager
jobs.description: Yext (NYSE: YEXT) is the enterprise agentic marketing platform. Built on the world's most comprehensive structured data platform for local businesses, Yext gives brands and their partners the visibility intelligence to win every moment of discovery – across AI and traditional search. Yext's API\-first architecture connects structured data to APIs, MCP servers, and generative interfaces, so partners and developers can build purpose\-built experiences on the same infrastructure powering Yext's own products. Thousands of brands and digital marketing partners in financial services, healthcare, retail, hospitality, and food rely on Yext to manage, measure, and optimize visibility at scale. For more information, visit yext.com. At Yext, **Product Engineering** builds and evolves the technology behind our products and services. We're looking for engineering managers who want to lead strong teams, solve meaningful technical problems, and help shape what we build next. We work in an agile environment with two\-week sprints and regular demos that keep teams aligned and give engineers clear visibility into the impact of their work. As an engineering manager, you'll partner closely with Product and Engineering leaders to set direction, turn broader priorities into actionable plans, and create an environment where engineers can do their best work and continue to grow. We are looking for an engineering manager to join the **Knowledge Graph** team, which builds and maintains the systems that turn customer information into a connected, usable source of truth. The team develops the core infrastructure, APIs, and workflows that help brands model, manage, and connect their knowledge across products and experiences. The work involves challenging engineering problems, including representing complex real\-world entities, processing large volumes of changing data, building reliable distributed systems, and creating interfaces that allow other teams to build confidently on top of the graph. This is an opportunity for engineers who enjoy foundational technology, thoughtful data modeling and system design, and seeing their work enable a wide range of customer experiences. This role is based in our New York City office in the Chelsea neighborhood of Manhattan, where in\-person collaboration plays an important part in how our teams work, learn, and build relationships. We're looking for people who genuinely value that environment and are comfortable coming into the office at least three days per week. At the same time, we don't prescribe specific in\-office days and want employees to have the flexibility to handle personal needs without disrupting their work or team collaboration. **What You'll Do** * Lead and develop a team of software engineers, providing regular coaching, actionable feedback, and support for their career growth * Partner with Product and Engineering leadership to translate product priorities and longer\-term goals into clear, achievable plans for the team * Own the team's execution and delivery, establishing priorities, breaking larger initiatives into manageable work, and maintaining a sustainable development cadence * Create clarity for the team by resolving ambiguity, removing blockers, managing competing priorities, and protecting engineers from unnecessary organizational churn and distractions * Maintain a strong technical understanding of the team's systems and provide guidance on architecture, design, implementation, and technical tradeoffs * Foster a high bar for engineering quality through thoughtful design discussions, code reviews, testing, operational readiness, and continuous improvement * Ensure the team is prepared to respond effectively to production incidents, providing leadership and coordination during incidents and driving meaningful follow\-up afterward * Build an environment where engineers take ownership, collaborate effectively, learn from one another, and feel comfortable raising concerns and challenging assumptions * Collaborate across Product Engineering and with partners throughout the company to coordinate dependencies, resolve issues, and deliver shared initiatives * Recruit and hire talented engineers, actively participate in the interview process, and build an effective onboarding experience for new team members * Identify opportunities to improve the team's systems, processes, and ways of working, and help turn those opportunities into meaningful change * Model thoughtful use of AI\-assisted development tools and help engineers incorporate AI effectively throughout design, research, implementation, testing, debugging, and code review * Maintain a high\-quality bar for AI\-assisted work by ensuring engineers understand and validate generated output and remain accountable for its correctness, security, maintainability, and alignment with engineering standards * Encourage experimentation with new AI capabilities and workflows, share successful approaches across the team, and help identify opportunities where AI can meaningfully improve engineering effectiveness **What You Have** * A BA/BS in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent college\-level education * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience * 1\+ years of team or technical leadership * Experience coaching engineers, providing direct and constructive feedback, and supporting their professional development * Experience translating product or business priorities into technical plans and driving a team toward successful delivery * The ability to stay technically engaged enough to guide design decisions, evaluate tradeoffs, and help engineers work through difficult problems * Strong communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to create clarity when priorities or requirements are ambiguous * A track record of building healthy, effective engineering teams while holding a high bar for quality and accountability * Experience using AI\-assisted development tools and the ability to evaluate their output critically as part of a responsible engineering workflow * Sound judgment regarding data privacy, intellectual property, security, and the appropriate use of confidential information when working with AI tools * Strong technical judgment and a foundation in software architecture, design, data structures, and algorithms * Fluency with Java, Go, C\+\+, Python, or a similar programming language (we code primarily in Java and Go) * Experience recruiting, interviewing, and onboarding software engineers * Openness to new technologies, new ways of working, and creative solutions * Comfort working in a fast\-paced environment \#LI\-JB2 Yext is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a results\-driven, engaging culture where every employee has the opportunity to contribute to the success of the Company, perform at the highest possible level, and grow their skills and capabilities. Yext welcomes employees and applicants of all backgrounds and demographics, and does not engage in discrimination on the basis of any protected characteristic recognized under applicable law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. The Company believes a broad variety of life experiences across the Yext team is critical to its mission to help every business in the world be visible everywhere customers search. By seeking out fresh perspectives and fostering a positive interview experience and employee experience, Yext can remain at the forefront of innovation, and better serve its customers. It is Yext's policy to provide reasonable accommodations to people with disabilities as required by applicable law. If you have a disability that requires an accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, or participating in the employee selection process, please complete this form. **Security Alert** All legitimate Yext communications come from @yext.com email addresses. Messages from other domains (for example, @yext.team) are not authorized and are likely fraudulent. If you receive a message that seems suspicious, do not share personal information, click on links, or provide payment. Instead, please report the communication to security@yext.com.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Professional I

United by curiosity and a culture of caring, we develop smart solutions that anticipate our customer’s and partner’s needs and solve their challenges. Being part of Zebra Nation means you are seen, heard, valued, and respected. Drawing from our unique perspectives, we collaborate to deliver on our purpose. jobs.title: Applied Research Scientist, World Model
jobs.description: **About the team** ------------------ The Agentic Foundations team is a focused group of 15–20 applied scientists within Zillow's broader Agentic AI organization, building the foundational AI technologies that power the next generation of home shopping experiences. We are building a Zillow World Model: a model of the housing market and the people in it that our agents can reason with. jobs.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description: AutoStore™ holds a simple yet powerful vision: to store and move things for everyone, everywhere. Founded in Norway, we've grown into a global technology company. AutoStore uses advanced software to automate and orchestrate order fulfillment. Our goal is to ensure orders arrive faster than ever, with minimal environmental impact. That’s how we help brands exceed customer expectations. We have more than 1600 systems in nearly 60 countries, and we grow continuously as a community of employees, partners, customers, suppliers, and connected technologies. Automation should make life easier, and by listening carefully to our community, we innovate to meet the industry’s most complex needs. With AutoStore™, brands gain speed, efficiency, and improved workplaces. And much more floor space. AutoStore – moving things forward. **The Role** AutoStore is hiring a Senior Mechanical Engineer who has successfully carried new products to market. We are looking for an engineer with experience taking complex electromechanical products from concept to launch. The successful engineer will have owned mechanical systems through the challenges encountered during development and production, including reliability failures, wear and fatigue issues, manufacturing constraints, supplier quality challenges, tolerance stack\-up issues, and the difficult design trade\-offs required to deliver robust, scalable products without compromising long\-term performance. This individual will serve as a technical leader, owning the architecture and development of key mechanical subsystems within AutoStore's robotic and automation platforms. They will be expected to balance performance, reliability, manufacturability, serviceability, and cost while delivering innovative solutions that can be successfully deployed at scale. **Key Tasks and Responsibilities:** Mechanical System Ownership – Concept Through Production * Lead the design and development of mechanical and electromechanical systems from concept through architecture, CAD design, prototyping, validation, and production release. * Own subsystem architecture, component strategy, and technical trade\-offs balancing performance, reliability, manufacturability, and cost. * Design and develop mechanical solutions including structural components, mechanisms, drive systems, robotic assemblies, and other electromechanical systems. * Lead and execute root\-cause investigations of design, manufacturing, reliability, and field\-performance issues. * Perform and guide engineering analysis, including FEA, fatigue analysis, tolerance stack\-ups, dynamic analysis, vibration assessments, and design verification activities. * Drive DFM, DFA, DFR, and DFx activities with suppliers and manufacturing partners to ensure scalable and cost\-effective production. * Own prototype builds, engineering validation testing, pilot builds, and production launch activities. * Partner closely with electrical, firmware, software, controls, manufacturing, and systems engineering teams to ensure successful product integration. * Develop robust mechanical systems capable of operating reliably within demanding robotic and automated warehouse environments. * Define and execute functional, environmental, vibration, fatigue, wear, and life\-cycle testing to validate product performance and reliability. Support supplier development, component qualification, manufacturing readiness, and continuous product improvement initiatives. * **Key Qualifications:** * 9\+ years of experience in mechanical engineering and product development of complex mechanical or electromechanical systems. * Experience leading products from concept through validation, production launch, and sustaining engineering. * Strong proficiency with 3D CAD, FEA, FMEA, PLM systems, and engineering documentation best practices. * Experience in designing mechanisms and electromechanical systems incorporating motors, gear trains, bearings, belt drives, actuators, sensors, and power transmission components. * Strong understanding of mechanical system dynamics, kinematics, fatigue, wear mechanisms, vibration, and reliability engineering. * Experience performing GD\&T, tolerance analysis, tolerance stack\-ups, and design verification activities. * Experience performing structural, modal, and dynamic analysis of mechanical systems and moving machinery. * Experience selecting materials and manufacturing processes for high\-volume products, including sheet metal, aluminum extrusions, castings, machined components, and injection\-molded plastics. * Strong understanding of Design for Manufacturing (DFM), Design for Assembly (DFA), Design for Reliability (DFR), and Design for Cost (DFC). * Experience working with global suppliers and contract manufacturing partners to support high\-volume production. * Experience with requirements development, interface management, risk assessment, and system\-level trade studies. * Demonstrated technical leadership, including subsystem ownership, technical decision\-making, design reviews, and mentoring of engineers. * Strong troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis skills with a hands\-on engineering mindset. Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, or a related field (relevant experience may substitute for formal education). * **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience developing robotics, automation equipment, autonomous systems, material handling equipment, or industrial machinery. * Experience with warehouse automation, ASRS systems, or automated fulfillment technologies. * Experience with reliability growth testing, accelerated life testing, and field\-performance analysis. * Experience working within cross\-functional product development teams spanning mechanical, electrical, controls, and software disciplines. Experience with automated warehouse products is preferred. * **We Offer:** AutoStore believes in taking care of employees and is dedicated to providing a supportive and rewarding work environment. Join us in our mission to store and move things for everyone, everywhere. * Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision plans * Health Savings Account (HSA) with a company contribution * Generous Paid Time Off including 12 holidays, paid exercise time, paid volunteer time, and paid parental leave plans for all new parents * Retirement 401(k) plan with employer match and discretionary profit sharing contribution * Educational assistance and professional development programs, including mentorship/coaching programs with external industry leaders Additional benefits include Group Life Insurance, Voluntary Additional Life Insurance, Disability Insurance, Employee Assistance programs, and more! * AutoStore is an Equal Opportunity Employer that does not discriminate on the basis of actual or perceived race, color, creed, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, sex or gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, pregnancy\-related conditions, and lactation), gender identity or expression (including transgender status), sexual orientation, marital status, military service and veteran status, physical or mental disability, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws and ordinances.

jobs.title: Senior / Staff AI Platform Engineer
jobs.description: **About Suno** ============== We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world. Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible. Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA). **About the Role** ================== Suno's song creation agent is becoming something other teams build on. As a Senior AI Platform Engineer, you'll build the APIs, SDKs and shared tooling, including eval infrastructure, tracing and model routing, that let engineers across Suno ship agent features faster. You'll work closely with the agent team, partner teams and Infra, and your customers are other engineers, so adoption is a measure of success. You'll help shape the platform as it grows. **Listen to the song we made about it:** **https://suno.com/s/bxgQXsn06Vz3KKEn** **What You'll Do** ================== * Design and build the platform APIs and SDKs that other teams use to build agent features. * Develop shared eval infrastructure, including the eval runner, results storage and dashboards, and help the team decide what to build and what to buy. * Implement end\-to\-end tracing and observability, so any request can be followed across services from prompt to audio. * Manage model provider routing, fallback, rate limits and cost controls. * Partner with engineering teams across Suno to onboard them onto the platform with docs and hands\-on support, and with Infra on the reliability and scale of the agent runtime. * Help more people turn ideas into music by making it faster and safer for teams across Suno to ship agent features. **What You'll Need** ==================== **Must\-Haves** --------------- * 4–6 years building and scaling backend or platform systems in production, in any language. * Experience on a team that supports other developer teams, including building a platform, API or SDK that other teams adopted. * Experience with production LLM or agent systems, for external or internal users. * Depth in distributed systems and observability, including tracing across services. * Comfort working with internal customers: scoping with partner teams, earning adoption and handling ambiguity. **Nice\-to\-Haves** ------------------- * Experience building an eval or tracing product. * Experience running LLM gateway or model routing infrastructure. * Experience writing SDKs that other teams use. * Experience with Python backends. **Work Location Policy** ======================== This role is expected to work from the designated Suno SF office 5 days a week, per Suno's company policy. Full\-time employees will receive competitive equity packages, and comprehensive benefits. The actual base salary offered may vary depending on location, skills, qualifications, and experience. Listen to the Suno version of this role! https://suno.com/s/bxgQXsn06Vz3KKEn **Additional Notes** ==================== Applicants must be eligible to work in the US. **Perks \& Benefits for Full\-Time Employees** ============================================== * Company Equity Package * 401(k) with 3% Employer Match \& Roth 401(k) * Medical, Dental, \& Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA \& FSA options) * 11 Paid Holidays \+ Unlimited PTO \& Sick Time * 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave * Creative Education Stipend * Generous Commuter Allowance * In\-Office Lunch (5 days per week) **Compensation** ================ * $228K\- $363K Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the Massachusetts Fair Chance in Employment Act, NYC Fair Chance Act, LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. Compensation Range: $228K \- $363K

jobs.description: **Company** **Name****:** tastytrade **Role:** Data Engineer **Location:** Chicago, IL (Hybrid, 3 days/week) **About the Role** We're looking for a Data Engineer to join our Analytics team. You'll own data pipeline architecture, upskill those around you, and have real influence on how we build our data platform. You'll be part of a full stack data team of data scientists, data engineers, and analysts who take full ownership of our data pipelines and feature generation. This is a full\-scope role: you'll design systems, make tech decisions, ship, and iterate. If you have a good idea and can execute it, we'd love to learn from you. Our team works with Snowflake, dbt, Airflow, Tableau, Python, AWS (S3, ECR, EKS), GitHub, ArgoCD, Elementary, and Grafana. **What** **You'll** **Do** * Design and build scalable data pipelines using dbt, Python, Airflow, and Snowflake to support business processes, such as our executive reporting dashboards * Own pipeline architecture and performance, and drive strategic initiatives to improve our data platform * Make architectural decisions, including schema design, tool selection, and trade\-offs * Own data quality and observability, and build the infrastructure that keeps our data right * Write ELT code using modern data engineering practices, including Git and automated testing and deployments * Debug production data issues when they break (and they will) * Process, clean, and validate data from a variety of external sources and internal data pipelines * Lead ad\-hoc analysis using internal and external data sources to help teams understand how customers interact with our products * Collaborate with upstream data producers (Software Engineering/DevOps) and downstream data consumers (Marketing, Product, and Leadership) * Contribute to data visualization and reporting efforts in Tableau * Upskill those around you through code review, design collaboration, and knowledge sharing * Optimize performance, improve processes, and level up team practices **Who You Are** * You have 2\-5 years of professional data engineering experience * You have expert SQL skills: you think in queries and optimize ruthlessly * You have real dbt experience, meaning actual production work and not just exposure * You write solid Python, with production code rather than scripts * You have hands\-on experience with Airflow (or Prefect/Dagster) * You have experience with a cloud data warehouse (Snowflake, BigQuery, or Redshift) * You understand the data product lifecycle, standards, and practices * You know your way around data quality functions like cleansing, standardization, parsing, and validation * You can design systems and lead projects * You communicate clearly with non\-engineers and engineers alike * You're proficient with version control (Git/GitHub) and command line interfaces **Preferred Qualifications** * Kubernetes or infrastructure\-as\-code experience * CI/CD and DevOps practices * Data quality frameworks (Elementary, Great Expectations, Monte Carlo) * Financial services background Advanced Airflow patterns and custom operators * * Experience with agile development practices and the project lifecycle **Company Perks \+ Benefits:** * Performance Bonuses * Stock Purchase Options * Medical/Vision/Dental Benefits * 401k Plan * 20 Paid Vacation Days (plus an additional paid vacation day the month of your birthday!) * 10 Paid Sick Days * Gym Membership Reimbursement * Commuter Benefits * Pet Insurance * Wellness \& Mental Health Programs * Charitable Donation Matching * Two Paid Volunteer Days Off * Daily catered lunch when in the office * Full kitchen with snacks and beverages In\-building gym * * Shuttle to/from Metra **Base Salary Range:** $130,000\-$150,000 *The actual salary offered will be based on the candidate's level of experience and qualifications.* **Discretionary Performance Bonus:** 8\-12% of base salary based on individual and company performance. **About IGNA \+ tasty** IG North America is home to tastytrade, tasty*live \&* tastyfx—a family of brands built to democratize trading and empower individual investors. Founded in Chicago by the creators of thinkorswim, acquired by London\-based IG Group in 2021, we combine startup innovation with the backing of a FTSE 100 fintech operating across five continents serving over 1\.3m customers and handling billions of dollars in transactions – built on scale, trust, and proof. From our headquarters in Chicago's Fulton Market, our team builds award\-winning trading platforms, produces live financial education content daily, and creates technology that makes complex markets accessible. tastytrade is our retail brokerage for self\-directed investing and trading, with tasty*live* providing content to educate our customers. tastyfx is the fastest\-growing forex broker in the US. tastycrypto provides self\-custody digital wallets for decentralized finance. We're a lean, collaborative team that values autonomy, pragmatism, and impact. Whether you're building technology, creating content, serving customers, or supporting operations, you'll work alongside people who are passionate about disrupting traditional finance and genuinely care about helping traders succeed. Our culture rewards initiative, embraces experimentation, and measures success by the value we create for our users. The bar is high – bring a curious and forward\-thinking mindset and we'll give you the platform to define what comes next. Join us at IG\|tasty – the future gets built here. **Location:** Our office is in the West Loop \- Chicago's growing center of tech, great cuisine, and high\-end bars. **tastytrade** **\|** **tasty*****live*** **\|** **tastyfx** 1330 W Fulton Market, Chicago, IL 60607
